title: Project Manager
description:
**Job Title**
 Project Manager
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 This role involves full ownership of end\-to\-end project delivery, leading multidisciplinary teams to successfully execute commercial and residential base build projects. The Project Lead is accountable for planning, execution, budgeting, procurement, quality, safety, and stakeholder end\-to\-end co\-ordination and monitoring, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and budget. The position demands strong leadership, strategic planning, risk management, and cost optimization skills to achieve operational excellence and client satisfaction.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
* Take full ownership of large\-scale commercial and residential base build projects from initiation to completion
* Develop and implement strategic project plans, detailed schedules, and budgets
* Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams including contractors, consultants, architects, and internal stakeholders
* Oversee procurement processes, contract administration, and vendor management
* Ensure compliance with quality, safety, statutory, and regulatory standards across all project activities
* Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, and implement proactive corrective actions
* Monitor project performance using KPIs, dashboards, and progress reports, ensuring timely course correction
* Maintain proactive communication with clients, investors, and stakeholders, providing regular updates and addressing concerns
* Resolve critical project issues and conflicts efficiently to prevent delays and cost overruns
* Optimize resource allocation and implement process improvements to enhance operational efficiency
* Drive cost management, budget control, and financial accountability across all projects
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget while maintaining high standards of quality and client satisfaction
* Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including reports, contracts, approvals, and compliance records
* Promote best practices, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across all project teams


**About You**
* B.E. in Civil Engineering with a master’s degree in project management (PMP certification preferred/required)
* 12 to 18 Years \& above of relevant experience
* Should have completed at least 8 \- 10 institutional/University/residential along with infra works projects end to end during the tenure
* Candidate working with Project Management Consultancy would be preferred
* Technical awareness of civil, electro\-mechanical, and architectural works
* Excellent organizational and motivational skills
* Outstanding attention to detail and observation ability
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities


**Why join Cushman \& Wakefield?**
 As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman \& Wakefield means you will benefit from;
   

  

* Being part of a growing global company;
* Career development and a promote from within culture;
* An organisation committed to Diversity and Inclusion


 We're committed to providing work\-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.
   

  

 We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster a promotion from within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.
   

  

**We have a vision of the future, where people simply belong.**
*That's why we support and celebrate inclusive causes, not just on days of recognition throughout the year, but every day. We embrace diversity across race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or persons with disabilities or protected veteran status.*

title: SAP Project Manager
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 Own the end\-to\-end SAP and enterprise applications landscape for the organization. Drive digital transformation, process standardization, and operational excellence across manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and commercial functions. Identify and implement new technologies to leverage IT for business benefits. Act as the strategic partner to business leaders and the Sr. GM IT / CFO for all SAP\-related initiatives.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* **Strategy \& Governance**



  




* Define and execute the SAP roadmap aligned to business strategy, including S/4 HANA evolution, RISE / cloud strategy and integration with non\-SAP systems
* Establish governance frameworks for change management, release management, master data, security, and compliance (including DPDP Act and internal controls
* Drive process standardization and best practices across plants and business units, leveraging SAP standard functionality wherever possible



  




* **Delivery \& Operations**



  




* Lead end\-to\-end SAP implementations, upgrades, and migrations (ECC → S/4HANA, Greenfield / Brownfield), ensuring on\-time, on\-budget delivery with quality
* Oversee day\-to\-day operations of SAP and key business applications (ITIL/SDLC\-based), including incident, problem, and change management, and vendor
* Ensure seamless integration between SAP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, QM, PM, WM/EWM, PS, etc.) and with MES, SCADA, PLM, BI, and other enterprise systems.



  




* **Manufacturing \& Domain Leadership**



  




* Partner with COO, Plant Heads, and Supply Chain leaders to align SAP architecture with production planning, capacity planning, shop\-floor automation, and MRP processes
* Provide deep expertise in discrete / process manufacturing concepts: BOMs, routing, work centers, production orders, quality inspections, maintenance plans, and cost controlling
* Drive digital manufacturing initiatives (e.g., shop\-floor data capture, IoT integration, advanced analytics, AI/ML, RPA) on SAP BTP and allied platforms



  




* **Team \& Vendor Management**



  




* Build and lead a high\-performing team of functional, technical, and basis consultants, as well as support staff; drive capability building and succession planning
* Manage relationships with system integrators, vendors, and partners, negotiating contracts, monitoring performance, and ensuring value realization



  




* **Risk, Security \& Compliance**



  




* Own application security, role design, SoD controls, and data protection in line with corporate policies and regulatory requirements
* Ensure audit readiness and support internal/external audits with appropriate documentation and controls



  




* **Reporting and Relationships**



  




* **Reports to:**
* Sr. GM (IT) / CFO



  




* **Direct reports:**
* SAP functional leads, technical leads, support managers, and project managers



  




* **Key stakeholders:**
* COO, Plant Heads, CFO, CHRO, Supply Chain Head, Quality Head, and external partners



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Qualifications \& Experience
* 15–20 years in SAP and enterprise applications, with at least 2 full\-cycle SAP implementations in complex manufacturing setups
* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP S/4 HANA (implementation and / or migration) and deep knowledge of core modules: FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, QM, PM; exposure to PS, WM /EWM, and Group Reporting is preferred
* Proven track record managing large teams (10\+) and multi\-plant, multi\-location rollouts



  




* **Education**
* Graduate or Postgraduate in Engineering, Finance, Marketing or Material Management



  





**Required Skills** 



* Skills and Competencies
* Domain: Manufacturing operations, supply chain, finance \& controlling, project systems, and plant maintenance
* Technical: SAP S/4HANA, ECC, SAP BTP, integration middleware, basic ABAP understanding, analytics (e.g., SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, Superset / Grafana)
* Leadership: Strategic thinking, stakeholder management, negotiation, team building, and executive communication
* Transformation: Digital transformation, automation (RPA / AI), cloud strategies (SAP RISE), and continuous improvement mindset

 to provide operational support, maintain critical logistics information, monitor shipment progress, and proactively manage delivery risks and operational challenges.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in
 **logistics, transportation, dispatch, warehousing, and supply chain operations** 
 , along with strong SAP knowledge and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across international markets.
   

  

 This role is based in
 **Chennai** 
 and operates on a
 **12:00 PM to 9:00 PM IST shift.**
 The working week is
 **Saturday to Thursday** 
 , with
 **Friday as the weekly off** 
 .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 🔹 Shipment Planning \& Coordination
   

  

* Coordinate daily dispatch and shipment activities based on customer orders and delivery schedules.
* Plan and arrange transportation for shipments from factories to customer locations across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and other relevant Middle East and African markets.
* Work closely with the Head of Logistics to support day\-to\-day logistics planning, execution, and operational decision\-making.
* Act as an operational support and coordination point for the Head of Logistics, maintaining critical shipment, transportation, and logistics information.
* Ensure timely availability of vehicles, transportation resources, and logistics partners required for shipment execution.
* Maintain updated contact details and records of transport vendors, drivers, logistics partners, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Track shipments from dispatch through delivery and proactively identify, report, and resolve potential delays, disruptions, and delivery risks.
* Coordinate closely with warehouse teams to ensure packing, loading, documentation, and dispatch readiness.
* Maintain effective communication with internal teams and multi\-national stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of logistics operations.
* Maintain strong governance and visibility across the end\-to\-end supply chain and logistics process.
* Develop a strong understanding of business operations and ensure timely fulfilment of customer and business commitments.


 🔹 Transportation \& Logistics Management
   

  

* Manage and coordinate transportation activities across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and other Middle East and African markets.
* Liaise with transport vendors, third\-party logistics providers, drivers, warehouses, factories, and destination teams to ensure smooth shipment execution.
* Monitor vehicle movement, shipment status, delivery schedules, and transportation performance.
* Proactively identify transportation risks and coordinate appropriate corrective actions to minimise delivery disruptions.
* Resolve transportation delays, vehicle availability issues, and delivery\-related challenges in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure effective coordination between factories, warehouses, transporters, drivers, customers, and destination teams.
* Support effective management of freight, transportation resources, shipment tracking, and delivery performance.
* Maintain accurate records of transportation activities, shipment status, delays, and operational issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation efficiency, service levels, and supply chain performance.


 🔹 Supply Chain Operations \& SAP
   

  

* Leverage strong SAP knowledge to support logistics planning, shipment execution, reporting, and day\-to\-day supply chain operations.
* Ensure timely and accurate updates of shipment and logistics information within relevant systems.
* Monitor supply chain activities and maintain visibility across the order, dispatch, transportation, and delivery cycle.
* Prepare and maintain logistics and supply chain reports covering shipment status, delivery performance, delays, transportation activities, and operational risks.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure accurate flow of information across the supply chain.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and support initiatives focused on process improvement, supply chain efficiency, and operational governance.
* Ensure adherence to established processes, controls, and governance requirements across logistics operations.


 🔹 Stakeholder \& Vendor Management
   

  

* Maintain strong relationships with transport vendors, logistics partners, warehouse teams, factory teams, customers, and internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate effectively with stakeholders across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
* Serve as a key coordination point between the Head of Logistics and operational stakeholders.
* Ensure timely communication of shipment status, operational challenges, delays, and critical escalations.
* Escalate significant logistics and supply chain issues to the appropriate stakeholders with relevant information and recommended actions.
* Support effective stakeholder communication to ensure continuity and smooth execution of logistics operations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with logistics partners to support reliable transportation and service delivery.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 15–20 years of experience in logistics, transportation, dispatch, warehousing, or supply chain operations.
* Strong experience working in manufacturing, factory, warehouse, distribution, or FMCG environments.
* Extensive experience in shipment planning, transportation coordination, logistics operations, and supply chain management.
* Experience managing logistics operations across international or multinational markets is preferred.
* Candidates with strong exposure to Middle East and Africa logistics operations will be preferred.
* Arabic\-speaking candidates will be given priority.


**Required Skills**
* Strong understanding of transportation, logistics, distribution, and end\-to\-end supply chain processes.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP and proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Experience in logistics reporting, shipment tracking, freight management, and transportation coordination.
* Strong knowledge of dispatch planning, delivery management, warehouse coordination, and transportation operations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coordination, and relationship management skills.
* Strong customer\-service orientation with the ability to manage internal and external relationships effectively.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* High attention to detail with a strong focus on process governance, operational control, and supply chain visibility.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operational challenges in a fast\-paced, international environment.
* Strong ownership and accountability for shipment execution, delivery commitments, and logistics performance.
* Ability to work effectively with multi\-national teams and stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* Strong understanding of freight management and shipment tracking systems.
* Arabic language proficiency will be a significant advantage.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in the FMCG industry.
* Exposure to logistics and supply chain operations across the Middle East and Africa region.
* Experience managing shipments to Saudi Arabia, Egypt, GCC countries, or African markets.
* Experience working with international transportation vendors and logistics partners.
* Strong exposure to SAP\-based supply chain and logistics operations.
* Arabic language proficiency.
* Experience supporting or working closely with a Head of Logistics, Supply Chain Director, or senior supply chain leadership.

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview**
 The Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys and manages a risk\-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates a global security operations center that monitors, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents.

 B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech/B.Sc./M.Sc./BCA/MCA (prefer IT/CS specialization)
   

  

**Certifications If Any** 
 : NA
   

  

**Experience Range :** 
 7\+ years

* Previous Application Programming/Development Lead experience in designing, developing and deploying high\-volume, multi\-tiered, distributed transactional applications.
* Experience working in Agile SCRUM development process and a comprehensive understanding of various phases of Software Development Lifecycle.
* A disciplined thinker and capable of working across organizational boundaries in a very demanding, high\-output environment.
* Ability to communicate, written and verbal, with technical and non\-technical cross\-functional teams.
* Strong skills in design and developing robust Java, RESTAPI, and Micro Services. Proficiency in Spring / SpringBoot.
* Experience in UI development with React

title: Software Development Manager, Books Purchase and Payment Experience
description:
**Description**
 Join us as we reinvent the books purchase experience of millions of customer across worldwide.
   

  

 The Amazon Books Purchase and Payments Experience team is looking for an experienced software development manager who is passionate about developing challenging and elegant software solutions, customer\-centric products, and building a team and product from scratch. You will be leading a team of engineers who work on tier 1 services, agentic commerce, payments, basket building CX, retail ordering and AWS Systems . Expect to be challenged!
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have an established background building and managing large scale systems, great communication skills, a proven track record of building best\-in\-class engineering teams, and the ability to innovate and deliver in a fast paced environment. This person will also be responsible for ensuring various system\-level and business\-level SLAs are met, while maintaining an unrelenting focus on quality, throughput and innovation. This person will have regular interactions with various internal business\-owners, external publishers/institutes to help understand priorities of tasks/projects, handling system issues and managing communication across all stakeholders.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You are a leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly, and who has a track record of building cohesive and inclusive teams that deliver results.
   

  

 You also love growing individuals and are invested in the success of each member of your team.
   

  

 You enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment, partnering with peers and stakeholders to solve challenging business and technical problems.
   

  

 You have a solid customer focus and advocate for their needs in product development, roadmap prioritization, requirements and design reviews, and in operational support.
   

  

 You have a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and agile development processes.
   

  

 You pave the way for innovation and know how to think big and invent and simplify. This role requires creative engineering and collaboration with your team.
   

  

 As a technical leader, you understand the technology your team owns, are willing to dive deep in to technical details, and can provide feedback and technical guidance to your team on design and architecture decisions.
   

  

 You collaborate with technical leaders and senior developers across the org to build scalable, distributed systems.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* 5\+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 5\+ years of engineering team management experience
* Experience partnering with product and program management teams
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience working with or evaluating AI systems


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree
* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: QRM - Contract Specialist - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**National Consulting Services**
 The National Office, a key Strategic Enablera in our new model, is comprised of professionals with various areas of focus that collectively provide mission critical services to support Deloitte’s overall success. Whether focused on project financials, quality and risk management, methods and tools, sales excellence, talent, leadership support, or other activities these professionals ensure that our Firm operates efficiently, and our people are able to effectively serve clients every day.
   

  

**Position Summary**
**Level:** 
 Senior Consultant
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 The Contract Specialist will engage in contractual matters related to account\-level agreements and subordinate, engagement\-specific documents for complex information technology (IT) services (e.g.,Technology Preferred Provider (TPP) relationships and managed services). The Contract Specialist will provide support ranging from contractual compliance / administrative matters, contractual research related to business issues that intersect one or more contracts, and reviews of customized contract documents (Statements of Work (SOWs), Work Orders and Change Orders). The Contract Specialist will work closely with the US Risk Managers to help manage contractual matters related to client\-facing IT contracts and non\-standard subcontracting agreements.
   

  

 The Contract Specialist will be primarily responsible for matters related to contractual administration and compliance and will maintain contractual currency for dynamic contracts. The Contract Specialist will team with the US Risk Manager(s) to interact with other functions (e.g., Office of General Counsel (OGC); Information Security (InfoSec); Office of Confidentiality and Privacy (OCP); Contigence Workforce Services (CWS)) to orchestrate integrated support and guidance for Deloitte’s client teams to address policies and procedures, contractual obligations, and regulatory compliance, as applicable.
   

  

 Service capabilities provided by the Contract Specialist will help identify contractual risks and mitigations and deploy structured contract management processes for compliance with contractual commitments and deliverables.
   

  

* Provide guidance and support to Deloitte account teams post contract execution for multi\-tiered contractual relationships for complex IT services (e.g.,TPP accounts and subordinate services engagements)
* Prepare MSA summaries (for business use), engagement summaries, obligations trackers, and contracting guidebooks
* Identify key contractual terms and requirements, including obligations and deliverables
* Periodically assess currency / compliance (together with the US Risk Manager(s)) and report on contractual obligations and deliverables
* Perform thorough research of tiered contracts in connection with business issues or disputes
* Prepare analysis of potential options for resolution / response with contractual support provided
* Work with the US Risk Manager(s) to distil complex business issues that intersect one or more contracts
* Analyze and assess potential impacts associated with contractual issues and disputes
* Support development of contract management tools, including: negotiated templates, contracting guidebooks, and methods and processes essential for successful compliance during delivery of engagements
* Provide contractual compliance / administrative support and guidance (e.g., capture, track / monitor, and document compliance with contractual obligations; maintain conformed contracts by applying change orders and amendments for both client and subcontractor contracts; prepare routine notices that are contractually\-required)
* Review and provide input to subordinate statements of work, work orders, and complex change orders by reviewing for contractual clarity and promoting Risk mitigations
* Provide support for customized subcontracting arrangements, working closely with the US Risk Managers to ensure all subcontracts include applicable prime contract flow\-down provisions
* Help prepare for periodic Engagement Reviews where contractual matters are involved
* Support US Risk Managers with contract closeout processes (including for partial terminations) by assisting with guidance to account / engagement PMOs for offboarding checklists; assist with document archival instructions and address return of confidential information, declaration of proprietary works, and transfer of software licenses
* Perform other ad hoc Risk and Contract management support activities as required


**The team:**
 The mission of Quality and Risk Management (QRM) is to manage the risk in our growing and increasingly complex business to improve financial performance and protect the firm’s assets and reputation.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Possess 6\+ years of post\-qualification experience in risk and contract management
* Proficiency in the use of MS Office \- Word, basic Excel, and PowerPoint
* Experience working on full Contract Lifecycle (IT/ITES)
* Experience working on IT operations and managed services agreements
* Experience working on commercial contracts
* Experience in identifying contractual risks and suggesting risk mitigations
* Exposure to contract language and risk mitigations associated with access to highly confidential client information including PII/PHI
* Experience in identifying business risks
* Excellent analytical and presentation skills
* Good relationship management skills
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills
* Proactive approach in performing duties, problem solving, and issue resolution


**Education:**
* Law graduate


**Location:**
* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. title: Director of Software Development India, Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies
description:
**Description**
 Interested in shaping the future of conversational and ambient AI at massive scale? Join the Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies (AACT) team. AACT's mission is to design, build, and operate the core horizontal services that power Alexa as the world's largest IoT installation and the most capable, efficient, and trusted AI assistant. We deliver the core capabilities that allow Alexa to connect, discover, set up, manage, and interface with over 1B connected endpoints (Echo, FireTV, Smart Home, Mobile, and Metis). Our work directly impacts every Alexa\+ customer interaction, and we're obsessed with making it fast, reliable, and efficient \- increasingly by putting generative AI and agentic systems at the center of how we build and operate.
   

  

 We're seeking a Director of Software Development to own all India\-based charters and teams. This role will manage AACT's charter and lead our teams based in Bangalore and Chennai consisting of SDMs, SDEs, TPMs, and SQEs. This leader will recruit and develop high\-caliber leaders and individuals and will set the standard for how an AI\-first engineering organization operates \- where large language models, agents, and AI\-assisted development are integral to strategy, execution, and day\-to\-day engineering.
   

  

 The successful candidate will demonstrate strong intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and creativity in solving complex, ambiguous technical problems, along with the ability to lead and scale large technical teams and influence across functions to drive results through others in a highly cross\-functional environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and drive technical strategy for critical initiatives — whether that's expanding Alexa into new modalities, enabling more fluid multi\-turn conversations, or evolving our inference and orchestration infrastructure to support both.
* As part of the AACT Senior Leadership team, set the India sites' strategy and lead software engineering teams.
* Own Operational Excellence (OE) for AACT India\-based charters — accountable for the availability, latency, security, and cost efficiency of the services your teams operate, including on\-call, incident response, COEs, and driving continuous operational improvements at scale.
* Champion the responsible adoption of generative AI and agentic tooling across the org — in the products you ship (LLM\-driven experiences, orchestration, inference) and in how your teams build (AI\-assisted coding, review, testing, and operations) — while owning the quality, safety, cost, and latency tradeoffs that come with it.
* Build the talent, mechanisms, and culture that let a large organization move quickly and safely with AI, raising engineering leverage and productivity without compromising customer trust or operational excellence.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience.
* 8\+ years of demonstrated experience managing senior engineering managers.
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team.
* Experience collaborating across multiple organizations and influencing key outcomes.
* Experience as a technical leader of multiple concurrent projects, driving strategic technical decisions.
* Understanding software engineering practices and best practices for the full software development life cycle including coding standards, build processes, testing, and operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in computer science or related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading product and development teams, with a focus on customer service or user\-facing technologies.
* Experience in a lead role in bringing a product to market.
* Proven track record of taking emerging technologies from research to production\-ready solutions.
* Familiarity with generative AI models and their application in customer interactions and process automation.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* AI Leadership Competencies \-We expect a director at this level to be fluent in AI as both a product capability and an engineering multiplier. Specifically:
* AI fluency and technical judgment — A working understanding of modern generative AI: LLMs, foundation models, prompting, fine\-tuning/RAG, agents and tool use, evaluation, and inference optimization. Able to engage credibly with scientists and senior engineers, ask the right questions.
* AI strategy and prioritization — Able to identify genuine, durable AI opportunities and to translate them into a prioritized, measurable roadmap tied to customer and business outcomes (latency, cost\-per\-interaction, trust).
* Driving AI\-assisted engineering productivity — Actively raises the leverage of the org by adopting AI\-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Sets expectations, mechanisms, and guardrails so teams use these tools effectively and consistently, and measures the impact on throughput and quality.
* Cost, latency, and scale economics of AI — Understands the economics of inference at scale and drives the right tradeoffs across model selection, orchestration, caching, and infrastructure to keep experiences fast, reliable, and efficient.
* Talent and culture for an AI\-first org — Attracts, develops, and retains leaders and builders who thrive in an AI\-native environment, and fosters a culture of experimentation, learning, and responsible innovation.

title: Project Head
description:
The Project Head will be responsible for the overall planning, execution, monitoring, quality control and timely completion of all construction projects undertaken by the company. The role requires complete ownership of project sites, coordination with internal departments, contractors, consultants and management, while ensuring adherence to quality standards, budgets and timelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Construction Quality Management**

Ensure the highest standards of construction quality across all projects. Monitor and approve the quality of materials used at project sites. Conduct regular inspections to verify compliance with approved specifications. Identify quality deviations and implement corrective measures immediately. Maintain quality control records and reports.

**2\. Project Planning \& Execution**

Oversee end to end execution of construction activities. Prepare and monitor project schedules, milestones and completion targets. Ensure projects are delivered within approved timelines and budgets. Anticipate project risks and proactively implement mitigation plans.

**3\. Drawing Review \& Approvals**

Review architectural, structural and MEP drawings in detail. Coordinate with the MD, VP, consultants and architects for approvals related to design modifications, corrections and project enhancements. Ensure all site activities are executed as per approved drawings and specifications. Recommend improvements based on site requirements and practical feasibility.

**4\. Site Management**

Take complete responsibility for project sites and construction activities. Supervise site engineers, contractors, supervisors and labor teams. Ensure proper workforce allocation and productivity management. Monitor daily progress and resolve site related issues promptly. Ensure safety standards and compliance at all times.

**5\. Cross Functional Coordination** Coordinate with Sales, CRM, Legal, Finance, Procurement, Marketing and Administration departments to ensure smooth project execution. Facilitate timely approvals, material procurement, payments and statutory compliance. Conduct regular review meetings and provide updates to management.

**6\. Material \& Procurement**

Oversight Verify material specifications before procurement. Ensure procurement of quality materials at competitive prices. Coordinate with procurement teams for timely material availability. Monitor inventory utilization and prevent material wastage.

**7\. Competitor \& Market Analysis**

Conduct regular analysis of competing real estate projects. Study construction methodologies, amenities, materials, layouts and design trends adopted by competitors. Recommend innovative construction practices and value additions to improve project competitiveness. Prepare competitor benchmarking reports for management review.

**8\. Technical Expertise \& Monitoring**

Maintain in\-depth knowledge of all construction activities, including civil, structural, finishing, infrastructure and utility works. Review minute technical details and ensure compliance with engineering standards. Guide site teams on technical issues and best construction practices. Monitor project documentation and technical records.

**9\. Management Reporting**

Submit weekly and monthly progress reports to MD and VP. Highlight project achievements, risks, delays and corrective actions. Provide recommendations for improving efficiency, quality and cost control.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of construction methodologies and project execution.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management abilities.
* Budgeting and cost control knowledge.
* Proficiency in MS Office, AutoCAD and project management software

**Experience**

* 10–15\+ years of experience in real estate construction and project management.
* Minimum 5 years in a senior leadership role managing multiple projects.
* Experience in villa, plotted development, residential, commercial or township projects preferred.

Pay: ₹70,000\.00 \- ₹150,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Interior Project Manager
description:
Role Overview

The Interior Project Manager will be responsible for the **end\-to\-end execution of assigned interior projects**, ensuring that projects are delivered within the agreed **scope, timeline, budget and quality standards**.

The role involves close coordination between the **Design Team, Project Engineering Team, Factory/Manufacturing Team, vendors, contractors, suppliers and clients**.

The ideal candidate should be highly organised, technically strong, proactive in problem\-solving and comfortable taking ownership of multiple moving parts on an interior project.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Project Planning \& Execution

* Take complete ownership of assigned interior projects from design handover to final completion.
* Review the approved design, drawings, BOQ, scope of work, specifications and project requirements before execution.
* Prepare and maintain project execution schedules and milestones.
* Break down projects into activity\-wise execution plans and monitor progress against timelines.
* Coordinate dependencies between civil, electrical, carpentry, modular furniture, painting, false ceiling, flooring, plumbing and other trades.
* Identify potential execution bottlenecks in advance and take corrective action.
* Ensure projects progress according to the approved sequence and schedule.

2\. Site Management

* Conduct regular site visits and monitor day\-to\-day execution.
* Coordinate with site labour/contractors.
* Ensure site activities are executed as per approved drawings and specifications.
* Verify dimensions, levels, alignment, installation and workmanship.
* Coordinate site readiness before commencement of each activity.
* Ensure proper protection of completed works and materials at site.
* Maintain site discipline, cleanliness and safe working practices.

3\. Design \& Technical Coordination

* Review drawings and designs before execution and identify technical or site\-related issues.
* Coordinate with the Design Team to resolve design clarifications and site constraints.
* Ensure that no deviation from approved drawings is executed without appropriate approval.
* Coordinate site measurements and verify critical dimensions before manufacturing or installation.
* Ensure coordination between 2D drawings, 3D designs, BOQ, cutlists and actual site conditions.
* Identify design\-to\-execution gaps and communicate them proactively to the relevant team.

4\. Vendor \& Contractor Management

* Coordinate and manage contractors, installers, fabricators and specialised vendors.
* Allocate work and establish expected completion timelines.
* Monitor contractor performance, productivity and workmanship.
* Ensure vendors adhere to Antara Haus quality and execution standards.
* Coordinate material delivery, installation and rectification activities.
* Track pending works and ensure timely closure.
* Escalate persistent vendor performance or quality issues.

5\. Procurement \& Material Coordination

* Coordinate sourcing of required materials to ensure availability as per project schedule.
* Prepare and communicate material requirements sufficiently in advance.
* Track material orders, expected delivery dates and site requirements.
* Verify received materials against specifications and quantities where required.
* Identify material shortages, damages or specification mismatches immediately.
* Coordinate urgent procurement requirements to prevent project delays.
* Ensure materials are properly stored and handled at site.

6\. Quality Control

* Maintain high standards of workmanship across all project activities.
* Conduct regular quality inspections at critical stages.
* Check dimensions, alignment, finish, detailing, installation and functionality.
* Ensure modular furniture and site works meet approved design specifications.
* Identify defects and coordinate rectification with the responsible contractor/vendor.
* Maintain snag lists and track closure of all observations.
* Conduct pre\-handover quality inspections and ensure all punch\-list items are closed.

7\. Client Coordination

* Act as the primary project execution point of contact for the client where required.
* Communicate project progress, upcoming activities and site requirements clearly.
* Coordinate client approvals required for execution.
* Manage expectations regarding timelines, site conditions and execution requirements.
* Escalate design changes, scope changes and potential cost/time impacts to management before committing.
* Ensure client concerns are recorded, assigned and closed systematically.
* Maintain a professional and solution\-oriented relationship with clients.

8\. Project Cost \& Scope Control

* Ensure execution remains within the approved project scope and BOQ.
* Identify additional works, variations and scope changes before execution.
* Obtain appropriate approval for changes before committing resources or costs.
* Monitor material wastage and avoid unnecessary rework.
* Coordinate with the management/accounts team regarding project\-related commercial matters where required.

title: Mars Statutory Transformation Europe Lead
description:
**Job Description**
 The
 **Mars Statutory Transformation Europe Lead** 
 is responsible for leading statutory financial reporting, local regulatory compliance, and statutory reporting requirements across European countries as part of a global SAP S/4HANA transformation program. The role serves as the primary Finance and Controllership SME for European statutory reporting requirements, ensuring local GAAP, IFRS, financial statement, disclosure, and regulatory reporting obligations are incorporated into the SAP S/4HANA global template. The individual partners with Corporate Finance, Regional Controllers, Tax, IT, Shared Services, and System Integrators to design, test, and deploy compliant statutory reporting processes and technologies (e.g. SAP DRC reporting or other statutory reporting solutions).
   

  

**What are we Looking For?**
* 8\+ years of experience in statutory financial reporting, controllership, external reporting, or financial accounting.
* Strong knowledge of European statutory reporting obligations and local GAAP requirements.
* Deep understanding of IFRS reporting and European regulatory reporting requirements.
* Experience supporting SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA Finance transformations.
* Experience with statutory reporting technologies such as SAP DRC, ONESOURCE Statutory Reporting, Workiva, CCH Tagetik, BlackLine, or similar solutions.
* Strong understanding of Record\-to\-Report (R2R), financial close, consolidation, and external reporting processes.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Universal Journal, parallel ledgers, financial statement versions, and reporting architecture.
* Experience with Statutory Fixed Asset requirements in SAP
* Proven experience defining statutory reporting requirements and leading testing and deployment activities.
* Experience supporting multi\-country European deployments within a global template model.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills across Finance, Controllership, Tax, IT, Shared Services, and external auditors.
* Experience managing compliance risks, governance processes, and complex transformation programs.
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related discipline.
* CPA, ACA, ACCA, CA, or equivalent accounting qualification preferred.


**What are the Key Responsibilities?**
* Lead the Europe statutory reporting workstream for SAP S/4HANA design, build, testing, and deployment.
* Serve as the primary SME for statutory financial reporting requirements across European jurisdictions.
* Define and validate local GAAP, IFRS, statutory financial statement, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Ensure European statutory requirements are incorporated into the global S/4HANA template while balancing standardization and localization.
* Partner with Controllership, Record\-to\-Report (R2R), Tax, Consolidation, and Finance teams to align reporting requirements.
* Define statutory reporting requirements related to legal entities, ledgers, charts of accounts, account mappings, and financial statement hierarchies.
* Lead requirements and design reviews for SAP DRC, ONESOURCE Statutory Reporting, and other statutory compliance reporting technologies.
* Support finance design decisions involving parallel accounting, local GAAP adjustments, statutory journals, and reporting structures.
* Establish statutory reporting governance, controls, and compliance monitoring procedures.
* Assess the impact of new accounting and regulatory requirements on SAP processes and reporting solutions.
* Lead statutory reporting testing, defect management, business validation, and sign\-off activities.
* Support deployment readiness, cutover planning, hypercare, and stabilization activities.
* Collaborate with country finance teams to ensure local compliance requirements are fully addressed.
* Preferred SAP S/4HANA Transformation Experience:
+ Led statutory reporting workstreams for European SAP S/4HANA deployments.
+ Defined reporting requirements across key European jurisdictions including EU and non\-EU markets.
+ Designed statutory reporting solutions leveraging SAP S/4HANA Universal Journal and parallel ledger capabilities.
+ Implemented SAP DRC, ONESOURCE Statutory Reporting, or similar regulatory reporting solutions.
+ Defined requirements for local statutory financial statements, disclosures, and regulatory filings.
+ Led statutory UAT, defect management, cutover, deployment readiness, and hypercare activities.
+ Supported global template governance while ensuring country\-specific statutory compliance.
+ Collaborated with Finance GPOs, Regional Controllers, Tax, and System Integrators throughout the program lifecycle.
+ Supported audit readiness and external audit requirements during deployment and post\-go\-live operations.


**Key Deliverables**
* Approved European statutory reporting requirements and design decisions.
* Country statutory reporting requirement inventories and localization assessments.
* Local GAAP and IFRS reporting requirements documented and incorporated into solution design.
* SAP DRC, ONESOURCE Statutory Reporting, or equivalent compliance solution requirements and deployment sign\-off.
* Financial statement hierarchy, disclosure, and account mapping requirements.
* Statutory reporting process flows, operating procedures, and governance documentation.
* Statutory controls framework and compliance monitoring processes.
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans, scripts, execution results, and defect resolution tracking.
* Country\-specific statutory reporting readiness assessments.
* Executive reporting on statutory reporting readiness, compliance risks, and key decisions.
* Go\-live readiness and post\-production support plans.
* Knowledge transfer materials and operational support documentation.


**What can you expect from Mars?**
 Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles. Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today. A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in\-house Mars University. An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus

title: Events Platform Manager
description:
**Job Title: Events Platform Manager**
* Location: Hyderabad


**About Sanofi**
 We are an innovative global healthcare company, committed to transforming the lives of people with immune challenges, rare diseases and blood disorders, cancers, and neurological disorders. From R\&D to sales, our talented teams work together, revolutionizing treatment, continually improving products, understanding unmet needs, and connecting communities. We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing Progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world.
   

  

 Sanofi has currently the best and most robust pipeline of R\&D and consequent new launches in our history. The Go\-to\-Market Capabilities Team was organized to consolidate business operations efforts globally across all business units with an eye to create efficiencies that fund our pipeline and prepare us to drive multiple new product launches as we strive to materialize the miracles of science to improve people's lives.
   

  

**About The Job**
 The Events Platform \- Manager role is a part of the Go\-to\-Market Capabilities (GTMC), Customer Facing Capabilities (CFC), CRM \& Enablers team. The GTMC organization drives best\-in\-class capabilities and brings value and excellence in commercial operations. The GTMC organization is a key part of the modernization of Sanofi and allows all business operations efforts to be focused on Sanofi "Take the Lead" priorities across products, markets, and pipelines. It accomplishes these goals through realizing the efficiencies of removing silos that exist between our business units, avoiding the duplication and overlapping of resources, standardizing our processes and tools, operating with a One Sanofi approach to accelerate our key capabilities development, and fostering the entrepreneurial spirit by speeding up the decision\-making process.
   

  

 This role serves as the technical authority for Events and Congresses platform operations within OneCRM US, supporting the strategic vision for event platform capabilities, data governance, and system evolution. This leader ensures system enhancements operate as intended and advises on scalable event platform solutions that support multi\-brand, multi\-market launch requirements, ensuring enterprise\-wide compliance, data integrity, and continuous platform transformation across all Promotional and Non\-Promotional event types (Speaker Meetings, Displays, Product Theaters, Scientific Education Programs, and Speaker Trainings etc.).
   

  

 This position will work closely with CRM \& Enablers Team members in the US, US\-based stakeholders, Hyderabad HUB resources, contracted system enhancement resources, Sales, Marketing, Medical, Field Engagement Management, Business Operations, Compliance, other GTMC pillars, Veeva, and Sanofi Digital to support the end\-to\-end design, governance, and evolution of the Events and Congresses platform across the OneCRM US ecosystem. This leader serves as a strategic partner across the enterprise, supporting platform direction, data governance standards, User Acceptance testing and operational frameworks that underpin compliant, high\-performing event execution at scale.
   

  

 Main Responsibilities
   

  

* Support the strategic vision and roadmap for Events Management platform capabilities across OneCRM US, ensuring alignment with enterprise Events \& Congress standards and business priorities
* Serve as the technical lead for Veeva Events and Congresses enhancement user acceptance testing and issue investigation/resolution, overseeing service ticket process and driving associated improvements to the process
* Identify and recommend scalable event platform solutions supporting multi\-brand Speaker Meetings, Displays, Product Theaters, Scientific Education Programs, and Speaker Trainings across multiple markets and business units
* Drive enterprise\-wide data discrepancy investigation and correction for Compliance and Transparency events data, establishing data quality standards and reconciliation frameworks for transparency, compliance, and data integrity across all event types and downstream systems
* Ensure accurate end\-to\-end event platform frameworks and processes — including topic management, speaker profiles, budgets, and nomination and content submission tools — that scale with organizational growth and platform evolution
* Mentor the events platform operations team, providing technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and career development support that elevates individual and team capability
* Influence technical decisions across requirements gathering, system enhancements, and UAT for major platform initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, compliant, and fit for enterprise purposes
* Contribute toshape of the long\-term roadmap for Events and Congresses platform evolution and integration with downstream systems, including iCare, transparency, FMV, GRF, and contracting
* Lead change management efforts for Service Ticket (ESM) enhancements and evolution, driving adoption and alignment across field teams, Field Engagement Management, and business stakeholders including the creation of knowledge based articles.
* Drive capability building across the broader CRM community through structured knowledge sharing, best practice development, and train\-the\-trainer programs
* Partner with Field Engagement Management, Sales, Marketing, Medical, Compliance, and Business Operations to influence event platform strategy and ensure the platform meets evolving business requirements
* Oversight of service/incident ticket process for events , establishing performance measurement frameworks and continuous improvement approaches that drive platform excellence
* Investigate and remediate escalated inquiries, applying technical expertise to resolve complex issues and prevent recurrence through systemic process improvements
* Drive cross\-functional collaboration across partner GTMC US teams, ensuring event platform strategies are integrated with broader CRM and Global Events and Congress initiatives and enterprise data standards
* Partner with internal and external vendor technical teams to ensure platform readiness


**About Our Team**
 The CRM \& Enablers Team is a part of the GTMC organization in the US. The CRM \& Enablers Team strives to support our business customer facing teams by delivering innovative CRM capabilities that are timely, reliable, accurate, and constantly improving. We focus on our customers — both brand teams and customer facing teams — to adapt our CRM platform and operational systems to meet their needs. Our efforts to streamline and maintain OneCRM US bring value and impact to the organization by reducing the manual workload on our customer facing teams, by providing accurate activity data back to reporting systems, and acting as the nexus of data flow to and from Sanofi data systems. This team operates as a strategic partner to the business, driving platform excellence and enabling compliant, high\-impact field engagement at enterprise scale.
   

  

**About The Candidate**
 This candidate has a demonstrated track record of leading technical teams, influencing enterprise platform strategy, and designing scalable event platform solutions across multiple business units and product launches. They bring deep expertise in Veeva Events and Congresses, data governance, and compliance requirements — including PhRMA guidelines and transparency reporting — combined with the ability to translate complex technical platform requirements into enterprise\-wide operational frameworks. This leader has experience architecting event management solutions, driving process transformation, and building organizational capability at scale. They are skilled at influencing senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Medical, Compliance, and Field Engagement Management, navigating complex matrix environments, and shaping platform strategy across concurrent launch programs. Strong English communication skills and availability to engage with US stakeholders with significant operational hour overlap are essential.
   

  

 Ideal Experience
   

  

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited four\-year college or university (Project Management Masters or MBA preferred)
* 7\+ years of progressive events platform and CRM operations experience with demonstrated leadership
* 7\+ years of experience in Biotechnology or Pharmaceuticals
* Proven track record of leading technical teams and driving strategic platform initiatives across enterprise\-scale programs
* Experience in solution architecture for event management platforms and CRM systems
* Advanced expertise in data governance, compliance requirements (PhRMA guidelines), and data integrity across events and transparency reporting
* Strong knowledge and experience with Veeva Events and Congresses, Agile processes, and event management systems
* Deep understanding of the events ecosystem including transparency, FMV, GRF, contracting, and field engagement integration
* A keen eye for improvement opportunities and the demonstrated ability to deliver on these opportunities
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain not only the requirements and the "ask", but also the "why" with credibility
* Motivated, energetic, and a respected contributor who engages and elevates others
* Ability to change behaviors to evolve to the company's strategies and initiatives
* Experience working and thriving in a matrix environment
* Strong English communication skills with the ability to engage and align diverse stakeholders across geographies and functions

title: Operations Fulfilment Manager
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 AdOnMo is one of India's largest and fastest\-growing Out\-of\-Home (OOH) advertising companies, backed by marquee investors like Zomato, Ant Financial, and Astarc Ventures.
 



 We operate a vast and expanding network of 33,000\+ digital screens (outside lifts) and 20,000\+ static frame posters (inside lifts) across 24\+ major cities, including Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Pune, Chennai, Kochi, Jaipur, and more.
 



 Our ad formats are installed in high\-visibility public locations, including:
 


* Residential societies
* Corporate buildings and coworking spaces
* Cult.fit gyms
* Goa beaches
* Shopping malls
* Bike parking areas with branded standees and digital hoardings



 We work with 2,000\+ brands, including Amazon, IKEA, Meta, and Zomato, helping them build real\-world visibility through innovative and targeted outdoor advertising campaigns.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an Operations Fulfilment Manager to join the Acumen team and take ownership of the fulfilment journey end\-to\-end.
 



 The role will involve coordinating closely with production, warehouse, installation, Operations and Customer Success teams to ensure orders move as planned, timelines are met, and client escalations are resolved effectively.
 



 The ideal candidate should be organised, dependable, hands\-on, and comfortable working across multiple teams, with strong ownership of execution and follow\-through.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Experience: 3\+ years



  





  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* *1\. Own Fulfilment End\-to\-End*
* Track every order from production and dispatch through delivery, installation and go\-live.
* Maintain complete visibility on the status of every open order.
* Ensure orders progress through each stage as planned and are successfully closed.



  




* *2\. Drive Coordination and Timelines*
* Work closely with Production, Warehouse, Installation, Operations and Customer Success teams.
* Identify potential delays and bottlenecks early.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure orders move as planned and timelines are met.



  




* *3\. Own Client Escalations*
* Take complete ownership of client escalations related to fulfilment.
* Communicate clearly and calmly with stakeholders.
* Drive issues through to closure and ensure that escalations do not remain unresolved.



  




* *4\. Keep the Team and Process on Track*
* Support the existing Operations team in managing day\-to\-day fulfilment activities.
* Maintain a simple, accurate and up\-to\-date order tracker.
* Follow up on pending actions and ensure clear accountability for every next step.
* Maintain visibility on pending orders and ensure timely follow\-ups.



  




* *5\. Identify and Improve Recurring Issues*
* Identify patterns and recurring challenges in the fulfilment process.
* Proactively highlight issues to leadership.
* Suggest practical process improvements to reduce recurring fulfilment challenges and improve operational efficiency.



  





  





  





**Required Skills** 



* 3\+ years of experience in Operations, Fulfilment, Client Delivery, Service Delivery or a similar role.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end fulfilment or delivery processes.
* Strong coordination skills with the ability to work across multiple teams.
* Experience handling client/stakeholder escalations and driving them to closure.
* Strong follow\-up and execution skills.
* Comfortable maintaining trackers, monitoring pending actions and managing multiple orders simultaneously.
* Ability to identify operational challenges and suggest practical solutions.
* Highly organised, dependable and hands\-on approach to work.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with multiple priorities.



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience in a similar Operations, Fulfilment, Service Delivery, Client Delivery, Logistics, Installation or Project Execution role would be preferred.



  





  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




 AdOnMo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Manager, SCM-Business Excellence
description:
Build a career with confidence
   

  

 Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world\-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.
   

  

 Title: Manager, SCM\-Business Excellence
   

  

**About The Role**
 Leads team of intermediate to experienced Procurement professionals, setting objectives and guiding others on RFPs, negotiation strategy, cost accountability, and/or program execution. Reviews prices, manufacturing processes, and contracts and makes recommendations for changes to ensure a successful procurement process.
   

  

 The Manager, SCM – Business Excellence: Data \& Process Transformation will lead the supply chain transformation agenda across Productivity \& Cost Savings, Price Change Governance, Payment Terms, and Master Data (Vendor Master \& Supplier Onboarding). This role demands deep experience in supply chain operations, strong people leadership, and the ability to execute high\-impact programs that drive measurable business value.
   

  

 The Manager will own strategy, design, and execution of supply chain data and process transformation initiatives spanning procurement, sourcing, and category management, including price change governance, payment\-term centralization, vendor master management, and supplier onboarding, with direct accountability for portfolio delivery across global sites and stakeholders. The role includes managing a team of specialists/analysts, leading cross\-functional programs, and partnering with global supply chain, finance, and operations leaders to deliver scalable, digitally enabled business solutions.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Manages execution of processes, standards, and operational plans in support of Procurement strategy, including RFPs, negotation strategy, cost accountability, and/or program execution.
* Directs programs for effective vendor selection and management with a view to minimize purchasing costs without compromising quality or reliability of supply.
* Reviews changes in price trends and manufacturing processes and makes recommendations to ensure successful procurement process.
* Manages resolution of client issues or problems.
* Monitors and coordinates suppliers to schedule or expedite deliveries to ensure resolution of problems such as shortages and missed or late deliveries.
* Authorizes purchase orders, negotiates prices and approves payments to support the procurement process in large territories.
* Reviews and assesses request for proposals (RFP) and bid packages.
* Analyzes and monitors contract performance to ensure compliance with contractual obligations and to help determine need for changes.


**Responsibilities**
* Strategy \& Leadership in Process Transformation
* Define and own the transformation roadmap across the core pillars: Productivity \& Cost Savings (reporting, value\-capture tracking \& automation), Price Change / Price Updating Governance, Master Data governance \& standardization (vendor master, item, and contract data), Supplier Onboarding centralization, and Payment Terms \& Working Capital optimization (DPO, 1x centralization).
* Lead a team of specialists/analysts and drive portfolio execution against business targets for these pillars: \-
* Productivity \& Cost Savings: Centralize productivity and cost\-savings reporting across factory, indirect, and logistics sites; run the stage\-gate / value\-capture process end to end, and identify and recover clawbacks and missed opportunities to convert pipeline into realized savings.
* Master Data \& Vendor Master: Standardize and govern supplier, vendor, item, and contract master data; own data quality, validation rules, and de\-duplication to maintain a clean, reliable vendor master consistent across systems and regions.
* Payment Terms \& Working Capital: Expand payment\-term (DPO) initiatives, centralize 1x governance, and target WAPT improvements with measurable working\-capital impact.
* Supplier Onboarding: Centralize and simplify the supplier onboarding process; standardize intake, documentation, and data setup with clear SLAs and controls to enable faster, compliant onboarding across regions.
* Price Change / Price Updation Governance: Own the end\-to\-end price change process and controls; ensure timely, accurate price updation in the system with the right approvals, audit trail, and exception management, working closely with category, materials, and finance teams.
* Analyze end\-to\-end supply chain processes to identify structural improvement opportunities; drive strategic changes to improve cost, speed, compliance, and operational resilience.
* Lead, coach, and develop specialists/analysts; allocate resources, prioritize work, and review deliverables to ensure high\-quality outcomes and meet business milestones.
* Reporting, Governance, and Oversight
* Lead the design and implementation of Power BI/Excel dashboards for executive\-level analytics, insights, and business metrics across procurement and inbound supply chain.
* Own the governance model for critical procurement metrics, including cadence, definitions, and alignment with finance and category teams.
* Drive transformation and centralization of reporting with a strong focus on automation, data integrity, and auditability.
* Own procurement master data quality KPIs and governance processes, ensuring consistency across systems (e.g., SAP/Oracle) and regions.
* Advanced Stakeholder \& Team Management
* Act as the primary point of contact for global and regional procurement, category management, and sourcing leaders on master data and reporting topics.
* Align transformation projects with business priorities; provide regular updates to senior leadership on progress, risks, and impact.
* Promote effective collaboration and communication across global teams; facilitate workshops and steering meetings to harmonize processes and standards.
* Influence stakeholders to adopt standardized processes, data definitions, and tools, balancing global governance with local business needs.
* Technical Competencies \& Advanced Analytics
* Oversee the use of Excel, ERP, Power BI, and other tools for scalable enterprise reporting and analytics.
* Lead advanced analytical initiatives driving business value across the key projects owned.
* Sponsor and guide automation and system\-integration efforts to reduce manual work and improve data reliability.
* Champion digital and analytics innovation in supply chain reporting and master data (e.g., standardization, data quality rules, exception management, and workflow).


**Qualifications**
* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.
* 12\+ years’ experience in supply chain or manufacturing, with significant exposure to data/process transformation, procurement, sourcing, and category management.
* Deep expertise in supply chain management, master data governance, procurement analytics, and operational finance with hands\-on experience in data quality initiatives and reporting automation.
* Proven experience managing teams (5\+) and leading complex programs or transformation initiatives in a global environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; advanced experience with Power BI, ERP systems (SAP/Oracle), and emerging digital tools strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated track record of driving transformation, simplifying complex data landscapes, and delivering measurable business impact.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive organizational change.
* High learning agility, accountability, and strong collaboration skills across cross\-functional and cross\-regional teams.


 Additional Comments
   

  

* Full time role

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.****

title: Engineering Planner I
description:

**Job Purpose**
