title: Sr Manager, Procurement Platform Excellence
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for
 *all* 
 .**
 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
   

  

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.**
 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
   

  

 The Global Procurement team is an integral engine to Micron’s growth, delivering best\-in\-class total cost and supply chain resiliency through innovative predictive capabilities, risk analysis, and a focus on sustainability and diversity. Our business goals are directly tied to the value we place on our team members, our greatest asset. We invest in our people through a skills\-based learning and development model to create clear career pathways for growth. Join us and discover why Micron’s Global Procurement team is the preferred destination to ignite your talent.
   

  

 As Senior Manager, Platform Excellence within Global Procurement’s Center of Excellence Digital Transformation \& AI organization, you drive the Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) platform strategy and roadmap and lead end\-to\-end management of the S2P platform landscape. This is a collaborative role: you shape one coherent S2P platform direction together with your peer Senior Managers for S/4HANA Transformation, AI Transformation, Data \& Process Automation, and Data Excellence \& Governance. Your portfolio spans sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure\-to\-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and the analytics and reporting platforms used by the data analytics team, and you lead a team based in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

 This is not a SAP or ERP configuration role. The SAP S/4HANA and Ariba transformation is driven by a separate team; you partner closely with them so the S2P platform landscape integrates cleanly with the ERP core and enterprise systems, and every platform decision reinforces one coherent, standardized S2P experience. Similarly, new AI transformation products that are still at an early, incubation stage sit with the AI Transformation team — your accountability is the established S2P platform portfolio and how it is run, integrated, and adopted.
   

  

 You set direction and priorities and own value realization measured in real business terms — productivity, adoption, cycle time, and decision quality. You bring strong product and user\-centered discipline to how the portfolio is run: grounding decisions in user personas, journeys, and end\-to\-end processes, and owning supplier\-supported and third\-party products end\-to\-end, including escalation, supplier performance (reviews, SLAs, demos), licensing, renewals, and end\-of\-life transitions.
   

  

 This is a people\-leadership role. A core part of your mandate is to move platform operations from reactive, ticket\-driven support to a proactive, agent\-embedded model, and to embed product and user\-centered discipline across the portfolio. You develop a team of platform and product professionals and partner closely with AI Transformation, Data \& Process Automation, Data Excellence \& Governance, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Compliance. GP\-centric platform products are owned here end\-to\-end; enterprise\-wide systems and IT infrastructure remain with IT — the role does not perform software development or manage infrastructure.
   

  

**▍** 
**Key Responsibilities**
 A core expectation is to run Global Procurement’s Source\-to\-Pay platforms as products — end\-to\-end, value\-driven, well\-integrated, and adopted — while moving platform operations toward a proactive, agent\-embedded model.
   

  

**Platform Strategy \& Value Optimization**
* Own the end\-to\-end S2P platform portfolio strategy and roadmap — including the analytics and reporting platforms — framing business problems into clear product strategies that maximize outcomes over outputs.
* Prioritize opportunities and make build\-versus\-buy\-versus\-partner trade\-offs, sequencing platform investment against S2P Reimagined and ERP transformation milestones.
* Track value through real business indicators — productivity, adoption, cycle time, and decision quality — and engage stakeholders on investment decisions and supplier and technology trends.


**End\-to\-End Platform Leadership \& Lifecycle**
* Lead and be accountable for the S2P platform portfolio across its full lifecycle — sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure\-to\-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and analytics platforms — setting clear direction and adapting priorities as needs evolve.
* Own supplier\-supported and third\-party products for GP\-centric solutions, including escalation, supplier performance management (reviews, SLAs, demos), licensing, renewals, and end\-of\-life transitions.
* Apply product\-management fundamentals — budgeting, cost\-versus\-value trade\-offs, and lifecycle planning — to keep platforms fit\-for\-purpose as scale and complexity grow, while keeping GP\-centric solutions PM\-owned and enterprise\-wide systems with IT.


**Platform Operations, Integration \& Health**
* Own platform stability, configuration, release, environment and test, and incident and problem management across the S2P landscape.
* Ensure the S2P platforms integrate cleanly with the SAP S/4HANA and Ariba ERP core and enterprise systems, so data, controls, and processes flow reliably end\-to\-end.
* Establish platform health KPIs, service levels, and monitoring, and shift from reactive support to proactive, increasingly self\-healing platforms — with agents handling detection, triage, routing, and routine configuration and testing.


**Analytics Platforms, Adoption \& Product Performance**
* Product\-manage the analytics and reporting platforms used by the data analytics team — ensuring the tooling is reliable, well\-integrated, and fit\-for\-purpose, while analytics outputs and insights remain owned by the data analytics team.
* Instrument platforms to measure usage, adoption, and value, and use those signals to refine roadmaps and features.
* Define what “good adoption” means beyond usage — decision confidence, reduced rework, and behavior change.


**User\-Centered Solution Design**
* Ground solutions in user personas, journeys, and end\-to\-end process understanding, balancing usability, feasibility, business value, and enterprise constraints.
* Challenge low\-value features and over\-customization; advocate scalable, standard\-driven design and consistent interaction patterns across S2P tools and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Anticipate adoption risks and continuously improve solutions based on user behavior and usage signals.


**Stakeholder Engagement, Enablement \& Change**
* Engage stakeholders, build trust, and bring people along through change; translate needs into clear action plans and resolve issues through influence and partnership.
* Own the platform enablement and support model — training, documentation, self\-service, and a responsive support experience across regions.
* Embed change management into the product journey and drive adoption through clear, simple, actionable communication.


**Innovation \& Agent\-Embedded Ways of Working**
* Reimagine platform operations and enablement with agents embedded — platform support copilot, configuration and testing agents, integration\-monitoring agents, and enablement copilot.
* Sponsor rapid experiments, validate impact, and turn the best into reusable building blocks for broader adoption across Source\-to\-Pay.


**Team Leadership \& Enterprise Partnership**
* Lead, coach, and develop a Hyderabad\-based team; build depth, ownership, and succession, and coach the team for a product\-led, agent\-embedded operating model.
* Partner across DTAI pillars, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Compliance, and functional Global Procurement teams, and represent the platform agenda in program reviews and executive readouts.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for platform stability, integration, and adoption risks, translating complex dynamics into clear decisions and tradeoffs for senior stakeholders.


**▍** 
**Leadership Expectations**
 This leader is expected to embody Micron’s core values and set the tone for the team:
   

  

**People**
 Care for each other — build an inclusive, high\-trust team; develop talent, grow capability, and plan succession within the team.
   

  

**Innovation**
 Shape the future — run platforms as products and champion agent\-embedded ways of working; experiment, learn fast, and scale what works.
   

  

**Tenacity**
 Nothing shakes our resolve — own platform stability, integration, and adoption outcomes end\-to\-end through complex, cross\-system challenges.
   

  

**Collaboration**
 Aligned to win — break silos across DTAI, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and the business; win as one team across time zones.
   

  

**Customer Focus**
 Partner and win together — treat procurement stakeholders and end\-users as customers; design for their journeys and deliver adopted, high\-value platforms.
   

  

**Speed**
 Act with purpose and set the pace — make timely, well\-reasoned decisions and move prioritized platform work from pilot to scale without losing rigor.
   

  

**▍** 
**Leadership Competencies**
* Product \& value judgment: Frame problems into value\-driven strategy, prioritize outcomes over outputs, and make build\-versus\-buy\-versus\-partner calls with clarity.
* User\-centered \& adoption mindset: Design for real user journeys and adoption, not just delivery, and define value beyond usage.
* Talent \& coaching: Develop, coach, and grow a multi\-region team; build bench strength and succession within the function.
* Cross\-cultural leadership: Work effectively across U.S. and Asia cultures and time zones, partnering with globally distributed stakeholders and peers.
* Influence \& partnership: Lead through influence across IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders without direct authority.
* Executive communication: Translate complex platform, integration, and product topics into crisp, decision\-ready narratives for senior leaders.
* Change leadership: Drive adoption of new platforms and agent\-embedded ways of working through enablement and change management.
* Outcome ownership: Set direction, prioritize ruthlessly, and hold the function accountable for measurable stability, adoption, and value.


**▍ Minimum Requirements**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
* Experience — depth: 13\+ years in enterprise platform, digital product, or Source\-to\-Pay application management, including 5\+ years leading platform or digital product delivery and operations and 3\+ years leading teams.
* Experience — scale: At least 5 years in a large, multi\-region enterprise (5,000\+ employees), including environments running on SAP (ECC and/or S/4HANA).
* Experience — domain: Deep, hands\-on ownership of a Source\-to\-Pay platform landscape (several of sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure\-to\-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and procurement analytics platforms), with close working knowledge of how these integrate with an SAP S/4HANA and Ariba ERP core.
* Product management: Proven end\-to\-end product ownership — vision, roadmap, prioritization, and value realization — with a track record of driving outcomes over outputs.
* Supplier / third\-party product management: Managing supplier\-supported products, including escalation, SLAs, performance reviews, licensing, renewals, and end\-of\-life transitions.
* Analytics \& adoption: Working knowledge of analytics and business intelligence (Power BI or Tableau) and of instrumenting products to measure adoption and value.
* Integration: Proven experience integrating SaaS platforms with an ERP core — APIs, middleware, connectors, and cross\-system data and controls.
* AI / agentic ways of working: Experience defining requirements for, or embedding, AI agents into platform operations, support, configuration, testing, or enablement.
* Cross\-functional leadership: Proven ability to lead through influence across IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders without direct authority on enterprise\-scale, multi\-region initiatives.
* Ways of working: Able to collaborate across U.S. and Asia time zones, including regular overlap with U.S.\-based stakeholders and partners.


**▍ Preferred Requirements**
* Product management certification (Pragmatic Institute, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager, or equivalent).
* Hands\-on experience with Source\-to\-Pay or procurement platforms (SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, GEP, Icertis, or Ironclad) and procurement analytics platforms.
* Experience reimagining platform operations and enablement with AI or agents embedded.
* Service management (ITIL) and Agile or DevOps ways of working for enterprise applications.
* Depth in Source\-to\-Pay and Procure\-to\-Pay processes and the broader procurement platform landscape.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Company Description**
 Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What you'll be doing**
 You will be the architecture owner for Experian's global video conferencing estate and collaboration spaces, driving standardization and lifecycle governance across 400\+ video conferencing units and our global refresh roadmap. Architect and govern the refresh program, aligned to the $1\.2M allocated budget. The program executes prioritization based on site strategy (Grow/Maintain/Retire), technology lifecycle status (including TLMP\-driven replacements), and room usage/telemetry. This prioritization focuses investment on high\-value rooms. This role will own room standards, VC platforms/devices, monitoring/telemetry, lifecycle/refresh execution architecture, and site readiness planning w/ local facilities teams. You will report to a Senior Director.
   

  

**Summary Of Primary Responsibilities**
* Own global VC/Rooms architecture \& standards: Define room typologies, standard bills of material, supported device classes (including standardization toward MTR patterns), configuration baselines, and supportability guardrails.
* FY27 lifecycle refresh governance (budget\-aligned): Architect the FY27 refresh plan using lifecycle/usage/site strategy and manage quarterly prioritization and rebalancing aligned to the $1\.2M allocation and quarterly budget phasing.
* EoL/risk management for decommissioned devices: Drive remediation for restricted\-state/EoL devices (e.g., impacted Cisco models listed as decommissioned/restricted) and ensure sequencing reduces user impact and operational risk.
* "Replace on failure" and non\-planned remediation architecture: Define technical standards and governance for emergency replacements and quality enhancements due to unexpected site changes, room remodels, device/peripheral failures, or accessory requirements.
* Monitoring \& proactive operations enablement: Expand monitoring approaches and define quality/performance telemetry standards to proactively address support gaps and reduce escalations.
* Network and SD‑WAN dependency management (room readiness): Architect readiness and validation patterns for network changes that impact VC rooms (e.g., SD‑WAN upgrades requiring on‑site testing of all units; dynamic implementation dates; site testing quantities and readiness discipline).
* Facilities/site leader engagement: Partner with Facilities leads to confirm competing plans, validate site strategy, and ensure refresh deployments align to workplace changes and constraints.
* Vendor technical leadership \& platform transition planning: Lead technical evaluation across VC ecosystems (including Webex upgrades/major platform changes and onboarding automation where applicable) and ensure alignment to global standards and support models.


**Qualifications**
* 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise video conferencing / AV / collaboration spaces architecture, including global standardization and refresh programs.
* Proven track record managing lifecycle transitions and EoL/EoS remediation across a large VC estate, using telemetry/usage insights to prioritize investments.
* Strong cross\-functional delivery leadership—comfortable operating at the intersection of Workplace/Facilities, Network, and UC Engineering/Operations to deliver room readiness and consistent user experience.
* Strong program governance and operational discipline


**Additional Information**
 Our uniqueness is that we truly celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what truly matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, engagement, collaboration, wellness, reward \& recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's strong people first approach is award winning; Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, FORTUNE Best Companies to work and Glassdoor Best Places to Work (globally 4\.4 Stars) to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site to understand why.
   

  

 Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Innovation is a critical part of Experian's DNA and practices, and our diverse workforce drives our success. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, color, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.
   

  

 Experian Careers \- Creating a better tomorrow together
   

  

**Recruitment Fraud Awareness** 
 \- Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Experian care for employee's work life balance, health, safety and wellbeing. In support of this endeavor, we offer best\-in\-class family well\-being benefits, enhanced medical benefits and paid time off.

title: Consulting Practice Leader
description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment**
* Gathers customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders as well as the main business sponsor to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects. Identifies and evaluates industry trends (customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry). Adapts business models, plans, and solutions to insights.
* Works with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach to determine if changes are needed to the business solution. Where the cost of change is accepted by the customer, shares this feedback with the project team and the broader account team to make the necessary adjustments using mechanisms such as updating the solution approach and projected costs in presales and change requests in delivery. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
* Uses evidence\-based approach to represent the customer/partner as a customer advocate and shares insights with Product Engineering teams and the business with a view to improving Microsoft technologies, products, services, and offerings such that they can better meet customer/partner needs across a territory.


**Architecture Design and Deployment**
* Leverages a structured approach to Architecture Projects using existing methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, Iterative) that make use of existing reference architecture and established architectural styles and design patterns. Proposes and develops new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners. Builds and maintains an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to ensure the rationale for the business solution's Architecture is known and understood.
* Defines and documents the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Leads complex cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the Architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Uses a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution.
* Collaborates with the Project Manager to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots, using enterprise architecture processes and ensuring quality control through peer review. Works with customers to understand and demonstrate business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realize.
* Works with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Manages and resolves complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Maintains the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Drives development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer. Where there are defects, works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Customer to redress or accept and document the status of the test results.
* Collaborates with the Account Team and/or Bid Team to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex Solution Approach with traceability of requirements, constraints, decisions, and tradeoffs that balances risk, technical credibility, and technical innovation to meet customer need, predominantly based on existing solution offerings and/or reference architecture. Jointly leads the implementation in close partnership with the Project Manager. Leads oversight and governance and establishment of quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Uses a cohesive build methodology with an agreed release schedule and timeline so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Works with the Project Manager to highlight where assumptions have proven false. Uses change requests to modify the Solution/project approach when needed. As needed, collaborates with subject matter experts to receive specialized advice that can help define the Solution and project approach and increase the time to value for the customer.
* Anticipates and identifies scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Orchestrates the broader Microsoft team to address technical blockers and works with account/project team to resolve non\-technical issues. title: Creative Lead
description:
**About WPP Production**
 We are WPP Production \- the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world\-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi\-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

**What does a Create Lead at WPP Production do?**
 We are seeking a highly creative and driven Creative Team Lead to inspire and manage a team of talented designers, copywriters, and other creatives. You will be responsible for overseeing the creative development and execution of high\-impact campaigns for our prestigious clients. This role demands a strong understanding of brand strategy, visual communication, and the ability to translate marketing objectives into compelling creative solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities** 
 :
   

  

* Design Direction: Lead the creative process from concept to completion, ensuring all work aligns with client briefs, brand guidelines, and overall strategic objectives and work closely with Art Director / Brand\-guardian team.
* Team Management: Manage, mentor, and motivate a team of creatives, fostering a collaborative and inspiring work environment. Conduct performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and identify opportunities for professional development.
* Client Collaboration: Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, presenting creative concepts, addressing feedback, and ensuring client satisfaction.
* Project Management: Oversee project timelines, budgets, and resource allocation, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within budget.
* Innovation \& Inspiration: Stay up\-to\-date on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices. Encourage experimentation and innovation within the team.
* Quality Control: Review and approve all creative deliverables, ensuring the highest standards of quality and consistency.
* Brand Stewardship: Develop a deep understanding of client brands and ensure all creative work accurately reflects their values and messaging.


**Key Responsibilities:**
* Bachelor's degree in Design, Advertising, Marketing, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in a creative leadership role, preferably within an agency setting.
* Proven track record of developing and executing successful marketing campaigns for world\-class brands. Strong portfolio showcasing a diverse range of creative work.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma and GEN AI.


**Why work here:**
 At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world\-class talent, cutting\-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next\-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.
   

  

**Inclusion and Impact**
 WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

**Data**
 We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

description:

**Position Summary**

 Our Human Capital team helps Deloitte client service teams support value creation through people's performance. We guide teams in reimagining work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise, and help in transforming HR functions with AI and emerging technology. title: Architect Manager
description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 People Management
   

  

 Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.
   

  

 Model \- Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.
   

  

 Coach \- Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.
   

  

 Care \- Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.
   

  

 Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
   

  

 Provides support for their team in gathering and propagating customer/partner insights to help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Holds teams accountable for mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business outcomes, and ensures that proposed solutions are aligned with broader organizational strategy. Leverages prior work, customer/partner insights, and industry trends, and shares insights with team to apply.
   

  

 Supports their team in working with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach. Advises team on managing changes and facilitating feedback. Uses broad patterns of feedback to develop strategic and actionable insights and presents a compelling business case to program managers that influences product roadmaps and decision making. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
   

  

 Drives internal advocacy by facilitating insight sharing with Product Engineering teams, and providing guidance through escalation, acceleration, and prioritization. Looks across multiple customers/partners for opportunities to consolidate and prioritize items across the business. Mentors peers and teams on best practices around internal resources usage. When appropriate, establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams.
   

  

 Architecture Design and Deployment
   

  

 Holds teams accountable for leveraging existing architecture approaches to achieve Microsoft's agreed commitments to the customer/partner and developing new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners and markets. When appropriate, governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.
   

  

 Guides team in defining and documenting the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix. Ensures team is equipped to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Guides team in cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Promotes a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. Provides coaching to allow architects to scale solutions. Support new customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft, as needed.
   

  

 Collaborates with the other managers to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots. Provides end\-to\-end governance, oversight, and thought leadership within assigned account. Provides guidance to team in understanding and demonstrating business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes.
   

  

 Guides team in working with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Supports team in managing and resolving highly complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Ensures maintenance of the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Oversees development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer.
   

  

 Leads team in collaborating to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Ensures team builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex solution approach. Provides thought leadership on oversight and governance sets expectations for quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Promotes a cohesive build methodology so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams. When appropriate, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes. Challenges deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately. Communicates current view of delivery to customer executives on regular cadence, as needed. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. Innovates and implements long\-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the portfolio, as needed. Ensures delivery team alignment and holds delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.
   

  

 Creates a culture and clarity around technical insights and escalations, and ensures broad sets of projects move forward. Provides support and guidance to team in identifying scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Anticipates blockers and resolves escalations as needed and coaches team on best practices for handling escalations. Ensures that issues and blockers and addressed by the appropriate groups. Identifies widespread patterns in blockers across business areas or territories. Develops strategies to prevent blockers and issues in the future. When necessary, attends steering committee meetings with strategic customers to remove blockers and ensure delivery success.
   

  

 Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to anticipate, identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. Outlines methodology and governance principles and practices for the broader organization that allows others to minimize risks.
   

  

 Practice Development

* CSCO, CMC, Quality, Finance, CMO Project Managers and Procurement team

title: Controls Manager Associate
description:
**Job Description**
 Join Controls and help strengthen KYC and onboarding outcomes through strategic testing, data\-driven insights, and smart automation. Work hands\-on with large datasets and AI\-enabled tools to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and increase transparency. Build your career in a high\-impact role that partners across business, technology, and corporate functions to protect the firm and clients.
   

  

 As a Strategic Testing Control Manager – Associate within Client Onboarding \& Documentation (CO\&D) Controls, you execute control reviews and testing to ensure KYC/onboarding activities align with firm standards, operational policies, and regulatory requirements. You identify control gaps and BAU operational breaks through data\-driven testing, audit\-ready documentation, and proactive reviews. You drive AI\-enabled simplification and automation— including LLM\-based controls and prompt engineering—to improve testing consistency, accelerate turnaround times, and enhance controls monitoring.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Execute control testing across KYC/client onboarding processes, including CDD/EDD documentation completeness and evidence standards.
* Perform proactive reviews triggered by regulatory, audit, or risk/control partner engagements.
* Assess adherence to policies, laws, regulations, and internal guidelines across LOBs and corporate functions.
* Document scope, sampling approach, results, evidence, and conclusions in an audit\-ready manner.
* Identify control gaps, operational breaks, and recurring themes; support root\-cause discussions and remediation tracking.
* Communicate results, trends, and systemic issues through clear reporting and executive\-ready summaries.
* Simplify and streamline testing and documentation processes using AI\-enabled tools, including LLM\-based solutions.
* Translate testing requirements into prompt engineering patterns and reusable prompt templates for evidence checks and issue summarization.
* Embed AI into BAU monitoring to surface breaks and control gaps proactively with appropriate governance.
* Maintain deep understanding of KYC/onboarding risk drivers and continuously improve testing methods and standards.
* Identify automation opportunities and contribute new ideas that strengthen continuous learning and innovation.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Hold an MBA, CA, or postgraduate qualification in Finance/Banking.
* Bring 7\+ years of experience in financial services risk domains such as KYC/AML, financial crimes, operational risk, audit, or client onboarding.
* Demonstrate strong ownership mindset with proactive execution and ability to operate independently.
* Lead stakeholder discussions confidently, ensuring follow\-through and timely closure of actions.
* Apply strong knowledge of KYC lifecycle, documentation standards, and key control points.
* Produce clear written and verbal communication, including executive\-ready summaries with strong attention to detail.
* Analyze large datasets efficiently to identify trends and patterns and translate them into control insights.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Leverage prior control testing experience across first line testing, second line oversight, or internal audit.
* Apply control design concepts and root\-cause analysis to drive sustainable remediation.
* Use LLMs in control testing for documentation quality checks, issue identification, and summarization with strong prompt engineering.
* Utilize Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, UiPath, Pega, and Python to automate testing and reporting workflows.
* Demonstrate strong critical thinking and problem\-solving to resolve complex control questions.
* Collaborate effectively with teams across multiple locations and time zones with flexible working hours.
* Standardize prompt libraries and testing templates to improve consistency and reduce variability.


**ABOUT US**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. title: HVAC Equipment Service Technician 5
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Service Manager – Applied HVAC Chiller is responsible for leading the service operations business for centrifugal, screw, scroll, and absorption chillers across the assigned region. This role involves managing a team of service engineers, technicians, and supervisors while ensuring customer satisfaction, operational excellence, revenue growth, service contract management, and adherence to safety and quality standards.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise in applied HVAC systems, chillers, controls, and mechanical systems, combined with proven people management and customer relationship skills.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Service Operations Management
   

  

* Manage end\-to\-end service delivery for applied HVAC chiller equipment.
* Oversee planned preventive maintenance (PPM), breakdown service, troubleshooting, repairs, retrofits, and modernization projects.
* Ensure timely response and resolution of customer service requests and complaints.
* Monitor service KPIs including response time, first\-time fix rate, uptime, contract renewals, and customer satisfaction.
* Drive operational efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.


 People Leadership \& Team Management
   

  

* Lead, coach, develop, and motivate a team of service engineers, supervisors, and technicians.
* Conduct performance reviews, talent development discussions, and succession planning.
* Ensure adequate workforce planning, resource allocation, and technician utilization.
* Foster a high\-performance culture focused on safety, quality, and customer excellence.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, and technical training activities.


 Customer Relationship Management
   

  

* Act as the primary escalation point for key customers.
* Build strong relationships with facility managers, consultants, contractors, and end users.
* Conduct regular customer reviews and identify opportunities for service improvements.
* Ensure high customer retention and contract renewal rates.


 Financial \& Business Management
   

  

* Manage service P\&L for the assigned territory/business.
* Drive service revenue growth through AMC/CMC contracts, repairs, upgrades, retrofit opportunities, and parts sales.
* Monitor costs, productivity, profitability, and budget adherence.
* Forecast manpower, revenue, and operational requirements.


 Technical Excellence
   

  

* Provide technical guidance on centrifugal, screw, and air\-cooled/water\-cooled chillers.
* Support complex troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis.
* Ensure compliance with OEM standards and engineering best practices.
* Maintain expertise in HVAC controls, BMS integration, VFDs, refrigeration systems, and energy optimization.


 Safety \& Compliance
   

  

* Promote a zero\-incident safety culture.
* Ensure compliance with EH\&S, local regulations, and company policies.
* Conduct regular safety audits, toolbox talks, and risk assessments.
* Ensure proper documentation and service reporting.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Refrigeration \& Air Conditioning, or related field.
* 10–15 years of experience in HVAC service operations.
* Minimum 3–5 years of people management experience leading field service teams.
* Strong experience in applied HVAC systems, especially centrifugal and screw chillers.
* Experience managing service contracts and customer\-facing operations.


**Preferred Skills**
 Technical Skills
   

  

* Applied HVAC systems
* Centrifugal Chillers
* Screw Chillers
* Air\-Cooled and Water\-Cooled Chillers
* Chiller Controls \& Automation
* Building Management Systems (BMS)
* Variable Frequency Drives (VFD)
* Refrigeration Cycle Diagnostics
* Energy Efficiency Solutions
* Root Cause Analysis


 Leadership Skills
   

  

* Team Leadership
* Performance Management
* Coaching \& Mentoring
* Conflict Resolution
* Stakeholder Management
* Customer Relationship Management
* Business Acumen
* Strategic Planning


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Service Revenue Achievement
* Contract Renewal Rate
* Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
* Technician Utilization
* First\-Time Fix Rate
* Response \& Resolution Time
* Safety Compliance Metrics
* Employee Engagement \& Retention
* Margin and Profitability Targets


 Competencies
   

  

* Customer\-centric mindset
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Decision\-making and problem\-solving ability
* Results\-oriented leadership
* Commercial acumen
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced service environment
* Strong collaboration and cross\-functional leadership skills

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview**
 We are looking for a Technical Delivery Manager to lead our Digital Process Automation (DPA) initiatives. This role requires close collaboration with the Product Management, Policy Operations, and Content Operations teams to drive innovative automation solutions that enhance operational efficiency, increase revenue, and reduce manual effort. The ideal candidate will also ensure seamless integration of AI solutions into the business unit's (BU) product suite of applications.
   

  

 This role requires leveraging spec\-driven development (an AI\-native development approach) and influencing business stakeholders to align with this approach.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage a team focused on developing automation solutions for manual\-intensive workflows.
* Collaborate with the Product Management and Business Operations teams to identify automation opportunities.
* Oversee the design, development, and deployment of automation solutions with an AI\-first strategy.
* Provide technical direction by leveraging a strong understanding of how AI technologies and generative AI can help solve business challenges, and guide the team in implementing AI\-driven automation.
* Ensure strong collaboration with application development teams to seamlessly integrate automation solutions into the BU's product suite of applications, ensuring scalability and minimal disruption.
* Drive stakeholder management, ensuring effective communication and alignment of automation goals.
* Apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills to address complex business challenges.
* Utilize negotiation skills to balance business priorities, technical feasibility, and resource constraints.
* Stay updated on the latest AI, ML, and automation trends to drive innovation and efficiency.


**Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of overall IT experience, including at least 4 years delivering AI solutions.
* Proven experience in Business Process Automation/Digital Process Automation.
* Strong technical expertise in Python; LLM architecture (transformers, embeddings, context windows); prompt engineering; LangChain/LangGraph or equivalents (LlamaIndex, CrewAI); RAG and vector databases (Pinecone/Qdrant/Chroma/pgvector/OpenSearch); agent and tool\-calling frameworks, including MCP; evaluation frameworks (Ragas); LLMOps and tracing (Langfuse/Arize); and cloud AI services (Bedrock/Vertex/Azure OpenAI).
* Strong understanding of how AI technologies and generative AI can help solve business challenges, with the ability to provide strategic direction to the team.
* Experience in stakeholder management, working with cross\-functional teams, and aligning automation initiatives with business goals.
* Strong collaboration skills to ensure automation solutions are effectively integrated into the BU's product suite of applications.
* Strong problem\-solving, negotiation, and critical thinking abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive results in a fast\-paced environment.

title: Business Accountability Senior Manager- Technology Risk Delivery Management
description:
**About This Role**
 Wells Fargo is seeking a Business Accountability Senior Manager.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Manage and develop teams of specialists and managers to oversee moderate to highly complex activities associated with the development and implementation of business\-specific programs, processes, and controls which identify, assess, monitor, measure, and mitigate risk
* Identify and recommend opportunities for process improvement, risk mitigation, and control strategies
* Determine appropriate strategies and actions, interpret and develop policies and procedures, and provide leadership to strategize and execute a variety of programs, services, initiatives, protocols, and deliverables that are moderate to high\-risk within scope of responsibility
* Collaborate with and influence all levels of professionals including senior managers
* Engage and influence business heads, regulators, control management, risk, legal, and audit partners to successfully ensure appropriate management of business risk
* Develop and guide a culture of talent development to meet business objectives and strategy


**Required Qualifications:**
* 7\+ years of risk management, business controls, or compliance experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 3\+ years of management or leadership experience


**Desired Qualifications:**
**Delivery Intake \& Triage**
* Own the centralized delivery intake process for Technology delivery initiatives.
* Assess incoming demand for scope, priority, execution risk, stakeholder impact, and required level of support.
* Route work to the appropriate delivery owners and aligned DRM teams based on risk, execution needs, and program maturity.
* Maintain visibility of intake status, ownership, and next steps through a consistent tracking model.


**Portfolio Monitoring \& Execution Governance**
* Establish common portfolio monitoring routines across supported delivery workstreams.
* Track progress against milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and remediation commitments.
* Use common cadence, thresholds, and governance practices to identify execution gaps early.
* Provide consistent leadership updates on delivery status, risk posture, and items requiring decisions or escalation.
* Coordinate execution across Technology teams, CIO partners, control partners, and delivery stakeholders.
* Align delivery activities to agreed priorities, timelines, ownership, and escalation paths.
* Reduce duplicate touchpoints and handoffs by creating clear engagement expectations and operating routines.
* Ensure work moves through the delivery lifecycle with clear accountability and timely decision\-making.


**Risk\-Based Escalation \& Issue Resolution**
* Identify at\-risk initiatives, execution blockers, ownership gaps, and missed impacts through proactive monitoring.
* Escalate delivery risks using agreed thresholds, leadership forums, and defined escalation pathways.
* Drive resolution of delivery blockers by coordinating accountable owners and decision\-makers.
* Support earlier gap detection and stronger remediation completion through consistent tracking and follow\-up.


**Reporting, Communications \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Create standardized progress reporting, delivery dashboards, and risk\-based notifications for leadership and aligned teams.
* Communicate delivery status, dependencies, risks, and decisions in a concise and executive\-ready manner.
* Facilitate operating cadences, governance reviews, and stakeholder routines for the Delivery Management portfolio.
* Serve as the primary Delivery Management point of contact for intake, orchestration, monitoring, and escalation topics.


**Process Standardization \& Continuous Improvement**
* Standardize delivery playbooks, templates, engagement cadences, and escalation models.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual tracking, duplicate follow\-ups, rework, and inconsistent communications.
* Strengthening delivery management practices through automation, improved tooling, and data\-driven reporting where feasible.
* Promote a scalable approach that improves visibility, prioritization, accountability, and execution discipline.


**Job Expectations:**
* 7\+ years of strong experience in Delivery Management, Portfolio Management, Program Management, PMO, or Technology Transformation.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex delivery portfolios with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and execution risks.
* Strong governance, reporting, escalation, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to design and operate intake, prioritization, monitoring, and escalation frameworks.
* Comfort working with Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Business stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills, with ability to turn fragmented information into clear execution plans and leadership insights.
* People leadership experience with the ability to set direction, build capability, and drive accountability.
* Create a single, consistent Delivery Management operating model for intake, triage, progress tracking, risk identification, and escalation.
* Provide leadership visibility into delivery health, execution gaps, dependencies, and emerging risks.
* Coordinate execution across Technology stakeholders using standardized communications, reporting, and escalation pathways.
* Move the delivery management function from reactive follow\-up to proactive, risk\-based monitoring and orchestration.

 Position Overview
   

  

 The Design \& Build Project Manager is responsible for coordinating and managing the entire project lifecycle from design through construction completion, serving as the core link between design and construction while coordinating the interests of all parties. This position requires comprehensive technical knowledge, management capabilities, and communication skills, making it one of the most challenging and important roles in the construction engineering industry.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Critical Presentations and Communication


 Lead project presentations at all stages, including introducing project objectives, scope, schedule, and organizational structure to the team and client at project initiation; presenting conceptual and detailed design proposals during the design phase to obtain client approval; conducting regular progress reports on construction progress, issues, and solutions; delivering milestone reports at critical junctures (such as structural topping out and MEP completion); and presenting project deliverables, conducting handover, and providing project summaries at completion.
   

  

* Project Management and Coordination


 Responsible for overall project planning, execution, and monitoring to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and to quality standards. Coordinate work among design teams, construction teams, consultants, and subcontractors to ensure effective communication and collaboration among all parties.
   

  

* Design Phase Management


 Supervise the progress and quality of architectural, structural, MEP, and other design work within the design team, ensuring design solutions meet client requirements, regulatory requirements, and budget constraints. Review design drawings and technical specifications, and coordinate the design change process.
   

  

* Construction Phase Management


 Supervise on\-site construction progress, quality, and safety within the construction team, conducting regular site inspections. Manage client vendors, construction teams, and subcontractors, resolving technical issues and conflicts during construction. Ensure construction complies with design drawings and relevant specification standards.
   

  

* Financial and Contract Management


 Collaborate with design and construction teams to discuss strategies for preparing and controlling project budgets, reviewing and approving change orders and payment applications. Manage contractual relationships with owners, design consultants, and contractors, handling claims and disputes.
   

  

* Risk Management and Reporting


 Identify project risks and develop response strategies, providing regular project progress reports to senior management and clients. Ensure projects comply with health, safety, and environmental regulatory requirements.

title: STEP Cutover Lead
description:
**Major Accountabilities**
* Own and govern the end\-to\-end STEP cutover strategy, roadmap, governance model, and decision framework, with primary focus on SAP S/4HANA and related SAP ecosystem components while ensuring alignment with non\-SAP applications and business processes.
* Develop, maintain, and continuously refine the integrated STEP cutover plan, including task sequencing, dependencies, ownership, business freeze activities, data migration, transports, integrations, infrastructure readiness, validation steps, and go/no\-go milestones.
* Coordinate cutover preparation across SAP functional, technical, integration, data, security, quality, testing, infrastructure, business, vendor, and non\-SAP application teams to ensure all pre\-cutover and post\-cutover activities are complete, validated, and traceable.
* Plan and lead mock cutovers, dress rehearsals, and cutover simulations to validate execution timing, dependencies, resource availability, business readiness, data conversion outcomes, technical readiness, contingency procedures, and escalation paths.
* Lead cutover execution during the go\-live window, operating the cutover command structure, tracking progress against the detailed plan, managing risks and issues in real time, driving timely decisions, and escalating blockers to programme leadership as required.
* Ensure cutover activities comply with relevant regulatory, quality, security, data privacy, validation, auditability, and business continuity requirements, including appropriate documentation, controls, approvals, and evidence for validated and business\-critical environments.
* Define and coordinate fallback, contingency, recovery, and business continuity approaches for critical SAP and non\-SAP cutover scenarios, ensuring decision points, responsibilities, communication routes, and operational impacts are clearly understood.
* Provide transparent cutover readiness, execution, risk, and issue reporting to business, technology, quality, vendor, and programme stakeholders, and coordinate a structured transition into hypercare, post\-go\-live validation, lessons learned, and operational handover.
* Responsible for performing all assigned activities in compliance with GxP regulations, company SOPs, and data integrity requirements.


**Minimum Requirements**
 Experience and Skills:
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in SAP programme delivery, deployment management, cutover management, release management, or complex enterprise transformation within a global, multinational organisation, ideally including SAP S/4HANA implementations.
* Proven experience leading cutover preparation and execution across multiple workstreams, including SAP functional and technical teams, data migration, integration, security, infrastructure, testing, business readiness, non\-SAP applications, vendors, and system integrators.
* Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA landscapes, SAP ecosystem components, integration patterns, data conversion processes, transport management, interface dependencies, batch jobs, authorisations, technical switchover activities, and connected non\-SAP systems.
* Demonstrated ability to build and manage detailed cutover plans, command centre structures, dependency maps, readiness checklists, go/no\-go criteria, fallback scenarios, escalation paths, and post\-go\-live transition plans.
* Hands\-on experience planning and leading mock cutovers, dress rehearsals, dry runs, business freeze windows, production go\-live execution, hypercare preparation, and post\-cutover validation in business\-critical environments.
* Strong delivery leadership skills, including risk and issue management, dependency management, vendor coordination, progress tracking, decision facilitation, executive\-level reporting, and management of time\-critical go\-live activities.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate large cross\-functional teams, lead cutover meetings, clarify responsibilities, manage escalations, and communicate risks, readiness, and contingency options clearly.
* Experience working in regulated, quality\-driven, and business\-critical environments, with awareness of security, compliance, data privacy, auditability, validation, segregation of duties, and operational resilience requirements.
* Strong analytical, structured problem\-solving, and prioritisation skills, with the ability to identify critical path dependencies, resolve blockers, manage ambiguity, and maintain control during high\-pressure cutover and go\-live periods.
* Deep knowledge and practical experience in large\-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation programmes, with strong understanding of cutover planning, deployment orchestration, data migration, integrations, transports, environment readiness, and business transition activities.
* Certification in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Activate, programme/project management, ITIL, PRINCE2, PMI, or equivalent delivery governance methods is a plus.
* Experience or certification in release management, deployment management, service transition, validation, quality management, or regulated system implementation practices is preferred.
* Experience with agile, hybrid, and waterfall delivery approaches, test coordination, readiness tracking, issue management, and cutover tooling in regulated enterprise environments is preferred.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.


**Languages**
* Fluent English required (oral and written)

Project Manager**Job Description Summary**


The MEP Manager is responsible for leading and managing all Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) services for construction projects from design to commissioning. The role involves planning, coordination, and execution of MEP systems to ensure they meet design intent, quality standards, timelines, safety norms, and budget targets. The position requires close collaboration with architects, structural engineers, consultants, contractors, and clients to deliver integrated and efficient building systems.**Job Description**

* Integrate MEP systems with structural and architectural works.
* Manage day\-to\-day site activities related to HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting, BMS, and other MEP installations.
* Ensure that all work is executed as per approved drawings, specifications, and safety standards.
* Supervise and monitor MEP subcontractors and vendors for timely delivery and installation.

* Review material submittals, method statements, and technical drawings.
* Ensure compliance with local building codes, IS standards, and client specifications.
* Prepare and monitor MEP budgets and cost estimates.
* Review and approve vendor quotations and subcontractor bills.
* Identify and control cost overruns through value engineering and efficient resource utilization.
* Plan, supervise, and validate the testing and commissioning of all MEP systems.
* Ensure proper handover documentation and O\&M manuals are submitted to the client.
* Lead a team of MEP engineers and site supervisors across multiple projects.
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and training to the team.
* Act as the main point of contact for all MEP\-related discussions with the client and consultants.
* Present progress reports and resolve any design or execution conflicts proactively.

* Project Execution \& Commissioning

Site Engineer must ensure safe, correct, and timely **installation of DG sets, panels, fuel system, exhaust system, earthing, and cabling** as per approved drawings, standards, and safety norms. **Data Centre experience is preferred**.

  

* Pre\-Site Preparation \& Resource Readiness – Verify approved drawings, layouts, P\&IDs, piping/cable schedules, and ensure site readiness, manpower safety induction, tools, lifting equipment, testing kits, and PPE availability before mobilization.
* Material Handling \& Equipment Installation – Inspect and verify receipt/storage of DG sets, heat exchangers, pumps, cooling towers, piping, valves, and accessories; carry out proper installation, alignment, levelling, grouting, and mounting of DG sets and associated equipment as per approved drawings.
* Mechanical System Installation – Execute installation of exhaust, fuel, water cooling, and piping systems including silencers, insulation, flexible joints, valves, strainers, NRVs, vents, drains, supports, expansion loops, and hydro/pressure testing of pipelines.
* Cooling Water \& Cooling Tower Integration – Install and commission heat exchangers, cooling water/raw water pumps, cooling tower structures, piping connections, gauges, VFD/starter panels, and ensure proper alignment, rotation checks, water quality, and chemical dosing systems.
* Electrical, Cabling \& Earthing Works – Install AMF/synchronizing panels, lay and terminate LT/HT cables, verify control wiring/interlocks for DG–HE–Pump–CT systems, conduct IR tests, and ensure proper earthing/bonding with resistance monitoring and logs.
* Pre\-Commissioning \& Testing Activities – Perform leak tests, hydrotests, insulation tests, alignment and rotation checks, verify oil/coolant/fuel/battery conditions, confirm relay settings, alarms, interlocks, and sensor feedback systems before commissioning.
* Safety, Compliance \& Project Documentation – Ensure adherence to PPE, PTW, rigging, welding, fire safety, MSDS, and site safety practices while maintaining daily logs, installation/test reports, inspection clearances, as\-built drawings, and final handover**.**

  

**Work Experience**  

Site Execution, Erection Management, Testing \& Commissioning, Contractor Management, Project Planning

description:
**What will you do:**



As a Senior Service Engineer, you will deliver advanced service, commissioning, and troubleshooting expertise for chiller systems in mission\-critical data center environments. You will:


* Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective repairs on Air\-Cooled and Water\-Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control\-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
* Conduct chiller start\-up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
* Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
* Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy\-efficiency improvements in existing cooling infrastructure.
* Review technical drawings, wiring diagrams, P\&IDs, submittals, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
* Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and equipment documentation.
* Ensure compliance with safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer\-specific operational protocols.
* Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
* Interface regularly with customers to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure timely project and service completion.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and implement corrective/preventive actions.
* Collaborate with internal teams including sales, engineering, and project management to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Submit RCA and 8D reports in a timely manner.
* Attend Monthly MOR and Quarterly QBR meetings with data center clients.


**What you will bring: (Skills \& Competencies)**


* Strong expertise in Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, ideally in data center environments.
* Deep understanding of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and redundancy concepts.
* Proficiency in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and controls issues using diagnostic tools and software.
* Ability to interpret wiring diagrams, technical drawings, P\&IDs, and OEM manuals.
* Strong communication skills to operate effectively in mission‑critical customer environments.
* Sound knowledge of safety standards and best practices.
* Strong problem\-solving capability and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience supporting mission\-critical data centers or large industrial cooling systems.
* OEM\-specific training or certifications (Trane, Carrier, Daikin) preferred.
* Knowledge of energy\-efficiency programs, retrofits, and performance optimization.

title: Change Manager
description:
Experience : 8\+ Years
 



 Location : Mumbai
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced Technical Change Manager to support a large\-scale Salesforce Revenue Cloud implementation. This role will be part of the PMO and will be responsible for coordinating technical changes, release activities, business approvals, deployment readiness, and production releases.
 



 The ideal candidate will have strong experience managing enterprise application releases, coordinating across business and technology teams, obtaining required sign\-offs, and driving Go/No\-Go decisions for production deployments.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 • Own the Change Management and Release Management process for the Salesforce Revenue Cloud program.
 



 • Work as part of the PMO, coordinating closely with Program Managers, Business Leads, Salesforce teams, QA, DevOps, Support, and other technology teams.
 



 • Coordinate and track all technical changes associated with Salesforce releases.
 



 • Ensure appropriate business approvals and sign\-offs are obtained before production deployment.
 



 • Maintain release plans, deployment schedules, change calendars, dependencies, and readiness checkpoints.
 



 • Coordinate release activities across Development, QA, UAT, Production, and supporting systems.
 



 • Validate that required testing, UAT approvals, production readiness, rollback plans, and support plans are completed before release.
 



 • Lead Go/No\-Go calls and facilitate release readiness discussions with business and technology stakeholders.
 



 • Document decisions, risks, issues, dependencies, and action items from Go/No\-Go meetings.
 



 • Coordinate production deployment activities and ensure all participating teams understand their responsibilities and timelines.
 



 • Manage emergency changes, planned releases, hot fixes, and production change requests.
 



 • Coordinate releases involving Salesforce and integrated upstream/downstream enterprise applications.
 



 • Track release risks and escalate issues that could impact deployment timelines or business operations.
 



 • Ensure changes follow established Change Management, Release Management, and governance processes.
 



 • Coordinate post\-deployment validation, production verification, and business confirmation.
 



 • Facilitate post\-release reviews and capture lessons learned for future releases.
 



 • Provide release and change status reporting to PMO and senior stakeholders.
 



 Required Skills \& Experience
 



 • 7\+ years of experience in Technical Change Management, Release Management, Program Management, or Technical PMO roles.
 



 • Strong experience managing enterprise application releases and production deployments.
 



 • Experience supporting Salesforce implementations, preferably Salesforce Revenue Cloud, CPQ, Billing, or Quote\-to\-Cash programs.
 



 • Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, testing, UAT, production deployment, and release governance.
 



 • Experience running Go/No\-Go meetings and production readiness reviews.
 



 • Strong experience obtaining and managing business, technology, QA, and operational sign\-offs.
 



 • Ability to coordinate multiple technical and business teams across complex releases.
 



 • Experience managing release calendars, dependencies, risks, issues, and deployment checklists.
 



 • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
 



 • Experience working within a PMO governance structure.
 



 • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Salesforce DevOps tools, or similar platforms.
 



  





**Preferred Experience:** 




 • Salesforce Revenue Cloud / Revenue Cloud Advanced
 



 • Salesforce CPQ and Billing
 



 • Quote\-to\-Cash / Lead\-to\-Cash processes
 



 • Salesforce integrations with ERP, Finance, Billing, CRM, and downstream systems
 



 • ITIL Change and Release Management
 



 • CI/CD and Salesforce deployment processes
 



 • Large enterprise transformation programs
 



  





**Key Focus Areas:** 




 This is not a traditional Organizational Change Management / communications role. The primary focus is technical change governance, release coordination, production readiness, business sign\-offs, and execution of enterprise Salesforce releases.
 



 The Technical Change Manager will serve as the central coordination point between the PMO, Business, Salesforce delivery teams, QA, DevOps, and Production Support to ensure every release is properly approved, controlled, communicated, and successfully deployed.

description:

**Role description:**
 The Project Controls Associate MEP supports Capital Management teams by preparing, reviewing, and verifying MEP deliverables related to cost estimation, contracts, cost reporting, and change order assessments. This role is part of the Project Controls Team within the Centre of Excellence (COE) team and aligns deliverables to project requirements, regional codes and standards, and ensures independent cost verification. The associate contributes to process standardization and governance initiatives to improve commercial efficiencies within real estate projects, particularly office fit\-outs.
   

  

**Role accountabilities:**
* Integrated Project Controls: Collaborate with Project Controls team members to align Capital Management deliverables and timelines, ensuring strict adherence to the policies and procedures of each Stage Gate process.

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical /Electrical Engineering, Quantity Surveying.

* Good understanding of pre\-contract (quantification \& market analysis supporting cost planning, benchmarking, design validation, risk management) and post\-contract (rate analysis \& drawings measurements supporting change control management, cost reporting, final accounts) stages of MEP services of Real Estate projects.
* Experience working in a global organization or COE or PMO (prior experience of working on Owner’s side is preferable).

* Experience of working with stakeholders and teams spread across 2\-3 regions.
