 is a global leader in insurance broking and risk management. In more than 130 countries, our experts in every facet of risk and across industries help clients to anticipate, quantify, and more fully understand the range of risks they face.
   

  

**Marsh Advisory** 
 is the consultative branch of Marsh, which operates internationally and provides solutions in the increasing needs of our clients to implement risk management programs within their organization. Marsh Advisory helps companies to change their risk profiles so they can improve resiliency, reduce claims, and minimize the total cost of risk. Businesses today regularly tackle multiple challenges, whether facing property and casualty, cyber, reputation, or other risks, Marsh Advisory can help.
   

  

 The global
 **Cyber Risk Consulting** 
 (CRC) practice of Marsh Advisory supports customers to understand, estimate and mitigate cyber risks. This role is open in Marsh McLennan India Private Limited (MMIPL) a global in\-house center for Marsh. The MMIPL in Mumbai has a function called ‘Knowledge Services which supports the MMC group by providing specialized services. Under the Knowledge Services function, there is Marsh Advisory team, which supports the global clients and colleagues. This role will initiate a new service line for Marsh Advisory team in Mumbai, which entails supporting the CRC colleagues in execution of the cyber consulting projects.
   

  

**What can you expect?**
* You will join an international team of cyber security experts helping our clients with all aspects of their cyber security programs and contributing toward their business resilience.
* You will be flexible and ready to adapt to a constantly changing environment, sharing your time between reviewing and developing cyber strategies and products, managing consulting projects, advising stakeholders, leading workshops, as well as supporting business development and marketing.
* Immediate exposure to top\-tier clients and excellent opportunities for personal and professional development.
* Since you will be working directly with clients, some travel will be required.


**We will count on you to:**
* Support business development of Cyber Risk Consulting UK Region.
* Support the design and delivery of multiple Cyber Risk Consulting projects through to their timely completion as required.
* Collaborate across the Marsh (global and regional) community and provide expert input and contributions where necessary.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with other involved parties such as Marsh cyber brokerage colleagues, global cyber teams and business partners.


**What you need to have \[Required Skills and Experience]:**

* Demonstrable understanding of technology and security principles and deep knowledge of cyber threat landscape.
* Good understanding of IT architectures, networks, common business applications, SaaS services and data storage.
* Understanding network security principles, including firewalls, VPNs, and secure network architecture.
* Familiarity with cloud security, endpoint security, and network security best practices.
* Good understanding of UK and European cybersecurity regulations and standards, such as: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Network and Information Systems (NIS) Directive, EU Cybersecurity Act, European Union Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA) guidelines, DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act) for financial institutions.
* Good knowledge of cybersecurity compliance standards and frameworks, including ISO 27001, NIST, and CIS Controls.
* Analytical problem\-solving skills and experience ideally gained in the management\-consulting sector although other sectors could be relevant.
* Experience in supporting multiple projects from inception to completion with high quality of delivery in a complex and challenging environment.
* Smart, collaborative, strong sense of business ethics and principles
* Ability to demonstrate sound judgment in the prioritization of competing work assignments, escalation of issues and the formulation of solutions.
* Effective organization skills with key attention to detail and delivery of high\-quality documentation with the ability to implement/influence change.
* Professional security certifications (CISA, CISM, CISSP) would be advantageous.
* Experience and skills acquired in Incident Response is advantageous.
* Experience in Vulnerability Assessment, Penetration Testing techniques and tools is advantageous.
* Excellent English language skills (both verbal and written) and the ability to communicate technical matters to a non\-technical audience.

 As a

 , you will be the hands\-on technical leader for AI products across our International portfolio — orchestrating the build across blended teams of internal engineers and external contractors while staying close to the code. You will bring deep expertise in at least one core discipline — data engineering, data science and ML engineering, AI engineering, or backend/full\-stack development — combined with working knowledge across the others, and you will navigate the full digital solution stack with confidence: data products, AI data products, generative and agentic AI solutions, and full\-stack applications, understanding what it takes to advance each from POC to MVP to an enterprise\-grade system. * Experience coordinating with and managing external vendor or contractor teams, with emphasis on delivery quality.
* Deep expertise in at least one relevant discipline (e.g., data engineering, data science and ML engineering, AI engineering, backend/full\-stack development), with working exposure across the others.
* Solid understanding of the digital product development lifecycle, including the distinction between POC, MVP, and enterprise\-grade systems and the engineering practices each stage requires.
* Strong critical thinking, technical judgment, and trade\-off analysis; ability to formulate proposals, analyses, and decision rationale.
* Fluency in Python and proficiency in SQL; ability to write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
* Experience working in a cloud\-based analytics ecosystem (e.g., AWS, Snowflake) and familiarity with modern data tooling (e.g., Airflow, dbt) and the standard AI engineering stack.
* Solid grounding in cloud infrastructure and backend engineering, CI/CD, and testing practices; awareness of MLOps/LLMOps.
* Hands\-on experience working in agile teams, processes, and practices, and proficiency with agile delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, Confluence).

* Experience building generative and agentic AI solutions (e.g., orchestrating agents on top of existing services and front ends).

title: Assistant Manager - Client Solutions
description:
**About Nextyn:** 




 Nextyn is a fast\-growing expert network company that enables clients worldwide to connect with industry experts for research, consulting, and strategic decision\-making.
 



 With a growing global presence, we work with clients across geographies and industries, helping them access high\-quality expert insights to support critical business and investment decisions.
 



 Role Summary
 



  





 As an
 **Assistant Manager – Client Solutions** 
 , you will manage key client relationships while leading a team of Associates/Analysts responsible for delivering high\-quality expert research and engagement.
 



  





 The role combines
 **client relationship management, team leadership, expert identification, project delivery, and account growth** 
 . You will be responsible for understanding client requirements, ensuring timely and high\-quality execution, developing your team, and identifying opportunities to strengthen and grow client accounts.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Client Relationship Management
 


* Own end\-to\-end relationships with a portfolio of key clients and understand their research objectives, priorities, and evolving requirements.
* Act as the primary point of contact for client queries, escalations, and project\-related discussions.
* Build strong, long\-term relationships that support client retention and account growth.
* Maintain a high level of responsiveness and ensure a consistent client experience across engagements.



 2\. Team Management \& Development
 


* Recruit, onboard, train, and develop Associates/Analysts within the Client Solutions team.
* Set clear goals and expectations and monitor individual and team performance.
* Provide regular coaching, feedback, and support to help team members build their client management, research, and expert engagement capabilities.
* Build a high\-performing team that can independently manage projects and deliver against client expectations.



 3\. Expert Identification \& Engagement
 


* Oversee the identification, evaluation, and engagement of relevant industry experts for client requirements.
* Guide the team on expert sourcing strategies and quality evaluation criteria.
* Ensure experts identified are relevant, credible, and aligned with the client's research objectives.
* Take ownership of specialized, complex, or high\-priority expert searches when required.



 4\. Account Growth \& Revenue
 


* Own revenue targets for assigned accounts and work towards achieving account growth objectives.
* Identify opportunities for upselling, cross\-selling, and expanding relationships across client accounts.
* Track account performance and proactively highlight potential risks and growth opportunities to leadership.
* Support client proposals, pricing discussions, and commercial conversations where required.



 5\. Project Coordination \& Delivery
 


* Oversee the timely and high\-quality execution of projects managed by the team.
* Coordinate with internal teams including Research, Operations, and Compliance to resolve project\-related bottlenecks.
* Monitor turnaround times, project progress, and quality standards across active engagements.
* Step in where required to resolve critical issues and ensure client commitments are met.



 6\. Research \& Insights
 


* Guide the team on qualitative and quantitative research approaches based on client requirements.
* Review and validate research outputs, expert profiles, and market insights before client delivery.
* Develop a strong understanding of relevant industries and market trends to support client conversations and internal decision\-making.
* Use research and market insights to identify relevant experts and strengthen project outcomes.



  





 Qualifications \& Skills
 



 Education
 


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Management, or a related field.



  





 Experience
 


* 2–5 years of relevant experience in expert networks, client management, account management, research, consulting, or a similar client\-facing environment.
* Prior experience managing or mentoring a team is preferred.
* Experience in expert networks, market research, consulting, or professional services will be an advantage.



  





 Skills
 


* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong client and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proven ability to manage, coach, and develop a team.
* Strong analytical, research, and problem\-solving skills.
* Good business judgment and the ability to understand client requirements.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts, projects, and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively under deadlines.



  





 Location \& Joining
 


* **Location:** 
 Mumbai
* **Work Model:** 
 Work from Office
* **Preference:** 
 Immediate joiners preferred



  





 What Nextyn Offers
 


* Work\-from\-office environment with structured working hours.
* Opportunity to work with global clients and senior industry experts.
* Leadership exposure through team management and account ownership.
* Opportunities to build expertise across industries and develop strong client\-facing capabilities.
* Learning and career growth opportunities within a rapidly scaling organization.
* Competitive compensation and benefits, including PF and insurance.

title: Vice President Supply Chain
description:
To oversees the efficient flow of goods, information, and finances from raw material procurement to final product delivery while coordinating with suppliers, manufacturing plant and distributors to meet customer demands
 



  Supply Chain Manager: Oversee the entire supply chain, develop strategies to optimize efficiency, manage budgets, and coordinate with various stakeholders.
 



  Procurement Specialist: Should have understanding and experience of sourcing and purchase raw materials, negotiate with suppliers, manage contracts, and ensure cost\-effective procurement. Build strategic suppliers for packing material. Understand the various activities and implications of imports and fulfilment of advance licenses.
 



  Logistics Coordinator: Manage transportation, warehousing, and distribution of goods, ensure timely delivery, and optimize logistics costs.
 



  Inventory Management: Monitor inventory levels, forecast demand, manage stock replenishment, and minimize excess inventory of raw material, packing material and Finished Products.
 



  Demand Planner: Predict future product demand, create demand forecasts, and align supply chain activities with market needs. Identify minimum quantities of raw material and packing material to be kept so that economies of purchase and continuity of production can be maintained while balancing the working capital. Do ABC analysis of stocks.
 



  Product Launches \& Collaboration: Partner with business teams (R\&D, Production, Quality etc.) to support global product launches (in\-house and CMOs). Ensure timely delivery of final outputs within defined budgets and timelines.
 



  CMO: Build supplier base and Oversee procurement of CMO products at cost effective prices with continued high\-quality product supplies. Ensure quality compliance of CMO\-manufactured products through effective coordination with CMO partners, Quality Assurance, and cross\-functional teams.
 



  Cross functional activities – Plant and manufacturing coordination: Ensure seamless collaboration between Supply Chain, Production, and Quality functions to achieve timely dispatch of products while maintaining compliance and service levels. Understand the plant capacities and ensure the plant is running at optimum capacities.
 



  Risk Management: Identify potential risks and vulnerabilities in the supply chain such as supply shortages, supplier disruptions, regulatory changes and geopolitical issues. Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies to address challenges and business continuity.
 



  Technology and Innovation: Stay updated with the latest trends, technologies and innovations in supply chain management software, data analyst and automation.
 



  





**Competencies** 




  Hands\-on knowledge and exposure related to procurement, logistics, commercial of related materials in pharmaceutical formulations industry.
 



  Awareness on domestic/International pharma regulatory guidelines on Supply chain management.
 



  Knowledge and understanding of industry 4\.0 and its applicability in pharmaceutical industry.

Regularly serves as lead project manager and main client contact. Provides training to department members. Completes special projects as needed.
   

  

**About Linguistic Validation**
 Linguistic Validation (LV) is a specialized business unit within RWS Regulated Industries that focuses on the translation, validation, licensing, and electronic implementation of Clinical Outcome Assessments (COAs). COAs are questionnaires completed during clinical trials which allow sponsors to collect data about treatment effectiveness, side effects, and health status directly from patients and caregivers.
   

  

 The LV Team is over 20 years of experience in the COA field, positioning us as the industry leader. **Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
* Specialize in assessing early to mid stage development, technical, operational, construction and development risks in the energy industry.
* Support deal execution teams through front end and customer facing involvement in development deals exhibiting deep domain knowledge and expertise in projects from inception to a “ready to build” / financial close stage.
* Support the efforts of EFS underwriting and portfolio groups in identification and mitigation of risks and in execution of investment objectives. Perform techno\-commercial due diligence for both underwriting and portfolio holdings.
* Review and instructively comment on technical and construction specifications as outlined in key project documents such as interconnection, power off\-take, permits, land agreements, and equipment, construction, operations and maintenance contracts, in some cases even leading / supporting the negotiations of these documents.
* Ensure that technical and business\-related issues are communicated within EFS and provide techno\-commercial risk assessments for credit requests
* Interact with EFS customers and partners and internal GE Power and GE Renewables teams in the completion of due diligence and negotiation of financing terms related to technical issues.
* Possess understanding of the risk appetite, and portfolio management philosophy of EFS.
* Lead due diligence processes into new investment platforms.
* Develop and structure development budgets, schedules and reporting frameworks for new investment platforms.
* Be familiar with the GE industrial product offerings and maintain contacts within GE Power and GE Renewables.
* For assigned investment platforms, manage development progress, reporting and alignment with project budgets and schedules.
* Actively monitor portfolio (e.g. regulatory requirements, development progress, construction, physical plant optimization, and contractual performance). Possess in\-depth understanding of how specific sub\-function interacts with the broader business, as well as a good understanding of the industry and commercial awareness.
* For assigned projects, develop and supervise construction management teams and ensure construction safety, environmental compliance, cost and schedule performance. Provide internal reporting on construction status.
* Support EFS efforts to sell equity positions through assembly of technical project information and responding to buyer’s technical questions.

* Bachelor’s Degree Civil or Mechanical or Electrical Engineering and Construction Management.

* Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to identify, analyze and resolve technical development issues. Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects.

title: Project Manager – Project Annapurna
description:
**POSITION:** Project Manager – Project Annapurna
  

**REPORTS TO:** Programme Lead – Annapurna


**LOCATION:** Maharashtra (Pune/Thane)
  

**LEVEL/GRADE:** Manager / Senior Manager


**About ACCESS:**
  

ACCESS Development Services is a national livelihoods promotion organization that incubates innovations and builds sustainable models of livelihood promotion for the poor — implementing programmes on the ground (Tier I); partnering civil society, government, the corporate sector and multilateral agencies (Tier II); and shaping national policy and the enabling environment (Tier III). Headquartered in New Delhi, ACCESS works across 14 project offices. More at www.accessdev.org


**Project Summary:**  

Annapurna – Catalysing Women Entrepreneurship in Food Processing is a 36\+3\-month initiative supported by Bajaj Holdings \& Investment Limited, administered by the Bajaj Finserv CSR team, running from 1 August 2026 to 31 October 2029\. It works with 12,000 women from 1,200 Self Help Groups across 15 blocks of Thane, Pune and Raigad districts of Maharashtra — 4,000 women, 400 SHGs and 5 Annapurna Resource Centres (ARCs) per district, each ARC serving about 80 SHGs through centralised (at\-ARC) and decentralised (home\-based) support. Maharashtra State Rural Livelihoods Mission (UMED) is proposed as a facilitation partner.


**Position Summary:**  

Day\-to\-day operational command of Annapurna across three districts and fifteen blocks — delivery calendar, field team, ARC rollout, budget burn and HQ reporting — under the Programme Lead. This is a field\-anchored role, not a desk role. ACCESS wants someone who has built a multi\-district women’s enterprise programme from inception, can hold a CSR donor’s compliance calendar without slippage, and will say early and plainly when something is not going to plan.


**Responsibilities:**

**1\. Delivery and Field Management**


* Convert the approved plan into annual and quarterly operating calendars and drive the ARC rollout.
* Lead a ground team member; set work plans, review performance and hold the weekly, fortnightly, monthly and quarterly review rhythm
* Own mobilisation of 12,000 women from 1,200 SHGs, the centralised/decentralised delivery split, and ARC premises identification, right\-to\-use, fit\-out and commissioning
**2\. Partnership, Compliance and Convergence**


* Manage the UMED/MSRLM relationship at state, district and block level and service the Steering Committee
* Ensure every ARC food business runs on an FSSAI registration or licence held by the community institution or enterprise group that operates the premises
* Ensure sales revenue is transacted by community institutions and individual entrepreneurs
* Drive convergence with PMFME, MUDRA, Udyam, MSME registration and social security entitlements
**3\. Budget, Risk and Reporting**


* Manage a budget; track burn against the instalment schedule and flag drawdown, refund and interest exposure early
* Deliver donor and internal reports on time, with every figure traceable to an approved source, and maintain the risk register, clarification tracker and decision log.
**Education \& Experience::**

* Postgraduate in Rural Management, Agribusiness, Development Studies, Social Work or Management (IRMA / TISS / XISS / IIFM or equivalent)
* 8–10 years in the sector, including 5\+ years managing multi\-district livelihoods or women’s enterprise programmes with line responsibility for teams of 10 or more
* Demonstrated work with SHGs, VOs and CLFs and with NRLM/SRLM convergence; Maharashtra and UMED/MAVIM experience strongly preferred
* Managed CSR\-funded projects— instalment funding, utilization certificates, statutory reporting and audit. Exposure to food processing micro\-enterprise and FSSAI compliance is an advantage
**Skills and Competencies:**

* Fluency in Marathi essential, with Hindi and donor\-grade written English
* Strong planning, budgeting and MIS discipline; argues from data, not impression
* Equally credible with district officials, CLF leaders and a corporate CSR team
* Judgement under pressure, and honesty to escalate bad news early.
**Travel Requirement:**

Extensive travel across Thane, Pune and Raigad; 12–15 field days a month.


**Compensation:**

The salary range for this position is commensurate with industry standards and will be determined based upon the experience set of the candidate and the HR policies of the organization.


**How to apply:** For your application to be successfully submitted, kindly fill the google form provided in link – https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScZcDQw\_eeQezBrYBtZccT0WjDEMyTluNNLHZmHgh0QvQ0\_DQ/viewform


*ACCESS is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. ACCESS values diversity and inclusion, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, caste, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, marital status, age and disability.*

title: Senior Executive - Accounts Receivable & Project Accounting
description:
### **About Zeeco:**



Zeeco is a global leader in the design and manufacture of advanced combustion and environmental solutions for the refining, petrochemical, chemical, LNG, power, pharmaceutical, and allied industries. With engineering and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Zeeco delivers innovative combustion technologies and world\-class customer support to clients in more than 100 countries.


### **Position Summary:**



Zeeco India is seeking an experienced **Accounts Receivable professional** with **5–10 years of relevant experience** in a **manufacturing, EPC, oil \& gas, engineering, or project\-based organization**. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in **Accounts Receivable, Customer Collections, Project Billing, Credit Control, and Revenue Tracking**, with exposure to project accounting and **Percentage of Completion (POC)** accounting being highly desirable.



The incumbent will work closely with Finance, Project Management, Sales, and Customers to ensure timely invoicing, collections, accurate receivable accounting, and effective working capital management while supporting project financial reporting.



### **Key Responsibilities:**


### **Accounts Receivable Management:**


* Manage end\-to\-end Accounts Receivable activities for domestic and international customers.
* Generate and review customer invoices in accordance with contractual milestones, project schedules, and commercial terms.
* Monitor outstanding receivables and ensure timely recording and allocation of customer payments.
* Reconcile customer accounts and resolve billing discrepancies, short payments, debit notes, and credit notes.
* Maintain accurate customer ledgers and ensure receivable balances are reconciled on a regular basis.
* Review customer credit limits and coordinate with internal stakeholders on credit\-related matters.

### **Customer Collections \& Credit Control:**


* Drive collection of outstanding receivables through regular customer follow\-ups.
* Coordinate with Project Managers, Sales, Commercial, and Customers to resolve payment delays and invoice disputes.
* Monitor customer aging reports and prioritize collection of overdue accounts.
* Prepare weekly and monthly collection status reports, cash flow forecasts, and escalation summaries for management.
* Support initiatives to improve **Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)**, collection efficiency, and working capital performance.
* Maintain strong customer relationships while ensuring timely realization of payments.

### **Project Billing \& Project Accounting Support:**


* Coordinate project billing based on contractual milestones, shipment schedules, engineering progress, or project completion stages.
* Support project accounting activities by tracking project costs, billings, receivables, and customer advances.
* Assist in maintaining project\-wise financial records and supporting schedules.
* Work closely with Project Managers to validate billing milestones, project progress, and commercial documentation.
* Monitor unbilled revenue, customer advances, retention amounts, and milestone\-based receivables.

### **Revenue Recognition (POC Accounting):**


* Support revenue recognition under the **Percentage of Completion (POC)** method in accordance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.
* Assist in monthly project cost reviews and revenue calculations.
* Coordinate with Project Finance and Operations teams for project progress validation.
* Prepare supporting schedules for project profitability analysis and revenue reporting.

### **Financial Reporting \& Compliance:**


* Support month\-end and year\-end closing activities relating to Accounts Receivable and project accounting.
* Prepare customer reconciliations, AR schedules, aging analysis, and management reports.
* Ensure compliance with accounting standards, internal controls, and company policies.
* Assist during statutory audits, internal audits, tax audits, and financial reviews.
* Identify process improvement opportunities to enhance billing accuracy, collection efficiency, and reporting.
### **Qualifications:**


* **M.Com graduate** with **5–10 years of relevant experience** in Accounts Receivable.
* Experience in **Manufacturing, Oil \& Gas, EPC, Engineering, Industrial Equipment, Process Equipment, Heavy Engineering, or Project\-based organizations** is highly preferred.
* Working knowledge of project billing, milestone invoicing, customer collections, and receivable accounting.
* Exposure to **Percentage of Completion (POC) Accounting** and **Revenue Recognition** will be an added advantage.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as **Sage X3 or similar ERP platforms**.
### **Required Skills:**


* Strong knowledge of **Accounts Receivable, Customer Collections, Credit Control, and Customer Reconciliations**.
* Good understanding of project\-based billing and commercial documentation.
* Knowledge of revenue recognition and project accounting concepts.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including **Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, IF formulas, data analysis, and reporting**.
* Strong analytical, numerical, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Finance, Sales, Project Management, Commercial, and Customers.
* High attention to detail with strong organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced multinational environment.
### **Preferred Experience:**


* Accounts Receivable Management
* Customer Collections \& Credit Control
* Project Billing
* Milestone\-Based Invoicing
* Project Accounting
* Percentage of Completion (POC) Accounting
* Revenue Recognition
* Customer Reconciliations
* Working Capital Management
* Financial Reporting
* Advanced Microsoft Excel
### **What You'll Gain:**


* Opportunity to work with one of the world's leading combustion and environmental solutions companies.
* Exposure to global project accounting and multinational finance operations.
* Hands\-on experience in project billing, customer collections, revenue recognition, and working capital management.
* Cross\-functional collaboration with Project Management, Commercial, Sales, and Global Finance teams.
* Career growth within a multinational engineering and manufacturing organization.
* Exposure to large\-scale industrial, oil \& gas, refinery, petrochemical, LNG, and power sector projects.

title: Manager / Assistant Manager - Estimation
description:
**About Zeeco**
 Zeeco is a global leader in advanced combustion and environmental solutions, delivering innovative technologies for the refining, petrochemical, chemical, LNG, power, pharmaceutical, and allied process industries. Our portfolio includes process burners, power burners, boiler burners, duct burners, thermal oxidizers, flares, vapor recovery systems, incinerators, and combustion control systems. With engineering and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Zeeco provides customized combustion solutions that meet the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and environmental compliance.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Zeeco is seeking an experienced
 **Senior Estimation Engineer** 
 with
 **10 to 15\+ years of experience** 
 in preparing techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner systems. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of combustion equipment, burner management systems, instrumentation, mechanical equipment, and project costing.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for reviewing customer enquiries, interpreting technical specifications, coordinating with engineering and procurement teams, obtaining vendor quotations, developing accurate cost estimates, and preparing competitive technical and commercial proposals for global projects.
   

  

 Candidates with either a
 **Mechanical Engineering** 
 or
 **Instrumentation \& Control Engineering** 
 background and extensive experience in industrial combustion equipment are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**RFQ \& Technical Review**
* Review customer RFQs, ITBs, specifications, datasheets, PFDs, P\&IDs, burner schedules, and other project documents.
* Evaluate process requirements, fuel characteristics, combustion duty, control philosophy, emissions, and applicable design standards.
* Identify technical clarifications, scope gaps, deviations, and commercial risks before proposal submission.


**Estimation \& Costing**
* Prepare accurate techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner packages.
* Develop Bills of Materials (BOM) covering burners, fuel trains, BMS/CCS, PLC/HMI, instrumentation, valves, electrical, mechanical, and bought\-out items.
* Estimate engineering, fabrication, assembly, testing, logistics, commissioning, and documentation costs.


**Vendor \& Proposal Management**
* Obtain and evaluate vendor quotations for technical compliance, pricing, and delivery.
* Coordinate with procurement to optimize vendor selection and project costing.
* Prepare technical and commercial proposals, including cost sheets, assumptions, exclusions, and deviations.


**Engineering Coordination**
* Coordinate with Mechanical, Process, Electrical, Instrumentation, Procurement, and Manufacturing teams to validate technical and commercial inputs.
* Review engineering deliverables such as P\&IDs, GA drawings, wiring diagrams, and instrument schedules to support accurate estimation.


**Cost Optimization \& Bid Support**
* Identify value engineering opportunities and cost\-effective technical solutions while ensuring compliance with customer specifications.
* Support customer clarification meetings, bid evaluations, negotiations, and project handover following order award.


**Estimation Database**
* Maintain estimation databases, standard costing, historical pricing, and vendor cost records to improve estimation accuracy and proposal competitiveness.


**Technical Expertise**
**The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of:**
**Combustion Systems**
* Process, Boiler, Power, and Duct Burners
* Low NOx, Ultra Low NOx, Gas, Oil, Dual\-Fuel, and Multi\-Fuel Burners
* Burner sizing, fuel selection, combustion principles, and emissions requirements


**Fuel Train \& Mechanical Systems:**
* Fuel gas and liquid fuel trains
* Pressure regulators, safety shut\-off valves, control valves, vent valves, filters, and strainers
* Burners, dampers, registers, skid\-mounted systems, piping, and fabricated assemblies


**Instrumentation \& Controls:**
* Burner Management Systems (BMS) and Combustion Control Systems (CCS)
* PLC/HMI\-based control systems
* Flame scanners, ignition systems, pressure, temperature, and flow instrumentation
* Control valves, actuators, and combustion safety interlocks


**Estimation \& Proposal Engineering:**
* Interpretation of RFQs, P\&IDs, datasheets, burner schedules, and technical specifications
* Preparation of Bills of Materials (BOM), vendor enquiries, techno\-commercial evaluations, and detailed cost estimates
* Cost optimization, value engineering, and proposal preparation for industrial burner packages


**Codes \& Standards:**
 Working knowledge of applicable combustion and industrial standards, including
 **NFPA 85/86** 
 ,
 **API** 
 ,
 **ASME** 
 ,
 **IEC** 
 , and
 **ISA is preferred.**
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Instrumentation \& Control Engineering.
* 10–15 years of experience in estimation, proposal engineering, or applications engineering for industrial combustion systems.
* Experience working with burner OEMs, combustion equipment manufacturers, EPC companies, or industrial heating solution providers is preferred.


**Preferred Industry Background**
* Industrial Burner Manufacturers
* Combustion Equipment OEMs
* Boiler Manufacturers
* Process Heater OEMs
* Furnace Manufacturers
* Oil \& Gas
* Petrochemical
* Refining
* Power Generation
* EPC Organizations
* Industrial Heating Equipment Manufacturers


**Desired Competencies**
* Strong techno\-commercial acumen.
* Excellent understanding of combustion systems and process heating applications.
* Ability to interpret complex customer specifications and translate them into accurate cost estimates.
* Strong analytical and cost modelling skills.
* Excellent negotiation and vendor management capabilities.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent).
* Ability to manage multiple enquiries with tight bid submission deadlines.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Self\-driven with a strong focus on accuracy, quality, and continuous improvement.

title: Deployment Project Manager
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Deployment Project Manager is a key role within the Litmus Customer Success team and is responsible for ensuring the successful deployment of Litmus products into our customer’s environments.
   

  

 The Deployment Project manager will create and manage implementation schedules, manage issues and risks and develop and execute project communication strategies for our client\-facing projects.
   

  

 The Deployment Project manager will also, at times, have oversight of third\-party partners who will be performing work as sub\-contractors to Litmus.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Manages Litmus projects using a waterfall methodology through Initiation, Planning, Execution and Close Phases
* Develop and maintain schedules, manage issues and risks for customer facing deployments of Litmus products
* Manage scope of the project and identify / issue change requests due to changing requirements
* Prepare project management reports for Account Management and customer stakeholders
* Develop statement of work in conjunction with sales and account management teams, including estimates for project effort
* Perform cost analysis for ongoing projects and recommend actions to preserve profit margin as needed
* Hold project status meetings, take and publish minutes, ensure timely communication with customers
* Leads handover to support of any deployment projects as part of the Closedown phase


****What You’ll Bring****
**Must Have**
* Proven track record and experience implementing software and infrastructure projects in a manufacturing environment
* Excellent communication, negotiation and organizational skills
* Experience using Wrike or other Project Management software
* Experience performing in a customer facing / interactive role
* Self\-starter and able to work independently as well as in a team environment


**Nice to Have**
* PMP or other professional project manager designation is preferred
* Background in manufacturing software or infrastructure is an asset
* Enjoys solving problems
* Enjoys staying up to date on new technology and continually learning new things
* Able to adapt to change in a fast\-paced environment.

Ensure that project / program governance is strictly adhered to and projects / programs are compliant. Provide the required inputs to the project assurance partner(s).

**Meet the Team**
 Welcome to the Cisco Customer Experience Centre (CXC), a strategic business entity within Cisco's broader Customer Experience (CX) organization. CXC serves as a "trusted advisor" environment, helping organizations explore AI\-driven insights, secure infrastructure, and digital transformation strategies.
   

  

 Our teams operate across strategic regions worldwide, bridging time zones, languages, and local laws to deliver a seamless and relevant customer experience. We are passionate about entire customer lifecycle, from initial vision through adoption to value realization — ensuring that every customer achieves substantial business outcomes through authoritatively engagements.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Project Manager within CXC, you will be at the forefront of Cisco's AI\-first strategy, driving Execution and Delivery through AI\-assisted project management. Your work will directly develop how Cisco delivers value to customers on a global scale.
   

  

**You Will**
* Act as a strategic partner to executive leadership and key customer stakeholders, translating sophisticated technical delivery into compelling business value propositions
* Institutionalize next\-generation project management methodologies, encouraging a culture of AI\-fluency and innovation under Cisco's PMO framework
* Drive predictive delivery by using AI\-driven insights to proactively lead project lifecycles, identifying and mitigating risks before they impact any constraints.
* Hold full accountability for program\-level financial health, including margin optimization, revenue forecasting, and strategic prioritization
* Present service business value to customers, influencing their assessment, planning, and management of critical projects


**Responsibilities**
* Supervise sophisticated, high\-stakes Projects and Programs across multiple accounts, ensuring alignment with global business objectives and long\-term customer success
* Lead large and complex infrastructure projects within an account or group of accounts
* Lead large\-scale, cross\-functional teams to resolve systemic delivery issues, driving consensus across diverse business units, technology areas, and global theatres
* Develop and present proposals and agreements to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Leverage AI assistants and prompt engineering to automate routine project management tasks, including real\-time meeting intelligence, action item tracking, and status reporting
* Use the Digitized Delivery platform and AI\-driven insights to manage project lifecycles proactively, identifying and mitigating potential risks before they impact timelines
* Influence customers in the assessment, planning, and management of projects
* Define and institutionalize next\-generation project management methodologies under Cisco's PMO framework, encouraging a culture of innovation and AI\-fluency


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Engineering or Technology (BE/B.Tech or equivalent)
* Minimum 6 years of dedicated Project Management experience within the IT industry, with an overall experience of 11 to 15 years.

* Superb communication skills.
* Willingness to travel locally and internationally as required by project scope, and adaptability to diverse time zone requirements


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with AI\-assisted project management tools and prompt engineering techniques to drive automation and productivity
* Experience in program\-level management, including revenue forecasting, margin optimization, and strategic resource planning
* Track record of successfully leading large\-scale, cross\-functional teams across geographies and business units


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

description:
Organization Overview:
   

  

 We are a dynamic, global, and diverse Organization, with a presence in over 60 Countries; covering all front post execution Operations teams including product aligned Middle Office groups, Settlements, Margin, Asset Servicing, Listed Derivative \& Commodities Operations. We support an extensive range of Capital Markets products and services including Fixed Income (FX, Rates, Credit, Muni, Cash and Derivatives) where Citi is consistently a dominant top 3 player in the market, Equity (Cash, Derivatives, Prime Brokerage, Futures, Listed Derivatives, FXPB) where Citi has a significant growth program to continue to build out its capabilities and services; and Syndicates where we support both FI and EQ new issues and IPOs.
   

  

 We take pride and are passionate about our People and our culture. We are invested in our People and their development. We are transforming and simplifying our operating model, creating an exciting environment which encourages diversity of thought and inclusion.
   

  

 Our Operations groups are core to the success of the Markets business and have significant impact across the lifecycle of a trade. We partner extensively with a range of internal stakeholders including Front Office Sales and Trading Desks, Compliance, Legal, Finance and HR; alongside having significant interaction with our external client base, playing a key role in the overall client experience. We have a Client relationship group, dedicated to overseeing the Organizational service performance and strategic partnership for our top tier client base, where we play a key role in supporting our global clients to ensure they have a first\-class experience when doing business with Citi.
   

  

 Our Business Intelligence and Process Re\-engineering group works alongside our Operations teams delivering automation solutions to solve for operational challenges. We partner with Citi’s innovation labs to drive optimization, and overall play a pivotal role in enabling us to transform to achieve our target operating model.
   

  

 Our Technology partners develop and implement a wide range of applications that support the Operations, Change, Design and Implementation groups in providing innovative products and solutions. We have re\-imagined how to provide technology and service in our domain through the alignment of our team vision, culture, and aggressive retirement plan for legacy applications and adoption of a micro\-based containerized cloud environment. We encourage our people to create, explore and be adventurous whilst taking measured risk, adopting safe practices to protect the firm. Data lineage and optimization is core to how we develop our eco system. We are growing our capabilities using artificial intelligence, natural language processing and machine learning.
   

  

 Our roles entail ensuring we operate in a robust control environment, whilst in a fast\-paced workplace. We comply with global regulations and internal policies and adopt a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to reduce risk through the continuous evaluation of our controls; to protect our clients, the firm, and our reputation.
   

  

 We work closely with our external global peers, partners, and regulators, and play an integral part in leading an agenda at the forefront to optimize and streamline processes and drive strategy across our industry.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 The Markets Process Engineering team has been formed to support stakeholders both within Operations and across the bank, to design and deliver a multi\-year transformation roadmap. Our transformation is underpinned by strategy, investment change execution and a market leading change delivery team focusing on program and project management, business analysis, process re\-engineering and low code application development.
   

  

 The Futures and OTC Clearing franchise is an agency business providing trading and clearing capabilities across 40\+ exchanges to our clients and proprietary lines of business such as Equities, Rates, Commodities, FX and Prime D1\. The business is embarking on a strategic re\-engineering of its platforms. This is a multi\-year initiative, moving to real\-time computation, and with ambitious goals to design and deliver a more robust, strategic, well controlled end state for Futures and OTC Clearing Operations.
   

  

 We are recruiting for a Project/Business Analyst to help lead the delivery of strategic initiatives. This is a great opportunity to join a growing, global, and dynamic change management team, delivering a major Tier 1 program.
   

  

 The role will work in partnership with the Futures and OTC clearing business, global operations teams, technology and downstream areas such as finance and regulatory reporting.
   

  

 The core responsibilities of the Project Manager and Business Analyst include but not limited to the following:
   

  

* Develop and manage project plans, define project scope, goals, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements to ensure successful project execution.
* Manage project lifecycle from initiation to closure, ensuring that project deliverables are met and proper evidence provided.
* Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies, developing and implementing effective mitigation and contingency plans.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including project charters, requirements, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Facilitate and lead project meetings, including kick\-offs, status updates, working groups and governance forums, to ensure clear and consistent communication among all project participants.
* Conduct business and data analysis to document business and operational processes and recommend improvements.
* Develop and maintain detailed process maps, use cases to support business and functional requirements
* Analyze existing business processes to identify opportunities for improvement, and assist in designing enhanced workflows
* Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure that developed solutions meet business requirements and are fit for purpose.
* Prepare senior level presentations to communicate project updates
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance and other functions to ensure successful project implementation.


**Qualifications:**
* Project Management and Business Analysis experience
* Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) Regulatory Reporting knowledge is a plus
* 2\-3 years operations experience (preferably in banking)
* Critical thinking and problem solving
* Strong ability in use of Microsoft Applications (PowerPoint, Visio, Project, Word, Excel, Access)
* Proficient with the project life cycle (Waterfall \& Agile)
* CAPM, PMP, PgMP and/or MBA are a plus
* Developed communication and diplomacy skills required to persuade and influence others; may negotiate with external parties.


**Role Overview:**
 The role we are recruiting for is a hybrid Business Analyst / Project Manager role aligned to the Equities business. You will be part of the Futures \& Derivatives Clearing (FDC) and Equities Operations Program Execution Team, a key component of the Markets Ops Transformation organization. The team drives strategic transformation and delivers Target Operating Models for FDC and Equities Operations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Project Leadership \& Delivery: Manage end\-to\-end projects from defining scope, milestones and deliverables with stakeholders to ensuring successful, on\-time delivery meeting business needs.
* Planning \& Documentation: Develop comprehensive project documentation, including charters, business requirements, plans, and risk/issue logs.
* Monitoring \& Reporting: Monitor project progress, resources, and risks, identifying and escalating issues promptly and providing timely, clear updates and presentations to all stakeholders, including senior management.
* Process Optimization: Lead business analysis efforts, clarify requirements, and drive the development and implementation of innovative, efficient processes for Equities Operations.
* Risk \& Compliance: Apply robust risk management practices and ensure regulatory compliance to protect the firm's reputation.
* Team \& Collaboration: Drive resource planning and foster strong cross\-functional collaboration across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and other departments.
* Strategic Initiatives: Champion change management and undertake additional strategic projects/tasks as required.

title: Lead, Business Continuity Management
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Lead, Business Continuity Manager (APAC Location)**
**Location**
 Bangalore / Pune
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Lead, Business Continuity Management (APAC Location) is responsible for the development, implementation, governance, testing, and continuous improvement of Business Continuity Management (BCM).
   

  

 This role serves as the primary APAC focal point for technology continuity planning while partnering with global technology teams, infrastructure organizations, cybersecurity, enterprise risk management, business units, and regional regulators. The incumbent will ensure that critical technology services can withstand, respond to, and recover from disruptive events while maintaining compliance with internal policies and regional regulatory requirements.
   

  

 The role requires balancing regional execution with global alignment, ensuring APAC\-specific risks, regulatory obligations, and operational requirements are effectively incorporated into the enterprise resilience framework.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Continuity Strategy \& Governance**
* Lead the APAC Technology Business Continuity Program.
* Develop and maintain regional technology continuity and resilience strategies aligned with global frameworks.
* Ensure regional BCM practices are aligned with enterprise risk management standards and global technology policies.
* Establish governance forums, metrics, reporting, and executive dashboards for continuity and resilience programs.
* Support annual reviews of continuity policies, standards, procedures, and recovery strategies.


**Continuity Planning \& Preparedness**
* Develop, maintain, and govern Technology Business Continuity Plans (BCPs).
* Ensure recovery plans exist for critical platforms, infrastructure services, applications, and technology processes.
* Coordinate Business Impact Analyses (BIA) and risk assessments across APAC technology functions.
* Assess dependencies involving third\-party vendors, cloud service providers, and critical technology partners.
* Maintain inventories of critical services, applications, recovery strategies, and recovery objectives.


**Disaster Recovery \& Resilience Testing**
* Coordinate disaster recovery testing programs across APAC technology teams.
* Manage tabletop exercises, simulation exercises, crisis management drills, and failover testing activities.
* Validate Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).
* Track remediation of gaps identified through testing and post\-incident reviews.
* Produce executive summaries and lessons\-learned reports following exercises.


**Operational Resilience**
* Support identification and mapping of Important Business Services (IBS) and technology dependencies.
* Assess resilience vulnerabilities across people, process, technology, facilities, and third\-party ecosystems.
* Assist in establishing impact tolerances and resilience performance measures.
* Support enterprise operational resilience initiatives and regional regulatory requirements.


**Crisis Management \& Incident Response**
* Support technology crisis management and major incident response activities.
* Participate in regional command centers during significant incidents.
* Coordinate communications, issue escalation, decision tracking, and recovery governance during disruptions.
* Facilitate post\-incident reviews and corrective action plans.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Serve as the primary APAC liaison between global BCM teams and regional technology leadership.
* Partner with:
+ Infrastructure Engineering
+ Cyber Security
+ IT Operations
+ Technology Risk Management
+ Enterprise Risk
+ Corporate Services
+ Business Units

* Provide guidance and coaching to technology teams regarding continuity planning requirements.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Risk Management, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* Master's degree preferred.


**Professional Certifications (Preferred)**
* CBCP (Certified Business Continuity Professional)
* MBCI (Member, Business Continuity Institute)
* ISO 22301 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor
* PMP
* ITIL


**Experience**
* 8\-12 years of experience in Business Continuity Management, Disaster Recovery, Operational Resilience, Technology Risk, or Technology Operations.
* Minimum 3\-5 years managing continuity programs within a technology organization.
* Experience supporting large\-scale global technology environments.
* Experience managing regulatory, audit, and risk management engagements.
* Financial services experience preferred but not mandatory.


**Technical Knowledge**
**Strong Understanding Of**
* Business Continuity Management (BCM)
* Disaster Recovery (DR)


**Leadership Competencies**
* Strategic Thinking
* Executive Communication
* Stakeholder Influence
* Risk\-Based Decision Making
* Program Management
* Problem Solving
* Cross\-Cultural Leadership
* Collaboration Across Global Teams
* Continuous Improvement Mindset


**Success Measures**
**The Role Will Be Measured By**
* Completion and quality of APAC continuity plans.
* Regulatory and audit outcomes.
* DR testing completion and success rates.
* Reduction in continuity\-related risk exposure.
* Timely closure of resilience remediation activities.
* Executive and regulatory reporting quality.
* Recovery readiness for critical technology services.
* Alignment of APAC resilience practices with global standards.


**Scope of Responsibility**
* Regional ownership of Technology BCM and Operational Resilience for APAC.
* Coordination with global continuity and recovery teams.
* Support for technology operations spanning multiple APAC countries and time zones.
* Influence across infrastructure, application delivery, cyber security, and technology operations teams.
* Participation in executive crisis management and major incident governance.


**Working with Us**

title: Cyber Risk Governance & Reporting
description:
Join us as a Cyber Risk Governance \& Reporting at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Cyber Risk Governance \& Reporting, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Managing a large and complex portfolio of cyber risk governance, regulatory assurance, and reporting activities across regions, entities, and stakeholders
* Performing data analysis and preparing responses to support Barclays’ continued compliance with regulatory obligations across the globe
* Strong working knowledge of cyber security, risk management, and regulatory expectations, with the ability to translate complex technical content into clear, non\-technical outputs for senior stakeholders and regulators
* Using collaboration, workflow, and reporting platforms such as SharePoint, trackers, and MI dashboards to generate insights, support decision\-making, monitor delivery, and highlight emerging risks
* Supporting tracking, oversight, and resolution of control issues, including those raised by 2LOD and internal assessments that could impact regulatory compliance
* Driving group\-wide GRC assessments, reporting, and compliance to the Barclays Control Framework to identify control enhancements aligned to regulatory requirements
* Enabling proactive risk identification through thematic analysis, MI\-driven insights, continuous improvement initiatives, and effective stakeholder engagement


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Strong experience in Governance, Risk \& Control within large enterprises, preferably within financial services or a similarly regulated environment
* Ability to generate, analyse, and interpret cyber security MI using qualitative and quantitative techniques to identify trends, risks, control gaps, and improvement opportunities
* Experience with audit oversight, control frameworks, internal assessment activities, and regulatory requirements, including the ability to support evidence\-based assurance and issue remediation
* Ability to translate technical cyber risks into business\-relevant insights, reporting narratives, and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively across cyber, technology, risk, compliance, audit, and senior leadership teams.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, and communication, as well as job\-specific technical skills in cyber risk governance, regulatory engagement, reporting, and quality assurance.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune, India.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To provide independent and balanced advice and counsel to senior stakeholders through problem identification, solving and decision making practices.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Provision of strategic advice to Group Executives to support the decision\-making process of business challenges and opportunities.
* Development and implementation of strategic advisory incentives to grow and optimise the bank’s operations, through market research and analysis.
* Collaboration with various stakeholder groups to identify the appropriate strategic direction type to meet the needs of Barclays clients and investors.
* Development of financial models to support strategic recommendations and transactions through financial data analysis, financial projects and considering the financial impact of transactions.
* Management of transactions, negotiations, transaction structure development and post\-transaction integration.
* Collaboration with internal stakeholders to maintain client relationships, and develop new relationships to identify opportunities.
* Identification of industry trends, maintain peer benchmarking and developments related to strategic advisory services by attendings conferences, participating in training and conducting market research.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: SAP Platform Lead
description:
**Application Deadline:** 
 6 September 2024
 



**Department:** 
 Program Optimus
 



**Location:** 
 India
   

  




**Description**
*Great People Work Here*
 Transforming WHAT we do and HOW we do it.
   

  

 We are embarking on a huge program of global business transformation enabled by the implementation of a new global technology solution. The delivery and embedding of this technology solution across our highly successful and highly de\-centralized business will change the way we work forever, enabling greater data insight, simplification of processes and ways of working and creating greater collaboration across the business.
   

  

**Purpose:** 
 The Platform Leader is accountable for delivering the strategic technical design, implementation, and long\-term vision for applications and integrations under the Optimus program. This role involves strategic leadership, working closely with key stakeholders to align platform initiatives with business goals, ensuring that the technology landscape supports current needs while also preparing for future growth and innovation. In partnership with our SI partner, AMS Partner, SAP, and the business technology services (BTS) architecture team, this role oversees planning and delivery across Basis, Infrastructure, Security, technical development, integrations, and overall technical architecture of our global SAP solution. The role demands a blend of strategic thinking, hands\-on leadership, problem\-solving, and good relationship management.
   

  

**Scope:** 
 This is a global role covering TwiningsOvo (TwO) international businesses. The role will require occasional international travel.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide strategic leadership in the implementation of platforms and applications under the Optimus program, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and long\-term strategy.
* Oversee the development and execution of the platform and integration strategy, ensuring that platforms are secure by design, scalable, and able to support the future growth of the business.
* Respond strategically to new and emerging security threats and vulnerabilities, ensuring proactive rather than reactive responses.
* Develop and implement policies for managing applications and platforms securely, including identity and access management, patching, and disaster recovery, with a focus on future\-proofing the technology landscape.
* * * Provide the strategic implementation of iPaaS platforms that deliver any\-to\-any integration across heterogeneous applications in hybrid landscapes worldwide.
* Foster innovation and strategic thinking in the development and building of a centralized, well\-documented API estate, promoting reuse and supporting API versioning and lifecycle management.
* Shape the current and target state of application and integration architectures, defining and managing strategic standards, guidelines, and processes to govern integration and future expansion.
* Ensure the seamless transition from the program to BAU of all platforms, applications, and integrations, establishing comprehensive strategic processes and comprehensive documentation to support long\-term sustainability.
* Collaborate strategically with AMS teams to analyze operations and develop cost\-effective strategies to reduce manual tasks and improve the overall health and performance of underlying platforms.
* Stay ahead of technology trends and explore the strategic application of existing, new, and emerging technologies to enable new and evolving business and operating models.
* Develop strategic partnerships with other leaders to implement new platforms, develop custom solutions, and modernize integrations to support the company’s strategic direction.
* Maintain and develop strategic relationships with key technology suppliers, ensuring that their roadmaps align with our long\-term strategic goals.
* Manage financial budgets strategically, ensuring that investments are aligned with the long\-term health and strategic direction of the platforms and applications.
* **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
	+ At least 10 years of hands\-on experience working with SAP technologies in a large\-scale, multi\-platform systems environment.
	+ Demonstrated ability to develop and implement strategic plans for platform security and emerging security threats.
	+ Expertise in future\-focused SAP tech stack/platforms: i.e., SAP S/4HANA, SAP Cloud ALM, IAG, Ariba, IBP, etc.
	+ Proven strategic leadership in developing and delivering large\-scale IT projects across multiple geographies and platforms.
	+ Good strategic planning skills with experience in shaping and delivering long\-term technical roadmaps aligned with business goals.
	+ Demonstrated growth in influencing and executing strategic decisions that balance business needs and technical capabilities.

	+ PF and Gratuity.
	+ Long Service Policy.
	+ Life Term Policy,
	+ Monthly Broadband Bill Reimbursement \- Rs.2000 or on actual whichever is lower.

 Strong communication skills
