title: Factory Manager- Aluminium Facades
description:
Production Manager – Aluminium Façades
 



**Company:** 
 McCoy Architectural Systems Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Location:** 
 Chakan, Pune
 



**Department:** 
 Aluminium Façades Manufacturing
 



**Reports to:** 
 Plant Head / Factory Manager
 



**Direct reports:** 
 Production Engineers, Supervisors, Operators, Assembly Technicians and Helpers
 



**Functional coordination:** 
 Engineering, PPC, Quality, Procurement, Stores, Maintenance, EHS and Site Installation
 



 This role is tailored for an architectural façade manufacturing environment involving aluminium façade systems, skylights and related building\-envelope products.
 



 Job purpose
 



 To plan, manage and control aluminium façade production so that products are manufactured safely, accurately, economically and according to approved drawings, project schedules and quality requirements.
 



 Key responsibilities
 



 Production planning and execution
 


* Execute production plans issued by PPC.
* Manage cutting, CNC machining, routing, drilling, assembly and packing activities.
* Ensure correct production sequencing for stick, unitised, semi\-unitised, curtain\-wall and cladding systems.
* Allocate manpower, machines, tools and workstations.
* Monitor daily production against planned quantities and project milestones.
* Coordinate production priorities with Engineering, PPC and Project Management.



 Technical and drawing control
 


* Ensure production uses only approved and revision\-controlled drawings.
* Verify profiles, accessories, glass, brackets, fasteners, gaskets and sealants before production.
* Review fabrication drawings, cutting lists, BOMs and assembly instructions.
* Identify design or constructability issues before production starts.
* Coordinate technical clarifications with the Engineering Department.



 Quality control
 


* Ensure correct profile dimensions, cutting accuracy, drilling positions and assembly tolerances.
* Control joint preparation, corner crimping, screw fixing, sealing and gasket installation.
* Ensure correct use of approved sealants, tapes, fasteners and accessories.
* Coordinate first\-piece inspection and in\-process inspection with QA/QC.
* Reduce rejection, leakage risk, scratches, dents, colour mismatch and rework.
* Support mock\-ups, performance testing and customer inspections.



 Manpower and shop\-floor management
 


* Supervise production supervisors and shift teams.
* Maintain skill matrices and arrange operator training.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, overtime and labour productivity.
* Establish standard work instructions for repetitive operations.
* Promote 5S, visual management and continuous improvement.



 Material and inventory control
 


* Coordinate with Stores for timely availability of aluminium profiles and accessories.
* Control material identification, batch traceability and project\-wise segregation.
* Minimise profile wastage and damage during handling.
* Ensure proper protection of finished components before dispatch.
* Report shortages, excess consumption and material discrepancies.



 Equipment and maintenance
 


* Ensure proper operation of saws, CNC machines, routers, drilling machines, crimping machines and assembly tools.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance with the Maintenance Department.
* Report machine breakdowns and production losses promptly.
* Ensure calibration and condition of measuring instruments and jigs.



 Safety and compliance
 


* Enforce PPE, safe material handling and machine\-guarding requirements.
* Ensure safe use of sealants, solvents, adhesives and cutting equipment.
* Conduct toolbox talks and shop\-floor safety inspections.
* Stop unsafe work and report incidents or near misses.
* Maintain good housekeeping and emergency access routes.



 Dispatch and site coordination
 


* Coordinate packing and dispatch in the required installation sequence.
* Ensure identification marks, labels, packing lists and project documents are complete.
* Support site teams with installation feedback and technical clarification.
* Analyse site complaints and implement corrective actions in production.



 Key performance indicators
 


* Production plan achievement
* On\-time project dispatch
* Labour productivity
* First\-pass quality acceptance
* Rework and rejection percentage
* Aluminium profile utilisation and wastage
* Machine utilisation and downtime
* Material damage during production
* Customer/site complaints
* Safety observations and incidents
* 5S and housekeeping audit score



 Decision\-making authority
 



 The Production Manager may:
 


* Allocate manpower and production resources.
* Re\-sequence work within approved project priorities.
* Hold defective or damaged material for inspection.
* Stop production where drawings, materials or safety conditions are inadequate.
* Recommend overtime, subcontracting or additional manpower.
* Initiate corrective action for recurring production problems.



 Changes to design, specifications, material grades, finishes or approved drawings require Engineering and Quality approval.
 



 Qualification
 


* Degree or diploma in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering.
* Additional knowledge of aluminium façade systems, curtain walls, cladding or glazing is preferred.
* Knowledge of CAD drawings, BOMs, production planning and inspection procedures.



 Experience
 


* 8–12 years in aluminium façade, curtain\-wall, cladding, glazing or architectural metal manufacturing.
* Experience supervising a project\-based, customised production environment.
* Experience with aluminium profiles, CNC machining, façade accessories and assembly tolerances.
* Exposure to site installation and façade mock\-up requirements is desirable.



 Required skills
 


* Aluminium façade production knowledge
* Production planning and manpower control
* Drawing and BOM interpretation
* Problem\-solving and root\-cause analysis
* Quality and dimensional\-control awareness
* ERP/MIS reporting
* Vendor and subcontractor coordination
* Team leadership and communication
* Strong safety and housekeeping discipline



 Personal attributes

title: Senior Analyst - Incident Management
description:
For more than 40 years, Accelya has been the industry’s partner for change, simplifying airline financial and commercial processes and empowering the air transport community to take better control of the future. Whether partnering with IATA on industry\-wide initiatives or enabling digital transformation to simplify airline processes, Accelya drives the airline industry forward and proudly puts control back in the hands of airlines so they can move further, faster.
   

  

**Critical Incident Manager (CIM)**
**Location: Pune / Hybrid**
**Role Purpose**
 As an
 **Critical** 
**Incident Manager (CIM)** 
 , you will lead the end\-to\-end management of business\-critical and high\-visibility production incidents, ensure rapid restoration of services and minimizing customer impact. You will direct incident response activities, coordinate cross\-functional teams, and drive effective communication strategies throughout the incident lifecycle.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for owning and managing P1/P2 incidents, ensuring timely resolution within SLA commitments, driving structured incident governance, and maintaining alignment between technical teams, business stakeholders, and customers.
   

  

 This position will be responsible for incident management, stakeholder communication, operational governance, root cause analysis, and continuous service improvement. The focus will be on ensuring operational resilience, maintaining customer trust, improving service reliability, and driving proactive incident prevention initiatives in line with
 **Accelya's global business strategy, values, and mission.**
**Duties \& Responsibilities**
**Incident Ownership \& Lifecycle Management**
* Own and manage the lifecycle of critical P1/P2 and high\-priority incidents from detection through resolution and closure.
* Act as the primary escalation point for major incidents, ensuring timely engagement of appropriate stakeholders and technical teams.
* Perform impact assessments, severity classification, and incident prioritization to ensure effective response execution.
* Drive production fixes, workarounds, and mitigation plans required to restore services.


**Incident Coordination \& Bridge Management**
* Assemble and lead Incident Response Teams (IRT) across Engineering, Cloud Operations, Infrastructure, DevOps, and Support functions.
* Initiate, facilitate, and manage incident bridge calls, ensuring clear accountability, ownership, and progress tracking.
* Remove operational roadblocks and maintain resolution momentum throughout the incident lifecycle.


**Stakeholder \& Customer Communication**
* Provide timely, accurate, and structured communications to customers, leadership teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure communication consistency across customer notifications, management updates, bridge calls, and service status channels.
* Manage communications for high\-impact incidents affecting strategic customers and business\-critical operations.


**Status Page \& Customer Transparency**
* Own customer\-facing status page updates for all major incidents.
* Publish clear incident updates outlining customer impact, affected services, mitigation activities, and recovery progress.
* Maintain defined communication cadence throughout incident management and restoration activities.
* Ensure alignment of messaging across all communication channels.


**RCA \& Problem Management**
* Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) creation, review, quality assurance, and timely delivery.
* Identify recurring issues and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to eliminate underlying causes.
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to closure.


**Monitoring, Governance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Proactively monitor service health and operational alerts to identify potential service disruptions.
* Lead Daily Operations Reviews (DORs), providing updates on incident trends, risks, and operational performance.
* Analyze incident patterns and service trends to identify stability improvements and automation opportunities.
* Support enhancements in monitoring, alerting, reporting dashboards, and operational tooling.
* Maintain audit\-ready incident documentation across Zendesk, Jira, RCA repositories, and reporting systems.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud Operations, Product, DevOps, and Support teams to improve service reliability and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate with external vendors and technology partners during critical incidents when required.
* Ensure accountability, ownership, and adherence to escalation processes across all stakeholder groups.


**Operational Excellence**
* Drive accountability throughout incident management, ensuring timely service restoration and closure.
* Participate in a 24x7 rotational on\-call support model to provide uninterrupted major incident coverage.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, operational excellence, and customer\-first service delivery.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* Proven experience in Major Incident Management, Service Operations, Production Support, IT Service Management, or Site Reliability Operations.
* Strong experience managing critical P1/P2 incidents in complex enterprise or SaaS environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross\-functional technical teams during high\-pressure incident situations.
* Hands\-on experience with incident management processes aligned with ITIL best practices.
* Experience conducting incident triage, impact assessments, severity classification, and escalation management.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, customers, and technical teams.
* Experience driving Root Cause Analysis (RCA), corrective action tracking, and problem management initiatives.
* Knowledge of cloud\-based environments, distributed systems, and modern application architectures.
* Experience with ticketing and incident management tools such as Jira, Zendesk, ServiceNow, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**Preferred Experience \& Skills**
* ITIL Foundation or higher certification.
* Experience supporting airline, travel technology, SaaS, or mission\-critical enterprise platforms.
* Knowledge of AWS, Azure, or cloud\-native operational environments.
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Splunk, or Dynatrace.
* Experience driving automation initiatives within operational support environments.
* Exposure to SRE, DevOps, Problem Management, and Change Management practices.
* Experience creating executive dashboards and operational reporting metrics.


**What do we offer?**
* Open culture and challenging opportunity to satisfy intellectual needs
* Flexible working hours
* Smart working: hybrid remote/office working environment
* Work\-life balance
* Excellent, dynamic and multicultural environment


**About Accelya**
*Accelya is a leading global software provider to the airline industry, powering 200\+ airlines with an open, modular software platform that enables innovative airlines to drive growth, delight their customers and take control of their retailing.*
*Owned by Vista Equity Partners long\-term perennial fund and with 2K\+ employees based around 10 global offices, Accelya are trusted by industry leaders to deliver now and deliver for the future.*
*The company's passenger, cargo, and industry platforms support airline retailing from offer to settlement, both above and below the wing. Accelya is proud to deliver leading\-edge technologies to its customers, including through its partnership with AWS and through the pioneering NDC expertise of its Global Product teams.*
*We are proud to enable innovation\-led growth for the airline industry and put control back in the hands of airlines.*
 For more information, please visit
 **www.accelya.com** 
 .
   

  

 What does the future of the air transport industry look like to you? Whether you’re an industry veteran or someone with experience from other industries, we want to make your ambitions a reality!

This includes making a positive contribution to the development of the team and wider FPC business, as well as working effectively with all FPC colleagues to successfully deliver projects and support FPC’s business objectives.

	+ Carry out any other duties reasonably requested by FPC Management


**Qualifications**

 Experience and Qualifications
   

  





 The Digital Buildings Consultant Engineer should possess experience and qualifications in the following:

* Proven track record in Digital Building related roles e.g. Consultant, Designer, Project Manager or Engineer
* Required Bachelor's or Master's degree in Controls, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

**Group Leader \- Architecture Practice** 




  





**Work Arrangement:** 
 Work from Office

 Monday to Friday

 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM
 



**Work Location:** 
 South Delhi

 INR 24\.00 to INR 35\.00 LPA, based on fit and experience
 



  





**About Role** 




 We are hiring a
 **Group Leader \- Architecture Practice** 
 for a reputed design\-led architecture and interior design practice based in New Delhi.
 



  





 This is a senior leadership role for an architect who can lead projects, guide teams, work closely with Partners, handle clients maturely, and bring design, execution, and people leadership together.
 



  





 The role is not limited to design delivery. It requires someone who can own a group, build team clarity, manage project priorities, and contribute to the long\-term strength of the practice.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Lead an architecture group across concept, design development, documentation, consultant coordination, and site delivery.
* Manage 5 to 6 active projects at a time, across hospitality, selective residences, clubhouses, amenity blocks, and mixed\-use developments.
* Work closely with Partners on project priorities, design reviews, client expectations, and team performance.
* Manage client and consultant communication with maturity, clarity, and accountability.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of approximately 7 to 15 architects and designers.
* Coordinate with engineering, services, structural, MEP, landscape, and other consultants.
* Understand project contracts, milestones, billing dependencies, time implications, and scope creep.
* Identify risks early and create practical plans before they become client, team, or commercial escalations.
* Build a clear, supportive, and accountable team rhythm.
* Contribute to group\-level planning, team bandwidth management, and project profitability awareness.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 12\-18 years of experience in architecture, with strong design, execution, client, and team leadership depth.
* Strong design judgment; able to generate, evaluate, and advance ideas rather than only execute instructions.
* Genuine prior team leadership experience, not just senior individual\-contributor time.
* Ability to lead 7 to 15 people over time, through delegation, review, and mentoring.
* Strong client\-facing communication and trust\-building.
* Experience managing multiple complex projects in parallel.
* Comfort working in a Partner\-led studio structure, with trust, humility, and independent judgment.
* Commercial awareness: understands time, scope, milestones, billing, and profitability implications.
* High emotional intelligence and calm under ambiguity, pressure, and multi\-project load.
* Long\-term orientation towards leadership, not just a senior designation.



**Good to Have** 



* Hotel / hospitality architecture experience.
* Clubhouse, workspace, commercial, or complex mixed\-use project experience.
* Experience in a structured architecture or design\-led practice.
* Ability to manage larger groups of 12 to 15 people.



  





**This Role May Be Right For You If** 



* You enjoy leading people as much as you enjoy leading design.
* You can work with senior Partners while also guiding younger architects.
* You treat a group as a small business unit, not just a task pipeline.
* You can handle clients without becoming defensive or overly transactional.
* You understand that good design requires concept, execution, coordination, and delivery discipline together.
* You are looking for a long\-term leadership path within a serious design practice.



  





**This Role May Not Be Right For You If** 



* You are a strong project manager but not a people leader.
* You are uncomfortable mentoring, delegating, or holding team clarity.
* You need constant Partner direction for routine project decisions.
* Your experience is housing\-only, with limited appetite for hospitality or services complexity.
* You are not comfortable with client conversations.
* You prefer a loose, unstructured, or purely independent practice style.
* You are looking only for a title or compensation jump.

**Engineering Manager, Passkeys**
 Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
   

  

**About the Role**
 As we establish our India Engineering Center of Excellence (COE), we are looking for an experienced
 **Engineering Manager** 
 who can lead and grow the Passkeys team. You will build the technology taking the world beyond passwords. Bitwarden is a credential provider across browser, desktop, and mobile, and the Passkeys team owns our implementation of WebAuthn and FIDO2 — creating and asserting credentials, integrating with each platform's credential provider APIs, and the emerging standards for moving credentials between providers so that users are never locked in.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Hire, develop, and retain a strong team of engineers
* Set and report on measurable goals and objectives for the team
* Facilitate team ceremonies including weekly syncs, backlog refinements, retrospectives, and sprint planning
* Monitor in\-flight work to identify blocked items, proactively drive resolution, and provide contextual updates outside of the team to the rest of the organization
* Own escalation and triage for production issues, community\-reported bugs, and enterprise customer escalations related to autofill behavior and desktop integrations
* Maintain a healthy, sprint\-ready backlog by prioritizing bugs and tech debt alongside feature work and ensuring all items are well\-defined with accurate descriptions, technical breakdowns, and designs prior to refinement
* Serve as the primary liaison between your engineering team and Design, Product, Architecture, and other engineering teams, fielding cross\-functional questions and maintaining alignment on priorities
* Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to synthesize requests into prioritized, actionable work
* Continuously identify friction points in team processes and develop solutions to improve efficiency, quality, and developer experience
* Create an inclusive environment where teamwork and collaboration are valued
* Conduct regular 1:1s, develop individualized performance goals and growth plans, and identify stretch opportunities to support each engineer's career progression
* Perform annual or semi\-annual performance reviews when required


**What You'll Bring**
* 10\-12 years of demonstrated experience leading engineering teams or complex cross\-functional product engineering initiatives within a software engineering organization.
* Experience working in globally distributed Product Engineering, GCC, or Center of Excellence environments along with managing distributed or cross\-regional teams, including working across time zones.
* Proven ability to successfully lead delivery across engineering organizations and influence multiple stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Agile software development, modern engineering practices, and product delivery lifecycles.
* Experience in Engineering Management, Technical Program Management, Engineering Delivery, Product Operations, Design Program Management, or similar leadership roles.
* Ability to communicate effectively with Engineering, Product, Design, and executive stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving, prioritization, and decision\-making skills with a continuous improvement mindset.
* A coaching\-oriented leadership style with demonstrated experience developing high\-performing teams.
* Strong technical background in CI/CD, automation \& release engineering \- sufficient to engage credibly in technical discussions and step in hands\-on when necessary.
* Excellent communication skills, with experience representing a team's work to leadership and stakeholders outside the team.
* Prior experience managing or working closely with BRE, SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering teams.
* Formal management training or certifications preferred.
* Experience with specific tools like Jira, Confluence, or similar project management platforms preferred with AI tooling for development and workflow support (Claude Code or similar).


**Success in This Role**
 You'll thrive in this position if you:
   

  

* Lead through influence, collaboration, and trust.
* Bring structure without introducing unnecessary processes.
* Balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Create clarity across complex, cross\-functional initiatives.
* Enjoy building teams, developing people, and enabling engineering excellence.
* Are energized by helping establish and scale a world\-class Engineering organization.


**Why Join Us**
 This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up.
   

  

 Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
   

  

 Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization \& contribute to products used by customers around the world.
   

  

 If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast\-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

Requisition Id: 1745255
   

  

 As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. **The opportunity** 
 : Project Consultant\-GOV\-SaT\-SaT \- TCF \- Infrastructure Advisory \- New Delhi
   

  

**GOV :**
 Our Global Government \& Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best\-in\-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
   

  

 Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
   

  

 To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re\-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross\-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
   

  

 We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head\-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
   

  

**SaT :**
 The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government \& Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
   

  

 The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sector’s diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY’s Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firm’s sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
   

  

 The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social \& Health care, Education, Urban \& Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste \& Sanitation, Power \& Utilities and Public Finance \& Management.
   

  

**SaT \- TCF \- Infrastructure Advisory :**
 Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to today’s toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade\-offs to support them with better decision\-making around financing and capital efficiency.
   

  

 Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go\-to\-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision\-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
   

  

 Our key focus areas are \- Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon \- Strategy and EY Parthenon \- Execution.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**
* Demonstrated technical understanding of infrastructure development concepts and advisory frameworks. Ability to support infrastructure projects through structured analysis, research, and problem\-solving. Proficient in preparing clear project documentation, data summaries, and client\-ready deliverables. Experience in evaluating infrastructure\-related business, operational, and implementation considerations. Capable of contributing to consulting engagements with a strong focus on technical accuracy and project execution.


**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**
* Master of Architecture
* Post Graduate Diploma in Management


**Experience**
* Project Management (6\+ years)


**What We Look For**
 People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side\-by\-side with market\-leading entrepreneurs, game\-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
   

  

 EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
   

  

 If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
   

  

 Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

 We are seeking an experienced Project Designer to join a design\-led commercial interiors practice, specializing in large\-scale hospitality, institutional, clubhouse, and office environments. title: Project Manager
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.


We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!


Job Description


**Project Manager (Industrial Automation)**

A Project Manager at Rockwell Automation leads projects through their entire lifecycle—from initiation and planning to execution, monitoring, and closure. You will ensure projects meet scope, schedule, cost, and quality goals while complying with Rockwell Automation's Quality Management System (QMS) standards.


You will be reporting to Director Engineering Delivery / Sr. Manager in a hybrid capacity.


We are open to hire \- Noida location.


**Your Responsibilities:**

* **Project Planning** : Develop project schedules, budgets, and resource plans; monitor progress and implement
* **Coordination \& Communication** : Act as the primary point of contact for customers and other teams; lead project meetings and manage team member expectations.
* **Quality \& Compliance** : Ensure deliverables meet QMS requirements and follow engineering standards.
* **Risk \& Issue Management** : Identify risks early, implement mitigation strategies, and resolve issues promptly.
* **Reporting** : Provide regular status updates, financial forecasts, and documentation for partners.

**The Essentials – You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field (preferred).
* We prefer a PMP or equivalent.
* Experience in project management in industrial automation or related sectors.
* Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with Rockwell Automation products and tools like Microsoft Project.
* Inspire, guide, and develop teams to achieve organisational goals.
* Plan and prioritisation capabilities to ensure efficient workflow and resource management.
* Foster collaboration and understanding across all levels.
* Project Management: experience to manage multiple projects within a matrix environment, ensuring delivery and quality outcomes.

**The Preferred – You Might Also Have:**

* Total experience 10\+ years with 2\+ years in project management in industrial automation or related sectors.
* Experience in project management for process automation
* Partner with multiple team members and influence project decisions, teamwork, customer service

**What We Offer:**

* Our benefits package includes …
	+ Comprehensive mindfulness programmes with a premium membership to Calm
	+ Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
	+ Company volunteer and donation matching programme – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
	+ Employee Assistance Program
	+ Personalised wellbeing programmes through our OnTrack programme
	+ On\-demand digital course library for professional development

... and other local benefits!


*At Rockwell Automation, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply.*

**\#LI\-Hybrid**

**\#LI\-SM1**

Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

description:
Job Description – Project Coordinator Intern

**Company:** RiskBirbal Insurance Broker Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Business Operations / Project Management  
**Location:** Janakpuri, New Delhi  
**Experience:** Freshers / Graduates  
**Duration:** 6 Months  
**Stipend:** ₹7,000 per month  
**Work Mode:** On\-site / In\-person

About the Role

RiskBirbal Insurance Broker Pvt. Ltd. is a technology\-driven insurance broking company operating primarily in the **B2B insurance space**. We are looking for a motivated and organized **Project Coordinator Intern** to support project execution, team coordination, and day\-to\-day business operations.

This internship is ideal for graduates who are interested in project management, business operations, and building a career in the insurance industry.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in planning, coordinating, and tracking ongoing projects.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely completion of tasks.
* Maintain project trackers, reports, and documentation.
* Follow up with team members and stakeholders on assigned activities.
* Schedule meetings, prepare updates, and maintain project records.
* Identify delays or challenges and communicate them to the reporting manager.
* Support process improvement and day\-to\-day operational activities.
* Assist in preparing MIS reports and performance updates.
* Ensure smooth communication between departments and stakeholders.

Eligibility \& Requirements

* **Graduation is mandatory.**
* Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent coordination, organizational, and time\-management skills.
* Presentable, confident, expressive, and professional personality.
* Good logical thinking, problem\-solving ability, and learning aptitude.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and MS Office is preferred.
* Willingness to learn and work in a fast\-paced, office\-based environment.
* Candidates residing in Delhi/NCR, preferably near Janakpuri, are preferred.

What We Offer

* Practical exposure to project coordination and business operations.
* Experience working in a B2B insurance broking environment.
* Mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals.
* Opportunity to develop project management, communication, and organizational skills.
* Exposure to multiple departments and business processes.

**Candidates who are organized, proactive, good communicators, and interested in project management and the insurance industry are encouraged to apply.**

Pay: ₹7,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Principal Hardware Project Manager – SoC/MCU

Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.
   

  





 Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Individual will be responsible for managing the hardware development of SOC/MCU from concept to mass production. During the life cycle of the project, he would be responsible for

* Solid technical background with understanding and/or hands\-on experience in of HW Chip development (CPU’s/GPU’s/MCU’s/SoC’s/Memory dev etc.)
* Able to plan and manage complex Projects spanning across multiple departments and different development phases (from concept to production).

title: Technical Project Coordinator
description:

 Noventiq (Noventiq Holdings PLC) is a leading global solutions and services provider in digital transformation and cybersecurity, headquartered in London. The company enables, facilitates, and accelerates digital transformation for its customers’ businesses, connecting 80,000\+ organizations across all sectors with a vast selection of best\-in\-class IT vendors, alongside its own services and solutions.
   

  

 Noventiq delivered record gross revenue of $1\.6 billion for the 12 months to March 31, 2023, an increase of 52% in constant currency. title: Staff Project Engineering Manager
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent years managing ASIC and IC design projects where the stakes are real, timelines are tight, and the difference between a successful tapeout and a missed window is your ability to see around corners. You know that the hardest part of delivering complex IP is not just the technical work, it is keeping cross\-functional teams aligned when R\&D, Marketing, Sales, and customers all have different definitions of "done."
   

  

 You do not manage by status reports alone. You get into the details when a SerDes PHY design hits a roadblock, understand the technical tradeoffs well enough to ask the right questions, and work with your engineers to find a path forward that does not compromise quality or schedule. You have learned that risk management is not about spreadsheets, it is about knowing which risks to escalate, which to mitigate quietly, and which conversations to have before they become problems.
   

  

 You are the kind of leader who can translate a customer's vague requirement into a concrete project scope, push back when timelines do not match reality, and still maintain trust on all sides. You care about process, but only when it makes the team faster and more effective, not for its own sake.
   

  

 At Synopsys, you will lead SerDes PHY IP projects that power the next generation of high\-speed connectivity in everything from data centers to automotive systems. The work is technical, the teams are global, and what you deliver will ship in products that matter.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of high\-speed SerDes PHY IP projects from definition through tapeout and customer deployment
* Lead cross\-functional project teams including design engineers, verification engineers, and layout specialists to execute against aggressive schedules
* Partner with R\&D and Marketing to define project roadmaps, prioritize features, and align technical deliverables with market requirements
* Identify resource gaps, manage project risks, and resolve cross\-team dependencies before they block progress
* Drive process improvements across the engineering organization, implementing best practices that reduce cycle time and improve quality
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support teams on pre\-sales technical engagement and post\-sales issue resolution
* Deliver regular status updates to executive leadership and customers, translating technical progress into business outcomes


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Accelerate time\-to\-market for advanced SerDes IP that enables high\-speed connectivity in AI, automotive, and data center applications
* Enable customers to meet increasingly complex design requirements with proven, high\-quality IP that integrates cleanly into their SoCs
* Strengthen Synopsys' reputation as a trusted partner for mission\-critical semiconductor IP through consistent on\-time, on\-spec delivery
* Improve engineering efficiency across the organization by identifying bottlenecks and implementing scalable processes that work across multiple projects
* Foster tighter collaboration between R\&D, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Support, ensuring alignment from early concept through customer deployment
* Contribute directly to Synopsys' leadership position in high\-speed interface IP, supporting customers building the next generation of smart, connected devices
* Mentor project leads and engineers on your team, building organizational capability in technical program management and cross\-functional leadership


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 8\+ years of relevant experience, or Master's/PhD with 6\+ years
* Deep technical knowledge of IC design, ASIC development flows, and semiconductor IP integration, particularly in mixed\-signal or SerDes domains
* Proven track record leading complex engineering projects in a high\-tech environment, ideally in semiconductor IP or ASIC development
* Strong risk management and change management skills, with experience navigating technical uncertainty and scope changes without derailing schedules
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, you can explain technical tradeoffs to executives and translate customer requirements into actionable engineering plans
* Experience with SerDes PHY IP, high\-speed interface standards like PCIe, USB, or Ethernet is a strong plus
* Familiarity with project management methodologies and tools, whether Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches tailored to hardware development


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can walk into a project review, quickly assess whether the team is on track or at risk, and ask the two questions that get to the real issue
* When a customer escalation lands on your desk, you do not panic or deflect, you pull the right people together, get to root cause, and own the path to resolution
* You are comfortable pushing back on unrealistic timelines or under\-scoped requirements, but you do it in a way that builds trust rather than defensiveness
* You see process improvement as a means to an end, not a goal in itself, and you know the difference between a process that helps and one that just adds overhead
* You are detail\-oriented enough to catch a missed dependency in a project plan, but strategic enough to keep the team focused on what actually moves the needle
* You adapt quickly when priorities shift, resources change, or a technical assumption turns out to be wrong, and you help your team do the same without losing momentum


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 Join our Mixed\-Signal Semiconductor IP team, a collaborative group driving innovation in high\-speed SerDes solutions for next\-generation devices.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

* Establish delivery discipline: predictable cadence, transparent reporting, and continuous improvement.
* Champion an AI\-first engineering culture; ensure AI tooling is used safely and effectively.
* Ensure engineering excellence: quality, security, reliability, and operability by design.


 AI\-Driven SDLC \& Transformation
   

  

* Embed our AI\-driven SDLC (AI\-assisted design, coding, testing, documentation, and release readiness) into day\-to\-day delivery.
* Drive adoption of AI ways of working (guardrails, playbooks, and training) in partnership with Enablement/Architecture.

* Run planning and execution rituals; manage dependencies and cross\-team alignment.
* Remove impediments, manage delivery risk early, and drive predictable releases.

 People, Talent \& Operations

* Set performance expectations, coach growth, and build a feedback culture aligned to Thales leadership.
* Own capacity and execution tracking; escalate risks with options.
* Ensure operational excellence (on\-call readiness, incident learnings, and continuous improvement).


 What You Bring

* Strong delivery management: planning, dependency/risk management, release management, and stakeholder communication.

* Proven change leadership: scaling new tools and practices, including AI\-assisted development.
* AI fluency: hands\-on experience with AI coding/testing/documentation tools and an ability to coach safe, effective adoption.


 Success Looks Like
   

  

* Predictable delivery: roadmaps translated into realistic plans and on\-time releases with transparent trade\-offs.
* AI\-driven SDLC adopted across squads with measurable improvements in cycle time, automation coverage, and quality.
* Strong engineering outcomes: security and reliability targets met; reduced incident/defect escape rates.
* High\-performing teams: clear expectations, visible growth, and healthy engagement/retention.


 Reporting Line
   

  

 This role reports to the Engineering Director.
   

  

 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Senior Lead, Information Technology (IT) and System Support
description:
Are you a change maker who wants to play a pivotal role in restoring vision for millions of people in low\-income settings across India? Would you like to work for an organisation that is a pioneer in social impact practices?
 





 We are seeking a highly motivated, dynamic, and self\-driven candidate who would like to have a challenging and meaningful career path in information technology and the social sector. Information Technology (IT) is a key focus area in our organisation and requires a proactive and dynamic approach. The candidate should be dedicated and sincere towards her/his work and should always be open to learning new things. The candidate should have in\-depth subject matter knowledge, expertise, and experience. Timely and high\-quality delivery of goals would be essential and will be a key performance measurement criterion. S/he will be based out of Delhi NCR (Noida), India.
 




  





**About You** 



* You love all aspects of IT and are comfortable talking about WAPs, routers, and websites one minute, Microsoft Azure, SAP, and Salesforce the next, researching new technologies in the morning, and writing SOPs and meeting with developers in the afternoon.
* You enjoy working with cross\-functional teams to learn what their needs are and turn those needs into requirements and user stories/use cases.
* You enjoy working with programmers to build out the project/feature release plan.
* You are a team player and enjoy working with other IT professionals.
* You work well in an open planned environment and see everyone as an equal, no matter what their responsibilities are.
* You are flexible and adaptable and thrive in environments where each day is unlike the next.
* You operate with integrity and take pride in going above and beyond even when no one is watching.
* You love to start, run, and complete projects, no matter how big or small.
* You are excited to demonstrate your projects.
* You enjoy problem solving that requires research and development.
* You like to manage technology projects of any nature.




  
 




**About Us** 



* We are creating access to eyeglasses for low\-income people. Clear vision creates opportunities for increased learning, work, safety, civic participation, and quality of life.
* As a social organisation, social change motivates us first. Our focus is on advancing our mission objectives \- to increase functioning, productivity, and income earning potential for our low\-income people by correcting impaired vision with eyeglasses.
* We are working to transform the systemic dysfunction which has failed to deliver eyeglasses \- a 700\-year\-old technology \- to approximately 55 Crore people in India in need of vision correction.
* We serve low\-income people who are more than beneficiaries to us. The people (and the partners) we serve expect high\-quality eye\-screening and eyeglasses.
* To efficiently scale, we must deliver each new unit at less cost.
* We run our operations on financial metrics and social impact measures. We leverage a range of processes and practices to get the work done.
* We believe in scaling our impact, not our organisation. We are a lean team of doers.



  





**What You’ll Do** 





 You will be leading the IT department and the talented individuals that are part of the same. You will be responsible for providing management for the development and release of internal and external software projects and the management of system support and infrastructure operations. If you work well in an energising environment, have excellent communication, superb administrative and technical skills, can multi\-task under pressure, and are self\-motivated…we want you!
 




  





**Essential Functions** 



* Managing IT operations teams for internal system support and Azure cloud/LAN infrastructure.
* Planning and implementing projects ensuring timely and accurate communication and distribution of information, documentation, and issue resolution to all appropriate team members.
* Leading, facilitating, and tracking project deliverables using Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
* Overseeing QA/QC testing, user acceptance/adoption, and tools research and selection.
* Strong hands\-on experience in cybersecurity tools, risk mitigation, and compliance.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL framework.
* Administer and manage SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 suite.
* Develop intranet portals, document management system, workflows (Power Automate), and permissions architecture.
* Manage SharePoint security, data retention policies, and integration with other work/operational apps.
* Drive user adoption and training for SharePoint and Teams.
* Budgeting, vendor management, license compliance, and IT asset management.
* Maintain IT documentation, SOPs, and IT risk register
* Providing program insights efficiently.
* Working with teams across multiple locations.
* Overseeing the programming team.
* Experiencing managing software development projects.



  





**What’s Required** 



* 15\+ years’ experience in IT operations and software product development.
* Fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English
* Experience in feature release planning, product charter, scope definition, requirements gathering, project planning, change control, risk management, and reporting.
* Ability to break down the requirements into user stories and can run the stories with the organisation to define the prioritisation.
* At least 3 years’ project management experience using Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
* Experience working with SAP B1 and Salesforce.
* Experience managing a website.
* Experience with the integration between various systems.
* Experience of working on multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to translate organisational requirements to technical documentation and artifacts.
* Ability to wireframe and prototype solutions.
* Strong understanding of SDLC and its phases.
* Ability to interact with users and translate needs maintainable configurations, extensions and customisations.
* Ability to set up source code management/release platform (GitHub)
* Ability to set up automated QC/QA testing.
* Experiencing managing IT teams.
* Experience with Zoho Sprint a plus.
* Working experience in database programming using RDBMS databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, others, etc.
* Exposure to Microsoft IIS.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure is a plus.
* Extraordinary follow\-through, attention to detail and deadlines, and a strong personal sense of accountability.
* The highest standards of ethics, with a demonstrated capacity for discretion and for handling sensitive information with care.
* Meaningful experience working as a part of a team and demonstrated success collaborating with external consultants to move projects forward.
* Quick learner and self\-driven.



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 



* Salary based on experience and education.
* Competitive benefits, including health insurance and generous vacation time.



  





**To Apply** 



* We want to know more than just what you have done. We want to know who you are. What are the passions and talents that draw you to this role?
* Please submit an application, including a thoughtful cover letter and your CV/resume, to:
 
 careers@visionspringfoundation.org
 
 . Please ensure there is a short description of each organisation on your CV/resume. Include your last name and “Senior Lead, Information Technology (IT) and System Support” in the subject line.
* Please note that only candidates to be interviewed will be contacted.
* Evaluation of qualified candidates will include an assessment exercise, which will be followed by a competency\-based interview.
* We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

**Job Summary:**
 The SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager will lead configuration efforts for the global SAP implementation, rollout, migration, and support programs for the EY SAP platform. The role combines SAP delivery leadership, program governance, solution design, data migration, and stakeholder management across geographically distributed teams to deliver controlled releases, reduced delivery risk, and business continuity.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**

**Project \& Program Management**
* Establish program structure, delivery cadence, governance routines, and decision forums for complex global SAP initiatives.
* Manage scope, timelines, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery commitments to support successful outcomes.
* Escalate key risks, resolve delivery blockers, and align decisions across business and technology stakeholders.


**SAP Delivery Leadership**
* Lead functional delivery for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, and RISE transformation initiatives.
* Manage SIT, UAT, regression testing, production cutover, defect management, quality assurance, and release governance.
* Oversee retrofit activities, code synchronization, landscape coordination, and deployment readiness.

* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP solutions aligned with global business templates.
* Drive solution architecture, process harmonization, and business process improvement across Order\-to\-Cash, Billing, Commercial Project Management, and Customer Relationship Management domains.


**Data Migration \& Systems Integration**

* Coordinate data cleansing, validation, transformation, and reconciliation activities.
* Guide integration design across SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, SAP BTP, Clean Core, side\-by\-side extensions, and compliance\-related capabilities.


**Stakeholder \& Team Management**

* Lead geographically distributed teams, facilitate issue resolution and change management, and coordinate delivery across matrixed environments.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

**Supervision Responsibilities:**
 The role will lead geographically distributed delivery teams across countries and time zones, providing clear direction, mentoring consultants, resolving blockers, and building disciplined project teams.
   

  

**Other Requirements:**
**Job Requirements:**
**To qualify, candidates must have:**
* Bachelor's degree in Electronics \& Communication Engineering or a related discipline.

* Ability to influence executive leadership, business stakeholders, global delivery teams, and third\-party providers in a matrixed environment.

description:

 myNachiketa is the world’s only D2C brand with products that bring the knowledge of the Gita \& Vedas to children. We design innovative products in the form of books, games, videos, workshops, learning programs and more.
 




  






 Our products are based on deep scholarship, with a special focus on ease of use and customer delight. We reach families through our books, digital platforms and programs in India and internationally.
 





 Our products have consistently received 4\.6\+ star ratings on Amazon and have featured as Bestsellers. We have reached over 500K families and have a growing community of parents, children and supporters.
 





 myNachiketa is founded by Varun Aggarwal, co\-founder of Aspiring Minds, which had a $100M exit. We work with a small, high\-performance team with the ambition to take Indian philosophical knowledge to children across the world.
 




  






 Website:
 
 www.mynachiketa.com

 We are looking for a
 
**smart, enterprising and execution\-oriented individual**

 This is a broad role, where you will work across
 
**program management, marketing, partnerships, community building and fundraising outreach** 

 , while independently owning key projects from planning to execution.
 





 One day you may be improving the Gita Scholar Program. The next, you could be identifying podcasts for founder outreach, building a donor pipeline, planning a workshop, or working on a campaign to grow participation in our programs.
 





 For the right person, this role can grow significantly in scope and responsibility. Responsibilities include: 
 




  





**Own our Programs** 



* Manage and improve the
 
**Gita Scholar Program, Gita Classes, workshops and other learning initiatives** 

 .
* Coordinate with parents, students, schools and partners to ensure programs run smoothly.
* Think beyond execution: identify ways to
 
**increase participation, engagement and impact** 

 .
* Track key metrics and continuously improve how our programs operate.



  





**Build Partnerships** 



* Identify and reach out to
 
**schools, communities, institutions and organizations** 

 that can help expand myNachiketa’s reach.
* Create structured outreach plans and follow through until closure. Build relationships with potential collaborators and partners.
* Research and build databases of
 
**individual donors, foundations, CSR organizations and other potential supporters** 

 .
* Support fundraising outreach, communication and follow\-ups.
* Work directly with the founder on developing relationships with potential supporters and ecosystem partners.



  





**Marketing \& Outreach** 



* Work on outreach initiatives across
 
**LinkedIn, email, podcasts, events and other channels** 

 .
* Identify relevant podcasts, media opportunities, events and forums for myNachiketa and its founders.
* Help conceptualize campaigns to grow awareness, participation and community engagement.
* Work with content and design teams to take campaigns from idea to execution.



  





**What are we looking for** 




  




* **1\.5\+ years of professional experience OR an MBA equivalent postgraduate management degree. Fresh MBAs may apply.**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational ability and attention to detail.
* High ownership and a bias towards getting things done.
* Ability to independently manage multiple projects and stakeholders.
* Strong research and analytical ability.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets, digital tools and AI.
* Curious and willing to work across functions rather than remain within a narrow job description.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
* Prior experience in startups, education, program management, marketing, partnerships, community building or fundraising is a plus.

**ability, curiosity and ownership matter more** 

 .

 This role is designed for someone who wants
 
**breadth, ownership and rapid learning** 

 early in their career.
 





 You will:

**program management, marketing, partnerships, fundraising and community building** 

 .

title: Design Team Lead
description:
**Company Description** 
 AirBrick is transforming commercial interior design by combining human creativity with advanced artificial intelligence. The company’s multidisciplinary team of interior designers, architects, and AI specialists uses machine learning, data analytics, and computer vision to create functional, aesthetically aligned spaces that enhance productivity, employee satisfaction, and customer experience. AirBrick delivers interactive 3D visualizations, virtual reality walkthroughs, and real\-time design modifications so clients can make confident decisions before implementation. Serving industries such as corporate offices, coworking, hospitality, retail, and healthcare, AirBrick offers scalable, adaptable solutions for projects of varying size and complexity. The organization is focused on creating environments that reflect each client’s brand identity while improving workflow efficiency and space utilization.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Design Team Lead is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Gurugram. This role oversees a multidisciplinary design team, guiding the end\-to\-end design process from initial client briefing and concept development through detailed design, review, and delivery. The Design Team Lead will coordinate closely with clients to understand business objectives, translate requirements into design solutions, and present design proposals using AirBrick’s AI\-enabled tools. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include managing project timelines and resources, aligning design output with brand and functional goals, reviewing and refining team members’ work, and collaborating with AI and product teams to incorporate data\-driven insights into design decisions. The role also involves mentoring team members, implementing best practices, and ensuring consistent quality across all commercial interior design projects.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong Team Leadership and Team Management skills to guide, motivate, and develop a multidisciplinary design team.
* Excellent Communication skills for client interactions, stakeholder alignment, and clear internal collaboration.
* Proven Project Management abilities to oversee timelines, budgets, deliverables, and cross\-functional coordination.
* Hands\-on experience in Product Design or spatial/experience design, ideally within commercial interiors or related domains.
* Background in interior design, architecture, industrial design, or a related field; relevant degree or certification preferred.
* Experience working with design and visualization tools (e.g., CAD, 3D modeling, BIM, VR) and comfort collaborating with technology and AI\-focused teams.
* Ability to work on\-site in Gurugram and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated portfolio showcasing leadership on commercial design projects; familiarity with data\-driven or AI\-assisted design is a plus.

title: Group Manager - Actuarials (Unify, UK Life Insurance)
description:
****Company Description****
 WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI\-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI\-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human\-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.
   

  

****Job Description****
**Purpose**
* Lead delivery of actuarial transformation initiatives leveraging the Unify platform.
* Act as the primary Business \& Functional SME bridging actuarial stakeholders and workflow development teams.
* Drive process automation, workflow standardisation, governance and business adoption across actuarial reporting and modelling processes.
* Define and execute the future\-state operating model for actuarial production and transformation.


****Work Experience****
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Life Insurance actuarial functions.
* Minimum 4\+ years in leadership and stakeholder management roles.
* Significant experience across actuarial reporting, valuation, capital modelling, Prophet production, IFRS17 and/or Solvency II processes.
* Experience leading actuarial transformation and automation initiatives.
* Experience working directly with UK Life Insurance clients and stakeholders.


****People Responsibilities****
* Lead and develop a team of actuarial SMEs, business analysts and transformation specialists.
* Mentor team members on actuarial process design, workflow automation and business analysis techniques.
* Drive capability development in Unify, Python, actuarial production processes and governance frameworks.
* Support workforce planning, recruitment and resource allocation.
* Conduct performance reviews and development discussions.
* Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and automation.


****Process Responsibilities \- Business SME Leadership****
* Provide actuarial production expertise and business domain leadership across Unify initiatives.
* Translate actuarial business requirements into detailed functional specifications for workflow developers.
* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, actuarial teams and development teams.
* Drive solution design decisions ensuring alignment with actuarial processes, controls and governance requirements.
* Provide oversight and challenge throughout the development lifecycle.


****Process Responsibilities \- Unify Transformation \& Workflow Automation****
* Lead design and implementation of Unify workflows supporting actuarial reporting and modelling processes.
* Drive automation of basis production, model execution, result extraction and reporting activities.
* Support migration of legacy Excel/VBA processes into governed Unify and Python\-based solutions.
* Define reusable workflow frameworks, templates and development standards.
* Support multi\-basis, multi\-risk and multi\-scenario actuarial production solutions.
* Identify automation opportunities and deliver measurable efficiency improvements.


****Process Responsibilities \- Requirements \& Solution Design****
* Lead workshops to gather, document and validate business requirements.
* Develop business process maps, functional specifications and user stories.
* Analyse existing actuarial processes to identify inefficiencies, risks and automation opportunities.
* Design scalable and sustainable future\-state solutions.
* Ensure traceability between business requirements and delivered solutions.


****Process Responsibilities \- Testing \& Business Readiness****
* Define and execute SIT, UAT and business readiness strategies.
* Coordinate testing activities across actuarial and development teams.
* Ensure solutions meet business requirements, controls and timetable expectations.
* Manage defect prioritisation and resolution activities.
* Support operational readiness and transition into production.


****Process Responsibilities \- Governance \& Controls****
* Establish and maintain governance frameworks for Unify solutions.
* Ensure appropriate controls covering input validation, access management, auditability, version control and result validation.
* Lead governance forums and Go/No\-Go decision processes.
* Maintain solution documentation, audit trails and operational procedures.
* Support internal audit, regulatory and control reviews.


****Process Responsibilities \- Actuarial Domain Expertise****
* Strong understanding of actuarial production processes including valuation, IFRS17, Solvency II, capital modelling and reporting.
* Experience supporting Prophet model execution and downstream reporting processes.
* Understand data flows, assumptions, basis management and results analysis.
* Provide guidance on actuarial process optimisation and target operating models.
* Support strategic transformation programmes involving actuarial and finance functions.


****Process Responsibilities \- Automation \& Innovation****
* Drive adoption of modern technologies including Python, cloud platforms and workflow automation tools.
* Promote standardisation and reusability across actuarial processes.
* Develop dashboards and operational monitoring solutions.
* Support continuous improvement and process modernization initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and automation capabilities.


**Project Leadership**
* Lead large\-scale actuarial transformation and Unify implementation programmes.
* Manage project plans, milestones, risks and stakeholder communications.
* Coordinate with actuarial, finance, risk, technology and operations teams.
* Support operating model design and roadmap development.
* Drive successful delivery within agreed timelines and quality standards.


****Qualifications****
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering or related quantitative discipline.
* Progressing towards or qualified Fellow of IFoA, SOA, IAI or equivalent actuarial body.
* Fully Qualified Actuary preferred but not mandatory for candidates with strong actuarial transformation experience.


****Technical Skills****
* Strong understanding of Life Insurance actuarial processes and reporting frameworks.
* Experience with Prophet ecosystems and actuarial production environments.
* Strong business analysis and process re\-engineering capability.
* Python, SQL and automation expertise.
* Understanding of cloud\-based data and workflow platforms.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.


****Preferred Systems \& Platforms****
* Unify Platform
* Prophet Professional / Prophet Enterprise
* Python Frameworks
* SQL Databases
* Snowflake
* Azure Platform
* Power BI
* Git / Azure DevOps (desirable)


****Soft Skills****
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong facilitation and requirement\-gathering capability.
* Ability to influence and challenge senior stakeholders constructively.
* Strong project management and planning skills.
* Strategic thinking and transformation mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Ownership and accountability.
* Strong customer focus.
* Attention to detail and governance mindset.
* Collaborative leadership style.
* Continuous improvement orientation.
* Adaptability and resilience.


****Communication Skills****
* Ability to engage effectively with senior actuarial, finance and technology stakeholders.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business language.
* Strong workshop facilitation and business analysis skills.
* Ability to build consensus and drive decisions across multiple teams.


****Qualifications****
* Graduation/ Masters in Actuarial Science
