title: Operational Innovations Senior Analyst
description:
**Locations** 
 : Gurgaon \| London
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 BCG’s internal functions are the foundation of how our firm operates— representing thousands of professionals and hundreds of millions in investment that enable BCG to deliver exceptional client impact at global scale. As the firm continues to grow and technology changes rapidly, our internal operations face an extraordinary opportunity: to continue to evolve to an even more scalable, technology\-enabled, global organization.
   

  

 Our Operational Innovations (OI) team is at the center of this transformation. We are trusted partners to our functions and firm leadership for driving this ambitious change agenda. We enable step\-change improvement in the effectiveness and efficiency of the firm by accelerating high\-priority initiatives sponsored by the Operations Leadership Team and/or our Operating Committee. From technology \& AI deployments to end\-to\-end process redesign, we partner with functional and geographic leaders to re\-architect how the firm operates — faster, smarter, and more connected than ever before.
   

  

 We don’t just manage change — we partner with the business to make it happen. Our team helps shape and accelerate BCG’s most strategic initiatives, providing hands\-on executional leadership and deep expertise in transformation, digital enablement, and change management. We enable functions to scale effectively, improve performance, and unlock new sources of value through data, automation, and forward\-thinking design.
   

  

**Key Activities And Responsibilities Include**
* In partnership with initiative owners and OI Project Managers, provide content support, research, expertise, analyses, or documentation to support project management and accelerate various functional or geographic improvement initiatives. Project emphasis to include operational improvement projects, and often the digital delivery of operational improvements, digital collaboration, and/or digital employee services.
* Support development of deliverables, ensuring highest potential for value delivery. Deliverables could include business improvement plans, process design, effective communication \& engagement plans, implementation plans or supporting analyses for any of these. Expectation that analysts can distil key insights from analyses to presentation formats
* Work with line owners and OI team members to identify potential investments and/or process improvements to accelerate BCG’s digital and operational development. Assist in defining end\-state processes and organizational models, as well as the path to achieve those end states.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads to support on the ground implementation of Change initiatives including enabling impacted users, embedding behavioral change and doing change impact analysis.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads translate project objectives and change needs into concrete employee communications, engagement actions and campaigns using a range of channels and media.
* Track project success and progress, working with project managers to ensure projects remain on course and objectives are realized on\-time and within budget parameters, and that projects deliver against stated objectives and KPIs.
* Support development of senior management reporting and broader communications, as required, in part by providing related analyses and supporting documentation


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* University degree or equivalent – ideally in a business related subject
* Experience working in a multi\-national or large scale environment
* Data Analysis – strong data analysis skills, able to communicate key insights effectively
* Curiosity and focus on continuous development, learning
* Creativity and openness to new approaches, digital tools, Agile methodologies
* Project and Program Management a plus


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 The OI Leadership Team and OI team members, especially project managers and change managers Internal Clients / stakeholders to develop communications to deliver project and stakeholder change objectives External Associates – our network of BCG approved contingent resources, when appropriate.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**You’re Good At**
* Organizing and managing project details with a bias for getting to great output quickly – You are flexible and organized in your work and can be effective across a range of activities and stakeholders
* Working in a complex environment at pace – You are analytical and comfortable managing multiple deliverables with multiple inputs often with high impact, time sensitive requirements
* Data Analysis – Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of information and data to draw out insights and help shape project plans, business cases, etc.
* Stakeholder Engagement – You can hear what someone needs, translate it into your own words, and create it. You are politically and organizationally savvy and can navigate/influence complex matrix organizations
* Structuring and analyzing information. You can take an idea for organizing or analyzing data and turn it into a useful deliverable. Strong attention to detail
* Culture and collaboration – you care deeply about the experience and engagement of your colleagues and believe in the core tenets of BCG’s purpose statements
* Learning and adapting – you are an eager and consistent learner, are naturally curious, open to feedback and interested in continuous improvement


*At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.*
 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Manager – Exports, Imports & Global Commercial Operations
description:
**Manager – Exports, Imports \& Global Commercial Operations** 




 End\-to\-end ownership of the international order\-to\-delivery cycle
 



  





**Company:** 
 APAC Sourcing Solutions Limited \| www.apacss.com
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 



**Experience:** 
 10 – 20 Years
 



**Industry:** 
 Chemicals / Specialty Chemicals / Ingredients / International Trading / Merchant Export / Global Sourcing
 



**Function:** 
 Export \& Import Operations / International Logistics / Supply Chain / Commercial Operations
 



 Employment Type: Full Time
 



  





**About the Company** 




 APAC Sourcing Solutions Limited is engaged in Global Sourcing, Merchant Export, Custom Manufacturing and Product Development — sourcing products from India and other Asian countries for customers across the USA, Canada, Europe and other international markets. Our business spans chemicals, pharmaceuticals, APIs, pharmaceutical intermediates, food and cosmetic ingredients, natural products, polymers, specialty 
 



 chemicals and custom\-manufactured products.
 



 We are looking for an experienced professional to take end\-to\-end ownership of international export execution. This is a high\-responsibility position and is not limited to routine export documentation or logistics coordination.
 



  





**Role Objective** 




 The incumbent will own the complete order\-to\-delivery cycle:
 



***Customer Order → Supplier Confirmation → Production / Material Readiness → Shipment Planning → Freight Negotiation → Container / Isotank Booking → Export Documentation → Customs → Vessel Departure → Shipment Tracking → Customer Communication → Delivery***




 The principal objective is to ensure that APAC consistently delivers the
 **right product, right quantity and right documentation, at the right freight cost, and within the customer’s committed ETA.** 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\. End\-to\-End Export Order Ownership** 




 ● Take ownership of every confirmed international customer order.
 



 ● Establish a detailed execution plan from order confirmation to delivery.
 



 ● Track production, material readiness, shipment booking, documentation, customs, vessel departure and ETA.
 



 ● Maintain a live order and shipment tracker.
 



 ● Identify risks well in advance and initiate corrective action.
 



**2\. Customer ETA Management** 




 ● Work towards 100% adherence to committed customer ETA.
 



 ● Monitor vessel schedules, transit times, supplier readiness and shipment milestones.
 



 ● Identify potential delays before they affect the customer.
 



 ● Develop alternative logistics plans where necessary.
 



 ● Maintain clear visibility of customer\-required ETA versus actual / revised ETA.
 



**3\. Supplier / Manufacturer Coordination** 




*A critical part of the position — the incumbent is expected to actively drive supplier readiness rather than wait for supplier updates.* 




 ● Coordinate continuously with suppliers / manufacturers across India and Asia.
 



 ● Confirm production schedules and firm up material readiness dates; follow up on production progress.
 



 ● Coordinate QC / testing and COA availability; confirm packaging and dispatch readiness.
 



 ● Ensure material is ready sufficiently before vessel cut\-offs; coordinate pickup / loading.
 



 ● Identify and escalate supplier delays at an early stage.
 



 ● Ensure suppliers understand customer delivery commitments.
 



 4\. Freight Negotiation \& Cost Optimisation
 



 ● Obtain competitive ocean freight quotations and benchmark rates across major trade lanes.
 



 ● Negotiate with shipping lines, carriers, NVOCCs and logistics providers.
 



 ● Analyse freight components and surcharges; monitor PSS, GRI and other freight changes.
 



 ● Develop direct relationships with shipping\-line commercial teams.
 



 ● Identify opportunities for cost reduction and minimise unnecessary intermediary costs.
 



 ● Maintain freight\-rate records and benchmarks.
 



**5\. Direct Shipping\-Line Booking** 




 Where commercially feasible, develop APAC’s capability to book containers and isotanks directly with shipping lines / carriers, covering:
 



 Direct carrier relationship development • Vessel schedule identification • Rate negotiation • Space booking • Container / isotank availability • Booking confirmation • Equipment release • SI / VGM cut\-off management • Gate\-in coordination • Vessel rollover management • Carrier escalation
 



*Experience with isotank shipments and DG cargo will be an advantage.* 




**6\. Customer Communication \& Shipment Visibility** 




 Maintain proactive communication with international customers, providing timely updates on:
 



 Supplier / material readiness • QC / COA status • Expected dispatch • Container / isotank booking • Vessel details • ETD • Port status • Transshipment • Shipment movement • ETA • Any changes or delays • Shipping documents.
 



*The fundamental principle is: NO SURPRISES FOR THE CUSTOMER.* 




 If an ETA is at risk, the customer must be informed proactively along with the reason, revised timeline and corrective action.
 



**7\. Export Documentation** 




 Coordinate preparation and verification of:
 



 Commercial Invoice • Packing List • Certificate of Origin • COA • SDS / MSDS • DG Declaration • Shipping Instructions • VGM • Shipping Bill • Bill of Lading • Customer\-specific documentation • Product / regulatory documents as applicable
 



*Ensure documentation is accurate and completed before applicable cut\-offs.* 




**8\. Customs \& ICEGATE – In\-House Capability** 




 A key objective for APAC is to develop stronger in\-house control over export customs processes. The incumbent will manage direct preparation and filing of Shipping Bills through the ICEGATE portal, wherever applicable:
 



 ● Prepare Shipping Bill data; verify HSN / ITC classification and export details.
 



 ● File Shipping Bills through ICEGATE and monitor filing status.
 



 ● Resolve validation errors / queries and coordinate with Customs.
 



 ● Monitor the process through clearance / LEO and relevant post\-export stages; maintain proper records.
 



 ● Ensure timely filing so customs formalities do not affect vessel cut\-offs or customer ETA.
 



*APAC will continue to use CHA / C\&F agents primarily for physical customs, port and related activities requiring their involvement, while building greater in\-house capability for documentation, electronic filing, tracking and export execution.* 




**9\. CHA / C\&F / Port Coordination** 




 ● Coordinate with CHA / C\&F agents for customs and port activities; ensure timely customs clearance.
 



 ● Monitor Shipping Bill status and LEO; coordinate examination / inspection where required.
 



 ● Ensure containers reach port within cut\-off; resolve customs / port\-related issues promptly.
 



 ● Monitor DG\-related requirements where applicable.
 



**10\. Container \& Isotank Planning** 




 ● Plan container and isotank requirements in advance; ensure equipment availability before material readiness.
 



 ● Coordinate loading and dispatch; monitor equipment release and return requirements.
 



 ● Coordinate DG and special\-handling requirements; avoid last\-minute equipment shortages.
 



**11\. Shipment Risk \& Exception Management** 




 Proactively manage supplier / production / quality\-release delays, container and isotank shortages, vessel cancellations and rollovers, port congestion, customs issues, documentation errors, DG acceptance issues, transshipment delays and freight increases.
 



*Expected approach: Identify → Analyse → Act → Communicate → Resolve → Close* 




**12\. Management Reporting** 




 Maintain an updated shipment dashboard covering:
 



 Customer • PO • Product • Quantity • Supplier • Production status • Material readiness • QC / COA • Container / isotank • Booking • Vessel • ETD • Customer ETA • Current ETA • ETA variance • Documentation • Customs • Gate\-in • Risk status • Next action
 



  





**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS** 




 The position will be measured primarily on outcomes:
 



 100% focus on committed customer ETA • Supplier readiness against agreed dates • On\-time shipment execution • Competitive freight rates \& direct carrier bookings • Container / isotank availability • Timely and accurate documentation • Timely ICEGATE Shipping Bill filing • Zero avoidable documentation\-related shipment delays • Proactive customer communication \& early risk identification • Reduction in emergency 
 



 freight and avoidable demurrage / detention • 100% visibility of active shipments
 



  





**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 




 10 – 20 years in export operations / international logistics / supply chain • Chemicals, pharmaceuticals, specialty chemicals or ingredients experience preferred • Strong knowledge of export documentation \& Indian export procedures • Container shipments experience; DG preferred; isotank an advantage • Strong freight negotiation \& direct dealings with shipping lines • Supplier / manufacturer coordination \& 
 



 strong customer communication • ICEGATE / Shipping Bill filing highly desirable; strong Excel / ERP / CRM • Able to manage multiple international shipments simultaneously
 



  





**Personal Attributes** 




 Strong ownership • Commercial orientation • Excellent follow\-through • High sense of urgency • Proactive communication • Strong negotiation skills • Problem\-solving ability • Attention to detail • Works independently • Manages pressure \& multiple priorities
 



  





***The mindset we are looking for: “Once APAC accepts a customer order, I own the execution until the shipment reaches the customer within the committed ETA.”***




 If you want to build and own an international export operation rather than merely process documents, this is an excellent opportunity to make an impact.
 



  





**HOW TO APPLY** 




 Mail your resume to aloksrivastava@apacss.com and odes@apacss.com APAC Sourcing Solutions Limited \| Gurgaon \| www.apacss.com

title: Senior Associate - Consumer & Retail Consulting
description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate \- Consumer \& Retail Consulting** 




  





 Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



 Experience: 4–8 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance and maximize stakeholder value. Founded in 1983, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management and interim leadership services across industries and geographies. Its professionals combine independent thinking, deep expertise and an operator mindset to deliver measurable results for clients. The India Global Capability Center partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, supporting end\-to\-end client delivery, thought leadership, digital enablement and analytics. The Consumer and Retail Group works with companies across consumer products and retail to address disruption, strengthen performance and create growth. A\&M’s culture is guided by integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity, with founding principles centered on leadership, action and results.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Consumer \& Retail Group, you will own medium\-to\-complex workstreams across corporate transformation and performance improvement engagements. You will translate ambiguous client questions and operational data into fact\-based insights, practical recommendations and measurable actions across consumer products and retail. Working in a flat team with Managers, Directors and senior clients, you will lead analyses, manage key stakeholder relationships and help deliver outcomes across market assessment, growth strategy, supply chain, pricing, merchandising, store operations and financial performance. The role combines analytical depth with commercial judgment, clear communication and hands\-on execution. You will also contribute to pitches, thought leadership, capability building and mentoring, while working onsite from Gurgaon and remaining open to business travel and potential future relocation within the India capability center.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own medium\-to\-complex workstreams from problem definition through client\-ready output, using structured analysis to identify performance gaps and convert findings into practical transformation actions.
* Develop Consumer and Retail solutions across consumer products and retail sectors, connecting market, operational and financial metrics to growth strategy, value creation and improved client performance.
* Analyze and benchmark data across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations to surface underperformance and prioritize interventions.
* Lead client and internal stakeholder interactions by clarifying requirements, communicating insights and explaining business impact to senior CRG clients, A\&M leaders and third parties.
* Build accurate models, dashboards and presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Python to support timely decisions and zero\-defect deliverables.
* Manage milestones, dependencies and competing priorities under pressure, while collaborating with team members to deliver agreed outputs and maintain momentum across projects.
* Support A\&M growth through pitch development, marketing, innovative offering development, recruiting, training and mentoring Analysts and Associates.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong Consumer Products and Retail expertise, including sector data and metrics across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or transformation, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver fact\-based recommendations that influence client decisions.
* Advanced Excel modelling and analytical skills, including organizing complex data to draw conclusions, test scenarios and support timely operational and financial decision\-making.
* Strong PowerPoint capability, with a track record of creating clear, persuasive and defect\-free presentations for senior clients, leadership teams and business development discussions.
* Working proficiency in Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and Alteryx or Python for data analysis, with the judgment to select appropriate tools for each problem.
* Excellent written, verbal, research and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate difficult messages with integrity and explain analytical impact to varied stakeholders.
* Practical leadership, prioritization and teamwork skills, including mentoring junior colleagues, motivating teams and delivering high\-quality work in pressured environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience across multiple Consumer Products or Retail subsectors, such as Food and Beverage, Personal Care, Household Goods, Health and Wellness, Electronics, Grocery, Apparel or E\-Commerce.
* Exposure to corporate transformation, performance improvement, operating model change or financial enhancement programs in a consulting or industry setting.
* Interest in developing thought leadership, new offerings and client relationships within a growing global Consumer and Retail practice.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A graduate degree from a strong institution and 4–8 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or a comparable transformation environment.
* A commercially minded Consumer and Retail problem solver who understands how industry metrics connect across growth, operations, customer experience and financial performance.
* An entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach: you are comfortable with ambiguity, require limited direction, challenge the status quo and take ownership through to measurable client outcomes.
* The communication, judgment and integrity to lead workstreams, mentor Analysts and Associates, influence senior stakeholders and deliver messages clearly even when they are difficult to hear.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 You will join a rapidly growing Consumer and Retail team where your work directly shapes high\-impact transformation programs for global clients. The role offers exposure across the full project life cycle, from market analysis and growth strategy through operational improvement and financial performance enhancement. You will work closely with Managers, Directors and senior client stakeholders in a flat structure that rewards ownership, sound judgment and practical execution. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high\-performing professionals early responsibility and the opportunity to influence both client outcomes and the growth of the practice. You will deepen your expertise across consumer products and retail subsectors while contributing to pitches, thought leadership, new offerings and capability building. The India Global Capability Center connects you to colleagues and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, creating a genuinely global platform for learning and impact. Development is supported through mentorship, formal training, performance feedback, on\-the\-job learning and internal mobility. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits accompany a culture that values integrity, inclusion, personal growth and results.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to senior A\&M leaders, global case teams and client stakeholders, with meaningful ownership of workstreams and visible influence on transformation outcomes.
* Structured professional development through mentorship, performance feedback, formal training, on\-the\-job learning and opportunities to build expertise across Consumer and Retail sectors.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, well\-being resources, inclusive diversity initiatives and opportunities to contribute beyond client delivery.

 Founder
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




 As Head of Operations, you will be responsible for the
 **end\-to\-end operational efficiency of the legal services function.** 




 You will ensure:
 



**Right person → Right work → Right process → Right timeline → Right client experience** 




 You will work closely with the Founder, lawyers and cross\-functional teams to create a legal services operation that is
 **scalable, measurable, technology\-enabled and less dependent on individual intervention.** 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\. Run Day\-to\-Day Operations** 



* Own the daily functioning of the legal services operation.
* Ensure all matters/tasks have clear ownership and deadlines.
* Monitor work allocation across the team.
* Ensure priorities are clearly communicated.
* Identify bottlenecks and resolve them proactively.
* Conduct regular operational reviews.
* Ensure the team operates with discipline and accountability.



**2\. Drive Team Efficiency \& Productivity** 



* Monitor individual and team productivity.
* Track workload, capacity and utilisation.
* Identify overloading, under\-utilisation and inefficiencies.
* Establish measurable performance standards.
* Create dashboards and performance reports.
* Work with team leads to improve productivity.
* Ensure team members are accountable for their deliverables.



**3\. Own Timely Delivery** 




 This will be one of your most important responsibilities.
 


* Establish and monitor TATs and SLAs.
* Track every active matter and its status.
* Identify upcoming deadlines and delayed matters.
* Ensure proactive follow\-ups.
* Escalate internally before issues reach the client.
* Analyse reasons for delays and eliminate recurring causes.
* Continuously improve turnaround time.



**Our clients should not have to chase us for work that we have committed to deliver.** 




**4\. Build Processes \& SOPs** 




 You will be expected to
 **build the operating system** 
 , not simply manage an existing one.
 


* Map existing workflows.
* Identify process gaps.
* Design and implement SOPs.
* Create checklists and standard workflows.
* Standardise repetitive activities.
* Define ownership at every stage.
* Build escalation mechanisms.
* Continuously improve processes based on data and feedback.



 You should naturally look at a messy process and think:
 



**“How do we make this simpler, faster and more reliable?”** 




**5\. Manage Client Escalations** 



* Own operational/service\-related client escalations.
* Coordinate with lawyers and internal teams to resolve issues.
* Ensure timely communication with clients.
* Handle difficult conversations professionally.
* Track escalation resolution time.
* Identify root causes of recurring escalations.
* Implement corrective processes to prevent recurrence.



 The objective is not merely to
 **solve the escalation** 
 .
 



 It is to ensure
 **the same escalation doesn't happen again.** 




**6\. People Management** 



* Set clear expectations and responsibilities.
* Monitor team performance.
* Conduct regular reviews.
* Identify performance gaps.
* Drive accountability.
* Improve coordination between team members.
* Support hiring and onboarding where required.
* Build a culture of ownership and execution.



 You should be comfortable managing strong professionals and having difficult performance conversations when necessary.
 



**7\. MIS \& Management Reporting** 




 Own the operations dashboard and provide management with clear visibility on:
 


* Active matters
* Completed matters
* Pending matters
* Ageing
* TAT/SLA performance
* Team productivity
* Capacity/utilisation
* Client escalations
* Rework
* Bottlenecks
* Pending client actions
* Other operational KPIs



 Your reporting should answer:
 



**What is happening? Why is it happening? What needs to be done?** 




 Not simply provide numbers.
 



**8\. Cross\-Functional Coordination** 




 Work closely with:
 


* Legal Team
* Sales
* Customer Success
* Accounts
* Technology/Product
* HR
* Founder/Management



  





**WHAT WE EXPECT YOU TO BUILD** 




 We are looking for someone who can eventually create an operation where:
 


* Every matter has an owner.
* Every task has a deadline.
* Every deadline is tracked.
* Every delay has a reason.
* Every escalation has an owner.
* Every process is documented.
* Every team member knows their KPIs.
* Management has real\-time visibility.
* Technology reduces manual intervention.
* The Founder doesn't need to chase execution.



**The ultimate goal:** 




**Build an operation that runs efficiently without constant Founder intervention.** 




  





**SUCCESS METRICS** 




 Your performance will primarily be measured on:
 



**Delivery** 



* SLA/TAT adherence
* Reduction in delayed matters
* Reduction in ageing matters



**Efficiency** 



* Team productivity
* Lawyer utilisation
* Work allocation efficiency



**Client Experience** 



* Number of escalations
* Escalation resolution TAT
* Repeat complaints



**Process** 



* SOP implementation
* SOP adherence
* Process improvement initiatives



**People** 



* Team accountability
* Performance management
* Employee productivity



**Technology** 



* CRM/platform adoption
* Automation of manual processes
* Data accuracy



**Management** 



* Quality and timeliness of MIS
* Ability to identify and solve operational bottlenecks



  





**WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?** 




 We are looking for an
 **operator** 
 , not necessarily a lawyer.
 



**Preferred backgrounds** 



* MBA
* Company Secretary
* Law
* Business Operations
* Service Delivery
* Professional Services
* Legal Operations
* Startup Operations
* SaaS Operations
* Consulting



**Experience** 




**6–10 years of relevant experience** 
 , preferably with experience managing teams and running a service\-oriented operation.
 



 Experience in
 **legal services, legal\-tech, professional services, SaaS, consulting or other high\-touch businesses** 
 will be an advantage.
 



  





**MUST\-HAVE QUALITIES** 




**Ownership** 




 You don't wait to be told what needs to be done.
 



**Execution** 




 You get things done and follow through.
 



**Process Thinking** 




 You don't repeatedly solve the same problem manually. You build a system.
 



**People Management** 




 You know how to hold people accountable while keeping the team motivated.
 



**Problem Solving** 




 You identify the root cause rather than treating symptoms.
 



**Client Orientation** 




 You understand that delays and communication gaps directly impact customer trust.
 



**Data Orientation** 




 You use numbers to understand and improve operations.
 



**Technology Orientation** 




 You look for ways to use technology to make the operation faster and more scalable.

description:

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.


Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.**Engineering Delivery Manager – Identity Platform (AI\-Driven SDLC)**
======================================================================

**Overview**
------------


We are looking for an **Engineering Delivery Manager** to **lead delivery across multiple squads** building and evolving a **cloud\-native Identity Platform**. You will drive **predictable outcomes**, **high engineering quality**, and adoption of our **AI\-driven SDLC**—improving **speed**, **reliability**, and **compliance** through modern ways of working.


You will lead a delivery organisation of **\~20 engineers**, shaping squads around **product priorities**, coaching **delivery discipline**, and ensuring teams use **AI tooling** (coding, test generation, documentation, triage) to raise **throughput** and **quality**.


Partner with **Product**, **Architecture**, **Security** and **Platform** stakeholders to translate roadmap intent into **executable plans**, manage **dependencies** and **risks**, and deliver **measurable outcomes**.


This is a **hands\-on leadership role** focused on **delivery excellence** and **AI\-enabled transformation**.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Own end\-to\-end delivery** across multiple squads (scope, plan, dependencies, risks, and outcomes).
* **Lead, coach and develop** \~20 engineers; set clear expectations and give timely feedback.
* **Establish delivery discipline**: predictable cadence, transparent reporting, and continuous improvement.
* **Champion an AI\-first engineering culture**; ensure AI tooling is used safely and effectively.
* **Ensure engineering excellence**: quality, security, reliability, and operability by design.

### **AI\-Driven SDLC \& Transformation**

* **Embed our AI\-driven SDLC** (AI\-assisted design, coding, testing, documentation, and release readiness) into day\-to\-day delivery.
* **Drive adoption of AI ways of working** (guardrails, playbooks, and training) in partnership with Enablement/Architecture.
* **Measure impact and improve** (cycle time, defect escape rate, automation coverage, and developer experience) and act on insights.
* **Ensure responsible use of AI** aligned to **security**, **privacy**, and **compliance** expectations.

### **Delivery Execution**

* **Shape and adjust squads** based on roadmap priorities, skills, and capacity.
* **Run planning and execution rituals**; manage dependencies and cross\-team alignment.
* **Remove impediments**, manage delivery risk early, and **drive predictable releases**.
* **Use metrics to improve flow** efficiency, quality, and operational readiness.

### **Stakeholder Partnership**

* **Partner with Product** to clarify scope, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
* **Provide clear delivery commitments**, trade\-offs, and status—**no surprises**.
* **Align with Architecture/Security/Operations** to ensure designs are scalable and compliant.

### **People, Talent \& Operations**

* **Hire and retain diverse talent**; build capability plans with explicit **AI upskilling**.
* **Set performance expectations**, coach growth, and build a feedback culture aligned to **Thales leadership**.
* **Own capacity and execution tracking**; escalate risks with options.
* **Ensure operational excellence** (on\-call readiness, incident learnings, and continuous improvement).

**What You Bring**
------------------

* **7\+ years** in software engineering with **3\+ years** leading delivery and/or people in multi\-team environments.
* **Track record delivering** cloud\-native, distributed and **security\-sensitive** platforms (identity experience a plus).
* **Strong delivery management**: planning, dependency/risk management, release management, and stakeholder communication.
* **Modern SDLC practices** (CI/CD, test automation, observability, DevSecOps).
* **Proven change leadership**: scaling new tools and practices, including **AI\-assisted development**.
* **AI fluency**: hands\-on experience with AI coding/testing/documentation tools and an ability to coach **safe, effective adoption**.

**Success Looks Like**
----------------------

* **Predictable delivery**: roadmaps translated into realistic plans and on\-time releases with transparent trade\-offs.
* **AI\-driven SDLC adopted** across squads with measurable improvements in **cycle time**, **automation coverage**, and **quality**.
* **Strong engineering outcomes**: security and reliability targets met; reduced incident/defect escape rates.

**Reporting Line**
------------------


This role reports to the Engineering Director.

Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

You will be responsible for developing business strategies to manage and navigate risks in a rapidly changing business environment.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will lead teams, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for the execution of project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. You will also address conflicts or issues, engaging in difficult conversations with clients, team members, and other stakeholders, escalating where appropriate.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Developing and implementing risk management strategies to navigate complex regulatory landscapes
* Leading contract negotiation processes to mitigate contractual risks effectively
* Building and maintaining relationships with stakeholders to enhance risk management frameworks
* Utilizing risk management standards to identify and address potential risks impacting organizational objectives
* Guiding teams in strategic planning and execution of risk mitigation initiatives
* Analyzing system components to identify linkages and interactions for improved risk management
* Taking ownership of projects, focusing on planning, budgeting, execution, and completion
* Mentoring team members to deepen their skills and encourage growth beyond comfort zones
* Engaging in difficult conversations with stakeholders to address conflicts and issues
* Upholding professional and technical standards, including adherence to the firm's code of conduct and independence requirements

 What You Must Have
   

  

* Bachelor's degree (Law).

* Demonstrating proficiency in contract negotiation and contractual risk mitigation
* Utilizing risk management frameworks and standards effectively
* Building and maintaining strong relationships with stakeholders
* Developing strategic risk management strategies for complex projects
* Excelling in leadership and mentoring junior team members
* Navigating complex project planning and execution with precision
* Embracing technology and innovation to enhance project delivery
* Experience in generative AI in contracting workflows under a human\-in\-the\-loop governance model.
* Exposure to multi\-tower managed services or outsourcing contracts.

title: Foundry Production Manager
description:
We're starting a new manufacturing plant in Kolkata. Using the lost\-wax/investment casting process, this venture will create multiple B2B and B2C brands, acting as a hub for metal/alloy casting from East India. We have already tested the market by outsourcing to third\-party vendors (Jaipur, Moradabad, Rajkot), even created one of the intended brands with a solid customer base. Now, we're about to in\-house the entire production within greater Kolkata area, from start to finish.
 



  





 For running this plant, we need a professional with several years of foundry experience.
 



  




* Experience with non\-ferrous alloys like Zamak and brass.
* Preferred to have experience with lost\-wax or investment casting process, but similar processes like die\-casting or sand casting can be considered as well.
* Ideally, you should have some idea about the entire production process from molds, wax patterns, and ceramic slurry mixtures to casting and finishing/polishing.
* We're open to having you join us as a partner or on a profit\-sharing basis, instead of a salary.



  





 Further, we'd prefer it if you have one or more of the following qualities:
 



  




* Fixing production issues and finding smart solutions for casting\-related defects
* Contacts/leads of workers and artisans we can approach to work under me
* Supervising a plant during the day and ensuring quality production
* Experience in export\-quality production where items were sold out of India
* Specialization in smaller parts and decorative items
* Technical background to adjust issues with sprues/gates and material composition
* Mechanical background to fix issues with casting\-related machinery
* Good grasp on the post\-production process (finishing, filing, polishing, buffing, etc.)

* Experience with vulnerability management and risk assessment.
* Excellent communication skills for technical and business stakeholders.
* Project management experience with cross\-functional teams.

* Demonstrated ability to work independently and provide guidance to technical colleagues.

title: Pre-Sales & Tender Bidding Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Pre\-Sales \& Tender Bidding Specialist / Manager with strong expertise in government and enterprise tendering, RFP/RFQ responses, proposal management and business development support.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in identifying relevant tender opportunities, understanding client requirements, preparing technical and commercial proposals, coordinating with internal technology and digital marketing teams, and ensuring timely and compliant submission of bids.
   

  

 This role will focus on opportunities across digital marketing, website and software development, IT services, digital transformation and AI\-led solutions.
   

  

 The candidate should be able to independently manage the complete tender lifecycle, from opportunity identification and bid qualification to proposal submission and post\-bid coordination.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 3 \- 6 Years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Kolkata (Onsite)
   

  

**‍Key Responsibilities**
 ‍
   

  

**Tender \& Bid Management**
* Identify and track relevant government, PSU, enterprise and private\-sector tenders, RFPs, RFQs and EOI opportunities.
* Monitor tender portals, procurement platforms and other relevant sources for digital marketing and software project opportunities.
* Review tender documents, eligibility criteria, scope of work, technical specifications, evaluation criteria and submission requirements.
* Conduct bid qualification and feasibility analysis based on project scope, capabilities, eligibility, timelines and commercial viability.
* Prepare tender calendars, bid trackers, submission schedules and compliance checklists.
* Ensure all tender submissions are accurate, complete, compliant and submitted within the defined deadlines.
* Coordinate pre\-bid queries, clarifications, corrigenda, extensions and other tender\-related communications.


 ‍
   

  

**Pre\-Sales \& Proposal Development**
* Understand client requirements and translate them into structured technical and business proposals.
* Prepare RFP/RFQ responses, technical proposals, solution write\-ups, capability documents, company profiles and presentations.
* Develop project understanding, proposed approach, implementation methodology, deliverables, timelines and resource plans.
* Coordinate with Technology, Project Management, Digital Marketing, Creative and other internal teams to gather inputs.
* Support the preparation of Statements of Work (SOW), scope documents, assumptions, exclusions and project plans.
* Ensure proposals clearly communicate Web Spiders' capabilities, relevant experience, value proposition and proposed solution.


 ‍
   

  

**Digital Marketing \& Software Project Expertise**
**Support Proposals And Tenders Related To**
* Digital marketing and performance marketing.
* SEO, SEM, social media marketing and content marketing.
* Website design, development and maintenance.
* Web portals, CMS and e\-commerce solutions.
* Mobile application development.
* Custom software development and enterprise applications.
* AI\-powered solutions, chatbots and conversational AI.
* Cloud, DevOps, application support and digital transformation.
* Creative design, branding and multimedia solutions.
* Work with internal experts to understand technical requirements and prepare relevant, client\-focused proposals.


 ‍
   

  

**Technical \& Commercial Coordination**
* Coordinate with technical leads, project managers, solution architects and business stakeholders for proposal inputs.
* Support effort estimation, resource planning, costing and commercial proposal preparation.
* Work with Finance / Accounts and Business Development teams to finalize pricing and commercial terms.
* Review proposal assumptions, dependencies, payment terms, SLAs and contractual requirements.
* Maintain consistency between technical scope, resource estimates, pricing and delivery commitments.
* Escalate risks, deviations, missing information and commercial concerns before submission.


 ‍
   

  

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Participate in pre\-bid meetings, client discussions, clarification calls and presentations.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion of bid deliverables.
* Support client presentations, solution walkthroughs and tender\-related meetings.
* Maintain professional communication with prospective clients, partners and consortium members where applicable.
* Track bid outcomes, feedback, negotiation status and next steps.


 ‍
   

  

**Proposal Documentation \& Knowledge Management**
* Maintain a centralized repository of proposals, tender documents, case studies, credentials and reusable bid content.
* Develop and maintain proposal templates, capability decks, company profiles and solution libraries.
* Track submitted bids, win/loss outcomes, reasons for rejection and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure all bid documentation follows company standards and approval requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality of client information, pricing, business proposals and internal documents.


 ‍
   

  

**‍Required Skills \& Experience**
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in Pre\-Sales, Tender Management, Bid Management, Proposal Management or IT Business Development.
* Should have experienced with any one of the tender platforms (GeBiz/Tender24x7,Gems, any other Gov portals) for the Digital Marketing \& Software Projects.
* Proven experience in handling government / PSU / enterprise tenders, RFPs, RFQs and EOIs.
* Strong knowledge of the complete tender bidding lifecycle.
* Experience in preparing technical and commercial proposals for software, IT services or digital marketing projects.
* Good understanding of website development, software engineering, digital marketing and digital transformation solutions.
* Strong technical writing, documentation and presentation skills.
* Ability to read and interpret tender documents, eligibility criteria and technical requirements.
* Experience coordinating with technical, project delivery, finance and business development teams.
* Strong attention to detail, deadline management and compliance tracking.
* Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace, Excel / Google Sheets and PowerPoint / Google Slides.


 ‍
   

  

**Interview Process**
* Application review
* 5–10 minute initial screening call with the TA team
* Technical interviews {Domain specific}
* ‍Practical test conducted in the presence of a panel member
* ‍Role match \& offer

title: Principal Project Engineer
description:

Skill and qualification

* Expertise in Design Reviews (Desirable)
* Experience of all aspects of multi\-discipline projects

title: Project Control Specialist II
description:
**About us**Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.


**The Role**

***As a Project Control Specialist II with Worley*** , you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.  

  



* Graduate engineers with 10 to 15 years of experience in Project Control department of a consultancy organization and/or technical services department of a Metal / Mineral / Chemical Processing plant.
* Domain Expert / Specialist in the field of Engineering or in Construction \- handling EPC / LSTK / PMC / EPCM project. Having overall knowledge of interdependencies between project phases.
* Good understanding of Workflow Process, Execution sequences, inter\-relations of Activities, activity durations, WBS. Good understanding of Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS), Cost Codes, Cash Flow is added advantage.
* Hands on experience \& sound knowledge of using Planning/Scheduling Tools like Primavera, MS Project (is MUST), Microsoft Office applications \& Techniques.
* Good understanding of Progress Measurement Norms, progress measurement trend Curves (S\-Curve) \& forecasting by earned value method (EVM), Resource Planning, Productivity.
* Working experience in Mining, Metal and Minerals (is MUST), Oil \& Gas Industry.
* Preferred working knowledge in ECOsys or any other inhouse progress measurement tools.
* Good Communication \& Presentation skills.
* High on initiative \& Drive.
* Analytical skills.
* Team Player.
* Urge to learn.
* Team Management

**About You**

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:


* A degree engineering from a reputed university.
* Total 10 to 15 years of experience in Engineering and Design, preferably with engineering consultants/contractors or from client's side.
* Good Presentation Skills.
* Good spoken and written English language skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills.
* Mention any professional affiliations/certifications.
* Should be open for short travel and deputation to sites/ Overseas Offices where required.
Mention near term mobility readiness.  
* 

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.


And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.


And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Senior Project Control Specialist
description:
**About us**

  

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.


**Purpose** : To lead the Project Controls team and manage all project planning, scheduling and cost management activities to ensure that projects are completed on time, on budget and required project services are delivered to Worley, and its client’s requirements.


**The Role**

***As a Senior Project Control Specialist with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.


* Lead the team, manage employee development and support career progression for the function.
* Ensure the services the team deliver meet project requirements to specified quality, on time and are within budget.
* Drive a culture of accountability within the group and enforce necessary measures when performance is inadequate.
* Drive a culture of ‘doing it right first time’ and delivering high quality deliverables that are part of fit for purpose solutions.
* Drive adoption of GID’s new way of operating.
* Build capability in the function to match capability needs identified by Works Management.
* Support implementation of a high performance delivery and unified GID organisational culture which spans across geographic locations and cultures.
* When necessary, perform project controls services.
* Ensure Continuous Improvement through the implementation of an Annual Improvement Plan and addressing lessons learnt.
* Develop, implement, improve and maintain Worley project controls systems, processes, practices and procedures.
* Review proposals for suitability of project scope, cost and scheduling requirements and coordinates development of all data in support of negotiations in line with Worley guidelines.
* Review Control budgets prepared for the projects and monitor deviation of the project cost with respect to the budgets prepared.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Interface with Project Management and Finance and Governance to prepare monthly internal reports, project control statements and MPRD reports.
* Partner with Workforce Planning to forecast personnel needs for projects.
* Liaise with other departments at meetings relative to project operations, to ensure that information affecting the project plan is continually updated.
* Proactively resolve any discrepancies between Worley and client’s requirements.
* Keep up to date with developments and innovations in the function.
* Demonstrate commitment to Zero Harm through regular actions and courageously speak up if work is being performed unsafely.
* Take accountability for own development and support the learning of others in areas of own experience by providing support to them as they are learning.
* Take initiative to get things done and do things before being asked by others.
* Apply standard procedures and processes to consistently deliver individual and team goals.
* Actively demonstrate WorleyParsons values and beliefs.
* Undertake any other reasonable duties as requested from time to time by the leadership team.

**About You**

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:


* 15\+ years of technical, practical and leadership experience in Project Controls in the same or similar industry, managing and leading large multi\-disciplinary projects and teams including 10\+ years of experience as project controls engineer / project planning engineer in engineering delivery organisation.
* Recognised degree in the relevant area or equivalent qualification/experience.
* Commercial experience, including contracts and procurement.
* Competent in the use of Primavera software package, Microsoft Excel, Access and other project controls specific software like PRA, Fuse etc.
* Able to make difficult decisions and lead others in changing business conditions.
* Can manage and resolve conflict between individuals and/or groups.
* Strong in negotiation of successful outcomes that achieve the required objectives and have the support and acceptance of all parties.

**Generic competencies:**

* Able to influence others, think ‘on your feet’ and have ability to work as part of a high performing team.
* Able to work effectively in small multi\-disciplinary teams, and share and transfer knowledge within teams.
* Able to share information to diverse audiences.
* Can listen and ask questions to ensure understanding.
* Able to use effective cross\-cultural communication skills.
* Able to develop and propose new approaches, methods, or technologies in response to changing business conditions.

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.


And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

**Project Manager \- Strategic Initiatives, Facilities \& Maintenance**
**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
   

  

**Function:** 
 Operations / Engineering Services
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Director Operations
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Ingersoll Rand India Ltd. is seeking an experienced and results\-driven
 **Project Manager \- Strategic Initiatives, Facilities \& Maintenance** 
 to lead strategic infrastructure projects while ensuring reliable operation and maintenance of plant facilities, utilities, and support infrastructure.
   

  

 The role will be responsible for planning, executing, and sustaining facility expansion projects, manufacturing footprint initiatives, utility systems, building infrastructure, and maintenance excellence programs. The incumbent will manage the complete project lifecycle from concept to commissioning while ensuring world\-class facility reliability, safety compliance, and cost\-effective maintenance practices.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess 12\-15 years of experience in industrial manufacturing environments with significant exposure to EPC project execution, facility management, utility systems, asset management, statutory compliance, and maintenance leadership.
   

  

 This role requires a strong leader capable of delivering projects on Quality, Cost, and Delivery (QCD) metrics while maintaining a safe, compliant, and highly reliable manufacturing infrastructure.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent.
* Master's Degree / MBA preferred.
* PMP, Certified Maintenance \& Reliability Professional (CMRP), Lean Six Sigma certification preferred.


**Experience**
* 10\-15 years of experience in:
+ Facility Engineering
+ Plant Engineering
+ Industrial Infrastructure Projects
+ Maintenance Management
+ Utilities Management
+ Capital Projects


**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Projects \& Facility Expansion**
* Lead factory footprint optimization and infrastructure development projects.
* Drive facility expansion, brownfield development, capacity enhancement, and operational improvement projects.
* Manage complete EPC project lifecycle, including:
+ Feasibility studies
+ Concept design
+ Engineering reviews
+ Procurement
+ Construction management
+ Commissioning and handover

* Develop project schedules, budgets, risk mitigation plans, and execution strategies.


**Facilities Management**
**Building Infrastructure**

* Manufacturing facilities
* Warehouses
* Roads and internal infrastructure
* Fire systems
* Security systems


**Utilities Management**
**Ensure Reliable Operation And Optimization Of**
* Electrical distribution systems
* DG sets
* Air compressors
* HVAC systems
* Chillers and cooling systems
* Water supply systems
* STP/ETP facilities
* Fire protection systems
* Industrial gases and utility networks


 Drive energy management initiatives focused on cost reduction and sustainability.
   

  

**Maintenance Excellence**
* Develop and implement world\-class maintenance programs.
* Drive preventive, predictive, and reliability\-centered maintenance strategies.
* Improve asset availability and equipment reliability.
* Establish maintenance KPIs and governance mechanisms.
* Lead maintenance planning and shutdown management activities.
* Drive MTBF and MTTR improvements.
* Optimize maintenance costs while improving operational effectiveness.


**Reliability \& Asset Management**
* Develop long\-term asset management strategies.
* Implement condition\-based monitoring and predictive maintenance tools.
* Utilize digital systems for maintenance planning and asset tracking.
* Drive lifecycle cost optimization of critical assets.
* Lead criticality assessment and reliability improvement projects.


**Safety \& Compliance Leadership**
* Champion a Zero Harm safety culture.
* Ensure compliance with all statutory requirements related to facilities, utilities, and maintenance operations.
* Conduct periodic safety audits and risk assessments.
* Drive contractor safety management programs.


**Regulatory \& Statutory Compliance**

+ Asset reliability

title: Founder's office
description:
**Location:** 

 Ahmedabad (hybrid)
 
**Reports to:** 

 Founders
 
**Type:** 

 Full\-time
 



**About the role** 


 We're looking for someone to sit close to the founders and help make the agency run better. Someone who can look at how we deliver work for clients, spot where time and money leak, and fix it. You'll start on operations and process, move into client\-facing work within 6 months, and be positioned to lead ops for the agency in 2–3 years.
 





 This is a build\-and\-own role. You'll get access to how the business actually runs and be expected to bring structure to it, not just watch.
 



**What you'll actually do** 

**First 6 months \- operations and systems** 



* Map how work currently moves through the agency: brief → proposal → kickoff → delivery → review → renewal. Find where it breaks.
* Build and maintain SOPs for recurring workflows (SEO/AEO retainers, website redesigns, content production, campaign reporting)
* Track project timelines and deliverables across accounts, flag slippage before clients do
* Work with founders on proposal scoping and pricing \- sit in on the conversations, not just format the docs
* Own internal reporting: what's on time, what's at risk, what's profitable
* Sit in on client calls to learn the accounts, the people, and how we sell and service



**6 months onward \- client\-facing** 



* Take direct ownership of select client relationships (starting smaller/lower\-risk accounts, scaling up)
* Run status calls, handle day\-to\-day client communication, manage scope conversations
* Be the point of escalation before it needs to reach a founder



**2–3 years \- ops leadership** 



* Own agency operations end to end: resourcing, delivery quality, tooling, process
* Build and manage a small ops/PM function as the agency scales
* Be a founder\-level thinking partner on how the business is structured and run


**What we need from you** 
* 1–2 years of experience in agency operations, client servicing, or project management \- ideally at a marketing, design, or digital agency
* You understand what "billable," "scope creep," and "retainer" mean in your sleep
* Sharp with tools \- you should already be using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in your daily work, not as a novelty but because it makes you faster. We're an AI\-native shop; if you're not already working this way, this isn't the right fit
* Comfortable being in rooms with founders and clients and holding your own
* A working sense of tech and marketing \- you don't need to write code or run ad campaigns yourself, but you should understand what SEO, performance marketing, brand identity, and website work actually involve, enough to spot bad scoping or a missed handoff
* Sharp with spreadsheets, docs, and basic reporting \- you'll be building the systems, not waiting for someone to hand them to you
* Low ego about the work. Early on this role involves a lot of unglamorous process\-building before it becomes client\-facing


**Nice to have, not required** 
* Prior experience at a boutique or small agency (where you wear multiple hats by necessity)
* Exposure to B2B SaaS or D2C client environments
* Some hands\-on experience with SEO/AEO, content, or performance marketing basics


**Why this role** 


 Most ops or associate roles at agencies keep you in a lane. This one doesn't \- you're in the room for strategy, scoping, and delivery from day one, and the path to owning a P\&L\-relevant function is explicit, not vague. If you want to eventually run something rather than support something, this is built for that.

**Description**
 We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.
   

  

 This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* Hands\-on technical leadership \& design — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* AI\-assisted engineering — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* SE \+ SQE leadership — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* People management \& culture — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.


**Skills, Knowledge And Expertise**
**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don't, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.


**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).

* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.

Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.

description:

The company manages five proprietary exhibition brands held annually or bi\-annually across countries such as Bangladesh, Kenya, Nigeria, Jordan, and Uzbekistan, with a strong focus on the pharmaceutical and chemicals industries. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include managing cross\-functional teams, coordinating with international partners and stakeholders, monitoring budgets and timelines, and optimizing processes for event delivery. The General Manager will report on performance metrics, identify improvement opportunities, and support senior leadership in long\-term strategic planning.

* Strong leadership, team management, and people development skills to guide diverse, cross\-functional teams.

* Financial and analytical skills, including budgeting, forecasting, and performance tracking for complex projects.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Management, Event Management, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience with digital and hybrid event platforms and comfort with using technology tools for planning and coordination.

title: Assistant General Manager, Manufacturing
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
* Technical Leadership \& Process Optimization
* Upstream Strategy: Lead the design, optimization, and troubleshooting of Solid\-Phase Peptide Synthesis (SPPS) protocols, including difficult sequences and modification chemistry.
* Downstream Scaling: Direct the scaling up of Preparative HPLC and RP\-HPLC purification methods from analytical to pilot/production scale.
* Troubleshooting: Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) to resolve complex synthesis failures, poor solubility issues, and challenging impurity profiles.
* Tech Transfer: Oversee the seamless transfer of peptide processes from the R\&D stage to validation and commercial production batches.
* Operations \& Team Management
* Resource Allocation: Manage a team 22 members of engineers/scientists, assigning daily synthesis, purification, and lyophilization tasks.
* Project Timelines: Ensure projects meet strict delivery schedules while optimizing raw material consumption (resins, protected amino acids, solvents).
* Equipment Oversight: Oversee the calibration, maintenance, and qualification of automated synthesizers, Prep\-HPLC systems, and lyophilizers.
* Data Integrity: Review and sign off on chromatograms, analytical data, Master Batch Records (MBRs), and final batch release reports.
* Compliance Lead: Ensure the laboratory strictly adheres to GLP/GMP guidelines, data integrity standards, and safety regulations.
* SOP Authoring: Author, update, and approve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), deviation reports, and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).


**Qualifications**
**Candidate Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Education: B.Tech / M.Tech in Biotechnology or Chemical Engineering OR M.Sc. / Ph.D. in Organic, Analytical, or Biochemistry.
* Experience: 15 to 18\+ years of core industrial experience in peptide chemistry, with at least 2\+ years in a supervisory or team\-leading role.
* Technical Mastery: Deep, provable expertise spanning both upstream chain\-building (cleavage, coupling) and downstream isolation (salt\-exchange, TFF, freeze\-drying).
* Software Literacy: High proficiency in chromatography data software (e.g., Empower, Chromeleon) and data analysis tools.
* Soft Skills: Strong project management, clear cross\-functional communication, and a proven track record of mentoring junior scientists.
