title: Senior Executive, IT User Support
description:
**Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The role is responsible for ensuring effective day\-to\-day technical support to employees across a range of hardware and software systems. The role focuses on independently diagnosing complex user issues, performing advanced troubleshooting and fault rectification, and ensuring timely and high\-quality resolution of user problems, queries, and complaints. The role manages end\-to\-end incident resolution, supports root cause identification, and ensures proper escalation and coordination with internal or external support teams when required. The role emphasizes service reliability, adherence to SLAs, user satisfaction, and compliance with IT policies and information security standards.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Provide advanced user support for hardware and software issues
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical problems independently
* Perform detailed troubleshooting and fault rectification
* Coordinate and manage escalations with internal/external teams
* Ensure timely closure of incidents as per SLAs
* Document issues, resolutions, and root causes
* Support system access, configurations, and device setups
* Ensure compliance with IT policies and security standards
* Guide junior support staff when required


**Job Responsibilities –**
* Plant IT Leadership \& Service Delivery: Lead end\-to\-end IT operations and service delivery for the plant, covering Quality Informatics, Manufacturing Informatics, IT Infrastructure, End User Computing, and Information Security.
* Quality \& Manufacturing Informatics: Provide techno\-functional leadership and support for QC laboratory and manufacturing computerized systems, including LIMS, Empower, and equipment control systems, ensuring availability, compliance, qualification, and effective lifecycle management.
* Plant IT Infrastructure: Own and manage plant\-level LAN/WAN, servers, network, firewalls, Wi\-Fi, internet connectivity, server rooms, storage, backup, and end\-user computing infrastructure to ensure reliable and uninterrupted business operations.
* Information Security: Ensure implementation and monitoring of endpoint security, OS\-level access controls, logical access, patch management, vulnerability remediation, local firewall controls, and other applicable information security requirements.
* Regulatory Compliance \& Audits: Act as the Plant IT SPOC for regulatory and customer audits and ensure compliance with GxP, SOX, Data Privacy, ISMS, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
* IT Governance \& SOP Management: Establish, implement, and maintain Plant IT SOPs, procedures, standards, controls, and governance frameworks in coordination with Quality and relevant business functions.
* IT Projects \& Digitization: Lead plant\-level IT projects, infrastructure upgrades, digital transformation, automation, productivity improvement, cost optimization, and technology initiatives in alignment with business requirements.
* Vendor \& Partner Management: Manage IT vendors and service partners, including performance monitoring, SLA/OLA compliance, escalation management, technical evaluation, and contract/service governance.
* Business Continuity \& Disaster Recovery: Ensure effective implementation, monitoring, and periodic testing of backup, high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions for critical plant IT systems.
* Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop the Plant IT team, allocate resources effectively, drive accountability, and ensure timely resolution of IT incidents, service requests, and business requirements.
* Stakeholder Management: Work closely with Plant Leadership, Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, EHS, HR, Finance, Corporate IT, Cybersecurity, and other functions to understand requirements and deliver effective IT solutions.
* IT Service Performance: Monitor Plant IT performance through SLA/OLA, incident management, problem management, service availability, MTTR, and user satisfaction, ensuring continuous improvement of IT services.
* Technology \& Infrastructure Planning: Work closely with the Head – IT Infrastructure \& Information Security on IT strategy, capacity planning, technology roadmap, budgeting, CAPEX/OPEX planning, and infrastructure standardization across the plant.
* CSV / Computerized System Compliance: Provide support for computerized system validation lifecycle activities, including assessment, qualification, change management, periodic review, and retirement of GxP\-relevant computerized systems.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, standardization, cost optimization, and technology modernization to improve plant productivity, quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.

title: Construction project coordinator
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

uniqside is an architectural, interior and construction company based in Kochi. We deliver residential and commercial fit\-out and civil projects end to end \- design, estimation, procurement and execution.

We are looking for a Project Manager who can own a project from handover of drawings to final client sign\-off. You will be the single point of accountability for programme, cost, quality and site discipline across two or more live projects at a time. This is a hands\-on site role, not a desk role.

We are not fixed on a number of years. Show us the projects you have delivered and we will judge on that.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Planning and programme

\- Prepare and maintain project schedules in MS Project or Primavera; set milestones, track the critical path and issue look\-ahead plans

\- Run weekly site review meetings and circulate daily and weekly progress reports (DPR/WPR)

\- Flag slippage early with a recovery plan, not after the deadline has passed

Cost, BOQ and billing

\- Review and validate BOQs, quantity take\-offs and rate analyses before work is released

\- Control project cost against the approved budget; track variations and get them approved in writing

\- Certify contractor and vendor bills, check measurements at site, and coordinate client billing

Procurement and vendors

\- Plan material requirements against the programme so nothing stops site

\- Float enquiries, compare quotations, negotiate and place orders with vendors and subcontractors

\- Manage subcontractor scope, deployment and performance \- carpentry, joinery, modular, painting, flooring, MEP

Site execution and quality

\- Read and interpret working drawings, GFC drawings and shop drawings; resolve drawing queries with the design team

\- Supervise execution to drawing, specification and finish standard; carry out snagging and de\-snagging

\- Enforce housekeeping and site safety; maintain measurement books, registers and photo records

Client and stakeholder management

\- Be the client's main contact through execution \- updates, approvals, material and finish selections

\- Coordinate with architects, consultants, structural and MEP teams

\- Manage handover: as\-built documentation, warranties, completion certificate and closing the final account

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Essential qualification

\- M.Tech / M.E. in Civil Engineering \- Structural Engineering, Construction Engineering and Management, or a related civil specialisation

\- B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering at undergraduate level

Applications without an M.Tech in a civil discipline will not be considered for this role.

Also essential

\- Experience managing construction or interior fit\-out projects, with a period of independent site responsibility

\- A record of delivering projects to programme and budget \- be ready to talk us through two of yours

\- Working knowledge of AutoCAD, MS Project or Primavera, and MS Excel

\- Confident reading working and shop drawings and taking site measurements

\- Fluent Malayalam and English

\- Two\-wheeler or car with a valid licence, for site visits

Preferred

\- Turnkey interior fit\-out, modular furniture or joinery\-heavy projects

\- Exposure to MEP coordination

\- Experience handling client billing and final accounts

\- Published research or a dissertation in construction management, structures or project delivery

Who fits here

Someone who chases a delay the same day they see it, who is comfortable telling a client an uncomfortable truth early, and who keeps paperwork clean without being asked. We are a growing company \- you will have real ownership and the freedom to fix a process that is not working.

WHAT WE OFFER

\- Salary negotiable, based on experience and the projects you have delivered

\- Direct exposure to the leadership team and a real say in how projects are run

\- Growing project pipeline across residential and commercial interiors

TO APPLY

Apply through Indeed with your CV. Please state your M.Tech specialisation and institution, and include the project value, duration and your specific role for two projects you have delivered.

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager

About the Role

Elkanio is looking for an experienced **Project Manager** to take ownership of planning, coordinating, and delivering technology projects from initiation through successful completion.

You will work closely with **clients, product teams, developers, QA, UI/UX, DevOps, and leadership** to ensure projects are delivered within agreed scope, timelines, quality expectations, and business objectives.

The ideal candidate has **3–5 years of experience in software project management or delivery management**, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to understand technical discussions and translate business requirements into actionable delivery plans.

This is a hands\-on role requiring strong ownership, proactive communication, structured planning, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced technology environment.

What You'll DoProject Ownership \& Planning

* Own assigned projects and initiatives from **requirement gathering through delivery and production rollout**.
* Understand project objectives, scope, requirements, timelines, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
* Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, schedules, and delivery trackers.
* Break down requirements into actionable workstreams and coordinate execution across teams.
* Track progress against milestones and proactively address deviations.
* Coordinate releases, UAT, deployments, and post\-release activities.
* Ensure deliverables are completed within agreed scope, timelines, and quality expectations.

Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Act as a key point of contact for assigned clients and projects.
* Establish regular communication and reporting cadence with stakeholders.
* Lead client meetings, requirement discussions, sprint reviews, demos, and status calls.
* Clearly communicate project progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and upcoming milestones.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and proactively communicate changes or potential delays.
* Ensure client decisions and requirements are clearly understood and communicated internally.
* Build strong working relationships with technical and business stakeholders.

Requirement \& Scope Management

* Work with clients and product stakeholders to understand and clarify business requirements.
* Coordinate with technical teams to translate requirements into actionable development tasks.
* Support backlog prioritization and release planning.
* Identify dependencies and gaps in requirements before development begins.
* Manage changes to scope and communicate their impact on timelines, resources, and delivery.
* Maintain clear visibility of agreed scope and approved changes.
* Work with Product Owners and technical teams to ensure requirements are ready for development.

Team \& Delivery Management

* Coordinate development, QA, UI/UX, DevOps, product, and other teams involved in delivery.
* Ensure teams have the required information and dependencies to execute their work.
* Track resource availability and highlight capacity or allocation constraints.
* Identify blockers and drive them toward resolution.
* Coordinate cross\-team dependencies and ensure timely handoffs.
* Support teams in maintaining focus on sprint and release objectives.
* Escalate critical issues appropriately when leadership intervention is required.

Risk, Issue \& Dependency Management

* Proactively identify and maintain visibility of **project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies**.
* Define mitigation actions with relevant stakeholders.
* Track issues through to closure and ensure clear ownership.
* Identify potential schedule, resource, technical, or scope risks early.
* Escalate critical risks and delivery concerns in a timely manner.
* Facilitate root\-cause discussions for significant or recurring delivery issues.
* Maintain appropriate risk and issue registers.

Agile \& Delivery Practices

* Work effectively with teams following **Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives where required.
* Track sprint commitments, velocity, blockers, and delivery outcomes.
* Work with Product Owners and engineering teams to maintain a prioritized backlog.
* Coordinate release planning and track release readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve team processes, delivery predictability, and collaboration.

Reporting \& Governance

* Prepare regular **project status reports and management updates**.
* Provide visibility into project health, milestones, progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and resource requirements.
* Track planned versus actual delivery timelines.
* Maintain project dashboards, trackers, action logs, and decision records.
* Provide concise and accurate updates to leadership and clients.
* Establish and maintain appropriate project governance and reporting practices.

What We're Looking For

* **3–5 years of experience** in software project management, delivery management, or a similar technology role.
* Proven experience managing software projects through the **SDLC**, from requirements through production.
* Strong understanding of **Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Strong stakeholder and client management skills.
* Experience managing cross\-functional technology teams.
* Strong planning, organization, prioritization, and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, workstreams, and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong risk, issue, dependency, and scope management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both **technical and non\-technical stakeholders**.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency with **Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Teams, Slack, or similar project management and collaboration tools**.
* Good understanding of software development concepts, APIs, databases, testing, deployments, integrations, and production support.
* Ability to understand technical discussions and coordinate effectively with engineering teams.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.

Technical Understanding

You don't need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable understanding and discussing:

* Frontend and backend development
* REST APIs and third\-party integrations
* Database concepts and data flows
* QA, testing, UAT, and defect management
* Cloud environments and deployment processes
* Git and software development workflows
* Production releases and incident management
* Basic system architecture and technical dependencies
* Performance, scalability, and integration considerations

Bonus Points

* Experience working on **B2B or B2C technology products**.
* Experience in **travel, hospitality, e\-commerce, fintech, or other transaction\-based domains**.
* Experience managing projects involving third\-party APIs and external integrations.
* Experience with payment gateways or booking platforms.
* Experience working with international clients or distributed teams.
* Technical background in software development, QA, business analysis, or engineering.
* Scrum Master, PMP, PRINCE2, or other relevant certification.
* Experience with delivery metrics, dashboards, and project reporting.
* Experience coordinating projects involving multiple teams, vendors, or external technology partners.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on **real\-world technology products with real users and business impact**.
* Exposure to challenging projects involving **travel technology, APIs, integrations, payments, and digital platforms**.
* Direct interaction with clients, product teams, engineering teams, and leadership.
* A collaborative environment with opportunities to work across technology and business domains.
* Opportunity to develop strong expertise across **project management, Agile delivery, stakeholder management, and technology delivery**.
* Increasing ownership and career growth based on performance and capability.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
Location: Bangalore, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

 DIGIS Tribes develop and maintain applications for Business Lines Avionics Global Services AGS, inside Thales GBU AVS.
   

  

 AVS business lines provides, all around the world, customer support and maintenance of avionics Thales equipment.
   

  

 The applications are built on top and outside SAP ERP. Their main business goals are to facilitate users’ day\-to\-day works (logisticians, repair technicians, marketing, sales, …) and improve overall industrial performance.
   

  

 Such applications need to be connected in real time to SAP ERP, through OData web services, to read, update or delete data (SAP objects). We also have multiple reports and dashboards executed from SAP as wel.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to join our agile delivery team. The Scrum Master will be responsible for facilitating scrum ceremonies, coaching teams on agile best practices, removing impediments, and driving continuous improvement to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality products.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

title: Program Management Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Change the world. Love your job.**
 Texas Instruments (TI) is looking for an energetic, service minded leader, who enjoys helping others to succeed by providing team members and clients with motivation and support in a positive and professional work environment as a Software Program Management Engineer. We are seeking a highly motivated individual who will challenge teammates to achieve flawless execution goals, while maintaining strong working relationships. Success in this role is measured by the ability to deliver SW products to set scope, ontime and with quality and driving the SW teams to meet and exceed the business needs.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Own end\-to\-end SW program delivery – from scoping and planning through integration, verification, and customer ramp.
* Work across Design, Marketing, Systems \& Applications to align the SW scope and schedule needs as well as the priorities driving the tradeoff choices within the development cycle as the need arises
* Build and maintain program schedules; track milestones, monitor and manage external dependencies(including other functions and third parties), surface risks early, and drive resolution of blocking issues across teams.
* Coordinate development dependencies between various SW teams \- middleware, tools, verification, and application engineering teams.
* Serve as the primary interface to customers for SW release plans, delivery commitments, and issue escalations.
* Drive ASPICE compliance across SW projects; prepare teams for internal and third\-party audits, enable any necessary certifications.
* Lead program reviews and status reporting to senior leadership; translate engineering progress into clear, decision\-ready summaries.
* Partner with technical leads to scope new feature requests, estimate effort, and align resource capacity with roadmap commitments.
* Identify process inefficiencies in the SW delivery flow and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Mentor project leads and engineers on program management practices, customer\-facing communication as well as any other project specific planning and procurement needs


**Qualifications**
**Minimum requirements:**
* Bachelors in Electronics, Electrical or Computer Engineering or related engineering degree
* 5\-12 years of experience with project engineering/management experience on complex SW products/projects (Baremetal and LLOS)
* Proven leadership capabilities in working across multifaceted global organizations
* Successful proven track record in indirect management and influence
* Strong combination of technical, communication, execution and leadership capabilities


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong understanding of embedded SW development – C programming, RTOS concepts, MCU architecture (ARM Cortex\-M/R), and SW build/integration flows.
* Familiarity with AUTOSAR architecture (MCAL, BSW, RTE, application layers) and automotive SW development lifecycle.
* Experience with functional safety standards and process frameworks: ISO 26262, ASPICE (CL2 or higher).
* Proficiency with program tracking tools: Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent.
* Experience with defect triage processes, release management, and customer delivery workflows.Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, and set realistic plans based on required tasks with available resources
* Ability to effectively coordinate and lead global development teams on projects that include both New SW products, post production maintenance SW
* Ability to provide clear direction to both internal teams and external support organizations on project priorities in alignment with the business needs
* Proven program management skills – schedule management, risk identification, dependency tracking, and milestone ownership across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Demonstrated strong analytical and problem solving skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams including hardware, verification, tools, and customer applications.
* Strong time management skills that enable on\-time project delivery
* Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced and rapidly changing environment
* Ability to take the initiative and drive for results


**About Us**
**Why TI?**

* We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. Meet the people of TI
* Benefits that benefit you. We offer competitive pay and benefits designed to help you and your family live your best life. Your well\-being is important to us. Please find our country\-specific benefits here


**About Texas Instruments**
 Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. Learn more at TI.com .

description:

You will test across all of it.
   

 Our engineers and SDETs are empowered to own quality decisions, not just execute test cases. You will be expected to identify gaps, propose solutions, and present your work in team and org\-level forums.

* Apply GitHub best practices and work within CI/CD processes
* Work with the organisational QA team to build product knowledge, resolve challenges, and share results

**About You** 



* 3\+ years experience with object\-oriented programming languages and techniques: Golang, Node, TypeScript, JS, Java, RDBMS, Rest APIs

description:

 Come make an impact every day at Zebra.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 The Software Design Assurance Team is responsible for ensuring our software products meet quality, reliability, and release\-readiness standards throughout the development lifecycle. The design assurance team supports Zebra’s promise of quality to our customers and is responsible for participating in design reviews, sprint refinement, build/release operations, and post\-mortems, and process gap analysis to conduct release readiness assessment. This position works with a minimum level of supervision.
   

  

 This position is hybrid based in Bengaluru, India.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
 Perform an analysis of SW Design Assurance for cloud\-native SaaS Technology products and provide feedback for all the key Quality Metrics and deliverables executed by the functional teams, including:
   

  

* Responsible for SW Quality assessment of SWS \& cloud solutions. Identify deviations from stated product goals, standards, and processes.
* Perform Software Quality Reviews, measure and monitor progress of programs under development.
* Lead and conduct Product Release readiness reviews ensuring release criteria for software \& device solutions are met and communicate all quality issues, risks, requirements gap prior to product approval.
* Recommend latest technologies and new approaches to design and implementation of new technology
* Should have strong knowledge of cause\-and\-effect relation between SW defects and potential customer impact use cases.
* Instrument the product CI/CD pipeline and surface build\-stage quality signal — code coverage trends, flaky\-test detection, build stability, deployment frequency, and rollback rate — as a living engineering dashboard rather than a downstream report.
* Experience with Software\-as\-a\-Service development processes, release automation, observability tooling, and quality metrics for distributed cloud systems.
* Knowledge of the SDLC, testing concepts, methodologies, metrics, automated SW testing frameworks

* Guidance of the process, test methodologies, test strategy used in production of Zebra's NSI SW products and solutions including Software Stability, Stress, and performance strategies
* Experience communicating cross\-functionally and across management levels in formal and informal settings

* Demonstrated experience with modern test architecture across unit, integration, contract, and end\-to\-end layers; flaky\-test triage; regression\-suite design; and test\-pyramid discipline applied to refactor\-heavy codebases.
* Software QA automation experience with technologies such as Java, Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, or comparable.

* Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to deliver an independent quality recommendation to an engineering team in which the engineer is embedded — without compromising the working relationship.

* Production\-incident and release\-health fluency — comfortable leading post\-mortems, building escape\-defect feedback loops, and translating field signal into engineering priorities; credibility built from on\-call experience.
* Experience with multi\-tenant enterprise SaaS domains and complex customer\-facing platforms.

* Ability to deal with ambiguity effectively and exercise sound judgment when evidence is incomplete.

* Demonstrated ability to deliver high\-quality work on tight schedules.
* Strong analytical skills and a methodical, objective approach to problem\-solving.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**About Runable:** 




  





 Runable builds software that helps small and medium businesses grow — the tooling, automation, and workflows that let a lean team operate like a much larger one. Our users are business owners and operators, not power users of software, so how clear the product feels decides whether it gets adopted at all.
 



  





**The Role:** 




  





 We are hiring a UI/UX Designer to own the experience of what we ship — from the messy problem to the pixels engineers build against. You will do both halves of the job: the thinking that decides what a screen should do, and the craft that makes it look like it was designed on purpose.
 



 This is a small team, so you will own product areas outright rather than decorating someone else's flows. Expect to sit with real customer problems, work directly with engineers, and see your designs live within weeks. Our users are non\-technical and time\-poor — every unnecessary step you remove is the actual output of this role.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 




  




* Own end\-to\-end design for product areas: problem framing, user flows, wireframes, high\-fidelity UI, and prototypes.
* Turn vague requests and customer pain into clear, shippable design solutions with a defensible rationale.
* Design for clarity over cleverness — our users are SMB operators who need to get one thing done fast.
* Build and extend our design system: components, patterns, tokens, and documentation that keep the product coherent.
* Work directly with engineers through implementation, reviewing builds and fixing the gap between design and shipped UI.
* Prototype interactions and motion where static screens cannot answer the question.
* Run lightweight research and usability testing — talk to users, watch them struggle, change the design.
* Use analytics and session data to find where people drop off, then design and measure the fix.
* Design responsive interfaces that hold up across desktop and mobile, with accessibility treated as a default.
* Contribute to marketing and brand surfaces when needed — landing pages, in\-product education, and launch assets.



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* 4–8 years designing digital products, with a portfolio of shipped work — not concept pieces.
* Currently managing a design team of at least 2–4 people, with direct responsibility for their work and growth.
* Strong UI craft: layout, typography, hierarchy, colour, and spacing discipline you can explain rather than eyeball.
* Genuine UX ability: you can map a flow, simplify a process, and justify structure with user reasoning.
* Expert in Figma — components, auto\-layout, variants, and prototypes that engineers can actually work from.
* Experience designing SaaS, dashboards, or complex workflow tools where information density is a real problem.
* Working understanding of front\-end constraints and comfortable collaborating closely with engineers.
* Experience building or contributing to a design system.
* Comfortable using AI tools to move faster — exploring directions, generating assets, and cutting production time.
* Able to present and defend design decisions to founders and engineers, and to change your mind when the argument is better.
* Self\-driven in a low\-process environment: you find the problems worth designing for instead of waiting for tickets.



  





**Nice to Have:** 




  




* Startup experience where you were the only or first designer.
* Experience designing for non\-technical or SMB audiences.
* Interaction and motion design skill (Rive, Lottie, After Effects, or Figma's motion tooling).
* Ability to build with front\-end code or AI app builders to ship simple things yourself.
* Illustration, iconography, or brand design range.
* Exposure to AI\-native product patterns — chat, agents, generative interfaces.



  





**Why Runable:** 




  




* Real ownership: your design decisions ship, and you see how SMB customers respond within weeks.
* Small team, high leverage — design quality is a company\-level differentiator here, not a finishing step.
* Direct access to founders and customers; short feedback loops, minimal process.
* Room to shape the design system and the product's visual direction as we scale.
* Compensation is benchmarked to experience and impact, and discussed openly in the first conversation.

title: Global Product Cyber Security Expert – R&D Digital Portfolio EM&AO
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


Digital Solution Engineering Manager **Your role and responsibilities**

Working as a Global Digital Portfolio Cyber Security Expert, you will play a critical role in safeguarding our organization's digital assets for products of the global AUEN Digital Energy Management / Autonomous Operations products.


You will be responsible for **defining, governing and assuring cybersecurity\-by\-design across global R\&D product development**, ensuring compliance with ABB Product Security requirements, international standards (e.g. IEC 62443\), and applicable regulations.


The role acts as **global cybersecurity reference for the Digital Energy Management and Autonomous Operations product portfolio**, working with R\&D teams to embed security requirements into architectures, software, and lifecycle processes (SPDLC), while **challenging designs and approving security readiness**.


In this role, you will be part of a global team of product owners, software developers, architects, and testers to apply principles of software engineering, contribute to development as part of different state\-of\-the\-art cloud and edge software systems and architectures of the product portfolio.


You will be hosted in one of the team locations: Mannheim (DE), Genoa (IT), Bangalore (IN) in a hybrid mode (\#LI\-Hybrid)


Relocation of the candidate is not required.**\***


Your work will have a profound impact on the global cloud, cloud\-native and edge platform landscape.  

  

You will be mainly accountable for:

**Cyber Security Management:**


Develop and implement comprehensive cyber security strategies, policies, and procedures to protect digital on\-prem/edge/cloud products against cyber threats, including malware, phishing, data breaches, and insider threats following the minimum cyber\-security requirements from ABB in full compliance, and responsibility, with PSA (Product Security Assessment) internal process.


Conduct regular security assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities, risks and take proactive measures to address them.


Respond promptly to security incidents.


Implement access controls, encryption, and other security measures to safeguard sensitive data in line with Global Digital Team direction.

**Compliance and Risk Management:**


Stay up to date with industry Standards \& Compliance, regulations, and best practices related to cyber security and cloud computing, such as GDPR, NIS2, ISO/IEC 27001 and IEC 62443 SL3\.


Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.


Collaborate with internal teams and external auditors to ensure adherence to compliance requirements and address any findings, incidents or recommendations by executing and coordinating: investigation, schedule, corrective actions and disaster recovery plan to ensure business continuity.

**Other responsibilities/skills:**

* Collaborate with all organization members to contribute to the overall software development lifecycle in assigned areas and reach targets, share knowledge and contribute to a positive work atmosphere
* Follow agile software development practices to build and deliver software in an iterative and incremental manner as part of a global team’s scrum\-based development process
* Continue your personal learning journey by staying abreast of new and evolving software engineering technologies and sharing knowledge with team members
* A high level of self\-motivation, curiosity, as well as a strong desire and ability to learn and adapt to new technologies, tools, and programming languages
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and debug software issues
* Project management capabilities
* Scrum and Agile methodologies knowledge
* Ensure that CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices incorporate cybersecurity controls and security testing requirements.
**Qualifications for the role**

* Master's degree in computer science with a focus on IT security. A PhD with cyber security focus is considered a plus.


Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP) preferred.


10 years of proven experience in product or system cybersecurity for industrial or critical systems.


5 years in cloud computing, with a strong understanding of security principles, technologies, and best practices.


Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including proficiency in cloud services and management tools. Familiarity with Azure DevOps for CI/CD pipelines.


Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Podman for container orchestration and management.


Proficiency in OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and identity management solutions such as Keycloak.


Experience with Helm charts for managing Kubernetes applications and deployments.


Strong understanding of the design and architecture of microservices, including principles such as loose coupling, bounded contexts, and domain\-driven design.


Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and work cross\-functionally with internal teams geographically distributed.


Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks in a fast\-paced environment, while also collaborating effectively as part of a global team.


Effective verbal and written communication skills in English, eventually German if location is Germany. Willing to travel, time to time, for office/site visit.
* *This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.*

*The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.*

  

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.


Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Product Management(Accounting Services), Vice President
description:
**Job Description**

**What are we looking for?**

State Street Alpha Service product team is seeking a visionary Vice President to lead product innovation and lifecycle management for Alpha Services, driving transformative solutions in account onboarding and integration. This qualified individual will develop and deliver products, business solutions, and strategies aligned with our Alpha Account onboarding and data integration with downstream consumers. This leader will focus on driving front, middle, and back\-office service innovations that support and streamline end\-to\-end integration, servicing, and interoperability for our Alpha clients.


**Why is this job important to us?** 

State Street Alpha brings together data and capabilities across the investment lifecycle to help our clients make better decisions, grow at scale, and deliver returns for their clients. We partner with clients to optimize their operations, data, and technology footprint by leveraging the Alpha Platform and outsourced Alpha Services. The successful candidate must be skilled in analyzing our complex business service flows across front, middle, and back office operating models for our Alpha Clients, with a focus on post\-trade execution lifecycle products and services. They will also be driving the strategic solution design, business architecture, and business solutions/services while driving program/project execution and reporting. This role is pivotal in shaping Alpha’s next\-generation onboarding and lifecycle solutions, enabling clients to scale faster and operate smarter


**What will you be responsible for?**

**Product Development:**

* Oversee the end\-of\-the\-end product lifecycle for portfolio onboarding data and workflow solutions, from ideation and business case development to design, implementation, and delivery, ensuring seamless new account setup and lifecycle maintenance.
* Leverage data analysis techniques to inform solution design and identify potential risks and challenges.
* Embed Agile Practices into product development cycles:


	+ Lead and participate in daily standups, retrospectives, and sprint planning sessions to ensure clear progress and timely issue resolution.
	+ Collaborate with Agile Scrum Masters and IT teams to bridge communication between business and technology stakeholders.
	+ Incorporate client feedback iteratively by involving clients in regular demo sessions and milestone reviews, ensuring products meet user expectations.
* Drive initiatives to improve system redundancies and operational efficiencies within Account services workflow, UI, ODS and downstream consuming systems.

**Product Solution and Strategy:**

* Develop and execute a product strategy for portfolio and account reference data solutions, ensuring alignment with industry trends, technology advancements, and client needs.
* Conduct market research and competitive analysis to understand the technology landscape and adopt a future\-proof product strategy.
* Create and manage a product roadmap, outlining feature development, enhancements, and implementation timelines to drive continuous product evolution.
* Gather and analyze customer feedback, translating insights into actionable product improvements that enhance user experience and satisfaction.
* Build strong business cases with quantifiable outcomes, ensuring a clear return on investment (ROI) and strategic alignment with broader business objectives.

**Stakeholders Management:**

* Establish strong cross\-functional partnerships with Operations, Technology, and Product teams to drive integrated business solutions that support client and strategic business goals.
* Gather and document detailed business and functional requirements, ensuring seamless collaboration between product, operations, and technology teams.
* Work closely with product implementation teams to ensure a smooth transition from development to deployment, driving successful product delivery and client adoption.

**What we value?** 

These skills will help you succeed in this role:


* Deep expertise in portfolio and account reference data across front, middle, and back\-office functions within asset management, wealth management, and alternative investments
* Strong analytical and interpersonal skills to effectively communicate with diverse stakeholders, including senior executives.
* Proven ability to manage multiple competing priorities, demonstrating excellent time management and organizational skills.
* Experience as a Product Owner working with Agile methodologies, driving product development from ideation to execution.
* Expertise in designing new solutions by analyzing requirements, assessing system capabilities, and drafting detailed business and functional requirements.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to conduct in\-depth analysis, ensuring portfolio data structures align with business needs.
* Ability to interpret entity\-relationship diagrams and logical data models, validating system designs against business requirements.
* Integrate emerging technologies such as automation, AI, and distributed ledger technology (DLT) to optimize operational workflows for portfolio reference data and lifecycle events.
* Conduct market intelligence, competitive analysis, and industry trend research, with a focus on new account onboarding and lifecycle maintenance workflows, to drive innovation and differentiation.
* Represent the product team in executive\-level discussions, ensuring alignment with State Street Alpha’s strategic objectives and contributing to the broader product portfolio vision.
* Serve as a thought leader within the organization, providing expertise on data products, workflow automation, and product strategy, while mentoring junior team members.
* Knowledge of State Street’s technology infrastructure for front, middle, and back\-office services is a plus.

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications** :


* Advanced degree in business, technology, or a related field. CFA, MBA, or Masters preferred.
* 16\+ years of experience in product development, preferably in large financial services or asset management firms. Through understanding of end\-to\-end operational processes, risk and interdependencies.
* Strong understanding of Agile development methodologies.
* Proven track record of successfully launching and managing complex fin\-tech products.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Apply strong business judgment to surface implications and practical, high impact options.
* Proven experience in **product management** , including product market research, development, product delivery, and client implementations.

**About State Street**
======================

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
   

  

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We're committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 As a member of the Financial Risk \& Governance (FR\&G) Testing Team, the Senior Associate will lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) across FR\&G functions. This role plays a critical part in validating system enhancements, risk tooling, regulatory‑driven changes, and new technology solutions prior to production deployment.
   

  

 The Senior Associate will lead UAT planning and execution for releases, including defining UAT scope/approach, coordinating stakeholder engagement, ensuring audit\-ready sign\-off. This role will work closely with Risk Users, Product Owners, Technology Delivery Teams, and Business Analysts to ensure new capabilities meet the expectations and control needs of the Financial Risk \& Governance organization prior to production release. Testing is performed in a controlled non‑production environment designed to simulate production as closely as possible.
   

  

 Success in this role requires a strongly inquisitive mindset, an ability to understand a day‑in‑the‑life of Risk users, and a passion for improving both processes and systems. The Senior Associate will also contribute to the automation of UAT and help increase testing efficiency and repeatability across the organization.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
 Integration, Collaboration, and Discovery
   

  

* Support an environment that ensures employees understand how their efforts contribute to overall business strategy
* Manage assigned book of work, partnering with leadership to plan the future supply and demand of resources required
* Evaluate the testing status of assigned projects while identifying and escalating critical risks
* Partner closely with Financial Risk and Governance teams to understand functional workflows, risk processes, and control expectations.
* Collaborate with Product Owners and Delivery Teams to shape epic‑level acceptance criteria, ensuring they properly reflect FR\&G user needs and regulatory considerations.
* Develop a strong understanding of end‑to‑end risk processes, including how users interact with systems, data, and controls.
* Partner with team to ensure maintenance of UAT templates and test logs in approved repositories in accordance with record‑retention standards.
* Maintain UAT templates and test logs in approved repositories in accordance with record‑retention standards.


 UAT Planning, Execution and Governance
   

  

* Drive UAT status governance (daily/regular reporting, risk/issues escalation, defect triage coordination) within Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) or similar lifecycle tools, ensuring all acceptance criteria are validated.
* Mentor testers; standardize templates, evidence expectations, and execution discipline.
* Define UAT approach/plan for assigned projects and oversee execution across testers/workstreams
* Lead UAT scope definition, user acceptance validation, and support change/release readiness decisions.
* Ensure final UAT package is complete (templates, statistics, evidence) and stored appropriately at end of UAT.
* Analyze and interpret business requirements, risk policies, and control objectives to develop comprehensive user test plans and test cases.
* Review test plans and cases with business partners and obtain sign‑off to confirm comprehensive test coverage aligns with approved UAT scope and established entry criteria.
* Execute UAT in representative non‑production environments, ensuring functional behavior aligns with expectations and supports control effectiveness.
* Discover, report, and track defects using JIRA, collaborating with delivery teams on resolution and retesting.
* Validate system behavior not only for “happy path” (ideal, expected flow) scenarios but also for risk‑sensitive, exception‑mode, and control‑triggering scenarios.
* Contribute to the automation of UAT test cases, partnering with QA, engineering, or automation teams as needed.


 \*\*NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. \*\*
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Minimum 6 years of related experience leading SIT/UAT planning and execution and supporting signoffs in a controlled environment
* Bachelor's degree (preferred) or equivalent experience


**Talents Needed For Success**
* Understanding of distributed and/or mainframe test environments.
* Familiarity with SDLC/SILC, Agile, Kanban, ALM, and JIRA.
* Strong curiosity and desire to understand complex risk workflows.
* Experience in Financial Risk, Operational Risk, Model Risk, or Governance preferred.
* Experience in estimating, prioritizing, and planning testing activities
* Experience presenting to business users/stakeholders
* Experience with Intermediate MS Excel


 Willingness to build and expand skills in automation and quality assurance.
   

  

* High attention to detail and strong documentation discipline.
* Ability to think critically, ask insightful questions, and challenge assumptions.

description:
**Job Description:**

**Job Profile Summary**

**Job Summary:** The Team Coach \- Coaching \& Transformation for India supports the scaling and sustained adoption of BTOM\-aligned ways of working and promotes consistent, high\-quality coaching practices across assigned product teams and value streams

**Job Description:**

* Coach product teams on agile practices to drive delivery discipline and predictability. Provide 1:1 role\-based coaching for Product Owners and other team members to strengthen agile maturity.
* Apply coaching methodologies to support cross\-functional product teams in improving collaboration, enhancing delivery cadence, and achieving outcomes aligned with product goals.
* Facilitate team\-level ceremonies (e.g., planning, stand\-ups, retrospectives) to ensure effective collaboration, alignment, and dependency management.
* Coordinate with other teams to manage cross\-team dependencies and maintain alignment. Escalate blockers to senior coaches or leadership as needed to ensure timely resolution.
* Support teams in improving performance through ongoing inspection of team practices and adoption of new approaches.
* Work with teams to define and develop objectives and key results (OKRs) aligned with enterprise and value stream priorities; assist in tracking progress through performance dashboards.
* Guide teams to leverage flow and outcome metrics effectively to inform improvement; support development of targeted coaching plans to enhance team performance and maturity.
* Contribute as a member of the Center of Excellence by adopting standards, sharing learnings, and supporting continuous evolution of the operating model.
* Partner with Product Owners to build and maintain a strong backlog aligned with product strategy and priorities.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to support team needs and maintain alignment with product goals.
* Reinforce team understanding of how their work contributes to product and value stream OKRs.

**Must have:**

* 7–9 years of experience in roles such as Scrum Master or Agile Coach, working with agile teams in a scaled environment.
* Good knowledge of agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, etc.) with experience in agile delivery practices and ability to reinforce strong team habits.
* Ability to coach teams using supportive and adaptive techniques to drive continuous improvement.
* Experience with agile tooling (e.g., Jira, SPM) and applying best practices for team\-level adoption.
* Exposure to OKR development and outcome\-based performance tracking.
* Solid understanding of software development lifecycle and technology delivery.
* Familiarity with product platform constructs preferred.
* Working knowledge of engineering practices such as test automation, CI/CD, and DevOps.
* Good facilitation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to maintain alignment and transparency across teams and stakeholders.

**Good to have skills**:

* Developing enterprise mindset beyond team\-level execution
* Ownership and accountability for team\-level outcomes
* Inclination towards action, experimentation, and continuous improvement

At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Partner with product managers to review and challenge requirements – balancing complexity, cost, performance, and maintainability.
* AI based implementations, plan and drive delivery across multiple agile squads, ensuring milestone commitments are met.
* Actively contribute to technical solutions – understanding design choices, engaging in trade\-off discussions, and ensuring long\-term scalability.
* Monitor risks, track progress, and provide transparent reporting to stakeholders.
* Join client discussions to confidently articulate solutions, negotiate scope, and manage delivery expectations.
* Own UAT issue management once issues are assigned to development – ensuring they are assessed, routed to the right squad, prioritized appropriately, and tracked through to resolution.
* Work with Squad Leads, Product Management, and PMO to plan and coordinate deliverables across sprints – including facilitating sprint planning to ensure priorities, dependencies, and deliverables are clearly understood and ready for execution.


**What You Bring**
* Strong experience delivering technology products/projects – ideally in financial services.
* Solid understanding of corporate actions processing and lifecycle.
* Exposure to Agile delivery and multi\-client platforms.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to independently evaluate requirements and shape solutions.
* Understanding of key technical concepts:
+ Multi\-threading, real\-time messaging, REST APIs, file\-based integration
+ Database fundamentals and web application architectures
+ Cloud platforms (incl. cost, performance, and scale considerations)
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills – confident engaging with senior business, technology, and client stakeholders.


 We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.
   

  

**Use of AI in Hiring**
 As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)\-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**Job Title** 




**Delivery Manager – Digital** 




**Role Summary** 




 The Digital Delivery Manager is responsible for end\-to\-end delivery of digital initiatives, ensuring solutions are delivered on time, within scope, budget, and quality expectations. The role acts as a bridge between business stakeholders, product teams, and technical delivery teams, with strong ownership of execution, governance, and client satisfaction.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Delivery \& Execution** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery of digital programs, platforms, or transformation initiatives across web, mobile, cloud, and enterprise systems.
* Plan, track, and manage delivery milestones, dependencies, risks, and mitigations.
* Ensure adherence to delivery commitments on scope, timeline, cost, and quality.
* Drive predictable and transparent delivery using Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid methodologies.



**Stakeholder \& Client Management** 



* Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders and clients.
* Translate business requirements into executable delivery plans.
* Provide regular status updates, dashboards, and executive\-level reporting.
* Manage expectations, resolve escalations, and ensure high client satisfaction.



**Team Management** 



* Lead cross\-functional teams including UX, engineering, QA, DevOps.
* Foster a high\-performance delivery culture focused on accountability and collaboration.
* Support resource planning, onboarding, and performance management.



**Governance \& Risk Management** 



* Establish delivery governance frameworks, standards, and best practices.
* Identify delivery risks early and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with security, regulatory, and organizational standards.



**Financial \& Commercial Oversight** 



* Manage delivery budgets, forecasts, and financial tracking.
* Support change requests, effort estimation, and commercial negotiations.
* Ensure optimal utilization of resources and cost efficiency.



**Continuous Improvement** 



* Drive process improvements and delivery maturity across digital programs.
* Leverage metrics (velocity, throughput, quality, CSAT) to improve outcomes.
* Encourage adoption of modern tools, automation, and DevOps practices.



**Required Skills \& Experience** 




**Experience** 



* 15\+ years of experience in IT or digital delivery roles.
* At least 5\+ years of experience in project management having multiple teams.
* Proven experience delivering large\-scale digital platforms or transformation programs.
* Strong background in Agile and scaled Agile delivery environments.



**Skills** 



* Strong delivery planning, execution, and risk management skills.
* Excellent stakeholder communication and leadership abilities.
* Solid understanding of digital technologies (web, mobile, APIs, cloud, CMS, data).
* Experience with delivery management tool ( Azure DevOps).



**Education \& Certifications (Preferred)** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* Agile certifications (CSM, SAFe, PMI\-ACP) or PMP preferred.

title: Manager, Business Project Management
description:
The Manager, Business Project Management role is part of the Program Management Office, responsible for driving the end\-to\-end transition of product engineering capabilities, managing steady\-state delivery across engineering pods once onboarded, and building the governance backbone (standards, dashboards, forums)
   

  

**About Vanguard**
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

**Vanguard India**
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Manager of Business Project Management is responsible for overseeing project execution, ensuring alignment with business objectives, and managing teams throughout the project lifecycle. This role involves driving project success by maintaining strong stakeholder relationships, managing communication and change initiatives, and proactively addressing potential risks or obstacles. The ideal candidate will have strong leadership, project management expertise, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams effectivel
   

  

**Responsibilites**
* Hire, evaluate, and supervise team members, providing training, guidance, and performance management to support business objectives.
* Lead project teams through all phases of the project lifecycle, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery of business objectives.
* Manage project\-level communication and change management activities, tailoring messaging and delivery based on project complexity and scope.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including project leadership and workstream leads, to drive project success.
* Monitor project capacity, scope, and dependencies to optimize resource allocation and ensure alignment with strategic goals.
* Identify, evaluate, and resolve obstacles that may impact project timelines or outcomes, escalating critical issues to senior management with recommended solutions.
* Develop and implement project management best practices, methodologies, and templates to improve efficiency and standardization.
* Oversee financial tracking, status reporting, and risk management for projects, ensuring compliance with governance requirements.
* Provide mentorship and training to project team members, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional development.
* Participate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Minimum 8 years of relevant work experience, with at least two years in project management.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. A Master’s degree or relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, Prosci, or Agile certifications) is a plus.
* Strong track record of working with senior leadership and stakeholders to secure buy\-in and drive strategic decisions.
* Experience with change management methodologies and frameworks (e.g., ADKAR, Kotter’s 8\-Step Change Model).
* Solid understanding of technical project management principles, tools and techniques.Previous people leadership experience preferred.
* Strong stakeholder management, problem\-solving, and project execution skills.
* Experience managing complex, cross\-functional projects with multiple workstreams.


**Location**
 This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
   

  

**Our mission**
 Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
   

  

**Our commitment to you**
 Vanguard takes the same long\-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
   

  

**Financial wellness**
 We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
   

  

**Physical wellness**
 We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
   

  

**Personal wellness**
 We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in\-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission\-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long\-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Senior Product Engineering Lead (Client Journey & Solutioning)
description:
**About Olea:** 




 Olea is a digital infrastructure platform that connects global liquidity with trade and supply chain opportunities, fueling growth and unlocking potential worldwide. Olea has diverse liquidity pools with varying appetite and focuses. Olea’s vision is to connect capital to opportunity. It has a strong conviction in the role of trade to support sustainable economic development across countries, particularly emerging markets, particularly Asia where many smaller suppliers are based. Olea supports suppliers and buyers in over 70 corridors.
 



**Role summary:** 




 We are looking for a
 **Tech Team Leader** 
 for our
 **Client Journey \& Solutioning engineering** 
 team to bridge the gap between complex business product lines and highly scalable technology. In this role, you will manage and guide a high\-performing engineering team focused on crafting seamless, friction\-free client onboarding and transaction workflows for trade finance products, including invoice financing, factoring, and supply chain finance. You will closely collaborate with Business teams and the SDET Architect to champion agile methodologies, and pioneer the adoption of AI\-native engineering workflows, ensuring that all code—whether human\-written or AI\-generated—adheres to strict structural guardrails and automated testing standards throughout the software delivery lifecycle
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* **Team Leadership \& Product Collaboration:** 
 Partner closely with Business Product teams to translate complex invoice financing, factoring, and supply chain finance requirements into intuitive, reliable client journeys and technical solutions.
* **End\-to\-End Delivery Management** 
 : Manage the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) for both existing client\-facing and product applications, balancing the ongoing enhancement and stablity of existing production platform with the delivery of new greenfield capabilities. Take absolute ownership of frontend experiences, backend scalability, automated testing, and production stability.
* **AI\-Native Engineering Leadership** 
 : Design, establish and scale AI\-native engineering workflows, leveraging AI coding assistants, automated testing, and structured development guardrails to accelerate delivery velocity while enforcing rigorous engineering discipline.
* **Guardrails \& Code Integration** 
 : Establish and oversee robust code merge gates; ensure that whether code is generated by AI and reviewed by a developer, or written directly by a developer, it strictly passes the automated test suite, security linting, and compliance checks before being merged into the main codebase.
* **Technical Mentorship \& Culture:** 
 Guide, mentor, and pair\-program with engineers to uplift full\-stack technical capabilities, foster an agile DevOps culture, and continuously optimize CI/CD pipelines.
* **Proactive Problem Solving** 
 : Take absolute responsibility for resolving systemic technical debts, operational bottlenecks, or misalignments between business requirements and technical execution.



  





**Role specific technical competencies:** 



* **Product \& Solution Architecture:** 
 Ability to translate complex business processes into scalable technical architectures, customer journeys, APIs, and platform capabilities.
* **Full\-Stack Leadership Capability** 
 : Proven experience building clean, responsive client\-facing user interfaces as well as secure, high\-throughput, and scalable backend architectures.
* **Core Tech Stack** 
 : Deep proficiency in building full\-stack applications using Java or NodeJS / JavaScript / TypeScript (preferably strong across both ecosystems).
* **Trade Finance Domain Expertise** 
 : Hands\-on domain knowledge and engineering experience within specific supply chain finance frameworks, notably Invoice Financing, Factoring, and Supply Chain Finance workflows.
* **Client Journey Solutioning** 
 : Demonstrated ability to map out complex financial workflows into highly performant, intuitive, and secure client solutions and API integrations.
* **AI\-Native Engineering Proficiency** 
 : Strong familiarity with leveraging AI coding platforms or enterprise AI assistants effectively to boost team velocity without compromising on architectural integrity, code security, or regulatory compliance.
* **Core Software Engineering** 
 : Strong systems design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and advanced test automation practices.



  





**Qualifications (training, licenses, memberships and certifications):** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a similar quantitative/engineering discipline.
* Extensive experience in a senior or lead engineering capacity, with a proven track record of managing technical teams specifically within Fintech, transactional banking, or Trade Finance platforms.
* 3\-5\+ years leading engineering teams



  





**Note:** 




 Olea is committed to diversity and inclusion. By providing equal opportunities we foster a work environment which embraces diversity and gets the best out of the broadest spectrum of people to sustain business performance and competitive advantage. We build an inclusive culture by demonstrating respect for each other’s unique strengths and perspectives to enable every employee to develop a sense of belonging and have the opportunity to maximize their potential.

title: Business Transformation Consultant – Process, Experience & AI
description:

title: Senior Testing Lead - Automation, Performance, Security & Functional QA
description:
**Position: Senior Testing Lead \- Automation, Performance, Security \& Functional QA**
**Location: Hyderabad ( 8 PM to 5 AM IST)**
**Work Type: Full\-Time/Onsite**
**Experience: 8\+ Years**
**PETADATA is looking for a highly experienced Senior Testing Lead with 8\+ years of experience to own the overall quality strategy, build and scale test automation, and lead functional, performance, security, API, and data\-validation testing for a data migration platform operating across cloud and on\-premise environments.**
**Roles \& Responsibilities** 
**Quality Strategy \& Leadership**
* Own and define the overall QA and testing strategy across functional, automation, performance, security, and data\-integrity testing.
* Establish quality gates, release criteria, testing standards, metrics, and reporting.
* Identify and prioritize testing efforts based on business and technical risk, especially data\-correctness risks.
* Build and manage the quality function with minimal supervision.
* Mentor developers and QA engineers and promote a quality\-first engineering culture.
* Partner closely with Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Security, and Implementation teams.


**Test Automation**
* Design and build test automation frameworks from scratch.
* Develop automated UI, API, integration, and regression testing solutions.
* Use tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, and REST/API automation frameworks.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Build scalable regression suites that improve release velocity and confidence.
* Use programming languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java for automation.


**Functional \& Migration Testing**
* Own end\-to\-end functional testing across supported CRM platforms and migration scenarios.
* Test standard and custom objects, relationships, transformations, mappings, and edge cases.
* Design test scenarios based on real\-world customer data migration use cases.
* Validate migration correctness from source to destination.
* Test multi\-tenant behavior, configuration, and tenant data isolation.
* Identify defects and ensure issues are properly investigated, resolved, and prevented from recurring.


**Data Validation \& Integrity** 
  

  

* Build automated source\-to\-target data validation frameworks.
* Validate:
+ Record counts
+ Field\-level accuracy
+ Data mappings
+ Relationships and associations
+ Transformations
+ Deduplication
+ Overall data integrity

* Use SQL and programmatic validation techniques to verify migration results.
* Ensure migrated customer data remains complete, accurate, and consistent.


**Performance Testing**
* Design and execute load, stress, scalability, and performance testing.
* Test large data volumes and high numbers of concurrent migrations.
* Establish performance baselines, benchmarks, and SLAs.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and work with Engineering and Architecture teams to resolve them.
* Use tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust.
* Integrate appropriate performance testing into the CI/CD pipeline.


**Security Testing**
* Perform and coordinate security testing across the application and platform.
* Test tenant isolation and ensure no cross\-tenant data access is possible.
* Validate authentication and authorization controls.
* Perform input validation and abuse\-case testing.
* Integrate SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning into CI/CD.
* Coordinate penetration testing with internal security teams and external security vendors.
* Support security and compliance requirements such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001 through appropriate testing evidence.


**Technical Quality \& Delivery**

* Establish automated quality checks throughout the development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with developers to identify defects early.
* Review testing approaches and improve overall engineering quality.
* Support both cloud and on\-premise deployments.
* Help establish reliable test environments using cloud, containers, and infrastructure automation.

* Proficiency with Playwright, Cypress, and/or Selenium.
* Strong API and REST testing experience.
* Strong programming experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java.
* Hands\-on experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

 we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and

You will collaborate closely with Delivery Product Owners, product leadership, business stakeholders, and technology teams to help translate business needs into delivery\-ready features, validate quality through detailed review and testing, and support the successful rollout of product capabilities. The team consults and executes on a wide range of initiatives involving process and tool development and implementation including training development, engagement management, tool design, and implementation.
   

  

**Location –** 
 Hyderabad \& Gurugram

 11 am to 8 pm or 2 pm to11 pm IST
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Required 6\+ years experience
* 3\+ years of experience supporting product delivery, business analysis, project coordination, or technology implementation teams.
