title: Sr SDE - Issuance ( Backend - Java )
description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real\-time cross\-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
   

  

 Co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11\-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
   

  

 It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
   

  

 Our payout network spans 190\+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 \+ corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40\+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross\-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross\-Border Payments Companies list.
   

  

 In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1\.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high\-growth company.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Senior Software Engineer at Nium, you will be a key contributor within a cross\-functional team, collaborating with stakeholders across the organisation to design, build, and maintain our core platforms. You will leverage your experience to develop robust, scalable solutions to complex challenges, playing a critical role in the ongoing transformation of our technology landscape.
   

  

 In this hands\-on role, you will actively contribute to development efforts while mentoring fellow engineers and guiding the team toward high standards of technical excellence. You will take ownership of code quality and foster a culture of continuous improvement through constructive feedback and leadership by example.
   

  

 You will advocate for engineering best practices, drive enhancements to tools and processes, and promote collaboration and knowledge sharing. Based in Mumbai, and working closely with our teams in Malta, you will help lead a talented engineering team in building and maintaining our card issuance capabilities that are shaping the future of the industry.

* Platform \& Business Insight
* Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the company's software platforms, business logic, infrastructure, and delivery processes

* Lead the design and planning of technical and product initiatives
* Make informed engineering decisions aligned with business objectives
* Act as a subject matter expert and set the benchmark for code quality and best practices

* Contribute to team development through training sessions, technical talks, and informal mentoring

**Communication \& Alignment**
* Clearly communicate technical decisions, standards, and processes
* Foster a culture of transparency, open communication, and shared ownership


**Talent Development**

* Software Engineering \& Design
* 4 to 6 years of experience in designing and building robust, scalable software systems
* Strong passion for engineering and a pragmatic approach to high\-quality delivery
* Up to date with current development trends, technologies, and best practices
* Solid understanding of modern software engineering methodologies and delivery processes


**Backend Development**
* Deep expertise in Java and frameworks like Spring and Spring Boot
* Strong SQL and relational database design skills, including performance tuning and query optimization
* Proficient in designing and consuming RESTful APIs
* Familiarity with OpenAPI for API documentation


**DevOps \& Infrastructure**
* Experience or familiarity with tools like MySQL, Postgres, Kafka, Zookeeper, Docker, and Kubernetes

**Quality Assurance**

* Proficient with unit testing frameworks and related tools


**Collaboration \& Communication**
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Strong team player who provides leadership and guidance on key initiatives


**What We Offer At Nium**
**We Value Performance:** 
 Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.
   

  

**We Care for Our Employees:** 
 The wellness of Nium’ers is our \#1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our year\-end shut down. We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).
   

  

**We Upskill Ourselves:**

**We Thrive with Diversity:** 
 Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18\+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.
   

  

**Beware of recruitment scams:**

 . Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.

title: Project Sr Analyst - C12 - PUNE
description:
Organization Overview:
   

  

 We are a dynamic, global, and diverse Organization, with a presence in over 60 Countries; covering all front post execution Operations teams including product aligned Middle Office groups, Settlements, Margin, Asset Servicing, Listed Derivative \& Commodities Operations. We support an extensive range of Capital Markets products and services including Fixed Income (FX, Rates, Credit, Muni, Cash and Derivatives) where Citi is consistently a dominant top 3 player in the market, Equity (Cash, Derivatives, Prime Brokerage, Futures, Listed Derivatives, FXPB) where Citi has a significant growth program to continue to build out its capabilities and services; and Syndicates where we support both FI and EQ new issues and IPOs.
   

  

 We take pride and are passionate about our People and our culture. We are invested in our People and their development. We are transforming and simplifying our operating model, creating an exciting environment which encourages diversity of thought and inclusion.
   

  

 Our Operations groups are core to the success of the Markets business and have significant impact across the lifecycle of a trade. We partner extensively with a range of internal stakeholders including Front Office Sales and Trading Desks, Compliance, Legal, Finance and HR; alongside having significant interaction with our external client base, playing a key role in the overall client experience. We have a Client relationship group, dedicated to overseeing the Organizational service performance and strategic partnership for our top tier client base, where we play a key role in supporting our global clients to ensure they have a first\-class experience when doing business with Citi.
   

  

 Our Business Intelligence and Process Re\-engineering group works alongside our Operations teams delivering automation solutions to solve for operational challenges. We partner with Citi’s innovation labs to drive optimization, and overall play a pivotal role in enabling us to transform to achieve our target operating model.
   

  

 Our Technology partners develop and implement a wide range of applications that support the Operations, Change, Design and Implementation groups in providing innovative products and solutions. We have re\-imagined how to provide technology and service in our domain through the alignment of our team vision, culture, and aggressive retirement plan for legacy applications and adoption of a micro\-based containerized cloud environment. We encourage our people to create, explore and be adventurous whilst taking measured risk, adopting safe practices to protect the firm. Data lineage and optimization is core to how we develop our eco system. We are growing our capabilities using artificial intelligence, natural language processing and machine learning.
   

  

 Our roles entail ensuring we operate in a robust control environment, whilst in a fast\-paced workplace. We comply with global regulations and internal policies and adopt a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to reduce risk through the continuous evaluation of our controls; to protect our clients, the firm, and our reputation.
   

  

 We work closely with our external global peers, partners, and regulators, and play an integral part in leading an agenda at the forefront to optimize and streamline processes and drive strategy across our industry.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 The Markets Process Engineering team has been formed to support stakeholders both within Operations and across the bank, to design and deliver a multi\-year transformation roadmap. Our transformation is underpinned by strategy, investment change execution and a market leading change delivery team focusing on program and project management, business analysis, process re\-engineering and low code application development.
   

  

 The Futures and OTC Clearing franchise is an agency business providing trading and clearing capabilities across 40\+ exchanges to our clients and proprietary lines of business such as Equities, Rates, Commodities, FX and Prime D1\. The business is embarking on a strategic re\-engineering of its platforms. This is a multi\-year initiative, moving to real\-time computation, and with ambitious goals to design and deliver a more robust, strategic, well controlled end state for Futures and OTC Clearing Operations.
   

  

 We are recruiting for a Project/Business Analyst to help lead the delivery of strategic initiatives. This is a great opportunity to join a growing, global, and dynamic change management team, delivering a major Tier 1 program.
   

  

 The role will work in partnership with the Futures and OTC clearing business, global operations teams, technology and downstream areas such as finance and regulatory reporting.
   

  

 The core responsibilities of the Project Manager and Business Analyst include but not limited to the following:
   

  

* Develop and manage project plans, define project scope, goals, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements to ensure successful project execution.
* Manage project lifecycle from initiation to closure, ensuring that project deliverables are met and proper evidence provided.
* Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies, developing and implementing effective mitigation and contingency plans.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including project charters, requirements, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Facilitate and lead project meetings, including kick\-offs, status updates, working groups and governance forums, to ensure clear and consistent communication among all project participants.
* Conduct business and data analysis to document business and operational processes and recommend improvements.
* Develop and maintain detailed process maps, use cases to support business and functional requirements
* Analyze existing business processes to identify opportunities for improvement, and assist in designing enhanced workflows
* Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure that developed solutions meet business requirements and are fit for purpose.
* Prepare senior level presentations to communicate project updates
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance and other functions to ensure successful project implementation.


**Qualifications:**
* Project Management and Business Analysis experience
* Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) Regulatory Reporting knowledge is a plus
* 2\-3 years operations experience (preferably in banking)
* Critical thinking and problem solving
* Strong ability in use of Microsoft Applications (PowerPoint, Visio, Project, Word, Excel, Access)
* Proficient with the project life cycle (Waterfall \& Agile)
* CAPM, PMP, PgMP and/or MBA are a plus
* Developed communication and diplomacy skills required to persuade and influence others; may negotiate with external parties.


**Role Overview:**
 The role we are recruiting for is a hybrid Business Analyst / Project Manager role aligned to the Equities business. You will be part of the Futures \& Derivatives Clearing (FDC) and Equities Operations Program Execution Team, a key component of the Markets Ops Transformation organization. The team drives strategic transformation and delivers Target Operating Models for FDC and Equities Operations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Project Leadership \& Delivery: Manage end\-to\-end projects from defining scope, milestones and deliverables with stakeholders to ensuring successful, on\-time delivery meeting business needs.
* Planning \& Documentation: Develop comprehensive project documentation, including charters, business requirements, plans, and risk/issue logs.
* Monitoring \& Reporting: Monitor project progress, resources, and risks, identifying and escalating issues promptly and providing timely, clear updates and presentations to all stakeholders, including senior management.
* Process Optimization: Lead business analysis efforts, clarify requirements, and drive the development and implementation of innovative, efficient processes for Equities Operations.
* Risk \& Compliance: Apply robust risk management practices and ensure regulatory compliance to protect the firm's reputation.
* Team \& Collaboration: Drive resource planning and foster strong cross\-functional collaboration across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and other departments.
* Strategic Initiatives: Champion change management and undertake additional strategic projects/tasks as required.

title: Software Consultant
description:
**Department:** 
 Development
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  




**Description**
 ParentPay Group is Europe’s leading software product company and the UK’s largest education technology business. We are on a mission to bring next\-generation innovation to positively impact on the lives of millions of parents, teachers, and students every day in over 49 countries.
   

  

 Our market leading products use cutting edge cloud\-based technology to streamline school processes, including secure web and mobile apps that enable secure online payments for school items such as meals, trips, clubs and uniform, improve parental engagement, simplify meal management and \- through our product SIMS \- collect and manage a database of student information and core school operations.
   

  

 ParentPay Group’s new offices in Pune are a fantastic tech hub for those looking to boost their careers in software product development.
   

  

 Our bright team FastTrack their career with international exposure and ways of working based on agile development best practices from globally renowned technology consultancies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Software Development** 
 : design, code, test, and debug software solutions in accordance with project specifications. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
   

**Coding and Documentation:** 
 write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code. Maintain comprehensive documentation for code and software features.
   

**Front end web development** 
 : ability to design, create and evolve user\-facing applications to be scalable, maintainable, secure, aesthetic and usable within the constraints imposed by the browser using a combination of languages, design skills, and client\-side scripts and frameworks.
   

**Backend development** 
 : ability to write, maintain and design the business logic of a software application, the data or services requested are available as well as create and maintain the core databases, data and application program interfaces (APIs) to other backend processes.
   

**Database Management** 
 : knowledge of database systems (e.g. SQL Server, Oracle). Competence in writing and optimizing SQL queries.
   

**Version Control** 
 : proficient in using the Git version control systems.
   

**Testing and Debugging** 
 : experience with testing frameworks (e.g. XUnit) and debugging tools.
   

 Knowledge of test\-driven development (TDD) principles.
   

**DevOps** 
 : basic understanding of DevOps practices, continuous integration, and deployment.
   

**Cloud Computing** 
 : familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
   

**Collaboration:** 
 work closely with team members to understand project requirements and collaborate on project goals. Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to coding standards.
   

**Adaptability** 
 : stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends. Adapt to new tools, languages, and methodologies as required by projects.
   

**Quality Assurance:** 
 implement coding standards to ensure high\-quality, bug\-free code.
   

**Development Principles** 
 : implement industry standard development principles and frameworks for achieving quality, speed and maintainability. This includes the practices, techniques and tools that support those principles, and an understanding of when things may or may not be applicable in a situation or context.
   

**Giving and Receiving Feedback** 
 : solicit and engage with feedback on a continuous basis. Having timely, actionable and meaningful conversations about quality and performance for the purpose of improving effectiveness.
   

**Emotional Intelligence** 
 : recognizes, understands and manages their own emotions and recognizes, understands, shares and influences the emotions of others. Collaboration: works jointly with others to co\-create and achieve a common goal. This includes learning, practising and experimenting with tools, techniques and frameworks that foster collaborative working environments.
   

**Ownership and Accountability** 
 : takes personal accountability and ownership for their work. This includes personal follow through, making and defending difficult decisions and tradeoffs, removing blockers, driving collective progress.
   

**Continuous Improvement** 
 : advances by ongoing, incremental improvement through continuous learning, questioning the status quo and trying out creative and novel ideas. Shows curiosity and has a keen interest to drive learning for themselves and others.
   

**Systems Thinking** 
 : Positively impact complex systems or domains by understanding the whole picture and the interdependencies of its component parts. Maintain strong expertise and knowledge of current and emerging technologies and products.
   

  

  

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
 • Communication skills (both written and verbal) demonstrated at all levels of the organisation
   

 • Software development skills (.NET Framework, .NET Core, C\#, VB.Net, React, MVC, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, Xamarin, Java / XCode)
   

 • Cloud computing, particularly Microsoft Azure, with experience of deploying and managing applications in the cloud
   

 • RESTful API development
   

 • Testing framework knowledge (XUnit, Moq) and test driven development experience
   

 • Experience of source code control and release management (CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps)
   

 • Knowledge of API testing (Postman).
   

 • Database management, extensive query skills and ORM (Entity Framework) experience
   

 • Agile development methodologies: Kanban, Scrum, XP, Lean.

title: Software Engineer in Test
description:
**Job Description: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), OSS/BSS** 




**Job Title:** 
 Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), OSS/BSS
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, India
 



**Reports To:** 
 Engineering Manager
 



**About Telna** 




 Telna provides Mobile Network Operators (MNOs), Communication Service Providers (CSPs), and Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) with a fully managed global cellular connectivity platform. With access to the largest 2G–5G and LTE\-M coverage from over 800 radio network operators—300 of which are direct partners—across 200 countries, Telna empowers seamless, high\-performance connectivity worldwide.
 



 Our global multi\-network connectivity platform simplifies integration, offering localized break\-out capabilities via cloud infrastructure. With a single integration into Telna’s platform, millions of devices are powered by resilient, multi\-network connectivity—enabling a wide array of innovative cloud\-based solutions.
 



**Position Overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our engineering organisation and operate as a core developer on quality. You will design and build the platforms, frameworks, tooling, and infrastructure that make our OSS/BSS systems (network provisioning, inventory, CRM, billing, charging, and mediation) testable, observable, and releasable with confidence at telecom scale.
 



 Unlike a traditional QA role, you will spend most of your time writing production\-quality software—test harnesses, simulators, data generators, CI/CD tooling, service virtualisation, and contributions into product code to improve testability. You will partner closely with backend, platform, and DevOps engineers, treat test infrastructure as a first\-class product, and raise the engineering bar for quality across distributed, high\-volume telecom services.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, build, and own end\-to\-end test platforms and frameworks for Java\-based microservices, event\-driven systems, and the GUI applications that sit on top of OSS/BSS components.
* Write production\-quality code in Java (and supporting languages such as Python, Kotlin, or TypeScript) for test libraries, harnesses, SDKs, CLIs, and shared abstractions used across the engineering organisation.
* Build simulators, stubs, mocks, and service virtualisation for upstream/downstream telecom systems (network elements, mediation feeds, charging gateways, payment systems) to enable deterministic, isolated testing.
* Contribute directly to product code to improve testability—adding hooks, feature flags, contract definitions, observability, and clean seams between modules—as a peer of the backend developers.
* Design and implement end\-to\-end automated coverage spanning APIs, backend services, databases, message queues, and GUI workflows for CRM, billing, mediation, provisioning, and charging.
* Architect CI/CD test infrastructure (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD): pipeline design, parallelisation, ephemeral environments, test data provisioning, quality gates, flaky\-test detection, and self\-service tooling for other engineers.
* Build automation that validates Call Detail Records (CDR/EDR), rating, charging, and invoicing flows end\-to\-end, ensuring revenue assurance and data integrity at scale.
* Design and run performance, load, soak, and resilience tests (JMeter, Gatling, k6, chaos tooling) for high\-throughput telecom workloads, and turn the results into actionable engineering improvements.
* Drive a strong shift\-left culture: pair with developers on testability, review their unit/integration tests in code review, and own framework\-level patterns that the wider team builds on top of.
* Investigate complex failures across distributed services using logs, traces, metrics, and packet captures; isolate root causes, file high\-quality defects, and contribute fixes where appropriate.
* Mentor QA and SDET engineers on software engineering practices, design patterns, framework design, and code quality; act as a technical reference for test engineering across the team.
* Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, and Agile ceremonies; advocate for quality and testability as architectural concerns, not after\-thoughts.



**Required Qualifications** 



* 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time spent building test platforms, frameworks, or developer tooling (not just authoring test cases).
* Strong hands\-on programming skills in Java (OOP, collections, concurrency, exception handling, design patterns) at a level comparable to a backend software engineer; ability to design, review, and ship production\-quality code.
* Proven experience designing automation frameworks and test platforms from scratch, including architecture, modularity, extensibility, and adoption across multiple teams.
* Hands\-on experience automating REST/HTTP APIs and backend services using REST Assured, Karate, or similar frameworks, including contract\-style testing.
* Hands\-on experience automating GUI applications using Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, or equivalent—including Page Object Model, dynamic UIs, waits, and cross\-browser execution.
* Solid experience with build tools (Maven or Gradle), version control (Git), and modern code review workflows.
* Experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, etc.) including parallel execution, test reporting, quality gates, and flaky\-test mitigation.
* Proficiency in SQL for database verification and data setup; comfort with scripting languages (Python, Bash) for tooling and automation.
* Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices, asynchronous messaging, and cloud\-hosted architectures, and how each of these affects testing strategy.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, and common authentication mechanisms (tokens, OAuth, mTLS).
* Experience with test management and issue tracking tools (Jira, Confluence, TestMo, ALM, or similar) and treating quality data as a product.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to read logs, traces, and data records (CDRs, CSVs, DB tables) to isolate root causes.
* Strong written and spoken English communication skills, and the ability to work independently as well as in a global cross\-functional team.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience working in telecom OSS/BSS environments (CRM, billing, mediation, provisioning, charging) or MVNO/MVNE platforms.
* Familiarity with telecom protocols (e.g., SNMP, Diameter, SS7 concepts) and OSS/BSS architecture.
* Experience validating eSIM, SIM lifecycle, or mobile connectivity workflows.
* Experience with Charging, Rating, and Mediation systems, and with Online Charging Systems (OCS).
* Hands\-on experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm).
* Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, Pulumi) and building ephemeral or on\-demand test environments.
* Experience with message queues and event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ), including testing event\-driven contracts.
* Experience with performance testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6\), chaos engineering, and network tracing (Wireshark).
* Experience with contract testing (Pact), BDD frameworks (Cucumber, Karate), and consumer\-driven testing strategies.
* Exposure to security testing (SAST/DAST, OWASP) and to supporting UAT and customer pilots.
* Open\-source contributions to test frameworks, developer tooling, or quality infrastructure.



**Why Join Us** 



* Contribute to the advancement of cutting\-edge telecom technologies and infrastructure.
* Collaborate with a diverse, experienced, and multicultural team of engineers and industry professionals.
* Enjoy a flexible work environment with remote work options.
* Receive a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package.
* Grow your career through professional development opportunities and technical training.

title: Delivery Manager
description:

 And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. * Comprehensive medical insurance for employees and dependents, including dental and vision cover, with optional top\-up plans available.

* Retirement benefits including Provident Fund, Gratuity and optional National Pension Scheme participation.
* Employee Assistance Programme, Indian Health Organisation membership and access to wellbeing resources through the dh Wellness Hub.
* Office commute support, internet allowance, Talent Scout referral programme, long service awards and additional family support benefits.
* 25 days annual leave plus public holidays, enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and a day off on your birthday.


**Our approach to Flexible Working**
 At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

title: Release Train Engineer
description:
About This Role
**5 years of experience**  

**Skills: SAFe 5, RTE, PI Planning, ART Sync, Stakeholder Engagement, Agile, Banking, Capital Markets, DevOps, Jira/confluence**

**About the Role** We are looking for an experienced Release Train Engineer (RTE) with 5\+ years of experience to lead and facilitate Agile Release Train (ART) delivery You will serve as a servant leader and coach for the ART — facilitating PI Planning, managing cross\-team dependencies, removing impediments, and driving continuous improvement across the delivery organisation. Banking and capital markets domain experience is essential for this role — enabling you to engage credibly with business stakeholders, understand regulatory delivery constraints, and navigate the governance frameworks of a complex financial services environment.


**Key Responsibilities**


ART Facilitation \& Delivery


* Facilitate and coordinate all ART\-level ceremonies — PI Planning, ART Sync, System Demos, and Inspect \& Adapt workshops — ensuring effective cross\-team alignment and programme increment delivery.
* Manage and coordinate delivery across two squads of 7 — ensuring teams are aligned to PI objectives, dependencies are managed, and risks are identified and mitigated proactively.
* Track and manage ART\-level programme board — maintaining visibility of features, dependencies, risks, and milestones across both squads throughout each programme increment.
* Facilitate cross\-team dependency resolution — identifying blockers, coordinating between squads, and escalating impediments that cannot be resolved at team level.
* Support squad\-level Scrum Masters — providing coaching, guidance, and facilitation support to ensure effective Agile ceremonies and team delivery rhythms.
* Monitor and report ART\-level delivery metrics — velocity, predictability, feature completion, and PI objective achievement — providing clear, evidence\-based progress updates to programme leadership.
* Coordinate System Demo preparation and execution — ensuring both squads deliver integrated, demonstrable working software at the end of each programme increment.

Continuous Improvement \& Coaching


* Lead Inspect \& Adapt workshops — facilitating structured retrospectives at ART level, identifying systemic improvement opportunities, and driving measurable delivery improvement.
* Coach squads, Product Owners, and stakeholders on SAFe principles, Agile practices, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Champion DevOps and continuous delivery practices — supporting squads in improving build, test, and deployment automation to accelerate feature delivery.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and psychological safety across both squads — enabling high\-performing, self\-organising teams.

Stakeholder Management \& Governance


* Act as the primary ART\-level communication interface — providing regular, clear delivery status updates to programme managers, product leadership, and senior stakeholders.
* Manage relationships with Business Owners, Product Management, and key stakeholders — facilitating business engagement in PI Planning, System Demos, and governance forums.
* Contribute to portfolio\-level planning — providing ART capacity, dependency, and risk inputs to support programme and portfolio prioritisation decisions.
* Support risk and compliance governance — ensuring ART delivery activities align to organisational delivery standards, change management processes, and regulatory requirements within a banking and capital markets environment.
* Maintain ART\-level documentation — PI plans, programme boards, risk registers, and retrospective action logs.

**What We're Looking For**


* 5\+ years of experience in Agile delivery roles — Scrum Master, RTE, or Agile Coach — with at least 2–3 years as a Release Train Engineer in a SAFe environment.


* Deep SAFe expertise — PI Planning facilitation, ART coordination, programme board management, and Inspect \& Adapt — with proven ability to lead ARTs of 10–15\+ people.


* **Banking and capital markets domain experience — essential** — understanding of financial services delivery constraints, regulatory governance, and capital markets technology programmes.


* Experience managing cross\-team dependencies and delivery coordination across multiple squads in fast\-paced programme delivery environments.


* Strong servant leadership and coaching skills — supporting Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and squad members in Agile best practices.


* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — engaging senior business and technology stakeholders with clear, concise ART\-level delivery reporting.


* Proficiency with Agile tooling — Jira, Confluence, Miro — for PI planning, programme board management, and delivery reporting.


* Strong facilitation skills — leading large\-group PI Planning events, System Demos, and Inspect \& Adapt workshops with energy, structure, and impact.


* Good understanding of DevOps and continuous delivery practices — supporting squads in improving automation and deployment frequency.


* Strong analytical mindset — interpreting ART delivery metrics and driving data\-informed continuous improvement.


**Nice to Have**


* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE) certification — SAFe 5 or SAFe 6\.
* SAFe Programme Consultant (SPC) certification.
* Experience in capital markets technology programmes — trade reporting, regulatory platforms, market data, or trading systems delivery.
* Familiarity with LPM (Lean Portfolio Management) and portfolio\-level Agile governance.
* Experience with scaled Agile tooling — Jira Align, Rally, or equivalent ART\-level planning tools.
* Agile coaching certification — ICP\-ACC or equivalent.
* Exposure to regulatory delivery programmes — MiFID II, EMIR, APRA, or equivalent financial services regulatory change.

title: Team Lead – Software Engineering
description:
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Team Lead to build and lead a team of software engineers developing a strategically important cloud\-based platform that enables customers to check and improve the accuracy of their X\-Rite color measurement devices.
   

  

 This is a player\-coach role, combining hands\-on software development with technical leadership and people management. The role focuses on enabling team effectiveness, technical excellence, cloud\-native architecture, and continuous improvement in a global engineering environment.
   

  

 The team owns a modern web application built with TypeScript, React, Redux, HTML, CSS, AWS, Lambda, Node.js, and serverless technologies, as well as a companion Qt/C\+\+ desktop application responsible for collecting and managing data that is integrated into the cloud platform.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing team of software engineers
* Hire, onboard, motivate, and coach team members, fostering engagement, growth, and a strong team culture
* Contribute hands\-on to software development, including design, implementation, code reviews, and technical problem solving — leveraging AI throughout the software development lifecycle
* Provide technical leadership and guide architectural decisions for both the cloud platform and associated desktop applications in collaboration with global engineering teams (US, Switzerland, India, Germany, Netherlands, North Macedonia)
* Own and evolve scalable, secure, and maintainable cloud\-native architectures on AWS
* Drive the evolution of frontend and backend systems, ensuring high performance, reliability, usability, and security
* Collaborate closely with product management, UX, QA, data engineering, and application support teams to deliver customer value
* Facilitate Agile ways of working (Scrum/Kanban), supporting effective planning, execution, prioritization, and delivery
* Establish and continuously improve software engineering practices, including testing, CI/CD, cloud operations, observability, security, and effective usage of AI
* Ensure seamless integration between cloud services and desktop applications that contribute data to the platform
* Work closely with global stakeholders across India, Europe, and the US to align technical direction with product strategy
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and engineering excellence


**Required Qualifications \& Professional Knowledge**
* 8\+ years of relevant experience in software engineering
* 3\+ years of experience leading software engineering teams
* Strong hands\-on experience building and maintaining modern web applications
* Several years of experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Redux, HTML, and CSS
* Strong backend development experience with Node.js and TypeScript
* Experience designing and operating cloud\-native solutions on AWS or Azure
* Solid understanding of serverless architectures and services such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and related cloud technologies
* Experience designing scalable distributed systems and defining application architectures
* Ability to analyze customer and business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions
* Experience establishing engineering best practices including testing strategies, CI/CD, code quality, monitoring, and security
* Solid understanding of modern web application architecture and software design principles
* Experience collaborating with UX, Product Management, QA, and other engineering disciplines
* Ability to collaborate effectively with global, cross\-functional teams
* Solid understanding of the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle
* Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum and/or Kanban)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Willingness to travel (10%)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience leading teams developing cloud\-native SaaS or enterprise software platforms
* Experience with AWS services beyond Lambda and API Gateway, such as RDS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch
* Experience with DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud automation
* Experience working with data\-intensive applications, analytics platforms, or data pipelines
* Experience working in geographically distributed teams


**Nice to Have**
* Knowledge of desktop software development using C\+\+ and Qt
* Experience integrating desktop, edge, or device\-connected applications with cloud services
* Knowledge of color management, measurement systems, or hardware\-connected software solutions


**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* :5\+ years of experience delivering and evolving commercial software products throughout their lifecycle
* Experience balancing technical leadership, people leadership, and hands\-on software development responsibilities


**Personal Attributes**
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to balance hands\-on work with leadership responsibilities
* Passion for building high\-performing engineering teams and developing people
* Collaborative and pragmatic approach in a cross\-functional, global environment
* High learning agility and enthusiasm for modern software engineering practices, cloud technologies, and AI\-assisted development
* Ability to make sound technical and organizational decisions in a fast\-paced environment
* Effective communicator capable of aligning stakeholders across multiple functions and regions


 Ability to operate effectively in a distributed team with partial timezone overlap (India ↔ US/EU)
   

  

 We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. We believe in the value of unique perspectives, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who may not meet every criterion to apply and bring their distinctive experiences to our team.
   

  

**We Offer**
* A dynamic, international, and innovative work environment.
* Exciting technical challenges and expert colleagues with decades of experience in the field.
* A position in our Bangalore office with flexibility in the time schedule and hybrid work model.
* A human\-sized organization where you'll have contact beyond the R\&D department.
* Coaching and learning opportunities at every stage of your career.
* The opportunity to work on business\-critical data platforms that support decision\-making across the company.
* Be part of building products that address real\-world challenges for customers across global industries. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership, influence technical decisions, and see your contributions create measurable business value.
* Direct collaboration with engineers, product managers, support teams, and business stakeholders across Europe, Asia, and North America.
* A culture that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and constructive challenges.
* The freedom to contribute ideas, drive improvements, and influence technical direction.
* Team leads are trusted to contribute not only technical expertise, but also vision, coaching, and leadership that help shape the future of our products and organization.


 Immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic workplace that spans industries such as printing, packaging, photography, graphic design, video, automotive, paints, plastics, and textiles. Join a team that thrives on pushing the boundaries of what's possible, where innovation meets impact, and cross\-functional teamwork sets us apart.
   

  

 At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

title: Assoc Clin DB Validation Mgr
description:
**Job Overview**
 Manage end\-to\-end delivery of testing services for single/multi\-service projects, ensuring quality deliverables on time and within budget, to customer satisfaction. Provide comprehensive testing expertise to testing team to provide high quality database that meet customer requirements. Provide leadership and vision to the team in the areas of project planning, execution, and close\-out; financial management; communications; and milestone deliverables. Comply with Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), applicable regulatory guidelines, SOPs, policies, and, where available, CDM guidance documents.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Attend Kick Off Meeting and regular project meetings until Study Go Live.
* Take complete responsibility for creation of Edit Checks Test Plan document and writing test cases.
* Release the Edit Checks Test Plan to the testing team to conduct testing activities.
* Review Project Plan and escalate issues (if any) to all stakeholders.
* Comprehend study protocol and share the basic requirement of protocol with validation project team.
* Perform eCRF and Time \& Events QC as per QC checklist.
* Test email alerts
* Review ASB and Edit Specification document, provide input and escalate issues if any.
* Document in version history if any changes made to Edit Specifications within Test Plan during validation process.
* Request final and authorized version of documents to validate system configuration (AUL, Rights and Roles, Home page, System Settings).
* Provide project status updates on validation activities to Data Team Lead/Lead Programmers.
* Review Testing Comments Log after each cycle of testing and provide Testing Comments Log to Programmer.
* Document all testing documentation in eDMSF in a timely manner.
* Co\-ordinate with internal Customers on a regular basis and establish strong Communications with them.
* Work with functional manager(s) to ensure appropriate resources are assigned to meet project deliverables.
* Implement proactive quality management plans across multiple projects/programmes. Track service performance and provide leadership to identify root cause of issues and implement remedial actions.
* Continuously look for opportunities to improve the process; work with team to develop and implement plan to re\-organize and drive change across multiple projects/programme (with minimal support)
* Ensure timely follow\-up and resolution of compliance issues.
* Serve as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for validation group.
* Train and mentor Testing Team Members.
* Provide end to end Project Management for testing activities in the team, e.g. proactive and accurate resource planning, planning for deliverables, identifying
* risks (if any) and escalate such risks to the Manager.
* Conduct Quality Reviews as applicable.
* Review the QIP for appropriate budget allocation and communicate if any out of scope activities are noted.
* Review individual project financial performance and communicate issues to the appropriate stakeholders. Ensure adherence to study budgets.
* Supervise implementation of new technology.
* Serve as primary point of contact for Internal Customers on testing deliverables.
* Provide justification for and perform direct negotiations with Internal Customers, e.g., timelines, financial, process, resources.
* Develop and maintain strong Customer relationships.
* All responsibilities are essential job functions unless noted as nonessential (N).


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree Bachelor in Science/Computer science/Information Technology or Bachelor in Technology Req
* 4\- 6 years of relevant clinical DB Testing experience in CDMS Platforms and total exp being 6\+ yrs Req

We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com
   

  

 IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. title: Software Engineering Manager — Funded Development
description:
**Department:** 
 Engineering
   

  

**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad/GiftCity
   

  

**Description**
 We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.
   

  

 This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* Hands\-on technical leadership \& design — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* AI\-assisted engineering — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* SE \+ SQE leadership — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* People management \& culture — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.


**Skills, Knowledge And Expertise**
**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don't, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.


**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.


**Benefits**
***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* Health \& Financial Security:
+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off \& Flexibility:
+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.
+ Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).

* Work\-Life Support \& Resources:
+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.

* Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:
+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.

* Our Culture:
+ Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

description:

 Information Technology
   

  

 As a UI/UX Designer for the ServiceNow platform, you will help create intuitive, accessible, and engagingexperiences across enterprise workflows. Working with UX leadership, product owners, business stakeholders, architects, and developers, you will translate user needs and complex processes into clear
   

  

 designs that improve usability, adoption, and productivity.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on individual contributor role. You will participate in research and discovery, create journey maps, user flows, wireframes, and prototypes, support usability testing, and collaborate with delivery teams from concept through implementation. You will apply established design standards while contributing ideas and reusable patterns that improve the overall platform experience.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Design user experiences for ServiceNow workspaces, Employee Center, portals, mobile experiences, Virtual Agent, and AI\-assisted workflows.
* Create user flows, wireframes, responsive layouts, clickable prototypes, and design specifications using Figma or comparable tools.

* Apply established UX standards, design\-system components, accessibility requirements, and reusable platform patterns.
* Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, architects, and developers to balance user needs with platform capabilities and delivery constraints.
* Support backlog refinement and provide design details and acceptance criteria needed for development.
* Review implemented experiences, identify gaps from approved designs, and support usability validation before and after release.
* Document design decisions and contribute new patterns, research findings, and examples to the UX practice.
* Present design concepts and recommendations clearly to project teams and business stakeholders.

* Bachelor’s degree in human\-computer interaction, UX or product design, service design, graphic design, psychology, information science, computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* A portfolio demonstrating user\-centered design, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and delivered digital experiences.
* Proficiency with Figma, FigJam, or comparable design and prototyping tools.
* Experience participating in user research, usability testing, or design workshops and translating findings into design improvements.
* Understanding of responsive design, accessibility, inclusive design, and WCAG principles.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams in an Agile or iterative product\-delivery environment.
* Strong visual, written, presentation, and collaboration skills.

title: Lead UI/UX Designer
description:
As the UX Lead for our ServiceNow platform, you will drive consistency across our UX and UI, document and own the standards that get us there, and build the design system and practice that make great experiences repeatable
   

  

 rather than accidental. This is a hands on leadership role. You will set the design direction and build it, in UI Builder and in React.
   

  

 This is a pivotal moment for experience on our platform. We are raising our ambition from enterprise tolerable to consumer grade, moving beyond a traditional ITSM mindset to design solutions our users genuinely want to use.You will own the success and adoption of what we ship, not just the design behind it.
   

  

 You will establish a formal UX practice on the platform from the ground up and lead the designers and developers
   

  

 who join it. Strong stakeholder management and communication are central to the role. You will be the advocate for experience who aligns product, engineering, and business around a shared bar for quality, and holds us to it.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 UX Standards and Consistency
   

  

* Own and document the UX and UI standards for the platform, and drive their adoption across every team building on ServiceNow.
* Build and own a design system and component library so that consistency is built in, not policed after the fact.
* Establish design patterns, guidelines, and reusable components that raise the floor on every solution we ship.
* Define what “good” looks like on the platform and hold teams to it through design reviews and clear standards.


 Consumer Grade Experience and Adoption
   

  

* Move the platform beyond a traditional ITSM mindset and design solutions where the experience is consumer grade.
* Own the success and adoption of the solutions we ship. Define what adoption looks like, measure it, and use


 it to drive design decisions.
   

  

* Partner with product and business teams to make sure we are solving the real user problem, not just delivering the requested feature.
* Bring an outside\-in view of quality, benchmarked against the consumer products our users actually compare us to.


 Hands On Design and Build
   

  

* Design and build experiences directly in UI Builder and the Now Experience Framework.
* Write front\-end code in React to build components, prototypes, and production experiences where native tooling is not enough.
* Move fluidly between design and implementation so that what gets shipped matches what was designed.
* Set front\-end engineering standards for the UX work on the platform.


 User Research and Accessibility
   

  

* Stand up a user research practice. Talk to real users, run usability testing, and bring evidence to design decisions rather than opinion.
* Own accessibility on the platform. Make sure what we build meets WCAG standards and works for everyone, and build accessibility into the design system rather than retrofitting it.
* Turn research and accessibility from checkboxes into a genuine part of how the team works.


 Mobile Experience
   

  

* Extend the same consumer grade bar to mobile. Our mobile experience is a strength today and this role keeps it that way as the platform grows.
* Design and build mobile experiences that are first class, not afterthoughts, across ServiceNow mobile apps and mobile web.


 Building the UX Practice and Team
   

  

* Establish a formal UX practice on the platform from scratch: the standards, the tools, the rituals, and the ways of working.
* Hire, lead, and grow a team of UX designers and developers, and build a culture where craft and user obsession are the norm.
* Mentor the team and raise the level of design and front\-end work across everyone building on the platform.


 Stakeholder Management and Communication
   

  

* Be the advocate for experience across product, engineering, operations, and business, and align them around a shared bar for quality.
* Communicate design decisions clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive leadership, and bring people along rather than mandating.
* Make the case for investment in UX and show the return through adoption and outcomes.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Deep hands on experience with ServiceNow native UX capabilities, including UI Builder and the Now Experience Framework, across workspaces, portals, and Employee Center.
* Hands on front\-end development experience with React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with the ability to build production experiences directly.
* Proven track record building and owning a design system and component library adopted across multiple teams.
* Experience establishing and documenting UX and UI standards and driving their adoption at scale.
* Hands on user research experience, including usability testing and translating findings into design decisions.
* Strong accessibility expertise, including WCAG 2\.1 / 2\.2 and designing for assistive technologies.
* A portfolio that shows consumer grade enterprise experiences, and the judgment to move a platform beyond legacy and ITSM era patterns.
* Proven people leadership. You have built or led a team of designers and developers.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including with executive leadership.
* Experience owning the adoption and success of what you ship, and measuring it.
* Proficiency with Figma or equivalent design and prototyping tools.
* 8\+ years in UX and UI design, with meaningful time in a lead or player\-coach capacity.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ServiceNow certifications related to UX, UI Builder, or application development (e.g., CSA, CAD).
* Hands on experience with ServiceNow mobile, including Now Mobile and the mobile app builder.
* Experience standing up a UX or design ops practice inside an organization that previously had none.
* Experience turning around the reputation of a platform or product that had outgrown its original design.
* Familiarity with Employee Center Pro intranet and portal experiences.
* Experience with design system tooling such as Storybook, design tokens, and component documentation.
* Interaction and motion design skills, and UX writing or content design experience.
* Experience working with large scale enterprise design systems.

We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

title: Product Experience Lead
description:
AI can make a polished screen in seconds. Getting someone to trust an AI agent with their real work is much harder. That's the problem we're hiring for.
 



  





 At Tipstat, we build AI systems that run whole business workflows. Our two products are Ozyn.AI, a productivity assistant that works across Gmail, CRM, Calendar, Sheets and 50\+ other integrations, and Alvoff, an AI\-native B2B procurement platform. Our customers are mid\-market companies, many in regulated industries.
 



  





 You'll be our first dedicated product experience hire. You'll own how both products feel, from the first click to the hundredth workflow.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Talk to users every week, watch session recordings and dig into data to find the gap between what people say and what they actually do
* Design trust between people and AI agents: when an agent acts on its own and when it asks first, how it shows its work, and how users take back control
* Shape behavior, not just screens, using motivation, habit, cognitive load and deliberate friction
* Own the whole journey: onboarding, empty states, errors, notifications, emails and pricing
* Give our products a distinct feel instead of the generic SaaS look, and back your choices with evidence
* Tie design to activation, adoption of agent workflows and retention, and run experiments to learn what works and why
* Use Claude Design, Figma and code prototypes to explore quickly, then spend your time choosing and refining
* Work with founders and engineering to shape the roadmap
* Build our experience principles, design system and research practice



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 6\+ years in product design or UX, ideally in B2B SaaS or complex workflow tools
* Deep working knowledge of user psychology and behavioral design. You can explain why a design works, not just that it looks good
* Research skills you actually use: interviews, usability testing and product analytics
* Strong craft in interaction design, information architecture and visual design
* Clear writing. You treat microcopy as part of the design
* Comfort with ambiguity and with being the only designer in the room
* Hands\-on experience with AI design and prototyping tools



  





 Bonus points if you've designed AI or agent products, worked in a regulated industry, or can prototype in code.
 



  





 This role probably isn't for you if your best work is Dribbble shots rather than outcomes, or if you'd rather hand off mockups and move on.
