Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology company building AI\-powered intelligence for the freight forwarding industry. Freight forwarders manage thousands of shipments, rates, exceptions, and operational decisions every day. The challenge is not a lack of data. It is knowing what needs attention, what is going wrong, and what action to take next.
   

  

 Portcast uses AI and data to help freight forwarders surface shipment exceptions, identify cost and margin risks, and make better decisions across the shipment lifecycle. Our products help teams improve operational efficiency, protect margins, and make faster, more informed decisions. Our vision is to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.
   

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
 We are looking for a Marketing Designer to be the design engine behind our marketing. You'll turn briefs and copy into polished, on\-brand assets across the full funnel, landing pages, case studies, social and paid creative, event materials, product collateral, and video, often at speed and across several formats at once. You'll partner closely with content and growth marketing (copy and content sit with the Content Marketing Manager; the visual craft is yours) to keep a consistent visual system across everything we publish, and raise the bar on how the Portcast brand shows up.
   

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:**
* A consistent, high\-quality visual system across everything Portcast publishes, with assets shipped quickly and on\-brand across web, print, social, paid, and video, so marketing can move fast without design becoming a bottleneck or losing craft.


**WHAT YOU’LL OWN:**
* Design landing pages, case study PDFs, product one\-pagers, and sales/product collateral
* Produce social creative (LinkedIn\-first), including post series and campaign templates
* Build paid media and creative for LinkedIn and Google campaigns across personas
* Create event and webinar assets: banners, booth graphics, decks
* Produce and edit video content end to end, short\-form social clips, product feature videos, webinar/event recaps, and launch teasers, from raw footage to polished, on\-brand output
* Maintain and extend the Portcast brand system: components, tokens, templates
* Support HTML email/newsletter production and light web design handoff
* Iterate quickly across multiple design and content review rounds


**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent
* At least 3\+ years in a design role, ideally in\-house at a B2B SaaS product\-based startup or at an agency doing B2B marketing, with a portfolio that shows real range across web, print, social, campaign, and video work
* Fast, high\-craft execution: You produce polished work quickly, often across several formats at once, without letting speed erode quality. You take direction and iterate well, but you hold your own opinions on what "good" looks like
* Detail\-obsessed: Pixel alignment, spacing, and consistency matter to you. You catch the small things others miss and hold the visual bar across everything that ships
* Figma (advanced): You work fluently with components, variants, auto\-layout, and shared libraries, and you keep the design system clean and reusable
* Adobe Creative Suite: Strong in Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign, including multi\-page, print\-ready layouts for case studies and collateral
* Design fundamentals: A strong grasp of typography, layout, grid systems, and brand consistency, and the ability to design for web and print formats interchangeably
* Creative at scale: You're comfortable designing social and paid ad creative at volume from templates, keeping everything on\-brand across personas and campaigns
* Video editing and production: You can take a project from raw footage to finished, high\-quality output, cutting, pacing, color, captions/subtitles, motion titles, and sound. You're fluent in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (or equivalent DaVinci Resolve / Final Cut), and CapCut or similar for fast short\-form social edits
* Web and email handoff: A basic understanding of HTML/CSS, enough to work within existing markup for email and web handoff, not necessarily coding from scratch
* Brand systems: Working knowledge of brand systems and design tokens, and how to keep every asset on\-system as the brand scales
* Advanced motion design: animation and motion work (Lottie, complex After Effects, 3D/Blender)
* Presentation design: high\-polish decks in PowerPoint or Google Slides
* AI design tooling: familiarity with image generation, AI\-assisted layout, prompt\-based workflows, and AI video
* Webflow basics: building or maintaining pages in Webflow, not just designing them
* Curiosity for the logistics domain: Experiencein logistics, supply chain, transportation, or freight technology is valued, but so is a genuine curiosity to understand our market in depth
* AI\-forward mindset: You consistently apply AI across design workflows and actively experiment with new tools as they emerge
* Startup builder mentality: You thrive in lean, fast\-moving environments where ownership is high and resources are limited
* Strong communicator: You communicate clearly across a diverse, distributed, cross\-cultural team. You can be opinionated, but you engage with other views and compromise when it's right


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**
* Own the visual craft end to end: You'll own how Portcast looks and feels across everything we publish, with real influence over the brand and few layers between an idea and what ships.
* Build in an industry still defining modern B2B marketing: Logistics and supply chain tech is at an exciting stage of digital transformation, with significant room to rethink how enterprise software is marketed and how it looks. You'll bring fresh ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and help shape what great design looks like in this space.
* Work at the intersection of AI, design, and logistics: We have a strong product, established enterprise customers, and a real opportunity to sharpen how we show up. You'll get to push AI\-forward design and video workflows, not just execute templates.
* Small by design, fully distributed across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Your work directly shapes launches, customer perception, and how the market sees Portcast.


**OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO:**
* Curiosity: We dig into why a design worked or didn't, how a freight forwarder actually operates, and what makes our brand land with customers.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait to be told what to make, and we stay on a piece until it's genuinely on\-brand and right.
* Raising the bar: We don't settle for assets that are merely fine. We hold a high standard for craft, polish, and the experience our brand creates.
* Effectiveness: We focus on design that drives real marketing outcomes, pipeline, launches, and brand perception, not just output. We prioritize the right work and make practical trade\-offs.


 Join us at Portcast and help shape the future of the logistics and shipping industry through design that is as sharp as the product behind it.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Job description:** 




  





 The Graphic Designer will be part of Factory U/X team and will work on industrial visual communication as well as complete workplace\-experience environments. The role involves transforming complex safety, operational and organizational information into clear, engaging and visually powerful communication.
 



  




* The designer will contribute to projects such as:
* Customer Experience Centers Safety Experience Centers
* Training and Innovation Centers
* TPM and DWM Galleries
* Factory\-wide visual\-management programmes
* Workplace branding and culture communication
* Wayfinding and navigation systems
* Safety and behavior\-change campaigns
* Interactive and digital workplace displays



  





**The person must be comfortable developing a design direction, visualizing it within a physical space and converting the approved concept into accurate, production\-ready artwork.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Workplace and Experience Design** 



* Develop visual concepts for Customer Experience Centers, Safety Experience Centers, Training Centers, TPM/DWM Galleries and other workplace\-experience environments.
* Translate a central concept into a cohesive physical experience across walls, displays, digital screens, installations and interactive elements.
* Create mood boards, spatial themes, wall elevations and realistic mock\-ups using site photographs, dimensions and architectural references.
* Work with project, content, fabrication and installation teams to ensure the final execution remains consistent with the approved design.



  





**2\. Industrial Visual Communication** 



* Design factory\-wide safety communication, visual\-management systems, workplace branding, wayfinding, process displays and behavior\-change campaigns.
* Simplify complex safety, technical and operational information into communication that is clear, engaging and easy to understand.
* Develop a consistent visual language across multiple artworks, locations and audience groups.
* Work within customer brand guidelines while maintaining the intended communication and design quality



  





**3\. Production Artwork** 



* Convert approved concepts into accurate, production\-ready artwork for large\-format printing and different fabrication applications.
* Adapt master designs across multiple sizes, formats, languages and site locations.
* Ensure accuracy in dimensions, scale, bleed, colour modes, image resolution, cut lines, fonts and file packaging.
* Conduct final quality checks and maintain systematic file naming, version control and artwork archives.



  





**4\. AI\-Assisted Design** 



* Use AI tools for concept exploration, image generation, visual references, retouching and faster artwork adaptation.
* Write effective prompts to generate industry\- and brand\-relevant visual content. Professionally refine AI\-generated outputs and check them for accuracy, realism and production suitability.
* Follow company guidelines on confidentiality, copyright and responsible use of AI.



  





**5\. Project Coordination and Quality** 



* Understand project briefs, technical content, site conditions and customer requirements before beginning the design.
* Participate in internal reviews and customer presentations when required, and incorporate feedback accurately.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to resolve design, production and implementation\-related issues.
* Manage multiple assignments while maintaining quality, consistency and agreed timelines.



  





**Experience and Educational Background** 




  




* 3–4 years of relevant professional design experience.
* Degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Communication Design, Applied Arts or a related discipline.
* Experience with a design agency, environmental\-graphics company, workplace\-branding firm, exhibition or experience\-design company, or large\-format production organization.
* Experience in industrial communication, safety communication, environmental graphics, wayfinding or experience\-center design will be strongly preferred



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Strong working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop and CorelDRAW.
* Strong understanding of typography, composition, colour, visual hierarchy and information layout.
* Good image\-editing, photo\-manipulation and retouching skills.
* Ability to create realistic design mock\-ups using actual site photographs.
* Understanding of environmental graphics, spatial storytelling and experience\-led design. Ability to visualize a complete physical environment not just an individual poster or signage.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as Adobe Firefly, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Gemini or equivalent platforms.
* Experience preparing artwork for small\-format and large\-format printing.
* Ability to interpret measurements, drawings, site photographs and marked\-up presentations.
* Ability to work with customer brand guidelines and established visual systems.
* Good command of written English and the ability to identify basic content errors.
* Strong attention to detail, especially while handling safety and technical information.



  





**Application Requirements** 




  




* Updated résumé.
* Portfolio containing 8–12 relevant projects.
* Examples of branding, environmental graphics, spatial design, signage, layouts or largeformat production work.
* At least one project demonstrating how complete physical space was visualized.
* Examples of AI\-assisted design work, with a brief explanation of how AI was used.
* Current compensation is expected compensation and notice period.

title: Creative Lead
description:
Who Are We?
   

  

 RZR is an AI\-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full\-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose\-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.
   

  

 We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.
   

  

 RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M\&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The Creative Lead for Production owns quality and pipeline health for a pod of designers delivering creative across Video, Banner, Native, Interstitial, and Playable formats. You are the QA gate — every asset passes through your sign\-off before it ships.
   

  

 You sit at the seam between Creative Strategy and Production: translating briefs into executable direction, maintaining the team's output velocity, and protecting quality even at peak volume (20–30 tickets per day). This is not a pure management role. You are expected to stay hands\-on — personally concepting, storyboarding, and executing — while leading, coaching, and developing your direct reports.
   

  

 The right person sets the creative bar rather than enforcing someone else's, and finds the balance between forward output and quality control without dropping either.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own production quality standards across all formats and enforce the QA matrix — every asset passes your sign\-off before shipping
* Direct creative execution across channels and set the bar for what "done" looks like
* Manage the QA pipeline end to end: review and approve RZR Studio submissions, flag revisions, track resolution at 20–30 tickets per day at peak, with first\-review turnaround under 2 hours
* Triage and allocate bandwidth across your pod, flag bottlenecks before they become backlogs, and deliver a daily pulse on pipeline health
* Coordinate with the Creative Strategy Lead on brief\-to\-execution alignment, escalating collated feedback when strategic creative revisions run heavy on first pass
* Drive production workflow and tooling improvements, owning the team's iteration velocity and output volume targets
* Maintain and update the Playbook and RZR Studio Templates on every new account launch, with same\-day turnaround
* Run 1:1s and development check\-ins with all direct reports; report pod output metrics to the Director of Creative Services


**Required Skills And Experience**
 Must\-Have
   

  

* 7\+ years in creative production, motion or graphic design, or multimedia design within digital, gaming, or adtech
* Hands\-on fluency across the Adobe Suite — Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects — at a level where you can personally concept, storyboard, and execute, not just review
* Proven QA and production management experience: owning sign\-off standards, SLA turnaround, and quality bars across multiple formats including Video, Banner, Native, Interstitial, and/or Playable
* Experience managing production pipelines at volume (20\+ tickets per day equivalent) without quality slipping
* Track record of personally shipping strong concept work — storyboards, key art, or campaign creative — not just directing others' output
* Familiarity with platform\-specific creative specs and constraints across DSP, Meta, TikTok, and ASO
* Experience managing and developing a team of designers (3\+ direct reports), coaching on craft not just workflow
* Comfortable translating strategic briefs into clear, executable production direction
* Strong written and verbal communication — able to give craft feedback that lands and escalate risk clearly


 Nice\-to\-Have
   

  

* Prior experience in adtech, programmatic advertising, or mobile advertising creative
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted production tooling and a clear view on where human craft judgment must stay in the loop
* Experience working across international or distributed creative teams


 Work Setup
   

  

 This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, India, requiring regular onsite attendance for collaboration, reviews, and team activities. This is not a fully remote position. Creative team members may occasionally be required to work onsite more frequently depending on project demands.
   

  

 Why Join RZR?
   

  

* You set the creative bar, not just enforce someone else's — this is a high\-impact production leadership role with genuine ownership over quality standards across the pod
* Hands\-on craft alongside people leadership — this is not a pure management track. You will stay in the work, personally concepting and executing alongside directing your team
* Direct visibility to Creative Leadership — pod output and quality reporting flows directly to the Director of Creative Services, with clear line of sight to your impact
* Established team and systems to optimize, not build from scratch — you are inheriting a functioning pod with defined workflows, tooling, and playbooks, with room to elevate them
* Clear progression path — strong performance in this role leads toward cross\-pod production standards and the Creative Director track


 RZR Behaviors
   

  

 RZR operates by eight core behaviors: Extreme Ownership
   

  

* Move Fast
* Drive for Excellence
* Proactive Communication
* Courage
* Curiosity
* Deliver Results
* Manage Ambiguity

 our customers,

designs that improve usability, adoption, and productivity.

title: Delightree - Senior Design Engineer
description:
### **About the role**


This role splits roughly in half.


The first half is designing for franchise operations \- multi location brands, franchisee owners, and frontline staff each needing something different from the same product.


The second half is owning the layer between design and code. You'll own the design system \- the components, patterns, and code. You'll write frontend code yourself, and you'll define how design work becomes a shipped interface for everyone else on the team.


That second half is why this role exists. Our approach to product development is shifting. Instead of traditional mockup handoffs, product managers and designers directly build working prototypes directly in code, using AI workflows alongside our component library. Engineering builds on those prototypes rather than starting over. You own this system and ensure it's up to scale and quality.

### **What you'll do**

* Design and build UI in the same motion \- prototyping novel AI\-native interactions directly in code rather than in Figma\-then\-handoff, especially where no pattern library exists yet.
* Sit inside a pod (PM \+ eng lead \+ you) and take features from concept to shipped, rather than handing off a spec and waiting.
* Own the interaction and motion details \- loading/streaming states, transitions, micro\-interactions \- the polish that's nearly impossible to fully spec in a doc.
* Build and maintain shared UI components so the rest of the org can move fast without reinventing patterns feature by feature.
* Work directly in the production codebase.

### **What we're looking for**

* 4\+ years in product design, with depth in dense interfaces \- tables, forms, permissions, multi role flows.
* Real product/visual design judgment *and* the ability to ship real frontend code \- not a designer who dabbles in code or an engineer who cares about UI, but someone for whom design and implementation are the same skill.
* Hands\-on frontend engineering. A portfolio \+ GitHub showing shipped, interactive, polished products \- not just mockups or case studies.
* Design systems built and maintained at scale, in code. You should be able to direct AI tools to build and maintain prototypes that adhere to accessibility, component system, and other guardrails.
* Experience or strong interest in AI\-native interfaces: streaming output, agentic/human\-in\-the\-loop UX, confidence and uncertainty in UI.
* Bonus: has worked somewhere small enough that design and engineering weren't separate functions. AI used structurally in how features got shipped, from ideation through implementation and review \- not just for copy or asset generation.

* Design flows, wireframes, prototypes, and final specs for features across web and mobile\-web \- with the polish and clarity engineers need to ship.

**Contribute to Product Direction** 




  




* Partner with product stakeholders to pressure\-test ideas, sharpen scope, and propose alternatives \- not just pick up tickets.

title: Content & UI Specialist
description:
Job Type: Permanent \- Full Time
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 Job Category: IT
   

  

**Job Description**
 Are you ready to grow your career in our global tech hub?
   

  

 Zurich Cover\-More Group helps people travel safely across the globe every day. We are there at every step of a traveller’s journey, to keep them safe and help them out if something goes wrong. We are committed to providing reliable, fast, flexible and bespoke services for our customers as well as the many well\-known brands we partner with, such as travel agencies, airlines, banks and major sporting clubs!
   

  

 In the post\-pandemic world, travel insurance is more important than ever. We are committed to delivering an exceptional service for our customers and we want you to be part of that journey.
   

  

**So, what’s the job?**
* You'll proactively partner with stakeholders to develop, manage, and maintain digital content across CMS platforms, ensuring quality, accuracy, and consistency at every stage.
* You'll lead the creation and management of pages supporting product, feature, and campaign launches.
* You'll establish, advocate for, and enforce content standards and best practices across CMS platforms.
* You'll manage site authors by overseeing access permissions, governance processes, and CMS training initiatives.
* You'll conduct regular site audits to identify broken links, outdated content, and UX issues while driving continuous content improvements.
* You'll optimise web pages for usability, accessibility, and search engine optimisation (SEO).
* You'll collaborate with UX/UI designers across multiple geographies and time zones to implement intuitive interfaces, improve user journeys, and enhance overall site usability.
* You'll partner with developers, product teams, and global stakeholders to translate business requirements into polished, user\-friendly digital experiences.
* You'll design and implement features and workflows that improve efficiency in content management processes.
* You'll ensure all digital experiences meet responsive design, device and browser compatibility, and WCAG/ADA accessibility standards.
* You'll build feasibility analyses and proof\-of\-concept (POC) solutions for optimisation initiatives using ZCM's standard CMS component set.
* You'll plan, build, and execute A/B and multivariate tests using ZCM's test\-and\-learn toolset.
* You'll validate optimisation rules and audience segment configurations to ensure accurate test delivery.
* You'll analyse test results and convert insights into actionable recommendations, effectively communicating outcomes to stakeholders across locations.
* You'll lead UAT and QA processes to ensure accurate, high\-performing, and compliant digital experiences across web and app touchpoints.
* You'll validate content, functionality, device responsiveness, and WCAG compliance across partner and owned digital properties.
* You'll coordinate QA activities across distributed teams to ensure comprehensive testing and smooth go\-live execution.
* You'll act as the subject\-matter expert on ZCM's CMS, optimisation toolset, and digital platforms, providing first\-level support to the Rapid Learning Lab team globally.
* You'll document requirements for CMS component enhancements and communicate effectively with developers and stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* You'll demonstrate strong asynchronous communication practices, keeping remote and onshore stakeholders informed, engaged, and unblocked between scheduled touchpoints.
* You'll work closely with Content, UX Design, Engineering, and broader business teams to deliver cohesive, high\-quality digital outcomes.
* You'll align Rapid Learning Lab and travel partner requirements to maximise technology capabilities, optimise user experiences, and drive sales performance.
* You'll write and debug CSS to create high\-quality web experiences, including resolving specificity and cascade conflicts, leveraging CSS custom properties, and translating design mockups into responsive, production\-ready web pages.
* You'll apply modern CSS layout techniques, including Flexbox and CSS Grid, to build responsive interfaces that provide an optimal experience across devices and screen sizes.
* You'll use browser Developer Tools to inspect, troubleshoot, and resolve styling, layout, and markup issues in live environments.
* You'll utilise vanilla JavaScript for DOM manipulation, including element selection, content updates, class management, and basic interactive functionality.
* You'll create, update, and manage website content using Web Content Management Systems (CMS), ensuring accurate and engaging digital experiences.
* You'll build and manage A/B and multivariate tests on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) websites using Adobe Target and similar experimentation platforms to optimise user experience and business outcomes.
* You'll apply front\-end development skills to implement, customise, and support website enhancements, experiments, and digital initiatives.
* You'll maintain a strong understanding of website architecture, functionality, and best practices to support effective digital delivery.
* You'll ensure websites meet WCAG and ADA accessibility standards by identifying, addressing, and preventing common accessibility issues.
* You'll apply SEO best practices, ensuring websites are optimised for search engine visibility, performance, and discoverability.
* You'll design and develop responsive web experiences that follow industry best practices and deliver consistent functionality across a range of devices and screen sizes.
* You'll implement and validate web analytics and advertising tracking tags using tools such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, and related marketing technologies to support measurement and optimisation activities.
* You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure tracking, experimentation, accessibility, SEO, and front\-end development requirements are effectively delivered and maintained.


**And what are we looking for?**
* You'll bring a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Digital Marketing, Web Design, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field.
* You'll have 18 months or more of hands\-on, business\-side experience managing content within a CMS for a public\-facing website.
* You'll demonstrate experience working within offshore, distributed, or globally dispersed teams, successfully managing deliverables and communications across multiple time zones.
* You'll have hands\-on experience with one or more enterprise CMS platforms, such as Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Tridion, or Ektron.
* You'll possess experience using multivariate and A/B testing tools and methodologies, including platforms such as Adobe Target, Optimizely, Google Optimize, or similar solutions.
* You'll have a solid technical understanding of HTML, CSS, and web publishing principles.
* You'll demonstrate a strong understanding of content optimisation, technical SEO principles, and digital best practices.
* You'll have proven experience creating and managing web pages designed for a global audience.
* You'll possess strong knowledge of responsive design, device and browser compatibility, and WCAG/ADA accessibility standards.
* You'll have experience leading or supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Quality Assurance (QA) processes for digital products.
* You'll stand out with experience using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
* You'll bring knowledge of additional Adobe Digital Marketing tools, such as Adobe Target and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics.
* You'll have familiarity with digital environments within the travel or insurance industries.
* You'll have exposure to analytics and reporting tools that support optimisation and test performance analysis.
* You'll be exceptionally detail\-oriented, with outstanding proofreading skills and a commitment to content accuracy and test quality.
* You'll be a clear and proactive communicator who keeps remote and onshore stakeholders informed, aligned, and engaged.
* You'll work confidently and independently, managing priorities across multiple time zones with minimal day\-to\-day supervision.
* You'll thrive in a fast\-paced environment, seamlessly switching between priorities while consistently meeting deadlines without compromising quality.
* You'll be self\-motivated, responsive, and committed to delivering high\-quality digital experiences regardless of team location.
* You'll be highly collaborative and team\-oriented, recognising that exceptional digital experiences are built through strong global partnerships.
* You'll be naturally curious and improvement\-focused, constantly seeking opportunities to enhance digital experiences and outcomes.


**So, why choose us?**
 We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability and determination.
   

  

 We have more than 2600 employees worldwide: we’re a global group of digital natives, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts and customer service professionals. We share a global mission to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.
   

  

 Job flexibility. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid work week policy ensures our employees maintain work\-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.
   

  

 Career growth. We want you to continue to learn, develop and bring your ideas to the table. We want to hear what you think, and we want you to work with the business \- not for the business!
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. So whatever walk of life you wander, just be you and come as you are.
   

  

 Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need, when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, covid leave (to get vaccinated and for when you’re sick), volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.
   

  

**We also offer some other perks including:**
* Mediclaim insurance cover in case of any health emergency
* Coverage under group personal accident insurance
* Flexible and compressed work weeks and hybrid working options.
* Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays
* An extra day off for you to take on your birthday or your annual work anniversary.


 Apply today and let’s go great places together!

title: Software Consultant
description:
**Department:** 
 Development
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Permanent \- Full Time
   

  

**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Upendra Kamat
   

  

**Description**
**ParentPay Group** 
 is the largest EdTech company in Europe with over 1000 employees and more than £130m turnover. The group has a portfolio of software solutions for educational establishments which serve their management, payments, catering and library service needs.
   

  

 PPG is also the largest provider of school management software in the UK and touches the lives of over one million people every day, streamlining school administration and management to free up time for teaching and learning, with its market\-leading SIMS software solution
   

  

 SIMS is at the heart of 19,000 schools, including over 700 independent and international schools in 49 countries.
   

  

**What We Are Doing**
 We are developing a new single authentication solution that will be integrated and used by all products within the ParentPay Group.
   

  

 A new team will be forming and will be working under a DevSecOps culture using eXtreme Programming techniques, ensuring the highest standards of quality, security and delivery are met.
   

  

 The product will pass through a formal Service Transition process into live support, but the team should also have a firm focus on live service operations and where they fit into 3rd line support.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Consultant who is passionate about building products that deliver exceptional customer experience. You will contribute towards creating test scenarios, manual Testing, automating the scenarios and benchmarking the performance of products and services in the ParentPay group portfolio.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding the domain as well as technical intricacies of the product working on the product backlog, and aid in delivery acceleration through creative thinking, an evidence\-based approach and a keen focus on user and business value.
   

  

 The product will deliver a new Auth Solution for all group products, so alongside customer facing elements there will need to be a firm technical foundation. A solid understanding of technical principles and an ability to converse and work with solutions and technical requirements is therefore essential to success.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop understanding of the Domain and technical intricacies of the product.
* Consistently evaluate and become the expert in the domain space.
* Collaborate with the product stakeholders to understand the Acceptance criteria thoroughly.
* Build robust UI/UX solution using .NET, C\#, Microservices, HTML, CSS technologies.
* Would need to work on Azure B2C implementation.
* Strong understanding of architectural principles
* Understanding of oauth api call sequence
* Strong Agile Development Practices
* Ability to work in a technical environment. Should have experience with Whitebox testing techniques.
* Demonstrate clarity of thought and the ability to translate the complex into simple and consistent terms.


 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

**Essential Skills**
* .NET 8 or later
* Azure ecosystem (ADO)
* C\#
* Strong understanding of architectural principles
* Strong understanding of API Design
* Agile Development Practices


**Desired Skills**
* k8s
* kiuwan or similar for security testing
* JUnit or similar for unit testing

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Title: Full Stack Developer
 



 Location: Pune
 



 Exp: 3 \- 5 Years
 



 Timing: 3pm \-11pm \| Monday to Saturday (2nd \& 4th Saturday Off)
 



 Joining: Immediate
 



 Website: https://chatwithads.com/
 



 Address: NIBM road, Pune
 



  





 ChatwithAds is building an AI\-powered intelligence layer for paid media teams—helping brands move from
 **Signal → Decision → Outcome → Learning** 
 .
 



 We’re looking for a strong product engineer who doesn’t just ask, “What should I build?” but thinks ahead:
 



**What are we really trying to solve? What will this need to become six months from now? How do we build it fast today without creating problems tomorrow?** 




 This is an
 **onsite role in Pune** 
 . You’ll work closely with the founder and product team, with significant ownership over how the product gets built.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Build and ship core CWA product features across frontend, backend, APIs, data and AI workflows.
* Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction.
* Convert rough product ideas into thoughtful, scalable implementations.
* Build systems around advertising data, analytics, signals, recommendations and decision tracking.
* Design integrations with platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, Slack, Teams, email, ClickUp/Asana and other business tools.
* Work with LLMs, agents, structured outputs, retrieval and AI\-assisted workflows.
* Think through architecture, edge cases, data quality, permissions, performance and reliability.
* Identify technical problems before they become bottlenecks.
* Turn repeated workflows into reusable systems instead of repeatedly patching features.
* Use modern AI development tools to improve development speed.
* Own features from idea → architecture → implementation → deployment → monitoring.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 You should be someone who:
 


* Has strong full\-stack development fundamentals.
* Can independently understand a business problem and propose the technical solution.
* Thinks beyond the immediate ticket.
* Understands APIs, databases, backend architecture and modern frontend development.
* Is comfortable working with large amounts of third\-party data.
* Has experience building SaaS products.
* Understands or is excited to deeply learn AI/LLM application development.
* Can move quickly without writing disposable code.
* Knows when to engineer for scale and when to keep things simple.
* Communicates clearly about technical trade\-offs.
* Is naturally curious about new technologies and constantly experiments with better ways to build.



**The Mindset We Care About** 




 A normal developer says:
 



**“Tell me exactly what needs to be built.”** 




 A strong developer says:
 



**“I understand what you want. Here’s how I would build it.”** 




 The person we want says:
 



**“I understand what you’re trying to achieve. Here’s how I’d build it now, what will become difficult later, and how we can structure it today so we preserve our options without overengineering.”**




**You'll Fit Well If** 



* You want to work onsite and collaborate closely with the founding team.
* You enjoy ambiguous problems.
* You want influence over the product, not just implementation.
* You think in systems.
* You challenge weak assumptions.
* You care about product outcomes as much as code quality.
* You want to build something from an early stage into a serious technology company.



**Bonus**




 Experience with any of the following is valuable:
 


* Google Ads / Meta APIs
* Advertising technology or analytics platforms
* OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini APIs
* Agentic AI systems
* Python
* Node.js / TypeScript
* React / Next.js
* PostgreSQL
* Data pipelines
* AWS / GCP
* Queueing / background jobs
* Observability and monitoring
* Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture



  





**Growth**




 This is not intended to remain a narrow developer role.
 



 For the right person, there is significant room to grow into a
 **Lead Engineer / Engineering Lead / Head of Engineering** 
 position as CWA scales.
 



 We care more about
 **ownership, product thinking, technical judgment and rate of learning** 
 than titles.

title: Marketing Designer
description:
Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology company building AI\-powered intelligence for the freight forwarding industry. Freight forwarders manage thousands of shipments, rates, exceptions, and operational decisions every day. The challenge is not a lack of data. It is knowing what needs attention, what is going wrong, and what action to take next.
   

  

 Portcast uses AI and data to help freight forwarders surface shipment exceptions, identify cost and margin risks, and make better decisions across the shipment lifecycle. Our products help teams improve operational efficiency, protect margins, and make faster, more informed decisions. Our vision is to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.
   

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
 We are looking for a Marketing Designer to be the design engine behind our marketing. You'll turn briefs and copy into polished, on\-brand assets across the full funnel, landing pages, case studies, social and paid creative, event materials, product collateral, and video, often at speed and across several formats at once. You'll partner closely with content and growth marketing (copy and content sit with the Content Marketing Manager; the visual craft is yours) to keep a consistent visual system across everything we publish, and raise the bar on how the Portcast brand shows up.
   

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:**
* A consistent, high\-quality visual system across everything Portcast publishes, with assets shipped quickly and on\-brand across web, print, social, paid, and video, so marketing can move fast without design becoming a bottleneck or losing craft.


**WHAT YOU’LL OWN:**
* Design landing pages, case study PDFs, product one\-pagers, and sales/product collateral
* Produce social creative (LinkedIn\-first), including post series and campaign templates
* Build paid media and creative for LinkedIn and Google campaigns across personas
* Create event and webinar assets: banners, booth graphics, decks
* Produce and edit video content end to end, short\-form social clips, product feature videos, webinar/event recaps, and launch teasers, from raw footage to polished, on\-brand output
* Maintain and extend the Portcast brand system: components, tokens, templates
* Support HTML email/newsletter production and light web design handoff
* Iterate quickly across multiple design and content review rounds


**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent
* At least 3\+ years in a design role, ideally in\-house at a B2B SaaS product\-based startup or at an agency doing B2B marketing, with a portfolio that shows real range across web, print, social, campaign, and video work
* Fast, high\-craft execution: You produce polished work quickly, often across several formats at once, without letting speed erode quality. You take direction and iterate well, but you hold your own opinions on what "good" looks like
* Detail\-obsessed: Pixel alignment, spacing, and consistency matter to you. You catch the small things others miss and hold the visual bar across everything that ships
* Figma (advanced): You work fluently with components, variants, auto\-layout, and shared libraries, and you keep the design system clean and reusable
* Adobe Creative Suite: Strong in Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign, including multi\-page, print\-ready layouts for case studies and collateral
* Design fundamentals: A strong grasp of typography, layout, grid systems, and brand consistency, and the ability to design for web and print formats interchangeably
* Creative at scale: You're comfortable designing social and paid ad creative at volume from templates, keeping everything on\-brand across personas and campaigns
* Video editing and production: You can take a project from raw footage to finished, high\-quality output, cutting, pacing, color, captions/subtitles, motion titles, and sound. You're fluent in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (or equivalent DaVinci Resolve / Final Cut), and CapCut or similar for fast short\-form social edits
* Web and email handoff: A basic understanding of HTML/CSS, enough to work within existing markup for email and web handoff, not necessarily coding from scratch
* Brand systems: Working knowledge of brand systems and design tokens, and how to keep every asset on\-system as the brand scales
* Advanced motion design: animation and motion work (Lottie, complex After Effects, 3D/Blender)
* Presentation design: high\-polish decks in PowerPoint or Google Slides
* AI design tooling: familiarity with image generation, AI\-assisted layout, prompt\-based workflows, and AI video
* Webflow basics: building or maintaining pages in Webflow, not just designing them
* Curiosity for the logistics domain: Experiencein logistics, supply chain, transportation, or freight technology is valued, but so is a genuine curiosity to understand our market in depth
* AI\-forward mindset: You consistently apply AI across design workflows and actively experiment with new tools as they emerge
* Startup builder mentality: You thrive in lean, fast\-moving environments where ownership is high and resources are limited
* Strong communicator: You communicate clearly across a diverse, distributed, cross\-cultural team. You can be opinionated, but you engage with other views and compromise when it's right


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**
* Own the visual craft end to end: You'll own how Portcast looks and feels across everything we publish, with real influence over the brand and few layers between an idea and what ships.
* Build in an industry still defining modern B2B marketing: Logistics and supply chain tech is at an exciting stage of digital transformation, with significant room to rethink how enterprise software is marketed and how it looks. You'll bring fresh ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and help shape what great design looks like in this space.
* Work at the intersection of AI, design, and logistics: We have a strong product, established enterprise customers, and a real opportunity to sharpen how we show up. You'll get to push AI\-forward design and video workflows, not just execute templates.
* Small by design, fully distributed across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Your work directly shapes launches, customer perception, and how the market sees Portcast.


**OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO:**
* Curiosity: We dig into why a design worked or didn't, how a freight forwarder actually operates, and what makes our brand land with customers.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait to be told what to make, and we stay on a piece until it's genuinely on\-brand and right.
* Raising the bar: We don't settle for assets that are merely fine. We hold a high standard for craft, polish, and the experience our brand creates.
* Effectiveness: We focus on design that drives real marketing outcomes, pipeline, launches, and brand perception, not just output. We prioritize the right work and make practical trade\-offs.


 Join us at Portcast and help shape the future of the logistics and shipping industry through design that is as sharp as the product behind it.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

 As the

 of experience in creative design, with at least

title: Senior Designer
description:
What’s up?
 **We’re VaynerMedia!** 
 We are a contemporary global creative and media agency with an expertise in driving relevance for clients and delivering impactful business results. The independently\-owned agency was founded in 2009 and has offices in New York, Los Angeles, London, Singapore, Australia, Thailand, Japan and Mexico City. VaynerMedia has been recognized for its work at Cannes Lions, the Clio Awards and The Webby Awards. It is part of the VaynerX family of companies.
   

  

**Culture is our key and Empathy is how we build it.** 
 VaynerMediaAPAC is strong with a world\-class combination of diverse backgrounds collaborating to put forward innovative, creative and strategic solutions to the one advantage that stands the test of time \-\-\- PEOPLE. Day in and day out, we propel some of the biggest brands in the world to the intersection of attention and culture. In APAC, we are proudly \+150, servicing a diverse client all around the region.
   

  

**The PITCH**
 We are creators, creative industry rogues, and SuperBowl stars. We are not just on the internet; we are creating the stuff the internet wants to see. We’re insane for what we do and the people we do it with. We move so fast and make so much good shit that we can’t even keep up with ourselves. So, we need more folks just like us, the unconventional, less\-obvious, unseasoned (
 *or over seasoned* 
 ) creative pros. But above all \- passionate makers and culture shakers.
   

  

 At VaynerMedia, we’re lucky that everyone within our walls thinks creatively – and shares a passion for building communities and understanding a world of micro\-content. In that case, our designers serve a slightly different role than more traditional “digital creative types” but thankfully none of which involve the term “design ninja”
   

  

 You have a passion for design and a hunger to learn how to create pieces that drive engagement and extend brand experiences. However, you also understand that good ideas can come from anywhere and are open\-minded when working with teammates. You are a flexible multi\-tasker who communicates naturally, passionately, and collaboratively. You'll be working exclusively within the digital realm (no print work) and the portfolio you submit should reflect this, but we also love seeing your overall solutions and ideas throughout your book.
   

  

 This exciting opportunity will allow you to work independently while collaborating with our strong force of 50\+ creative team members across APAC.
   

  

**The task at hand:**
* You’ll be asked to do a range of creative work from faster, “smaller” pieces to “bigger” builds for a range of clients, as well as VaynerMedia\-wide projects
* You’ll work within a dynamic team structure with several creative leads, helping to support and deliver on our core community and brand specific campaigns
* You’ll have a mastery of industry best practices and the platforms we love, as well as be willing to learn and articulate the unique VaynerMedia POV on each
* You’ll care about concepting, designing, developing, and putting the team in the best position to present our ideas way more than you do about getting credit for the work
* You’re expected to be as much of a friendly teacher as a proficient doer when working within our Account team structure
* You’ll have strong typography skills, a love and mastery of photoshop and feel very comfortable in all adobe creative suite programs


**The ideal candidate has:**
* A Bachelor’s degree (preferably from a design school) and 3\-5 years of design experience, developing and creating for digital / social strategies \+ campaigns, including client\-facing experience
* The ability to effectively collaborate with various teams, providing the most useful guidance in an enthusiastic and inspiring manner
* A sparkling personality that will mesh well with the existing VaynerMedia family
* A smile on their face the majority of the time
* An understanding of UI/UX, hands on with design (motion and static) and an interest in the big social media platforms and their abilities/limitations (design\-wise).
* Experience working with writers, developers and team focused creative process Mild to major illustration skills
* An obsession with sports, music, or food\-we love people who can bring their own interests into the mix


**What You Should Know About VaynerMedia**
 Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!
   

  

 Our environment (and pace) feels much more like a start\-up than most agencies you might be used to. Hopefully that, and the opportunity to collaborate with the talented and enthusiastic crew, work with big brands excites you, as it does us.
 **We can’t wait to meet you.**
 P.S Portfolio would be nice :)

title: CRO Lead
description:
**OneMetric \| Full\-time \| Gurgaon**
****The role in one line****
 This is not a "manage the website" role or a CRO role for its own sake — it's a lead\-generation role that uses the website as the primary lever. You own the website end to end — from a raw idea for a page to a shipped, converting landing page — against one defined outcome: 35–50 MQLs a month generated organically from the website and the motions around it.
   

  

****Why this role exists****
 Most people who "manage the website" either write copy and hand it to a designer, or build pages and wait for someone else to tell them what to put on them. We need someone who does both halves in one head: knows what a page needs to say because they've done the research and talked to customers, and knows why a page converts or doesn't because they think like a CRO person, not just a writer or a builder. The output is a live, working page — not a doc that someone else has to translate.
   

  

******What You'll Own******
* The website as a whole — structure, page inventory, and how it evolves as the company's positioning evolves.
* Idea → live page. You take a rough brief ("we need a page for X service" or "we're repositioning around Y") and turn it into a wireframe, then real copy, then a shipped page — working with a designer where needed, but driving the thing yourself.
* Conversion performance — what's converting, what isn't, and why. You run the experiments, not just report the numbers.
* Lead capture and funnel logic on\-site — forms, CTAs, gating, the path from a visitor landing on a page to becoming a lead in HubSpot.
* The lead number. 35–50 organic leads/month from the website and the motions around it (SEO, AEO, on\-site conversion, content) is your number. The page isn't done when it ships — it's done when it's producing.


****What you'll actually do, week to week****
* Talk to customers and internal stakeholders (sales, delivery, leadership) to figure out what a page actually needs to say to move a buyer — not guess at it from a template.
* Look at signals — search intent, competitor positioning, what prospects ask sales, what's converting elsewhere — and turn them into a point of view on what the page should be.
* Write the copy yourself. This isn't a hand\-off role — strong, clear, buyer\-facing writing is a core skill here, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Sketch wireframes and work directly with a designer (or design tools yourself) to get from idea to a real, live example fast.
* Build and manage pages in WordPress and HubSpot CMS.
* Use AI tools (Claude and others) and Figma as part of your everyday workflow — for research, drafting, quick mockups, and design iteration.
* Structure pages and content for both traditional SEO and AEO (answer engine optimization) — so the site shows up in Google and gets cited by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews.
* Track what's converting and what's not, and keep iterating rather than treating a page as "done" once it ships.


****What we need****
* A CRO brain. You should be able to look at a page and say, with reasons, why it will or won't convert — and know how to fix it. This means understanding funnels, lead capture mechanics, and what actually moves a B2B buyer to act.
* Strong writing, in service of strategy. You can write clean, persuasive copy, but more importantly you know what needs to be said and why, before you write a word.
* A founder/CMO\-level eye for B2B design. You don't need to be the designer, but you need the taste to know what good B2B design looks like and the ability to brief and push back on one.
* The ability to simplify. You can take a genuinely complex service or technical concept (a RevOps build, an AI GTM agent) and explain it in language a buyer actually understands.
* A working understanding of AEO and SEO. You know how to structure and write content so it ranks in search and gets picked up and cited by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) — this isn't optional anymore for a website role.
* Strong writing skills paired with AI fluency. You write well yourself, and you use AI tools to move fast — generating quick mockups, drafts, and iterations rather than waiting on a full design cycle for every idea.
* Comfort with the tools: WordPress, HubSpot CMS, Figma, and AI tools (Claude and similar) as part of daily work.
* Ownership instinct — you treat the website as yours, not as a queue of tickets from other teams.
* 4–5 years of experience working on websites/landing pages, ideally with direct exposure to conversion work, not just content or design in isolation.


****What's in it for you****
* Ownership, not a task list. We don't hand you a checklist and check boxes. Direction and context get discussed openly, and then the "how" — the wireframe, the copy, the page — is yours to run with.
* A performance\-driven culture. Speed and conversion results define your trajectory here, not tenure or face\-time. Ship fast, see what moves the numbers, and get rewarded for it.
* Access to the top of the market. The pages you build speak to CMOs, VPs of Sales, and founders across the B2B US market — real high\-stakes work, not busywork nobody reads.


****How we'll know this is working****
 Within a quarter: organic leads from the website and its motions are trending toward the 35–50/month range, pages you've shipped are outperforming what existed before on conversion, sales and leadership are coming to you first when a new page or repositioning is needed, and the website stops feeling like a static asset and starts feeling like something that's actively working for the business.
   

  

******Who You'll Work With******
 Reports into growth/marketing leadership at OneMetric, works closely with sales, delivery leads, and a designer (in\-house or external) to take ideas from brief to live page.
   

  

******Who You'll Work With******
 This role reports to the CEO’s office at OneMetric and works closely with sales and delivery leaders on HubSpot implementation, RevOps, and GTM projects.

A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around.
   

  

 At the heart of userization philosophy is ScreenSense, our proprietary AI engine, which continuously interprets both the context of what users are doing in an application or an AI tool and the intent behind their actions. By combining these signals, Whatfix delivers real\-time guidance, nudges, knowledge, and automation directly in the flow of work.
   

  

 This intelligence powers our entire product suite.
   

  

* Digital Adoption helps users get productive faster.
* Product Analytics uncovers friction and closes adoption gaps.

**About The Role**

 This role is both strategic and hands\-on, ideal for someone who thrives in a player\-coach capacity.  As a design leader, you can coach and support your teams to thrive in fast\-paced, hyper\-growth environments. You’ll have experience working with product and engineering leaders throughout the product development life\-cycle as you manage and support your design team.

title: Product Experience Lead
description:
AI can make a polished screen in seconds. Getting someone to trust an AI agent with their real work is much harder. That's the problem we're hiring for.
 



  





 At Tipstat, we build AI systems that run whole business workflows. Our two products are Ozyn.AI, a productivity assistant that works across Gmail, CRM, Calendar, Sheets and 50\+ other integrations, and Alvoff, an AI\-native B2B procurement platform. Our customers are mid\-market companies, many in regulated industries.
 



  





 You'll be our first dedicated product experience hire. You'll own how both products feel, from the first click to the hundredth workflow.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Talk to users every week, watch session recordings and dig into data to find the gap between what people say and what they actually do
* Design trust between people and AI agents: when an agent acts on its own and when it asks first, how it shows its work, and how users take back control
* Shape behavior, not just screens, using motivation, habit, cognitive load and deliberate friction
* Own the whole journey: onboarding, empty states, errors, notifications, emails and pricing
* Give our products a distinct feel instead of the generic SaaS look, and back your choices with evidence
* Tie design to activation, adoption of agent workflows and retention, and run experiments to learn what works and why
* Use Claude Design, Figma and code prototypes to explore quickly, then spend your time choosing and refining
* Work with founders and engineering to shape the roadmap
* Build our experience principles, design system and research practice



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 6\+ years in product design or UX, ideally in B2B SaaS or complex workflow tools
* Deep working knowledge of user psychology and behavioral design. You can explain why a design works, not just that it looks good
* Research skills you actually use: interviews, usability testing and product analytics
* Strong craft in interaction design, information architecture and visual design
* Clear writing. You treat microcopy as part of the design
* Comfort with ambiguity and with being the only designer in the room
* Hands\-on experience with AI design and prototyping tools



  





 Bonus points if you've designed AI or agent products, worked in a regulated industry, or can prototype in code.
 



  





 This role probably isn't for you if your best work is Dribbble shots rather than outcomes, or if you'd rather hand off mockups and move on.

description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
   

  

 Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next\-generation skills.
   

  

 People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Product Analyst II at HackerRank, you will own the end\-to\-end analytics for our products and platforms, working across AI\-powered experiences, developer\-facing products, content, community growth, or platform initiatives. This is not a BI reporting role — you will own and drive analytics initiatives end\-to\-end and act as a thought partner to Product, Engineering, Content, Design, and business stakeholders, helping answer not only "what happened?" but also "what should we build, improve, prioritize, or measure next?"
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own analytics for next\-generation product(s), platform, content, AI, community, or growth areas.
* Define and evolve metrics across adoption, engagement, retention, satisfaction, usability, usage quality, and customer value.
* Analyze customer and developer journeys, segments, and feature\-level behavior to identify opportunities and friction points.
* Evaluate the quality, effectiveness, and adoption of new content and AI\-powered product experiences.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Content, Design, and Marketing teams to define measurement plans and success criteria for new initiatives.
* Drive experimentation by framing hypotheses, sizing opportunities, designing experiments, interpreting results, and recommending next steps.
* Use AI agents as part of your daily analytics workflow, and analyze AI assistants/agentic workflows including usage, outcomes, cost, and usage\-based pricing.


**Who You Are**
* You have 3\-6 years of full\-time experience in product analytics, data science, growth analytics, consumer analytics, platform analytics, or a related field.
* You have advanced SQL skills and experience working with event, session, or clickstream\-level product data.
* You are comfortable using Python for analysis and working with large, imperfect, or text\-based datasets.
* You have a strong foundation in statistics, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, statistical significance, power analysis, sampling, regression, and causal inference.
* You understand funnels, cohort analysis, segmentation, retention, experimentation, and feature adoption.
* You can turn ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, clear recommendations, and measurable outcomes.


**Even better if you have**
* Familiarity with LLM product metrics, AI quality evaluation, or agent workflow analysis.
* Experience implementing or validating clickstream instrumentation; not only defining requirements for it.
* Experience measuring content quality, learning outcomes, developer workflows, or community engagement.
* Experience working with consumer tech, developer tools, learning platforms, marketplaces, or B2B SaaS products.


**You will thrive if you**
* You enjoy owning analytics initiatives end to end, from problem framing through impact measurement.
* You thrive in fast\-paced environments where priorities evolve based on feedback and insights.
* You have a strong bias for action, experimentation, and continuous improvement in ambiguous environments.
* You enjoy working across product areas and building context quickly.
* You are great at collaborating with multiple stakeholders.

 To learn more about our impact, we invite you to explore here.

 An Employee Value Proposition is the authentic promise of what employees experience every day.
 



 Over the next three months, you will partner closely with the Internal Communications team to conduct one of the most strategic talent initiatives at Amagi. You'll engage directly with some of our high performers and business leaders to uncover what truly makes Amagi unique.
 



 Your work will directly influence how Amagi attracts, develops, and retains talent across the globe.

-

 Qualitative research and organizational diagnostics
 



 Employer branding and EVP strategy
 



 Executive stakeholder management
 



 HR consulting and people analytics
 



 Strategic storytelling and presentation design
 



 If you're excited by the idea of discovering what makes an organization truly unique and helping shape its future talent story, we'd love to hear from you.

* Curious about organizational culture, employee experience, and employer branding.
* Comfortable speaking with senior stakeholders and employees across levels.
* An excellent listener with strong interviewing and facilitation skills.
* Highly analytical with the ability to synthesize qualitative data into clear themes.
* Exceptional at PowerPoint storytelling and presenting insights visually.
* Organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple conversations simultaneously.
* Proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Google Workspace.

 Amagi is an equal opportunity employer. Our culture is built around four values that show up in how we work every day.

 We always lead with integrity.

* **Think Macro, Do Micro.** 
 We dream big but execute with relentless precision.


-

You and your loved ones have access to comprehensive health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program, which covers mental health counselling, financial and legal guidance, and diet and nutrition support. Our office spaces are naturally lit and ventilated, with nutritious meals available every day. An on\-site gym and wellness rooms are available for you to rejuvenate.

**About Namma Yatri \& Bharat taxi** 




  





 Namma Yatri, built and operated by Moving Tech, is the tech and strategy partner for Bharat Taxi.  Bharat Taxi aims to be the Amul for Mobility \- a people\-ﬁrst, cooperative\-based taxi initiative backed by the Central Government Ministry of Cooperation that offers safe, affordable, and digniﬁed mobility at scale. It brings drivers together on a common platform so they can earn fairly while serving riders with trust and transparency.
 



  





 Together, Bharat Taxi and Namma Yatri are building a multi\-city, multi\-modal mobility network that serves Samaaj (society), Sarkar (government), and Bazaar (business), aligned with open digital public infrastructure.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a high\-ownership Growth Manager to drive growth, supply expansion,
 



 operational excellence, and conversion improvements across Karnataka.
 



  





 This role sits at the intersection of Ops, Product, Growth, and Analytics. The ideal candidate
 



 should be extremely strong with numbers, operational problem\-solving, and cross\-functional
 



 execution.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Supply\-Led Growth \& Marketplace Management** 




 ● Drive supply growth and marketplace efficiency across cities
 



 ● Own key supply metrics including active drivers, online hours, conversion, cancellations, utilisation, and subscription realisation
 



 ● Identify and solve demand\-supply gaps through structured interventions
 



  





**Conversion \& Funnel Optimisation** 




 ● Improve conversion metrics across search → booking → completed rides
 



 ● Work closely with Product teams to improve user journeys and reduce friction points
 



 ● Coordinate with Marketing teams on top\-of\-the\-funnel growth and conversion efficiency
 



  





**Data \& Experimentation** 




 ● Build dashboards, track cohorts, identify trends, and derive actionable insights
 



 ● Run structured experiments across pricing, supply, and engagement levers
 



  





**Operations \& Execution Excellence** 




 ● Build scalable operational playbooks and improve execution reliability
 



 ● Solve operational bottlenecks with speed and ownership
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  





 ● Strong problem solving and structured thinking
 



 ● Comfort with data \- dashboards, metrics, decision\-making from numbers
 



 ● Experience in product, program management, consulting, account management
 



 ● Experience working with tech and engineering teams
 



 ● Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
 



 ● High ownership, bias to action, and comfort with ambiguity
 



 ● Interest in impact, mobility, public good, and driver empowerment
 



 ● High on empathy and EQ to balance priorities of multiple stakeholders
 



  





**Bonus Points** 




 ● MBA from top tier B school
 



 ● Experience in mobility, community\-led initiatives, cooperatives, public transport, government programs, or platform businesses
 



 ● Experience launching or scaling products in new cities or regions

description:
**About Evolute Group \-**
**Evolute Group – One ecosystem. Infinite impact.**
 Evolute Group is a future\-ready Indian technology conglomerate built on the belief that technology, when led by the right intent, can create lasting impact at scale. Operating as an integrated ecosystem across Fintech, Digital Identity Embedded Solutions, Electronic Manufacturing, and Industrial Electronics, Evolute brings together deep engineering, indigenous innovation, and manufacturing excellence to deliver mission\-critical solutions in India and global markets.
   

  

 Guided by its vision of Techpowering the World®, Evolute enables leaders and teams to move ideas seamlessly from concept to deployment, combining speed, ownership, and accountability. The Group’s culture values hands\-on leadership, clarity of execution, and long\-term thinking, empowering individuals to build businesses—not just manage functions.
   

  

 Evolute Fintech Innovations plays a pivotal role in India’s financial inclusion and e\-Governance journey, delivering Digital Identity Solutions, Aadhaar\-certified biometric devices, micro\-ATMs, Android POS systems, secure device management platforms, and geo\-location security solutions. With over 500,000 devices deployed, teams work close to real\-world impact—where trust, uptime, and scale matter every day.
   

  

 Evolute’s Electronic Manufacturing arm, Evolute Cleantech Solutions promoting ”Evoflex”, redefines EMS Repair and Refurbishment, through a modular, flexible “buy\-what\-you\-need” model, enabling faster innovation cycles and operational resilience.
   

  

 Glomore Electro\-Tech Solutions an Industrial Electronics Components business, built on a 40\+ year legacy, continues to support thousands of MSMEs, OEMs and ODMs with reliable, application\-led solutions including its renowned brand of relays ‘Leone’;
   

  

 SpiritusPay is building a B2C transaction platform to enable last\-mile transaction renewal solutions.
   

  

 Backed by globally recognized certifications including ISO 9000/27001/30414, STQC,MOSIP, PCI/PTS, EMV,TQM (Mastercard),DSIR GPTW recognition, Evolute is entering a phase of disciplined, innovation\-led growth.
   

  

 Evolute offers the opportunity to shape industries, build enduring capabilities, and lead with purpose—while creating measurable impact across industries and markets.

* Strategic responsibilities: –
* Conduct primary and secondary research; generate and qualify market analytics/research drive the execution of all product lifecycle processes for products, including product research, market research, competitive analysis, planning, positioning, roadmap development, requirements development, and product launch with GTM
