**Fiche De Poste**
**Product Analyst – Job Description**
**Job Summary**
 The Business Analyst cum Product Analyst analyzes business systems, processes, and data to engineer solutions that enhance business capabilities and operational efficiency. As a core member of the product team, this role translates business workflows into clear technical requirements, specifications, and acceptance criteria. The analyst also functions as a proxy product owner and subject matter expert, collaborating closely with business stakeholders and technical teams. A strong foundation in requirements engineering, process modeling, Agile practices, and data analysis is essential.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Requirements \& Product Analysis**
* Translate business processes, goals, and terminology into technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Act as a proxy product owner for designated business domains, offering functional expertise and guidance.
* Collaborate with product owners, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to analyze, document, and refine product requirements.
* Manage and prioritize product backlog items in Azure DevOps based on business value, dependencies, and stakeholder inputs.
* Prepare communications, presentations, and documentation on system enhancements, alternatives, and recommended solutions.


**Process \& Data Analysis**
* Analyze business workflows to identify opportunities for process improvement, efficiency gains, and automation.
* Validate, interpret, and analyze data from Mainframe environments, DB2 databases, and SQL queries to support decision\-making.
* Contribute to building business cases by gathering data, identifying issues, and documenting components under senior guidance.


**Agile Delivery \& Project Support**
* Support Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Develop schedules of tasks based on overarching project timelines and keep stakeholders informed on progress.
* Participate in system testing, UAT, and production validation to ensure solution accuracy and quality.
* Work independently on projects of low to moderate complexity and with minimal supervision on more complex initiatives.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Build, maintain, and enhance strong relationships with business partners through active listening, consistent communication, and accountability.
* Understand stakeholder needs and expectations to deliver clear, value\-driven solutions.
* Demonstrate trust, influence, and adaptability to meet evolving business requirements.


**Reporting \& Documentation**
* Create business and functional requirement documents, process flows, guidelines, and technical communication materials.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and metrics using Microsoft Office tools to track product performance and project progress.
* Seek relevant information to ensure clarity and accuracy of technical communication tailored to different audience groups.


**Continuous Improvement \& Strategy Execution**
* Apply an understanding of financial, ROI, and market principles to support strategy development.
* Identify inefficiencies within work processes and apply innovative ideas or established tools to improve outcomes.
* Continuously pursue opportunities for system, workflow, and product improvements.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Proven experience as a Product Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role (5–8 years preferred).
* Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps for managing requirements and product backlogs.
* Experience with Mainframe systems, DB2 databases, SQL, and data validation.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/SAFe) and cross\-functional team collaboration.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio).
* Exposure to PL/SQL, EDI Mapping, enterprise integration, and data flows across legacy and modern platforms.
* Core competencies: requirements elicitation, process modeling, workshop facilitation, and analytical thinking.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong stakeholder management ability.
* High attention to detail, strong organizational and time\-management skills, and a problem\-solving mindset.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* Combination of university education and hands\-on business/domain experience is valued

title: Product Mgr II
description:
**Are you passionate about shaping products that solve real customer problems and create meaningful business impact?**
**Do you enjoy collaborating with cross\-functional teams to bring innovative product features from concept to delivery?**
**About Our Team**
 RX Global aims to create unforgettable experiences for attendees and exhibitors through organizing events. Innovation, creativity, and collaboration drive the company to offer exceptional services to clients.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Product Manager II will own one or more product features and lead project execution. You will develop and manage product development plans, represent your feature area within a cross\-functional team, and drive solutions that address customer needs through a deep understanding of customer pain points. You will also prioritize customer issues and defects, support timely resolution, and demonstrate product progress and outcomes to key stakeholders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own one or more product features and drive product execution from concept through delivery.
* Develop and maintain product development plans aligned to customer needs and business objectives.
* Represent assigned features within cross\-functional teams and collaborate with engineering, design, and business stakeholders.
* Identify and propose new feature ideas that address customer pain points and opportunities.
* Prioritize customer issues and product defects using relevant data and customer insights.
* Support timely resolution of production issues and communicate priorities effectively.
* Lead product demonstrations for key stakeholders at program milestones.
* Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of digital and back\-office platforms supporting Sales, Marketing, and Finance functions.


**Requirements**
* Experience managing product features or products throughout the product lifecycle.
* Ability to translate customer needs into product requirements and feature enhancements.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience prioritizing work using customer feedback, data, and business objectives.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, including delivering product demonstrations.
* Analytical problem\-solving skills and a customer\-focused mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Strong collaboration skills with technical and non\-technical teams.


**Work in a Way That Works for You**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.
   

  

**Working Pattern**
 Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.
   

  

**Working for You**
**Benefits**
 We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work\-life balance
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges
* Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support
* Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays


**About The Business**
 RX is a global leader in events and exhibitions, leveraging industry expertise, data, and technology to build businesses for individuals, communities, and organizations. With a presence in 25 countries across 41 industry sectors, RX hosts approximately 350 events annually. RX is committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all our people. RX empowers businesses to thrive by leveraging data\-driven insights and digital solutions. RX is part of RELX, a global provider of information\-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. For more information, visit http://www.rxglobal.com

title: Risk Analytics - Product Analyst - Senior
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \- Delivery Excellence Senior position**
 Within last decade, cost of delivery and Delivery excellence has become the most critical factors to run successful and popular businesses spread around the globe. To support such a dynamic and fast paced IT transformation industry, we are using various cutting\-edge Delivery Excellence models and tools with relentless focus on automation to offer best in class and tailor\-made solutions to our clients.
   

  

 As a part of our global team you will be part of GDS projects as Delivery Excellence management professional. You will be involved in working on challenging problems and creating next generation delivery excellence platforms.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Are you a detail driven professional with a passion for translating business needs into impactful product experiences? Do you thrive at the intersection of people, process, and technology? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our Product team and help shape solutions that deliver real value to our clients and users.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll serve as a critical bridge between the business stakeholders and the development and engineering teams. Your work will influence how ideas become features, how features become products, and how products deliver meaningful outcomes in a fast paced, evolving environment.
   

  

 As a key member of the Product team, you will play a hands on role in defining business requirements, crafting user stories, and ensuring that technical execution aligns seamlessly with business objectives. You will lead user acceptance testing (UAT), drive iterative testing cycles, validate enhancements, and ensure that issues or defects are accurately identified, tracked, and resolved. Your keen eye for detail and strong communication skills will help ensure that every release meets the highest standards of quality and functionality.
   

  

 This is a client facing and user centric role where you will engage with stakeholders, address queries, clarify requirements, and ensure that feedback is incorporated into continuous product improvements. You’ll gain a deep understanding of real world user behaviors, business processes, and product journeys—making this the perfect place to grow as a product focused business professional while driving meaningful impact across the product lifecycle.
   

  

 If you’re energized by the opportunity to influence product development end to end, collaborate with cross functional teams, and help bring scalable, user friendly solutions to life, this role provides the platform for you to make a lasting difference.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, ensuring alignment across stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by testing the defined test cases, validating functionality, and ensuring readiness for release.
* Support in iterative testing cycles, identifying defects, documenting issues, validating fixes, and performing regression testing as needed.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Serve as one of the primary liaison between business teams and engineering, providing clarifications, resolving requirement gaps, and ensuring shared understanding throughout the product lifecycle.
* Review and validate bug fixes, ensuring that resolved issues meet expected outcomes before closure.
* Engage with clients and end users, addressing queries, troubleshooting issues, and gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
* Support product rollout activities, including release planning, communication, and training support where required.
* Monitor product performance post release, identify enhancement opportunities, and contribute to backlog prioritization.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation including requirement specifications, UAT plans, test results, and user feedback logs.
* Support product strategy, roadmap planning, and end\-to\-end product lifecycle management for Internal Controls and Audit solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders across business, risk, audit, and technology teams to gather requirements and drive product adoption.
* Own MIS, reporting, KPI tracking, and executive dashboards to measure product performance and business outcomes.
* Analyse large datasets to derive insights, identify control gaps, and support decision\-making.
* Drive product implementation, rollout, user onboarding, and change management initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define functional requirements and prioritise product backlogs.
* Identify automation and AI opportunities to enhance audit and internal control processes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Risk Assessment – Assessment of internal processes to identify findings, vulnerabilities, and control gaps/deviations identified across applications and infrastructure.
* Control Monitoring / Testing \- Understanding of controls around Business processes, ITGC, Cyber, Data protection and privacy to perform testing of design and operational effectiveness of controls.
* Ability to create process documentation.
* Ability to understand business problems in Risk/Finance and contribute to translating them into solution or product requirements.
* Exposure (through projects or roles) to Risk, Finance, Supply Chain Operations (SCO), or related business functions preferred.
* Demonstrates interest in AI/analytics\-driven Risk solutions and their business applications.
* Agentic AI architecture\- Design agentic AI system architectures and define associated technical guardrails.
* Functional understanding of foundation models (LLMs) and associated risks. Awareness of the AI deployment lifecycle
* Control Automation – Identify automation opportunities using analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
* Basic exposure to Presales, solutioning, proposal support, or client presentations is a plus.
* Interest in working in tech\-enabled or AI\-led Risk products/solutions environment.
* Ability to support senior team members in product development, go\-to\-market efforts, and client engagements.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, global delivery environment with distributed teams.
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.
* Open to hiring across locations, aligned with EY’s Global Delivery Services (GDS) model.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Overall 3\-6 years of experience in Risk Advisory (preferably Internal Controls) experience with Big 4 or comparable professional services environment
* CA or Master’s degree in Business Administration or Risk management
* Good to have certifications – CISA, CISM, CIA, AIGP, ISO 42001, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant)
* Any 1 hard tech skill is a must – Either Python or Databricks Or full stack or AI
* Product Management experience with demonstrated ownership of delivering business solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Experience in reporting, MIS, analytics, and data\-driven decision making.
* Hands\-on experience in product implementation and deployment.
* Domain expertise in Internal Controls, Risk, Compliance, or Audit (mandatory).


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 250\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Working knowledge of SDLC, Agile/Scrum framework, sprint planning, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, product testing, release support, and post\-launch support.

title: Product Analyst
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a Product Analyst with a background in technology, or a related field. In this role, you will communicate with team members and business partners on a regular basis. The Business Analyst will analyze our requirements and design solutions to meet those requirements. You will also be responsible for testing, implementing, and maintaining software applications to improve business processes.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Elicits, analyzes, specifies, and validates the business needs of stakeholders, be they customers or end users.
* Collaborates with project sponsors to determine project scope and vision.
* Conducts interviews to gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Identifies and establishes scope and parameters of requirements analysis on a project\-by\-project basis to define project impact, outcome criteria, and metrics.
* Works with stakeholders and project team to prioritize collected requirements.
* Researches, reviews, and analyses the effectiveness of existing requirements\-gathering processes and develop strategies for enhancing or further applying these processes.
* Helps conduct research on products to meet agreed upon requirements and to support purchasing efforts.
* Participates in the QA of solutions to ensure features and functions have been enabled and optimized.
* Participates in the selection of any requirements documentation software solutions that the organization may opt to use.
* Analyzes and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.
* Develops and utilizes standard templates to accurately and concisely write requirements specifications.
* Translates conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is comprehensible to developers/project team.
* Creates process models, specifications, diagrams, and charts to provide direction to developers and/or the project team.
* Develops and conduct peer reviews of the business requirements to ensure that requirement specifications are correctly interpreted.
* Assists with the interpretation of customer requirements into feasible options, and communicating these back to the business stakeholders.
* Manages and tracks the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine as necessary.
* Communicates changes, enhancements, and modifications of business requirements — verbally or through written documentation — to project managers, sponsors, and other stakeholders so that issues and solutions are understood.
* You will report to manager \- IT


**The Essentials \- You Will Have**
 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience
   

  

 Typically requires 8 years of related experience (project Management, Process Improvement and data management experience)
   

  

 Communicate the plan and priorities for the Program Increment and define the PI goals
   

  

 Drive release behavior, incenting discipline and quality over speed
   

  

 Determine resource requirements and partner with Tech Lead or Business Owner on sourcing talent
   

  

 Integrates change management elements needed to support the desired state;
   

  

 Track key delivery issues and risks and escalating as needed.
   

  

 Accountable for validation of acceptance criteria met before accepting completed features and definition of done
   

  

 Overall responsibility to manage the Epic and Feature backlogs and Themes for measuring to key objectives, value delivery.
   

  

 Collaborate and shape design, development and implementation requirements with partners and engineering team members.
   

  

 Be responsible for training and support documentation, as well as business readiness \& service transition
   

  

 Provides consultative support in financial management, organizational change, vendor management, and operational excellence to business lead technology initiatives and to our business or enterprise shared services teams
   

  

 Provide analysis on key business drivers and metrics using the latest analytics \& visualization technology.
   

  

 Define the needed business cases with project team and process owner, defining business outcomes, including current baseline and future target metrics, such as leading and lagging indicators, and linking to strategic key performance indicators (KPIs).
   

  

 Proven experience with business and technical requirements analysis, elicitation, modeling, verification, and methodology development
   

  

 Demonstrated project management skills and project management software skills, including planning and organizing
   

  

 You will report toTeam Lead \-IT
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Our benefits package includes …
   

  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!


*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
 or
   

  

 Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Sr Principal, Primary Insights
description:
**About the Role:**
 Gartner seeks a Senior Principal for the Primary Insights Solutions (PIS) team within the Customer and Market Intelligence (CMI) group. This individual contributor role focuses on B2B primary research to generate actionable insights for and about C\-level executives across industries. You will lead primary research projects, collaborating with stakeholders to deliver impactful findings on a range of IT and business topics. The role offers opportunities to apply statistical and AI\-driven research methods.
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
 This position is for experienced researchers interested in leading B2B primary research, particularly surveys, to create impactful new insights for Gartner clients and internal stakeholders.
   

  

* Lead primary research projects to inform research and symposium content development.
* Conduct all stages of primary research including scoping, design, execution, analysis, and presentation of results.
* Design and recommend research approaches to validate hypotheses and deliver actionable insights.
* Manage large\-scale quantitative research projects, including complex sampling and advanced statistical analyses (e.g., regressions, factor analysis, MaxDiff).
* Create data\-driven research narratives and present findings to internal stakeholders.
* Promote best practices in research design, execution, and delivery.
* Collaborate with Gartner Analysts as primary internal stakeholders.


**What You’ll Need:**
**Professional Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., statistics, business, marketing, psychology, data analytics); Master’s preferred.
* At least 8 years’ experience in research, insights, or analytics roles focused on primary research.


**Technical Skills And Competencies**
* Strong knowledge of research methods, including surveys and executive interviews.
* Proven ability to lead quantitative studies from design to presentation.
* Experience with sampling, survey design, and data management.
* Strong foundational knowledge and practical experience in running statistical analysis (regressions, clustering, etc.).
* Proficiency in a statistical software package (e.g., SPSS, R, Q).
* Practical understanding of survey platforms and capabilities (e.g., Qualtrics, Confirmit, Decipher).
* Ability to manage multiple, data\-intensive projects independently.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for engaging with senior stakeholders.
* Creative, independent thinker with strong problem\-solving skills.
* Able to collaborate with global, diverse teams.


**What you will get:**
* Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, Group Medical Insurance, Parental Leave, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and more!
* Collaborative, team\-oriented culture that embraces diversity
* Professional development and unlimited growth opportunities


**Who are we?**

 **.**
**Job Title: Senior Analyst \- Social listening \& Consumer Insights
   

  

 Location: Bangalore
   

  

 Reporting to: Manager \- Digital Marketing**
* PURPOSE OF ROLE:


 We are seeking a skilled and analytical Social Listening Analyst to design, execute, and deliver custom social listening reports that inform strategic decision\-making across the organization. The role involves engaging with stakeholders to gather business requirements and translating them into structured, platform\-specific queries that monitor social conversations around internal brands, competitors, products, marketing campaigns, and key events.
   

  

 The Analyst will be responsible for conducting in\-depth analysis of unstructured social media data, identifying key themes and sentiment drivers, and synthesizing findings into concise, insight\-driven narratives. The ability to differentiate meaningful signals from noise and communicate insights in a business\-relevant context is critical.
   

  

 This role requires a high degree of independence, as assignments may lack predefined templates or processes. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong problem\-solving capabilities, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to manage cross\-functional collaboration effectively. Additionally, the role includes working with multilingual content, requiring the Analyst to derive culturally contextualized insights from non\-English sources.
   

  

* KEY TASKS AND ACCOUNTABILITIES
* Consult with stakeholders to define social listening topics, metrics, and filtering criteria aligned to business objectives across standard, ad\-hoc, and industry reports.
* Design and implement social listening setups, including query parameters, keyword configurations, and dashboard creation across approved tools.
* Pull, interpret, and analyze data from social listening platforms to assess volume, sentiment, conversation drivers, influencer activity, and emerging trends.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams \- including Marketing Insights, Marketing, and Brand teams \- to integrate social media insights into broader research initiatives and campaigns.
* Champion a holistic, consumer\-centric view \- connecting the dots between what consumers say, how they engage, and what influences their perceptions and behaviors.
* Present insights and recommendations in a clear, structured manner to inform strategic and tactical decision\-making.
* Create and edit reporting deliverables in PowerPoint, Excel, and newsletter formats that effectively transform social data into actionable narratives.
* Visualize findings through charts, tables, and infographics to clearly communicate insights to diverse stakeholder groups.
* Maintain a recurring and ad\-hoc reporting calendar, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of outputs.
* Demonstrate high attention to detail and data accuracy in all reports, with strong written communication and data storytelling skills.
* Proactively refine and optimize social listening queries to ensure data relevance, minimize noise, and enhance the quality of insights.
* Monitor and share industry best practices and case studies to support capability building within the insights function.
* Adhere to global social listening collaboration protocols, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and processes.
* Apply a blend of technical proficiency, business acumen, and interpersonal skills to interpret data and influence key stakeholders.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high quality and consistency across deliverables.
* Contribute to identifying earned consumer engagement patterns, as well as analyzing campaign\-related performance across platforms.
* QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS
* 2 \- 4 years of experience in social listening, consumer insights or social media marketing roles.
* Proven experience with social listening and analytics platforms such as Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Cision, Emplifi, or equivalent tools.
* Experience in Consumer Insights tools such as GWI, CreatorIQ, MeltWater or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of social media platforms and ecosystems, including Facebook, Instagram, X (formerly Twitter), YouTube, blogs, forums, and emerging channels.
* Demonstrated analytical skills with experience in data gathering, interpretation, and the development of actionable, insight\-driven recommendations.
* Experience building Boolean queries and refining search logic for accuracy and relevance.
* Basic understanding of sentiment analysis and natural language processing.
* Ability to identify emerging trends within the beverage industry and broader social media landscape; culturally aware and informed on global digital conversations.
* Skilled at distilling complex datasets into clear, concise, and business\-relevant insights.
* Strong multitasking and time management abilities with a consistent track record of delivering high\-quality outputs under tight deadlines.
* Naturally curious and detail\-oriented, with a deep interest in uncovering the “why” behind social trends and behavioral shifts.
* Self\-starter with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently present findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a cross\-functional, fast\-paced environment.


**Mandatory Skills:** 
 Digital Marketing, Social Listening, Expertise in PPT and Advanced Excel
   

  

**Preferred Skills:** 
 Power BI, Stakeholder Management
   

  

*And above all of this, an undying love for beer!
   

  

 We dream big to create future with more cheers.*

title: Associate - Medical Writing
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
   

  

**Purpose**
 Scientific data and information are core assets of Lilly. Providing balanced, objective, and accurate information to regulators, the scientific community, health care professionals, payers, and patients in a consistent and timely fashion across the entire drug development lifecycle is fundamental to Lilly.
   

  

 The purpose of the Associate, GSC Regulatory role is to work with cross\-functional, multidisciplinary teams to lead the development of documents intended for regulatory audiences (including, but not limited to, protocols, clinical study reports, briefing documents, regulatory responses, Investigational New Drug Applications, and marketing authorization applications).
   

  

 Primary Responsibilities: This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the job requirements at the time it was prepared. The job requirements of any position may change over time and may include additional responsibilities not specifically described in the job description. Consult with your supervision regarding your actual job responsibilities and any related duties that may be required for the position.
   

  

* Content Strategy and Execution: Document Preparation, Development and Finalization/Document Management
* Effectively collect and evaluate data, information, and input from multiple sources, functions, and regions to create a cohesive content strategy for writing projects.
* Plan (including organizing/preparing outlines), write (including first\-draft authoring), edit, review, coordinate, and complete the regulatory documents supporting clinical development/product registration.
* Conduct effective document initiation meeting to ensure authoring team alignment and understanding.
* Build scientific\-based rationale that support the purpose of more complex and/or strategic documents.
* Ensure data are presented in a clear, complete, accurate, and concise manner.
* Ensure that key data, statements and conclusions are consistent across related documents, and that statements and conclusions are integrated, accurate, balanced and supported by appropriate data.
* Coordinate expert/scientific reviews, collate reviewer’s comments, adjust content of document as required based on internal/external input, and prepare final version.
* Ensure and coordinate quality checks for accuracy.
* Exhibit flexibility in moving across development and preparation of multiple document types.
* Influence or negotiate change of timelines and content with other team members.
* Work with internal and external experts to develop and prepare presentations.
* As needed, may build and manage relationships with vendors/alliance partners.
* Project and Stakeholder management
* Lead the writing process and apply effective project management skills to ensure timely completion of high\-quality regulatory documents.
* Build/communicate credible writing project timelines.
* Anticipate and mitigate risks to delivery.
* Work with teams and stakeholders to ensure smooth and timely development of documents and escalate issues, as appropriate, to ensure document completion.
* Effectively communicate project status to stakeholders.
* Knowledge and Skills Development
* Maintain and enhance therapeutic area knowledge including disease state and compound(s) for assigned project(s).
* Exhibit flexibility in moving across document types, therapeutic areas, and compounds, depending on project assignment.
* Maintain and enhance knowledge of regulatory guidelines and publication guidelines.
* Possess overarching view of compound, therapeutic area, and external environment (including competitors) with ability to participate effectively in clinical planning, submission strategy planning, customer regulatory responses, and/or current awareness literature updates and reviews.
* Maintain and enhance the scientific communications skills to align with the audience needs and with the changes in technology and platforms.
* Knowledge Sharing
* Provide coaching to others by sharing technical information, giving guidance, answering questions.
* Recognized for technical expertise in specific document development.
* Network with others (including other functions and regions) to identify and share best practices.
* Contribute to process improvements, suggesting opportunities where appropriate.
* Provide database and other tool (e.g., document management systems) expertise.


**Minimum Qualification Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, health, communications, technology health related field.
* Demonstrated experience in technical/ regulatory scientific writing.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Successful completion of writing exercise (a writing exercise is required as part of the candidate evaluation process)


**Other Information/Additional Preferences**
* Graduate degree with formal research component or in life sciences.
* Demonstrated mastery of verbal and written English skills in the medical, scientific or technical writing fields.
* Clinical pharmacology, therapeutic area, or other medical and scientific specific knowledge and experience specific to hiring area (e.g., neuroscience, oncology, cardiovascular, immunology or endocrine expertise).
* Experience writing regulatory, clinical trial documents and/or publications
* Experience in clinical development, clinical trial process or regulatory activities.
* Demonstrated project management and time management skills.
* Demonstrated high\-level end\-user computer skills (e.g., word processing, tables and graphics, spreadsheets, presentation and templates).

title: Content Manager – GHR Service Center
description:
**What Are We Looking For**
 We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Content Manager to join our GHR Service Center team. This role will be responsible for managing and optimizing employee\-facing and support\-facing content, ensuring it aligns with GHR objectives, content standards and governance policies.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have a strong background in content administration, creative writing, platform management, and stakeholder collaboration. You will play a key role in building and supporting content expansion in HR, managing BAU (Business as Usual) activities, and leveraging/managing AI tools/applications to enhance content delivery and employee experience.
   

  

**Why This Role Is Important To Us**
 The team you will be joining plays a key role in the overall success of the Talent organization. Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. In your role you will strive for cutting\-edge solutions, which are straightforward and scalable. You will help the Talent Org build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best.
   

  

 Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
**Content Administration \& Governance**
* Develop and maintain content standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks to ensure consistency and compliance across all HR content.
* Manage the document lifecycle, including creation, review, approval, publishing, archiving and retirement of content.
* Ensuring all content meets State Street’s legal, regulatory, organizational standards, particularly in a highly regulated financial services environment.


**Professional Writing \& Content Development**
* Create, edit and optimize employee\-facing and support\-facing content, including FAQs, knowledge base articles, documents, newsletters, chatbot scripts and HR communications.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate complex HR policies, benefits and processes into clear, engaging and user\-friendly content for global audience.
* Support content expansion initiatives by identifying gaps and opportunities for new content creation particularly in areas like pay, time, benefits, talent, learning, and supporting all State Street center of excellence owned/managed content.


**Platform Management \& AI Tools**
* Manage and optimize content platforms including HR portals, knowledge bases, and chatbots ensuring a seamless experience for employees and HR support teams
* Oversee the implementation and maintenance of AI tools content management, ensuring they are leveraged effectively to improve content delivery and user experience.
* Monitor and maintain chatbot functionality, including content updates, performance tracking, and integration of user feedback.


**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Vendor Management**
* Work closely with HR stakeholders across State Street’s Global operations to understand content needs and deliver solutions that align with HR strategies.
* Manage relationships with external vendors, ensuring high\-quality content delivery and adherence to SLAs.

**BAU \& Reporting**
* Manage BAU activities related to content creation, publishing, maintenance, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of HR content
* Monitor content performance and user feedback, generate regular reports to inform content improvements and demonstrate ROI(Return on Investment)
* Implement feedback loops to continuously enhance content quality, relevance and user satisfaction.


**Content Publishing \& Maintenance**
* Oversee the publishing process, ensuring content is delivered on time and meets State Street’s quality and compliance standards.
* Conduct regular content audits to ensure accuracy, relevance and alignment with HR objectives and global policies.
* Manage content updates and revisions to HR policy changes, user feedback and organizational needs.


**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in communications, Journalism, Human resources or related fields.
* 7\+ years of experience in content management, preferably within HR or employee or customer facing environment.
* 5\+ years in HR content management and content writing
* Strong writing, editing, and proof\-reading skills, with the ability create clear and engaging content for global audience
* Experience managing content platforms, including knowledge bases, HR portals and chatbot.
* Familiarity with AI tools and their application in content management
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with experience working in global or multi\-regional organization.
* Knowledge of content governance, document management lifecycle, and content standards
* Proficiency in content management systems (CMS), Microsoft office Suite, and collaboration tools (e.g. SharePoint, Trello, etc.)
* Outstanding written English Skills
* Excellent communication, organization and time management skills
* Strong skills in creating original content that targets a specific audience and meets company objective
* Strong attention to detail and consistency
* Prepared to work on multiple projects simultaneously
* Comfortable working with colleagues from diverse backgrounds


**What We Value**
* Experience working in a global environment
* Familiarity with HR policies, processes and requirements
* Verifiable experience with MS office 365, SharePoint, Adobe Creative Suite
* Knowledge of HTML and online publishing Agile in an evolving and demanding environment
* Network with our stakeholders to strengthen working relationships and encourage collaboration
* Experienced managing a large, global repository
* Knowledge of chatbot management and optimization
* Understanding of UX principles and their application to content design
* Proactive, critical thinker who is able to provide content solutions to the SME whilst aligning to polices, governance and risk excellence at the forefront

title: Lead II - Creative Design
description:
**Role Description**
 The Sr. Communications Lead develops and drives the communications strategy for IT \& Engineering (ITES), ensuring leaders, colleagues, and key stakeholders receive clear, consistent, timely, and business\-relevant communications. The role shapes how ITES priorities, decisions, accomplishments, and strategic initiatives are communicated across a global organization. This is a senior communications role with both strategic and hands\-on accountability. 6\-10 years The Sr. Communications Lead sets communications standards and messaging frameworks, serves as a trusted advisor to leadership, and directly leads high\-visibility communications where senior ownership is required. The role works closely with ITES leadership, Corporate Communications, Human Resources, and business and functional partners to align messaging, sequencing, audiences, and channels. Key Responsibilities Communications Strategy \& Planning
   

  

* Own and continuously evolve the ITES communications strategy in alignment with ITES priorities and enterprise communications standards.
* Develop integrated annual and quarterly communications plans that connect leadership priorities, major initiatives, organizational updates, and key milestones.
* Define audience, message, channel, timing, and cadence for communications so stakeholders receive the right level of information at the right time.
* Translate complex technology, business, and organizational topics into clear narratives that explain what matters, why it matters, and what stakeholders need to know or do.
* Anticipate communications needs and advise leaders on sequencing, stakeholder impact, message risk, and the most effective communications approach. Executive \& Leadership Communications
* Serve as a senior communications advisor to ITES leaders, providing counsel on messaging for high\-visibility, sensitive, or complex topics.
* Develop executive communications including key messages, leadership updates, talking points, presentations, announcements, Q\&A materials, town hall content, and follow\-through summaries.
* Ensure leadership messages are consistent across functions and geographies while allowing appropriate tailoring for different audiences.
* Support leaders in communicating strategic priorities, decisions, organizational updates, business outcomes, and expectations with clarity and credibility.
* Prepare leaders for major communications moments by identifying likely stakeholder questions, areas of concern, and required follow\-up. Strategic \& Enterprise Communications
* Lead communications for major ITES priorities and strategic initiatives, including digital, data, AI, innovation, operational excellence, and capability\-building efforts.
* Develop communications that make technical initiatives relevant to the business by connecting them to customer, colleague, operational, financial, or strategic outcomes.
* Coordinate communications across global IT teams and Centers of Excellence to maintain a coherent ITES narrative and reduce conflicting or duplicate messaging.
* Develop communications that recognize accomplishments, reinforce strategic focus areas, and improve visibility of ITES contributions and business value. Channels, Content \& Communications Governance
* Define and maintain communications standards, templates, editorial guidance, and reusable tools that improve quality and consistency across ITES.
* Manage the integrated communications calendar and coordinate content across channels including email, Teams, intranet, newsletters, town halls, leadership forums, presentations, and other internal channels.
* Establish appropriate review and approval processes for high\-impact communications while keeping routine communications efficient and timely.
* Partner with Corporate Communications to align ITES content with enterprise brand, editorial standards, and enterprise\-wide channels where applicable.
* Maintain message discipline and content accuracy, challenging unclear, inconsistent, unsupported, or unnecessarily complex communications before release. Stakeholder Partnership \& Communications Enablement
* Build strong working relationships with ITES leadership, Corporate Communications, Human Resources, business partners, functional teams, and subject\-matter experts.
* Coach leaders and content owners on audience\-focused writing, message clarity, presentation structure, and effective use of communications channels.
* Create practical guidance and self\-service resources that allow teams to communicate routine updates consistently without creating unnecessary central dependency.
* Coordinate message timing across stakeholders so major communications are sequenced appropriately and do not compete with or contradict one another. Measurement \& Continuous Improvement
* Define practical measures for communications effectiveness, including reach, engagement, understanding, timeliness, and stakeholder feedback.
* Use channel data, stakeholder feedback, and recurring themes to identify communication gaps and improve messaging, formats, cadence, and channel selection.
* Periodically review the effectiveness of the ITES communications approach and recommend changes based on business needs, leadership priorities, and audience behavior. Experience \& Capabilities
* Demonstrated experience developing and leading communications strategy in a complex, global, matrixed organization.
* Exceptional executive writing and editing skills, with the ability to simplify complex information without losing accuracy or intent.
* Strong executive presence and judgment, including the ability to advise senior leaders and handle sensitive information appropriately.
* Experience developing multi\-channel internal communications and coordinating communications across geographically dispersed teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to align multiple contributors around a clear narrative and communications plan.
* Ability to move comfortably between strategy and execution, from shaping the communications approach to personally developing high\-priority content.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technology and organizational priorities to business\-relevant outcomes.
* Experience working in a regulated, life sciences, healthcare, technology, or similarly complex environment is preferred. Success Measures
* ITES priorities, decisions, and strategic initiatives are communicated clearly, consistently, and at the appropriate time.
* Leadership communications are concise, aligned, audience\-appropriate, and ready for use with minimal rework.
* Stakeholders demonstrate improved understanding of key ITES priorities, initiatives, and business outcomes.
* Communications channels are used intentionally, with measurable reach and engagement and reduced duplication of messages.
* High\-impact communications are anticipated and planned rather than developed reactively.
* Leadership and stakeholder feedback indicates that ITES communications are credible, useful, and business\-relevant.

title: Founder's Office - Generalist
description:
12 of the top 15 pharma generic companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.
 



 Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.
 



 Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top\-tier global investors, 60\+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Tackle founder\-level problems. Dive into ambiguous questions (e.g., "How do we cut customer onboarding time by 40%?") and deliver a data\-backed solution—process, product spec, or growth playbook
* Shadow → Own. Start by shadowing founders and executives across GTM, Product, and Operations, and quickly take ownership of initiatives with significant revenue, customer, or cost impact
* Be the connective tissue. Translate hard manufacturing realities from shop\-floor SMEs into crisp product requirements; then turn those into value propositions sales can run with
* Scale what works. Systematize every win—dashboards, SOPs, automations—so the next team member can sprint from day 1
* Rinse, learn, repeat. Each quarter you'll rotate (sales → CS → product → biz ops), compounding domain depth while keeping a 10,000\-foot strategic view



  





**You Might Thrive Here If You** 



* Love messy problems. You run towards the smoke, disassemble chaos into first\-principles, then rebuild in clean layers of logic \& data
* Play in spreadsheets \& slides with equal joy. Google Sheets in the morning; crisp narrative memo by lunch; client demo at 4 PM
* Have a bias for action. You'd rather ship v0\.1 today and iterate than debate v2\.0 for weeks
* Communicate like an engineer and a poet. Precision when the stakes are technical; story when hearts \& budgets are on the line
* Are hungry—really hungry. Titles don't impress you; impact does. You measure weeks in learnings shipped
* Bring 1\-5 years of high\-intensity experience. Early\-stage start\-up, tier\-one consulting, I\-banking, ops in manufacturing—anything that shows you can out\-execute peers



  





**Requirements** 




  





**Must\-Haves** 



* 1\-4 years of experience in start\-up, consulting, business operations, product, or manufacturing.
* Engineering background from tier 1 / tier 2 colleges
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent Excel/Google Sheets and presentation skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* High ownership, bias for action, and comfort with ambiguity.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally across GTM, Product, Operations, and CS.



  





**Nice\-to\-Haves** 



* Experience working with founders/CXOs or on strategic projects.
* Background in B2B SaaS, manufacturing, pharma/lifesciences, or enterprise tech.
* Experience with SQL, dashboards, automation, or process building.



  





**Benefits** 



* Be part of a fast\-growing SaaS company transforming the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing through cutting\-edge technology
* Collaborate with a passionate, high\-performing team building innovative AI\-powered digital solutions
* Take ownership of impactful client implementations from day one, with ample opportunities for learning, career growth, and professional development
* Enjoy a competitive compensation package designed to reward your contributions
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry\-leading coverage for your peace of mind
* Complimentary Meals \& Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Family\-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

title: Cardiovascular Program Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
 At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life\-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.
   

  

 As a pioneer and market leader in robotic\-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. For more than 25 years, we have worked with hospitals and care teams around the world to help solve some of healthcare's hardest challenges and advance what is possible.
   

  

 Intuitive has been built by the efforts of great people from diverse backgrounds. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. We strive to foster an inclusive culture built around diversity of thought and mutual respect. We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves.
   

  

 Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture. Our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long\-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential.
   

  

 Join a team committed to taking big leaps forward for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let's advance the world of minimally invasive care.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Primary Function of Position**
 The Cardiovascular Program Specialist (CVPS) will provide expert clinical support, education, and training to physicians, nurses, and hospital staff on the use of DaVinci cardiac surgery, devices and therapies. This role partners closely with the sales team, specifically the Cardiovascular Sales Manager (CVSM) to ensure safe and effective product adoption while driving positive patient outcomes. This role will be a part of a future small team of strategic sales professionals across the country who are focused on developing cardiac surgeons, and all those associated with cardiac programs.
   

  

**Clinical Support \& Case Coverage**
* Provide on\-site case support in the operating room or hybrid OR for procedures involving robotic cardiac procedures and surgery technologies.
* Serve as a clinical expert for product setup, troubleshooting, and optimal use during live cases.
* Ensure compliance with clinical and safety protocols.
* Expand the user base collaborating with CVSM to cultivate a training pipeline of new surgeons.
* Exhibit proficiency in multiple technology platforms to effectively support DaVinci adoption of Multiport Single Port, digital solutions, and customer needs.
* Promote advanced instruments and accessories to enhance surgical performance and promote surgeon autonomy.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional internal teams to identify and capitalize on opportunities for expanding the use of the da Vinci® Surgical Systems and strengthening Intuitive’s partnership with healthcare facilities.


**Training \& Education**
* Conduct training for physicians and care team members on indications and proper use of robotic platforms.
* Administer individualized surgeon and care team training sessions onsite and assist with organizing appropriate mentoring programs.
* Support new site start\-ups by delivering onboarding programs and in\-services.
* Act as a resource for ongoing education and product updates.
* Design and implement tailored da Vinci® pathways for surgeons and surgical teams to ensure proficient and autonomous system use, by providing recurring care team training as needed.
* Maintain flexibility to support after\-hours cases and provide weekend support as needed, dictated by the territory's adoption of robotic surgery.


**Collaboration \& Sales Partnership**
* Partner with local ISI sales team, leadership, customer training, and business partners to execute the appropriate clinical plan for surgeons and surgical teams to ensure system autonomy within a reasonable time frame
* Provide clinical insights to the commercial team to shape strategy and drive business growth.
* Participate in physician education programs, workshops, and regional/national conferences.
* Facilitate the adoption of our digital solutions through enhancing our customer infrastructure and capabilities.
* Communicate and collaborate with ancillary equipment manufacturers to develop strategies to ensure overall programmatic success


**Market \& Clinical Insights**
* Collect and communicate customer feedback to internal teams (sales, marketing, R\&D).
* Stay up to date on clinical literature, competitive products, and evolving treatment guidelines.
* Assist in clinical trial support when required.


**Preferred Skills and Experience** 
 (As applicable \- Specific skills, knowledge, and experience that are not required to perform the job, but are desirable to have)
   

  

* Deep understanding of cardiac anatomy, physiology, and interventional procedures.
* Exhibit a working knowledge of typical hospital policies.
* Excellent communication, teaching, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work in high\-pressure environments (OR/Cath lab)
* Adaptability to evolving technologies and complex procedures.
* Team oriented with a commercial mindset.
* Willingness to travel up to 75% domestically.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in nursing, Life Sciences, or related field required
* Advanced degrees (RN, PA, NP, RT, or other clinical credentials) preferred.
* Minimum 5\+ years of sales or related experience in the medical devices industry
* At least 2\+ years of managing government customers
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
* Marketing \& Hospital analysis experience is essential

title: Project Associate - Gender and Digital Empowerment
description:
IT for Change (ITfC) is a not\-for\-profit organization whose mission is to end digital inequality and advance just, equitable, and people\-led digital futures. ITfC works through three strategic program areas: Gender and Digital Empowerment, Public EdTech, and Just Digital Governance. The Gender and Digital Empowerment program works with adolescent girls across rural, semi\-urban, and urban Karnataka, inside schools and within communities. We are currently expanding our program and are looking for a Project Associate to support program delivery, documentation, and impact reporting for our in\-school interventions.
 



  





**Position Title** 




 Project Associate
 



  





**Location** 




 Bengaluru, Karnataka with in\-office presence
 



  





**Reporting To** 




 Head \- Gender and Digital Empowerment
 



  





**Role** 




 This is a field\-facing, ownership\-driven role at the heart of the adolescent empowerment program. The Project Associate will facilitate curriculum delivery in schools, help build and apply the program's MEL (Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning) systems, support funder reporting, and create digital content that documents and communicates program impact. The role bridges direct program delivery with the data, documentation, and relationship\-building that sustain and grow the initiative. 
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**01: Program Delivery \& Facilitation** 



* Facilitate the adolescent empowerment curriculum and digital skilling for adolescent girls and boys across Bengaluru schools.
* Manage field implementation across schools, colleges, and community settings, including day\-to\-day coordination.



  





**02: Impact Documentation** 



* Document project work and contribute to program strategy and ideation.



  





**03: Digital content creation \& Dissemination** 



* Develop digital resources including audio/video for program curriculum, toolkits and social media.
* Support program outreach with funders and peer organizations.



  





**04: Donor \& Funder Reporting** 



* Own donor and funder reporting for one or more institutional partners, including narrative and data inputs.
* Track reporting timelines and compliance requirements in coordination with the program lead.



  





**Core Competencies** 



* **Gender and adolescent empowerment expertise:** 
 Solid grasp of gender dynamics and adolescence, with a strong commitment to feminist values and an inclusive workplace.
* **Program implementation and field facilitation:** 
 Hands\-on experience delivering curriculum and running activities directly with adolescents in school and/or community settings.
* **Communication and content creation:** 
 Comfort with creating digital content, including audio and video, for social media and outreach, and translating program work into donor\-facing narratives.
* **Language proficiency:** 
 Solid hold on Kannada language (spoken, written and typing) along with English.
* **Ownership and self\-direction:** 
 Proven ability to independently plan, execute, and own program components end\-to\-end, delivering reliably.



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 



* Postgraduate degree in Social Work, Gender Studies, Development Studies, Sociology, or a related field.
* 3–4 years' experience working with adolescent girls and young women.
* Proficient in Kannada and English, spoken and written; Kannada typing is mandatory.
* Fluent with applications and tech tools, and open to picking up new tech skills.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to contribute meaningfully to social change
* Collaborative and mission\-driven work environment
* Scope for professional growth and leadership
* A flexible and hybrid work environment, with three in\-person office days a week
* A competitive compensation package including health benefits, with salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.

 For more details about the job and to apply, fill this form: https://bit.ly/gdeassociate
 



  





 Last date to apply: 25th September 2026

title: Associate Quality Engineer
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
   

  

 As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
   

  

 What You Can Expect
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Associate Quality Engineer supports software quality assurance, software testing, verification and validation (V\&V), and compliance activities in a regulated environment. This entry\-level role assists with reviewing software requirements and deliverables, developing and executing test documentation, supporting defect management, maintaining traceability, and participating in software lifecycle quality activities.
   

  

 The position works under the guidance of senior Software Quality and Quality Assurance team members and collaborates with cross\-functional teams including Software/R\&D, Quality Assurance, and Regulatory Affairs. The ideal candidate has a foundation in software testing, application and API testing, defect tracking, and software development lifecycle processes, with an interest in developing expertise in regulated software and medical device quality systems.
   

  

**Work mode:** 
 2 WFH, 3 WHO
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
   

  

 How You'll Create Impact
   

  

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**
* Support software quality assurance activities throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Assist with software verification and validation (V\&V) activities, including development, review, execution, and documentation of test plans, test cases, test protocols, and test reports.
* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and exploratory testing for software applications, including embedded, desktop, web\-based, and cloud\-based systems, as applicable.
* Support application testing to identify functional defects, UI issues, usability concerns, performance issues, and inconsistencies.
* Execute and document testing of software features and verify defect corrections and implemented fixes.
* Support the review of software requirements, design documentation, test documentation, and other software deliverables for completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability.
* Participate in requirements activities and assist with ensuring requirements are clear, complete, traceable, and verifiable.
* Assist with maintaining traceability between software requirements, risk controls, test cases, and verification evidence using Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs) or similar tools.
* Support defect tracking, investigation, documentation, retesting, and closure activities.
* Assist with testing REST APIs and software interfaces, including validation of requests, responses, error handling, and status codes using tools such as Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI.
* Support software integration testing between frontend, backend, databases, and external interfaces.
* Assist with software change management activities, including impact assessments, regression testing, and updates to applicable documentation.
* Assist with maintaining configuration and release traceability and supporting software version and change documentation.
* Prepare and maintain validation and quality documentation, including test plans, protocols, test cases, execution records, RTMs, validation reports, and other objective evidence.
* Support compliance with applicable quality system procedures and regulatory requirements, including FDA regulations, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, GAMP 5, and 21 CFR Part 11, as applicable.
* Assist with audit readiness activities and provide documentation or support during internal audits, external audits, and regulatory inspections as needed.
* Collaborate effectively with R\&D, Software Engineering, QA, and Regulatory teams to support software quality objectives.


 This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and might not necessarily comprise all of the essential functions for purposes of the Americans with Disabilities Act.
   

  

 What Makes You Stand Out
   

  

**Expected Areas Of Competence (i.e., Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)**
* Familiarity with web and application testing, including identification of UI defects, functional errors, formatting inconsistencies, responsiveness, and overall software quality issues.
* Exposure to REST API development and testing, including API requests and responses, HTTP methods and status codes, CRUD operations, and tools such as Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI.
* Exposure to Python and backend frameworks such as Flask and/or Django, with basic understanding of frontend\-to\-backend integration, software debugging, and relational databases such as MySQL and/or MariaDB.
* Basic understanding of software quality processes, the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), software verification and validation (V\&V), configuration management, version control, and software release traceability.
* Familiarity with regulatory and quality concepts and standards applicable to software, including FDA regulations, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, GAMP 5, and 21 CFR Part 11, as well as risk management, change management, and documentation control processes.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, organization, communication, and attention\-to\-detail skills, with the ability to document issues, test results, and findings clearly, work independently under guidance, and collaborate effectively in a cross\-functional team environment.


 Your Background
   

  

**Education/Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field required.
* 0–2 years of experience in software testing, software quality assurance, software validation, software development, or a related technical role.
* Internship, co\-op, academic project, or equivalent hands\-on experience in software testing, application development, API development/testing, or software quality is strongly preferred.
* Experience identifying and documenting software defects and verifying implemented fixes is preferred.
* Exposure to REST APIs, Python, Flask, Django, Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, MySQL, MariaDB, or similar technologies is preferred.
* Experience or exposure to regulated industries, including medical device, healthcare, life sciences, or other regulated environments, is a plus.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams, including Software/R\&D, QA, and Regulatory, is preferred.


 Physical Requirements
   

  

 Travel Expectations
   

  

 EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability
