 Muddenahalli, Karnataka
 



  





**About Us:** 




 One World One Family Mission provides free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare to those in need across 100 countries. Under the visionary leadership of the globally acclaimed humanitarian, Sadguru Sri Madhusudan Sai, the Organisation is dedicated to uplifting the most marginalised communities. The mission is grounded in the ethos of selfless service, guided by the belief that all are a part of ‘One World, One Family’.
 



  





**About the Mission’s websites** 



1. Mission Website \- The Mission has its own website which provides an overview of the mission and the member organisations worldwide. This is managed by the Mission Website Team.



  




1. Parent Trusts and Foundations \- In addition to this, there are parent trusts and foundations in India that primarily focus on specific verticals (Health, Education, Nutrition). Many of these organisations have their own websites, which are managed by dedicated website teams, while others are managed by the Mission Website Team.



  




1. Institutional Websites \- The Mission also manages multiple institutions such as Hospitals, Schools, Colleges and Universities. The Mission Website Team provides advice, guidance and instructions on the content, branding, function and usability of these sites.



  




1. Country Websites \- For countries in which our organisation has a presence, some of them have their own websites. Many of these countries do not have a website. However, for those that do, their websites are managed by local teams. The Mission Website Team provides advice, guidance and instructions on the content, branding, function and usability of these sites.



  





 The Mission is currently undergoing a rebranding phase wherein we are consolidating and enhancing the existing websites to ensure that it is clear to website visitors that all these websites fall under one Mission.
 



  





**Position Description** 




 The Website Manager will be responsible for the management, maintenance and enhancement of the key websites under the
 **One World One Family Mission** 
 . The role will ensure that all websites remain accurate, up\-to\-date, secure, user\-friendly, and aligned with the mission's vision, values, and objectives.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Website Management \& Operations** 



* Manage and oversee all websites under the One World One Family Mission.
* Ensure websites are regularly updated with relevant and accurate content.
* Monitor website functionality, performance, and availability.
* Maintain consistency in design, branding, content, and user experience across all mission websites.
* Implement website enhancement initiatives and support new website launches when required.
* For mission websites that are managed by other individuals and parties, the Website Manager is responsible for providing support, guidance and instructions to ensure that these websites maintain a standard of care, quality and professionalism and are in line with the Mission’s branding guidelines.
* Initiate and manage a dashboard or ticketing system for managing website updates.



**2\. Content Management** 



* Coordinate with departments, project teams, and content owners to collect and publish website content.
* Establish a systematic review process to ensure information remains current and relevant.
* Update news, events, announcements, programs, reports, and other digital content regularly.
* Ensure content follows organisational guidelines and quality standards.
* In areas where there are no existing processes or guidelines, the Website Manager is responsible for defining and developing new processes/guidelines.



**3\. Stakeholder Coordination** 



* Act as the central point of contact for all website\-related requirements.
* Collaborate with mission leaders, departments, partners, and external vendors for website updates and improvements.
* Gather stakeholder requirements and translate them into actionable website enhancements.
* Facilitate periodic review meetings to address website needs and priorities.



**4\. Website Governance \& Quality Assurance** 



* Conduct regular audits of website content, links, forms, and functionality.
* Ensure compliance with organisational standards, accessibility requirements, and digital best practices.
* Maintain documentation related to website structures, processes, and update logs.
* Ensure information accuracy and consistency across all websites.



**5\. Technical Coordination** 



* Liaise with developers, hosting providers, and IT teams for website maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Monitor website security, backups, software updates, and performance optimization.
* Coordinate implementation of new features, integrations, and technical improvements.
* Ensure timely resolution of technical issues affecting website operations.



**6\. Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Monitor website traffic, engagement, and performance metrics.
* Generate periodic reports on website usage and effectiveness.
* Provide recommendations to improve user experience, engagement, and website performance.
* Track the impact of digital initiatives and content updates.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Digital Media, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
* 8\-10 years of experience in website management, digital communications, or related roles, including at least 2 years in a role leading or supervising a team.
* Extensive experience working with Content Management Systems (CMS) such as WordPress or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with website analytics and digital marketing tools.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Strong organisational and project management skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Strong working knowledge of website technologies, hosting, and security practices, sufficient to liaise confidently with developers and IT teams and troubleshoot issues independently where possible. Solid understanding of SEO, accessibility standards, and digital best practices.
* Able to work on tight deadlines to ensure websites are updated on a timely basis, and establish/adhere to agreed SLA timelines.
* Demonstrated experience managing and developing a small team, including delegating responsibilities, setting priorities, and building team capability over time.
* Able to confidently communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
* Able to collaborate with other teams, including the content team, institutional leadership, design team, branding team and social media team.
* Able to manage multiple websites and priorities simultaneously.



  





**Location/Work Environment:** 
 This is a full\-time on\-site job role.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




  





 Joining the OWOF mission offers a chance to impact marginalized communities globally. With a focus on free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare across 100 countries, your efforts directly contribute to positive change. Being part of our mission means experiencing the joy of helping others and knowing your contributions bring happiness to those in need.

Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a Product Analyst with a background in technology, or a related field. In this role, you will communicate with team members and business partners on a regular basis. The Business Analyst will analyze our requirements and design solutions to meet those requirements. You will also be responsible for testing, implementing, and maintaining software applications to improve business processes.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Elicits, analyzes, specifies, and validates the business needs of stakeholders, be they customers or end users.
* Collaborates with project sponsors to determine project scope and vision.
* Conducts interviews to gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Identifies and establishes scope and parameters of requirements analysis on a project\-by\-project basis to define project impact, outcome criteria, and metrics.
* Works with stakeholders and project team to prioritize collected requirements.
* Researches, reviews, and analyses the effectiveness of existing requirements\-gathering processes and develop strategies for enhancing or further applying these processes.
* Helps conduct research on products to meet agreed upon requirements and to support purchasing efforts.
* Participates in the QA of solutions to ensure features and functions have been enabled and optimized.
* Participates in the selection of any requirements documentation software solutions that the organization may opt to use.
* Analyzes and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.
* Develops and utilizes standard templates to accurately and concisely write requirements specifications.
* Translates conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is comprehensible to developers/project team.
* Creates process models, specifications, diagrams, and charts to provide direction to developers and/or the project team.
* Develops and conduct peer reviews of the business requirements to ensure that requirement specifications are correctly interpreted.
* Assists with the interpretation of customer requirements into feasible options, and communicating these back to the business stakeholders.
* Manages and tracks the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine as necessary.
* Communicates changes, enhancements, and modifications of business requirements — verbally or through written documentation — to project managers, sponsors, and other stakeholders so that issues and solutions are understood.
* You will report to manager \- IT


**The Essentials \- You Will Have**
 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience
   

  

 Typically requires 8 years of related experience (project Management, Process Improvement and data management experience)
   

  

 Communicate the plan and priorities for the Program Increment and define the PI goals
   

  

 Drive release behavior, incenting discipline and quality over speed

description:

 We are looking for a Change Consultant to join our growing Change \& Transformation practice in India. This is a build\-and\-deliver role: you will help develop the practice's methodology, tools, and reusable assets while supporting live client engagements. It is ideal for a change professional who enjoys both crafting the underlying approach and rolling up their sleeves on delivery.
 



 You will work alongside the Practice Lead and cross\-functional consulting teams on life sciences transformation programmes, contributing across the full spectrum of organisational change management — stakeholder engagement, communications, learning and enablement, change impact assessment, and adoption. As one of the foundational hires in the practice, you will have excellent scope to shape how we work and to grow with the practice as it scales.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Build change management assets, methodology, and approach**

 capture lessons learned, case studies, and benchmarks, and help build the knowledge base that differentiates Chryselys in the market.

 contribute to training needs analysis, and the design and delivery of learning materials, quick\-reference guides, and enablement content that drive user adoption.
* **Champion adoption —** 
 design and monitor adoption measures, feedback loops, and reinforcement mechanisms to embed new ways of working.



**Project management and governance** 



* **Manage change activities —** 
 plan, track, and report on change workstream activities, milestones, risks, issues, and dependencies against programme timelines.
* **Support governance —** 
 maintain plans, RAID logs, decision logs, and status reporting, and prepare materials for steering and governance forums.
* **Coordinate across workstreams —** 
 work closely with programme, data, and technology teams to align change activity with the broader transformation.



**Experience and Qualifications** 




**Essential** 



* **4–8 years' experience** 
 in change management, organisational change, transformation, or a closely related discipline (change communications, learning and development, organisational design, or transformation project management).
* **Life sciences exposure —** 
 experience working with, or within, pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, or broader life sciences organisations.
* **Hands\-on change delivery —** 
 a demonstrable track record across the core change disciplines: stakeholder engagement, change impact assessment, communications, training and enablement, and adoption.

 excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to produce polished client\-ready materials and to engage stakeholders with confidence.

 or equivalent in a relevant discipline.



**Desirable**

 Prosci / ADKAR, APMG Change Management, CCMP, or equivalent.

 PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or similar.

 with commercial, medical affairs, or data transformations in life sciences (e.g. CRM, master data management, data platforms, or new operating models).

 experience delivering in a professional services, consulting, or advisory environment, ideally on transformation or change programmes.



**What You Bring** 



* A builder's mindset — comfortable creating structure, tools, and assets where none yet exist.

title: Government Liaison and Research Associate
description:
**About the Role** 




 Niti Aide is an AI solution provider to governments and PSUs across India, with a Telangana\-first focus (planned expansion to Andhra Pradesh). We're looking for someone who can be our on\-ground presence in government offices, building relationships with officials, uncovering real departmental pain points, and helping us track relevant empanelment and tender opportunities along the way.
 



 This is a field\-heavy, relationship\-driven role. You'll spend most of your time outside a desk, visiting offices, meeting officers, following up, and turning conversations into structured notes we can act on.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Visit government department offices (state and district level) to meet with officers and understand their operational challenges
* Do preliminary online research on departments, schemes, and tenders before visits, so conversations are informed and efficient
* Build and maintain relationships with department staff, Section Officers, PAs, and, over time with our support, senior officials
* Represent Niti Aide in meetings on our behalf when we can't be present, and brief us clearly afterward
* Track empanelment opportunities, tender notices, and government procurement processes relevant to our work
* Maintain a day\-to\-day activity log: who you met, what was discussed, what the pain point is, what the next step is
* Prepare short write\-ups, presentations, and documents in English summarizing findings and outreach status
* Learn enough about our AI solutions (what LLMs and AI agents are, and how we apply them for governments and PSUs) to explain it clearly and answer basic questions when representing us



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Comfortable and confident walking into government offices and initiating conversations with officers you don't know
* Working English, able to read/write a short document, WhatsApp update, or email, and follow a meeting conducted in English. Fluent Telugu required.
* Comfortable using a laptop for basic tasks: typing documents, filling forms, browsing, email
* Prior experience in any of the following is a strong plus: liaisoning work (real estate, RERA, registrations), insurance/loan field sales, political or constituency\-level work, or a similar govtech/PSU\-facing consulting role
* Organized, able to keep clear, consistent notes and follow up without being chased
* Comfortable with basic tools (WhatsApp, Google Docs/Sheets, smartphone use) and willing to learn new ones
* No prior tech background required, we'll train you on what LLMs and AI agents are and how to talk about them
* Willing to travel with the team for extended periods, including outside Hyderabad



  





**Compensation** 



* based on experience and fit
* Performance bonus tied to milestones: securing empanelment, tender wins, or projects moving to signed status as a result of your groundwork

**About The Role**

 As part of the core DEX team, manage the DEX life cycle:
   

  

* Assess needs and develop use cases.
* Build and maintain digital personas and journey maps.
* Measure and publish reports on DEX scores, including technology performance and adoption and employee sentiment.

* 6 to 10 years of experience within a large, complex and multinational organization.
* 5 years of experience implementing DEX tools to enable proactive endpoint management with associated analytics and automation.

title: Bid Project Manager
description:
**Who is Turner \& Townsend?** 




 All over the world people are using buildings, infrastructure, and assets we helped to deliver. It could be the hospital they work in, the railway they travel on every day, the fuel that powers their car or the data center they depend on at work. For more than 75 years we’ve been helping to deliver transformational programmes across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors, making a difference to people’s lives and ensuring a return on investment for our clients and their investors.
 



  





**Job description** 




 The Bid Manager will be responsible for driving best practice approaches and high\-quality bids in our 400\-person strong Turner \& Townsend Hyderabad team. Acting at both an advisory and hands\-on level, the successful candidate will be an experienced bid professional with strong stakeholder management skills and a track record for delivering complex proposals in a collaborative environment. They will be confident constructively challenging stakeholders and have an outcome focused, can\-do mindset.
 



 Key responsibilities include:
 


* Lead a best practice approach and the execution of proposals, tenders and bid responses. This includes:
* Reviewing procurement documentation, leading bid go/no go discussions, and formulating a clear plan for delivering a compelling offer.
* Acting as bid manager by mobilizing internal stakeholders, setting timelines and overseeing execution against the plan.
* Complying with the Turner \& Townsend “bid to win” process and governance requirements
* Facilitating discussions focused on differentiators, win themes and content to ensure high quality answers are developed.
* Working with Directors and other functional teams to deliver tender responses through collation of information, writing tender responses directly, or supporting others to produce quality responses.
* Working with external organizations and partners to develop and deliver bids and proposals.
* Delivering a professional bid that complies with brand guidelines and clearly and succinctly communicates key messages.
* Providing constructive feedback or escalating concerns to senior leadership and partner organizations throughout the bid and interview process
* Ensuring that all deadlines are met and that bids are submitted on time, and in the correct manner.
* Supporting positioning activities and Bid Leadership that support high conversion and business development activity. Examples include undertaking competitor research, market analysis or interrogating client feedback.
* Supporting the preparation of other deliverables related to conversion and work winning, such as interview presentation coaching and procurement team engagement.
* Reporting on pipeline and bid conversion at office and sector levels, including providing analysis and commentary on trends.
* Contribute to content libraries and best practice approaches by overseeing maintenance of content and bid libraries.
* Working alongside a team of existing bid professionals
* Support Business Development with other activities, as required



**Qualifications** 



* Relevant degree in Business, Marketing, English or engineering.
* Association of Proposal Management Professional (APMP) accreditation desired, or willing to be completed
* Minimum 7 years' experience of bid management and writing successful bid submissions
* Line management experience desirable
* Strong skills in Microsoft office suite, including PowerPoint and Word
* Proof reading skills with a keen eye for accuracy and detail, including ensuring responses adhere to word/page limits
* Organizational skills, with the ability to priorities and meet deadlines while maintaining a high standard of quality
* Communicate confidently and effectively, verbally and in writing and ability to foster credible collaborative relationships
* Team player who is willing to adapt to changing priorities of the business
* Contribute openly to the team with innovations and ideas to ensure the success and development of the company

title: Technical Sales Manager - Paperboard

title: Science Communicator on contract (Physics, Chemistry and Medicine)

title: Content & UI Specialist
description:
Job Type: Permanent \- Full Time
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 Job Category: IT
   

  

**Job Description**
 Are you ready to grow your career in our global tech hub?
   

  

 Zurich Cover\-More Group helps people travel safely across the globe every day. We are there at every step of a traveller’s journey, to keep them safe and help them out if something goes wrong. We are committed to providing reliable, fast, flexible and bespoke services for our customers as well as the many well\-known brands we partner with, such as travel agencies, airlines, banks and major sporting clubs!
   

  

 In the post\-pandemic world, travel insurance is more important than ever. We are committed to delivering an exceptional service for our customers and we want you to be part of that journey.
   

  

**So, what’s the job?**
* You'll proactively partner with stakeholders to develop, manage, and maintain digital content across CMS platforms, ensuring quality, accuracy, and consistency at every stage.
* You'll lead the creation and management of pages supporting product, feature, and campaign launches.
* You'll establish, advocate for, and enforce content standards and best practices across CMS platforms.
* You'll manage site authors by overseeing access permissions, governance processes, and CMS training initiatives.
* You'll conduct regular site audits to identify broken links, outdated content, and UX issues while driving continuous content improvements.
* You'll optimise web pages for usability, accessibility, and search engine optimisation (SEO).
* You'll collaborate with UX/UI designers across multiple geographies and time zones to implement intuitive interfaces, improve user journeys, and enhance overall site usability.
* You'll partner with developers, product teams, and global stakeholders to translate business requirements into polished, user\-friendly digital experiences.
* You'll design and implement features and workflows that improve efficiency in content management processes.
* You'll ensure all digital experiences meet responsive design, device and browser compatibility, and WCAG/ADA accessibility standards.
* You'll build feasibility analyses and proof\-of\-concept (POC) solutions for optimisation initiatives using ZCM's standard CMS component set.
* You'll plan, build, and execute A/B and multivariate tests using ZCM's test\-and\-learn toolset.
* You'll validate optimisation rules and audience segment configurations to ensure accurate test delivery.
* You'll analyse test results and convert insights into actionable recommendations, effectively communicating outcomes to stakeholders across locations.
* You'll lead UAT and QA processes to ensure accurate, high\-performing, and compliant digital experiences across web and app touchpoints.
* You'll validate content, functionality, device responsiveness, and WCAG compliance across partner and owned digital properties.
* You'll coordinate QA activities across distributed teams to ensure comprehensive testing and smooth go\-live execution.
* You'll act as the subject\-matter expert on ZCM's CMS, optimisation toolset, and digital platforms, providing first\-level support to the Rapid Learning Lab team globally.
* You'll document requirements for CMS component enhancements and communicate effectively with developers and stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* You'll demonstrate strong asynchronous communication practices, keeping remote and onshore stakeholders informed, engaged, and unblocked between scheduled touchpoints.
* You'll work closely with Content, UX Design, Engineering, and broader business teams to deliver cohesive, high\-quality digital outcomes.
* You'll align Rapid Learning Lab and travel partner requirements to maximise technology capabilities, optimise user experiences, and drive sales performance.
* You'll write and debug CSS to create high\-quality web experiences, including resolving specificity and cascade conflicts, leveraging CSS custom properties, and translating design mockups into responsive, production\-ready web pages.
* You'll apply modern CSS layout techniques, including Flexbox and CSS Grid, to build responsive interfaces that provide an optimal experience across devices and screen sizes.
* You'll use browser Developer Tools to inspect, troubleshoot, and resolve styling, layout, and markup issues in live environments.

**Department:** 
 Securities Research Production Support

 Equity Research
 



  





**Position Purpose** 




 The Supervisory Analyst (SA) reviews equity research reports written by a global team. The SA function is critical to ensure delivery of high\-quality publications with accurate, engaging and clear content conforming to relevant regulatory standards.
 



 The role will be based out of Mumbai and allows 50% WFH.
 








**Responsibilities** 




**Direct Responsibilities**



* Review analysts' financial models to ensure the meet internal quality standards
* Review equity research reports for grammar, style, clarity and accuracy. Where necessary, rewriting content to ensure that the reports have the right logical flow and to maximize market impact by providing catchy titles and engaging standfirsts.

**Contributing Responsibilities**




 · Contribute to enhance the research quality and the research production process.

* Intellectual curiosity and interest in financial markets.
* Excellent command over English language.
* Excellent report writing and editing skills.
* Attention to detail – should be able to spot discrepancies between text and tables/graphs, and discern nuances in language.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills. Experience in financial modelling. Previous experience as an equity research analyst is also a big plus.
* Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity markets in particular, with a good knowledge of equity valuation methods like DCF analysis, comparison of valuation multiples, etc.

* Tact, judgement and diplomacy; respect for confidentiality.

 Bachelor Degree or equivalent

 At least 11 years

title: Senior Document Controller
description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

**Purpose**
 Document Control lead on a project. Act as main interface between project personnel and client for any document control issues. Ensure that all project documentation is accurately logged, managed and issued via the Electronic Document Management System. It is imperative that each project has an accurate database containing each revision of all documents/drawings issued on a project and capturing all necessary meta\-data for each record including every document that is issued to each Company throughout the life of the project.
   

  

**The Role**
***As a Senior Document Controller with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Responsible for performing difficult and complex work assignments involving independent judgment to determine a course of action consistent with established functional and organization's policies and goals. Ability to lead and/or train lesser seasoned individuals.
* Performs difficult technical support assignments, requiring the application of advanced techniques, and engineering and mathematical principles, in accordance with established standards and procedures. May act as lead to lower\-level team members.
* Works under direct supervision with scope for planning and organization of work methods on assigned projects. Receives assignments in terms of specific objectives and priorities. Work is reviewed for accuracy, completeness and accomplishment of objectives. May receive supervised / self\-training in more advanced discipline work practices / applications.
* May exercise work direction over a small number of personnel, involving guidance and instruction on work methods and checking finished work.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* Technical school graduate with 5\+ years relevant experience or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.

* Advanced understanding of systems, processes and tools related to field. Able to assist others and troubleshoot issues. May be involved in the development of new systems, processes and tools.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Content Strategist (1-3 years)
description:
**Role: Content Strategist\- Spatial Branding** 




**Experience: 1\-3 years** 




**Salary: 35k \- 45k** 




**Location: Dahisar, Mumbai** 




  





***Kindly write to us with your resume and portfolio at talentaffair@gmail.com***




  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a curious and visually aware Content Strategist who can turn client briefs into compelling narratives for physical spaces. You will research clients, develop wall concepts and content themes, write spatial content, and create mood\-boards to guide our designers. You will contribute both
 



 during client pitches and after projects have been awarded. This is not a conventional social\-media content role. It sits at the intersection of research, storytelling, copywriting and visual thinking.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  Research the client’s business, industry, audience, culture and brand philosophy.
 



  Participate in briefing meetings and identify the purpose of different spaces.
 



  Develop customised content strategies, themes and wall concepts.
 



  Build narratives that connect individual walls to the organisation’s larger story.
 



  Write headlines, wall copy, stories, timelines, captions and value statements.
 



  Adapt content to suit the wall size, viewing distance, audience and purpose.
 



  Create mood\-boards defining the intended style, imagery, colours, typography and overall mood.
 



  Convert concepts into clear and persuasive client presentations.
 



  Present ideas and explain the thinking behind them to clients.
 



  Brief designers and review their work to ensure alignment with the approved concept.
 



  Coordinate with design, business development and project teams.
 



  Manage multiple assignments, feedback rounds and submission timelines.
 



  





**Skills Required** 




  Strong research, writing and storytelling ability.
 



  Excellent command of written and spoken English.
 



  Ability to write both concise copy and longer narrative content.
 



  Strong visual awareness and an eye for design references.
 



  Ability to create structured mood\-boards and presentation decks.
 



  Confidence in presenting ideas to clients.
 



  Curiosity about brands, people, culture, design and physical spaces.
 



  Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
 



  Ability to collaborate effectively with designers and accept feedback.
 



  





**Preferred Background** 



* Candidates may come from advertising, copywriting, brand strategy, communication design, journalism, literature, mass communication, architecture or related fields.
* A particular degree is less important than the ability to research deeply, think conceptually, write clearly and demonstrate visual judgement.
* Working knowledge of PowerPoint, Google Slides, Canva, Adobe InDesign or similar tools would be useful. Advanced graphic\-design skills are not mandatory.



  





**Portfolio Expectations** 




 Applicants should share relevant examples of brand concepts, copywriting, storytelling, research\-led content, mood\-boards or presentation decks. Previous spatial\-branding experience is welcome but not essential.

 Performs comprehensive quality analysis across region by evaluating performance metrics, trends, and compliance with quality standards. Translates data into actionable insights through structured reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) to support continuous improvement, operational excellence, and informed decision\-making.
   

  

**The Role**

 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

+ Conduct detailed analysis of quality metrics, performance indicators, and trends across projects and regional/global level.

* Ability to convert data into meaningful insights and executive\-level presentations.

Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

 Full\-time position

title: Senior Manager – Presales
description:
We are looking for a Presales expert who knows CPaaS well and can turn a client's business problem into a clear, working solution. You will work closely with Sales, Product and Tech teams. You will run RFPs, design custom solutions, demo our platform and present to senior client stakeholders. You will also help us win and grow large enterprise accounts in banking, fintech and ecommerce.
 



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**RFPs and Solutioning** 



* **RFPs:** 
 Own RFP, RFI and RFQ responses from start to finish, including technical answers, compliance sections and security questionnaires.
* **Custom solutions:** 
 Design omnichannel solutions across SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Voice and chatbots. Map them to client use cases such as OTPs, transaction alerts, onboarding and KYC, collections, renewals, marketing campaigns and customer support.
* **Solution documents:** 
 Prepare solution notes, flow and architecture diagrams, and scope documents. Give Sales the inputs they need for pricing.
* **Feasibility:** 
 Work with Product and Tech teams to check what is possible, scope custom needs and plan integrations.



**Demos and Presentations** 



* **Platform demos:** 
 Run live demos and proofs of concept (PoCs) tailored to each client's industry and use cases.
* **Pitch material:** 
 Build client\-facing pitch decks, use\-case decks and sample conversation flows for WhatsApp, RCS and chatbots.
* **Stakeholder meetings:** 
 Present with confidence to CXOs and to IT, marketing, digital and compliance teams.



**Enterprise Account Support** 



* **Sales partnership:** 
 Support Sales at every stage of the deal: discovery, requirement gathering, solutioning, negotiation and closure.
* **Account growth:** 
 Find upsell and cross\-sell opportunities in existing accounts. Support business reviews and delivery performance reviews.
* **Technical queries:** 
 Answer client questions on API integration, delivery reports, speed, delivery rates and fallback across channels.



**Market Knowledge and Sales Enablement** 



* **Industry updates:** 
 Keep up with changes to WhatsApp Business Platform policy and pricing, RCS developments, and TRAI / DLT rules for SMS.
* **Competitor tracking:** 
 Track what competing CPaaS companies offer and how they position themselves. Share what you learn with Sales and Product.
* **Sales enablement:** 
 Create enablement material, battle cards and use\-case libraries, and train the sales team.



**REQUIRED SKILLS** 




**CPaaS and Channel Knowledge** 



* **SMS:** 
 A2P messaging, DLT registration, headers and templates, and TRAI rules.
* **WhatsApp Business Platform:** 
 Template categories, conversation pricing, WhatsApp Flows, catalogues and interactive messages.
* **RCS Business Messaging:** 
 Rich cards, carousels, suggested actions and verified sender set\-up.
* **Voice:** 
 IVR, outbound dialling (OBD), click\-to\-call and missed\-call services.
* **Chatbots:** 
 Conversational AI and bot journey design, including handover to live agents.
* **Channel strategy:** 
 How to route messages and fall back between channels to improve reach and control cost.



**Technical and API Knowledge** 



* REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, callbacks and delivery reports. Able to read API documents and explain integration steps to client tech teams.
* Hands\-on with API testing tools such as Postman.
* Basic knowledge of SMPP, message routing and delivery rates.
* Awareness of CRM and marketing tool integrations (for example Salesforce, LeadSquared, CleverTap, MoEngage).
* Awareness of security and compliance needs in banking and finance: the DPDP Act, RBI guidelines, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and security questionnaires.



**Industry Knowledge** 



* **BFSI:** 
 Banks, NBFCs, insurance companies, mutual funds (AMCs) and stock brokers.
* **Fintech:** 
 Payments, lending and wealth platforms.
* **Ecommerce:** 
 Order and delivery updates, abandoned\-cart reminders, and campaigns to bring customers back.



**Communication and Presentation** 



* Strong presentation and storytelling skills.
* Excellent spoken and written English. Able to explain technical ideas simply.
* Polished, confident and professional with senior client stakeholders.
* Strong skills in PowerPoint, Excel and Word, and in diagram tools such as Visio, Lucidchart or draw.io.



**QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT or a related field. An MBA is a plus.
* 3–5 years of Presales or Solution Consulting experience, only in CPaaS.
* A proven track record of handling enterprise accounts and winning RFPs.



**GOOD TO HAVE** 



* Experience building WhatsApp Flows, RCS journeys or chatbot prototypes for demos.
* Exposure to GenAI\-based conversational solutions.
* Experience with email as a channel, or with customer engagement and marketing automation platforms.



**HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED** 



* RFP win rate and on\-time submissions.
* How many demos and PoCs turn into closed deals.
* Quality and accuracy of solution documents and client presentations.
* Revenue growth from supported enterprise accounts.
* Feedback from the Sales team and from clients.

title: Product Analyst
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a Product Analyst with a background in technology, or a related field. In this role, you will communicate with team members and business partners on a regular basis. The Business Analyst will analyze our requirements and design solutions to meet those requirements. You will also be responsible for testing, implementing, and maintaining software applications to improve business processes.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Elicits, analyzes, specifies, and validates the business needs of stakeholders, be they customers or end users.
* Collaborates with project sponsors to determine project scope and vision.
* Conducts interviews to gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Identifies and establishes scope and parameters of requirements analysis on a project\-by\-project basis to define project impact, outcome criteria, and metrics.
* Works with stakeholders and project team to prioritize collected requirements.
* Researches, reviews, and analyses the effectiveness of existing requirements\-gathering processes and develop strategies for enhancing or further applying these processes.
* Helps conduct research on products to meet agreed upon requirements and to support purchasing efforts.
* Participates in the QA of solutions to ensure features and functions have been enabled and optimized.
* Participates in the selection of any requirements documentation software solutions that the organization may opt to use.
* Analyzes and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.
* Develops and utilizes standard templates to accurately and concisely write requirements specifications.
* Translates conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is comprehensible to developers/project team.
* Creates process models, specifications, diagrams, and charts to provide direction to developers and/or the project team.
* Develops and conduct peer reviews of the business requirements to ensure that requirement specifications are correctly interpreted.
* Assists with the interpretation of customer requirements into feasible options, and communicating these back to the business stakeholders.
* Manages and tracks the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine as necessary.
* Communicates changes, enhancements, and modifications of business requirements — verbally or through written documentation — to project managers, sponsors, and other stakeholders so that issues and solutions are understood.
* You will report to manager \- IT


**The Essentials \- You Will Have**
 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience
   

  

 Typically requires 8 years of related experience (project Management, Process Improvement and data management experience)
   

  

 Communicate the plan and priorities for the Program Increment and define the PI goals
   

  

 Drive release behavior, incenting discipline and quality over speed
   

  

 Determine resource requirements and partner with Tech Lead or Business Owner on sourcing talent
   

  

 Integrates change management elements needed to support the desired state;
   

  

 Track key delivery issues and risks and escalating as needed.
   

  

 Accountable for validation of acceptance criteria met before accepting completed features and definition of done
   

  

 Overall responsibility to manage the Epic and Feature backlogs and Themes for measuring to key objectives, value delivery.
   

  

 Collaborate and shape design, development and implementation requirements with partners and engineering team members.
   

  

 Be responsible for training and support documentation, as well as business readiness \& service transition
   

  

 Provides consultative support in financial management, organizational change, vendor management, and operational excellence to business lead technology initiatives and to our business or enterprise shared services teams
   

  

 Provide analysis on key business drivers and metrics using the latest analytics \& visualization technology.
   

  

 Define the needed business cases with project team and process owner, defining business outcomes, including current baseline and future target metrics, such as leading and lagging indicators, and linking to strategic key performance indicators (KPIs).
   

  

 Proven experience with business and technical requirements analysis, elicitation, modeling, verification, and methodology development
   

  

 Demonstrated project management skills and project management software skills, including planning and organizing
   

  

 You will report toTeam Lead \-IT
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Our benefits package includes …
   

  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!


*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
 or
   

  

 Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Project Sr Analyst - C12 - PUNE
description:
Organization Overview:
   

  

 We are a dynamic, global, and diverse Organization, with a presence in over 60 Countries; covering all front post execution Operations teams including product aligned Middle Office groups, Settlements, Margin, Asset Servicing, Listed Derivative \& Commodities Operations. We support an extensive range of Capital Markets products and services including Fixed Income (FX, Rates, Credit, Muni, Cash and Derivatives) where Citi is consistently a dominant top 3 player in the market, Equity (Cash, Derivatives, Prime Brokerage, Futures, Listed Derivatives, FXPB) where Citi has a significant growth program to continue to build out its capabilities and services; and Syndicates where we support both FI and EQ new issues and IPOs.
   

  

 We take pride and are passionate about our People and our culture. We are invested in our People and their development. We are transforming and simplifying our operating model, creating an exciting environment which encourages diversity of thought and inclusion.
   

  

 Our Operations groups are core to the success of the Markets business and have significant impact across the lifecycle of a trade. We partner extensively with a range of internal stakeholders including Front Office Sales and Trading Desks, Compliance, Legal, Finance and HR; alongside having significant interaction with our external client base, playing a key role in the overall client experience. We have a Client relationship group, dedicated to overseeing the Organizational service performance and strategic partnership for our top tier client base, where we play a key role in supporting our global clients to ensure they have a first\-class experience when doing business with Citi.
   

  

 Our Business Intelligence and Process Re\-engineering group works alongside our Operations teams delivering automation solutions to solve for operational challenges. We partner with Citi’s innovation labs to drive optimization, and overall play a pivotal role in enabling us to transform to achieve our target operating model.
   

  

 Our Technology partners develop and implement a wide range of applications that support the Operations, Change, Design and Implementation groups in providing innovative products and solutions. We have re\-imagined how to provide technology and service in our domain through the alignment of our team vision, culture, and aggressive retirement plan for legacy applications and adoption of a micro\-based containerized cloud environment. We encourage our people to create, explore and be adventurous whilst taking measured risk, adopting safe practices to protect the firm. Data lineage and optimization is core to how we develop our eco system. We are growing our capabilities using artificial intelligence, natural language processing and machine learning.
   

  

 Our roles entail ensuring we operate in a robust control environment, whilst in a fast\-paced workplace. We comply with global regulations and internal policies and adopt a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to reduce risk through the continuous evaluation of our controls; to protect our clients, the firm, and our reputation.
   

  

 We work closely with our external global peers, partners, and regulators, and play an integral part in leading an agenda at the forefront to optimize and streamline processes and drive strategy across our industry.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 The Markets Process Engineering team has been formed to support stakeholders both within Operations and across the bank, to design and deliver a multi\-year transformation roadmap. Our transformation is underpinned by strategy, investment change execution and a market leading change delivery team focusing on program and project management, business analysis, process re\-engineering and low code application development.
   

  

 The Futures and OTC Clearing franchise is an agency business providing trading and clearing capabilities across 40\+ exchanges to our clients and proprietary lines of business such as Equities, Rates, Commodities, FX and Prime D1\. The business is embarking on a strategic re\-engineering of its platforms. This is a multi\-year initiative, moving to real\-time computation, and with ambitious goals to design and deliver a more robust, strategic, well controlled end state for Futures and OTC Clearing Operations.
   

  

 We are recruiting for a Project/Business Analyst to help lead the delivery of strategic initiatives. This is a great opportunity to join a growing, global, and dynamic change management team, delivering a major Tier 1 program.
   

  

 The role will work in partnership with the Futures and OTC clearing business, global operations teams, technology and downstream areas such as finance and regulatory reporting.
   

  

 The core responsibilities of the Project Manager and Business Analyst include but not limited to the following:
   

  

* Develop and manage project plans, define project scope, goals, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements to ensure successful project execution.
* Manage project lifecycle from initiation to closure, ensuring that project deliverables are met and proper evidence provided.
* Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies, developing and implementing effective mitigation and contingency plans.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including project charters, requirements, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Facilitate and lead project meetings, including kick\-offs, status updates, working groups and governance forums, to ensure clear and consistent communication among all project participants.
* Conduct business and data analysis to document business and operational processes and recommend improvements.
* Develop and maintain detailed process maps, use cases to support business and functional requirements
* Analyze existing business processes to identify opportunities for improvement, and assist in designing enhanced workflows
* Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure that developed solutions meet business requirements and are fit for purpose.
* Prepare senior level presentations to communicate project updates
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance and other functions to ensure successful project implementation.


**Qualifications:**
* Project Management and Business Analysis experience
* Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) Regulatory Reporting knowledge is a plus
* 2\-3 years operations experience (preferably in banking)
* Critical thinking and problem solving
* Strong ability in use of Microsoft Applications (PowerPoint, Visio, Project, Word, Excel, Access)
* Proficient with the project life cycle (Waterfall \& Agile)
* CAPM, PMP, PgMP and/or MBA are a plus
* Developed communication and diplomacy skills required to persuade and influence others; may negotiate with external parties.


**Role Overview:**
 The role we are recruiting for is a hybrid Business Analyst / Project Manager role aligned to the Equities business. You will be part of the Futures \& Derivatives Clearing (FDC) and Equities Operations Program Execution Team, a key component of the Markets Ops Transformation organization. The team drives strategic transformation and delivers Target Operating Models for FDC and Equities Operations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Project Leadership \& Delivery: Manage end\-to\-end projects from defining scope, milestones and deliverables with stakeholders to ensuring successful, on\-time delivery meeting business needs.
* Planning \& Documentation: Develop comprehensive project documentation, including charters, business requirements, plans, and risk/issue logs.
* Monitoring \& Reporting: Monitor project progress, resources, and risks, identifying and escalating issues promptly and providing timely, clear updates and presentations to all stakeholders, including senior management.
* Process Optimization: Lead business analysis efforts, clarify requirements, and drive the development and implementation of innovative, efficient processes for Equities Operations.
* Risk \& Compliance: Apply robust risk management practices and ensure regulatory compliance to protect the firm's reputation.
* Team \& Collaboration: Drive resource planning and foster strong cross\-functional collaboration across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and other departments.
* Strategic Initiatives: Champion change management and undertake additional strategic projects/tasks as required.

title: Senior Consultant- Project Management
description:
Project Management Office Senior Analyst
   

  

 Ready to grow your project management career? Join ERM, a global leader in sustainability consulting, and play a key role in supporting impactful projects that shape a better future. If you’re detail\-oriented, thrive in dynamic environments, and enjoy collaborating with top\-tier professionals, this is your opportunity to make a difference.
   

  

 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 As an PMO Senior Analyst you’ll provide critical support to Project Managers, ensuring smooth execution across all project phases. Your work will help maintain timelines, budgets, and quality standards—directly contributing to client satisfaction and ERM’s reputation for excellence.
   

  

 What Your Impact Is
   

  

* Assist with project coordination from proposal through closure, ensuring tasks are completed on time and within scope.
* Maintain project documentation, trackers, and dashboards for accurate reporting.
* Support financial processes, including invoicing schedules, accruals, and cost tracking.
* Facilitate meeting logistics, prepare agendas/minutes, and follow up on action items.
* Help enforce health, safety, and compliance standards across project activities.
* Collaborate with internal teams and subcontractors to keep deliverables on track.


 What You’ll Bring
   

  

**Required**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 7\+ years of experience in project coordination or project management support.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and ability to learn project management tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.


**Preferred**
* Experience in environmental consulting, engineering, or sustainability projects.
* Familiarity with financial tracking, invoicing, and subcontractor coordination.
* Exposure to cost estimation tools and project governance processes.
* Certifications such as CAPM or progress toward PMP.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Proposal Phase: Assist with subcontractor vetting, cost estimate preparation, and project plan development.
* Contract Phase: Organize documentation, support project setup, and ensure governance requirements are met.
* Start\-Up Phase: Coordinate kick\-off meetings, invoicing schedules, and health \& safety documentation.
* Implementation Phase: Track progress, update schedules, monitor scope changes, and maintain risk/issue logs.
* Delivery \& Closure: Support technical reviews, ensure timely deliverable submission, and assist with invoicing and collections.


 Why You’ll Love Working Here
   

  

 ERM offers a collaborative culture, professional development opportunities, and the chance to work on projects that make a real impact on sustainability and the environment.

title: Senior Proposal Manager

 The candidate should also have excellent verbal communication and team coordination skills to facilitate contributions from teams across the Shield AI team.  Leadership skills:

* Strong communicator: Strong oral and written communication skills. (Technical writing experience preferred.) Strong presentation skills. Ability to communicate seamlessly at all levels of Shield AI and customer organizations.

Our ideal candidate must always work with efficiency and a keen attention to detail. Both are critical to supporting on time, compliant Bids/Proposals and related deliverables.
* Organization and time management: Strong organizational and time management skills enabling the tracking and execution of multiple workstreams with stakeholders across Shield AI.

We manage the proposal lifecycle from start to finish including kickoff, collaboration with stakeholders, color reviews, and management reviews with senior leaders/executives. **What you will do:**

* Drive cross\-functional proposal teams to deliver compliant, high\-quality submissions on schedule.
* Continuously improve proposal processes, tools, templates, and best practices.
* Mentor proposal contributors and foster high\-performing, collaborative teams.
* Support India GTM team with briefing and presentation development for customer engagements.
* Support customer meetings, demonstrations, and GTM events as required.
* Provide additional support to BD Ops and GTM team leadership as needed.


**Required Qualifications**
* 2\-4\+ years of Government of India / Indian Ministry of Defence or international government proposal development or BD operations experience.
* In lieu of direct government proposal experience, have 3\+ years of experience working with Government of India or international government requirements.
* Bachelor's degree in business, communication, marketing, engineering, or equivalent industry experience.
* Strong record of academic achievement.
* Experience with proposal methodologies (e.g. Shipley), compliance matrices, and implementing project management tools and processes.
* Proven record of leadership in a professional setting.
* Ability to communicate complex, technical ideas effectively – both orally and in writing.
* Ability to work collaboratively and flexibly as part of a team, embrace the startup environment.
* Ability to work effectively with people at all levels of an organization.
* Demonstrated record of hard work, trustworthiness, holding oneself and others to high standards, and being kind to others.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong technical background especially with unmanned/uncrewed systems and/or autonomy software. \\
* Demonstrated understanding and knowledge of military operations and India defense acquisition processes.
* Understanding of international markets/geopolitical trends in aerospace / defense industry.
* Experience managing Foreign Military Sale and Direct Commercial Sale bids/proposals.

title: Trainer - Ortho Robotics - MISSO
description:
Open Locations \-
 



**Delhi, Cochin and Vapi** 




  





 The
 **Trainer – MISSO Orthopedic Robotics** 
 will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering comprehensive training programs for surgeons, clinical teams, hospital staff, and internal employees on the MISSO Orthopedic Robotic System. The role aims to enhance clinical proficiency, ensure effective adoption of the robotic platform, and build strong product and procedural capabilities across customer and internal teams.
 



  





***Key Responsibilities***




  





***1\. Training Program Design \& Delivery***




*· Develop and deliver structured training programs on the MISSO Orthopedic Robotic System for surgeons, OT staff, and hospital teams.* 




*· Conduct procedure\-specific training covering robot\-assisted orthopedic procedures, particularly knee replacement workflows.* 




*· Deliver hands\-on, simulation\-based, classroom, and virtual training programs for different learner groups.* 




*· Conduct Train\-the\-Trainer programs for internal TAS and Clinical Applications teams to ensure consistent knowledge transfer.* 




*· Provide on\-site training and clinical support during initial procedures and customer onboarding.* 




  





***2\. Internal Employee Training***




*· Conduct product, application, and procedural training for TAS, Service Engineers, and other relevant internal teams.* 




*· Develop structured learning modules to improve product knowledge, clinical understanding, and field readiness.* 




*· Assess employee competency through practical evaluations, simulations, and knowledge assessments.* 




*· Identify capability gaps and conduct refresher and advanced training programs as required.* 




*· Support onboarding and continuous development programs for new MISSO team members.* 




  





***3\. Content Development \& Training Innovation***




*· Develop and maintain training materials, presentations, procedure guides, simulations, and assessment modules.* 




*· Create practical and easy\-to\-understand learning content covering system workflow, surgical planning, robotic application, instrumentation, and troubleshooting.* 




*· Continuously update training content based on product enhancements, field feedback, customer requirements, and clinical developments.* 




*· Introduce interactive and simulation\-based learning methods to improve trainee engagement and competency.* 




  





***4\. Customer \& Cross\-functional Collaboration***




*· Work closely with Clinical Applications, Service, Sales, Product, and Marketing teams to ensure effective customer training and product adoption.* 




*· Coordinate with surgeons and hospital stakeholders to understand training requirements and develop appropriate learning interventions.* 




*· Support customer onboarding and ensure users achieve required competency before independent system utilization.* 




*· Gather customer and field feedback and incorporate relevant insights into future training programs.* 




  





***5\. Measurement \& Evaluation***




*· Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA) for customers and internal teams to identify competency and knowledge gaps.* 




*· Evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, practical demonstrations, feedback, and competency evaluations.* 




*· Maintain comprehensive training records, attendance, assessment reports, feedback, and competency trackers.* 




*· Monitor training outcomes and continuously improve training programs based on learner and field feedback.* 




  





***Qualifications \& Experience***




*· Education: Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering / Life Sciences / Physiotherapy / Nursing / Allied Medical Field. Master’s degree preferred.* 




*· Experience: 3–8 years of experience in clinical applications, customer training, medical devices, orthopedic robotics, surgical navigation, or related medtech domains.* 




*· Experience in orthopedic procedures, knee replacement, robotic\-assisted surgery, or surgical technology will be preferred.* 




*· Prior experience in delivering customer and internal employee training will be an advantage.* 




*· Willingness to travel extensively across India for customer and internal training programs.* 




  





***Key Competencies***




*· Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical workflows and robotic\-assisted procedures.* 




*· Excellent training, facilitation, presentation, and communication skills.* 




*· Strong customer\-facing and stakeholder\-management abilities.* 




*· Ability to conduct effective hands\-on, classroom, and practical training.* 




*· Ability to simplify complex clinical and technical concepts for different audiences.* 




*· Collaborative, adaptable, and field\-oriented professional with a strong learning mindset.*

title: Head of Design
description:
Candidates with a minimum of 10\+ years of dedicated experience in Commercial Office Interior Architecture \& Design only eligible.


**Role Definition**


The Head of Design holds total executive accountability for the creative vision, technical accuracy, commercial viability, and execution readiness of every design project at Divine Innovation. Directing a full multidisciplinary studio—including interior architects, 3D visualizers, furniture designers, proposal writers, and BOQ estimators—this leader translates sales downloads into awe\-inspiring, budget\-aligned workspace environments. The Head of Design personally checks all drawing packages to ensure 100% zero\-ambiguity handovers to project execution and purchase teams, while co\-leading design pitches to leave enterprise clients flabbergasted.

**Responsibilities \& Deliverables**

* **Creative Direction \& Enterprise Client Pitching:** Lead the design studio in crafting innovative commercial office concepts, while personally joining the Sales team to present and defend high\-ticket enterprise design pitches.
* **Airtight Technical Documentation \& Execution Handoff:** Rigorously check and vet 100% of technical drawings (GFCs, MEP, civil, ceiling, layout) to ensure project execution teams receive flawless packages requiring zero back\-and\-forth clarification.
* **Design\-to\-Budget \& BOQ Governance:** Direct the in\-house BOQ and proposal team to ensure all creative concepts strictly adhere to targeted client budgets and Divine Innovation’s gross margin requirements.
* **Factory Integration \& Furniture Design Leadership:** Oversee the internal furniture design team to produce precise, production\-ready factory shop drawings for custom joinery and workstations manufactured at the IMT Manesar plant.

**Tasks and Activities**

**1\. Creative Direction \& Enterprise Client Pitching**

* Take comprehensive project downloads from the Sales team, converting client headcount, aesthetic, and functional requirements into world\-class design solutions.
* Direct and mentor the studio team (interior designers, 3D renderers, space planners) to deliver designs that exceed client expectations ("happily flabbergast" the client).
* Partner with Sales Managers on key enterprise accounts to lead design presentations, walk CXOs through 3D models, and articulate design rationale.
* Enforce strict adherence to Divine Innovation's Process System Structure (PSS) for design SLA turnaround times from sales download to proposal delivery.

**2\. Airtight Technical Documentation \& Execution Handoff**

* Personally review, mark up, and approve 100% of drawing packages generated by the studio prior to client sign\-off and site release.
* Deliver complete, hyper\-detailed Good for Construction (GFC) drawing dockets to the Head of Projects, eliminating any need for execution teams to seek mid\-project clarifications.
* Write crystal\-clear material specifications, bill\-of\-materials (BOM), and procurement notes so non\-technical Purchase team members can source exact items effortlessly.

**3\. Design\-to\-Budget \& BOQ Governance**

* Supervise proposal and BOQ estimators to build detailed cost breakdowns alongside design development.
* Enforce "Design\-to\-Budget" principles: either design strictly within an established client budget or establish a baseline BOQ that protects target gross margins.
* Review all pre\-bid BOQs and techno\-commercial proposals for line\-item accuracy, material specification alignment, and commercial safety before client submission.

**4\. Factory Integration \& Furniture Design Leadership**

* Lead the dedicated Furniture Design team in developing custom modular workstations, executive desks, and loose furniture concepts.
* Ensure creation of millimeter\-accurate factory shop drawings (joinery details, hardware specs, finish schedules) for seamless production at the IMT Manesar manufacturing plant.
* Coordinate with the IMT Manesar production team to verify prototype feasibility, material availability, and manufacturing standards.

**Measurement Metrics**

* **Zero\-Query Handoff Rate:** 100% zero\-query technical handovers (Project execution team proceeds without requiring drawing clarifications).
* **Design SLA Adherence:** 100% compliance with internal PSS turnaround timelines from sales download to initial proposal presentation.
* **Design\-to\-Budget Accuracy:** 100% budget compliance with zero margin degradation caused by design oversights or unbudgeted material specs.
* **Enterprise Pitch Win Rate:** Contribution to achieving a 30%\+ win rate on key enterprise pitch presentations.
* **Non\-Technical Purchase Execution:** 0 purchasing errors resulting from vague or incomplete design specifications.

**Competencies We Are Looking For**

**Skills**

* Creative Design Leadership \& Commercial Workspace Concept Design
* High\-Impact Enterprise Client Pitching \& CXO Presentation
* Rigorous Technical Drawing Verification \& Detail Auditing (CAD/Revit/BIM)
* Design\-to\-Budget Engineering \& BOQ Estimation Governance
* Factory Shop Drawing Review (Modular Joinery \& Furniture Manufacturing)
* Cross\-Functional Specification Writing for Procurement Teams

**Knowledge**

* Deep expertise in commercial workplace architecture, space planning ratios, and ergonomics
* Thorough understanding of civil, MEP, HVAC, acoustic, lighting, and fire safety systems
* Material costs, finishing techniques, and commercial fit\-out procurement workflows
* Industrial furniture manufacturing processes, wood/metal joinery, and production workflows (IMT Manesar setup)

**Self\-Image**

* Master Design \& Technical Authority
* Creative Visionary with Commercial Discipline
* Flawless Execution Enabler

**Traits**

* Obsessive attention to technical detail and drawing accuracy
* High aesthetic sensibility combined with practical buildability
* Articulate, charismatic communicator with executive presence
* Calm under tight SLA pressure and multi\-project demands

**Motives**

* Driven by creating iconic, award\-worthy corporate workspace environments
* Motivated by technical perfection and zero\-error project execution
* Committed to building a seamless bridge between design creativity, manufacturing, and site delivery

We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
   

  

 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
