title: Senior Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 11 to 13\+ years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day\-to\-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge \& ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)


**Work Timings\***
 11:30 am to 8:30 pm
   

  

**Job Location\***
 Gurugram/Mumbai

title: Assistant Manager - Training
description:
Role: Training
 



 Level: Assistant Manager
 



 Location: Gurugram
 



 Reporting To: Senior Manager \- Training
 



  





**About The Function** 




  





 MakeMyTrip’s Hotels business is one of the
 **largest and fastest\-growing verticals** 
 within the organization, offering a diverse portfolio of accommodations across domestic and international destinations. With a network of
 **70,000\+ contracted properties** 
 , the business spans everything from budget\-friendly stays to premium and experiential hotels, catering to a wide range of traveller needs and serving millions of customers each year.
 



  





 Within this business, the
 **Training team**

The team drives capability building across stakeholders by strengthening product understanding, process excellence, service quality, and platform adoption. Through structured learning interventions and continuous upskilling, the Training function helps translate business priorities into consistent on\-ground execution and improved customer outcomes across the Hotels ecosystem.

 The role is responsible for end\-to\-end training management and content creation for the Hotels business, combining Learning \& Development, content development, and marketing communication to enable internal teams and partner ecosystems.
 



  





 It involves designing and delivering effective training programs alongside creating engaging communication and learning assets that drive awareness, adoption, and capability building.  Deliver engaging classroom, virtual, and hybrid training sessions for internal teams and external stakeholders, ensuring high levels of participation, clarity, and impact.

* Management graduate from a reputed institute with 4–6 years of experience across training, learning \& development, content creation, and communication roles.
* Exposure to sales, operations, partner enablement, or capability development environments preferred.
* Experience in e\-commerce, internet, FMCG, hospitality, or service\-oriented organizations is an added advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create clear, engaging, and audience\-relevant content.
* Hands\-on experience with content creation tools, presentations, and digital learning platforms.
* Working knowledge of social media platforms and digital content best practices preferred



  





**Key Success Factors Of The Role** 




  




* Ability to translate business needs into
 **practical, effective training and communication solutions.**
* High level of
 **ownership and accountability** 
 , with the ability to operate independently and drive outcomes end to end.
* Strong
 **storytelling and content design** 
 capability, with a sharp eye for clarity, engagement, and impact.
* Effective
 **stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration** 
 skills across business and support teams.
* **Creative mindset** 
 balanced with structured thinking and disciplined execution.

 **fast\-paced environment** 
 while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

title: CRO Lead
description:
**OneMetric \| Full\-time \| Gurgaon**
****The role in one line****
 This is not a "manage the website" role or a CRO role for its own sake — it's a lead\-generation role that uses the website as the primary lever. You own the website end to end — from a raw idea for a page to a shipped, converting landing page — against one defined outcome: 35–50 MQLs a month generated organically from the website and the motions around it.
   

  

****Why this role exists****
 Most people who "manage the website" either write copy and hand it to a designer, or build pages and wait for someone else to tell them what to put on them. We need someone who does both halves in one head: knows what a page needs to say because they've done the research and talked to customers, and knows why a page converts or doesn't because they think like a CRO person, not just a writer or a builder. The output is a live, working page — not a doc that someone else has to translate.
   

  

******What You'll Own******
* The website as a whole — structure, page inventory, and how it evolves as the company's positioning evolves.
* Idea → live page. You take a rough brief ("we need a page for X service" or "we're repositioning around Y") and turn it into a wireframe, then real copy, then a shipped page — working with a designer where needed, but driving the thing yourself.
* Conversion performance — what's converting, what isn't, and why. You run the experiments, not just report the numbers.
* Lead capture and funnel logic on\-site — forms, CTAs, gating, the path from a visitor landing on a page to becoming a lead in HubSpot.
* The lead number. 35–50 organic leads/month from the website and the motions around it (SEO, AEO, on\-site conversion, content) is your number. The page isn't done when it ships — it's done when it's producing.


****What you'll actually do, week to week****
* Talk to customers and internal stakeholders (sales, delivery, leadership) to figure out what a page actually needs to say to move a buyer — not guess at it from a template.
* Look at signals — search intent, competitor positioning, what prospects ask sales, what's converting elsewhere — and turn them into a point of view on what the page should be.
* Write the copy yourself. This isn't a hand\-off role — strong, clear, buyer\-facing writing is a core skill here, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Sketch wireframes and work directly with a designer (or design tools yourself) to get from idea to a real, live example fast.
* Build and manage pages in WordPress and HubSpot CMS.
* Use AI tools (Claude and others) and Figma as part of your everyday workflow — for research, drafting, quick mockups, and design iteration.
* Structure pages and content for both traditional SEO and AEO (answer engine optimization) — so the site shows up in Google and gets cited by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews.
* Track what's converting and what's not, and keep iterating rather than treating a page as "done" once it ships.


****What we need****
* A CRO brain. You should be able to look at a page and say, with reasons, why it will or won't convert — and know how to fix it. This means understanding funnels, lead capture mechanics, and what actually moves a B2B buyer to act.
* Strong writing, in service of strategy. You can write clean, persuasive copy, but more importantly you know what needs to be said and why, before you write a word.
* A founder/CMO\-level eye for B2B design. You don't need to be the designer, but you need the taste to know what good B2B design looks like and the ability to brief and push back on one.
* The ability to simplify. You can take a genuinely complex service or technical concept (a RevOps build, an AI GTM agent) and explain it in language a buyer actually understands.
* A working understanding of AEO and SEO. You know how to structure and write content so it ranks in search and gets picked up and cited by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) — this isn't optional anymore for a website role.
* Strong writing skills paired with AI fluency. You write well yourself, and you use AI tools to move fast — generating quick mockups, drafts, and iterations rather than waiting on a full design cycle for every idea.
* Comfort with the tools: WordPress, HubSpot CMS, Figma, and AI tools (Claude and similar) as part of daily work.
* Ownership instinct — you treat the website as yours, not as a queue of tickets from other teams.
* 4–5 years of experience working on websites/landing pages, ideally with direct exposure to conversion work, not just content or design in isolation.


****What's in it for you****
* Ownership, not a task list. We don't hand you a checklist and check boxes. Direction and context get discussed openly, and then the "how" — the wireframe, the copy, the page — is yours to run with.
* A performance\-driven culture. Speed and conversion results define your trajectory here, not tenure or face\-time. Ship fast, see what moves the numbers, and get rewarded for it.
* Access to the top of the market. The pages you build speak to CMOs, VPs of Sales, and founders across the B2B US market — real high\-stakes work, not busywork nobody reads.


****How we'll know this is working****
 Within a quarter: organic leads from the website and its motions are trending toward the 35–50/month range, pages you've shipped are outperforming what existed before on conversion, sales and leadership are coming to you first when a new page or repositioning is needed, and the website stops feeling like a static asset and starts feeling like something that's actively working for the business.
   

  

******Who You'll Work With******
 Reports into growth/marketing leadership at OneMetric, works closely with sales, delivery leads, and a designer (in\-house or external) to take ideas from brief to live page.
   

  

******Who You'll Work With******
 This role reports to the CEO’s office at OneMetric and works closely with sales and delivery leaders on HubSpot implementation, RevOps, and GTM projects.

title: Senior Analyst - BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Senior Analyst within BCG's Travel Cities and Infrastructure (TCI) and Capital Projects Excellence (CPEx) Practice Areas (PAs), you will work in a growing global team, delivering value to clients via individual expertise and/or institutionalized tools (digital products, methodologies, knowledge, data, workshops, frameworks, surveys, domain\-specific data, and related expertise, etc.).
   

  

 You will be part of BCG Vantage, a network of experienced consultants who leverage deep domain expertise to deliver insight for case teams and clients. Vantage members are affiliated with BCG Practice Areas, plugged into the strategic agenda, and build and deploy leading\-edge IP, data, and tools to support that work.
   

  

 You will contribute to cases and proposals by developing relevant analysis and insights for clients, and support business development and go\-to\-market efforts for both PAs through research and marketing analysis as opportunities arise. This includes travel to client sites during staffing assignments to understand requirements and design/develop solutions.
   

  

 You will support cases, business development, and commercialization efforts, working alongside business leaders, through activities such as:
   

  

 Leading process improvement initiatives in Capital Projects.
   

  

 Creating capital portfolio governance strategies.
   

  

 Analyzing and optimizing engineering processes for greater efficiency and quality.
   

  

 Implementing process standardization and continuous improvement methodologies.
   

  

 Collaborating with engineering and construction teams to ensure process alignment with business goals.
   

  

 Monitoring process performance metrics and implementing corrective actions as needed.
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 1\-2\+ years of consulting experience in construction, engineering, process improvement or implementation related field strongly preferred, ideally including a role with an EPC, General contractor or Project Management Consultancy (PMC) — e.g., site supervision, procurement review or vendor coordination
* In lieu of consulting experience, 2\+ years minimum relevant industry experience required; 3\-6\+ years of industry experience strongly preferred
* Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree preferred) in a relevant field such as engineering or industrial management
* Strong experience with construction and engineering process management and improvement, including working knowledge of civil/structural drawings, BOQs, project controls, scheduling and site documentation
* Experience with cost control, scheduling, risk management and field operations
* Analytical and data driven skills
* Fluency in English
* Strong business acumen and problem\-solving capabilities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 As a SA, you will work face to face with clients and with BCG Project Leaders, Associates and Consultants. In the period between cases, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients. Our team is made up a diverse pool of industry experts that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative consulting careers.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**
* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving, particularly related to infrastructure and making capital projects effective and efficient.
* Communicating with case teams and clients team members, in a credible and confident way
* Stakeholder engagement and communication
* Structured yet pragmatic and agile approach to task and project management.
* Organizational tasks and data analysis, with a keen understanding of how to distil data insights and translate them into action.
* Being a proactive team player with effective communication skills, showcasing practical efficiency over theoretical knowledge.
* Working collaboratively and effectively in a group dynamic, in\-person or virtually; proficient in agile ways of working.
* Being flexible and bringing a curious and creative mindset, open to new things and able to propose innovative ideas.
* Navigating complexity and ambiguity


 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
   

  

 For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
   

  

 We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Customer Services Rolling Stock (CS RS) Bid Manager
description:

 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard\-working mobility solutions. We’re making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!
   

  

**We are looking for Customer Services Rolling Stock (CS RS) Bid Manager**
**You’ll make a difference by**
* In your role as CS RS Bid Manager, you will be responsible to lead the full bid lifecycle from opportunity qualification through submission and post\-bid activities.
* Manage RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, and proposal responses.
* Develop bid plans, timelines, governance, and review schedules. Coordinate bid kick\-off meetings and stakeholder engagement. Ensure all submissions are completed accurately and on time.
* Lead and manage the Bid Approval Process (LoA Process) of Siemens Mobility by conducting bid/no\-bid assessments and opportunity evaluations, ensuring compliance with contractual, legal, and regulatory requirements, identify and mitigate techno commercial risks, and finally supporting commercial pricing and competitiveness modelling activities.
* Create compelling, customer\-focused proposals aligned with client requirement, by coordinating contributions from subject matter experts, solution architects, sales teams, and delivery leaders.
* Develop executive summaries, value propositions, win themes, and differentiators, providing regular management updates and securing decisions in best interest of Siemens
* Ensure consistency in messaging, branding, and proposal quality.
* Analyze bid outcomes and win/loss trend, implement improvements to increase proposal effectiveness and win rates.

 Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

AMS CoE consists of 70\+ team members, organized into \~18 teams, working across various sectors such as real estate/construction, heavy machinery, commercial aviation, logistics \& transport.

title: Graduate Trainee – Technology & Solutions
description:
**Graduate Trainee – Technology \& Solutions** 




**Company:** 
 SkillsNCR
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time \| In\-person
 



**Experience:** 
 Freshers / 0–2 years only
 



**Eligible Degrees:** 
 BCA / MCA / B.Tech / BE or equivalent technology degree
 



  





**About SkillsNCR** 




**SkillsNCR is building practical, industry\-oriented learning programs and technology\-enabled solutions designed to help students and recent graduates become workplace\-ready.** 




**We are looking for a Graduate Trainee – Technology \& Solutions** 
 who can grow with us across technology development, product support, data, AI, databases and technical learning.
 



 This is not purely a teaching role.
 



  





 You will be expected to:
 



**Learn → Build → Test → Support → Explain** 




**You may work on SkillsNCR's internal platforms, student\-facing applications, assessments, automation, data systems, AI\-enabled solutions and technical learning programs.** 




**You are not expected to know everything on Day 1\. We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership and the ability to learn quickly.** 




  





**What You Will Work On** 




**Depending on your strengths and business requirements, you may work across:** 



* SQL and databases
* MySQL / PostgreSQL
* Python
* Data analysis
* Data engineering fundamentals
* Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
* Generative AI and AI tools
* APIs and integrations
* Cloud platforms
* Git / GitHub
* Excel and data handling
* Automation
* Web applications and internal tools
* Testing and troubleshooting
* Technical support
* Student assessment platforms
* Learning management and technology solutions



 You are not required to be an expert in all these areas.
 



  





**Build \& Technology** 



* Help build and improve SkillsNCR technology solutions.
* Work on internal tools, dashboards, applications and automation.
* Write and maintain SQL queries.
* Work with databases and datasets.
* Build small applications, scripts and utilities.
* Support integrations between systems and APIs.
* Experiment with AI and Generative AI use cases.
* Assist in developing AI\-enabled learning and assessment solutions.
* Contribute to product enhancements and new features.
* Document technical workflows and solutions.



  





**Testing \& Support** 



* Test new features before release.
* Identify bugs and reproduce technical issues.
* Help troubleshoot application, database and user issues.
* Support students, trainers and internal teams when they face technical problems.
* Maintain issue logs and track resolutions.
* Help improve the reliability and usability of SkillsNCR platforms.
* Work with the team to diagnose and resolve technical issues.



  





**Learning \& Training** 




**As your technical capability develops, you may also:** 



* Help students during practical labs.
* Explain SQL, Python, databases, AI and related topics.
* Create exercises and technical assignments.
* Review student projects.
* Conduct demonstrations and practical sessions.
* Support technical assessments.
* Mentor students on projects and problem solving.



 Teaching responsibilities will depend on your strengths and will grow gradually with your technical experience.
 



  





**Who Should Apply** 




**You may be a good fit if you:** 



* Have completed BCA, MCA, B.Tech, BE or an equivalent technology degree.
* Are a fresher or have no more than 2 years of professional experience.
* Have basic programming knowledge.
* Understand the fundamentals of SQL, databases or software development.
* Are interested in Data, AI, Cloud or software technologies.
* Enjoy solving problems.
* Are comfortable learning new tools independently.
* Can communicate clearly in English and Hindi.
* Are comfortable helping others understand technical concepts.
* Are willing to work full\-time from Gurugram.
* Are comfortable working in an early\-stage startup environment.



  





**What We Value More Than Experience** 




**For this role, we care more about what you can learn and build than the number of years you have worked.** 




**We would like to see things such as:** 



* College projects
* Personal projects
* GitHub repositories
* Python projects
* SQL projects
* Websites or applications you have built
* Data analysis projects
* AI / GenAI experiments
* Automation projects
* Hackathons
* Internships
* Technical presentations



  





 Even a small project is valuable if you can explain:
 



**What problem did you solve?** 




**How did you build it?** 




**What went wrong?** 




**How did you fix it?** 




**You Do Not Need to Know Everything** 




  





**We expect Graduate Trainees to learn.** 




**If we give you a technology you have never used before, we want to see whether you can:** 



1. Understand the fundamentals.
2. Research independently.
3. Build a working solution.
4. Test it.
5. Troubleshoot problems.
6. Document what you did.
7. Explain it to someone else.



 That ability is more important to us than knowing every technology listed in this JD.
 



**This Role May Not Be For You If** 



* You have more than 2 years of professional experience.
* You are looking primarily for a remote role.
* You only want a teaching job.
* You only want a software development job with no user interaction.
* You are unwilling to work outside one specific technology.
* You prefer theory over hands\-on work.
* You are uncomfortable troubleshooting problems.
* You need detailed instructions for every task.
* You are interested mainly in collecting certifications.



  





**Why Join SkillsNCR** 




**As an early member of the team, you may get exposure to multiple areas instead of being limited to one narrow technology.** 




**You could work on:** 



* Data and databases
* AI and Generative AI
* Internal software platforms
* Student applications
* Automation
* Assessments
* Analytics
* Product testing
* Technical support
* Learning content
* Technical mentoring



 You will get an opportunity to understand how a technology solution is designed, built, tested, supported and used by real learners and internal teams.
 



  





 Strong performers can gradually move towards roles such as:
 



**Software / Technology Associate \| Data Analyst \| AI Associate \| Solution Engineer \| Product Support Engineer \| Technical Trainer \| Technology Mentor** 




**What Matters Most** 




**We are looking for graduates who can become dependable problem solvers.** 




**Our expectation is simple:** 




**Learn it. Build it. Test it. Fix it. Explain it.** 




**If that sounds like the kind of career you want to build, we would like to hear from you.** 




  





**Applications are open only to fresh graduates and candidates with 0–2 years of experience.** 




**Show us what you can build, solve and learn — not just what you have studied.**

title: CRO Lead
description:
**OneMetric \| Full\-time \| Gurgaon**

**The role in one line**
------------------------


This is not a "manage the website" role or a CRO role for its own sake — it's a lead\-generation role that uses the website as the primary lever. You own the website end to end — from a raw idea for a page to a shipped, converting landing page — against one defined outcome: 35–50 MQLs a month generated organically from the website and the motions around it.

**Why this role exists**
------------------------


Most people who "manage the website" either write copy and hand it to a designer, or build pages and wait for someone else to tell them what to put on them. We need someone who does both halves in one head: knows what a page needs to say because they've done the research and talked to customers, and knows why a page converts or doesn't because they think like a CRO person, not just a writer or a builder. The output is a live, working page — not a doc that someone else has to translate.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **The website as a whole** — structure, page inventory, and how it evolves as the company's positioning evolves.
* **Idea**  **live page.** You take a rough brief ("we need a page for X service" or "we're repositioning around Y") and turn it into a wireframe, then real copy, then a shipped page — working with a designer where needed, but driving the thing yourself.
* **Conversion performance** — what's converting, what isn't, and why. You run the experiments, not just report the numbers.
* **Lead capture and funnel logic on\-site** — forms, CTAs, gating, the path from a visitor landing on a page to becoming a lead in HubSpot.
* **The lead number.** 35–50 organic leads/month from the website and the motions around it (SEO, AEO, on\-site conversion, content) is your number. The page isn't done when it ships — it's done when it's producing.

**What you'll actually do, week to week**
-----------------------------------------

* Talk to customers and internal stakeholders (sales, delivery, leadership) to figure out what a page actually needs to say to move a buyer — not guess at it from a template.
* Look at signals — search intent, competitor positioning, what prospects ask sales, what's converting elsewhere — and turn them into a point of view on what the page should be.
* Write the copy yourself. This isn't a hand\-off role — strong, clear, buyer\-facing writing is a core skill here, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Sketch wireframes and work directly with a designer (or design tools yourself) to get from idea to a real, live example fast.
* Build and manage pages in WordPress and HubSpot CMS.
* Use AI tools (Claude and others) and Figma as part of your everyday workflow — for research, drafting, quick mockups, and design iteration.
* Structure pages and content for both traditional SEO and AEO (answer engine optimization) — so the site shows up in Google *and* gets cited by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews.
* Track what's converting and what's not, and keep iterating rather than treating a page as "done" once it ships.

**What we need**
----------------

* **A CRO brain.** You should be able to look at a page and say, with reasons, why it will or won't convert — and know how to fix it. This means understanding funnels, lead capture mechanics, and what actually moves a B2B buyer to act.
* **Strong writing, in service of strategy.** You can write clean, persuasive copy, but more importantly you know *what* needs to be said and *why*, before you write a word.
* **A founder/CMO\-level eye for B2B design.** You don't need to be the designer, but you need the taste to know what good B2B design looks like and the ability to brief and push back on one.
* **The ability to simplify.** You can take a genuinely complex service or technical concept (a RevOps build, an AI GTM agent) and explain it in language a buyer actually understands.
* **A working understanding of AEO and SEO.** You know how to structure and write content so it ranks in search *and* gets picked up and cited by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) — this isn't optional anymore for a website role.
* **Strong writing skills paired with AI fluency.** You write well yourself, and you use AI tools to move fast — generating quick mockups, drafts, and iterations rather than waiting on a full design cycle for every idea.
* **Comfort with the tools**: WordPress, HubSpot CMS, Figma, and AI tools (Claude and similar) as part of daily work.
* **Ownership instinct** — you treat the website as yours, not as a queue of tickets from other teams.
* 4–5 years of experience working on websites/landing pages, ideally with direct exposure to conversion work, not just content or design in isolation.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

* **Ownership, not a task list.** We don't hand you a checklist and check boxes. Direction and context get discussed openly, and then the "how" — the wireframe, the copy, the page — is yours to run with.
* **A performance\-driven culture.** Speed and conversion results define your trajectory here, not tenure or face\-time. Ship fast, see what moves the numbers, and get rewarded for it.
* **Access to the top of the market.** The pages you build speak to CMOs, VPs of Sales, and founders across the B2B US market — real high\-stakes work, not busywork nobody reads.

**How we'll know this is working**
----------------------------------


Within a quarter: organic leads from the website and its motions are trending toward the 35–50/month range, pages you've shipped are outperforming what existed before on conversion, sales and leadership are coming to you first when a new page or repositioning is needed, and the website stops feeling like a static asset and starts feeling like something that's actively working for the business.

**Who you'll work with**
------------------------


Reports into growth/marketing leadership at OneMetric, works closely with sales, delivery leads, and a designer (in\-house or external) to take ideas from brief to live page.

**Who you'll work with**
------------------------


This role reports to the CEO’s office at OneMetric and works closely with sales and delivery leaders on HubSpot implementation, RevOps, and GTM projects.

title: Content Marketer - BOFU

-------------------------------------


Most content writers stop at just writing the case study. We need someone who writes the case study, understands why the client made a purchase, builds the email sequence it belongs in, decides which segment sees it and when, and can explain whether it helped move the pipeline. You will design the funnel yourself, from mid\-funnel nurture all the way to closed\-won deals.

**What you'll own.**

* **BOFU content includes** case studies, white papers, sales one\-pagers, comparison or battlecard content, and ROI stories. These should be written with enough conviction and detail that a business leader, not just a marketer, reads it and finds it believable.
* **You’ll create** outbound email sequences, sales follow\-up routines, newsletter\-to\-sale paths, and the logic for segmenting who receives what and when.
* **Your goal is to generate 20–30 MQLs** per month from BOFU content and journeys. You’re not just creating assets; you’re responsible for the results they deliver.
* **You’ll work closely** with delivery, sales, and subject\-matter experts to truly understand the work, such as HubSpot implementations, RevOps builds, and GTM projects. This way, you can write about these topics with real credibility, not just from a brief.

**What you'll actually do, week to week**
-----------------------------------------

* **You should be able to design funnels and journeys, including** segmentation, sequencing, and stage logic. You need to be comfortable sketching out a journey on a whiteboard, not just writing the copy for it.

This role means you’ll go out and get the information you need by talking to engineers, delivery leads, and clients, instead of waiting for a content brief.rather than waiting for a content brief.

**Good to have:**

* It’s a plus if you have experience writing for a services or consultancy business, such as a HubSpot partner, RevOps agency, or martech consultancy, rather than just for product SaaS.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

* **Here, you get real ownership instead of just a list of tasks.** We talk openly about direction and context, but you decide how to get things done. If you prefer having every step defined for you, this might not be the right place. But if you like working with clear goals and plenty of freedom, you'll fit right in.
* **We have a performance\-driven culture.** Your progress depends on how quickly you work and the results you deliver, not on how long you've been here or how much time you spend at your desk. Move fast and show what you can do, and you'll be recognised.
* **You'll have the chance to work** directly with CMOs, VPs of Sales, and founders across the B2B US market. Instead of creating content in isolation, you'll help shape projects for some of the top go\-to\-market leaders. Knowing the US market well will really help you succeed here.

**How we'll know this is working**
----------------------------------


You’ll see results within a quarter. MQLs from BOFU content and sequences should be moving toward 20–30 per month. Sales will ask you for more of the assets that are working, and the case studies or white papers you create will be the ones sales teams use in their emails without being prompted.

title: Data Labeling Specialist
description:
**Job Title:** Data Labeling Specialist (In\-Office Contract)  
**Company:** Arijentek  
**Location:** Pollachi, India (On\-site)  
**Salary:** ₹2,40,000 to ₹4,80,000 per year (2\.4 LPA to 4\.8 LPA)  
**Job Type:** Contract  
**Working Hours:** Flexible schedule, maximum 50 hours per week

**About Us**

At Arijentek, we're not just labeling data, we're helping improve the technology people use every day. Our work creates the examples and feedback that make advanced systems more accurate, consistent, and useful.

**What You'll Do**

Evaluate outputs from AI models, text, images, video, and documents against detailed criteria. Assess quality, spot errors and inconsistencies, and write clear, well\-reasoned justifications for your judgments. Every evaluation you complete helps these systems perform better in the real world.

**Who We're Looking For**

People who write clearly, think critically, and can back up a judgment call with a clear explanation. This role suits people who've done work built around precise written evaluation, UI/UX design, graphic design, photography, video production, editorial or research work, or writing technical specs and requirements.

* Strong readers and writers with sound judgment
* Comfortable evaluating creative or technical work against a set of criteria
* Takes quality seriously and catches what others miss
* Can follow detailed written guidelines independently
* Able to commute to and work from our Pollachi office

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, completed or in progress
* Excellent written English: clear, precise, well\-organized
* Strong attention to detail
* At least 1 year of experience in a role built around evaluating or reviewing work against a standard (e.g., UI/UX design, graphic design, photography, video production, editorial, research, QA, or technical writing). Equivalent experience will be considered.

**Technical Requirements**

* Proficient in using desktop or laptop computers running Windows 10 (or later) or macOS. *(Note: All necessary hardware and high\-speed internet will be provided at your dedicated workstation in our office).*

**What We Offer**

* **Competitive Compensation:** 2\.4 LPA to 4\.8 LPA, based on experience and performance.
* **On\-Site Flexibility:** Work from our Pollachi office while setting a flexible schedule that works for you, up to a maximum cap of 40 hours per week.
* **Support \& Growth:** Clear guidelines, comprehensive training, and ongoing performance feedback from our on\-site team.
* **Career Advancement:** Some of our most reliable, high\-performing contributors have grown into roles where they guide and support others, with compensation that reflects the added responsibility. These opportunities depend on performance and how the work is evolving, and we're glad to support people who are a strong fit.
* **Impact:** Join a mission\-driven team focused on accuracy and quality, helping build the data foundation behind better technology.

Pay: ₹240,000\.00 \- ₹480,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Evaluating data requires intense focus over long periods. What specific techniques do you use to maintain your attention to detail and avoid "auto\-piloting" during long annotation sessions?
* Imagine an AI is asked: "What is the capital of Australia?"

The AI responds: "The capital of Australia is Sydney, which is famous for its Opera House and beautiful harbor."

Please review this AI output. Is it accurate? Write a 2\-3 sentence evaluation explaining your judgment, exactly as you would write it for our engineering team.

* Describe a time when you had to review or evaluate work against a set of guidelines, but the guidelines didn't clearly cover the specific issue you found. How did you handle the edge case?
* Are you currently located in, or willing to commute daily to, our office in Pollachi?
* This is an in\-office contract role (up to 50 hours per week). Are you comfortable working on\-site under these conditions?

**Company Description** 
 STWRAPEC is a leading provider of end\-to\-end packaging solutions across India, specializing in industrial strapping, stretch wrapping, and packaging automation systems. The company serves a wide range of sectors, including steel, aluminum, plastics, FMCG, automotive, pharmaceuticals, logistics, and heavy manufacturing. Its portfolio spans semi\-automatic and fully automatic strapping machines, pallet stretch wrappers, carton sealers, conveyor integration systems, and key consumables such as strapping rolls and stretch films. With a nationwide service network and dedicated after\-sales support, STWRAPEC focuses on maximizing uptime and performance for every installation. The organization’s core expertise lies in strapping, wrapping, automation, and consumables, offering integrated solutions tailored to industrial needs.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Sales Executive role based in Bengaluru. The Sales Executive will identify and qualify new business opportunities, build and manage a robust sales pipeline, and drive revenue growth for packaging equipment and consumables. Responsibilities include conducting client meetings and product demonstrations, preparing proposals and quotations, negotiating commercial terms, and closing sales in targeted industries such as manufacturing, logistics, and FMCG. The role involves regular coordination with technical, operations, and service teams to ensure smooth installation, commissioning, and after\-sales support for customers. The Sales Executive will also track market trends, maintain accurate sales reports and CRM records, and represent STWRAPEC at industry events or customer visits as required.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong skills in B2B sales, account management, and business development within industrial or packaging solutions.
* Ability to conduct market research, identify customer needs, and develop effective sales strategies and plans.
* Proficiency in communication, presentation, and negotiation, with the capacity to explain technical solutions in clear business terms.
* Experience managing the end\-to\-end sales cycle, including lead generation, proposal creation, pricing discussions, and deal closure.
* Comfort working on\-site at customer locations, coordinating with internal technical teams, and supporting after\-sales follow\-up.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field; relevant experience in industrial equipment, automation, or packaging is an advantage.
* Ability to use CRM tools and basic productivity software (e.g., spreadsheets, presentations, email) to manage sales activities and reporting.
* Self\-motivated, goal\-oriented mindset with willingness to travel within the region when required.

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**About Nirmaan Glass \& Plywoods** 




 Nirmaan Glass \& Plywoods is an architectural glass processing and fabrication business on Hosur Main Road, Bommanahalli, Bengaluru. The firm was established in 2001, and our family has been in the glass and plywood trade in Bangalore since the mid\-1960s. We process and supply toughened glass, laminated glass, mirrors, shower partitions and Lumirror, our own range of LED back\-lit mirrors, to architects, interior designers, contractors, builders, glaziers and retail counters across Bengaluru.
 



  





**The role** 




 This is a field job, not a desk job. You will spend most of the day with customers across your assigned area of Bengaluru, and the rest at our Bommanahalli office.
 



  





**What you will do** 




 • Visit architects, interior designers, contractors, builders, glaziers and dealer counters to build and hold a set of accounts
 



 • Generate your own leads and follow up on enquiries that reach us
 



 • Take sizes and requirements accurately, get quotations prepared, and follow them through to order
 



 • Present the full range, including Lumirror LED mirrors and shower partitions
 



 • Coordinate with the factory on dispatch, site fitment and after\-sales issues
 



 • Follow up on payments and keep customers informed on delivery
 



 • Record every visit, lead and order in our system
 



  





**What we are looking for** 




 • 2 to 5 years of field sales experience; glass, plywood, hardware, sanitaryware, tiles, paints or a related building\-materials trade preferred
 



 • Living in Bengaluru and able to travel across the city every day
 



 • Own two\-wheeler with a valid driving licence (mandatory)
 



 • Fluent Kannada; workable English or Hindi
 



 • 12th pass minimum; a diploma or degree is welcome but not required
 



 • Comfortable with a smartphone, WhatsApp and basic spreadsheets
 



  





**Salary and benefits** 




 ₹20,000 to ₹30,000 per month fixed, depending on experience, plus sales incentive (about ₹5,000 a month on average). Fuel and phone reimbursed as per company policy.
 



  





**Location and hours** 




 Nirmaan Glass \& Plywoods, Hosur Main Road, Mangammanapalya Cross, Bommanahalli, Bengaluru 560068\. Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM.
 



  





**Hiring process** 




 Apply on LinkedIn. Shortlisted candidates take a short online assessment, then one online interview, then a final meeting at our Bommanahalli works. Questions: 9740083464, Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM.
 



  





 Applicant privacy: the details you share are used only for this recruitment and are not shared outside Nirmaan Glass \& Plywoods.

As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Account Executive, SMB for G2 Marketing Solutions, you’ll own a new\-business quota in one of our fastest\-growing segments. You’ll run the full sales cycle \- prospecting through close \- for your assigned region, partnering with internal teams to craft data\-driven narratives that showcase G2’s value. You’ll create urgency with prospects, advocate customer needs internally, manage expectations and escalations, and drive executive engagement on high\-growth accounts.
   

  

 This role sells to APAC or EMEA prospects from India and requires working the corresponding shifts, which run from
 **08:00 am to 05:00 PM or 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST** 
 . During the ramp period, this is a full\-time, five\-day in\-office schedule for training and enablement; once completed, the role will transition to a hybrid model with 3 days work from office.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Own and exceed a new\-business quota for G2 Marketing Solutions in the SMB segment.
* Run full\-cycle deals across your territory. Build and manage a healthy pipeline with a consistent outbound motion (email, phone, social) tailored to India/APAC buyers.
* Craft data\-driven proposals and narratives, translating insights into clear ROI and next steps. Multi\-thread opportunities, engage executives early, and drive stakeholder alignment to accelerate cycles
* Forecast with precision; maintain rigorous SFDC hygiene, activity metrics, and stage progression accuracy
* Represent the voice of the customer \- surface market feedback to influence playbooks, messaging, and product roadmap.

* Run targeted outbound activation using email/phone/social to build and maintain pipeline
* Build a repeatable motion (cadences, quarterly territory plans) to sustain coverage


**Responsibility Area: Deal Execution \- 40%**
* Conduct rigorous discovery to quantify pains, timelines, and stakeholders; translate findings into mutual action plans that keep cycles on track.
* Map G2’s solutions to measurable outcomes; deliver tailored demos/proposals that show ROI and create executive confidence.
* Multithread and negotiate to value; align legal/procurement early, manage risks, and close predictably with disciplined give\-get frameworks.


**Responsibility Area: Operations \& Forecasting \- 10%**
* Maintain SFDC accuracy; Forecast via weekly call readiness
* Use data\-driven insights to remove bottlenecks (cycle time, win rate, discounting) and guide where to invest effort for outsized returns.


**Responsibility Area: Cross\-Functional Collaboration \- 10%**
* Orchestrate smooth handoffs to AMs and CS with clear success criteria and documented discovery.
* Channel market and competitive feedback from India buyers to refine playbooks, messaging, etc.

* Experience selling SaaS or subscription\-based products
* Comfortable working in\-office APAC/EMEA shift schedule
* Solid grasp of how marketing teams operate and what drives their decisions

title: Associate Sales Manager
description:
**About KidPro** 




  





 KidPro is a children's fitness brand, part of kprosport.com. Our mission is simple: make fitness a daily habit for every Indian kid. We run live, coach\-led classes that help children grow taller, stronger and more confident, right from their living rooms. Every week we put a KidPro demo in front of hundreds of families.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 We are hiring a Senior Closer for KidPro Live Classes. You own the moment a curious parent becomes a paying one. Every conducted demo is a warm lead handed straight to you. You call, you build trust, you handle the money question, and you close, fast. We already have a closer who sets the bar, and we are hiring someone who can match it and beat it.
 



  





 This is a full\-time, work\-from\-home role, open anywhere in India, six days a week.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




  





 • Call every family right after their child's demo and convert them into a paid KidPro plan.
 



 • Close on the same day the demo is conducted wherever you can, and within the same week at the latest.
 



 • Own the full money conversation: plans, pricing, objections, and the ask.
 



 • Run disciplined follow\-ups on every warm lead until it is won or genuinely lost.
 



 • Hit and beat your weekly enrollment target.
 



 • Keep every lead, note and status updated in our tracker in real time.
 



  





**The Number That Matters** 




  





 Same\-day conversion is the gold standard. A demo closed the day it happens is worth the most, to the family and to you. A same\-week close is the strong second. That is how we measure a great closer, and how your incentive is built.
 



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 




  





 • 3\+ years closing on the phone in EdTech, K\-12, insurance, or any high\-intent consumer sale.
 



 • A real track record of hitting and beating targets, with numbers you can talk through.
 



 • Fluent, warm and persuasive in Hindi and English. A South Indian language is a strong plus.
 



 • Quick on pricing and objections, and comfortable asking for the sale without flinching.
 



 • Self\-driven at home: you run your own day, follow up relentlessly, and log everything.
 



 • Motivated by incentives and competition. You want a role where closing more pays you more.
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




  





 Experience selling to parents or in kids and education, a feel for subscription products, fluency with a CRM, and a calm, reassuring hand with anxious first\-time parents.
 



  





**What We Offer** 




  





 • Fixed salary plus uncapped incentive on every enrollment.
 



 • Full\-time, work from home, anywhere in India.
 



 • Six days a week.
 



 • Immediate start.

title: Sr .Enterprise Account Executive - GCC
description:
**Company Description**

That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention.  Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
 You will produce new business sales revenue from a SaaS license model. You will accomplish this through account planning, territory planning, researching prospect customers, using business development strategies and completing field\-based sales activities within a defined set of prospects, territory or vertical.
   

  

 You'll build new business in GCC accounts by partnering with AI/Intelligent Automation CoE leaders, GBS leadership, Data \& Analytics leaders, and Engineering teams to deploy AI at scale—accelerating process automation, unlocking data\-driven decisions, and proving measurable productivity gains against their global innovation mandate. This role demands account strategy rooted in GCC P\&L mechanics, multi\-stakeholder navigation (CoE through C\-suite), and the ability to size deals around AI\-driven transformation ROI—not just licensing. You'll own a portfolio of GCC Accounts and execute field\-based account plans that move from AI CoE discovery through CFO\-led business case validation.
   

  

**What You Get To Do In This Role**
* Build and orchestrate multi\-stakeholder account strategies—starting with AI/Intelligent Automation CoE leaders, GBS heads, and Data \& Analytics leaders based in the GCC, then presenting business cases to global CFOs, CIOs, and regional COOs who drive budget and strategic approval
* Map and navigate complex GCC decision\-making structures, identifying which leaders own transformation mandates, data strategy, and cost\-avoidance metrics
* Be a trusted transformation advisor: understand GCC P\&L drivers, regulatory constraints, and local productivity mandates—then position how ServiceNow AI unlocks value that resonates with both GCC leadership and global finance/strategy buyers
* Orchestrate specialist resources (Solutions Consultants, AI specialists, Professional Services, product experts, partners) into deals at critical moments—CoE validation, business case build, implementation roadmap
* Execute vertical (GCC\-specific) and horizontal (cross\-function AI plays) sales strategies, scaling your territory while building a pipeline of Tier\-1 GCC accounts
* Lead account planning that moves from CoE discovery through CFO\-led business case validation, ensuring both innovation credibility and financial rigor
* Develop and collaborate with cross functional team through GCC\-specific deal complexity—stakeholder navigation, ROI methodology, multi\-quarter sales cycles
* Manage forecasting and communications with discipline, translating pipeline activity into predictable revenue
* Establish and nurture relationships at CoE leadership and C\-suite levels, becoming the trusted advisor on GCC AI transformation strategy
* Drive customer success practices and long\-term account expansion strategy post\-close


**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**
* 10\+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with 3\+ years selling to large GCC organizations
* Proven ability to sell AI\-driven transformation and automation solutions—demonstrating how AI impacts workflows, decision\-making, and organizational productivity
* Deep experience navigating multi\-tiered, matrixed customer relationships in enterprises with 5,000\+ employees, particularly in GCC/shared services environments
* Track record of closing large deals with CFO/COO involvement and complex sales cycles
* Demonstrated expertise sizing deals around business outcomes (cost\-avoidance, FTE reduction, automation ROI) rather than licensing
* Strong GCC region knowledge—familiarity with Tier\-1 Global Capability Centers, their organizational structures, and competitive dynamics
* Superior stakeholder management skills—ability to navigate C\-suite relationships, build credibility with technical CoEs, and translate business impact for finance buyers
* Strong forecasting discipline, communication, and executive presence
* Competitive mindset, optimism, humility, strong work ethic, and excellent collaboration and listening skills
* Willingness and ability to travel 50% of the time for customer meetings, with occasional global stakeholder engagement


 Additional Information
   

  

**Work Personas**
 We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.

**Accommodations**
 We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
   

  

**Export Control Regulations**
 For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals.  Onboard 25 – 50 clinics/hospitals in Bengaluru within 60 days.

title: Founder's Office - Strategy & Operations
description:
**Founder's Office \- Strategy \& Operations** 





 LH2 AI Labs · Bengaluru · Full\-time · On\-site 
 




  





**Mandatory requirement: a bachelor's degree from a premier engineering institute such as IIT, BITS, or NIT, or an MBA from a leading business school such as IIM, ISB, XLRI, or an equivalent institution.** 




  





**About** 





 Built by second\-time founders who have built and sold companies before, LH2 AI Labs (lh2\.ai) is building the post\-training infrastructure for frontier AI models.
 





 We bring private, high\-quality institutional datasets and vetted domain experts to frontier AI pipelines across verticals like coding, computer use, agentic, medical, audio and more.
 





 For AI to keep progressing, it needs high\-quality training data drawn from real production use cases. The public web has already been crawled and trained on – there's nothing left there. That's where we come in: we envision creating a world where frontier models can access data on tap – exactly how they access compute today.
 




  





**The role** 





 We're looking for smart people to lead our revenue function – i.e., our data verticals – coding, finance, company operations, medical, audio, egocentric, and many upcoming verticals.
 





 Leading a vertical means an ownership mindset and owning the entire revenue stack:
 



* Working with frontier models to understand training data requirements
* Finding the right data owners
* Negotiating licensing rights and closing agreements
* Building the delivery data pipelines with our engineering team
* Ensuring seamless delivery




 This is not a role where you'll be making decks or Excel sheets. It's a carry\-a\-number, close\-the\-deal role that happens to sit right next to the founders.
 





 Here's how it works. We point you at a vertical – codebases, medical, audio, whatever's next – and you go build its supply from scratch. You figure out who in the world has the data and expertise we need, work out how to win them, and close them. You own the whole thing: who to approach, in what order, on what terms, and where the moat gets built. Each vertical runs like its own small business, and what you learn in the field shapes what the founders prioritise next.
 





 We can teach you the domain, the data, and the AI landscape. We can't teach you to think on your feet or to want closure. That part you bring.
 




  





**What we're looking for** 



* You can sell. 2\-5 years in sales, partnerships, or BD with a real sales cycle – ideally opening and building new relationships from scratch (new business / new logo, not just managing an existing book). You've carried a number and owned deals end to end.
* Genuinely sharp. Top\-tier education and/or time at well\-regarded companies – you've operated around a high bar, and it shows. You pick things up fast, and you can hold your own in a room.
* Consultative problem\-solver – you read what a counterpart needs, solve the problem in front of you, and build a deal around it.
* Think like an owner – comfortable shaping how your vertical goes to market, not just executing a plan handed to you.
* Comfortable negotiating bespoke, non\-standard terms.
* Sharp on quality: you can tell what's worth closing and what isn't.
* High ownership; thrive in fast, ambiguous environments.
* A generalist who has worked in startups before – hands\-on with tools, automation, and basic scripting, and comfortable figuring things out without a playbook.



  





**Bonus** 



* Prior experience in a programme management role.
* Opened new markets, categories, or accounts from cold – where the relationship didn't exist before you walked in.
* A track record of running many deals at once, against a target, without hand\-holding.
* Sold into small buying committees (fewer than five stakeholders) and know how to move them.
* Prior exposure to AI, data, expert networks, or marketplaces.
* Founder's office, consulting, banking, or operating roles at a high\-growth B2B company.

* Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams for order fulfilment.
* Track inventory levels and avoid stock\-outs or excess inventory.
* Reconcile physical stock with online inventory.
* Monitor returns, RTOs, damaged products, and replacements.

5\. Sales \& Revenue Management

* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly e\-commerce sales.
* Analyse sales performance by product, marketplace, category, and channel.
* Identify opportunities to improve online sales and product visibility.
* Monitor pricing and competitor activity.

6\. Promotions \& Campaigns

7\. Website Management

* Update products, banners, offers, pricing, inventory, and promotional content.
* Coordinate with the website/development team for technical issues and improvements.

8\. Customer Service

* Monitor customer queries, complaints, reviews, and feedback related to e\-commerce orders.
* Coordinate with customer support teams to resolve issues.

9\. Reports \& Analytics

* Sales \& Revenue

* Conversion Rate
* Average Order Value
* Returns \& RTO
* Cancellation Rate
* Product Performance
* Inventory Status
* Analyse data and provide actionable insights to management.

title: Corporate Strategy Manager (Consulting & Strategy)
description:
**Company Description**  

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**


Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost\-to\-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise\-grade yet easy\-to\-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.  

  

**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

 **Job Description**  

Freshworks is looking for a Manager to join our global Corporate Strategy team and help shape some of the most important decisions facing the company.


This is a high\-impact strategy role for someone who loves solving complex business problems but wants to get closer to the decisions, the executives making them, and the outcomes that follow.


You'll work directly with Strategy leadership and senior executives on questions spanning AI, product strategy, pricing and monetization, GTM growth, market expansion, and strategic investments. One project might involve evaluating how we monetize a new AI capability; another could focus on where Freshworks should invest to accelerate growth or how we evolve our GTM strategy.


The team operates with the rigor of a top strategy consulting firm, but with one important difference: we don't stop at the recommendation. We partner across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to help turn strategy into action and see the impact of the decisions we help shape.

**What You'll Do**

* Own high\-priority strategic initiatives from initial question through recommendation and execution.
* Tackle ambiguous company\-level problems, develop hypotheses, and create the analytical frameworks needed to answer them.
* Evaluate growth opportunities across AI, product, GTM, pricing, market expansion, and strategic investments.
* Build business cases, financial models, market assessments, and scenario analyses that inform investment and resource allocation decisions.
* Partner directly with senior leaders across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to shape decisions and drive alignment.
* Translate strategy into actionable plans and stay close to execution to understand what is working and where we need to adjust.
* Develop executive and Board\-level narratives that distill complex analysis into clear choices and recommendations.
* Bring an outside\-in perspective on the SaaS and AI landscape and help identify the strategic questions Freshworks should be asking next.

 **Qualifications** **What We're Looking For**

* 4\-6\+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or a combination of consulting and in\-house strategy experience; **experience from a top\-tier management consulting firm, particularly MBB (Mckinsey, Bain, BCG) is preferred**
* Experience solving growth, product, GTM, pricing, market entry, or investment strategy problems
* Exposure to SaaS, enterprise software, or technology businesses strongly preferred
* Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with the ability to turn data into business insights and recommendations
* Executive\-level communication skills and the ability to influence without authority
* Comfortable moving between high\-level strategy and hands\-on analysis
* Curious, low ego, and energized by ambiguity
* Most importantly, you want to own the outcome, not just deliver the recommendation

**Why This Role**


Freshworks is at an exciting point in its evolution. We're scaling a global SaaS business, expanding our enterprise presence, and navigating how AI changes the products we build, how we monetize them, and how our customers work.


For someone coming from consulting, this is an opportunity to keep the parts of the job you love—complex problems, executive exposure, analytical rigor, and variety—while gaining something that's harder to get as an advisor: ownership.


You'll see the decisions get made. You'll work alongside the teams responsible for executing them. And you'll have the opportunity to see whether the strategy actually worked.


This is a highly visible individual contributor role with exposure to senior executives and the Board, and an opportunity to build a deep understanding of how a global SaaS company operates.

 **Additional Information**  

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

description:
**About Unosecur**


Unosecur is a fast\-growing, Pre\-Series A startup with $5M in funding. We're a B2B security SaaS platform making identity security smarter and simpler for enterprises worldwide, with sales teams across the USA, Europe, and India.


You'll be part of a diverse team working on cybersecurity and AI, with opportunities to solve complex problems and build production\-grade AI capabilities.

**The Role**


We're hiring a Solution Engineer based in Bengaluru to provide technical presales support and drive Proof of Value / Proof of Concept engagements during the sales cycle, including with C\-level stakeholders. You'll partner closely with Account Executives to own the technical win in complex sales cycles.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the technical win. Partner with Account Executives and GTM to drive complex sales cycles from initial discovery to technical wins.
* Tailor the narrative. Translate complex technical identity risks into business value — explain an IAM policy misconfiguration to a DevOps Engineer, then explain the business impact of that risk to a CISO five minutes later.
* Execute high\-velocity PoVs. Run frictionless Proof of Values. Our technology connects via APIs and shows value in minutes — guide the customer through that data, highlighting critical identity risks (toxic combinations, shadow admins, over\-privileged roles) in their environment.
* Be a trusted advisor. Become a deep subject\-matter expert on Identity Security across cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity providers (Okta, Entra ID), and business apps (Snowflake, GitHub) for clients and partners.
* Represent the voice of the customer. As an early member of the team, your feedback loop to Product and Engineering is critical — translate customer use cases and business requirements into clear feature requests to shape the roadmap.
* Evangelize. Represent Unosecur at industry conferences, webinars, and in technical blog posts.

**What You'll Need**

* 5\+ years of experience in Solution Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Technical Consulting within the SaaS or cybersecurity space

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented Senior Real Estate Sales Manager to lead and drive business development for our Office Space Leasing Division.

The candidate will be responsible for generating new business, managing key client relationships, driving office space leasing transactions, handling negotiations, and achieving revenue targets. Negotiation \& Deal Closure

\* Maintain accurate records of leads, client requirements, property options, site visits, proposals, negotiations, and closures.

\* Ensure timely updates of all sales activities in the CRM.

\* Prepare regular sales pipeline and performance reports for management.

\* Monitor conversion ratios and identify opportunities to improve sales performance.

\* Provide management with market feedback, sales insights, and business\-development opportunities.

* Identify and report operational issues to the relevant internal teams.

* Help site workers and labour teams understand the system and ensure they are comfortable using it during day\-to\-day operations.

* Diploma or engineering degree in any stream — Mechanical, Electrical, Polytechnic, Computer Science, or equivalent.

Good\-to\-Have
