**Academy Front Desk Administrator** 

**About Muzigal**

Muzigal was founded in the year 2020 by Dr. Lakshminarayana Yeluri, a serial Entrepreneur and Musician, with a vision to make high\-quality music education accessible and affordable by connecting huge untapped music teaching talent with aspiring learners through its app and offline academies. Within 24 months of its inception, Muzigal has served over 24,000 students and more than 400 teachers. Muzigal is the first\-ever organised player revolutionising the music education space globally. Muzigal has emerged as a dominant player in the last 18 months and has become the largest destination for music teachers and students.

Muzigal offers beginners to intermediate level music classes across Indian and Western music genres for all age groups through its proprietary curriculum delivered by qualified music teachers. Muzigal currently operates several offline academies across India and is expanding its footprint rapidly to become a household name for music learning in India and globally. The brand plans to expand to 100\+ academies across India within the next 18 months.

**Role Overview**

The Counsellor \& Admin at Muzigal Academy is a full\-time and multi\-functional position. The incumbent reports to the Academy Owner. S/he plays a pivotal role in managing sales \& marketing activities at the front desk that include making calls and responding to queries, ensuring steady stream of walkins, maintaining CRM Hygiene, undertaking walk\-in management tasks \- conduct academy tour, scheduling demo with Faculty, communicating with the walkin to ensure enrollment. In the Admin role the incumbent is required to manage day to day tasks of running facilities such as \- ensure opening and closing routines as per company SOP, maintain and manage inventory \- Forms, Info Leaflets and Brochures, Instruments \& Accessories, Books, , ensure display of instruments and follow the SOPS and guidelines prescribed by the Company.

**Responsibilities**

* Ensuring the Academy opens and closes as per timings and associated opening and closing routines strictly implemented such \- cleanliness,
* Keeping the frontdesk walkin ready to efficiently manage the counselling and enrollment processes \- Forms, Brochures,Desktop PoS and so on,
* Establishing rapport with the walkins and obtaining their relevant information to help in the right choice of course.
* Counselling the prospects on making the right choice of music learning through the various Muzigal information collaterals.
* Introduce the learning structures through Muzigal Preparatory Curriculum Framework and explain the learning progression Learn\> Play \> Inspire
* Ensuring Facility is managed efficiently as per company protocol
* Running daily checklist \- Day opening/ Closing,
* Ensuring inventory levels of stationary, pantry and other day to day supplies and services are satisfactorily maintained. Reordering if necessary.
* Maintain and manage vendor list for purchases, Payments, replacements and maintenance of facility.
* Ensure all Academy checklists are verified – cleaning and ambiance checklist , sterilisation checklist, toilet checklist, etc.
* Ensure that the Academy is running smoothly at all times
* Conduct outbound calls to prospective students and parents to provide information about the academy's courses and offerings.
* Achieve and exceed weekly/monthly sales targets through effective telephonic communication and follow\-up.

title: Sr. Incorta Developer
description:
**Job Description:**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

We are seeking an experienced Incorta Developer with 6–10 years of experience in enterprise reporting, analytics, and data modeling. The role will design scalable Incorta data models, develop complex dashboards and reports, integrate multiple source systems, and optimize analytical performance while partnering with business and data engineering teams.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Incorta Development and Data Modeling**

* Design and maintain Incorta physical schemas, business schemas, joins, materialized views, formula columns, measures, dimensions, and derived attributes.
* Configure ingestion jobs, data sources, pipelines, load plans, incremental refreshes, and data validation controls.
* Develop reusable semantic and dimensional models that support governed self\-service analytics.
* Translate complex business and reporting requirements into maintainable technical solutions.

**Reporting, Analytics, and Performance**

* Build complex operational, management, and executive dashboards and reports across multiple subject areas.
* Implement calculations, aggregations, filters, drilldowns, KPIs, exception reporting, and role\-based access.
* Troubleshoot and optimize queries, joins, formulas, schemas, ingestion patterns, and dashboard performance.
* Reconcile report outputs to source systems and resolve data quality or reporting discrepancies.

**Integration and Delivery**

* Integrate Incorta with ERP, CRM, WMS, TMS, finance, HR, and other enterprise source systems using database, API, file, or cloud\-based patterns.
* Work with data engineers on source mappings, transformations, data quality, refresh schedules, and lineage.
* Support design reviews, testing, UAT, defect resolution, releases, production support, and technical documentation.
* Provide mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior developers and report developers.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* 6–10 years in business intelligence, enterprise reporting, data analytics, or data warehousing, including substantial Incorta development experience.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of Incorta schemas, ingestion, Analyzer, dashboards, security, materialized views, and performance tuning.
* Advanced SQL skills including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and performance\-aware query design.
* Strong understanding of semantic modeling, dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, facts, dimensions, and slowly changing dimensions.
* Experience with ETL/ELT, data pipelines, source\-to\-target mappings, incremental loads, data profiling, and data governance.
* Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, or similar databases; familiarity with APIs, JSON/XML, and cloud data platforms.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder\-management, and documentation skills.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Incorta certification or formal training; experience with Incorta Cloud.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, Cognos, or comparable BI tools.
* Experience delivering analytics for supply chain, finance, procurement, sales, operations, or HR.
* Experience with end\-to\-end reporting\-platform implementation, migration, or modernization.

**EDUCATION AND COMPETENCIES**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field. A master’s degree or relevant certification is an advantage. The successful candidate demonstrates ownership, attention to data accuracy, structured problem solving, collaboration, and the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.

title: Sales & Marketing Operations Executive
description:
**Sales \& Marketing Operations Executive**
===========================================


**Address:** Somajiguda, Hyd


**Role Purpose**
----------------


To manage the backend engine of sales and marketing by ensuring enquiry tracking, quotation preparation, customer follow\-ups, documentation, coordination with internal departments, agency coordination, order\-status communication, and customer experience follow\-through.


This is not a hardcore marketing strategy role. This is an execution, coordination, follow\-up, CRM, and documentation role.


**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------


* **Experience:** 2–5 years
* **Qualification:** Graduate
* **Background:** Sales coordination, customer support, back\-office sales, CRM, order processing, commercial coordination, or operations support
* **Skills:** Excellent follow\-up, Excel/CRM discipline, email writing, coordination, documentation, and ownership
* **Age:** Flexible. Do not restrict unnecessarily to 28–35 unless there is a strong reason.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **A. Enquiry \& Lead Coordination**


* Maintain a live enquiry tracker with source, customer name, requirement, status, next follow\-up date, quotation status, expected order value, and responsible sales person.
* Send brochures, data sheets, company profiles, product details, catalogues, and introductory emailers to prospects as per approved templates.
* Maintain a proper follow\-up sequence for every enquiry so that no lead is forgotten.
* Coordinate with the sales team to understand whether the enquiry is hot, warm, cold, closed, lost, or needs senior intervention.

### **B. Quotation \& Sales Documentation**


* Prepare and send quotations based on approved pricing, formats, terms, and inputs from the sales/commercial team.
* Prepare proforma invoices wherever required.
* Check customer purchase orders against company sales policy, approved price, delivery terms, payment terms, taxes, freight, and other commercial conditions.
* Escalate any mismatch in PO terms to the senior sales/commercial team before order processing.
* Maintain records of quotations sent, revised quotes, approvals, purchase orders, proforma invoices, and order confirmations.

### **C. Customer Follow\-Up / Keeping in Touch (KIT) System**


* Follow up with customers for pending quotations, expected order confirmation, advance payment, dispatch clearance, inspection dates, and documentation.
* Use a defined KIT strategy , Keep In Touch sequence , for structured customer communication.
* Send polite reminder emails, WhatsApp messages, and call follow\-ups as per approved scripts.
* Escalate delayed or high\-value follow\-ups to the relevant salesperson or senior manager.
* Ensure customers receive timely updates without depending only on sales representatives.

### **D. Sales Backend \& Commercial Coordination**


* Coordinate with sales representatives for customer updates, pending documents, order status, and follow\-up remarks.
* Coordinate with the commercial department for order processing, production plan review, dispatch clearance, invoices, and payment documents.
* Coordinate with the factory/production team for material readiness, inspection status, dispatch planning, and expected timelines.
* Coordinate with transporters for vehicle placement, LR details, dispatch acknowledgements, and delivery confirmation.
* Generate or coordinate sale invoices where applicable.

### **E. Customer Experience \& Completion Documentation**


* Send order completion reports to customers after supply.
* Obtain completion certificates from customers for company records.
* Track customer complaints, delays, missing documents, delayed dispatches, and unresolved issues.
* Maintain a customer experience tracker showing whether the customer had a smooth, delayed, problematic, or escalated experience.
* Share recurring customer issues with management for process improvement.

### **F. Agency \& Marketing Collateral Coordination**


* Coordinate with marketing agencies/freelancers for brochures, datasheets, catalogues, emailers, LinkedIn creatives, and other collaterals.
* Collect inputs from sales/product/management and convert them into clear agency briefs.
* Maintain updated folders of final approved marketing material.
* Ensure the sales team has access to the latest brochures, presentations, company profile, product sheets, and email templates.
* Track agency deliverables, deadlines, approvals, and revisions.

### **G. Records, CRM \& MIS**


* Maintain customer\-wise files containing enquiry history, quotations, PO, PI, correspondence, dispatch details, invoices, payment status, completion certificate, and complaints.
* Update CRM/Excel/ERP daily.
* Prepare weekly MIS on enquiries, quotes sent, follow\-ups due, orders received, pending advances, dispatches, completion certificates pending, and payments pending.
* Share ageing reports for pending quotations, pending customer approvals, pending payments, and pending documents.
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
-------------------------------------


* Number of enquiries entered and tracked weekly


* Number of quotations prepared and sent


* Quotation\-to\-order follow\-up completion rate


* Number of overdue follow\-ups


* Average quotation turnaround time


* Number of completion certificates collected


* Pending payment follow\-up ageing


* Number of customer documents pending


* Agency deliverables completed on time


* CRM/Excel/ERP update accuracy percentage


**Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs) \& Measurement**
--------------------------------------------------


### **Enquiry tracking discipline**


**Measurement:** 100% of enquiries entered within 24 hours


### **Quotation turnaround**


**Measurement:** Standard quotes sent within agreed TAT


### **Follow\-up discipline**


**Measurement:** No follow\-up overdue beyond 48 hours


### **Documentation accuracy**


**Measurement:** PO/PI/quotation errors below defined tolerance

title: Territory Manager - Hydrebad
description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**
**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.** 
**At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**
**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**
**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**
**Your Role: Territory Sales Manager \- Poultry**
 As a Territory Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving sales growth and strengthening Elanco’s presence in the assigned region by engaging with veterinary professionals, farm owners, and distributors. Your role will focus on building strong customer relationships, executing company strategies, and ensuring timely product movement and payment collection.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities:**
* Meet with veterinarians and other key customers to promote animal health products and generate profitable sales.
* Collaborate with distributors to drive product liquidation and encourage repeat purchasing.
* Follow up on outstanding payments from customers and distributors to ensure timely collections.
* Implement company strategies in the field, monitor competitor activity, and provide timely feedback.
* Achieve sales targets and maintain accurate records of customer and territory data.


**What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Veterinary Science, Animal Husbandry, Agriculture, or a related field.
* Experience: Prior experience in animal health or pharmaceutical sales, preferably in a territory\-based role.
* Top Skills: Strong communication, relationship management, and sales execution skills.


**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (preferred qualifications):**
* Strong understanding of the animal health market, including veterinary channels and livestock farming.
* Experience working with distributors and managing accounts receivable.
* Proven ability to meet sales targets and execute field strategies effectively.
* High levels of ethics, self\-discipline, and accountability.
* Proficiency in reporting systems and Microsoft Office tools.


**Additional Information:**
* Location: Based in India – field\-based role covering an assigned sales territory.
* Travel: Frequent travel required within the assigned region for customer engagement and distributor meetings.
* Must attend company meetings and training sessions as scheduled and comply with all company policies and reporting systems.


 Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown underrecognized groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Elanco we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive work environment. If you think you might be a good fit for a role but don't necessarily meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this role or other roles!
   

  

 Elanco is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status
   

  

 Elanco may use automated tools, including AI, to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications against job‑related criteria and/or transferrable skills. These tools help ensure a consistent, structured evaluation, but they do not make hiring decisions. All decisions involve a human reviewer. For more information on how we handle personal data, please see our Elanco Workforce Privacy Notice.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Job Title: Corporate Sales Manager
 



 Location: New Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Ahmedabad, Kolkata, and more
 



  





 CTC: 5 to 9 LPA (Fixed) \+ 3\-10 LPA (Incentives) \+ 5\-12 Lacs in ESOPs
 



 Commitment: Full\-Time (WFO)
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 As a Corporate Sales Manager at Amitoje India, you will dive into the dynamic world of retail display sales, focusing on large brands and corporations. This role is a blend of strategy, persistence, and people skills, requiring you to master the art of communication, negotiation, and salesmanship under pressure. You'll engage in continuous calling, meeting, pitching, and navigating through complex sales cycles and stakeholder relationships, all aimed at closing significant deals and driving the company's growth.
 



  





**Your Daily Mission:** 




 ● Intensive Engagement: Spearhead the sales process by engaging in an extensive amount of calling and meeting, aiming for over 30 significant client interactions per month to pitch our innovative products and solutions.
 



 ● Strategic Negotiation: Employ your negotiation prowess to not just meet but exceed sales targets, while skillfully handling various client situations and internal team dynamics.
 



 ● Comprehensive Management: Be adept at managing the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing deals, including meticulous CRM logging and reporting.
 



 ● Resilience Under Pressure: Thrive in a high\-pressure environment, demonstrating your ability to push projects across the finish line, regardless of the hurdles encountered.
 



  





**What We Look For:** 




 ● Deep Corporate Sales Experience: Proven track record in corporate sales, with a keen understanding of selling to large brands, navigating complex stakeholder dynamics, and the specific challenges of B2B sales. Experience in B2C or channel sales may not be relevant for this role.
 



 ● Personality Traits: We seek individuals with unyielding drive, exceptional problem\-solving skills, integrity, high energy, and a natural flair for engaging with people. Your ability to remain undeterred in the face of rejection and your persistence in achieving your goals will define your success in this role.
 



  





**Why Amitoje India:** 




 ● Work with Prestigious Brands: Engage with some of the biggest names in the industry, representing our cutting\-edge and innovative products.
 



 ● Respect and Recognition: Your efforts and achievements are recognized and valued, offering you a platform to shine.
 



 ● Unmatched Growth Potential: With opportunities for constant learning and career advancement, the role promises a journey that never gets stale. Our fair and motivating incentive structure, alongside the potential for ESOPs, ensures your hard work is adequately rewarded.
 



 ● Dynamic and Supportive Environment: Thrive in a culture that champions growth, learning, and success, supported by a team that’s as driven as you are.
 



  





**Join Us If:** 




 You're someone who sees opportunity in challenge, understands the depth of corporate sales, and possesses the drive, problem\-solving capabilities, and integrity required to excel. With Amitoje India, you’re not just taking on a job; you’re stepping into a role that demands excellence and offers the rewards to match. Are you prepared to push your limits and achieve greatness?

title: Sales - Engineering Polymers and Compounds
description:
Sales \| Engineering Polymers and Compounds
 



  





**About the Company** 




  





 We’re partnering with a high\-growth, Series A venture\-backed specialty chemicals technology platform that is modernizing global industrial supply chains. By combining R\&D capabilities, global supply partnerships, and tech\-enabled distribution, the company enables B2B manufacturers to reliably source high\-performance chemical inputs and materials. Built on a foundation of rapid growth and strong investor backing, the business is scaling a lean, highly specialized team with an ambitious roadmap toward a $500M business by 2030\.
 



  





 To support the launch of a brand\-new commercial vertical focused on
 **Engineering Polymers and Compounds** 
 , the company is seeking driven, field\-intensive sales professionals (hiring at Sales Manager / Senior Manager / Regional Manager levels based on experience) to build customer territories from the ground up across major manufacturing hubs in India.
 



  





 📍
 **Location:** 
 Delhi / NCR, Mumbai, or Bengaluru (Candidates near manufacturing hubs in Gujarat or Chennai also considered)
 



 🗺️
 **Market:** 
 India Manufacturing Ecosystem (Engineering Polymers, Compounds \& Additives)
 



 🚗
 **Travel:** 
 Field\-intensive (Expected 10–15 customer meetings per week)
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




  





 This is a greenfield sales leadership opportunity for a true commercial builder. Rather than managing legacy accounts, you will take ownership of uncharted territory, opening doors, developing application\-based solutions, building a robust pipeline, and converting early\-stage opportunities into recurring revenue.
 



 Working directly alongside founder\-led leadership, you will play a foundational role in establishing market presence for this new division. If you are commercially hungry, understand the polymer ecosystem, and enjoy spending time in the field closing deals with SME promoters and manufacturing leaders, this position offers direct line\-of\-sight to long\-term commercial leadership.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Territory Development \& Customer Acquisition** 



* Own business development for the Engineering Polymers, Compounds, and Additives portfolio across your assigned region.
* Identify and build relationships with target manufacturers (₹50 Cr to ₹500 Cr revenue), engaging SME promoters, business owners, procurement leads, and technical stakeholders.
* Build a structured account list from the ground up, prioritizing high\-value commercial opportunities.



**Revenue Generation \& Pipeline Conversion** 



* Own and hit ambitious monthly and annual sales targets, aiming to scale toward \~₹1 Cr in monthly revenue within the first 3\-4 months of ramping.
* Manage the complete sales cycle in Zoho CRM from initial cold outreach and discovery to technical evaluation, commercial negotiation, and order closure.
* Drive high\-volume field activity, conducting 10\-15 customer meetings weekly to maintain a healthy project funnel.



**Application \& Consultative Solution Selling** 



* Position the product portfolio as cost\-effective, high\-performance drop\-in replacements for incumbent materials.
* Work closely with technical and product teams to map customer application requirements, coordinate sample trials, and evaluate performance.
* Gather on\-the\-ground market intelligence regarding pricing dynamics, competitor offerings, and emerging material demands.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





**Required Experience** 



* Years of B2B field sales experience within Engineering Polymers, Engineering Plastics, Compounds, Masterbatches, Polymer Additives, or closely allied specialty materials.
* Demonstrated track record of building new territories, acquiring new key accounts, and achieving aggressive revenue targets.
* Strong familiarity with Indian manufacturing clusters across regional hubs (Delhi/NCR, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Karnataka, or Tamil Nadu).
* Proven success selling to SME promoters, business heads, procurement teams, and plant technical staff.



**Key Skills** 



* Engineering Polymer \& Compound Application Knowledge
* Greenfield Business Development \& Cold Prospecting
* Field Sales Execution \& High\-Cadence Account Visits
* Drop\-In Replacement \& Solution\-Based Selling
* Commercial Negotiation \& Closing
* Pipeline Management \& CRM Hygiene (Zoho CRM experience is a plus)



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




  





 We are looking for an action\-oriented sales professional who thrives on autonomy and field activity.
 



 The ideal candidate will:
 


* Have deep market fluency in engineering polymers, compounds, or specialty additives.
* Be commercially confident and skilled at navigating pricing negotiations with Indian business owners.
* Take absolute accountability for revenue outcomes rather than just meeting activity metrics.
* Demonstrate high integrity, transparent communication, and a willingness to share market insights with internal teams.
* Be excited by the prospect of building a new business unit from scratch rather than inheriting existing accounts.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




  





 The successful candidate will:
 


* Rapidly establish a qualified opportunity pipeline and achieve early revenue traction (\~₹1 Cr/month target post\-ramp).
* Convert initial sample trials and technical evaluations into repeatable commercial supply contracts.
* Build long\-term strategic relationships with key promoters and manufacturing leaders in the territory.
* Lay the foundation for regional sales expansion, opening up opportunities for future team leadership.



  





**Why Join?** 




  




* **Ground\-Floor Opportunity:** 
 Help launch and scale a brand\-new commercial vertical within a venture\-backed tech\-enabled platform.
* **Aggressive Career Growth:** 
 Direct path from individual contributor to regional or national commercial leadership as the business unit scales.
* **Direct Access to Founders:** 
 Work alongside experienced serial entrepreneurs and investment leaders.
* **High Ownership \& Autonomy:** 
 Full freedom to manage and build your territory with minimal micromanagement and maximum accountability.

description:

 BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud\-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high\-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000\+ real devices and browsers.
 



  





 With over 1,200 employees and a remote\-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto\-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
 



  





 Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. description:
**Freight Forwarding \& LCL Consolidation — Customer Service / Procurement / Documentation / Sales** 




  





**Company:** 
 Kenshine Group ·
 **Location:** 
 Mumbai, Maharashtra (On\-site) ·
 **Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About Kenshine Group** 




 Kenshine Group has been moving cargo for Indian exporters and importers since 1989\. We are a multimodal logistics provider and an accredited Authorized Economic Operator (AEO), delivering port\-to\-door, door\-to\-port and door\-to\-door solutions across ocean, air and surface. Our services span freight forwarding, LCL consolidation, customs brokerage, third\-party logistics, warehousing, surface transportation and specialised packing, through Kenshine Global Logistics Private Limited, Kenshine Shipping Private Limited and Kenshine Logistics Private Limited.
 



  





**About the openings** 




 We are expanding our Freight Forwarding and LCL Consolidation business in Mumbai and are hiring across four functions. Candidates at all levels — from freshers to experienced professionals — are encouraged to apply; the role and responsibilities will be matched to your experience.
 



  





**Customer Service** 




 Own a set of accounts end to end: booking confirmations, space planning with carriers and co\-loaders, milestone updates to shippers and consignees, and resolution of delays, roll\-overs and exceptions. You are the single point of contact the customer calls.
 



  





**Procurement** 




 Source and negotiate ocean, air and LCL rates with carriers, NVOCCs, consolidators and overseas agents. Maintain the rate grid, close spot buys against live enquiries, and protect margin on every shipment without compromising transit or reliability.
 



  





**Documentation** 




 Prepare and verify shipping bills, bills of lading, delivery orders, manifests, certificates of origin and export/import documentation. Coordinate filings with customs, carriers and CFS/ICDs, and keep records audit\-ready against AEO and regulatory requirements.
 



  





**Sales** 




 Develop new business among exporters, importers and trade partners in the Mumbai market. Map prospects, quote and convert enquiries, build long\-term account relationships, and work with Procurement and Customer Service to deliver what you sell.
 



  





**What we are looking for** 



* Interest in, or experience with, freight forwarding, LCL consolidation, customs clearance or 3PL operations
* Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to deal directly with customers, carriers and overseas agents
* Working knowledge of MS Office; familiarity with a logistics or ERP system is an advantage
* Accuracy and attention to detail — in this business, a wrong document number is a real cost
* A graduate degree in any discipline; qualifications in Logistics, Supply Chain, International Trade or Commerce are preferred
* Willingness to work on\-site in Mumbai



  





**Why Kenshine** 



* 35\+ years in the trade, with an established network of carriers and overseas agents
* AEO\-accredited operations and strong compliance standards
* Direct exposure to the full shipment lifecycle rather than one narrow task
* A small, senior team where good work is visible

title: Field Engineer - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Field Engineers to partner with prospective and strategic enterprise customers. As a Field Engineer, you’ll be the technical face of Anysphere in the field, helping customers evaluate Cursor, guiding them through proofs of concept, and ensuring they see the full value of AI in their engineering workflows.
   

  

 You’ll work hand\-in\-hand with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope solutions, demonstrate capabilities, and act as a trusted advisor to technical stakeholders. This is a highly customer\-facing role where you’ll combine deep technical fluency with strong communication skills to drive adoption and influence product direction.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Partner with Account Executives to lead technical discovery, demos, and proof\-of\-concept engagements
* Build trusted relationships with engineering leaders, architects, and developers, serving as their technical advisor
* Translate customer requirements into solution designs, guiding them on best practices for rollout, prompt strategy, and context configuration
* Develop and deliver technical presentations, whiteboard sessions, and hands\-on workshops tailored to customer needs
* Act as the customer’s technical advocate internally, influencing roadmap priorities and escalating feedback to Product and Engineering
* Collaborate with post\-sales teams to ensure a smooth handoff and successful customer onboarding
* Maintain deep knowledge of Cursor’s capabilities and competitive landscape to position our value effectively
* Support strategic account planning and help drive expansion opportunities with technical validation


**You may be a fit if**
* You have strong communication skills and executive presence, equally comfortable coding alongside developers or presenting to CTOs.
* You have a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, modern engineering org structures, and developer productivity challenges
* You have hands\-on technical ability, and while you don’t need to be a full\-time engineer, but you should be fluent in technical workflows, AI tooling, and debugging complex environments
* You are customer\-obsessed with a knack for translating technical details into business impact
* You have experience in Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre\-Sales, or Consulting for enterprise software
* You thrive in a startup environment: resourceful, adaptable, and proactive in creating solutions

title: Founders office
description:
Founder’s Office – Strategy, Business Development \& Operations
 



  





 KS Legal \& Associates \| Mumbai
 



  





 About the Role
 



  





 KS Legal is looking for a highly driven, sharp and entrepreneurial individual to work directly with the Founder as part of the Founder’s Office.
 



  





 This is not a conventional desk job. We are looking for someone who can operate as an extension of the Founder someone who can think independently, manage people, build relationships, drive business, represent the firm professionally and take ownership of whatever needs to get done.
 



  





 The role will involve working across strategy, operations, client management, business development, PR, networking, presentations, research and special projects.
 



  





 You should be comfortable moving between a client meeting, a team discussion, a pitch presentation, a networking event and an internal operational issue and be able to handle each with confidence.
 



  





 What You Will Do
 



  





 1\. Founder’s Office \& Execution
 



  





 \* Work closely with the Founder on day\-to\-day strategic and operational priorities.
 



 \* Convert the Founder’s ideas and discussions into actionable tasks and ensure timely execution.
 



 \* Follow up with internal teams, clients, external stakeholders and vendors.
 



 \* Manage multiple priorities simultaneously and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
 



 \* Identify problems independently and find solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
 



 \* Prepare briefs, reports, trackers, presentations and updates for the Founder.
 



 \* Assist with special projects and initiatives undertaken by the firm.
 



  





 2\. Team Management
 



  





 \* Coordinate and manage different teams and workstreams.
 



 \* Allocate and follow up on tasks and monitor timelines.
 



 \* Ensure accountability and execution across the team.
 



 \* Identify bottlenecks and escalate important issues to the Founder.
 



 \* Help create systems, processes and workflows to improve the firm’s efficiency.
 



 \* Maintain discipline around deadlines, deliverables and follow\-ups.
 



  





 3\. Business Development \& Client Acquisition
 



  





 \* Identify and develop potential clients and business opportunities.
 



 \* Build and maintain relationships with founders, promoters, CXOs, investors, professionals, companies and other relevant stakeholders.
 



 \* Assist in converting relationships and conversations into mandates.
 



 \* Research prospective clients and understand their business and legal requirements.
 



 \* Participate in client meetings and business discussions.
 



 \* Prepare pitches, proposals, credentials and presentations.
 



 \* Follow up on leads, proposals and prospective mandates.
 



 \* Develop new channels for business generation and strategic partnerships.
 



 \* Represent KS Legal at networking events, conferences and industry forums.
 



  





 4\. Client Relationship Management
 



  





 \* Maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
 



 \* Understand client requirements and coordinate internally to ensure effective delivery.
 



 \* Track important client conversations, follow\-ups and opportunities.
 



 \* Ensure a high\-quality client experience.
 



 \* Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships.
 



  





 5\. PR, Media \& Brand Building
 



  





 \* Work with the Founder and external/internal PR teams on the firm’s positioning and visibility.
 



 \* Identify relevant media opportunities, publications, interviews, panels and speaking opportunities.
 



 \* Assist with journalist outreach and PR pitching.
 



 \* Coordinate thought\-leadership opportunities for the Founder and the firm.
 



 \* Help develop content, presentations, articles, opinions and other external communications.
 



 \* Track relevant industry conversations and identify opportunities for KS Legal to participate.
 



  





 6\. Presentations \& Communication
 



  





 \* Create high\-quality presentations, pitch decks, business proposals and internal presentations.
 



 \* Assist the Founder in preparing for important meetings, pitches and speaking engagements.
 



 \* Develop clear and compelling written and verbal communication for clients and external stakeholders.
 



 \* Present confidently when required.
 



  





 7\. Research \& Strategic Projects
 



  





 \* Conduct business, industry, competitor and market research.
 



 \* Track developments relevant to the firm’s practice areas and clients.
 



 \* Identify new sectors, industries and opportunities for the firm.
 



 \* Assist in developing new practice areas, initiatives and business strategies.
 



 \* Prepare concise research notes and actionable insights for the Founder.
 



  





 8\. Travel \& External Representation
 



  





 \* Travel with the Founder or independently for client meetings, conferences, networking events and business development initiatives, as required.
 



 \* Represent KS Legal professionally in meetings and external events.
 



 \* Coordinate logistics and preparation for meetings, events and travel.
 



  





 What We Are Looking For
 



  





 We are looking for an owner, not an order\-taker.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will be:
 



  





 \* Highly proactive and self\-driven.
 



 \* Extremely organised and excellent at follow\-ups.
 



 \* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced and demanding environment.
 



 \* Strong in communication, presentation and relationship\-building.
 



 \* Commercially aware and interested in business development.
 



 \* Confident interacting with senior professionals, founders, CXOs and clients.
 



 \* Comfortable managing teams and holding people accountable.
 



 \* Excellent at preparing presentations and written material.
 



 \* Comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities.
 



 \* Someone who can independently take a problem, figure out what needs to be done and execute it.
 



 \* Presentable, professional and confident in external interactions.
 



 \* Willing to travel and attend meetings/events when required.
 



 \* Someone who genuinely enjoys networking, meeting people and building relationships.
 



  





 The Most Important Quality
 



  





 You should not need to be told what to do at every step.
 



  





 If the Founder says, “We should explore this client / event / opportunity,” you should be able to research it, identify the right people, initiate contact, prepare the pitch, coordinate the meeting, follow up and report back — without needing instructions for every individual step.
 



  





 Who This Role Is For
 



  





 This role would suit someone who wants exposure to business, law, entrepreneurship, strategy, leadership and client management rather than being restricted to one functional role.
 



  





 You will work closely with the Founder and get a first\-hand view of how a professional services business is built, managed and scaled.
 



  





 Experience
 



  





 Any level of experience preferred, although exceptional candidates from consulting, business development, startups, professional services, PR, strategy, law or similar backgrounds may be considered.
 



  





 A legal background is not mandatory.
 



  





 What matters more is intelligence, ownership, communication, commercial instinct, execution ability and the ability to build relationships.
 



  





 Location
 



  





 Mumbai
 



  





 The role will involve regular interaction with the Founder, team members, clients and external stakeholders, along with travel and attendance at meetings/events as required.
 



  





 What We Expect
 



  





 \* High ownership
 



 \* Strong work ethic
 



 \* Excellent follow\-through
 



 \* Confidentiality and discretion
 



 \* Professionalism
 



 \* Attention to detail
 



 \* Speed of execution
 



 \* Ability to prioritise
 



 \* Strong relationship\-building skills
 



 \* Willingness to do whatever is required to get the job done
 



  





 What You Can Expect
 



  





 \* Direct exposure to the Founder and leadership of the firm.
 



 \* Significant responsibility and autonomy.
 



 \* Exposure to high\-value clients and business relationships.
 



 \* Opportunity to participate in business development, strategy, PR and growth initiatives.
 



 \* A fast\-learning environment with substantial ownership.
 



 \* Opportunity to grow into a senior leadership/business role within the organisation.
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who wants to build, not simply execute a job description.

title: Assistant Manager – Business Operations & Lender Partnerships
description:
**Manager / Assistant Manager – Business Operations \& Lender Partnerships** 




**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Experience:** 
 2–5 years
 



**Function:** 
 Business Operations
 



**Industry:** 
 Fintech / Digital Lending / NBFC / Banking
 



**Reporting:** 
 Senior Management
   





**About Supermoney** 




 Supermoney is an enterprise\-led Supply Chain Finance platform working with large corporate anchors, their MSME dealer/vendor ecosystems, and multiple banks and NBFCs.
 



 We manage the operating layer across anchor programmes, borrower acquisition, lender coordination, credit movement, limit activation and utilisation. The role therefore sits at the intersection of
 **business, credit and execution** 
 .
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We are looking for a high\-ownership Business Operations professional who can act as the execution bridge between
 **Sales, Credit, Operations, Anchors and our lending partners** 
 .
 



 This is not a conventional back\-office operations or MIS role.
 



 The person will own the movement of business from
 **opportunity → lender allocation → credit evaluation → sanction → limit activation → utilisation** 
 , identify bottlenecks before they become escalations, and help management improve conversion, turnaround times and lender performance.
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable getting into individual cases when required while simultaneously maintaining a portfolio\-level view of pipelines, lender capacity, ageing and operational priorities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Lender \& Case Execution** 



* Own day\-to\-day business coordination across Supermoney's active banks and NBFC partners.
* Drive cases from initial lender allocation through credit evaluation, sanction, documentation, limit activation and first utilisation.
* Maintain disciplined follow\-up on lender queries, approvals and pending actions, with clear ownership and escalation.
* Ensure Sales and lender pendencies are identified and acted upon within agreed TATs, with a target of
 **95%\+ actionable items addressed within 48 hours** 
 .
* Track lender\-wise available capacity, NTB appetite, programme limits, policy changes and operational constraints so that cases are routed appropriately.
* Identify sanctioned\-but\-not\-live and live\-but\-not\-utilised cases and drive them to commercial closure.



  





**2\. Pre\-Sales \& Case Quality** 



* Conduct an initial business and documentation review of
 **non\-FLDG cases** 
 before submission to lending partners.
* Assess whether the case is broadly aligned with the relevant lender programme/policy and ensure basic documentation readiness.
* Work with Sales and Credit to close obvious gaps before lender submission, thereby reducing avoidable queries and rework.
* Build institutional knowledge of lender appetite, credit filters and common rejection/deviation themes to improve sourcing quality and conversion.



**This role will not independently underwrite or sanction credit; final credit decisions remain with the relevant lending institution / Credit team.** 




  





**3\. Anchor Programme Operations** 



* Own business operations for assigned anchor programmes, initially including Supermoney's IT/ITES and other key enterprise relationships.
* Coordinate across the Anchor, lender, Sales, Credit and internal Operations teams to ensure smooth onboarding and programme execution.
* Track programme\-level pipeline, sanctions, activations, utilisation and unresolved issues.
* Act as the central internal owner for operational escalations affecting an assigned programme.
* Support activation and scaling of new anchor\-lender programmes once commercial and credit structures have been agreed.



  





**4\. Business Control Tower \& MIS** 



* Maintain a single, accurate view of the business pipeline across stages including:
* Pre\-sales / documentation
* Login
* Credit WIP / lender queries
* Awaiting sanction
* Sanctioned
* Processing fee / documentation pending
* Limit activation pending
* Live but undisbursed
* Utilisation
* Monitor ageing at every stage and highlight exceptions rather than merely reporting totals.
* Prepare concise daily/weekly management dashboards covering lender TATs, programme performance, bottlenecks, conversion and actions required.
* Ensure CRM and business trackers remain aligned and materially accurate.
* Gradually help reduce manual reporting by working with Product/Data teams to systemise recurring MIS.



  





**5\. Lender \& Programme Performance** 



* Track lender\-wise conversion, sanction TAT, activation TAT, utilisation and key reasons for rejection/pendency.
* Identify cases where lender performance, programme structure or internal processes are constraining business.
* Provide management with actionable observations such as:
* cases that can be moved to alternate lenders;
* programmes where available limits are underutilised;
* recurring policy/deviation issues;
* anchor programmes requiring intervention; and
* bottlenecks preventing sanctioned limits from generating AUM.



  





**6\. Policy, Deviation \& Incentive Roll\-outs** 



* Coordinate implementation of lender/programme deviation matrices, sourcing filters and business incentive structures.
* Ensure changes are clearly communicated to the relevant Sales and Operations teams.
* Maintain current versions of programme\-level operating guidelines and key lender requirements.



  





**7\. Cross\-functional \& Strategic Execution** 



* Work closely with Sales, Credit, Operations, Finance, Product and senior management on high\-priority business initiatives.
* Take ownership of short\-cycle projects and management priorities where strong coordination and execution are required.
* Build processes where recurring activities currently depend on individual follow\-up or manual intervention.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 The person should be able to independently:
 


* Run the lender/business operating rhythm without senior\-management intervention on routine matters.
* Maintain high visibility on every material case and programme bottleneck.
* Ensure \>95% of actionable Sales/lender pendencies are addressed within agreed TAT.
* Reduce ageing between sanction and limit activation.
* Improve quality of cases reaching lending partners.
* Improve conversion of sanctioned limits into active/utilised AUM.
* Produce concise, accurate management MIS with clear actions—not simply data.
* Become the internal go\-to person for understanding where each key lender programme and business pipeline stands.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 We would prefer candidates with
 **2–5 years of experience** 
 in one or more of the following environments:
 


* Fintech / digital lending platform
* NBFC or Bank – SME/MSME lending
* Supply Chain Finance / Channel Finance
* Lending partnership / alliance operations
* Credit or Sales Operations in a multi\-lender environment



 Prior experience coordinating with
 **multiple Banks/NBFCs** 
 and handling MSME lending cases will be strongly preferred.
 



  





**Key Skills** 



* Strong understanding of SME/MSME lending lifecycle from sourcing through sanction and activation.
* Ability to understand lender policies and identify obvious case\-fit/documentation gaps.
* Very strong stakeholder management and follow\-up discipline.
* Ability to push Sales teams and lender teams equally firmly while maintaining relationships.
* High comfort with Google Sheets / Excel, CRM systems, pipeline MIS and data analysis.
* Ability to convert data into actions and escalations.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* High attention to detail without losing sight of business outcomes.
* Ability to operate comfortably in a fast\-moving, entrepreneurial environment with changing priorities.



  





**The Kind of Person We Are Looking For** 




 This role will suit someone who naturally asks:
 



**“What is stopping this case from moving, who needs to act, and by when?”** 




 rather than someone whose role ends after updating the status in a tracker.
 



 We are looking for someone who is
 **structured, commercially aware, persistent and execution\-oriented** 
 , and who wants to build the operating backbone of a rapidly scaling MSME lending platform.
 



  





**Core Ownership** 




**Lender Execution \| Business Pipeline \| Anchor Programme Operations \| Case Quality \| Sanction\-to\-Activation \| Utilisation \| TAT Management \| Business MIS \| Lender Performance \| Cross\-functional Execution**

 At The VR Company, you will get hands\-on exposure to:

* If you are someone who enjoys communicating with people, organising work, taking ownership, and learning new things, we would love to hear from you.

title: Category Manager
description:
**About the Company** 




 Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high\-quality, standardized, and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



 Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind –
 


1. Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services
2. Partner empowerment: Build a deep, full\-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood
3. Technology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age\-old industry



**About the Role \& Team** 



* The Category Manager is responsible for driving on\-ground operations. This would primarily involve onboarding new partners and improving the quality of the existing partner base
* This includes end\-to\-end ownership of the initiative, including problem solving, analysis, process improvement, and execution
* Support Business Heads in BAU category management activities related to supply/demand planning, revenue planning



**What you’ll Do:** 



* Drive onboarding of great service professionals in the category – involves thinking through the full supply chain – sourcing, selection, and training of partners.
* Be part of projects that are focused on improving customer and partner experience
* Collaborate with cross\-functional internal partners in marketing, technology, and product to execute multiple category and central\-level projects



**What we need:** 



* Sharp and hungry professionals willing to go above and beyond to create impact
* 6 months –2 years of work experience
* Proficient in advanced Excel/ SQL/ Tableau/Power BI
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, requires solving ambiguous problems, and is highly outcome\-oriented. We will look for candidates who display these characteristics and demonstrate the ability to solve problems on the ground.
* Hustle and get things done attitude



**What can you expect:** 



* A great work environment with massive ownership and growth opportunities.
* Work closely with strong leaders who are amongst the best in the country when it comes to operational excellence and consumer obsession
* A lot of freedom and ownership to propose and change the way we do things. We still believe it is Day 0 and are hungry to improve and change
* Growth opportunities within UC via our robust internal mobility program



  





 At Urban Company, we are committed to providing equal and fair opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We endeavor to maintain a work environment free from harassment based on age, color, physical ability, marital status, parental status, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

Company: Lakyou Beauty

Role: Marketplace Ads Executive

Experience: 1–3 Years

Location: Mumbai

Employment Type: Full\-Time

About the Role

Lakyou Beauty is looking for a results\-driven Marketplace Ads Manager to manage and optimize advertising campaigns across Amazon and Flipkart. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience in marketplace advertising, PPC campaign management, keyword targeting, bid optimization, and performance analysis.

The candidate will be responsible for driving product visibility, increasing sales, improving ROAS, controlling ACOS/TACOS, and maximizing the overall performance of Lakyou Beauty's marketplace business.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, create, manage, and optimize Amazon PPC and Flipkart Ads campaigns.

Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display and relevant marketplace advertising formats.

Conduct keyword research and identify high\-performing, long\-tail, competitor, and product\-specific keywords.

Manage exact, phrase, and broad match keyword campaigns.

Set up and optimize negative keyword and negative product targeting to reduce irrelevant spend.

Monitor and optimize CPC bids, budgets, placements, targeting, and campaign performance.

Analyze campaign performance and optimize campaigns to improve ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, CTR, CPC, CVR, and CPA.

Identify high\-performing and underperforming ASINs/SKUs and recommend appropriate advertising strategies.

Monitor competitor products, pricing, visibility, keywords, and advertising activities.

Manage daily and monthly advertising budgets across Amazon and Flipkart.

Scale profitable campaigns while controlling unnecessary ad spend.

Analyze search term reports and regularly add relevant keywords and negative keywords.

Monitor marketplace sales, ad\-attributed sales, impressions, clicks, conversions, and organic ranking.

Coordinate with the catalog/content team to improve product titles, bullet points, descriptions, images, keywords, and A\+ content for better conversion.

Support new product launches by creating appropriate marketplace advertising strategies.

Plan advertising campaigns around Amazon/Flipkart sales events, festive periods, and promotional campaigns.

Monitor listing health, suppressed/blocked listings, Buy Box\-related issues, and other factors affecting ad performance.

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly marketplace advertising performance reports.

Provide actionable insights and recommendations based on campaign and marketplace data.

Continuously test new keywords, targeting methods, bids, budgets, and campaign structures.

Stay updated with the latest Amazon Ads, Flipkart Ads, marketplace PPC strategies, and e\-commerce trends.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, E\-Commerce, or a related field.

1–3 years of hands\-on experience in Amazon PPC / Marketplace Advertising.

title: RCGTH - Domain Consultant

About the role
  
As a Domain Consultant – RCGTH, you will make an impact by shaping compelling, insight\-led client propositions across Retail, Consumer Goods, Travel, and Hospitality, translating client priorities into differentiated solution narratives, business cases, proposals, and thought leadership. You will be a valued member of the Business Development team and work collaboratively with sales, pre\-sales, consulting, solutioning, solution architects, practice leaders, account teams, delivery teams, alliance partners, and clients.
  
In this role, you will
  
Act as a domain strategist and trusted advisor to sales, business development, consulting, and solutioning teams, researching and synthesizing industry trends, client priorities, market shifts, competitor activity, and emerging technologies across the RCGTH portfolio.
  
Translate client business needs into domain\-led solution themes, capability maps, value propositions, transformation roadmaps, and proposal narratives.
  
Support opportunity qualification and pursuits by developing compelling content for proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, executive presentations, solution storyboards, battle cards, and account\-specific point\-of\-view documents.
  
Shape differentiated go\-to\-market narratives and build reusable RCGTH assets such as industry trend summaries, value maps, use\-case libraries, case studies, reference architectures, and competitive positioning materials.
  
Contribute to practice development through thought leadership, market intelligence, and offering development, and mentor junior business development and pre\-sales associates.
  
Work model
  
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Mumbai. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
What you must have to be considered
  
10\-15\+ years of experience in domain consulting, business development, pre\-sales, industry advisory, digital transformation, or solution consulting, with a Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, Marketing, or a related discipline.
  
Strong understanding of Retail, Consumer Goods, Travel, and Hospitality business models, value chains, customer journeys, operating models, and industry\-specific priorities.
  
Proven experience developing proposals, solution narratives, executive presentations, market research outputs, thought leadership, business cases, or go\-to\-market assets.
  
Familiarity with key RCGTH transformation themes and relevant enterprise platforms and technology ecosystems, including CRM, commerce, contact center, data and analytics, AI/GenAI, marketing technology, order management, ERP, and digital experience platforms.
  
Demonstrated ability to convert ambiguous client needs into structured problem statements, value propositions, and outcome\-oriented recommendations while collaborating across cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.
  
These will help you succeed
  
An MBA or equivalent consulting experience.
  
Familiarity with CRM and customer engagement technologies such as Salesforce (Sales, Service, Marketing, Experience, Data, and Commerce Cloud, and Agentforce), Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP Customer Experience, Adobe Experience Cloud, and ServiceNow Customer Service Management.
  
Awareness of emerging themes such as hyper\-personalization, omnichannel experience, connected loyalty, intelligent fulfillment, sustainable operations, AI\-enabled workforce, and unified customer intelligence.
  
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to articulate business value, support ROI narratives, and align proposed solutions to client priorities.
  
Excellent research, synthesis, writing, communication, and presentation skills, with confidence engaging senior sales, account, consulting, and client stakeholders.
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Delivery Solutions Architect
description:
CSQ427R264


At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilising the the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
  

  

As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey. You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform in your customers. You will also help ensure customer success by increasing focus and technical accountability to our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate usage on Databricks workloads that they have already selected, helping them maximise the value they get of our platform and the return on investment.
  

  

This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestration of other focused/ specialised teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon. This is in parallel to being technical, with expectations being that you become the post\-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. This requires you to use your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate at all levels with an organisation. You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization.
  

  

**The impact you will have:**
* Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritised customers
* Lead the post\-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
* Be the accountable technical leader assigned to specific use cases and customer(s) across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, success, go\-live and healthy consumption of the workloads where the customer has made the decision to consume Databricks
* Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, oftentimes services multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
* Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services and Support resources, along with escalating to expert level technical experts to build the right tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise
* Create, own and execute a point\-of\-view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
* Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews and upgrade needs
* Develop an execution plan that covers all activities of all customer\-facing technical roles and teams to cover the below work streams:
	+ Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production
	+ Enablement / user growth plan
	+ Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision)
	+ Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning \& optimization)
	+ Executive and operational governance
* Provide internal and external updates \- KPI reporting on the status of usage and customer health, covering investment status, important risks, product adoption and use case progression \- to your Technical GM

**What we look for:**
* 10\+ years of experience where you have been accountable for technical project / program delivery within the domain of Data and AI and where you can contribute to technical debate and design choices with customers
* Programming experience in Python, SQL or Scala
* Experience in a customer\-facing pre\-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role
* Understanding of solution architecture related distributed data systems
* Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables
* Technical program, or project management including account, stakeholder and resource management accountability
* Experience resolving complex and important escalation with senior customer executives
* Experience conducting open\-ended discovery workshops, creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis and managing delivery of complex programmes/projects
* Track record of overachievement against quota, Goals or similar objective targets
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience
* Can travel up to 30% when needed

**About Databricks**


Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

* Reviews, monitors and analyses financial performance in collaboration with the Country Finance against established goals and benchmarks by managing relevant revenue workstreams including driving cost efficiency and savings without impacting customer or brand experience.

The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting\-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. This role requires strong leadership, stakeholder management, and the ability to coach and develop team members. The Team Leader will collaborate with branches, field representatives, and internal teams to align sales strategies, drive sales campaigns, and improve overall team performance. The role also requires strong technical sales skills to effectively communicate and sell complex products/services to customers

 oLead, mentor, and develop a team of Inside Sales Associates, ensuring they meet sales targets, maintain strong customer relationships, and adhere to company standards.
   

  

 oSet clear expectations for team performance, implementing corrective actions and training initiatives to drive both individual and team success.
   

  

 oFoster a collaborative and high\-performing culture, providing regular feedback, coaching, and mentoring.
   

  

 oConduct performance evaluations and identify growth opportunities for team members through structured development programs.
   

  

* Driving Sales Campaigns: Lead and execute sales campaigns within the assigned region, collaborating with the team to implement strategies that drive revenue and growth.

* CRM \& Reporting: Ensure accurate tracking of sales activities, customer interactions, and team progress through CRM tools, providing regular updates and performance reports to leadership.
* Technical Sales Skills: Demonstrate a strong understanding of the technical aspects of products/services and communicate them effectively to customers. Provide insights into how the products/services can meet specific customer needs and solve challenges. Collaborate with technical teams for product demonstrations, customized solutions, and resolving complex customer queries.
* Conflict Resolution \& Problem\-Solving: Strong problem\-solving skills to address challenges effectively and provide actionable solutions, both for the team and customers.


**Skills Required**

* Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to coach and motivate a diverse team.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively.
* Ability to drive and manage sales campaigns, aligning with overall business objectives.
* Experience in performance management, including identifying areas of improvement and implementing corrective actions.
* Proficiency in CRM software and MS Office.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities and a customer\-focused mindset.
* Knowledge of environmental science and waste management is a plus.
* Strong technical sales skills and understanding of the products/services being sold.
* High integrity, strong work ethic, and results\-driven approach.
