title: MANAGER- PRE SALES& LEAD CONVERSION
description:
Position: MANAGER – PRE\-SALES \& LEAD CONVERSION

Department: Sales \& Pre\-Sales

Location: Gurugram

Reporting To: Business Head / Director – Sales

Experience: 4–8 years in Real Estate Pre\-Sales, Tele\-Sales, Lead Conversion or Customer Acquisition

Industry Preference: Residential Real Estate / Luxury Real Estate / Plotted Developments / Premium Housing

Salary: 6 Lakh\-9Lakh/Year

⸻

1\. ROLE PURPOSE

The Manager – Pre\-Sales \& Lead Conversion will be responsible for managing the complete pre\-sales process from the time a lead is received until it is successfully converted into a qualified prospect and site visit.

The role requires strong communication, sales follow\-up, lead nurturing and team\-coordination skills, with a sharp focus on lead\-to\-site\-visit conversion.

The candidate will act as the primary link between Digital Marketing, Pre\-Sales and the Sales/Closing Team.

⸻

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Lead Management

\* Receive and monitor leads generated through Meta, Google, portals, website, WhatsApp and other marketing channels.

\* Ensure all fresh leads are contacted promptly.

\* Understand the prospect’s requirement, budget, location preference, purpose of purchase and purchase timeline.

\* Categorise leads into Hot, Warm, Cold and Not Qualified.

\* Maintain accurate lead records and follow\-up status in the CRM/database.

B. Lead Calling \& Qualification

\* Personally handle important/fresh incoming leads.

\* Conduct structured telephonic conversations to understand customer requirements.

\* Explain relevant project/product information and generate customer interest.

\* Identify genuine buyers and prioritise leads based on buying intent.

\* Handle initial objections related to price, location, project, payment plans and possession timelines.

\* Qualify prospects before transferring them to the Sales Team.

C. Follow\-up \& Lead Nurturing

\* Establish a systematic follow\-up process for every qualified lead.

\* Maintain regular contact through calls and WhatsApp.

\* Follow up with customers who are not immediately ready to visit.

\* Reactivate old, dormant and previously unresponsive leads.

\* Develop long\-term relationships with prospects until they are ready for a site visit.

\* Ensure no genuine lead is left unattended or without a defined next follow\-up date.

D. Site Visit Conversion

\* Convert qualified enquiries into confirmed site visits.

\* Coordinate with the Sales Team regarding availability and customer requirements.

\* Confirm site\-visit appointments with customers.

\* Send relevant project information, location details and appointment confirmations through WhatsApp.

\* Follow up with customers who cancel, postpone or do not turn up.

\* Track Lead → Qualified Lead → Appointment → Site Visit conversion.

E. Team Management

\* Supervise the Pre\-Sales / Telecalling Executive(s).

\* Allocate leads and databases appropriately.

\* Monitor daily calling and follow\-up activity.

\* Review pending follow\-ups and ensure timely action.

\* Conduct daily/weekly performance reviews with the telecalling team.

\* Train team members on calling scripts, project knowledge, objection handling and follow\-up techniques.

\* Escalate high\-value and high\-intent prospects to the Sales/Closing Team.

F. CRM \& Reporting

\* Ensure complete and accurate CRM/database updation.

\* Maintain records of calls, conversations, follow\-ups and customer requirements.

\* Prepare daily and weekly pre\-sales reports.

\* Track source\-wise lead performance.

\* Monitor lead ageing and follow\-up pending reports.

\* Provide feedback to Digital Marketing regarding lead quality and campaign performance.

⸻

3\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

The role will primarily be measured on quality and conversion, not merely the number of calls made.

Primary KPIs

\* Lead\-to\-Contact Ratio

\* Qualified Lead Conversion

\* Lead\-to\-Site\-Visit Conversion %

\* Number of Qualified Site Visits Generated

\* Site Visit Show\-up Ratio

\* Follow\-up Completion %

\* Lead Response Time

\* Old/Cold Lead Reactivation

\* Sales\-qualified leads handed over to Sales Team

Secondary KPIs

\* CRM accuracy and discipline

\* Daily calling productivity

\* Follow\-up ageing

\* Customer response rate

\* Team productivity

\* Lead quality feedback to Marketing

⸻

4\. DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Manager is expected to:

1\. Review all fresh leads received.

2\. Ensure immediate contact with new enquiries.

3\. Review pending follow\-ups.

4\. Personally handle high\-value/high\-intent prospects.

5\. Monitor the telecalling executive’s activity.

6\. Qualify prospects and schedule site visits.

7\. Coordinate confirmed visits with the Sales Team.

8\. Review cancelled/no\-show visits and initiate re\-follow\-up.

9\. Update CRM and ensure every active lead has a clear next action.

10\. Submit an end\-of\-day performance report.

⸻

5\. REQUIRED SKILLS

\* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

\* Strong telephonic sales and follow\-up ability.

\* Good understanding of real estate sales cycles.

\* Ability to identify genuine buying intent.

\* Strong objection\-handling and negotiation skills.

\* Excellent follow\-up discipline.

\* Customer relationship management skills.

\* Ability to work with CRM and lead\-management systems.

\* Strong ownership of targets and results.

\* Ability to manage and motivate a small pre\-sales team.

\* Professional and presentable personality.

⸻

6\. CANDIDATE PROFILE

The ideal candidate should be:

\* Experienced in real estate pre\-sales / inside sales / tele\-sales.

\* Comfortable handling high\-value residential property enquiries.

\* Target\-oriented and persistent without being overly aggressive.

\* Strong at converting conversations into appointments and site visits.

\* Comfortable working with digital leads from Google and Meta campaigns.

\* Capable of managing both fresh and old databases.

\* Data\-driven and disciplined in CRM usage.

Experience with premium/luxury residential projects, plotted developments, floors, villas or NRI clientele will be an advantage.

⸻

7\. AUTHORITY \& OWNERSHIP

The Manager will have ownership of the pre\-sales funnel from lead receipt until site\-visit generation.

The position is expected to work closely with:

Digital Marketing → Pre\-Sales → Sales → Site Team → Closing

The Manager will also provide regular feedback to Management regarding:

\* Lead quality

\* Campaign performance

\* Customer objections

\* Market response

\* Pricing feedback

\* Competitor activity

\* Reasons for lead drop\-offs

⸻

8\. SUCCESS IN THE ROLE

The Manager will be considered successful when the organisation consistently achieves:

MORE QUALITY LEADS → FASTER RESPONSE → BETTER QUALIFICATION → STRONGER FOLLOW\-UP → MORE SITE VISITS → MORE SALES

The core objective is simple:

“Every genuine enquiry must be systematically followed up and converted into a qualified sales opportunity and, wherever possible, a site visit.”

The Franchise Development Executive will serve as the primary point of contact (POC) for all / assigned franchise and peripheral centres. The role involves ensuring smooth business operations, driving admissions growth, maintaining operational compliance, enhancing centre performance, and building strong relationships with Centre Directors, Coordinators, and stakeholders.

The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and business development skills while being comfortable with **frequent travel and fieldwork.**

**Key Responsibilities**

Ø **Franchise Relationship Management**

* Act as the primary relationship manager for all assigned franchise and partner centres.
* Build and maintain strong professional relationships with Centre Directors, Coordinators, and key stakeholders.
* Resolve operational challenges and escalations promptly.
* Ensure franchisees receive timely support and guidance.

Ø **Business Growth \& Revenue Enhancement**

* Drive admissions growth across all assigned centres.
* Monitor enquiry\-to\-admission conversion performance.
* Develop and execute centre\-specific growth strategies.
* Identify opportunities for expansion and market penetration.
* Assist centres in achieving monthly, quarterly, and annual business targets.

Ø **Operations Management**

* Ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations across all centres.
* Monitor implementation of SOPs, policies, and operational standards.
* Conduct operational audits and compliance checks.
* Ensure proper execution of academic and non\-academic processes.

Ø **Lead Management \& Admissions Support**

* Distribute and monitor leads generated by the organization.
* Track lead follow\-ups and conversion activities.
* Review counselling quality and admission processes.
* Support centres in improving conversion ratios.

Ø **Training \& Development**

* Conduct regular training sessions for Centre Coordinators, Counsellors, and support staff.
* Train teams on sales processes, CRM usage, student management, and SOP implementation.
* Identify skill gaps and create improvement plans.
* Ensure consistency in service delivery across centres.

Ø **Performance Monitoring**

* Conduct daily, weekly, and monthly review meetings.
* Monitor centre KPIs and performance metrics.
* Prepare performance reports and improvement action plans.
* Track admissions, revenue, collections, attendance, and operational compliance.

Ø **Branch Visits \& Centre Audits**

* Conduct regular centre visits to ensure quality standards.
* Review infrastructure, branding, student experience, and operational efficiency.
* Submit detailed visit reports with observations and recommendations.
* Ensure corrective actions are implemented within defined timelines.

Ø **Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate between Head Office departments and franchise centres.
* Ensure smooth communication regarding academic schedules, marketing campaigns, examinations, and events.
* Facilitate timely resolution of inter\-departmental issues.

Ø **Student \& Parent Experience**

* Ensure high\-quality student and parent engagement.
* Take appropriate steps to manage student grievance
* Monitor complaint resolution and service standards.
* Work with centres to improve retention and satisfaction rates.

Ø **Reporting \& Documentation**

* Maintain detailed records of meetings, visits, performance reviews, and action plans.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly business reports.
* Track centre\-wise performance dashboards and improvement initiatives.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Graduate/Post Graduate in Business, Management, Marketing, Education, or related fields.
* 2–5 years of experience in any sales and operations.
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills.
* Strong leadership and team management abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets.
* Willingness to travel extensively.
* Ability to handle multiple centres simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset.

 : As the Senior Application Expert (LV Drives), the candidate will be the technical backbone of our new LV business vertical. Reporting directly to the Channel Sales Head, this role's primary mandate is to create technical "pull" in the market by converting complex engineering specifications at the consultant, OEM, and end\-user levels. The candidate will bridge the gap between sales and technology—equipping our internal regional sales team and our channel partners (System Integrators and Distributors) with the application expertise needed to win high\-value, application\-specific business. The candidate will be coordinating with HIES/HINC for application code / software development if required to support local team to apply carry forward same OEMs in India.
 



  





**Department:** 
 Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Position Reporting to:** 
 Channel Sales Head\- Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 Responsible for meeting the LV1 Module Technical Support:
 



 1\.Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for complex, heavy\-duty, and specialized LV VFD applications across industries (e.g., crane/hoist, tension control, multi\-drive systems, Compressors, Extruders, high\-speed pumps/fans, and HVAC systems, Machinery, Level 1 Automation).
 



 2\.Conduct joint technical visits with channel partners to key OEMs, Industrial End\-Users, and Automation Consultants to influence technical specifications in favour of our Japanese technology.
 



 3\.Analyze customer technical requirements, perform sizing, selection, and configuration of drives, and prepare robust, foolproof technical proposals. Troubleshoot complex application challenges during the pre\-sales phase to demonstrate product superiority and build customer confidence.
 



 4\.Design and deliver structured technical training programs, product certification courses, and application workshops for System Integrators (SIs), Value Added Resellers (VARs), and Distributors.
 



 5\.Create a self\-reliant channel ecosystem by empowering partner engineers to handle standard configurations and basic commissioning independently.
 



 6\.Provide continuous technical mentoring and application support to the internal team of 7–8 regional channel managers.
 



 7\.Perform deep technical benchmarking against key competitors (e.g., ABB, Siemens, Danfoss, Schneider, Fuji, Yaskawa Etc) to identify our product USPs and counter competitor arguments.
 



 8\.Develop localized application notes, success stories, and technical whitepapers to support the field sales team.
 



 Gather market intelligence on required product modifications, software features, or customized firmware, feeding this data back to the global Japanese R\&D and Product Management teams.

**Experience**

 Experience of LV Drive Application knowledge in various fields, PLC programming, code writing, Good Presentation skills, Training ability

 LV Drive market knowledge and product knowledge. Gujarati, Hindi and English language proficiency. Should be local resident, ready to travel across India.

description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
   

  

**Job Summary**
**Your Career**
 Working together with a Solutions Consultant,, you will be responsible for growing your territory. You are the primary point\-of\-contact for India’s one of the largest conglomerate group and are accountable for delivering above quota sales performance in your region. You are motivated by a hunger to solve critically difficult challenges that face our clients. You develop trusted relationships at a high, executive level, focusing on the strategic nature of the partnership. This means that you have a concrete understanding of our product suites, and are able to help identify areas that can be resolved by Palo Alto Networks solutions.
   

  

 You will lead to identifying and signing appropriate channel partners as well as training them on our solutions. Additionally, your credibility will guide your customers in their search to transition to a more secure online environment. You feel empowered by our product offerings \- and love a technical challenge.
   

  

**Your Impact**
* You will specifically be responsible for managing a strategic Conglomerate group
* Employing world\-class account management skills to identify cross\-selling and up\-selling opportunities within the target accounts
* Be a highly competent presenter, with a proven track record in selling to C level executives
* Develop and maintain detailed account profiles including organisational charts for all accounts to be reviewed by management on a quarterly basis
* Facilitate communication on strategic and tactical issues facing our clients and partners
* Maintain continuity and up\-to\-date knowledge of industry trends, technical developments, and governmental regulations that affect target markets
* Develop market strategies and goals for each product and service; understand the strategies, goals, and objectives of accounts
* Lead coordinating account strategy and tactics for sales support team (inside sales, systems engineering, sales management)
* Take full responsibility for accurate sales forecasting by demonstrating in\-depth knowledge of sales cycles from initial contact through the procurement process
* Extensive domestic travel and possible International travel as necessary


**Qualifications**
**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

Role summary

Own day\-to\-day Meta (Facebook/Instagram) advertising for ecommerce clients — from campaign build to scaling — with direct accountability for spend efficiency and revenue outcomes.

* Plan, launch and manage Meta ad campaigns across the full funnel: Advantage\+ Sales, prospecting, catalogue retargeting and remarketing.

* 3\+ years managing Meta Ads with demonstrable D2C/ecommerce scaling results (share account/spend scale in interview).
* Hands\-on with Advantage\+, catalogue ads, CAPI/Pixel setup, and audience strategy.
* Comfortable with Shopify, GA4 and Meta reporting; can read data and act on it, not just pull numbers.
* Strong grasp of creative\-performance relationship and testing discipline.

\> Good to have

* Experience with server\-side tracking (GTM/Stape), TikTok Ads, or Google Ads.
* Agency background managing multiple ecommerce accounts.

\> What success looks like

Sustained, profitable scaling of client accounts against blended MER/CAC targets, with clean tracking and a consistent creative testing pipeline.

title: Assistant District Sales Manager- Surat Location
description:
**Company Description**  

We take care of our employees, and they take care of our customers!


Become a member of a global community! The international logistics industry is an integral piece of the global trade puzzle; we make the world go round. Global supply chain management is what we do, and at the heart of Expeditors you will find professionalism, leadership, and a friendly environment, all of which foster an innovative, customer service\-based approach to logistics. Expeditors is a global logistics company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. As a Fortune 500 company, we employ over 19,000 trained professionals in a worldwide network of over 350\+ locations across six continents. Expeditors satisfies the increasingly sophisticated needs of international trade through customized solutions and seamless, integrated information systems.


Our Mission


We recruit, train, and retain the very best logistics and technical experts the world over. **We love to promote from within** \- more than 50 percent of our employees have been at Expeditors for five years or more. Our high retention rate is influenced by a unique compensation program for positions that are more than just jobs \- they're chances to grow, do what you love and build a career with us!

 **Job Description**  

The focus of the Assistant District Sales Manager is on achieving results that are aligned with the overall organization and it's strategic goals. Initiative, coupled with a sense of competitive drive, and the ability to stay focused on results despite changing conditions, are the keys to achieving the performance objectives of the District Sales Executive role at Expeditors.


The ADSM orchestrates involvement of multiple people in our Sales process, so that new customer revenue is consistently secured for our district office and Expeditors network. The job environment is flexible, constantly changing, and provides growth opportunity, recognition and reward for the achievement of business results. This position reports to the District Sales Manager.

**Key Deliverables**


These are the minimum results expected from a successful District Sales Executive:

* Manage an assigned territory and demonstrate extensive knowledge of potential customers and competitors in this area
* Timely data entry in our Customer Relationship Management tool
* Orchestrate customer / branch relationships and collaborate with regional Product, Service, Geo, and Knowledge Management resources
* Participate in the creation of value\-added solutions for customer's logistics needs, including supporting diagrams and cost\-benefit calculations
* Support the transition of new accounts through customer introductions, information transfer, and securing any necessary customer paperwork. When needed, support AR (accounts receivable) collection.
* Attend training \& development sessions to continue developing selling skills and updating Expeditors Product and Service knowledge
* Involvement in local trade groups, as directed by the District Sales Manager
* Take on additional assignments as required, supporting company needs

  

**Qualifications**  

* Must have at least 3\-5 years of Sales experience in Freight Forwarding industry
* The ability to meet with customers off\-site on a regular basis
* Oral and written proficiency in the English language
* Strong problem solving, organizational, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work productively both individually and in a team environment
* Sense of urgency for goal achievement
* Self\-motivated with ability to work in a fast\-paced and constantly changing environment
* Comfortable with regular data entry on a laptop computer
* Strong rapport and relationship\-building focused
* Empowered to make quick decisions in response to changing conditions
* Extroverted, confident, enthusiastic and persuasive
* Influences others to action
* Timeliness and accountability for results

  

**Additional Information**  

Expeditors offers excellent benefits:

* Paid Vacation, Holiday, Sick Time
* Health Plan: Medical
* Life Insurance
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Training and Personnel Development Program
* Growth opportunities within the company
* Employee Referral Program Bonus

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vastu Housing Finance Corporation Ltd., based in Mumbai, is a housing finance company focused on delivering responsible and sustainable credit solutions across India. The organization prioritizes financial inclusion by serving underserved and self\-employed communities in peri\-urban and rural areas, enabling homeownership and long\-term financial stability. Using deep local insights and its proprietary technology platform, Pulse, Vastu provides simple, swift, and customized housing finance solutions that bridge the formal credit gap. As of March 2025, Vastu has supported over 100,000 customers, many with modest monthly incomes and limited documentation, who traditionally struggle to access formal credit. With operations across 15 states and union territories and 340\+ districts, the company offers a decade\-long track record of strong governance, consistent profitability, and robust asset quality.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time, on\-site Relationship Manager role is based in Tamil Nadu, India. The Relationship Manager will manage and grow a portfolio of housing finance customers, guiding prospective borrowers through the end\-to\-end loan lifecycle from lead generation and initial inquiry to documentation, credit assessment support, disbursement, and post\-disbursement relationship management. Daily responsibilities include sourcing new business in designated markets, conducting customer visits, understanding customer income profiles and housing needs, and explaining loan products, terms, and processes in a clear and ethical manner. The role involves coordinating with credit, operations, and collections teams to ensure timely processing, compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements, and maintaining strong asset quality. The Relationship Manager will also monitor customer accounts, address service issues, encourage timely repayments, and represent Vastu as a trusted partner in local communities.
   

**Qualifications**
* Customer relationship management skills with the ability to build trust, understand needs, and maintain long\-term borrower relationships.
* Business development and sales skills, including lead generation, field sourcing, and closing housing finance opportunities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills in English and local languages, with the ability to explain financial products clearly and respectfully.
* Basic financial analysis and credit understanding, including assessment of income profiles, documentation, and repayment capacity.
* Familiarity with housing finance, retail lending, or broader financial services, especially in peri\-urban and rural markets.
* Comfort with using digital tools and platforms (mobile apps, CRM systems, and loan management systems) to manage customer data and workflows.
* Ability to work on\-site in the field, travel within assigned territory, and operate independently while adhering to company policies and compliance standards.
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in business, finance, commerce, or a related field; prior experience in housing finance or NBFCs is an advantage.

But you might be missing two things: a product that genuinely disrupts its category, and a compensation structure where your effort compounds instead of resetting to zero every quarter.
 



  





 We are a fast\-growing, highly agile deeptech company looking for a seasoned sales professional to build and scale our outbound sales function. You won't just be executing someone else's playbook; you will be helping to write it.
 



  





**What We Do** 




 Tuck is an AI\-powered virtual try\-on platform for global e\-commerce apparel brands. We solve a fundamental problem: shoppers hesitate to buy when they can't visualize the fit, leading to abandoned carts and high return rates. Tuck allows shoppers to see garments on their own photos, matched perfectly with brand size charts, directly driving up merchant conversions.
 



  





 Unlike competitors using off\-the\-shelf AI wrappers, we built a proprietary pipeline that delivers unmatched realism on actual retail catalogs. Our leadership team has a proven track record of building category\-defining technology, having previously built India’s first cashierless store technology which was successfully acquired by Amazon.
 



  





 The Role Your focus will be entirely on selling Tuck to founders and e\-commerce heads of D2C fashion brands globally. You will open conversations, diagnose their store's bottlenecks, demonstrate our solution using their own product catalogs, and close deals.
 



*Crucially: You won’t spend your days hunting for leads.* 
 We provide a researched, qualified pipeline. Your job is to drive the conversation. You will also have a seat at the table to shape our pitch, target segments, and go\-to\-market strategy.
 



  





**The Compensation** 



* **Fixed Base:** 
 ₹40,000 – ₹60,000 monthly, commensurate with experience.
* **Closing Incentives:** 
 Uncapped per\-client bonuses scaled to the plan they choose.
* **Recurring Commission:** 
 5% of your client's monthly subscription fee for their first 12 months. Your income grows with your book of business.
* **Target Earnings:** 
 Realistic OTE (On\-Target Earnings) for a strong performer is
 **₹1,00,000 – ₹1,25,000/month** 
 , scaling higher as your recurring portfolio builds.



  





**Who We're Looking For** 



* **Experience:** 
 Minimum 3 years in B2B technology sales (SaaS, software, or IT products).
* **Communication:** 
 Exceptional, confident spoken English. You must be comfortable speaking peer\-to\-peer with global founders.
* **Business Acumen:** 
 A deep curiosity about business metrics. You should be able to intelligently discuss Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), conversion rates, return logistics, and profit margins—not just recite software features.
* **Resilience:** 
 Comfortable owning a revenue target, managing a pipeline, and navigating the reality of B2B sales.
* *Advantageous:* 
 Familiarity with Shopify/e\-commerce ecosystems, strong CRM discipline, and experience in international markets.



  





**What to Expect** 




 You will work directly with the founders, receiving hands\-on product training from day one. You are joining early enough that whoever successfully builds this function will eventually lead it.
 



 We value transparency: building a solid client base takes time, and we maintain a clear performance bar for the first three months, which will be transparently discussed prior to an offer. We offer a dynamic environment where you experience real ownership rather than just acting as a cog in an existing machine.
 



  





**How We Hire** 




 Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a live mock sales call (product details will be provided in advance).

title: Solution Engineer Sales
description:
**About Unosecur**
 Unosecur is a fast\-growing, Pre\-Series A startup with $5M in funding. We're a B2B security SaaS platform making identity security smarter and simpler for enterprises worldwide, with sales teams across the USA, Europe, and India.
   

  

 You'll be part of a diverse team working on cybersecurity and AI, with opportunities to solve complex problems and build production\-grade AI capabilities.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're hiring a Solution Engineer based in Bengaluru to provide technical presales support and drive Proof of Value / Proof of Concept engagements during the sales cycle, including with C\-level stakeholders. You'll partner closely with Account Executives to own the technical win in complex sales cycles.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the technical win. Partner with Account Executives and GTM to drive complex sales cycles from initial discovery to technical wins.
* Tailor the narrative. Translate complex technical identity risks into business value — explain an IAM policy misconfiguration to a DevOps Engineer, then explain the business impact of that risk to a CISO five minutes later.
* Execute high\-velocity PoVs. Run frictionless Proof of Values. Our technology connects via APIs and shows value in minutes — guide the customer through that data, highlighting critical identity risks (toxic combinations, shadow admins, over\-privileged roles) in their environment.
* Be a trusted advisor. Become a deep subject\-matter expert on Identity Security across cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity providers (Okta, Entra ID), and business apps (Snowflake, GitHub) for clients and partners.
* Represent the voice of the customer. As an early member of the team, your feedback loop to Product and Engineering is critical — translate customer use cases and business requirements into clear feature requests to shape the roadmap.
* Evangelize. Represent Unosecur at industry conferences, webinars, and in technical blog posts.


**What You'll Need**
* 5\+ years of experience in Solution Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Technical Consulting within the SaaS or cybersecurity space
* Strong conceptual understanding of the major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) — how companies structure their cloud (organizations, projects, subscriptions) and the common security challenges they face
* Solid foundation in security concepts such as Identity and Access Management (IAM), Identity \& Access Governance (IAG), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Least Privilege, Zero Trust, and compliance standards
* Exceptional ability to present technical solutions to non\-technical audiences — can run a demo and handle objections with confidence
* Proven discovery skills: asking the right questions to uncover customer pain points and mapping them to technical solutions
* Startup agility: prior experience in early or growth\-stage startups, with a bias toward action and comfort with ambiguity


**Nice to Have**
* Experience selling or working with identity providers (Okta, Entra ID) and cloud security tools (Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca)
* Able to read and explain scripts as well as REST APIs
* Certifications such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals, or similar

title: Technical Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Intelense, founded in December 2018, develops advanced AI software that converts complex, unstructured data into clear, actionable insights for organizations worldwide. The company began with real\-time video analytics for public spaces and now supports decision\-making and marketing intelligence across multiple industries. Its AI\-driven solutions identify trends, consumer behavior, and operational inefficiencies while integrating into existing infrastructures without major upgrades. At the core is KenAI, powering products such as KenVision, KenRobotics, and KenIoT to deliver intelligent event detection, behavior learning, and anomaly detection through seamless integration with IoT sensors, cameras, and video systems. KenRobotics further extends this capability with drones and autonomous mobile robots that provide granular insights and predictive maintenance to drive efficiency.
   

**Role Description** 
 As a Technical Sales Manager at Intelense, you will lead end\-to\-end sales activities for AI and analytics solutions, focusing on building and growing strategic customer relationships. This full\-time, on\-site role is based in the Greater Bengaluru Area and involves collaborating closely with product and engineering teams to understand solution capabilities and translate them into compelling value propositions for prospective and existing clients. title: Digital Pre-Sales Executive
description:
**Role description** 




 We are looking for a Digital Pre\-Sales Executive to be the first point of contact for customers who enquire with us through digital channels. The role involves understanding customer requirements, qualifying leads, building initial trust, explaining our services, and converting qualified enquiries into design consultations/site visits/appointments for the sales team. The ideal candidate should be confident, articulate, commercially aware, and comfortable speaking with homeowners who are looking to invest in their interiors.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Respond promptly to leads generated digital channels.
 



 • Contact new leads through calls and WhatsApp within defined response timelines.
 



 • Understand the customer's requirements and qualify leads based on defined business criteria.
 



 • Maintain accurate and updated lead information in the CRM.
 



 • Explain the company's services, process, timelines, pricing approach, warranty, and key differentiators.
 



 • Build trust and establish a positive first impression of the brand.
 



 • Address basic customer questions and objections effectively.
 



 • Follow up or re\-engage leads who were previously unresponsive or not ready to proceed with leads who have not yet confirmed.

 • Provide feedback to Marketing on lead quality and campaign performance.
 



 • Support continuous improvement of lead qualification and communication processes.

 • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 



 • Strong conversational and persuasion skills.
 



 • Ability to understand and qualify customer requirements quickly.
 



 • Comfortable speaking with customers over the phone and WhatsApp.
 



 • Good objection\-handling and negotiation skills.
 



 • Strong follow\-up discipline.
 



 • Good working knowledge of CRM systems, WhatsApp, Excel/Google Sheets, and basic digital tools.
 



 • Ability to work with targets and performance metrics.
 




 • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple leads simultaneously.

 • 1 – 3 years of experience in pre\-sales, tele\-sales, lead qualification, customer relationship management, or digital sales.

 Compensation: 2\.4 – 3\.6 LPA

Customer experience and satisfaction are central, with a commitment to exceptional quality at competitive prices. Reminiscent Interior Design aims to simplify the interior design journey and has successfully completed numerous projects in a short time.

**About The Role**
 As a Domain Strategist – Life Sciences, you will make an impact by crafting compelling, insight\-led proposals and bid responses for life sciences clients across the pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, and diagnostics sectors. You will be a valued member of the Life Sciences Business Development team and work collaboratively with Sales and Solutioning teams to map client needs to solution capabilities and communicate clear business value to clients and key stakeholders.
   

  

**In this role, you will**
* Act as a trusted advisor to Sales and Solutioning teams, articulating the business value of Cognizant Moment solutions within the Life Sciences industry and converting client business requirements into domain\-led solution options.
* Drive domain content for proposals and bids, including win themes, solution storyboards, qualification responses, battle cards, and competitive one\-pagers that help sales quickly articulate differentiation.
* Stay current on the Life Sciences ecosystem of product partners and Cognizant proprietary industry solutions and accelerators, mapping client use cases to strengthen proposal differentiation.
* Curate reusable solution assets and reference architectures that accelerate proposal turnaround for Life Sciences opportunities.
* Contribute to Life Sciences practice offerings, case studies, and thought leadership, mentor junior BD and pre\-sales associates, and provide market intelligence on competitor positioning and emerging client needs.


**Work model**
 At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. title: Solutions Engineer
description:
As a Solutions Engineer, you will act as a trusted technical advisor to prospective customers in the US market. You will own the technical evaluation journey end\-to\-end, from the first discovery call to closing the deal, by demonstrating how our platform solves real\-world data integration challenges. This role involves working closely with global customers (primarily North America ), designing scalable architectures, running tailored product demos, and building proofs\-of\-concept that showcase value.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Run technical discovery calls with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs to understand their stack, pain points, and constraints. These are global conversations, primarily with customers in North America and Europe, and you will own them end\-to\-end.
* Design and present reference architectures showing how Hevo fits into their existing data stack (e. g., Salesforce, Postgres, GA4 Snowflake, dbt).
* Run live product demos tailored to the customer's stack. These are not scripted walkthroughs. You will need to read the room, adapt on the fly, and handle unexpected technical questions with confidence.
* Own the technical evaluation from the first conversation to the closed deal by addressing deep technical questions and earning trust with engineering teams.
* Build proofs\-of\-concept by configuring real pipelines from source systems (Salesforce, Outreach, Postgres, MySQL) into destinations like Snowflake or BigQuery.
* Develop deep expertise in the data integration landscape, including native solutions from AWS, GCP, and Azure (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Cloud Dataflow) as well as other data pipeline and integration platforms, and articulate Hevo's technical advantages in a way that lands with both technical and non\-technical buyers.
* Partner with Account Executives to drive technical wins and with Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs after a deal closes.
* Share customer feedback and patterns with Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 2 to 4 years of hands\-on experience as a Data engineer, Analytics engineer, ETL/ELT developer, or Data warehouse engineer.
* Experience building and operating real data pipelines in production, including handling source schema changes, failures, and reliability issues.
* Strong fundamentals in SQL and at least one cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift).
* Experience with at least one orchestration or transformation tool (Airflow, dbt, or similar).
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills.

* You can structure a technical narrative, not just answer questions but guide a conversation toward the right conclusion.

**Good to have:** 



* Experience with CDC tools or data integration platforms, whether cloud\-native (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, or Google Cloud Dataflow) or third\-party pipeline and integration tools.
* Exposure to multiple source system types such as CRMs, ad platforms, SaaS APIs, and OLTP databases.
* Public technical writing, conference talks, or open\-source contributions.
* Prior experience in customer conversations, even informally. For example, presenting to internal stakeholders or analytics teams or working with international teams across time zones.

title: Senior Presales
description:
**BCITS PRIVATE LIMITED** 




**Powering Utility Digitalization Since 1999** 




  





**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




 Presales – Utility Solutions (AMI, Metering, Billing \& Revenue Management)
 



**Department:** 
 Presales \& Business Development
 



**Function:** 
 RFP Analysis, Deliverable Mapping \& Internal Cost Estimation
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Chief Executive Officer
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, Karnataka (travel for pre\-bid meetings and site visits as required)
 



**Industry Domain:** 
 Power, Water \& Gas Utilities AMI, Smart Metering, MDAS/MDM, Billing \& Revenue Management
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





**ABOUT BCITS** 




 BCITS Private Limited, incorporated in 1999 and headquartered in Bengaluru, is a technology partner to the power, water and gas utility sector. Over 25 years, BCITS has delivered more than 100 projects across India as an OEM and system integrator in Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), Meter Data Acquisition, Revenue \& Billing Management, Meter Data Management, CIS, CRM, GIS and Smart/Spot Metering solutions.
 



 Empaneled by the Power Finance Corporation (PFC) as a Meter Data Acquisition Solution Provider under R\-APDRP, BCITS works with state distribution utilities and large System Integrators/EPCs (AMISPs) on turnkey programs that reduce losses, improve revenue and enhance customer service. BCITS is strengthening its presales function to bid accurately and competitively across AMI, RDSS and digital utility transformation programs.
 



  





**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS** 




 Every bid BCITS submits rests on one internal document: the cost sheet. It converts the RFP's scope, deliverables, SLAs and contract terms into every rupee BCITS will spend to execute the project. If the sheet misses a cost, BCITS wins the bid and loses money. If it overstates cost, BCITS prices itself out and does not win. This role owns that sheet.
 



 This is a domain\-first estimation role, not a generalist bid\-coordination or proposal\-writing role. We are looking for someone who has worked inside utility metering, billing or AMI projects, can read an RFP the way a delivery head reads it, and can independently produce a complete, defensible cost workbook that leadership can price from with confidence.
 



  





**ROLE PURPOSE** 




 Own the translation of utility RFPs/tenders into:
 



**(a)** 
 a clear, itemised list of what BCITS must deliver
 



**(b)** 
 a complete internal Excel cost model covering every component and expenditure BCITS will incur across the full contract term with no omissions, no double\-counting and no padding.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 1\. RFP / Tender Comprehension
 


* Read the entire tender pack scope of work, technical specifications, SLAs, payment terms, GCC/SCC, annexures, corrigenda and pre\-bid clarifications and extract precisely what BCITS is obligated to deliver, supply, install, integrate, operate and maintain, and for how long.
* Distinguish explicit deliverables from implied ones (e.g., a data\-migration obligation hidden in an integration clause, a training obligation inside a go\-live milestone, a DR requirement inside an uptime SLA).
* Identify eligibility, compliance and technical conditions that affect cost or bid fit (certifications, MeitY cloud, BIS/IS standards, local\-content rules, consortium terms).
* Flag ambiguities, contradictions and scope gaps and draft pre\-bid queries whose answers directly change the cost model.



 2\. Deliverable Mapping
 


* Prepare a Deliverable Breakdown Structure for each bid: every item BCITS must deliver, the quantity, the specification, the phase/milestone in which it falls and the acceptance condition.
* Validate the breakdown with delivery, solution and O\&M leads so that nothing in the RFP is left unowned internally.



 3\. Internal Cost Estimation (core accountability)
 


* Build the internal cost workbook in Excel for each bid, itemised across the cost heads listed below, with quantities, unit rates, sources of rates, assumptions and the calculation logic visible and auditable.
* Model costs across the full contract life implementation, warranty, O\&M/AMC including escalation, replacement cycles, SLA penalty exposure and cash\-flow impact of milestone\-linked payments.
* Obtain and validate rates from OEMs, telecom/communication partners, cloud providers, subcontractors and internal delivery teams; maintain a current rate library so estimates are not built from stale figures.
* Run sensitivity and scenario views (consumer count, read frequency, hosting model, manpower mix) so leadership can see where the estimate is most exposed.
* Present the cost sheet to the CEO and bid committee with a clear statement of assumptions, risks and confidence level; support margin and pricing decisions with facts, not opinions.



 4\. Bid Support
 


* Attend pre\-bid meetings and site visits; capture clarifications and corrigenda and reflect their cost impact immediately in the workbook.
* Support commercial bid preparation (BOQ/price schedule) so that the submitted price schedule reconciles exactly with the internal cost model.
* Support post\-submission clarifications, negotiations and reverse\-auction rounds with a clear view of the floor price.



 5\. Estimation Discipline \& Learning Loop
 


* Maintain a standard cost\-sheet template and estimation checklist for AMI/metering/billing bids and improve it after every bid.
* Compare estimated vs actual cost on won projects with delivery and finance teams; feed variances back into the template and rate library.
* Maintain a tender tracker with bid outcomes, L1 pricing intelligence and win/loss reasons.



  





**COST HEADS THE ROLE MUST COVER** 




 The candidate should be able to identify, size and price the following from an RFP without being prompted:
 



**Software \& Licences** 




 HES, MDM/MDAS, billing/CIS, CRM, GIS, prepaid, analytics, mobile apps; third\-party licences (DB, OS, middleware, cloud); customisation and integration effort with utility legacy systems.
 



**Hardware \& Field Devices** 




 Meters, communication modules, DCUs/gateways/RF concentrators, network equipment; spares, DOA/warranty replacement, testing and lab charges.
 



**Communication \& Connectivity** 




 RF mesh / RF\-PLC / NB\-IoT / cellular; SIM and data charges over contract life; telecom partner terms.
 



**Infrastructure \& Hosting** 




 Data centre / cloud (on\-prem vs MeitY\-empanelled cloud), DR, sizing for consumer count and read frequency, bandwidth, security compliance, escalation over term.
 



**Manpower** 




 Project management, solution and integration teams, field survey, installation and commissioning crews, helpdesk, O\&M staff — by role, location, duration and rate, including deployment ramp\-up/ramp\-down.
 



**Installation \& Commissioning** 




 Site survey, meter installation and replacement, testing, consumer indexing, data migration, UAT, go\-live support, training.
 



**O\&M / AMC / FMS** 




 Multi\-year operations, SLA\-linked penalties and liquidated damages, annual price escalation, obsolescence and technology refresh.
 



**Commercial \& Compliance** 




 EMD, PBG/security deposit cost, insurance, taxes/GST treatment, payment\-milestone cash flow and working\-capital cost, retention money, price\-variation clauses.
 



**Risk \& Contingency** 




 Quantified contingency for scope ambiguity, exchange rate, delayed site readiness, AMISP/SI consortium dependencies and change\-request exposure.
 



  





**MUST\-HAVE REQUIREMENTS** 



* **Domain** 
 Hands\-on utility domain experience: 6–12 years in the power/water/gas utility sector in AMI, smart metering, MDAS/MDM, billing/revenue management or metering\-communication projects in a delivery, solution, project\-management, estimation or presales capacity. Candidates without direct utility\-domain exposure will not be considered.
* **RFP literacy** 
 Has read and worked from utility RFPs/tenders (DISCOM, AMISP, SI/EPC, RDSS, R\-APDRP, IPDS, SMNP) and can explain scope, SLAs, payment milestones and penalty clauses in operational terms.
* **Costing track record** 
 Has personally built or owned bottom\-up cost estimates / BOQs for multi\-component technology projects with software, hardware, manpower and multi\-year O\&M elements; can show a sample or walk through one in interview.
* **Excel** 
 Advanced Excel structured, auditable workbooks with clear assumptions, lookups, scenario tabs and reconciliation checks. This is the primary working tool of the role.
* **Delivery realism** 
 Understands the practical cost drivers of an AMI/metering rollout where projects overrun (site readiness, communication coverage, consumer indexing, integration with legacy billing, O\&M manpower) and how those translate to money.
* **Attention to detail** 
 Demonstrated habit of checking work line by line, reconciling totals and questioning numbers that look wrong. Comfortable being accountable for the accuracy of the estimate.
* **Education** 
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation / Computer Science) or equivalent.



  





**GOOD TO HAVE** 



* MBA (Finance/Operations) or formal exposure to project costing, cost accounting or financial modelling.
* Working relationships with meter OEMs, communication technology providers, cloud/hosting partners or AMISPs.
* Exposure to public procurement norms GeM, e\-tendering portals, EMD/PBG, L1/QCBS evaluation, reverse auctions.
* Experience reconciling estimated vs actual project costs post\-award.



  





**HOW WE WILL ASSESS CANDIDATES** 




 Shortlisted candidates will be given an extract from a real utility RFP and asked to
 



 (1\) list the deliverables,
 



 (2\) build a cost sheet in Excel
 



 (3\) present their assumptions and identify what they would raise as pre\-bid queries. Selection will be based on completeness, domain judgement and clarity of the workbook not presentation polish.
 



  





**KEY COMPETENCIES** 



* Utility domain depth (AMI, metering, billing, revenue management)
* Analytical rigor and numerical accuracy
* Ownership and accountability for outcomes
* Structured, auditable working style
* Clear communication of assumptions and risks to leadership

* Experience managing the technical pre\-sales cycle, from initial scoping and architecture design to the successful delivery of integrated PoVs.

**About the job** 
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the deep technical bridge between customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer Proof\-of\-Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. You will keep the final production end\-state in mind from day one, advocate for AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. title: Founder's Office - Strategy & Operations
description:
**Founder's Office \- Strategy \& Operations** 





 LH2 AI Labs · Bengaluru · Full\-time · On\-site 
 




  





**Mandatory requirement: a bachelor's degree from a premier engineering institute such as IIT, BITS, or NIT, or an MBA from a leading business school such as IIM, ISB, XLRI, or an equivalent institution.** 




  





**About** 





 Built by second\-time founders who have built and sold companies before, LH2 AI Labs (lh2\.ai) is building the post\-training infrastructure for frontier AI models.
 





 We bring private, high\-quality institutional datasets and vetted domain experts to frontier AI pipelines across verticals like coding, computer use, agentic, medical, audio and more.
 





 For AI to keep progressing, it needs high\-quality training data drawn from real production use cases. The public web has already been crawled and trained on – there's nothing left there. That's where we come in: we envision creating a world where frontier models can access data on tap – exactly how they access compute today.
 




  





**The role** 





 We're looking for smart people to lead our revenue function – i.e., our data verticals – coding, finance, company operations, medical, audio, egocentric, and many upcoming verticals.
 





 Leading a vertical means an ownership mindset and owning the entire revenue stack:
 



* Working with frontier models to understand training data requirements
* Finding the right data owners
* Negotiating licensing rights and closing agreements
* Building the delivery data pipelines with our engineering team
* Ensuring seamless delivery




 This is not a role where you'll be making decks or Excel sheets. It's a carry\-a\-number, close\-the\-deal role that happens to sit right next to the founders.
 





 Here's how it works. We point you at a vertical – codebases, medical, audio, whatever's next – and you go build its supply from scratch. You figure out who in the world has the data and expertise we need, work out how to win them, and close them. You own the whole thing: who to approach, in what order, on what terms, and where the moat gets built. Each vertical runs like its own small business, and what you learn in the field shapes what the founders prioritise next.
 





 We can teach you the domain, the data, and the AI landscape. We can't teach you to think on your feet or to want closure. That part you bring.
 




  





**What we're looking for** 



* You can sell. 2\-5 years in sales, partnerships, or BD with a real sales cycle – ideally opening and building new relationships from scratch (new business / new logo, not just managing an existing book). You've carried a number and owned deals end to end.
* Genuinely sharp. Top\-tier education and/or time at well\-regarded companies – you've operated around a high bar, and it shows. You pick things up fast, and you can hold your own in a room.
* Consultative problem\-solver – you read what a counterpart needs, solve the problem in front of you, and build a deal around it.
* Think like an owner – comfortable shaping how your vertical goes to market, not just executing a plan handed to you.
* Comfortable negotiating bespoke, non\-standard terms.
* Sharp on quality: you can tell what's worth closing and what isn't.
* High ownership; thrive in fast, ambiguous environments.
* A generalist who has worked in startups before – hands\-on with tools, automation, and basic scripting, and comfortable figuring things out without a playbook.



  





**Bonus** 



* Prior experience in a programme management role.
* Opened new markets, categories, or accounts from cold – where the relationship didn't exist before you walked in.
* A track record of running many deals at once, against a target, without hand\-holding.
* Sold into small buying committees (fewer than five stakeholders) and know how to move them.
* Prior exposure to AI, data, expert networks, or marketplaces.
* Founder's office, consulting, banking, or operating roles at a high\-growth B2B company.

title: Forward deployed engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineer / Solutions Architect \- Deccan AI
 



**About** 
 :
 



 Deccan AI is a venture\-backed AI infrastructure company ($25M Series A, Prosus Ventures), headquartered in the Bay Area with an engineering hub in Hyderabad. We build the infrastructure layer for Reinforcement Learning and Agentic AI and work with frontier labs including Google DeepMind and Snowflake.
 



  





 Deccan AI builds the data, evaluation, and agentic infrastructure that helps frontier labs and enterprises ship AI that actually works in production. Our Helix and EnterpriseOS platforms put humans and AI side by side to catch failures, close evaluation gaps, and run mission\-critical workflows. As we move from data and evals into full\-scale enterprise deployments, we're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer / Solutions Architect to sit at the center of that motion: embedded with customers, owning the technical relationship, and turning ambiguous problems into shipped, reliable AI systems.
 



  





 This is a customer\-facing, build\-heavy role. You will spend as much time in a client's codebase and infrastructure as you do in a whiteboard session with their VP of Engineering. You are equally comfortable designing an architecture and writing the code that proves it out.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Embed directly with enterprise customers to scope, design, and build production AI solutions on top of Deccan AI's Helix and EnterpriseOS platforms.
* Own the end\-to\-end technical relationship for key accounts: requirements gathering, solution architecture, implementation, deployment, and post\-launch iteration.
* Translate ambiguous, often messy customer workflows into concrete technical designs data pipelines, agent architectures, evaluation harnesses, and integration points with the customer's existing infra.
* Write production\-grade code alongside customer engineering teams; this is not a slideware role.
* Build reusable patterns, tooling, and accelerators from each engagement so the next deployment moves faster than the last.
* Act as the technical voice of the customer internally feeding field learnings back into product and platform roadmaps.
* Debug and resolve issues in live, high\-stakes deployments, often under time pressure and with imperfect information.
* Present architecture, tradeoffs, and rollout plans to both engineering counterparts and executive stakeholders.



**What we're looking for** 



* 4\+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or a forward\-deployed / professional\-services engineering role, ideally with exposure to AI, ML, or data\-intensive systems.
* Strong hands\-on coding ability (Python and/or a modern backend language) you can prototype, productionize, and debug your own work, not just review someone else's.
* Experience designing and deploying systems on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including data pipelines and API\-level integrations.
* Working knowledge of LLM\-based systems: prompting, evaluation, RAG, agentic workflows, or fine\-tuning you don't need to have built a foundation model, but you need to have shipped something that uses one.
* Excellent communication skills you can move fluidly between a technical deep\-dive with engineers and a business conversation with a customer sponsor.
* A bias toward ownership: comfortable being the one person accountable for a customer's technical outcome, without a large team behind you at every step.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed and to work occasionally across customer time zones.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Prior experience in a forward\-deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role at an AI/ML or enterprise software company.
* Experience building or operating evaluation systems for AI agents or LLM applications.
* Familiarity with human\-in\-the\-loop workflows and production monitoring for AI systems.
* Startup experience, particularly in a 0\-to\-1 or early\-scale environment.



  





**Why Deccan AI** 



* Work at the point where AI research meets real enterprise deployment your work ships to production, not to a slide.
* High\-trust, high\-ownership culture: capable people who move fast and hold a high bar.
* Direct exposure to frontier AI labs and enterprise customers solving genuinely hard problems.
* Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and a seat at the table as the company scales.

Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
   

  

 As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
   

  

**Job Function**
 MedTech Sales
   

  

**Job Sub Function**
 Clinical Sales – Surgeons (Commission)
   

  

**Job Category**
 Professional
   

  

**All Job Posting Locations:**
 Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, PENJERLA, Telangana, India
   

  

**Job Description**
 About DePuy Synthes
   

  

 At DePuy Synthes, we are transforming orthopaedic care through intelligent technologies, data\-driven insights, and robotic\-assisted surgery. As part of Johnson \& Johnson MedTech, we are committed to advancing patient outcomes through innovation, education, and clinical excellence.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity to work with industry\-leading robotic and digital surgery platforms, collaborate with renowned surgeons, and contribute to the adoption of next\-generation surgical technologies. We provide world\-class training, professional development, and a dynamic environment where high performers can build a rewarding career.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 The District account manager – Digital Surgery is responsible for driving adoption and utilization of Digital Surgery solutions, including robotic\-assisted surgery platforms, navigation technologies, and data\-enabled surgical workflows within the assigned territory.
   

  

 The role focuses on executing surgeon conversion strategies, developing customer partnerships, supporting clinical excellence, and achieving sales and utilization targets. The District account manager will collaborate closely with Joint Reconstruction sales teams, marketing, clinical specialists, and hospital stakeholders to accelerate the adoption of Smart Surgery solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Business Development \& Sales Growth
   

  

* Drive sales growth and market expansion of Digital Surgery solutions within the assigned territory.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans to increase adoption of robotic\-assisted surgery technologies.
* Identify, prioritize, and convert target surgeons, hospitals, and healthcare systems through structured conversion plans.
* Achieve or exceed assigned sales, utilization, and market development targets.
* Build a sustainable pipeline of opportunities and maintain accurate forecasting.


 Surgeon Engagement \& Customer Development
   

  

* Establish strong relationships with key orthopaedic surgeons, hospital administrators, theatre managers, and clinical teams.
* Drive surgeon conversions through evidence\-based discussions, clinical value propositions, and workflow optimization.
* Support surgeon onboarding and adoption programs to ensure successful technology implementation.
* Act as a trusted advisor to customers by demonstrating clinical, operational, and economic value.


 Clinical \& Technical Support
   

  

* Provide in\-theatre support during robotic\-assisted procedures and technology\-enabled surgeries.
* Deliver product demonstrations, workshops, and educational programs for surgeons and operating room staff.
* Ensure customers are trained and confident in the utilization of Digital Surgery technologies.
* Collaborate with Clinical Specialists to maximize utilization and customer satisfaction.


 Strategic Account Management
   

  

* Develop territory business plans aligned with regional and national objectives.
* Monitor competitive activities, market trends, and customer needs to identify growth opportunities.
* Drive capital equipment opportunities through effective stakeholder engagement and value\-based selling.
* Support contract negotiations, business reviews, and technology utilization assessments.


 Cross\-functional Collaboration
   

  

* Partner closely with Joint Reconstruction Sales, Marketing, Clinical Education, Professional Education, and Service teams.
* Support product launches, customer education initiatives, and strategic marketing programs.
* Contribute to best\-practice sharing and continuous improvement initiatives across the Digital Surgery business.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Achievement of Digital Surgery sales targets.
* Surgeon conversion and adoption metrics.
* Robotic utilization growth.
* New account acquisition and account penetration.
* Customer satisfaction and retention.
* Market share growth within assigned territory.
* Training and education program effectiveness.
* Forecast accuracy and pipeline development.


**Essential**
 Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Physiotherapy, Healthcare, Business, or related discipline.
* Demonstrated success in medical device, healthcare technology, orthopaedics, or capital equipment sales.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced and highly technical environment.
* Strong business acumen and analytical mindset.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Preferred**
* Experience in Orthopaedics, Joint Reconstruction, Surgical Navigation, Robotics, Digital Health, or Operating Theatre environments.
* Experience supporting surgeons during surgical procedures.
* Knowledge of robotic\-assisted surgery technologies and healthcare digital transformation.
* Experience influencing multiple stakeholders in complex hospital sales environments.


 Desired Competencies
   

  

* Strategic Thinking
* Customer Centricity
* Commercial Excellence
* Technical Aptitude
* Clinical Credibility
* Influencing \& Negotiation Skills
* Problem Solving
* Collaboration \& Teamwork
* Adaptability and Resilience
* Results Orientation


 Why Join Us?
   

  

* Work with industry\-leading robotic and digital surgery technologies.
* Comprehensive onboarding and world\-class training programs.
* Opportunities for rapid career growth within Johnson \& Johnson MedTech.
* Competitive compensation and incentive programs.
* Collaborative and inclusive culture.
* Access to award\-winning leadership development programs.
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on surgeon outcomes and patient care.


**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
 Account Management, Business Behavior, Collaboration, Cultural Competence, Customer Analytics, Customer Centricity, Execution Focus, Healthcare Trends, Issue Escalation, Market Knowledge, Market Research, Medical Technology, Sales, Sales Support, Solutions Selling, Sustainable Procurement, Vendor Selection

title: Sales Engineer – CNC Machines & 3D Printing Solutions
description:

**Company:** 
 Adroitec Information Systems Pvt. Ltd.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Mumbai \& Chennai
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2–6 Years
   

  

**Salary:** 
 Up to ₹80,000/month \+ incentives
   

  

**Industry:** 
 CNC Machines \| 3D Printing \| Additive Manufacturing \| Industrial Engineering Solutions
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **Sales Engineer** 
 with strong experience in
 **CNC machine sales and/or 3D printing solutions** 
 to develop new business and manage industrial customers across manufacturing and engineering sectors.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have a combination of
 **technical knowledge and B2B sales experience** 
 , with the ability to understand customer requirements, conduct technical discussions and recommend suitable machinery/solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Identify and develop new business opportunities across manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, defence, medical, engineering and industrial sectors.
* Sell and promote CNC Machines, Industrial 3D Printers, Metal \& Polymer Additive Manufacturing solutions, and 3D Scanners.

* Prepare techno\-commercial proposals and quotations and support commercial negotiations.

* Represent the company at exhibitions, trade shows, seminars and industry events.
* Travel extensively within the assigned territory.

* Bachelor's/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering or related field.
* 2–6 years of experience in technical/B2B industrial sales.
* Experience selling CNC Machines is highly preferred.
* Experience in one or more of the following is an advantage:
+ CNC Machines / Machine Tools
+ VMC / HMC / CNC Turning
+ Industrial Machinery
+ CAD/CAM/CAE
+ Automation
+ 3D Printing
+ Additive Manufacturing
+ 3D Scanners
+ Metrology
+ Manufacturing Solutions
+ Engineering Products


 What We're Looking For
   

  

**Candidates Should Ideally Have**
* Hands\-on experience in selling CNC machines to industrial customers.
* Experience handling OEMs, manufacturing companies and engineering customers.

* Ability to conduct product demonstrations and technical presentations.
* Strong lead generation, negotiation and closing skills.
* Consultative/solution\-selling approach.
* Willingness to travel extensively.
* Good communication and customer relationship management skills.


 💰 What We Offer
   

  

* Salary up to ₹80,000/month, based on experience and suitability.
* Attractive performance incentives.
* Opportunity to work with CNC, 3D Printing, Additive Manufacturing and Industry 4\.0 technologies.
* Career growth in advanced manufacturing and industrial technology.
* Training and continuous learning opportunities.


 📩 Interested?
   

  

 If you have
 **CNC machine sales experience**

title: Manager - Sales
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Senior Manager – Sales (Neonatal \& Infant Care Equipment)
   

  

**Company:** 
 Inkarp Instruments Pvt. Ltd.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**Experience Required:** 
 8 \- 12 Years
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 National Sales Manager
   

  

**About The Role**
 Inkarp is hiring a senior sales professional to grow the sale of
 **infant care equipment** 
 to hospitals. The range covers infant incubators, infant radiant warmers and neonate phototherapy units, along with related
 **neonatal care equipment** 
 such as infusion and syringe pumps. You will own the full sales cycle in your territory and carry the territory target.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deliver the territory sales target for infant care equipment every quarter.
* Build strong relationships with neonatologists, paediatricians, NICU heads, biomedical engineers and hospital purchase teams.
* Generate leads across private hospitals, corporate chains, nursing homes, medical colleges and government institutions.
* Run product demonstrations and clinical evaluations for incubators, radiant warmers and phototherapy units.
* Prepare proposals, manage tenders and handle GeM and government procurement.
* Close orders, coordinate installation and after sales support, and keep the CRM pipeline current.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Eight to twelve years of field sales experience in medical capital equipment, with a clear record in neonatal or infant care equipment sold to hospitals.
* Direct experience selling infant incubators, radiant warmers or phototherapy units.
* Experience gained at an established manufacturer or distributor of neonatal and critical care equipment.
* A strong network of neonatologists, paediatricians and hospital purchase decision makers in the territory.
* Working knowledge of tenders, GeM, government procurement and CRM based pipeline management.


**Qualification**
* A degree in biomedical engineering, life sciences, pharmacy or a management discipline is an added advantage, not a requirement.
* Candidates without these qualifications are equally welcome. Proven sales experience in selling infant care equipment to hospitals is what matters most.


**What We Offer**
* Fixed annual CTC of 10,00,000 to 12,00,000, based on experience.
* Performance incentive of 0\.5 percent of net sales achieved. The incentive applies once 70 percent of the assigned target is met, and is calculated on a pro rata basis.
* The sales target will be shared at the time of joining.
* Travel reimbursement, mobile and data allowance, mediclaim cover and statutory benefits.


**How To Apply**
 Send your resume to
 **recruit@inkarp.co.in** 
 with the
 **subject line: Senior Sales Manager, Neonatal and Infant Care, followed by your city** 
 . Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.
