title: Corporate Sales Manager
description:
**Company Profile:** 









 Webtel Electrosoft Ltd. is a well\-established organization with over 25 years of experience, specializing in delivering comprehensive software and knowledge process outsourcing
 



 solutions, along with a variety of IT\-enabled services. We have a strong presence across major cities, including Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Punjab, and Bangalore. For more information visit www.webtel.in
 



  
 



**Our Advantage (The Edge):** 









 Founded in 2000, Webtel began its journey by providing software solutions focused on "e" compliance. Our commitment to excellence and a customer\-centric approach has driven us to expand into diverse products and services beyond compliance. Our team, comprising Chartered Accountants, Company Secretaries, and legal professionals, collaborates closely with IT experts, positioning Webtel as a unique player in the industry. From a single office in 2000 to a nationwide presence by 2022, Webtel has expanded from a small team of 7 to a workforce of over 500\. With more than 20 product offerings, we maintain our leadership in the industry, guided by our principle: "Customer is Supreme." Recognized as a top provider of taxation software in India, we proudly serve over 35,000 clients, including some of the country’s most esteemed organizations.
 



  
 



**Esteemed Clients Include:** 









 Nestlé, SBI, Food Corporation of India, HCL, ICICI, Ministry of Finance, Dabur, Apollo, Delhi Metro, Woodland, Bajaj, DS Group, FENA, among others.
 



 ·    
 **Work Schedule** 
 : 6 days a week, with alternate Saturdays off.
 



  
 



**Job Description:** 









**A. Prospecting and Sales:** 



* Identify and engage with potential clients to promote Webtel’s software products, generating new business opportunities.
* Develop and implement strategies to expand our client base and schedule product presentations.



**B. Account Management:** 



* Manage existing client relationships, focusing on driving revenue growth through cross\-selling, upselling, and renewals.



**C. Lead Generation and Follow\-Up:** 



* Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline by generating leads and ensuring timely follow\-up.



**D. Collaboration:** 



* Work closely with development and backend teams to ensure client needs are aligned with product capabilities.



**E. Sales Process Management:** 



* Prepare and present proposals, conduct product demonstrations, negotiate terms, and close sales.
* Meet or exceed sales targets as set by the company.



**F. Client Engagement:** 



* Cultivate relationships with key decision\-makers, including senior executives (CXOs, CTOs, CFOs), to identify new sales opportunities.



**G. Sales Execution:** 



* Take ownership of the full sales cycle, focusing primarily on corporate B2B sales.



  
 



**Job Specifications:** 



* Demonstrated problem\-solving capabilities.
* Proven experience in corporate/B2B sales.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
* Self\-assured, persuasive, and adept at closing software sales.
* Professional demeanour, with a confident and engaging personality.

Proven experience supporting RFx responses, client presentations and solution demonstrations.
  
Strong executive presence with excellent communication, storytelling and presentation skills.

Deep CMT industry fluency across 5G/telecom ecosystems, OTT and streaming, digital publishing, AdTech/MarTech, gaming and SaaS business models, with sub\-sector depth in Telecom, Media \& Entertainment or High\-Tech.

Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
   

  

 Gathers customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders as well as the main business sponsor to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects. Identifies and evaluates industry trends (customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry). Adapts business models, plans, and solutions to insights.
   

  

 Works with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach to determine if changes are needed to the business solution. Where the cost of change is accepted by the customer, shares this feedback with the project team and the broader account team to make the necessary adjustments using mechanisms such as updating the solution approach and projected costs in presales and change requests in delivery. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
   

  

 Uses evidence\-based approach to represent the customer/partner as a customer advocate and shares insights with Product Engineering teams and the business with a view to improving Microsoft technologies, products, services, and offerings such that they can better meet customer/partner needs across a territory.
   

  

 Architecture Design and Deployment
   

  

 Leverages a structured approach to Architecture Projects using existing methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, Iterative) that make use of existing reference architecture and established architectural styles and design patterns. Proposes and develops new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners. Builds and maintains an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to ensure the rationale for the business solution's Architecture is known and understood. 
   

  

 Defines and documents the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Leads complex cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the Architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Uses a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Project Manager to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots, using enterprise architecture processes and ensuring quality control through peer review. Works with customers to understand and demonstrate business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realize.
   

  

 Works with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Manages and resolves complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Maintains the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Drives development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer. Where there are defects, works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Customer to redress or accept and document the status of the test results. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Account Team and/or Bid Team to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex Solution Approach with traceability of requirements, constraints, decisions, and tradeoffs that balances risk, technical credibility, and technical innovation to meet customer need, predominantly based on existing solution offerings and/or reference architecture. Jointly leads the implementation in close partnership with the Project Manager. Leads oversight and governance and establishment of quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Uses a cohesive build methodology with an agreed release schedule and timeline so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Works with the Project Manager to highlight where assumptions have proven false. Uses change requests to modify the Solution/project approach when needed. As needed, collaborates with subject matter experts to receive specialized advice that can help define the Solution and project approach and increase the time to value for the customer.
   

  

 Anticipates and identifies scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Orchestrates the broader Microsoft team to address technical blockers and works with account/project team to resolve non\-technical issues. Reports significant problems to Microsoft management and resolves escalations when needed. Plans a way forward in complex and ambiguous situations with an innovative approach and durable design. Delegates and leverages specialist skills of others to drive technical alignment across internal/external teams. Coordinates disparate approaches into a single plan of action for complex scenarios.  
   

  

 Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. 
   

  

 Practice Development
   

  

 Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re\-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre\-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities. 
   

  

 Trusted Advisor
   

  

 Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior\-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.
   

  

 Uses evidence\-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed.
   

  

 Leads the adoption of Microsoft solutions technologies based on understanding of competitor solutions and how customer business value can be driven through Microsoft's offerings. Differentiates Microsoft's solutions in customer/partner conversations to influence the industry\-wide direction for specific architecture(s).
   

  

 Thought Leadership
   

  

 Leads virtual teams around technologies and customer/partner challenges by sharing ideas, insight, and strategic, technical input with technical teams, internal communities across the field, and the larger virtual team across Microsoft using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and their context in the competitive landscape.
   

  

 Participates in external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons) and shares learnings with internal team. Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non\-technical concepts and sharing best practices. Demonstrates deep industry knowledge and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences.
   

  

**Other**
 Embody our culture and values
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent work experience) relevant to Information Technology, Computer Science/Engineering.
   

  

 At least 12\-14\+ years related IT experience with Solution Architecture having experience in enterprise\-scale technical experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, architecture designs, database migrations, and technology management.
   

  

 Work experience should involve pre\-sales support on large deals in technical consulting, solution design of complex solutions, project envisioning, planning, development, deployment, and Team management.
   

  

 Must have a proven record of delivering business value and proven trust\-relationships with CxO, ITDM, BDM
   

  

 The job may require travel.
   

  

 Fluent English verbal and written communications skills are a must.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request via the Accommodation request form.Benefits/perks listed below may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Microsoft and the country where you work.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300057
description:
**Description**
**About the Role \& Team**
 We are seeking a Forward\-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high\-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI\-led engineering through hands\-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
   

  

 This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting\-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket\-bound Scrum cycles toward intent\-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production\-ready software.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications \& Experience**
**Must\-Have Attributes**
 Experience: 12\+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product\-side delivery.
   

  

 SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
   

  

 Hands\-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE\-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI\-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
   

  

 Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
   

  

 Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi\-agent orchestration, AI Observability
   

  

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
 Customer\-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high\-touch, customer\-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre\-Sales Engineering Leader).
   

  

 AI Governance \& Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI\-enabled enterprise systems.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Client Engagement \& Strategic Architecture


 Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high\-value areas for AI\-led acceleration.
   

  

 Design \& Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands\-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
   

  

 Lead the Intent\-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent\-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
   

  

  

* Value Measurement \& Executive Alignment


 Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story\-to\-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
   

  

 Technical \& Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long\-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C\-level stakeholders.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Sr Key Account Specialist-India
description:
*****About Kennametal*****
*With over 80 years as an industrial technology leader, Kennametal Inc. delivers productivity to customers through materials science, tooling and wear\-resistant solutions. Customers across aerospace and defense, earthworks, energy, general engineering and transportation turn to Kennametal to help them manufacture with precision and efficiency. Every day approximately 8,700 employees are helping customers in nearly 100 countries stay competitive. Kennametal generated $2\.1 billion in revenues in fiscal 2023\. Learn more at* 
*www.kennametal.com* 
*. Follow @Kennametal: Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.*
****Job Summary****
 Describe the purpose of the job:
   

  

* To drive new sales and retain key accounts in the assigned territory by providing technical and field support for Tungsten Carbide wear parts used in Rotary Drilling and DTH applications within the mining industry.
* Expand Kennametal offerings beyond India by adding new customers and increasing share of wallet through successful product trials


****Key Job Responsibilities****
* Manage key accounts within the assigned territory; role based in Hyderabad.
* Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve revenue and margin targets.
* Demonstrate strong application knowledge and technical capabilities to support customers.
* Promote Tungsten Carbide compacts for Rotary Drilling and DTH applications and manage high\-volume accounts.
* Identify and develop new business opportunities; lead negotiations and finalize long\-term contracts.
* Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders including Plant, R\&D, Engineering and Finance.
* Apply industry knowledge, data analysis skills and strong account management to drive growth in a fast\-paced environment.
* Assess customer needs and develop appropriate sales strategies.
* Drive YOY sales growth and new business development within assigned accounts.
* Support team sales initiatives by sharing relevant customer and market information.
* Utilize CRM tools (MS Dynamics) for account and sales management.
* Conduct field trials, resolve customer complaints, gather competitive intelligence, and deliver product seminars/training.
* Perform complex analyses and provide recommendations to support business objectives.
* Prepare regular progress, status and forecast reports.
* Manage receivables effectively and maintain required DSO.


****Education, Work Experience, Skills, Certificates****
 Necessary to perform the job at the minimum acceptable level and preferred:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or industrial engineering; MBA preferred.
* 10–15 years of experience in sales, key account management, industrial sales, and wear products, including experience working with mining customers for Tungsten Carbide Compacts, PTA powders, and HF rods.
* Strong value\-selling capabilities with a winning and growth\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to understand and communicate product and technical information effectively to customers.
* Proven ability to assess customer needs, conduct trials at customer sites, and generate detailed trial reports.
* Demonstrated selling and negotiation skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory (over 70%).


*****About Kennametal*****
*With over 85 years as an industrial technology leader, Kennametal Inc. delivers productivity to customers through materials science, tooling and wear\-resistant solutions. Customers across aerospace and defense, earthworks, energy, general engineering and transportation turn to Kennametal to help them manufacture with precision and efficiency. Learn more at kennametal.com. Follow @Kennametal: Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.*

title: Technical Consultant-Identity & Access Management
description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As a Technical Consultant specializing in Identity \& Access Management, you possess extensive experience and expertise in various IAM solutions, product suites, and downstream applications. You leverage in\-depth product knowledge, client business understanding, and IAM solution expertise to deliver high\-quality IAM solutions tailored to clients' diverse business needs.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Implement IAM Solutions: Deliver high\-quality IAM solutions tailored to clients' diverse business needs, ensuring a least privilege model and implementing single sign\-on solutions.
* Provide Consulting Services: Analyze and resolve IAM issues and provide consulting services to integrate IAM application services with broader application portfolios.
* Advise Clients: Advise clients on the selection, implementation, customization, configuration, and production support of IAM security tools and solutions.
* Deliver End\-to\-End Solutions: Provide end\-to\-end user life cycle provisioning, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems.
* Resolve IAM Issues: Analyze and resolve IAM issues, contributing to an overall superior security posture for the client.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* IAM Solution Expertise: Exposure to various IAM solutions, product suites, and downstream applications, with the ability to deliver high\-quality IAM solutions tailored to clients' diverse business needs.
* Product Knowledge: In\-depth understanding of IAM products, including configuration, customization, and production support, to advise clients on selecting and implementing IAM security tools and solutions.
* End\-to\-End Provisioning: Experience working with end\-to\-end user life cycle provisioning, ensuring a least privilege model and implementing single sign\-on solutions.
* Issue Resolution: Exposure to analyzing and resolving IAM issues, with the ability to provide consulting services to integrate IAM application services with broader application portfolios.
* Client Business Understanding: Understanding of client business needs, with the ability to leverage this knowledge to deliver tailored IAM solutions.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Downstream Application Knowledge: Exposure to various downstream applications, with the ability to integrate IAM solutions seamlessly. This includes understanding how to configure and customize these applications to meet clients' diverse business needs.
* Advanced IAM Product Suites: Experience working with multiple IAM product suites, including in\-depth knowledge of their features and capabilities. This enables providing high\-quality IAM solutions tailored to clients' specific requirements.
* Security Posture Enhancement: Exposure to analyzing and resolving IAM issues, with the ability to provide consulting services that enhance the overall security posture for clients. This includes identifying vulnerabilities and implementing measures to mitigate risks.

**Desired Skills And Experience**
**Xactly Incent Implementation \& Configuration** 
 :
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end configuration and implementation of Xactly Incent, including designing compensation plans, setting up quotas, crediting rules, and calculating commission payouts.
* Customize Compensation Rules to reflect complex commission structures, such as tiered payouts, accelerators, draws, and recoveries, based on client\-specific business requirements.
* Configure and manage participant hierarchies, team structures, and territory assignments, ensuring accurate compensation tracking.
* Create and maintain calculation formulas, including base pay, bonuses, and multi\-variable commissions, using Xactly’s Calculation Engine.
* Handle the credit assignment process, including splitting credits between multiple participants or roles and ensuring accurate credit allocation to sales activities.
* Configure and manage Plan Documents and Participant Statements, ensuring transparency and clarity in commission reporting.
* Perform data loading and integration of various input sources (e.g., CRM data from Salesforce, ERP systems, or manual files) using Xactly's Connect integration tool.

* Set up and manage dispute workflows, providing users with mechanisms to contest commissions and ensuring proper audit trails.


**Xactly Analytics And Reporting**
* Develop and configure Xactly Analytics dashboards and custom reports to provide clients with real\-time visibility into performance metrics, incentive payouts, and sales effectiveness.
* Build advanced reporting frameworks to track critical metrics, such as quota attainment, sales by product, compensation by territory, and team performance.
* Utilize Xactly Analytics' data visualization tools to design and present intuitive charts and graphs that highlight key insights for executives and sales leaders.
* Configure custom calculation logic for reporting purposes, including aggregate functions like year\-over\-year comparisons, trend analysis, and commission forecasting.
* Implement role\-based security in Xactly Analytics to ensure proper data access controls, enabling different levels of visibility for stakeholders (e.g., sales reps, managers, and executives).


**Qualifications**

* Must be comfortable with emerging technologies, learning new software, understanding a data model and an object model, writing SQL queries, and writing design specifications
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* 3\-5 years of experience implementing Xactly Incent and Xactly Analytics.


**Technical \& Business Requirements**
* Knowledge of software development \& implementation life cycles
* Experience with major relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, etc.)
* Proficient in Xactly Incent configuration, including:
+ Compensation Plan Design: Structuring and configuring incentive compensation plans, defining quotas, crediting rules, and payout methods.
+ Participant Management: Setting up and managing user hierarchies, teams, roles, and permissions.
+ Calculation Engine: Building custom formulas, handling complex calculation rules (e.g., weighted commissions, bonuses).
+ Plan Document Automation: Configuring automated and customizable participant statements and documents.
+ Quota Management: Configuring and managing quota\-setting processes.

* Expertise in Xactly Analytics configuration and reporting:
+ Advanced Data Modeling: Designing and configuring custom reports and dashboards.
+ Complex Report Building: Developing performance dashboards that aggregate sales data and compensation metrics.


**Knowledge Of The Following Technologies Is Considered An Asset**
* Microsoft SQL Server, Informatica, Xactly, Varicent

description:
**About DESRI**
 DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market\-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 13 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, and Hyderabad (India).
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an Analyst / Senior Analyst to join our Hyderabad office as part of the Strategy team. The Strategy team focuses on project acquisitions, PPA origination, market and corporate strategy, and capital raising. The team works closely across DESRI business units — including Finance, Development, EPC, Procurement, Legal, and FP\&A — to price risk and execute new opportunities that drive long\-term NAV growth. The candidate will be a part of an inclusive, highly skilled team responsible for supporting DESRI’s portfolio of wind, solar, and storage projects within a dynamic environment that values collaboration, thoughtful problem solving, and attention to detail.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Bid modeling and valuation for project acquisitions, PPA/ESA origination, repowers, and surplus BESS opportunities at any stage of the project life cycle.
* Assist in pricing and structuring bids targeting pre\-tax IRR and minimum NAV thresholds.
* Coordinate with EPC, Procurement, and Legal to validate assumptions and optimize site.
* Diligence support coordinating with DESRI Development \& EPC to evaluate project risk profiles.
* Conduct research on U.S. renewable markets covering financing markets, equipment pricing, competitor analysis, new markets, interconnection positions, and new technology
* synthesizing insights from public sources, utility proceedings, and internal databases.
* Contribute to battery strategy analysis, competitive intelligence, and management reporting on key market indicators.
* Prepare investor presentations, marketing materials, and support offtake diligence.


**Qualifications**
* Candidates holding MBA or relevant degree with 2–4 years of experience in investment banking, project finance, Strategy or consulting domain
* Strong financial modeling skills in Excel; ability to synthesize complex information into clear conclusions.
* Familiarity with renewable energy markets, PPA structures, and energy storage is preferred.
* Demonstrated intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and strong written and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams across teams in different time zones.
* Strong familiarity with usage of various AI models to optimize financial models, research and development and due diligence

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Company Description**
 Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About us, but we'll be brief:**
 Experian is the world's leading global information services company, unlocking the power of data to create more opportunities for consumers, businesses and society. We are thrilled to share that FORTUNE has named Experian one of the 100 Best Companies to work for. In addition, for the last five years we've been listed as one of the 100 "World's Most Innovative Companies" by Forbes Magazine.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 You will be the architecture owner for Experian's telephony, Teams Calling, and Contact Center services. As we modernize, we are moving toward a cloud‑first, Teams‑centric model. In this model, NICE will serve as the contact center platform, and we will use Teams Calling for corporate/campus telephony. This role is accountable for the end‑to‑end technical design and standards. This includes global telephony transformation. We mean this transformation to replace EOL Avaya, reduce on\-premise dependencies. It will also deliver features such as advanced IVR, dashboards, reporting, AI/speech recognition, omnichannel, call recording, and call accounting, etc. Additionally, I designed and guided Experian's contact center capability uplift. This included Presence Bi‑Sync with Salesforce Omni‑Channel, advanced quality, sentiment analysis, self‑service/automation, and ACD enhancements. I measured all of these against efficiency targets and business benefits. APAC modernization and discovery work (e.g., Teams Calling \+ NICE CXone direction; addressing EOL Cisco/Ribbon, India calling enablement constraints, and staff augmentation needs). This role directly owns PSTN/calling architecture, carrier/SBC design, numbering/porting, call routing, contact center flows, recording/QA/analytics, and compliance\-aligned controls. You will report to a Senior Director.
   

  

**Summary Of Primary Responsibilities**
* Own global telephony \& contact center target architectures: Define and maintain end‑to‑end designs for Teams Calling, NICE contact center, call routing, numbering, porting, recording/CDR, and integration patterns across regions.
* The UKI \& EMEA telephony modernization architecture authority is responsible for leading the technical approach. This approach involves replacing legacy Avaya, including the decommission of \~60 Avaya devices, and delivering the proposed campus/contact center changes. These changes include desk phone removal as standard, power\-user and VIP retention models, mandatory CC training, and enhanced IVR/ACD/analytics/automation capabilities.
* Contact center evolution and feature enablement involve architecting and governing advanced CC capabilities. We plan or have in\-flight these capabilities. They include integrating Salesforce enhancements, implementing Presence Bi\-Sync, developing omnichannel, creating QM\+/quality, conducting sentiment analysis, and designing automation/self\-service patterns. Examples of automation/self\-service patterns are password reset self\-service IVR flows and Origins integration.
* Compliance, risk, and data\-flow architecture: Own the technical inputs required to satisfy multi‑region risk/compliance needs, including DPIA/LIA/ROPA/TPRA patterns, country data residency constraints, and risk items affecting schedule/solution design. Drive "secure by design" call recording and processing architectures.
* Carrier/SBC and routing design leadership involves leading carrier/provider architecture decisions. It also includes solution designs, considering constraints that require Teams and NICE migrations to occur together in certain routing models. Additionally, it requires finalizing EMEA routing designs.
* Operational reliability and ITSM guardrails: Define architecture standards for availability, survivability, monitoring, and change rigor while modernization executes—balancing "run" stability with transformation delivery.
* Executive\-ready architecture artifacts: Produce reference architecture, option papers, sequencing plans, and risk statements to support business cases, funding approvals, vendor due diligence, and leadership decision forums.


**Qualifications**
* 10–15\+ years developing enterprise telephony/voice and contact center solutions in several environments (global/multi‑region preferred).
* Demonstrated experience modernizing from legacy PBX/contact center platforms to cloud SaaS models with emphasis on routing/porting/numbering, agent workflows, and service continuity.
* You have Contact center domain depth (e.g., NICE\-like platforms) including call flows, IVR/ACD, recording, QA, analytics, and CRM integration patterns.
* You have good partner communication—able to translate architecture tradeoffs into clear decisions for all kinds of audiences.
* You have operational governance and discipline; comfortable operating in environments with active risk, compliance review cycles, and change controls.


**Additional Information**
 Our uniqueness is that we truly celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what truly matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, engagement, collaboration, wellness, reward \& recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's strong people first approach is award winning; Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, FORTUNE Best Companies to work and Glassdoor Best Places to Work (globally 4\.4 Stars) to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site to understand why.
   

  

 Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Innovation is a critical part of Experian's DNA and practices, and our diverse workforce drives our success. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, color, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Experian care for employee's work life balance, health, safety and wellbeing. In support of this endeavor, we offer best\-in\-class family well\-being benefits, enhanced medical benefits and paid time off.

* Proven track record of delivering Dynamics 365 CRM programs at scale.
* Strong exposure to client\-facing roles, including pre\-sales and business development.

title: Field Systems Engineer (FSE)
description:
**About The Role**
 As a
 **Field Systems Engineer (FSE)** 
 , you will be the key person who will translate Svaya’s robots and platform capabilities into tangible automation solutions in manufacturing and beyond. You will drive seamless integration and operationalize our robotics platform at key customers sites in coordination with Svaya’s product and engineering teams. This is a multi\-disciplinary role, and you will be adept working across hardware, perception, simulation, coding, testing and data. In this hybrid role, you will be the ultimate go\-to person bridging the gap between customer deployments and Svaya development and engineering teams – using your first\-hand field experience and the vantage view of deployments, you will give constructive feedback to make our products and the platform reliable, robust and scalable. The ideal candidate will have background in robotics and have the willingness to learn and explore with a solutions mindset.
   

  

 Your Work
   

  

* Gain deep understanding of customers tasks, workflows, process and systems to inform and evolve tangible automation solutions that will drive key customer value metrics
* Work closely with sales, product and engineering teams to translate and operationalize Svaya robots and platform capabilities into practical in\-situ automation solutions
* Embed Svaya robotics platform at key customer sites with scalable reference implementations to enable wider adoption of our robots across customers environments
* Train and empower customer’s internal teams to successfully execute automation projects around Svaya’s products and platform with no external dependence
* Analyze and derive metrics from deployments and provide constructive feedback to product teams to guide future technical directions for product development


 What We're Looking for
   

  

* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in robotic systems preferably with field experience
* Strong understanding of robot kinematics (FK/IK), rigid body dynamics, and controls
* Experience in machine vision for inspection or robotic manipulation is a plus
* Experience with programming in C\+\+ and/or Python on Linux platform
* Knowledge and experience working with ROS, MoveIt is a plus
* Experience with MATLAB and other data analysis tools
* Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively across cross\-functional teams
* A learning mindset with willingness to take on new challenges and solve unfamiliar problems.


 Nice to Have's
   

  

* Knowledge of general software packages for motion planning, collision detection, and simulation of robotic systems
* A strong intuition for robot dynamics and controls theory, with the ability to apply these principles to guide and constrain learning\-based approaches
* Any experience with perception and scene understanding as it pertains to motion planning
* Familiarity with RTOS (real\-time operating systems)
* Familiarity with communication protocols such as EtherCAT, Ethernet/IP, ModbusTCP is a plus


 Education
   

  

 MS or MTech in Mechanical or electrical disciplines preferably with specialization in robotics or controls

**How you will contribute**

* 1\) Insight Generation \& Opportunity Sizing (Core)
* Deliver high\-quality analytics across pricing, PPA, promotions, trade investment/GTN, and mix to identify and size growth and margin opportunities
* Build and maintain analytical outputs such as:
+ price \& margin waterfalls
+ GTN decomposition and investment diagnostics
+ promotion ROI / elasticity views (where data allows)
+ mix contribution and pack/channel performance analysis

* Translate analyses into clear “so what” recommendations, including quantified upside, key assumptions, risks, and trade\-offs
* Provide analytical support for market decision points (e.g., AC/plan cycles, pricing rounds, promotion optimization waves)
* 2\) Project Delivery \& Market Execution Support
* Support prioritized market deep dives and sprints by owning the analytical workplan, timelines, and delivery quality
* Work with markets to convert analysis into execution\-ready actions (e.g., price moves, pack changes, promo mechanics changes, trade guardrails)
* Develop simple implementation packs for markets (what to do, where to do it, expected impact, how to track)
* Track progress and benefits delivery for supported initiatives, and run post\-implementation reviews to refine the approach
* 3\) Standardized Tools, Templates \& Ways of Working
* Develop and maintain standardized analytical templates and calculators for RGM levers (pricing, PPA, promo, GTN, mix) to improve speed and consistency
* Ensure analytical definitions, assumptions, and calculation logic are consistent to enable cross\-market comparability
* Create “minimum viable” analytical approaches for markets with limited data, balancing rigor with practicality
* Provide hands\-on coaching to market teams on how to use templates correctly and interpret outputs
* 4\) KPI Tracking, Performance Reporting \& Governance Support
* Support definition and ongoing tracking of core RGM effectiveness metrics (e.g., price realization, GTN%, promo ROI proxies, mix improvement indicators)
* Build and maintain dashboards / structured reporting for regional readouts and market check\-ins
* Ensure timely, accurate reporting with clear commentary on drivers, issues, and required actions
* Identify recurring performance gaps and propose targeted analytical deep dives or corrective actions
* 5\) Data Quality \& Analytical Enablement
* Partner with market teams and relevant functions (D\&A / I\&A) to improve availability and quality of RGM inputs (volume, price, GTN, promo, customer/channel mapping)

* Influencing stakeholders and interacting effectively with others with the courage and resilience to hold an alternative point of view

title: Founder office
description:
About the role
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership seat next to the founder of a fast\-growing AI marketing company working in Generative Engine Optimisation — the discipline of making brands the answer that AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude give when people ask a question.
 



  





 The category is roughly three years old. We work with listed companies, hospitals, defence manufacturers, luxury houses, law firms and global consumer brands across India, the US and Southeast Asia. There is no established playbook, which is exactly what makes this interesting.
 



  





 You will not have a narrow job description. You'll work on whatever is most important that week — which could be a client proposal on Monday, a hiring process on Wednesday and a pricing model on Friday.
 



  





 What you'll actually do
 



  





 • Client strategy and proposals — research prospects, build audits and scope documents, and prepare the commercial proposals the founder takes into rooms
 



 • Business development support — prepare for pitches, handle follow\-ups, and manage the pipeline so nothing goes cold
 



 • Special projects — new product definition, market research, partnership evaluation, pricing structures
 



 • Internal systems — help build the processes, templates and trackers that let delivery scale without breaking
 



 • Hiring and team building — draft roles, screen candidates, run first\-round conversations
 



 • Meeting follow\-through — capture what was decided, convert it into actions, and make sure those actions actually close
 



 • Anything else that needs an owner — genuinely
 



  





 What we're looking for
 



  





 • 2–5 years of experience — consulting, investment banking, startup operations, strategy, or a founder's office elsewhere. Strong recent graduates from top institutions with real internship depth will also be considered
 



 • Exceptional written English. You will write a great deal — proposals, emails, documents that go to CXOs of large companies
 



 • Structured thinking. You can take something ambiguous and turn it into a clear plan
 



 • Genuine research ability. You check facts, notice when two sources disagree, and don't assume
 



 • Comfort with ambiguity and pace. Priorities shift; you need to be the kind of person who finds that energising rather than destabilising
 



 • Real ownership instinct. Nobody will chase you. Things you own should close
 



  





 What will make you stand out
 



  





 • Hands\-on familiarity with AI tools as working instruments, not novelties
 



 • Exposure to B2B sales, agency or consulting environments
 



 • Financial literacy — you can build a pricing model or read a company's results
 



 • Experience working directly with senior leadership
 



  





 What this job is not
 



  





 • It is not a coordination or note\-taking role. You'll be expected to have views and defend them
 



 • It is not narrowly defined. If you need a fixed remit to do your best work, this will frustrate you
 



 • It is not a comfortable 10\-to\-6\. The pace is real, and so is the learning
 



  





 Why take it
 



  





 You'll sit at the centre of a company in a category that barely exists yet, with unusual visibility into how clients are won, priced and kept. The exposure is far broader than an equivalent\-level role at a larger firm — you'll see the whole business rather than one function of it.
 



  





 For the right person, this is a role that compounds quickly.
 



  





 To apply: send your CV and a short note — no more than half a page — on something you owned end\-to\-end and what you'd do differently, to abhay@connectify.global

title: Partner Success
description:

This role sits at the intersection of business development and training, and is built for someone who loves being out there, building relationships, and making things happen. **What You'll Do**
* Own the end\-to\-end activation of B2B partners from onboarding to steady\-state performance.

**What We're Looking For**
* 4–6 years of experience in partner management, channel sales, B2B relationship management, or a similar field\-facing role.
* Prior experience in fintech, BFSI, edtech, or any product\-led startup is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to train and enable external stakeholders on products or processes.
* Comfortable with frequent travel this is a field\-heavy role and you should genuinely enjoy it.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; can hold a room, whether it's 3 people or 30\.
* Self\-starter with a can\-do attitude you don't wait to be told twice, and you figure things out.
* Organised, data\-oriented, and able to manage multiple partner accounts simultaneously.
* Fluency in English and Hindi; regional language skills are an added advantage.


**What Makes You Stand Out**
* You've built partner programs from scratch or significantly grown an existing partner network.
* You bring infectious energy into every room — partners love working with you.
* You're as comfortable doing a product demo as you are sitting down with a partner to understand their challenges.
* You treat every partner relationship like it's your most important one.


**Why Join Us**
 You'll be joining an early\-stage, fast\-growing fintech startup where your work has visible, direct impact. No red tape. No waiting for approvals. Just real ownership, a great team, and the opportunity to build something that matter from Mumbai and beyond.
   

  

**About Us**
 Vittam An EduFund Company
   

  

 Vittam is a newly launched business vertical of EduFund, focused on B2B Mutual Fund distribution and the IFA (Independent Financial Advisor) ecosystem. Already live with 200\+ active partners, Vittam is now entering a high\-growth phase and is looking for a senior sales leader to own, scale, and build this business ground\-up.
   

  

 Vittam is being built to empower IFAs, RIAs, and wealth partners with a modern, scalable platform to grow their advisory business while delivering best\-in\-class investment solutions to end customers.
   

  

**Learn more about the platform:** 
**https://vittamfin.com/**
**About EduFund**
**EduFund** 
 is India’s first dedicated education\-focused fintech platform, built to help Indian families plan, save and secure their child’s education. Founded in 2020, our mission is to remove financial stress from education planning.
   

  

 We offer a full suite of solutions, including investments, education loans, visa and immigration support, international remittance, and expert counselling, making it India’s only end‑to‑end education financial planning platform.
   

  

 Whether it's saving early or funding a degree abroad, EduFund helps parents make smarter financial decisions for their child’s future.
   

  

 With 2\.5 lakh\+ families, 40\+ AMC partners, 15\+ lending partners, and a growing presence across Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities, EduFund is becoming the go\-to platform for education financing in India.
   

  

 In July 2025, EduFund raised $6 million in Series A funding, led by Cercano Management and MassMutual Ventures, bringing the total capital raised to $12 million.

title: Government & Partnership Associate, iTeach Growth Team
description:
**Why do we exist? What do we do?** 




 The quality of school education available to low\-income students across India is abysmal — it decides, before they've had a real shot, whether they'll ever attend college or build a career. iTeach Schools was born in 2015 to break that pattern and build a level playing field for every child.
 



 We run free, high\-impact schools and a college\-to\-career program for the most disadvantaged students in Pune and Navi Mumbai, known for world\-class professional development, a results\-driven culture, and student\-centric school design. More at
 
 www.iTeachSchools.org
 
 .
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 iTeach is scaling fast — from 4,500 to 10,000\+ students over the next 5 years, through 10\-12 new schools across Maharashtra's Municipal Corporations. This role sits within our Growth team and is where that growth gets built on the ground: identifying new opportunities, gathering the data that shapes our expansion decisions, and keeping our government stakeholder relationships strong.
 



 There are three key parts of the Government Partnerships \& Expansion Associate role.
 



  





**A. Expansion Work** 



* Support on\-ground landscape studies in current and prospective Municipal Corporations — finding space, infrastructure availability, and educational gaps.
* Conduct field visits and gather ground\-level data to inform which municipal corporation iTeach expands to next.
* Help identify and open initial conversations with local stakeholders and influential contacts in new areas.
* Support proposal and tender documentation as new Municipal Corporation opportunities move forward.



  





**B. Stakeholder Engagement \& Liaisoning** 



* Identify, build, and maintain relationships with key stakeholders — administrative (Municipal Corporation, Education Department, Zilla Parishad, State Government, SSC Board, Sarva Shiksha Abhiyaan) and political (Corporators, local leaders, community influencers).
* Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact between iTeach Schools and government stakeholders, regarding everything related to expansion proposals.
* Resolve issues between government officers and iTeach Schools.
* Keep the team updated on relevant policy and procedural changes.



  





**C. Compliance \& Systemic Reform** 



* Secure all necessary permissions and compliances for new schools from relevant departments.



  





**Education and Competencies** 



* Required: Graduate or above.
* Required: Minimum 2 years of experience in social sector work.
* Mandatory: Prior experience working with the government, or exposure to public field\-based work.
* Mandatory: Proficiency in reading, writing, and typing in Marathi and English.



  





**Location** 



* Mumbai based. Willing and able to travel within Greater Mumbai and occasionally other Municipal Corporations with prospective expansion opportunities.



  





**Compensation and Benefits:** 
 We take pride in offering competitive compensation and benefits commensurate with the candidate's education and work experience. The salary range for this position ranges from 4\.32 \- 5\.28 LPA CTC, and we are dedicated to providing top\-notch industry benefits. These benefits include PF, gratuity, medical insurance (up to 3 lakh PA), paid leaves, annual increments, and promotion opportunities.

* Good understanding of pre\-contract (quantification \& market analysis supporting cost planning, benchmarking, design validation, risk management) and post\-contract (rate analysis \& drawings measurements supporting change control management, cost reporting, final accounts) stages of MEP services of Real Estate projects.

title: Logistics Professional
description:
**Freight Forwarding \& LCL Consolidation — Customer Service / Procurement / Documentation / Sales** 




  





**Company:** 
 Kenshine Group ·
 **Location:** 
 Mumbai, Maharashtra (On\-site) ·
 **Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About Kenshine Group** 




 Kenshine Group has been moving cargo for Indian exporters and importers since 1989\. We are a multimodal logistics provider and an accredited Authorized Economic Operator (AEO), delivering port\-to\-door, door\-to\-port and door\-to\-door solutions across ocean, air and surface. Our services span freight forwarding, LCL consolidation, customs brokerage, third\-party logistics, warehousing, surface transportation and specialised packing, through Kenshine Global Logistics Private Limited, Kenshine Shipping Private Limited and Kenshine Logistics Private Limited.
 



  





**About the openings** 




 We are expanding our Freight Forwarding and LCL Consolidation business in Mumbai and are hiring across four functions. Candidates at all levels — from freshers to experienced professionals — are encouraged to apply; the role and responsibilities will be matched to your experience.
 



  





**Customer Service** 




 Own a set of accounts end to end: booking confirmations, space planning with carriers and co\-loaders, milestone updates to shippers and consignees, and resolution of delays, roll\-overs and exceptions. You are the single point of contact the customer calls.
 



  





**Procurement** 




 Source and negotiate ocean, air and LCL rates with carriers, NVOCCs, consolidators and overseas agents. Maintain the rate grid, close spot buys against live enquiries, and protect margin on every shipment without compromising transit or reliability.
 



  





**Documentation** 




 Prepare and verify shipping bills, bills of lading, delivery orders, manifests, certificates of origin and export/import documentation. Coordinate filings with customs, carriers and CFS/ICDs, and keep records audit\-ready against AEO and regulatory requirements.
 



  





**Sales** 




 Develop new business among exporters, importers and trade partners in the Mumbai market. Map prospects, quote and convert enquiries, build long\-term account relationships, and work with Procurement and Customer Service to deliver what you sell.
 



  





**What we are looking for** 



* Interest in, or experience with, freight forwarding, LCL consolidation, customs clearance or 3PL operations
* Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to deal directly with customers, carriers and overseas agents
* Working knowledge of MS Office; familiarity with a logistics or ERP system is an advantage
* Accuracy and attention to detail — in this business, a wrong document number is a real cost
* A graduate degree in any discipline; qualifications in Logistics, Supply Chain, International Trade or Commerce are preferred
* Willingness to work on\-site in Mumbai



  





**Why Kenshine** 



* 35\+ years in the trade, with an established network of carriers and overseas agents
* AEO\-accredited operations and strong compliance standards
* Direct exposure to the full shipment lifecycle rather than one narrow task
* A small, senior team where good work is visible

title: Sr. CSM (Logistics Tech)
description:
Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology company building AI\-powered intelligence for the freight forwarding industry. Freight forwarders manage thousands of shipments, rates, exceptions, and operational decisions every day. The challenge is not a lack of data. It is knowing what needs attention, what is going wrong, and what action to take next.
   

  

 Portcast uses AI and data to help freight forwarders surface shipment exceptions, identify cost and margin risks, and make better decisions across the shipment lifecycle. Our products help teams improve operational efficiency, protect margins, and make faster, more informed decisions. Our vision is to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.
   

  

****ABOUT THE ROLE:****
 We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to own our enterprise customer relationships end to end. Our CS team owns the full commercial relationship, strategic account management, adoption, renewal, expansion, and customer support, working directly with enterprise customers and their C\-suite. This is a senior individual\-contributor (IC) role for someone who can build trust and credibility at that level.
   

  

 At the heart of the role is discovery. The best expansion comes from deeply understanding what each customer is really trying to achieve, where their pain sits, and how Portcast turns their data into decisions and measurable business impact. Strong discovery is what lets you deepen adoption, grow your accounts, and drive real revenue from your existing customers, through upsell, cross\-sell, and new teams and regions.
   

  

 You'll also be technically fluent enough to be the customer's first point of contact on their questions and tickets, triaging the issue, working with our Data team to get the answer, and communicating a clear resolution back to the customer, all alongside the strategic work: QBRs, success plans, renewals, and expansion.
   

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:**
* Enterprise customers deeply adopt Portcast with measurable business outcomes, and see you as a trusted advisor at both the operational and C\-suite level.
* Discovery that consistently surfaces real customer needs and turns them into adoption, retention, and expansion.
* A steady expansion pipeline from existing accounts (upsell, cross\-sell, new teams and regions), with CS trusted, internally and by customers, to identify and drive those deals.
* Fast, credible resolution of customer questions and tickets, in partnership with the Data team, so customers always get reliable answers and stay confident in Portcast.


**WHAT YOU’LL OWN:**
* Own the full enterprise customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, renewal, and retention, ensuring a smooth, high\-impact experience.
* Lead discovery: deeply understand each customer's goals, workflows, pain points, and internal decision processes, so you can grow the account and drive expansion.
* Be a trusted advisor to enterprise stakeholders, including C\-suite, aligning Portcast to their strategic goals and addressing their challenges.
* Identify and drive expansion (upsell, cross\-sell, new teams, new regions) in partnership with Sales, positioning CS as a credible driver of new revenue from existing customers.
* Own customer questions and tickets: triage the issue, work with the Data team to get the answer, then review and communicate a clear resolution back to the customer.
* Run QBRs, success plans, and regular check\-ins, using data, outcomes, and clear narratives to drive adoption and expansion.
* Partner with Product, Data, and Engineering to channel customer feedback and influence the roadmap.
* Analyze customer usage and data to surface actionable insights and continuously improve the customer journey.


**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Logistics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent.
* 7\+ years in a commercial, customer\-facing role, Customer Success, Account Management, Pre\-sales/Solutions, or Sales, within the logistics industry or logistics technology space.
* A pre\-sales or solutions background is highly valued. Strong discovery is one of the most important skills in this role, it's what lets you expand existing customers and drive new revenue.
* Logistics / logistics\-tech domain: familiarity with freight forwarding and global logistics workflows, and the ability to confidently engage customers across operations and commercial stakeholders.
* Comfortable with enterprise customers and their C\-suite, with strong stakeholder management across functions and seniority levels.
* Technical fluency: comfortable with basic data, APIs, and SaaS concepts, enough to handle customer questions and tickets, work with our Data team, and translate technical answers into clear customer\-facing resolutions.
* A track record of driving account expansion (upsell, cross\-sell) and revenue growth from existing customers.
* Experience running QBRs and structured account success plans, using data and outcomes to drive adoption and expansion.
* Excellent, structured communication, especially with complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise customers.
* High ownership and independence, with the ability to operate in a lean startup environment and a bias for action.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**
* Work at the intersection of AI, data, and logistics: help enterprise customers turn predictive data into decisions and measurable business impact.
* Real impact from day one: we're lean by design, with few layers between you and the outcome, so your work moves adoption, retention, and expansion directly.
* Globally distributed, remote\-first flexibility: work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.


**OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO:**
* Curiosity: This is where discovery lives. We dig beneath what a customer asks for to what they're actually trying to achieve, staying genuinely curious about their business, their workflows, and how a freight forwarder really operates. That depth is where every expansion starts.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We own the customer relationship and the commercial outcome end to end, adoption, renewal, and expansion, and we stay on an account until the value is real and the number moves.
* Raising the bar: We don't settle for a renewed contract. We aim for customers who adopt deeply, expand with us, and become advocates, and we hold ourselves to that standard on every account.
* Effectiveness: We focus on the outcomes that matter, real adoption, retention, and revenue growth from our customers, not check\-ins or activity for their own sake. We prioritize the accounts and conversations that actually move the business.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description:

High emotional intelligence, resilience, and collaborative mindset

title: RCGTH - Domain Consultant
description:
About the role
  
As a Domain Consultant – RCGTH, you will make an impact by shaping compelling, insight\-led client propositions across Retail, Consumer Goods, Travel, and Hospitality, translating client priorities into differentiated solution narratives, business cases, proposals, and thought leadership. You will be a valued member of the Business Development team and work collaboratively with sales, pre\-sales, consulting, solutioning, solution architects, practice leaders, account teams, delivery teams, alliance partners, and clients.
  
In this role, you will
  
Act as a domain strategist and trusted advisor to sales, business development, consulting, and solutioning teams, researching and synthesizing industry trends, client priorities, market shifts, competitor activity, and emerging technologies across the RCGTH portfolio.
  
Translate client business needs into domain\-led solution themes, capability maps, value propositions, transformation roadmaps, and proposal narratives.
  
Support opportunity qualification and pursuits by developing compelling content for proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, executive presentations, solution storyboards, battle cards, and account\-specific point\-of\-view documents.
  
Shape differentiated go\-to\-market narratives and build reusable RCGTH assets such as industry trend summaries, value maps, use\-case libraries, case studies, reference architectures, and competitive positioning materials.
  
Contribute to practice development through thought leadership, market intelligence, and offering development, and mentor junior business development and pre\-sales associates.
  
Work model
  
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Mumbai. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
What you must have to be considered
  
10\-15\+ years of experience in domain consulting, business development, pre\-sales, industry advisory, digital transformation, or solution consulting, with a Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, Marketing, or a related discipline.
  
Strong understanding of Retail, Consumer Goods, Travel, and Hospitality business models, value chains, customer journeys, operating models, and industry\-specific priorities.
  
Proven experience developing proposals, solution narratives, executive presentations, market research outputs, thought leadership, business cases, or go\-to\-market assets.
  
Familiarity with key RCGTH transformation themes and relevant enterprise platforms and technology ecosystems, including CRM, commerce, contact center, data and analytics, AI/GenAI, marketing technology, order management, ERP, and digital experience platforms.
  
Demonstrated ability to convert ambiguous client needs into structured problem statements, value propositions, and outcome\-oriented recommendations while collaborating across cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.
  
These will help you succeed
  
An MBA or equivalent consulting experience.
  
Familiarity with CRM and customer engagement technologies such as Salesforce (Sales, Service, Marketing, Experience, Data, and Commerce Cloud, and Agentforce), Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP Customer Experience, Adobe Experience Cloud, and ServiceNow Customer Service Management.
  
Awareness of emerging themes such as hyper\-personalization, omnichannel experience, connected loyalty, intelligent fulfillment, sustainable operations, AI\-enabled workforce, and unified customer intelligence.
  
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to articulate business value, support ROI narratives, and align proposed solutions to client priorities.
  
Excellent research, synthesis, writing, communication, and presentation skills, with confidence engaging senior sales, account, consulting, and client stakeholders.
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Secure by Supplier Cyber Security Consultant
description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking a Secure by Supplier Cyber Security Consultant to help embed secure\-by\-design principles into supplier engagements from the earliest stages of the supplier lifecycle. This role focuses on identifying, assessing and mitigating cyber security and regulatory risks associated with third\-party suppliers, while ensuring compliance with UK Telecom Security Regulations and Vodafone’s internal security standards.
   

  

 The successful candidate will work closely with business, technology and supplier stakeholders to evaluate supplier security postures, provide risk\-based security recommendations, influence sourcing decisions, and support the inclusion of appropriate contractual controls. This is an opportunity to play a key role in protecting Vodafone’s supply chain while enabling secure and compliant business operations.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Perform technical assessments of supplier security capabilities and regulatory compliance during supplier sourcing and contracting activities
* Evaluate security and compliance risks using a standardised assessment methodology and identify effective mitigation measures
* Provide security recommendations to support supplier selection and sourcing decisions
* Engage with external suppliers to understand, validate and influence their security and regulatory compliance positions
* Collaborate with internal subject matter experts and stakeholders to verify supplier security positions and support effective decision\-making
* Act as the technical security specialist when communicating cyber security risks to business, technology and supplier stakeholders
* Support supplier contract negotiations by identifying technical security requirements and recommending contractual controls to minimise risk
* Develop, maintain and improve relevant processes, reporting and assessment tools
* Provide guidance on cyber security and compliance\-related matters to internal colleagues and suppliers
