title: Account Development Representative
description:
What You'll Do
   

  

 Avalara is hiring Account Development Representatives (ADRs) to help increase growth by creating conversations with prospective customers, building interest in our products, and generating new pipeline opportunities for our sales team through outbound prospecting.
   

  

 This is more than an entry\-level sales role. It is a starting point for individuals who want to build sales skills, perform in a high\-expectation environment, and grow their careers over time.
   

  

 At Avalara, we believe in promoting from within. If you want to learn sales fundamentals, put in the work, respond to coaching, and grow your career, then the ADR roles is for you.
   

  

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
* As an ADR, you will build the top of our sales funnel. You will prospect into target accounts, open doors with new partners, create momentum with prospects, and turn outreach into business opportunities.
* Every day you will initiate conversations with prospective customers, create interest in Avalara solutions, and create new pipeline through outbound outreach.
* You will qualify opportunities, handle objections, and schedule meetings for the sales team.
* Research accounts, identify buying signals, and build an understanding of Avalara's products, customers, and market
* Partner with Account Executives and sales leadership on account strategy, persona targeting, and pipeline creation
* You will use sales engagement, CRM, AI, and other tools to manage outreach, maintain operating discipline, and support webinars, events, and other demand generation plans when relevant
* Achieve monthly performance goals tied to activity quality, meetings, pipeline creation, and continuous improvement through feedback


 What You’ll Need To Be Successful
   

  

* You're looking for more than just a job—you want to build a meaningful, long\-term career.
* You have 4–10 years of professional experience in sales or other metrics\-driven environments.
* You're motivated to grow your career in sales and enjoy creating opportunities from the ground up.
* You're resilient, embrace challenges, and are willing to put in the effort every day, learn from rejection, and continuously improve your skills.
* You thrive on learning, personal growth, new opportunities, and the excitement of outbound prospecting.


**Work Location \& Schedule**
* This is an onsite role based in Pune.
* You'll work from the office five days a week, from 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST.
* You will report directly to Sales Manager


 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


 How We’ll Take Care Of You
   

  

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
   

  

 Inclusive culture and diversity
   

  

 Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
   

  

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
   

  

 We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
   

  

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Secure by Supplier Cyber Security Consultant
description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
  

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
  

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------


We are seeking a Secure by Supplier Cyber Security Consultant to help embed secure\-by\-design principles into supplier engagements from the earliest stages of the supplier lifecycle. This role focuses on identifying, assessing and mitigating cyber security and regulatory risks associated with third\-party suppliers, while ensuring compliance with UK Telecom Security Regulations and Vodafone’s internal security standards.
The successful candidate will work closely with business, technology and supplier stakeholders to evaluate supplier security postures, provide risk\-based security recommendations, influence sourcing decisions, and support the inclusion of appropriate contractual controls. This is an opportunity to play a key role in protecting Vodafone’s supply chain while enabling secure and compliant business operations.**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Perform technical assessments of supplier security capabilities and regulatory compliance during supplier sourcing and contracting activities.
* Evaluate security and compliance risks using a standardised assessment methodology and identify effective mitigation measures.
* Provide security recommendations to support supplier selection and sourcing decisions.
* Engage with external suppliers to understand, validate and influence their security and regulatory compliance positions.
* Collaborate with internal subject matter experts and stakeholders to verify supplier security positions and support effective decision\-making.
* Act as the technical security specialist when communicating cyber security risks to business, technology and supplier stakeholders.
* Support supplier contract negotiations by identifying technical security requirements and recommending contractual controls to minimise risk.
* Develop, maintain and improve relevant processes, reporting and assessment tools.
* Provide guidance on cyber security and compliance\-related matters to internal colleagues and suppliers.
* Promote security as a business enabler and support the adoption of secure\-by\-design principles across supplier engagements.
* Ensure suppliers understand and adhere to Vodafone’s security standards and regulatory obligations.
**Who you are**
---------------


* Experience working in a pre\-sales, sourcing, risk assessment or supplier security environment, evaluating responses and determining security recommendations.
* Strong ability to communicate security requirements, risks and mitigation measures to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Good understanding of networking concepts, traffic flows, network architecture and security best practices.
* Experience managing and influencing stakeholders across different levels of an organisation.
* Significant professional experience in information technology and cyber security, ideally within supplier risk, security assurance or governance roles.
* Knowledge of cloud security, web services security, container security, connectivity, identity and access management, network security and penetration testing concepts.
* Understanding of security governance across Software as a Service (SaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS) and Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) environments.
* Expertise across telecommunications technologies including:
	+ Switching and routing technologies
	+ Routers, modems and Optical Network Terminals (ONTs)
	+ Radio Access Networks (RAN)
	+ Core routers, firewalls and border gateways
	+ Mobile devices, tablets and IoT environments
	+ Mobile Private Networks (MPN) using 4G/5G technologies
* University degree in Information Security or an equivalent discipline.
* One or more recognised industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, GIAC, TOGAF, SABSA or equivalent.
* 5\+ years of experience in cyber security.
**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------



Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------


* Opportunity to influence supplier security decisions across a global telecommunications environment.
* Exposure to complex cyber security, supplier assurance and regulatory compliance challenges.
* Collaboration with business, technology and cyber security specialists across multiple functions.
* Ability to contribute directly to Vodafone’s supply chain security strategy and risk reduction objectives.
* Experience working with evolving telecom security regulations and industry\-leading security practices.
* Opportunity to shape secure\-by\-design adoption across supplier ecosystems.
**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------


* Advanced supplier cyber security assessment and assurance techniques.
* Regulatory compliance evaluation, including UK Telecom Security requirements.
* Security risk quantification, recommendation development and risk mitigation planning.
* Contractual security control evaluation and negotiation support.
* Supplier governance and third\-party risk management practices.
* Stakeholder management and executive\-level security communication.
* Telecom network security across fixed, mobile and emerging technology environments.
* Security governance across cloud, SaaS, PaaS and IaaS delivery models.
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------



Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------



At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Field Engineer - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Field Engineers to partner with prospective and strategic enterprise customers. As a Field Engineer, you’ll be the technical face of Anysphere in the field, helping customers evaluate Cursor, guiding them through proofs of concept, and ensuring they see the full value of AI in their engineering workflows.
   

  

 You’ll work hand\-in\-hand with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope solutions, demonstrate capabilities, and act as a trusted advisor to technical stakeholders. This is a highly customer\-facing role where you’ll combine deep technical fluency with strong communication skills to drive adoption and influence product direction.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Partner with Account Executives to lead technical discovery, demos, and proof\-of\-concept engagements
* Build trusted relationships with engineering leaders, architects, and developers, serving as their technical advisor

* Act as the customer’s technical advocate internally, influencing roadmap priorities and escalating feedback to Product and Engineering

* You are customer\-obsessed with a knack for translating technical details into business impact
* You have experience in Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre\-Sales, or Consulting for enterprise software
* You thrive in a startup environment: resourceful, adaptable, and proactive in creating solutions

title: Tender and Quotation Executive
description:
Delhi Electric Company is seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented person to identify opportunities from industrial clients and prepare techno\-commercial quotations. The role involves gathering project requirements, conducting inquiries with manufacturers and suppliers, preparing cost estimates, and submitting quotations for management review.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Visit and communicate with industrial clients to understand their electrical equipment requirements.
 



 Collect detailed inquiries related to:
 


* Power \& Distribution Transformers
* LT Panels
* HT/PT Panels
* Relay \& Protection Panels
* Switchgear and Electrical Switches
* Cable Trays
* Cables and other electrical accessories
* Coordinate with customers to obtain technical specifications, BOQs, drawings, and tender documents.
* Float inquiries to OEMs, manufacturers, and suppliers for pricing and technical details.
* Compare vendor quotations based on technical specifications, pricing, delivery schedules, and commercial terms.
* Prepare detailed techno\-commercial quotations using company formats.
* Submit quotations to the reporting manager for review and approval before sending them to customers.
* Follow up with suppliers for competitive pricing and timely responses.
* Maintain records of customer inquiries, vendor quotations, and submitted proposals.
* Coordinate with the sales, procurement, and technical teams to ensure accurate and timely quotation submissions.
* Follow up with customers regarding submitted quotations and provide any required clarifications.



  





**Required Skills** 




 Basic knowledge of industrial electrical equipment and power distribution systems.
 


* Familiarity with Transformers, LT/HT/PT Panels, Relay Panels, Switchgear, Cable Trays, and related electrical products.
* Ability to read technical specifications, BOQs, and electrical drawings.
* Good negotiation and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and organizational abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.



 • Ability to manage multiple inquiries and meet deadlines.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in electrical sales, estimation, tendering, or quotation preparation is preferred.

title: Solutions Architect - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Solution Architects to help the world’s best engineering organizations figure out what AI\-native software development actually looks like in production.
   

  

 This is a deeply technical, post\-sale role embedded inside SpaceXAI’s most strategic enterprise accounts. You’ll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high\-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI.
   

  

 Solution Architects sit at the center of long\-term customer transformation. You’ll help customers move from initial excitement to deeply integrating engineering workflows that teams rely on every day. That means understanding how modern software organizations operate, identifying where Cursor can create the most leverage, and helping customers scale adoption across teams, platforms, and workflows over time.
   

  

 This role is highly hands\-on. You’ll configure environments, design workflows, run enablement sessions, and solve technical problems directly with developers and platform teams inside complex enterprise environments. You’ll also help engineering leaders think through rollout strategy, workflow evolution, and the long\-term architecture for AI\-native development.
   

  

 The best Solution Architects combine deep technical credibility with strong product instincts, high ownership, and the ability to influence how large engineering organizations evolve. Solution Architects are also equally comfortable debugging CI workflows, leading architecture reviews, and helping executives understand where AI changes the economics of software development.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
**Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI\-Native Development**
* Roll out Cursor across strategic engineering organizations
* Configure environments, design workflows, and run hands\-on enablement sessions
* Help developers integrate Cursor into real production workflows, not isolated demos
* Drive fast time\-to\-value and durable adoption across teams
* Identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly


**Expand Cursor Across the Organization**
* Identify where Cursor should expand next inside the customer environment
* Help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company\-wide adoption
* Design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups
* Partner with customers to operationalize AI\-assisted development at scale
* Work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments


**Become a Trusted Technical Partner**
* Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders
* Lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions
* Advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy
* Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress
* Help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI\-native development evolves


**Drive Real Customer Outcomes**
* Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact
* Connect Cursor usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality
* Help customers communicate the value of Cursor internally and build momentum for broader adoption
* Turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization


**Help Make Cursor Indispensable**
* Deepen workflow adoption and long\-term product stickiness
* Monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on Cursor over time
* Support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction
* Help customers build workflows they can’t imagine operating without


**Shape the Future of the Product**
* Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering
* Identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements
* Help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships
* Turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns


**You may be a fit if**
* You have a strong technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling
* You have experience in customer\-facing technical roles such as Solution Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar
* You have the ability to work hands\-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership
* You have a strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments
* You have excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences
* You have strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams
* You have high ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast\-moving environments with ambiguity
* You have a passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering
* You are willing to travel to customers needed

title: Senior Proposal Manager
description:
The primary function of this role is the leading and managing of international government and commercial proposals across Shield AI’s India business. The BD Ops team is looking for this candidate to have strong technical writing experience, capable of conflating complex technical ideas into succinct prose.
   

  

 The candidate should also have excellent verbal communication and team coordination skills to facilitate contributions from teams across the Shield AI team. In this capacity the proposal manager will be able to support our growing number of proposals and manage, write, and respond to requests for information.
   

  

 Leadership skills:
   

  

* Lead India proposal efforts, align stakeholders, and communicate key customer, market, and BD strategy insights.
* Strong communicator: Strong oral and written communication skills. (Technical writing experience preferred.) Strong presentation skills. Ability to communicate seamlessly at all levels of Shield AI and customer organizations.
* Attention to detail in a fast\-paced environment: Be rigorous and go fast is one of Shield AI’s leadership traits and, possibly, the most relevant one for BD Ops. Our ideal candidate must always work with efficiency and a keen attention to detail. Both are critical to supporting on time, compliant Bids/Proposals and related deliverables.
* Organization and time management: Strong organizational and time management skills enabling the tracking and execution of multiple workstreams with stakeholders across Shield AI.
* BD Ops serves as the primary cross\-functional lead for Bids/Proposals across product lines and geographic regions. We manage the proposal lifecycle from start to finish including kickoff, collaboration with stakeholders, color reviews, and management reviews with senior leaders/executives. We are ultimately responsible for everything that does or does not happen in the Bid/Proposal process.

 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
**Your Career**
 The Named Account Manager partners with our customers to secure their entire digital experience. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. This role is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best\-in\-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero\-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well\-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 Serve as the go\-to trusted advisor in Identity Security, influencing strategy and deal execution across complex enterprise opportunities.
   

  

* Partner with product, SE, and technical specialists to shape and deliver customer strategies \- driving adoption, modernisation and expansion of PANW Idira solutions.

* Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self\-direction

title: Senior Associate - CSR Consulting
description:
**About the Company** 




  





  





 Give Grants enables large Indian corporations and foundations to deliver maximum social impact. Using a combination of consulting services, operations support and technology platforms, we work with 100\+ companies and grantmakers to make their giving journey convenient, compliant and the most impactful it can be. We are a part of Give, India’s largest philanthropic platform. Find out more about us at give.do/givegrants.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 The CSR Services team is the primary owner of all client relationships (companies / corporate foundations / philanthropic foundations) and is responsible for overall client delight. Our service offerings include strategy and program design, partner identification, KPI mapping, on\-ground monitoring and evaluation, and overall impact portfolio management. We also support clients in effectively using our CSR management tech platform. As a Senior Associate in this team, you will be working with the clients and will be required to understand the day\-to\-day operational tasks pertaining to the overall deliverables for the various stakeholders. This role will also require a good understanding and appreciation of the CSR / impact ecosystem and applicable standards / laws.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* **Program identification and delivery**
* Understand client's CSR vision and co\-develop action roadmap aligned to their CSR goals
* Deliver high\-quality reports / insights / updates to clients by regularly engaging with NGO partners and internal teams at Give Grants
* Analyse data from multiple sources including the technology platform and derive actionable insights for all stakeholders of the CSR programs. Share data\-backed insights with the clients regarding their programs.
* 
* **Strategic Consulting**
* Help clients to design / restructure programs and program indicators in line with their intent to deliver real, measurable, sustainable impact
* Keep up with the updates in the CSR ecosystem and social development space to ably guide the clients
* Undertake secondary research of the CSR / impact landscape / peer research to provide insights and trends to the clients.
* Develop depth of knowledge and expertise within specific sub\-verticals of the development landscape.
* 
* **Stakeholder Management**
* Maintain close coordination with the clients and their partners for timely delivery of services as per the agreed scope of work
* Timely raising of internal requests to ensure that the overall project plan and objectives are met.
* Develop an understanding of our tech products, to provide appropriate guidance to client teams.
* Actively contribute to pre\-sales efforts by supporting the development of high\-quality collateral and proposals.

- 


  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* Graduate/post\-graduate from top\-tier institutes with strong academic background. An academic background in economics / development studies / sociology / social work and other allied streams will be a positive but is not essential.

* Domain knowledge of CSR rules and understanding of the CSR ecosystem in India is essential.
* Knowledge in areas of national priority such as skilling, women empowerment, MCH, climate change will be a strong positive.



  





  





**Required Skills** 




  





  




* Strong analytical skills, excellent communication, storytelling and presentation skills, backed by strong verbal and written communication along with keen attention to detail.
* Technical Skills: Strong Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Word. Strong data analysis capabilities. Ability to work with the Google suite of products (Slides, Sheets, Docs).
* Soft Skills: Client communication, project management, relationship building, stakeholder management and client influencing.
* Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment with a strong commitment to ethical practices, social justice, and advancing positive social outcomes.
* A bias toward action, ability to manage multiple projects and priorities to deliver on tight deadlines.



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 




  





  




* Experience in the CSR / development space or equivalent consulting experience.
* Knowledge in areas of national priority such as skilling, women empowerment, MCH, climate change.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About The Position**
**About Coralogix**
 Coralogix is a full\-stack observability and security platform \- logs, metrics, traces, and SIEM analysed in\-stream at petabyte scale, stored in the customer's own data lake, and increasingly driven by our agentic AI layer (AI agent Olly, MCP server, CLI). Founded in 2015, headquartered in Boston, and backed by leading investors including Advent International, Brighton Park Capital, and Greenfield Partners with over $500M in funding.
   

  

 What sets Coralogix apart as a platform to build on is the combination of data depth and architectural openness. Because the platform's architecture makes full\-fidelity retention viable at scale, customers hold their complete operational and security picture in their own data lake \- no sampling, no gaps, no third party holding the keys. Every layer is then programmatic \- APIs, SDKs, and dev tools built for custom solutions \- creating an unusually rich and open foundation for the work ahead.ating requisitions 'from scratch'
   

  

**The role**
 Our most strategic customers need more than a platform. They need an engineer who deploys, customizes, and builds alongside them. Enterprise environments are complex \- multiple clouds, legacy infrastructure, custom deployments, multiple tools \- and what these customers need often extends well beyond what any platform delivers as standard.
   

  

 The Forward Deployed Engineer closes that gap. You are an engineer embedded in Tier\-1 accounts, working at the edge of what customers need next \- requirements that evolve continuously as enterprises scale, innovate, and push the boundaries of what observability and security can do for them. This is field\-deployed R\&D. It is not account management and it is not support.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Every engagement starts by getting to the real problem \- translating an ambiguous or evolving customer requirement into a concrete, scoped technical plan before a line of code is written. You build the new functionality that emerges from evolving customer requirements \- net\-new use cases with a clear path to other customers and/or back to the product, customisations that extend existing capabilities where out\-of\-the\-box configurations fall short, and critical features that unlock adoption or expansion with strategic accounts. You build in production\-grade code, not prototypes, working closely with both in\-house and customer observability and security teams \- you build, they define the logic \- ensuring domain validity in everything that ships. AI is central to both how you build and what you build: as a development accelerator and as the core ingredient in your solutions, with a particular focus on autonomous, multi\-step agentic AI workflows. Every engagement is engineered for repeatability, and you work closely with R\&D throughout \- feeding back field patterns and the solutions you have built \- so the best of what you ship is assessed, hardened, and absorbed into the platform. You are accountable for the outcomes in your accounts, not just the builds \- adoption, retention, and time\-to\-value are yours to move.
   

  

**How You Will Work**
 Own 2\-3 strategic accounts (a single account during intensive deployments), operating across the full stakeholder range within each \- from individual engineers and security analysts to CTOs and CISOs. Spend roughly 60\-70% of your time in deep customer engagement, on\-site and virtual, and the remainder on reusable playbooks and structured product feedback to R\&D. Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers, who own the commercial relationship. Exercise judgment on scope continuously \- deciding what matters now versus later, pushing back where needed, and knowing when something is ready to ship so the customer gets real value quickly. Your engagements are time\-bounded with clearly defined outcomes.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 8\+ years in software engineering writing production\-grade code. Prior security or observability experience is a big plus, not a requirement \- you will be paired with experts who provide the domain logic \- but you must ramp quickly into unfamiliar domains.
* A product\-minded engineer with experience designing and building software products end to end \- translating customer needs into product decisions, thinking in user experience and outcomes, and working fluently with modern AI development tools to build AI\-native solution
* Proven customer engagement experience across both technical and non\-technical audiences, including at C\-level \- able to build rapport quickly, explain complex concepts credibly, and navigate an enterprise organisation to get things done.
* Operates with founder\-level ownership: high urgency, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to define the problem as much as solve it.
* A genuine blend of engineering depth and strategic\-consulting instinct.
* Based in\-region, with significant on\-site time at customer sites.


**Strong plus:** 
 detection engineering or security\-operations background; hands\-on experience building agentic or LLM\-based systems in production, including familiarity with MCP; developer\-platform or SDK building; prior resident\-engineer, forward\-deployed, or strategic\-engineering experience at an observability, data\-infrastructure, or security vendor.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
 Replicable use cases delivered and subsequently absorbed into the product; improved time\-to\-value for new enterprise onboarding where you are deployed; stronger retention among your accounts versus baseline; and expansion revenue directly attributable to the capability you have built.
   

  

**How We Work**
 This is a new function \- a small, elite team with a founding mandate. We are entrepreneurial and high\-intensity, operating with unreasonable agency. If you want the deepest applied AI, observability and security engineering work available \- building real solutions for the most demanding enterprise environments, seeing your field\-proven patterns absorbed into a platform used by thousands of engineers globally \- this is where that happens. Think of it as your PhD in applied AI, observability and security: no academic benchmarks, only production.

description:
**Req ID:** 
 368981
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Technical Solutions Arch. Sr. Specialist \- PKI ( SCEPman, DigiCert) to join our team in NOIDA, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
   

  

 The PKI and Encryption Specialist is responsible for the design, implementation, and daily management of the organization’s Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and cryptographic systems. You will ensure secure communications and data integrity by managing the full lifecycle of encryption keys and digital certificates.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Infrastructure Management: Maintain and support enterprise\-level PKI solutions (e.g., Microsoft ADCS, PrimeKey EJBCA, or Entrust).
* Certificate Lifecycle: Oversight of requesting, issuing, renewing, and revoking X.509 digital certificates for users, servers, and IoT devices.
* Key Governance: Manage cryptographic keys throughout their lifecycle—including generation, distribution, and secure storage—often using Hardware Security Modules (HSMs) like Thales or Entrust.
* Automation: Implement automated certificate enrollment and renewal processes using protocols like SCEP, EST, or REST APIs to prevent service outages caused by expired certificates.
* Policy \& Compliance: Develop and enforce Certificate Policy (CP) and Certification Practice Statements (CPS) to ensure alignment with industry standards like NIST or FIPS.
* Crypto\-Agility: Lead efforts to transition from legacy algorithms (e.g., SHA\-1\) to modern standards and prepare for post\-quantum cryptography.


**Technical Skills Required**
* Cryptographic Protocols: Deep understanding of TLS/SSL, SSH, PGP, and IPsec.
* Identity Management: Experience with Active Directory (AD), LDAP, and their integration with PKI for auto\-enrollment.
* Encryption Platforms: Hands\-on experience with tools like Gemalto KeySecure, Thales CipherTrust, or HashiCorp Vault.
* Cloud Security: Familiarity with cloud\-based PKI services (e.g., AWS Certificate Manager, Azure Key Vault) and "PKI as a Service" (PKIaaS) models.

 **not a deal execution role**

**Requirements**
**What you will do**
**Pitch \& Business Development**
* Develop high\-quality, client\-facing pitch decks, credentials presentations, proposals and other business development materials

**Research \& Market Intelligence**
* Conduct company, sector and market research across financial services
* Develop sector maps, target lists, buyer/investor universes and market intelligence
* Research company ownership, shareholders, funding history, transaction history and relevant market activity
* Track M\&A and broader financial services market developments
* Turn research and data into concise, actionable insights that can support client conversations and business development


**Thought Leadership**
* Support the development of financial services thought leadership, market reports, sector insights and points of view
* Research emerging trends and themes across financial services and translate them into meaningful client\-facing content
* Help develop compelling narratives and insights rather than simply presenting data


**Pipeline \& Stakeholder Management**
* Maintain accurate business development and opportunity pipeline information
* Prepare materials for pipeline and business development meetings
* Track actions and follow up with relevant stakeholders
* Work directly with senior stakeholders across London, Manchester and Leeds
* Manage multiple requests and deadlines while maintaining quality and attention to detail


 What we're looking for
   

  

 We are looking for someone who combines
 **strong research capability, excellent PowerPoint skills and commercial thinking** 
 .
   

  

**Essential Experience**
* Relevant experience in business development, pitch support, research, strategy, investment banking, corporate finance, transaction advisory or a similar professional services environment
* Demonstrable experience creating high\-quality client\-facing pitch decks, presentations, proposals or credentials materials
* Experience contributing to thought leadership, industry reports, market insights, white papers or similar content
* Strong experience in company, market and sector research and the ability to turn research into meaningful insights
* Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills
* Excellent written and verbal English
* Ability to work with senior stakeholders and manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines
* Willingness to work with UK\-based teams and maintain a daily overlap with UK business hours


**Desirable**
* Experience within the Financial Services sector, including banking, insurance, asset \& wealth management, fintech, payments, specialty lending or related areas
* Exposure to M\&A, Debt Advisory, transaction services or other deal\-related environments
* Experience working with international stakeholders across different locations and time zones
* Familiarity with market and financial databases such as Capital IQ, PitchBook, Bloomberg, Refinitiv, Mergermarket or similar platforms
* CFA, MBA, CA or another relevant professional qualification


 What will make you successful?
   

  

 We are particularly interested in people who can demonstrate three things:
   

  

* Pitch Decks You can take a brief from a senior stakeholder and turn it into a polished, compelling and client\-ready presentation
* Thought Leadership You can understand a market or industry theme, develop a point of view and communicate it through high\-quality written and visual content
* Research You can go beyond collecting information — you can identify what matters, interpret the findings and turn them into insights that support a commercial conversation


 You should be comfortable asking,
 **"What is the question we're really trying to answer?"** 
 and
 **"So what does this mean for the client or the business?"**
 Why join us?
   

  

 This is an opportunity to work closely with senior Financial Services professionals across the UK and gain exposure to the
 **origination side of M\&A and advisory work** 
 .
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to develop your understanding of financial services markets, contribute to high\-profile pitches and thought leadership, and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our Financial Services practice.
   

  

**If you are someone who enjoys research, storytelling, creating impactful presentations and working closely with senior stakeholders, we'd love to hear from you.**
**Our Values:**
**Embrace different: \-** 
 From cultures to mindsets, we welcome them all. Our global presence means we're inclusive by nature and we believe that people are equal, but not the same.
   

  

**Do the right thing:** 
 \- Our comfort zone is uncomfortable; we always make the right decision not what is simply easy or popular. Always consider how to implement these decisions, people will always remember how you made them feel.
   

  

**All hands on deck:** 
 \- We stand shoulder to shoulder with colleagues and clients, be that physically or from afar. Our individual expertise may find them answers, but it is through teamwork that it is implemented.
   

  

**Passion drives success:** 
 \- The impossible is always possible, we push the boundaries of what is expected because we're never satisfied with the status quo. Our clients expect a positive result when they engage with us, and it's only by delivering this that we win.
   

  

**Benefits**
****Benefits****
* Opportunity to grow within a fast\-paced global organisation and build deep expertise in M\&A integration
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and executive management
* Competitive salary package, aligned with experience and market standards
* International exposure, working with multicultural teams across multiple regions

 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally.  As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the deep technical bridge between customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

title: Relationship Manager

* Willingness to work on\-site in Noida, conduct regular client meetings and property visits, and collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams.

By guiding and mentoring your team, you will foster a culture of excellence and drive revenue growth, positioning the company as a market leader in strategic account management.

By effectively managing key accounts and guiding your team, you will position the company for long\-term success and establish it as a leader in the industry.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 This exciting position will be focused on developing strong pipeline of Gas Metering ,Regulating and analysis (M\&C) business which includes Ultrasonic Meters, Flow Computers, Gas Chromatographs, Turbine Meters, RPD meters, Gas Renewable Solutions for Bio Gas and H2 etc., Regulators in growing vertical like Natural Gas, Bio Gas, Hydrogen, Oil and Gas, City Gas Distribution etc . You will develop customer relationships through coordinating and/or attending trade shows, seminar, and similar events. You will provide education of Honeywell product through technical presentations. You will maintain and provide reports and opportunity status using our customer relationship management system. You will provide competitive intelligence and market trends. You will provide forecast/demand input to Sales Inventory Operations Planning (SIOP).
   

  

 The role will coordinate and integrate an aligned customer strategy, defines product and solution scope across businesses and sets out a supporting decarbonization and growth roadmap.
   

  

 The role collaborates with sales and channel partner teams, who drive contracts, transacts, and operationally delivers with customers on the ground.
   

  

 The candidate will utilize knowledge of Gas Chromatography, Gas Renewable Market and applications, market/customer Insights, value chain understanding and risk management to develop credible and sustainable relationships At Senior Levels with Key Customers.
   

  

 The role will focus on developing multi\-year strategic customer plans and delivery roadmap, building India’s corporate customer headquarters\-level relationships, supporting annual planning cycle, leading multi\-functional and cross line of business core teams across Honeywell.
   

  

 Engage C\-suite and key decision makers at customers’ Americas headquarters during all critical stages of the strategic customer sales cycle.
   

  

 You have a deep knowledge of and passion for the energy Midstream Natural Gas Transmission market, including experience designing, structuring and selling Gas Quality and Gas Renewable projects, or other related products.
   

  

 Specification driving with consultants and EPC contractors.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop pipeline of opportunity and sales in respective assigned region
* Track the Government policy changes in renewable energy.
* Develop the strategy for H2 and Bio gas
* Attend (trade shows, seminars, events)
* Visit existing customers
* Search for new customers
* Campaign management
* Customer reporting
* Gas quality product knowledge
* Automation and remote solutions
* Customer account management
* Specification driving with consultants and EPC contractors.
* Chanel Partners handling


**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent in Instrumentation / Mechanical
* 7\+ years of experience on selling gas measurement and quality for transmission, natural gas distributions projects
* 2\+ years of experience in Bio gas and Hydrogen market development.
* Candidate with gas solution selling in process and petrochemical industry for selling Natural gas products.


**We Value**
* MBA in business development


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

* Strong understanding of databases, data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Practical experience with MCP, REST APIs, JSON\-RPC, OAuth, and secure integration frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, observability, LLMOps, and AI cost optimization.

* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, architecture documentation, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on delivering business outcomes.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or equivalent orchestration platforms.
* Experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face, or similar AI ecosystems.
* Familiarity with vector databases and search platforms such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Neo4j.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, vLLM, Langfuse, Ragas, DeepEval, and AI platform engineering practices.
* Understanding of AI governance and security frameworks, including NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI Security, ISO/IEC 42001, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience leading enterprise AI transformation initiatives, Centers of Excellence (CoE), or AI capability building programs.
* Exposure to MLOps, DataOps, and enterprise deployment strategies for scalable AI solutions.
* Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and presenting architecture roadmaps, AI strategies, and business cases.

title: Growth & Revenue Lead (AI Tech)
description:
**Job description:** 




 The Opportunity You already know how to sell technology. You know how to open a conversation, navigate objections, and close deals. But you might be missing two things: a product that genuinely disrupts its category, and a compensation structure where your effort compounds instead of resetting to zero every quarter.
 



  





 We are a fast\-growing, highly agile deeptech company looking for a seasoned sales professional to build and scale our outbound sales function. You won't just be executing someone else's playbook; you will be helping to write it.
 



  





**What We Do** 




 Tuck is an AI\-powered virtual try\-on platform for global e\-commerce apparel brands. We solve a fundamental problem: shoppers hesitate to buy when they can't visualize the fit, leading to abandoned carts and high return rates. Tuck allows shoppers to see garments on their own photos, matched perfectly with brand size charts, directly driving up merchant conversions.
 



  





 Unlike competitors using off\-the\-shelf AI wrappers, we built a proprietary pipeline that delivers unmatched realism on actual retail catalogs. Our leadership team has a proven track record of building category\-defining technology, having previously built India’s first cashierless store technology which was successfully acquired by Amazon.
 



  





 The Role Your focus will be entirely on selling Tuck to founders and e\-commerce heads of D2C fashion brands globally. You will open conversations, diagnose their store's bottlenecks, demonstrate our solution using their own product catalogs, and close deals.
 



*Crucially: You won’t spend your days hunting for leads.* 
 We provide a researched, qualified pipeline. Your job is to drive the conversation. You will also have a seat at the table to shape our pitch, target segments, and go\-to\-market strategy.
 



  





**The Compensation** 



* **Fixed Base:** 
 ₹40,000 – ₹60,000 monthly, commensurate with experience.
* **Closing Incentives:** 
 Uncapped per\-client bonuses scaled to the plan they choose.
* **Recurring Commission:** 
 5% of your client's monthly subscription fee for their first 12 months. Your income grows with your book of business.
* **Target Earnings:** 
 Realistic OTE (On\-Target Earnings) for a strong performer is
 **₹1,00,000 – ₹1,25,000/month** 
 , scaling higher as your recurring portfolio builds.



  





**Who We're Looking For** 



* **Experience:** 
 Minimum 3 years in B2B technology sales (SaaS, software, or IT products).
* **Communication:** 
 Exceptional, confident spoken English. You must be comfortable speaking peer\-to\-peer with global founders.
* **Business Acumen:** 
 A deep curiosity about business metrics. You should be able to intelligently discuss Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), conversion rates, return logistics, and profit margins—not just recite software features.
* **Resilience:** 
 Comfortable owning a revenue target, managing a pipeline, and navigating the reality of B2B sales.
* *Advantageous:* 
 Familiarity with Shopify/e\-commerce ecosystems, strong CRM discipline, and experience in international markets.



  





**What to Expect** 




 You will work directly with the founders, receiving hands\-on product training from day one. You are joining early enough that whoever successfully builds this function will eventually lead it.
 



 We value transparency: building a solid client base takes time, and we maintain a clear performance bar for the first three months, which will be transparently discussed prior to an offer. We offer a dynamic environment where you experience real ownership rather than just acting as a cog in an existing machine.
 



  





**How We Hire** 




 Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a live mock sales call (product details will be provided in advance).

description:
**Digital Marketing Specialist** 




  





**• Location: India (Global role, supporting all markets)** 




**• Experience: 3–7 years** 




**• Reports to: Global VP and GTM lead** 




  





**About the Role** 




  





 We're looking for a hands\-on Digital Marketing Specialist to own the end\-to\-end execution of our paid digital campaigns, email marketing, and the day\-to\-day upkeep of our digital properties (website, landing pages, event pages, organic social). This is an individual\-contributor role for someone who can bring knowledge of best practices and plan and run campaigns independently while working with global stakeholders. This role suits someone who wants ownership over the full digital funnel from ad spend and targeting through to the landing experience, email nurture, and performance reporting. What You'll Do Campaign Execution (Paid Media)
 



  





 • Plan and execute digital campaigns across LinkedIn Ads, Google Search, and other relevant platforms, from budget allocation and audience targeting/filtering through to launch, optimization, and iteration
 



 • Plan, run and manage Search campaigns and potentially AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) ad campaigns
 



 • Own campaign performance: monitor, analyze, and iterate on live campaigns to improve efficiency and results
 



 • Use Salesforce data to identify how prospects have engaged across campaigns and tie together loose ends in the funnel (e.g., connecting ad/campaign touches to pipeline activity, spotting drop\-off points, following up on gaps in engagement tracking)
 



 • Build and share regular performance reporting, with clear takeaways and recommendations, not just raw numbers
 



 • Identify and share best practices across campaign types and platforms to continuously raise the bar
 



 • Coordinate with third\-party vendors and agencies supporting digital advertising (media buys, platform reps, ad ops support) Email Marketing • Build and manage email marketing campaigns in Apollo
 



 • Build and maintain email lists using Salesforce data, working with sales operations to clean and validate lists • Plan and execute email sends/nurture sequences, monitor performance, and iterate Digital Properties C Organic Social
 



 • Own website performance and metrics (traffic, conversion, page speed). Monitor, report, and flag issues or opportunities
 



 • Own organic social media metrics and reporting
 



 • Handle simple, direct content edits on the website (WordPress) such as copy updates, campaign\-specific landing page tweaks, and content refreshes. Work alongside our web developer agency for anything beyond direct edits (new pages, complex builds, structural changes)
 



 • Manage cookie/consent configurations and campaign\-specific tracking setups (UTMs, pixels, conversion tracking)
 



 • Own web form setup and handling for campaign and content assets
 



 • Manage on\-page SEO / AEO for existing content (metadata, keywords, internal linking, content refreshes)
 



 • Publish and maintain blog content within the existing site structure
 



 • Create and retire event landing pages tied to campaigns, webinars, and conferences
 



 • Coordinate with the web developer agency on anything requiring development work, and work cross\-functionally with Content, Design, and Marketing Operations to keep digital properties current What You Bring
 



 • 4–5 years of hands\-on experience running digital campaigns across LinkedIn Ads and Google Search (Ads/AEO); B2B experience preferred
 



 • Working knowledge of WordPress specifically
 



 • Experience with Salesforce (or similar CRM), comfortable pulling and interpreting data to trace prospect engagement across campaigns
 



 • Experience with email marketing platforms (Apollo experience a plus) \- building lists, segmenting, and running campaigns
 



 • Familiarity with web analytics tools (GA4 or equivalent) and organic social analytics, with ability to translate data into reporting and next steps
 



 • Understanding of cookie/consent management and basic campaign tracking setup
 



 • Experience coordinating with external vendors/agencies (media, web development)
 



 • Very hands on, comfortable working independently and owning outcomes.
 



 • Strong communication skills; ability to work across time zones with North American and European stakeholders, and cross\-functionally with Content, Design, and Operations teams
 



 • Detail\-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple concurrent campaigns and site updates without dropping balls What This Role Is Not
 



 • Not a creative/design role — you'll work with existing creative assets, not produce them
 



 • Not a web development role — net\-new pages, CMS architecture, and complex technical builds go through our web developer agency; you'll handle simple, direct edits and coordinate with the agency on the rest

description:
**Influencer Marketing Manager** 




 We're not hiring someone to spam micro\-influencers with free products. We need someone who builds real relationships with creators, sources authentic UGC, and turns creator content into a growth lever for HIRA and our portfolio brands.
 



 The role is
 **Influencer Marketing Manager.** 




 The reality is — you own community, creator partnerships, and UGC that actually converts.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Creator Sourcing \& Outreach** 



* Find micro\-influencers who actually fit the brand (not just follower count)
* Build relationships with creators — be someone they want to work with again
* Pitch partnerships that feel authentic, not transactional
* Negotiate rates and deliverables without overpaying



**UGC \& Content Strategy** 



* Brief creators on what to make and why (product features, brand story, lifestyle angle)
* Ensure content works both organically and as paid ads
* Source unboxing, testimonial, and lifestyle UGC
* Repurpose creator content into Meta/Google ads with performance tracking



**Campaign Management** 



* Run influencer campaigns end\-to\-end (briefing → content → posting → tracking)
* Manage timelines and deliverables
* Handle affiliate/promo code tracking
* Build repeat creator relationships — lock in people who work



**Performance \& Analytics** 



* Track creator content performance (engagement, reach, saves, conversions)
* Know which creators drive actual sales vs vanity metrics
* Build creator cohort analysis — what type of creator works best?
* Optimize spend based on creator ROI



**Community Building** 



* Engage with creator communities — be present, responsive
* Foster brand advocates who want to work with you repeatedly
* Handle DMs, comments, and community feedback
* Build a "creator network" that feels like a community, not a vendor list



  





**You might be the one if —** 



* You have 2–4 years influencer marketing experience in D2C, beauty, or lifestyle
* You've managed creator relationships and built repeat partnerships
* You understand Instagram algorithm — why some content pops, why some doesn't
* You know the difference between an influencer and an actual fit for your brand
* You've sourced and negotiated with micro\-influencers (the real ROI lies here)
* You've tracked UGC performance and optimized for actual conversions
* You're comfortable with social media — you spend time on Instagram, you know trends
* Prior experience in fragrance, beauty, or FMCG D2C is a plus
* You think like a curator, not a marketer — you're finding people, not broadcasting



  





  





**Why Meolaa:** 




 Meolaa is launching with influencers as a core channel. You'll own creator relationships, UGC strategy, and community building from day one. You're not supporting someone else's strategy — you're building it.
 



 You'll work with the Growth team to repurpose your UGC into paid ads. You'll have real budget. And you'll see direct impact when creator content drives conversions.

title: Marketing Operations Specialist, Asset Management

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Overview Of The Role**
 Northern Trust Asset Management's global marketing strategy is evolving, our team is growing and we’re looking for individuals interested in growing with us. We are seeking passionate, results\-driven, creative thinkers, with a high attention to detail who value collaboration.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Product Marketing Operations, the Marketing Operations Specialist position is a generalist role within our production team in Marketing Operations. The production team establishes and adapts the update cycle process and procedures to create scale and mitigate marketing/business risk. This includes, but is not limited to, creating a cycle framework, implementing regulatory updates, managing collateral updates, and automating deliverables. The team also assists with Seismic, specifically content maintenance and uploads and executing tasks designed to modernize the platform.
   

  

 The Marketing Operations Specialist has primary responsibility for the updating, maintenance and production of our quarterly and annual performance marketing content and materials across print and digital platforms. Secondarily, during off\-update cycle periods, the Specialist will take on additional efficiency projects.
   

  

 The role will require strong collaboration and partnership within Marketing and across Data Operations and Technology, Product Development and Management, Investments and Client Portfolio Management, Compliance and Legal, and Distribution to establish clear objectives and priorities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Complete quarterly/annual update cycle of collateral materials (pitchbooks, profiles, flyers, bios, etc.) including content updates, status reporting, compliance submissions, and being well\-versed with all data and sources (performance, characteristics, rankings, internal databases, etc.)
* Create and manage procedures to efficiently and effectively scale content update \& maintenance, mitigate risk and comply with industry and internal standards
* Establish and maintain relationships throughout the firm, across Compliance, Technology/Data, Client Portfolio Managers/Portfolio Managers, Distribution, Reporting, and others
* Implement ad hoc content updates due to organization changes, fund actions, and regulatory rules \& changes, as established by governing bodies (SEC, FINRA, ASIC, FCA, ESMA, etc.), across various investment offerings, regions, and marketing assets, including coordinating changes to product webpages
* Review and identify opportunities to use technology to support efficiency and/or automation of marketing content and recurring deliverables, eliminating data dependency, redundancy \& reduce cycle time
* Be intellectually curious, gain a knowledge and understanding of our products, as well as continuing to research and learn about Marketing Operations and production advances in the industry
* Increase productivity by simplifying workflows using data and AI‑and automation\-driven tools
* Support the overall Marketing Operations team, acting as back\-up support for other roles and responsibilities within the group as designated


**Experience \& Skills**
 The successful candidate will benefit from having:
   

  

* 3 years of financial services performance/data update experience preferred
* Understanding of the investment management industry, familiarity with investment vehicles, marketing constructs, regulatory requirements, and distribution channels preferred
* Effective collaboration and communication (verbal \& written) skills
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, with a commitment to quality
* Ability to prioritize in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to follow established procedures and maintain accurate records
* Ability to think creatively and outside the box to find to solutions to known problems
* Demonstrated ability to multi\-task, ­effectively manage and navigate multiple projects, organize competing objectives and manage deadlines
* Strong work ethic and professional demeanor
* Creative and technical abilities across the Microsoft office suite, including Copilot


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**
 The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

 \*\*Type:\*\* Project\-Based Internship
 



 \*\*Stipend:\*\* As per market standards
 



 \*\*Joining:\*\* Immediate
 



  





 \#\#\# About Roti Kulcha Naan
 



  





 Roti Kulcha Naan is a growing food brand focused on serving great North Indian breads and food in a quick\-service format.
 



 We’re looking for energetic, curious and creative \*\*Marketing Interns\*\* who want to get hands\-on experience building marketing for a real consumer brand.
 



 This is not a typical internship where you'll spend three months making presentations and watching from the sidelines.
 



 You’ll be involved in \*\*coming up with ideas, executing them, testing what works and measuring the results.\*\*
 



  





 \#\#\# What You'll Work On
 



  





 Depending on your strengths and interests, you could work on projects across:
 



 \*\*Social Media \& Content
 



 \* Plan and execute Instagram content and Reels
 



 \* Come up with creative content ideas around food, customers and the brand
 



 \* Help create photos and videos at our outlets
 



 \* Experiment with different content formats and understand what performs
 



 \* Build and maintain a content calendar
 



  





 \*\*Local Store Marketing
 



 \* Identify marketing opportunities around our outlets
 



 \* Plan campaigns targeting nearby colleges, offices, apartments and communities
 



 \* Explore partnerships with local businesses and communities
 



 \* Come up with ideas to increase awareness and footfall
 



  





 \*\*Customer Growth
 



 \* Develop ideas to bring in new customers
 



 \* Find ways to increase repeat orders
 



 \* Work on referral, loyalty and promotional campaigns
 



 \* Explore WhatsApp and other customer engagement channels
 



  





 \*\*Marketing Experiments
 



 \* Identify a problem or opportunity
 



 \* Come up with a campaign or experiment
 



 \* Execute it with the team
 



 \* Measure the results
 



 \* Figure out what worked and what didn't
 



  





 \*\*Competitor \& Market Research
 



 \* Study other food and QSR brands
 



 \* Track their campaigns, offers and content
 



 \* Identify interesting ideas that RKN can learn from or test
 



  





 \#\#\# What We're Looking For
 



  





 You don't need to have previous marketing experience.
 



 We care more about \*\*how you think and how much initiative you take.\*\*
 



  





 You'd be a great fit if you:
 



 \* Are creative and constantly coming up with ideas
 



 \* Understand Instagram, Reels and social media culture
 



 \* Enjoy creating content or experimenting with new formats
 



 \* Communicate well and aren't afraid to approach people
 



 \* Are curious about why customers behave the way they do
 



 \* Can take an idea from concept to execution
 



 \* Are comfortable working in a fast\-moving, hands\-on environment
 



 \* Are willing to go beyond your assigned task when you see something that can be improved
 



  





 \*\*Students pursuing Marketing, Business, Media, Design, Communications or similar fields are welcome to apply.\*\*
 



  





 But your degree matters less to us than your \*\*ability, curiosity and attitude.\*\*
 



  





 \#\#\# What You'll Get
 



  





 \* Hands\-on experience working with a real consumer/food brand
 



 \* Ownership of actual marketing projects
 



 \* Opportunity to see your ideas go from concept to execution
 



 \* Exposure to social media, local marketing, customer acquisition and brand building
 



 \* Regular feedback and mentorship
 



 \* A portfolio of real projects and campaigns you can showcase
 



 \* Certificate of internship on successful completion
 



 \* \*\*Performance\-based opportunity for continued work with Roti Kulcha Naan\*\*
 



  





 \#\#\# What Success Looks Like
 



  





 By the end of the internship, you shouldn't just be able to say:
 



  





 \> "I interned at bla bla bla."
 



  





 You should be able to say:
 



  





 \> "I ran these campaigns, created this content, tested these ideas and generated these results."
 



  





 That's what we're looking for.
 



  





 \#\#\# How to Apply
 



  





 Send us:
 



  





 \*\*1\. Your resume\*\*
 



 \*\*2\. A short introduction about yourself\*\*
 



 \*\*3\. One marketing idea you'd like our brand to try\*\*
 



  





 No fancy cover letter required.

title: Associate Director - Growth & Retention
description:
**About Snapmint:** 




 India’s booming consumer market has over 300 million credit\-eligible consumers, yet only 35million actively use credit cards. At Snapmint, we are building a better alternative to credit cards that lets consumers buy now and pay later for a wide variety of products, be it shoes, clothes, fashion accessories, clothes or mobile phones. We firmly believe that an enduring financial services business must be built on the bedrock of providing honest, transparent and fair terms.
 



  





 Founded in 2017, today we are the leading online zero\-cost EMI provider in India. We have served over 10M consumers across 2,200 cities and are doubling year on year. Our founders are serial entrepreneurs and alumni of IIT Bombay and ISB with over two decades of experience across leading organizations like Swiggy, Oyo, Maruti Suzuki and ZS Associates before successfully scaling and exiting businesses in patent analytics, ad\-tech and bank\-tech software services.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As Senior Manager / Associate Director – Growth \& Retention, you will own the full lifecycle P\&L—from activation to repeat behaviour to reactivation—and lead a multidisciplinary team of 12–15 across analytics, CRM, campaign operations, personalisation, and rewards. This is a function\-head role. You will set strategy, manage a significant incentive budget, and represent Growth \& Retention in leadership forums.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 ● Full Lifecycle P\&L: CLTV, contribution margin, incentive budget allocation, and ROAS across all customer segments and product lines.
 



 ● Activation: Turn new users (especially checkout\-origin) into first\-time transactors on Snapmint; drive app adoption and reduce time\-to\-first\-purchase.
 



 ● Deepening Engagement: Build the repeat flywheel—cross\-sell across marketplace, vouchers, personal loans, and recharges; increase multi\-product adoption.
 



 ● Retention \& Reactivation: Prolong active lifespan, predict and reduce churn, run winback campaigns with documented payback periods.
 



 ● Rewards \& Loyalty: Oversee the rewards programme as an integrated lifecycle lever—merchant partnerships, unit economics, and programme ROI.
 



 ● Team \& Organisational Leadership: Build, mentor, and scale a high\-performing team; set quarterly priorities; be the executive stakeholder for the CRM/engagement tech stack
 



  





**Qualifications:** 




 ● 7\+ years of experience, with 4\+ years in lifecycle/CRM/growth at a consumer internet or fintech company.
 



 ● 3\+ years of people management—you’ve led and developed teams during high\-growth phases.
 



 ● Proven P\&L ownership—you’ve been accountable for a lifecycle or retention budget and its economic outcomes, not just engagement metrics.
 



 ● Strong analytical foundation: SQL, Python, CLTV/RFM modelling, A/B testing, and cohort economics.
 



 ● Hands\-on familiarity with CRM platforms (CleverTap, MoEngage, or similar) and multi\-channel campaign design (push, WhatsApp, SMS, email, IVR).
 



 ● Exposure to rewards or loyalty programme mechanics is a strong plus.
 



 ● A leader who sets the agenda, makes decisions with margin and payback in mind, and drives cross\-functional influence with Product, Credit, and Data Science.
