title: Content Marketer
description:
At Murf AI, we are simplifying voice integration and creation for builders and creators. Our Text\-to\-Speech platforms help developers build natural, responsive voice agents and enable enterprise teams to produce high\-quality voiceovers and multilingual dubs with ease.
 



  





**Some interesting facts about Murf AI:** 




 ●Customers in 100\+ countries
 



 ● 8Mn\+ registered users
 



 ● 200\+ voices in 35\+ languages offered by Murf Studio
 



 ● Rated by G2 as Top 10 Fastest Growing Products in 2024 \& 2025
 



 ● We are working on bleeding\-edge research problems, in synthetic speech, and dubbing
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We're looking for a Content Marketer to write, edit, and scale content across Murf's organic channels. You'll be part of the organic growth team to turn keywords/topics/customer queries into original blogs, landing pages, product teardowns, and product\-led content — and you'll do it at a volume and quality bar that's only possible with AI\-native workflows.
 



 This is not a "write three blogs a month" role. We want someone who treats content production as a system: building briefs, running AI\-assisted drafting pipelines, editing for accuracy and voice, and using data to decide what gets written next. We are looking for someone who can write genuinely helpful content that’s not a summary of a few articles from the internet.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Content Production \& Scale** 




 Write and edit content across Murf's organic channels — long\-form blogs, landing pages, use\-case and comparison pages, glossary and help content — aligned to search, customer queries and search\-intent strategy.
 



 Own the throughput and quality of the content pipeline: briefs in, publish\-ready pages out, with clear turnaround times and quality gates
 



 Operate and improve AI\-native content workflows (LLM\-assisted research, brief generation, drafting, humanizing, and pre\-publish audits)
 



 Refresh and consolidate existing content based on decay, cannibalization, and ranking data
 



  





**SEO Collaboration** 




 Partner with the SEO team on keyword research, SERP analysis, and content gap identification
 



 Structure content for search — headings, entities, internal links, human\-friendly formatting — and for AI search surfaces (AI Overviews, LLM citations)
 



 Track performance in Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and analytics dashboards; use the data to prioritize what to write, update, or retire
 



  





**Product \& Brand Accuracy** 




 Work closely with product, design, and customer\-facing teams so content accurately reflects Murf's features, use cases, and positioning
 



 Maintain Murf's tone of voice and editorial standards across every piece, whether written by a human, an AI, or both
 



 Contribute to content guidelines, style rules, and QC checklists that keep quality consistent as volume grows
 



  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 



* 3\+ years of experience in content marketing, with a strong focus on SEO and organic growth
* Must have: prior experience at a B2B SaaS company, writing for technical or semi\-technical buyers
* Well versed in AI\-native content workflows — you've used LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) in a real production setting, not just for one\-off drafts, and you have a point of view on where AI helps and where it hurts
* Genuine comfort with AI and technology as subject matter — you can explain how AI agents, voice AI and LLMs work to a non\-expert reader without getting it wrong
* Working knowledge of SEO tools (Google Search Console, Analytics, Ahrefs or SEMrush) and the ability to analyze data
* Strong portfolio of published content with demonstrable ranking or traffic results
* Excellent editorial judgment: you can tell a good draft from a mediocre one and know exactly what to fix
* Structured, systems\-minded approach to production — you think in briefs, templates, and repeatable processes



  





**Good to Have** 



* Computer science or engineering background, or equivalent technical fluency
* Hands\-on experience with content automation (e.g., multi\-step LLM pipelines, MCP\-connected tools, no\-code/low\-code automation)
* Familiarity with CMS platforms (Webflow, WordPress, headless CMS) and basic HTML/Markdown
* Experience writing for developer or API audience



  





**Why Murf.ai?** 




 Murf AI is revolutionizing creative workflows for businesses through the utilization of our cutting\-edge AI technology. Recognized as a consistent Leader and Momentum Leader on G2 in 2022 and 2023, we empower L\&D and creative teams to evolve into dynamic creative powerhouses. With a focus on cutting\-edge research and innovation, a positive work culture, and real impact in the AI\-driven space, Murf.ai is one of the fastest\-growing companies in the AI voice space. Join us at this pivotal moment, where your ideas matter, and your leadership can leave a lasting impact. If you're ready for a challenge and have the vision to lead from the front, Murf.ai is where your journey into the next chapter of AI innovation begins.

description:

**Sr Manager \| Director \- Implementation Planning, GOC**
****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
   

  

 At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP \& WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
   

  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.


****Role Summary And Impact****
 As part of our Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will partner with teams across the U.S., Europe, and Asia to deliver high\-impact, integrated media planning solutions across multiple markets and channels.
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end planning operations across multiple campaigns, brands, or markets while ensuring consistency in quality, timelines, and strategic output.
* Support Associate Directors and market stakeholders in developing integrated media planning recommendations aligned with business and campaign objectives.
* Act as a key escalation point for operational and planning\-related challenges across the team.
* Drive excellence in campaign planning deliverables, including audience strategy, channel allocation, forecasting, reporting frameworks, and post\-campaign analysis.
* Collaborate closely with Activation, Ad Operations, Analytics, and Client Servicing teams to ensure seamless execution of media plans.
* Ensure planning best practices, governance standards, and documentation processes are consistently followed across the team.
* Support implementation and adoption of planning tools, automation solutions, and operational efficiencies.
* Monitor team productivity, delivery quality, and workload allocation to ensure optimal operational performance.
* Provide coaching, mentorship, and developmental guidance to Managers, Senior Executives, and Executives.
* Contribute to capability\-building initiatives, knowledge\-sharing forums, and process improvement projects.
* Foster a collaborative and high\-performing team culture focused on accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.


****Skills And Experience****
* Media Planning teams are experts on the digital media landscape and how consumers interact with it. We architect and steward holistic media plans throughout their lifecycle, owning the creation of overall plans, cross\-channel budget allocation, in\-flight cross\-channel optimization \& reporting and post\-campaign analysis. We are our clients’ key contacts for a unified view across all aspects of their campaigns, narrating the story of the campaign from planning recommendation through to PCA.
* 6 plus years of experience in media planning, integrated communications planning, or digital strategy roles, preferably within a global agency environment.
* Strong understanding of integrated media channels including digital, social, search, commerce, video, programmatic, impact buys and other non biddable emerging media.
* Proven experience managing teams in a fast\-paced offshore/onshore delivery setup.
* Experience handling multi\-market campaigns and collaborating with global stakeholders.
* Strong operational mindset with experience managing workflows, quality standards, and process governance.
* Excellent analytical and strategic thinking capabilities with a data\-driven approach to planning and optimization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively.
* Experience with media planning tools, reporting dashboards, and planning frameworks.
* Strong presentation and storytelling capabilities.
* Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and drive operational efficiencies.
* Strong coaching and people management skills with experience developing high\-performing teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a dynamic environment.


****Life At WPP Media \& Benefits****
 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media \& WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in\-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include access to internal learning platforms, certifications, and training sessions, life insurance, wellness programs, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, employee mental health awareness day, and more.
   

  

 Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don't apply for roles if they don't meet all the criteria. At WPP Media, we strongly encourage you to apply if you’re interested, we'd love to know how you can positively impact our team with your experience!
   

  

 As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we believe that diversity is vital and positively influences the environment in which we operate. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment that is free of discrimination, harassment or bullying. Race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status have no bearing on our hiring decisions, and we encourage all applicants.
   

  

 We view everyone as an individual and we understand that inclusion is more than just diversity – it’s about belonging. We celebrate the fact that everyone is unique and that’s what makes us so good at what we do. We pride ourselves on being a company that embraces difference and truly represents the global clients we work with.
   

  

 We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
   

  

 Please read our Privacy Notice (
 **https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy\-policy** 
 ) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Senior Director - Performance Marketing (Remote)
description:
**Own the paid media engine for a $1Billion\+ brand. Decide what to launch and where the budget goes.** 




  





**Total Annual Package:** 
 Up to USD $240,000 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Global)
 



**Growth path from here is fluid:** 
 all paid channels, including the ones you select, moving toward scope at the intersection of capital allocation, creative strategy, and P\&L ownership. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere happens in 1\-2 here.
 



  





**We've been AI\-first since December 2023:** 
 Every proposal that reaches the CEO ships with an LLM validation link. Your first spend case gets stress\-tested by an advanced model to eliminate blind spots.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Senior Director of Performance Marketing to own a multi\-million\-dollar monthly paid media engine across Google and Meta with full authority over systems, measurement, creative testing, capital allocation, and team, reporting directly to the CEO.
 



  





 This role exists to convert a multi\-million\-dollar paid budget into maximum contribution margin, building the decision systems, measurement infrastructure, and team that let the revenue engine run and scale without day\-to\-day executive involvement.
 



  





**The Problems You'll Own:** 



* **Primary: Decide what to launch and where the budget goes:** 
 A multi\-million\-dollar monthly budget runs across Google and Meta, and every standard campaign type is already live and optimized: brand and non\-brand search, PMax, Meta prospecting and retargeting, Shopping and feed. Growth now has to come from what isn't running: new campaign structures, new creative, a different mix of spend.



  




* **Secondary: Build the system that runs the scaling decisions:** 
 Design and document the rules that govern spend, when to pause, when to increase budget, when to pull back, and the measurement each decision depends on. The system should run the scaling without day\-to\-day executive oversight.



  





**The Career Accelerator:** 




 This is not a role where you manage dashboards and present decks.
 



  




* **The scope is scarce** 
 : very few Senior Directors of Performance Marketing get simultaneous authority over multi\-million\-dollar monthly budgets on both major platforms, full ownership of measurement and creative systems, org design power, and a direct line to the CEO with no layers in between.
* **Your first 12 months:** 
 build pause/hold/scale logic, budget guardrails, and escalation protocols from scratch. Deploy incrementality testing and reconcile platform attribution against backend reality. Architect the creative engine as a system: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, and whitelisting. Design capital allocation on marginal return rather than platform\-reported averages. Design promo architecture across the retail calendar: pulse strategy, financing offers, funnel alignment. Identify, evaluate, and pilot paid channels beyond Google and Meta. Structure the performance marketing function itself. Shape the future of performance marketing at Puffy, where paid media is the primary growth lever.



  





**What Is In It For You:** 




 This isn't just another performance marketing role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
 



  





**1\. Own the Paid Engine End to End, With No Layers Above You** 




 You set the strategy, build the systems, and own the outcomes.
 



  




* You allocate multi\-million\-dollar monthly budgets across Google and Meta on marginal return rather than platform\-reported averages, design the pause/hold/scale logic and budget guardrails that govern all paid spend, and serve as the single source of truth on paid media performance. Creative runs as a system you architect: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting.
* You hold profitability to a contribution\-margin standard after returns and financing costs, not ROAS in isolation. You lead, assess, and structure the performance marketing function with org design authority and CEO sign\-off, reporting directly to the CEO.



  





**2\. Join a High\-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:** 



* 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
* 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
* 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.



 Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high\-velocity execution that drives a global brand
 



  





**3\. Embrace Radical Flexibility** 




 Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co\-working space, (OR) our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
 



  





**4\. Become the Operator Other Brands Try to Hire** 




 In most companies, performance marketing leaders inherit a system somebody else built and spend the next three years defending its numbers in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides how much capital goes into growth next quarter, your model is the input to that decision, not a report on it afterwards. You'll leave with a paid media system you designed end to end, and the proof that it held contribution margin at scale, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI\-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI\-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency deck in front of you.
 



  





**What You'll Need:** 



* 7\+ years in performance marketing with sustained ownership of $1M\+/month on both Google and Meta (concurrently or across roles). "Ownership" means authority over strategy, structure, and budget, not just execution.
* Google depth at PMax\-era: campaign structure, feed management, brand/non\-brand economics.
* High\-AOV considered\-purchase experience ($1,000\+ order values): sparse\-conversion, long\-decision\-cycle categories.
* Personally built, not inherited, bid, budget, and pause decision systems at scale. You'll be asked to present a playbook you authored.
* Statistical decision literacy: volume gating, false\-kill vs. wasted\-spend trade\-offs, threshold derivation, incrementality test design.
* Creative testing systems at scale in a post\-ATT environment: concept\-vs\-variation discipline, creative analytics.
* Team leadership including senior direct reports. Experience building or restructuring a performance marketing function.
* Structured approach to new channel evaluation: selection frameworks, pilot design, budget allocation, and kill criteria.



  





**Good\-to\-Have:** 



* Scripting against Meta/Google APIs; Google Ads Scripts.
* Mixed agency \+ in\-house background.
* Experience with emerging paid channels (e.g., TikTok, Connected TV, affiliate/partnerships, etc.).
* D2C e\-commerce background in home goods, furniture, or comparable high\-AOV verticals.



  





**The Puffy DNA:** 




 We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast\-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
 


* **Be the Owner:** 
 We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
* **Execute with Urgency:** 
 We thrive in high\-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
* **Demand Excellence:** 
 We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
* **Be AI\-First:** 
 Daily multi\-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
* **Go All\-In:** 
 When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.



  





**✨ Your Total Compensation \& Benefits:** 



* 💰
 **Compensation:** 
 Total Annual Package: Up to USD $240,000 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)



 Annual salary review every January
 


* 🏥
 **Health \& Protection:**

title: Social Media Manager - Restaurants and F&B
description:
**Social Media Manager – Restaurants \& F\&B** 




**Tangy Tech Media \| Hospitality, Restaurants \& F\&B** 




 Hybrid \| Travel / on\-ground presence for clients, shoots and launches as required
 



  





 If you’ve spent the last few years managing too many brands, filling content calendars, chasing trends and measuring success by whether you posted enough this month \- this role is probably going to feel different.
 



  





 We’re looking for a
 **Social Media Manager** 
 who understands restaurants and F\&B beyond Instagram.
 



  





 Someone who can walk into a restaurant, understand what makes it interesting, find the stories hiding inside the business, and turn those stories into content people want to watch, save, share \- and eventually experience for themselves.
 



  





 This is not a high\-volume social media role.
 



  





 It is a chance to work closely on a smaller but high\-stakes portfolio of hospitality brands, go deeper into each business and build social media that contributes to
 **brand relevance, desirability, discovery and growth.** 




  





**\#Why this could be an important career move:** 




  





 There are plenty of social media roles where you can manage 10\-20 accounts. This isn't one of them.
 



 At Tangy Tech Media, we are deliberately building around
 **quality over volume** 
 .
 



 You will work closely with restaurant founders, chefs and hospitality teams and be involved much earlier than the point at which somebody says: "We need six reels for next month."
 



 You'll understand the brand strategy. You'll understand the guest.
 



 You'll understand the restaurant, the food, the people behind it and what the business is trying to achieve.
 



  





 Then you'll decide what the brand should be saying \- and how social media can bring that to life.
 



  





 For the right person, this is an opportunity to move from
 **managing social media** 
 to becoming someone who can
 **build hospitality brands through content.** 




  





**\#What you'll own:** 




  





 You will take responsibility for the social media and content direction of the brands assigned to you \- from thinking through the strategy to making sure the work actually gets executed.
 



  





 That includes:
 



 \* Building social media strategies based on the brand's positioning, business objectives and target guest \- not generic monthly content buckets.
 



 \* Translating brand strategy into strong, recognisable content pillars and recurring formats.
 



 \* Developing monthly and campaign\-led content plans across Instagram and other relevant social platforms.
 



 \* Identifying the stories worth telling \- founders, chefs, dishes, ingredients, producers, design, culture, people, processes, experiences and everything happening behind the restaurant.
 



 \* Writing strong briefs for reels, photography, video, design and campaign content.
 



 \* Working with photographers, videographers, designers, creators and client teams to bring those ideas to life.
 



 \* Directing shoots from a content and storytelling perspective.
 



 \* Writing or shaping captions and social copy so that every brand develops its own voice rather than sounding like another restaurant account.
 



 \* Planning restaurant launches, menu launches, collaborations, events, seasonal campaigns and cultural moments across social.
 



 \* Building content around PR moments, influencer activity, partnerships and campaigns so that social doesn't operate in isolation.
 



 \* Understanding what's happening culturally and digitally without turning every brand into a trend\-chasing account.
 



 \* Managing publishing, community interaction and day\-to\-day social media hygiene.
 



 \* Reviewing performance and turning insights into better creative and strategic decisions.
 



 \* Tracking the metrics that matter \- reach and engagement, certainly, but also discovery, enquiries, reservations, campaign response, audience quality and other indicators relevant to the business.
 



 \* Presenting ideas and recommendations confidently to founders and senior client teams.
 



 \* Taking ownership when something isn't working and changing course instead of waiting to be told what to do next.
 



  





**\#What we are not looking for** 




  





 We're not looking for someone whose idea of social media strategy is: "Monday \- motivational post. Wednesday \- reel. Friday \- carousel."
 



 We're also not looking for someone who relies entirely on trending audio, meme formats or copying what another restaurant did last week.
 



 And this isn't a role for someone who wants to receive a brief, execute exactly what's written and move to the next task.
 



  





 We want someone who
 **thinks** 
 . Someone who asks:
 







 Why would anybody care about this?
 



 Why would somebody save this?
 



 What does this tell them about the restaurant?
 



 Could any other restaurant have posted this exact piece of content?
 



 What makes someone want to visit after seeing it?
 



 What does this brand need to become known for?
 



  





**\#Who we're looking for:** 




  





 You should ideally have
 **3–6 years of experience in social media, content or digital marketing** 
 , with meaningful experience working on
 **restaurants, F\&B, hospitality or closely related lifestyle brands.** 




  





 You should already understand that hospitality content is its own discipline.
 



 A beautifully shot dish isn't automatically a good piece of content.
 



 Neither is a founder talking into a camera.
 



 Neither is a reel with 500,000 views if nobody remembers which restaurant it came from.
 



  





**We're particularly interested in people who can demonstrate:** 




  





 \* Strong restaurant/F\&B social media work.
 



 \* The ability to develop ideas rather than simply execute calendars.
 



 \* A strong visual eye and understanding of photography, video and design.
 



 \* Good copy and storytelling instincts.
 



 \* An understanding of what makes restaurant brands culturally relevant.
 



 \* Experience briefing and directing photographers, videographers, designers or creators.
 



 \* Confidence working directly with founders, chefs and senior stakeholders.
 



 \* Strong organisation and the ability to move several pieces of work forward without constant supervision.
 




 \*
 
 Comfort analysing social media performance and making decisions from the numbers.
 




 \*
 
 Curiosity about restaurants, food, hospitality, culture, design and consumer behaviour.
 



  





**Agency experience is useful.** 




**Hospitality experience is considerably more important.** 




  





**What you can build here:** 




 We want this person to become far more than the person who manages our clients' social media accounts.
 



  





 As Tangy Tech Media grows, there is room for you to develop into someone who can lead social and content strategy across our hospitality portfolio.
 



 That means building your ability to:
 


1. Think strategically \- Understand where a restaurant wants to go before deciding what it should post.
2. Build brands \- Develop recognisable voices, visual worlds and content properties rather than disposable social posts.
3. Work commercially \- Understand how content connects with restaurant discovery, demand, launches, reservations, repeat visitation and brand growth.
4. .Lead creatively \- Develop ideas and guide photographers, videographers, designers, creators and younger social talent.
5. Build a serious hospitality portfolio \- Work deeply with a smaller number of restaurants and F\&B businesses rather than having your name attached to dozens of accounts you barely had time to understand.



  





**About Tangy Tech Media** 




  





 Tangy Tech Media is a hospitality\-focused growth marketing, PR and brand strategy company working with restaurants, F\&B businesses and hotels.
 



 Our work sits across brand strategy, PR, social media, content, partnerships, creators, campaigns, launches and growth. We believe the strongest hospitality marketing doesn't begin with deciding what to post. It begins by understanding: What should this brand become? And then using every communication channel to build that position consistently.
 



  





 That philosophy also shapes how our team works.
 



 We would rather do meaningful work for a smaller number of ambitious hospitality businesses than become another agency running dozens of accounts through a content factory.
 



  





**The kind of person who will thrive here:** 




  




1. You have high standards for your own work.
2. You notice details.
3. You're curious.
4. You can defend an idea but you can also recognise when another idea is better.
5. You don't need somebody constantly following up with you.
6. You're comfortable working in a founder\-led environment where good ideas can come from anywhere \- but ownership matters.
7. And you're excited by the idea of becoming very good at restaurant and hospitality social media, rather than remaining a generalist managing whichever category lands on your desk next.



  





**To apply: Please send us:** 



1. Your updated CV to hr@tangytechmedia.com
2. Your current and expected compensation.
3. Your notice period / earliest joining date.
4. Links to 2\-3 restaurant, F\&B or hospitality brands you've worked on.



  





**For at least one of them, tell us briefly:** 



1. What you were responsible for.
2. What you changed or introduced.
3. What happened as a result.



  





 We're less interested in seeing 50 Instagram handles.
 



 We'd rather understand what you actually contributed to three of them.
 



  





**Role:** 
 Social Media Manager \- Restaurants \& F\&B
 



**Tangy Tech Media**

The company manages the entire project lifecycle, including system design, procurement, installation, grid approvals, and post\-installation support. Midwatt focuses on delivering hassle\-free solar solutions so customers can benefit from clean energy without needing technical expertise. The team is committed to providing reliable, end\-to\-end services that simplify the transition to solar power for commercial and residential clients.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Lead Generation Specialist will be responsible for identifying and qualifying new business opportunities for Midwatt’s rooftop solar solutions. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Hyderabad. Day\-to\-day tasks include researching target markets, building and maintaining lead databases, initiating contact with prospective clients via calls, emails, and in person visits, and coordinating with the sales team to schedule meetings and follow\-ups. The role involves nurturing leads through clear communication, sharing service information, and supporting sales efforts to convert prospects into customers. The specialist will also track lead performance, update CRM records, and collaborate with marketing to refine outreach strategies.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Ability to identify and qualify New Leads and perform effective Lead Generation activities.
* Strong Communication skills for engaging prospects, presenting solutions, and handling queries.
* Sales skills to support conversion efforts, manage pipelines, and collaborate with the sales team.
* Research skills to analyze markets, understand customer segments, and identify potential opportunities.
* Prior experience in business development, inside sales, or lead generation, preferably in solar, energy, or related sectors.
* Comfort with using CRM tools and basic office software for tracking and reporting.
* Ability to work on\-site in Hyderabad, manage multiple leads, and meet defined targets.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About Tarento:**  

Tarento is a fast\-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Our teams combine Nordic values with Indian expertise to deliver innovative, scalable, and high\-impact solutions.  

We're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**, a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well\-being and growth. At Tarento, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose. **Role Overview**  

We are hiring an experienced DevSecOps Engineer with strong expertise in AWS Cloud, container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS etc.), and secure CI/CD deployments.
The ideal candidate will manage and optimize application deployments, troubleshoot production issues, and apply DevOps and security best practices to ensure high availability, scalability, reliability, and compliance of our cloud workloads. **Key Responsibilities**  

* This role is hands\-on and operational — focused on running, securing, and stabilizing production systems.
* Manage and optimize application deployments across AWS EKS, ECS, and EC2 environments.
* Oversee production operations, incident management, and root cause analysis (RCA) for critical issues.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodePipeline.
* Ensure secure deployment processes through integrated scanning tools (Snyk, Trivy, SonarQube, rapid7\) and vulnerability management.
* Implement \& Monitor system health using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK, ensuring proactive alerts and observability.
* Administer and manage AWS services including S3, EC2, ECR, ECS, EKS, Lambda (serverless), SNS, SES, and Secrets Manager.
* Configure and secure networking components — VPC, subnets, route tables, NAT gateways, security groups, load balancers (ALB/NLB), CloudFront, API Gateway, and WAF.
* Enforce AWS IAM and network security best practices, including least\-privilege policies and secure key management.
* Collaborate with development and QA teams to optimize application performance, reliability, and security posture.
* Drive and promote a “Security by Design” mindset and SRE\-driven reliability culture within the DevOps ecosystem.

 **Required Skills \& Experience:**  

* Proven hands\-on experience managing AWS production environments — EKS, ECS, EC2, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, WAF, SNS, SES, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, VPC, IAM.
* Strong understanding of containerization (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS).
* Proficiency with CI/CD tools — Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline.
* Strong networking knowledge — VPC design, subnets, DNS, routing, SSL/TLS, load balancing, and firewall rules.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices — scanning, policy enforcement, and compliance monitoring.
* Skilled in troubleshooting across infrastructure, networking, and application layers.
* Experience with monitoring and alerting stacks — Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch.
* Scripting experience using Bash, Python, YAML, and JSON.

**Good to Have Skills:**  

* Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA / CKAD, or AWS SysOps Administrator.
* Familiarity with service mesh (Istio / App Mesh) and policy\-as\-code tools (OPA, Kyverno).
* Experience with runtime security platforms (Falco, Aqua, Prisma Cloud).
* Terraforms, CloudFormation for deployment automation.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and AWS Security Hub / GuardDuty.
* Exposure to incident response automation or resilience engineering practices.

**Education:****BE/BTech**, Information Technology, or related discipline.

description:
### **When you join Verizon**


You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.

### **What you’ll be doing...**


We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Lead SAM Flexera Expert to play a crucial "player\-coach" role within our Software Asset Management (SAM) function. You will architect the end\-to\-end publisher management strategy while actively working as a hands\-on implementor for our most complex, tier\-1 software publishers within the Flexera One platform. In this role, you will drive enterprise\-wide continuous cost optimization programs, manually design and configure complex licensing frameworks, serve as the lead technical defender during major vendor audits, and mentor a team of SAM professionals.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Defining the end\-to\-end lifecycle strategy for software publishers within Flexera, while rolling up your sleeves to directly execute the onboarding, configuration, and compliance monitoring for critical tier\-1 vendors.
* Acting as the primary authority and hands\-on implementor for translating highly complex EULAs, MSAs, and amendments into accurate license records and product use rights (PUR) within the platform.
* Directing and executing continuous cost optimization initiatives, actively diving into the data to identify strategic opportunities regarding shelfware, hybrid cloud licensing, and enterprise\-wide application rationalization.
* Leading the defense and data strategy during major software vendor audits, collaborating closely with IT Procurement, Legal, and Sourcing teams to mitigate financial risk.
* Executing advanced data normalization, beacon management, and hands\-on troubleshooting of the Flexera architecture to ensure optimal platform health.
* Overseeing the strategic roadmap and technically supporting the implementation of Flexera integrations with enterprise systems like ServiceNow CMDB, cloud portals (AWS/Azure/GCP), and discovery tools.
* Mentoring and guiding SAM analysts by leading by example, fostering a culture of continuous ITAM process improvement and technical excellence.
* Developing and presenting executive\-level reporting on software compliance risk, ELP status, and realized cost savings.
* Collaborating with Sourcing and Legal teams to maintain continuously updated compliance workpapers, defend against vendor audits, and proactively support contract renewals.

### **What we’re looking for...**


You are a strategic leader and hands\-on technical expert with an authoritative understanding of software asset management and complex publisher licensing frameworks. You possess excellent problem\-solving skills, a proven ability to execute complex platform configurations, and a passion for mentoring others. You thrive when balancing high\-stakes compliance strategy with the technical implementation required to realize multi\-million\-dollar cost\-saving opportunities.

### **You’ll need to have:**

* 9\+ years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM) or IT Asset Management (ITAM), with at least 5\+ years of dedicated, hands\-on implementation and architecture experience in Flexera.
* Proven leadership experience blending end\-to\-end publisher lifecycle strategy with direct, hands\-on platform execution.
* Expert\-level understanding of software licensing frameworks for major vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Adobe, SAP, Red Hat, VMware/Broadcom).
* Extensive technical experience managing ecosystem integrations and databases, including ServiceNow CMDB, SQL queries, REST APIs, and discovery agent operations.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex licensing data into actionable business strategies for leadership.

### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Flexera Certified Professional / Administrator (Flexera One / FNMS) and/or CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager) or IAITAM certification.
* Scripting and automation skills (such as Python or PowerShell) to streamline API integrations and automate data management tasks.
* Understanding of how SAM intersects with Cybersecurity, specifically regarding the identification and management of End\-of\-Life (EOL) or End\-of\-Support (EOS) software to mitigate security risks.


If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

 About Last Minutes Deal

 The platform makes spontaneous travel easier by bringing relevant stay options together and simplifying the discovery, comparison, and booking experience.

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 Sri Madhusudan Sai Global Humanitarian Mission passionately provides free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare to those in need across 100 countries. Under the visionary leadership of the globally acclaimed humanitarian, Sri Madhusudan Sai, the organisation is dedicated to uplifting the most marginalised communities. The mission is grounded in the ethos of selfless service, guided by the belief that all are a part of ‘One World, One Family’.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 The Social Media Strategist role will involve crafting impactful campaigns that resonate with our values and vision. By staying abreast of the latest social media trends and technologies, you'll ensure our message reaches the right audience. Collaborating closely with our project and communications teams, you'll help manage our online reputation and leverage data\-driven insights to optimise our social media presence.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Transform our social media presence with groundbreaking strategies that resonate with our audience and powerfully convey our message.
* Collaborate closely with the project and communications teams to create cohesive and impactful social awareness strategies and campaigns.
* Demonstrate expertise in navigating and utilising major social media platforms, including Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, Instagram, and other popular apps.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest social media trends, technologies, and best practices to ensure the organisation maintains a strong online presence.
* Handle online reputation management and social listening activities to monitor the organisation's brand image and respond to discussions and inquiries.
* Leverage data analytics and insights to measure the performance of social media campaigns, identify opportunities for improvement, and make data\-driven decisions.
* Organise and host external events, such as community events and competitions, to further engage the organisation's online following.
* Continuously explore new and innovative ways to leverage social media to support the organisation's mission and objectives.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in social media strategy, management, and content creation.
* Proven track record of developing and executing successful social media campaigns.
* Familiarity with social media management tools and analytics platforms.
* Experience in event planning and community engagement is an added advantage.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Exceptional strategic and creative thinking skills to conceptualise and execute engaging social media campaigns.
* Proficiency in managing and leveraging major social media platforms, including Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, and Instagram.
* Strong understanding of social media trends, emerging technologies, and best practices.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Data\-driven approach to social media analytics and performance optimisation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to articulate ideas and strategies.
* Proactive and adaptable mindset to respond to changing social media landscape.
* Project management skills and ability to work under tight deadlines.
* Creativity and passion for leveraging social media to drive organisational goals.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience in event planning and community engagement is an added advantage.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  





 This is a fully remote position, offering the flexibility to work from home on a full\-time basis.
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





 Joining SMSGHM offers a chance to impact marginalised communities globally. With a focus on free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare across 32 countries, your efforts directly contribute to positive change. Being part of our mission means experiencing the joy of helping others and knowing your contributions bring happiness to those in need.

 Planner, Economic Development and Strategic Projects
   

  

**Discover Your Next Planning Role in Northern Alberta**
 Are you looking for the next step in your career in economic development, strategic planning, or municipal leadership? Northern Alberta is calling!
   

  

 Imagine living in a place where the long summer days stretch into unforgettable nights, and the beauty of the Northern Lights dances across the sky above you. In this stunning, close\-knit community, your work goes far beyond reviewing development applications and administering policies. You'll help shape how our community grows, develops, and thrives for generations to come.
   

  

**Why Northern Alberta?**
**Endless Summer Days**
 Enjoy long, golden hours with vibrant sunsets that inspire creativity and rejuvenate your spirit. The area offers a variety of active living opportunities for everyone, including camping, quadding, snowmobiling, hunting, and fishing. High Level offers pristine lakes and rivers and is the gateway to outdoor adventures across Northern Alberta and the Northwest Territories.
   

  

**Breathtaking Northern Lights**
 Witness one of nature's most spectacular displays as the northern sky transforms into a canvas of colour and wonder.
   

  

**A True Sense of Community**
 Join a place where neighbours are friends and your work has a direct impact on the future of the community. Your planning expertise will help guide development, support responsible growth, and create opportunities for residents and businesses.
   

  

**Make a Difference**
 Your work isn't simply processing applications. You'll play an important role in shaping neighbourhoods, supporting investment, implementing Council's vision, and ensuring the community develops in a thoughtful and sustainable way.
   

  

**Set Down Roots**
 Northern Alberta offers a unique opportunity to build a fulfilling life and career in a region rich with opportunity. High Level is alive with festivals, rodeos, sporting events, and recreational activities for all ages. Experience the rich Indigenous cultures that help define our region and celebrate the many First Nations events and traditions throughout the year.
   

  

 This isn't just a job, it's a chance to
 **live, plan, and thrive** 
 in one of Alberta's most extraordinary regions.
   

  

**Ready to help shape the future of Northern Alberta? Your story starts here.**
**The Opportunity**
 Reporting to the Director of Planning and Development Services, the Planner, Economic Development \& Strategic Projects leads and supports strategic initiatives that advance the Town's economic growth, investment readiness, community development, and long\-term sustainability.
   

  

 As a key member of the Planning and Development Services team, you will:
   

  

* Lead economic development and tourism initiatives that support business growth and diversification.
* Build relationships with businesses, investors, government agencies, and regional organizations.
* Research, prepare, and implement plans, policies, studies, and strategies that support economic and community development objectives.
* Identify, pursue, and administer grant and funding opportunities.
* Prepare reports, presentations, and recommendations for Council, Committees, and Administration.
* Facilitate stakeholder engagement, partnerships, and community consultation activities.


**The Full Job Description Is Available Here.**
**What We're Looking For**
 Your educational background includes a degree in Urban Planning, Economic Development, Public Administration, Community Development, Business Administration, Geography, Public Policy, or a related discipline. Membership, or eligibility for membership, with the Canadian Institute of Planners (CIP), or Alberta Professional Planners Institute (APPI) is strongly preferred. Membership with an economic development organization such as EDAC or EDA would be considered an asset.
   

  

**Your Experience Includes:**
* Three to five years of progressively responsible experience in economic development, municipal planning, strategic initiatives, project management, community development, or a related field.
* Experience leading and coordinating multi\-stakeholder projects.
* Experience preparing reports, funding applications, policies, and presentations for senior leadership, boards, committees, or Council.
* Experience working with municipal plans, strategic initiatives, and public engagement processes.
* Grant writing, funding administration, and municipal government experience would be considered strong assets.


 Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
 *We welcome applications from early\-career professionals, recent graduates, and individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. If you are excited about this opportunity and believe your education, experience, or transferable skills have prepared you for this role, we encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every qualification listed.*
 You must possess a valid Class 5 Driver's License and be available to attend occasional evening or weekend meetings.
   

  

****What We Offer****
 In exchange for your education, experience, enthusiasm, and desire to make a difference, the Town offers:
   

  

* Competitive salary (2026 wage range: $88,668\.78\-$109,051\.42\)
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Local Authorities Pension Plan (LAPP)
* Three weeks of vacation to start
* Professional development opportunities
* A collaborative and supportive workplace culture
* Relocation support may be available for candidates relocating to High Level from elsewhere in Canada


 For more information about our community and organization, please visit
 **highlevel.ca**

 Planner, Economic Development and Strategic Projects
   

  

**Discover Your Next Planning Role in Northern Alberta**
 Are you looking for the next step in your career in economic development, strategic planning, or municipal leadership? Northern Alberta is calling!
   

  

 Imagine living in a place where the long summer days stretch into unforgettable nights, and the beauty of the Northern Lights dances across the sky above you. In this stunning, close\-knit community, your work goes far beyond reviewing development applications and administering policies. You'll help shape how our community grows, develops, and thrives for generations to come.
   

  

**Why Northern Alberta?**
**Endless Summer Days**
 Enjoy long, golden hours with vibrant sunsets that inspire creativity and rejuvenate your spirit. The area offers a variety of active living opportunities for everyone, including camping, quadding, snowmobiling, hunting, and fishing. High Level offers pristine lakes and rivers and is the gateway to outdoor adventures across Northern Alberta and the Northwest Territories.
   

  

**Breathtaking Northern Lights**
 Witness one of nature's most spectacular displays as the northern sky transforms into a canvas of colour and wonder.
   

  

**A True Sense of Community**
 Join a place where neighbours are friends and your work has a direct impact on the future of the community. Your planning expertise will help guide development, support responsible growth, and create opportunities for residents and businesses.
   

  

**Make a Difference**
 Your work isn't simply processing applications. You'll play an important role in shaping neighbourhoods, supporting investment, implementing Council's vision, and ensuring the community develops in a thoughtful and sustainable way.
   

  

**Set Down Roots**
 Northern Alberta offers a unique opportunity to build a fulfilling life and career in a region rich with opportunity. High Level is alive with festivals, rodeos, sporting events, and recreational activities for all ages. Experience the rich Indigenous cultures that help define our region and celebrate the many First Nations events and traditions throughout the year.
   

  

 This isn't just a job, it's a chance to
 **live, plan, and thrive** 
 in one of Alberta's most extraordinary regions.
   

  

**Ready to help shape the future of Northern Alberta? Your story starts here.**
**The Opportunity**
 Reporting to the Director of Planning and Development Services, the Planner, Economic Development \& Strategic Projects leads and supports strategic initiatives that advance the Town's economic growth, investment readiness, community development, and long\-term sustainability.
   

  

 As a key member of the Planning and Development Services team, you will:
   

  

* Lead economic development and tourism initiatives that support business growth and diversification.
* Build relationships with businesses, investors, government agencies, and regional organizations.
* Research, prepare, and implement plans, policies, studies, and strategies that support economic and community development objectives.
* Identify, pursue, and administer grant and funding opportunities.
* Prepare reports, presentations, and recommendations for Council, Committees, and Administration.
* Facilitate stakeholder engagement, partnerships, and community consultation activities.


**Your Experience Includes:**
* Three to five years of progressively responsible experience in economic development, municipal planning, strategic initiatives, project management, community development, or a related field.
* Experience leading and coordinating multi\-stakeholder projects.
* Experience preparing reports, funding applications, policies, and presentations for senior leadership, boards, committees, or Council.
* Experience working with municipal plans, strategic initiatives, and public engagement processes.
* Grant writing, funding administration, and municipal government experience would be considered strong assets.


 Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
 *We welcome applications from early\-career professionals, recent graduates, and individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. If you are excited about this opportunity and believe your education, experience, or transferable skills have prepared you for this role, we encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every qualification listed.*
 You must possess a valid Class 5 Driver's License and be available to attend occasional evening or weekend meetings.
   

  

****What We Offer****
 In exchange for your education, experience, enthusiasm, and desire to make a difference, the Town offers:
   

  

* Competitive salary (2026 wage range: $88,668\.78\-$109,051\.42\)
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Local Authorities Pension Plan (LAPP)
* Three weeks of vacation to start
* Professional development opportunities
* A collaborative and supportive workplace culture
* Relocation support may be available for candidates relocating to High Level from elsewhere in Canada


 For more information about our community and organization, please visit
 **highlevel.ca** 
 .
   

  

 Interested candidates should submit a cover letter and résumé to:
   

  

**Barb Wilton**
 HR Consultant
   

  

**hrconsultant@highlevel.ca**
 This position will remain open until filled. Early applications are encouraged, as submissions will be reviewed as they are received.

* Administer and interpret the Town's Land Use Bylaw and planning policies.

* Coordinate public consultation and stakeholder engagement activities.
* Support community growth initiatives that advance Council priorities and long\-term community development objectives.


**The Full Job Description Is Available Here.**

 Your educational background includes a degree in Urban Planning, Regional Planning, Community Planning, Geography, Environmental Studies, Public Administration, or a related discipline. **Your Experience Includes:**
* Three to five years of progressively responsible experience in municipal planning, development services, land use planning, or a related field.
* Experience reviewing development permits, subdivision applications, and planning\-related approvals.
* Experience preparing reports and recommendations for senior leadership, boards, committees, or Council.
* Knowledge of Alberta planning legislation, including the Municipal Government Act and land use planning processes.

description:
**About Smart Working** 



  


 At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity \- it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well\-being. Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full\-time, long\-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.
 


  


 Join one of the highest\-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote\-first world.
 


  


**About the Role** 



  


 As a Senior Data Engineer, you will build and lead the data infrastructure powering an intelligent AI assistant that automates operational workloads for property managers, letting agents and build\-to\-rent teams. The platform manages communications, compliance, maintenance coordination and scheduling, helping property businesses operate with the efficiency of modern digital platforms.
 


  


 You will architect and scale the systems behind the AI products, spanning real\-time data pipelines, analytics infrastructure, vector databases and machine learning data workflows. Working closely with AI engineers, backend engineers, product teams, founders and product leadership, you will ensure the platform can process large volumes of operational data reliably and intelligently.
 


  


 As the first senior data hire, you will define the data architecture, tooling, engineering standards, culture and hiring bar, building the foundations of the future data team.
 


  






  




**Responsibilities** 
  

  
* Architect and build scalable data pipelines and infrastructure to support AI and product systems
  
* Design and maintain data ingestion, transformation and storage architectures for operational and AI workloads
  
* Develop and manage batch and real\-time data pipelines
  
* Build and optimise systems for vector search, retrieval and machine learning data pipelines
  
* Ensure data reliability, security and governance across the platform
  
* Collaborate with AI and backend engineering teams to support training, inference and product features
  
* Implement monitoring, observability and data quality frameworks
  
* Optimise the performance of large\-scale datasets and query systems
  
* Contribute to technical architecture decisions and long\-term data strategy
  
* Act as the founding data hire, defining culture, standards and the hiring bar for the data function as it scales
  
* Partner directly with founders and product leadership to translate data capabilities into product decisions
  

  


  


  




**Requirements** 
  

  
* 7\+ years of professional experience, with the majority of that experience in dedicated data engineering roles
  
* Strong experience designing and building data pipelines and distributed data systems
  
* Experience working with relational databases, with PostgreSQL preferred, although MySQL or similar is acceptable
  
* Experience working with NoSQL databases
  
* Experience with vector databases used in modern AI systems
  
* Strong programming experience in Python
  
* Demonstrated ability to make and justify architectural decisions, rather than only implementing them
  
* Experience building scalable backend systems
  
* Experience designing data models and storage architectures
  
* Strong understanding of data processing performance and optimisation
  
* Experience with some of the following data frameworks and infrastructure technologies is highly desirable: Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Kafka, and Elasticsearch or OpenSearch
  
* Experience with relevant database technologies is highly desirable, including PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and vector databases such as Qdrant, Milvus or pgvector
  
* Experience with Python data\-processing libraries such as Pandas or Polars is highly desirable
  

  


  


  




**Nice to Have** 
  

  
* Experience working on AI or machine learning platforms
  
* Familiarity with stream processing and event\-driven architectures
  
* Experience with cloud infrastructure such as GCP, AWS or Azure
  
* Experience working in high\-growth startups or early\-stage companies

description:
**Company Description**
  

 When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
   

  

 Experience a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
   

  

 Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
   

  

  

**Job Description**
  

 Turnitin's Revenue Operations team is modernizing its analytics foundation — moving to governed dbt models on Redshift and building a trusted, consolidated view of the business for Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Finance.
   

  

 You own the models, pipelines, and tests that everything downstream depends on. You're not a ticket\-taker: we expect you to understand why a metric matters before you model it, and to say so when the requirement as stated will produce a number that's technically correct and practically wrong.
   

  

 This is an early\-stage function, so you'll have unusual influence over how it's built.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Lead the migration of legacy Alteryx workflows into documented, tested dbt models on Redshift.
* Design models with deliberate grain and clear lineage, building toward a certified set of marts that reporting reads from.
* Own orchestration, monitoring, and alerting in Dagster (or Airflow), and the ingestion layer feeding it.
* Keep Redshift fast and cost\-effective.
* Trace issues to the right root cause — reporting, data model, or upstream business process — and route each to the right fix.
* Build the data foundations behind RevOps initiatives such as account\-based marketing, customer health scoring, and predictive work like churn and lead scoring.
* Use AI and LLM tooling thoughtfully in the engineering workflow, and help the team form a view on where it belongs.


  

  

**Qualifications**
  

**What We're Looking For**
* A self\-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, leads with questions, and doesn't wait to be assigned work.
* A translator who can explain a data problem to a Sales Director in terms of their quota, and a quota problem to an engineer in terms of a data model.
* A systems thinker who looks upstream and downstream before proposing a fix.
* Someone constructively skeptical who reconciles the numbers before shipping them.
* Impact\-focused — you deliver the "so what?", not just the data.
* An owner who takes pride in the cleanliness of their code and their documentation.


**Essential**
* 6 \- 8\+ years in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or Business Intelligence with substantial hands\-on modeling responsibility.
* Proven experience building and maintaining production\-grade dbt projects, including testing and documentation.
* Hands\-on production experience with Dagster or Airflow.
* Advanced SQL and real experience with Amazon Redshift (or Snowflake / BigQuery), including performance tuning.
* Git\-based workflow, code review, and CI as a normal part of how you work.
* Strong working knowledge of the Salesforce data model.
* Python for data work and automation.


**Preferred**
* Experience with Alteryx, particularly in a migration context.
* Experience with Airbyte, Dagster \& DBT or comparable ELT tooling.
* Salesforce\-specific data modeling experience.
* Exposure to predictive modeling or machine learning workflows.
* Experience with large customer engagement datasets (1M\+ rows).
* Ability to build and maintain Tableau dashboards, even if it isn't your primary craft.


  

  

**Additional Information**
  

**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  

 At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
   

  

 Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
   

  

 In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being.
   

  

**Our Mission** 
 is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
   

  

  

  

**Our Values** 
 underpin everything we do.
   

* **Customer Centric:** 
 Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:** 
 We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:** 
 Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action \& Ownership:** 
 We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:** 
 We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:** 
 We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.


**Global Benefits**
* Remote First Culture
* Health Care Coverage\*
* Education Reimbursement\*
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Self\-Care Days
* National Holidays\*
* 2 Founder Days \+ Juneteenth Observed
* Paid Volunteer Time\*
* Charitable contribution match\*
* Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement/\*
* Access to Modern Health (mental health platform)
* Parental Leave\*
* Retirement Plan with match/contribution\*


 \* varies by country
   

  

**Seeing Beyond the Job Ad**
  

 At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad.  We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

****Job Description:****
**insightsoftware**
**Equity Management Engineering — Job Description**
**Senior Quality Engineer — Reporting/BI Engineering**
**Reports To:** 
 Principal QA Lead or Sr Engineering Manager — QA \& Standards
   

  

**Location:** 
 Remote (India) \| Global team
   

  

**Team:** 
 Reporting/BI Engineering — fully embedded
   

  

****About Insightsoftware****
 insightsoftware is a growing, dynamic computer software company that helps businesses achieve greater levels of financial intelligence across their organization with our world\-class financial reporting solutions. At insightsoftware, you will learn and grow in a fast\-paced, supportive environment that will take your career to the next level. We are looking for future Insighters who can demonstrate teamwork, results orientation, a growth mindset, disciplined execution, and a winning attitude to join our growing team!
   

  

****Job Description****
 As a Senior Quality Engineer embedded in the Reporting/BI Engineering team, you will be the primary quality voice for a scrum team focused on building and enhancing the financial reporting and business intelligence capabilities of the Certent Equity Management (CEM) platform for a large, strategic enterprise client engagement. You will report into the QA \& Standards organization while working day\-to\-day within the Reporting/BI scrum team, collaborating closely with the Lead Engineer, engineers, and product management throughout the delivery lifecycle.
   

  

 This is not a standard application\-layer QA role. The Reporting/BI test surface is dominated by SQL correctness, data accuracy, query performance, and report output fidelity — not UI workflows. You will need to think in terms of data: whether the right rows came back, whether the aggregations are correct, whether hierarchical traversal produces the right results, whether a report output matches the source data at the financial detail level. Writing SQL to validate data is not optional here — it is the primary tool for most of your testing.
   

  

 The right candidate takes personal ownership of quality outcomes — not just identifying problems, but partnering with engineering to drive them to resolution. “No bugs made it to production on my watch” is not a goal, it’s a standard. This is a hybrid manual and automation role. SQL\-based data validation and API test coverage are the priority automation surfaces; UI automation is secondary. AI will be a core part of how you work across every aspect of quality engineering.
   

  

****Responsibilities****
**Quality Ownership \& Test Execution**
* Own the quality of the Reporting/BI team’s deliverables — from requirements review through release — ensuring nothing ships without adequate test coverage across functional, data accuracy, performance, and non\-functional scenarios.
* Define, document, and execute test plans and test cases for new reporting features, SQL changes, BI enhancements, and bug fixes — covering report output correctness, data transformation accuracy, edge cases, regression, security, and non\-functional scenarios.
* Identify test conditions from user stories, reporting specifications, and requirements documents — including positive, negative, boundary, hierarchical data traversal, aggregation correctness, and null handling scenarios.
* Execute test cases, document results, track defects, and own them through to resolution — partnering with engineers and product management to ensure nothing falls through the cracks. Identifying a problem is the beginning, not the end.
* Participate actively in sprint ceremonies — planning, refinement, standups, demos, and retrospectives — as the quality voice of the team.
* Collaborate with the Principal QA Lead and Sr Engineering Manager — QA \& Standards to maintain consistent quality standards across scrum teams.


**SQL \& Data Accuracy Validation**
* Write Oracle SQL and PL/SQL queries to validate report output against source data — verifying row counts, field\-level accuracy, aggregation correctness, financial calculations, and referential integrity. This is the primary testing tool for this team.
* Design and execute data accuracy test strategies for complex, non\-flattened hierarchical data models — validating that reporting queries traverse hierarchies correctly and produce accurate results across all nodes and rollup levels.
* Validate SQL and PL/SQL changes — stored procedures, packages, views, and query modifications — ensuring correctness, expected performance characteristics, and no unintended side effects on existing report output.
* Identify and document data discrepancies clearly — providing engineers with precise SQL evidence that isolates where in the data pipeline a calculation or transformation is producing incorrect results.
* Validate query performance benchmarks as part of definition of done — confirming that new or modified queries meet the team’s performance standards and do not introduce regression in report responsiveness.


**Reporting \& BI Output Testing**
* Test end\-to\-end report output fidelity — validating that what is displayed in a report or BI dashboard accurately reflects the underlying data, with correct formatting, correct totals, correct filtering behavior, and correct drill\-down results.
* Validate Logi Analytics (Logi Symphony) report and dashboard implementations — testing report rendering, parameter handling, data binding, conditional logic, and export output against expected data.
* Test report configuration and parameterization — verifying that user\-selectable filters, date ranges, grouping options, and report variants produce correct, consistent results across all input combinations.
* Validate financial report output for accuracy and auditability — understanding that errors in financial reporting output for a regulated enterprise client carry compliance implications, and treating data correctness accordingly.
* Test report performance — validating that reports load within acceptable thresholds under representative data volumes, and flagging regressions in report responsiveness for investigation.


**AI\-Augmented Testing**
* Leverage AI tooling to generate test plans, test cases, edge cases, positive and negative scenarios, end\-to\-end scenarios, security scenarios, and test data sets — expanding coverage and accelerating test authoring.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate the authoring of SQL validation queries, data comparison scripts, and report output test cases.
* Continuously improve your use of AI tooling to raise the quality bar — using AI not just to work faster but to test more thoroughly than manual effort alone could achieve.
* Stay current on emerging AI tooling relevant to QA — test generation, intelligent triage, data synthesis — and bring forward\-looking recommendations to the Principal QA Lead and Sr Engineering Manager — QA \& Standards.


**Automation Development \& Maintenance**
* Write and maintain automated test suites for the features and SQL changes you test — owning automation as an extension of your manual testing work.
* Prioritize SQL\-based data validation automation and API test coverage as the primary automation surfaces for this team; UI automation is secondary.
* Make informed decisions on what to automate vs. what to test manually — balancing coverage value, maintenance cost, and delivery velocity.
* Contribute to the shared automation framework and test infrastructure alongside peer QA Engineers — including SQL assertion patterns, API test coverage, and CI/CD pipeline integration via Azure DevOps.
* Execute automated tests within CI/CD pipelines; triage failures to distinguish genuine defects from environmental noise.
* Continuously improve automation coverage, reliability, and triage efficiency within the Reporting/BI team.


**Security Testing**
* Incorporate security testing into your standard test approach — including input validation, authentication and authorization boundary testing, data exposure risks, and injection vulnerabilities in report parameters and API inputs.
* Partner with engineers to identify security\-sensitive areas of new reporting features and ensure appropriate security test coverage is included in test plans.
* Leverage AI tooling to generate security\-focused test scenarios and edge cases that manual analysis alone might miss.
* Escalate identified security risks clearly and promptly to the scrum team, Principal QA Lead, and Sr Engineering Manager — QA \& Standards.


**Collaboration \& Communication**
* Partner closely with the Lead Engineer and peer engineers to understand reporting implementations, SQL changes, and data model updates — flagging quality risks early and influencing design decisions that affect testability.
* Collaborate with the Principal QA Lead and Sr Engineering Manager — QA \& Standards on test strategy, coverage standards, and process improvements.
* Communicate defect status, test progress, data accuracy findings, and quality risks clearly to the scrum team and QA leadership.
* Support junior QA Engineers through peer review, knowledge sharing on SQL\-based data validation techniques, and mentorship.
* Interface with client stakeholders as needed under the direction of the Lead Engineer — reporting issue clarification and defect evidence documentation.


****Qualifications****
**Required**
* 6\+ years of software quality engineering experience in enterprise SaaS environments.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset — a track record of driving defects to resolution rather than just logging them, and taking personal accountability for the quality of everything your team ships.
* Hands\-on experience writing SQL to validate data accuracy at the database layer — row counts, field\-level correctness, aggregation logic, and relational integrity. This is the primary required skill for this role; Oracle experience strongly preferred.
* Experience testing reporting or BI systems — validating report output fidelity, data transformation correctness, or analytical query results against source data.
