title: IT Systems & Automation Engineer
description:
**About Plivo** 




 Plivo is a leading technology company transforming customer engagement for some of the world's largest B2C brands, including Uber, WhatsApp, and Zomato. Our newest product, an AI Agents platform, automates the entire customer lifecycle from acquisition to support through cutting\-edge multimodal AI, including LLMs, text\-to\-speech, and speech detection. With a 100\+ member team across India and the US, we build high\-impact global products that handle over 1 billion API requests per month. If you are excited about solving hard, real\-world infrastructure challenges at scale, we look forward to talking with you!
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The role is that of an IT Systems \& Automation Engineer to own and automate the internal technology platform our teams across India and the US run on every day: identity and access, the endpoint fleet, office and remote connectivity including VPN, and the SaaS stack the company depends on. You will treat that platform as something to be engineered rather than administered: scripting away manual work, building the integrations that keep systems in sync, and leading end\-to\-end migrations that move users and data between vendors without disruption or loss. This is a hands\-on role for someone who understands these systems from first principles rather than from a runbook, who spots and fixes problems before anyone raises a ticket, and who uses modern AI tooling to move faster than a team this size normally could.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 • Automate recurring operational work: script against platform and SaaS APIs in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to eliminate manual provisioning, reporting, and offboarding.
 



 • Lead migrations end\-to\-end: plan and execute moves between vendors and systems with zero data loss, covering mail and file migrations, tenant consolidations, identity provider and MDM cutovers, and on\-premise to cloud transitions, owning validation and rollback at every step.
 



 • Own and automate identity and access management: SSO/SAML/SCIM, Google Workspace, directory services, and a secrets manager; automate joiner\-mover\-leaver flows and run periodic least\-privilege access reviews.
 



 • Manage the endpoint fleet at scale: device provisioning and MDM policy, disk encryption, patching, and compliance across a distributed, multi\-OS workforce.
 



 • Own networking and connectivity: LAN/WLAN, routing and switching, firewalls, DNS/DHCP, network segmentation, and site\-to\-site and remote\-access VPN, including deep troubleshooting when things break.
 



 • Operate and maintain core infrastructure: servers, virtualization, storage, and backup and recovery across Linux, macOS, and Windows environments.
 



 • Strengthen our security posture: endpoint protection, vulnerability and patch management, logging and alerting, hardening baselines, and evidence collection for compliance audits.
 



 • Drive IT and security incident response: triage, contain, find root cause, and document, so the same issue does not return.
 



 • Use AI\-assisted tooling (Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate scripting, migration planning, runbooks, diagnostics, and overall operational speed and quality.
 



  





**What You Bring** 




 • 5\+ years of experience in IT systems administration, corporate IT / IT platform engineering, or IT security engineering.
 



 • Strong hands\-on infrastructure skills across Linux, macOS, and Windows administration, virtualization, storage, and backup and recovery.
 



 • Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing and switching, firewalls, and hands\-on VPN configuration and troubleshooting. You can explain what is actually happening on the wire, not just which setting to change.
 



 • Proven migration experience: you have moved users and data between platforms yourself and handled planning, cutover, validation, and rollback.
 



 • Identity and access management experience with SSO/SAML, directory services, MDM, and password or secrets management.
 



 • Working knowledge of security fundamentals: endpoint protection, patching, encryption, logging, and least\-privilege access.
 



 • Scripting ability in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate administration and reporting.
 



 • Genuine conceptual clarity and a proactive ownership mindset: you understand why systems behave the way they do, and you find and fix problems before they are reported to you.
 



 • Fluency with AI development tools: you actively use Claude, Copilot, or similar to work faster and smarter. This is important to us.
 



  





**Great to Have** 




 • Experience supporting a fast\-growing product engineering organisation across multiple offices and time zones.
 



 • Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001, or GDPR compliance programmes, audits, and evidence automation.
 



 • Cloud infrastructure exposure: AWS IAM, VPC, and networking.
 



 • Relevant certifications (CCNA/CCNP, Google Workspace or Microsoft administrator, CompTIA Security\+, AWS).

* Evaluate source of funds, source of wealth, occupation, expected activity, and customer purpose

* Familiarity with trading activity and a variety of financial crime typologies, including spoofing, layering, wash trading, front\-running, insider trading, fraud(deposit/withdrawals,account takeover/transfers) and manipulative order behavior

* Strong investigative writing skills, including the ability to prepare clear, concise, and audit\-ready case narratives and SAR recommendations
* Strong analytical skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize multiple tasks and deadlines effectively
* Experience using transaction\-monitoring, sanctions\-screening, case\-management, fraud\-monitoring, or securities\-surveillance systems
* Ability to work independently and adapt to a rapidly changing business and regulatory environment

* Working knowledge of domestic and international payment systems
* Ability and willingness to work a schedule that provides meaningful overlap with U.S. Eastern Time


**Who You Might Be (Nice\-to\-Haves):**

description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**


To support the Service Automation team within Siemens Energy's Digital Core, this role is established to backfill capacity and address the increased workload from expanded responsibilities and upcoming strategic Energy Now initiatives. Operating at the Experienced Professional (P2\) level in India, the consultant will ensure operational stability, service excellence, and successful execution across key service areas. To address these business aims, the role focuses on ServiceNow ITSM solution design, platform configuration, and stakeholder collaboration. These core areas ensure alignment between business processes and technical implementations while driving out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) adoption and minimizing platform customizations.


**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* **ServiceNow Solution Design \& Implementation**
* + Design and deliver scalable, upgrade\-safe solutions across ServiceNow ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge Management) leveraging out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) capabilities.
	+ Configure core platform architecture, including Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, custom scripting, and third\-party tool integrations (e.g., Snowflake, Jira, Salesforce).
	+ Implement and manage technical integrations using REST, SOAP, MID Server, and Import Sets, ensuring alignment with platform security models and ACLs.
	+ Promote OOTB adoption, minimize unnecessary customizations, and leverage ServiceNow AI capabilities to deliver efficient solutions.
* **Functional Consulting \& Stakeholder Management**
* + Conduct discovery workshops and sessions with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and translate requirements into functional specifications.
	+ Prepare comprehensive design documents and define acceptance criteria to guide technical teams and review final solution designs.
	+ Provide strategic recommendations on ServiceNow best practices, process optimization, and alignment with CMDB, CSDM, and SPM modules.
* **Project Delivery \& Operational Support**
* + Collaborate within Agile/Scrum and SAFe delivery environments to support the execution of strategic EnergyNow projects and initiatives.
	+ Perform acceptance testing, validate solutions against requirements, and coordinate deployment activities with delivery partners to ensure operational stability.

**What You Bring**

* 6 to 8 years of professional experience in ServiceNow ITSM implementation and techno\-functional consulting.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – IT Service Management (CIS\-ITSM).
* ServiceNow ITSM implementation and techno\-functional consulting experience.
* ServiceNow Core Architecture \& Administration.
* Flow Designer \& IntegrationHub Configuration.
* ServiceNow Scripting \& Customization Best Practices.
* Integration Technologies (REST, SOAP, MID Server, Import Sets).
* IT Service Management (ITSM) Process Design.
* Common Service Data Model (CSDM) \& CMDB.
* Requirement Gathering \& Business Systems Analysis.
* Solution Architecture \& Design Documentation.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication.
* Agile/Scrum \& SAFe Methodologies.
* Analytical Problem\-Solving.

**About the Team**


Our Corporate and Global Functions play a critical role in driving Siemens Energy’s strategic initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across departments, business areas, and regions. As part of this team, you will contribute to shaping the global energy transition, partner with internal and external stakeholders, and conduct business responsibly while adhering to legal and regulatory requirements.

**Who is Siemens Energy?**


At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.


Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.


Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo

**Our Commitment to Diversity**


Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. description:

With 5,400\+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq\-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world\-class products and services to all types of investors.


Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

**Corporate Functions** Engage in a deep variety of business\-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game\-changing policies.


Responsibilities:
**Position Purpose:** The QA Engineer is responsible for assuring the quality and stability of the Nexus Futures trading ecosystem, including order management, execution services, broker and exchange connectivity, and post\-trade processing. The role delivers comprehensive test coverage across business initiatives and platform modernisation efforts through a combination of functional testing, automation, risk\-based quality assurance, and release validation. Working closely with cross\-functional teams, the QA Engineer helps ensure reliable, resilient, and scalable trading solutions that support StoneX's futures business and clients globally.  

The team is actively investing in AI\-assisted software delivery and quality engineering. The successful candidate will be encouraged to leverage AI tools to improve test design, automation development, defect analysis, documentation, and overall delivery efficiency, while maintaining appropriate governance and quality controls.
Testing is performed in both manual and automated fashion, but the team focuses on expanding the automated test suites. The projects you will be working on are mainly server\-side. **Technology Ecosystem:*** API Tools: Swagger, Postman, Devtools
* Back End: C\#, SQL Server, WebApi, ReqNRoll/Specflow, Gherkin, Cucumber, FIX
* Architect: Docker Kubernetes, TeamCity, BitBucket, Jira, Confluence, Octopus, Rancher, Influx, KPI Metrics, Nolio
* Cloud: DataDog, Kafka, Databricks, Redis
* **AI \& Productivity Tools:** Claude, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT

 **Primary duties will include:*** Collaborate with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand project requirements and ensure comprehensive test coverage.
* Own test strategy, estimation, test planning and test execution for new features, enhancements, and production fixes.
* Identify and prioritize test cases for automation, considering both functional and non\-functional requirements and implementing the existing test automation frameworks for backend side of trade system in Specflow/ReqNRoll.
* Test end\-to\-end trading flows across, execution services, FIX gateways, exchange/broker connectivity and downstream processing.
* Analyse server and application logs, system data to isolate defects, support root\-cause analysis and provide clear evidence to Engineering.
* Analyse complex systems, spot trends, draw conclusions, and produce specifications and decisions.
* Perform API, service, database and message\-level testing using appropriate tools and SQL queries.
* Assess release risk, define test exit criteria and provide clear QA recommendations for UAT, production deployment and operational readiness.
* Managing the release deployment in various environments with cooperation with different teams.
* Contribute actively to requirements refinement, Three Amigos discussions, sprint planning, defect triage, demonstrations and retrospectives.
* Document test plans, test cases, and test results to facilitate communication and knowledge sharing within the team.
* Improve QA practices through peer review, reusable test assets, knowledge sharing and measurable reduction of manual regression effort.

  


Qualifications:
**To Land this role you will need:*** Strong professional experience testing complex trading, financial, transactional or other high\-integrity backend systems.
* Hands\-on experience of manual functional, integration, regression and end\-to\-end testing in an Agile delivery environment.
* Confident API and backend\-service testing, with the ability to validate requests, responses, events and persisted data.
* Basic SQL skills for data interrogation, reconciliation and test\-evidence preparation.
* Experience diagnosing issues through application logs, service behaviour, databases and message flows.
* Practical automation experience using C\# or a comparable language to extend the existing test framework.
* Experience with Git\-based version control, CI/CD pipelines and test execution within build and deployment tooling.
* Ability to translate requirements and business workflows into clear, risk\-based test coverage and traceable evidence.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience taking testing from requirements analysis through QA sign\-off, UAT support and production release.

**What will make you stand out:*** Exchange\-traded derivatives, particularly US Futures.
* Electronic order entry, order management or execution management systems.
* FIX protocol, including session behaviour and execution\-report\-based order lifecycles.
* High\-throughput or low\-latency distributed systems and asynchronous messaging technologies.
* Operational resilience, failover, disaster recovery and controlled production releases.
* Experience with tools or technologies such as Postman, Swagger, SQL Server, Kafka, Kubernetes, Rancher, TeamCity, Jenkins, Octopus, Jira and Confluence.
* Experience evaluating and adopting emerging QA technologies, including AI\-assisted test generation, intelligent test selection, automated defect analysis, synthetic test data generation, and quality analytics.
* Keen interest in understanding the distributed architecture

 **Ways of working*** Builds effective relationships across Product, Business Analysis, Engineering, QA and Operations.
* Challenges requirements constructively and raises delivery or quality risks early with supporting evidence.
* Takes ownership of test outcomes while remaining collaborative and pragmatic.
* Balances detailed functional investigation with automation and continuous improvement.
* Shares domain knowledge and supports peer review to strengthen team resilience.

 **Education / Certification Requirements:*** Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* ISTQB or relevant testing certification is advantageous but not essential.

**Working environment:**

* 4 days in office per week

title: QA Engineer
description:
**QA ENGINEER**
---------------

**Overview**
------------


Tintri, a DDN company, builds enterprise storage platforms that power mission\-critical virtualized environments. Our QA Engineering team is the last line of defense before every VMstore release reaches a customer, validating everything from core storage protocols and hardware resiliency to hypervisor integrations and data\-at\-rest encryption. We're looking for a QA Engineer who's equally comfortable writing automation code and getting hands\-on with real storage hardware, someone who enjoys tracing a defect back to its root cause as much as designing the test that caught it in the first place.


You'll work closely with development throughout the release cycle, not just at the end of it, helping define what "tested" actually means for a given feature before it's built, then proving it once it is. ------------------------

* Design, develop, automate and execute test plans and test cases for the storage platforms.
* Build and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts.
* Clear understanding of defect life cycle.
* Collaborate with developers to understand requirements and define the test strategies.
* Perform root cause analysis of defects and drive issues to resolution.
* Conduct sanity, smoke, performance and stress test coverage.
* Document test execution processes and results.

* Strong programming ability with hands\-on experience in one or more scripting languages (preferably Python).

----------------------------

* Understanding of NAS \& SMB protocols.

---------------------------

* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We're the people who keep the cloud running — supporting all AWS data centers and the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.



We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to join our Infrastructure Supply Chain team, building large\-scale distributed systems that power one of the world's most complex physical supply chains. Our systems manage hundreds of thousands of rack demands annually across AMER, EMEA, APAC, and GOVT regions — from demand forecasting and material planning to manufacturing execution, logistics, and data center deployment.



These are greenfield projects offering a rare opportunity to build systems from the ground up using modern technologies including reactive microservices, serverless computing, and distributed NoSQL data stores.


### **What You'll Do**



Design and build highly scalable, fault\-tolerant distributed systems that support the end\-to\-end infrastructure supply chain — spanning demand planning, fulfillment, manufacturing, logistics, and DC readiness Solve complex architecture and business problems, delivering extensible solutions that operate at AWS scale Write high\-quality, modular, functional, and testable code with a focus on operational excellence Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including supply chain planners, hardware engineers, and operations managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions Formally mentor junior engineers on system design, coding best practices, and troubleshooting Contribute to the full software development lifecycle — from design and code reviews through testing, deployment, and operations Drive innovation in areas such as demand forecasting, supply optimization, and end\-to\-end observability through the Infrastructure Control Tower Basic Qualifications 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture experience (design patterns, reliability, and scaling) of new and existing systems Experience programming with at least one modern software programming language (Java, Python, TypeScript, or equivalent) Strong understanding of fundamental algorithms, data structures, and system design principles


### **Preferred Qualifications**



3\+ years of full software development lifecycle experience, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations Experience building distributed systems, microservices architectures, or event\-driven platforms at scale Familiarity with AWS services (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, Step Functions, ECS/EKS) Experience with supply chain, logistics, or manufacturing domain systems Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent


### **Why Join Us**



Greenfield opportunity — Build from scratch with technologies and define the architecture from day one Massive scale — Work on systems that manage 130\+ hardware categories, global manufacturing partners (Jabil, Foxconn, Quanta), and data center deployments worldwide High impact — Every rack you help deliver powers the AWS services that millions of customers depend on Career growth — Endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship, and career\-advancing resources to help you grow into a senior technical leader About the Team We value diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.



We value work\-life harmony and strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique.



Key job responsibilities The Key Job Responsibilities section now covers 10 areas:



Design \& Build Scalable Systems — end\-to\-end supply chain applications Solve Complex Architecture Problems — translating ambiguous requirements into solutions Write Production\-Quality Code — modular, testable, operationally excellent Own the Full Development Lifecycle — design through production, including on\-call Build Supply Chain Domain Expertise — S\&OP, VMI, SFGs, fulfillment pipeline, DC readiness Contribute to System Design \& Technical Strategy — design reviews, architecture decisions Mentor \& Develop Junior Engineers — formal mentorship of SDE Is Collaborate Cross\-Functionally — work with planners, hardware engineers, PMs globally Drive Operational Excellence — monitoring, alerting, runbooks, proactive risk mitigation Innovate \& Automate — ML\-powered forecasting, intelligent observability, automation



About the team As an SDE II on the Infrastructure Supply Chain team, your typical day will include a mix of deep technical work, collaboration, and continuous learning:



Morning Stand\-up \& Sprint Planning — Start the day with your agile team to review progress, discuss blockers, and align on sprint priorities across supply chain workstreams Design \& Architecture Sessions — Participate in or lead design reviews for new features — such as a new fulfillment pipeline stage tracker or a demand forecasting data ingestion service Heads\-Down Coding — Spend focused blocks writing, refactoring, and testing code for distributed microservices, serverless functions, and API integrations that power supply chain workflows Code Reviews — Review pull requests from teammates, providing constructive feedback on design patterns, edge cases, performance, and operational readiness Debugging \& Troubleshooting — Investigate production issues using CloudWatch dashboards, X\-Ray traces, and Control Tower observability tools to identify root causes and deploy fixes Cross\-Team Collaboration — Join working sessions with supply chain planners, hardware engineers, or logistics teams to clarify requirements, demo features, or align on data contracts Mentoring — Pair\-program with junior engineers, walk through design approaches on a whiteboard, or review their design documents to help them grow technically Operational Reviews — Monitor service health metrics, review alarms, update runbooks, and participate in weekly operational excellence reviews to maintain a high availability bar Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing — Write or update design documents, API specs, and wiki pages; present tech talks or brown\-bag sessions to share learnings with the broader team Innovation \& Experimentation — Dedicate time to explore new approaches — prototyping an ML\-based anomaly detector for dwell time spikes, evaluating a new AWS service for event\-driven workflows, or contributing to team hackathon projects


### **Basic Qualifications**


* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Configuration Specialist
description:
**Purpose (of the role):**


The Configuration Specialist operates within a structured, scalable delivery model focused on executing well\-defined configuration activities through a centralised intake process (e.g. ServiceNow). Work items are assigned with detailed requirements, contextual information, and predefined standards via structured request forms, enabling consistent, high\-quality delivery at scale.


This role is responsible for accurately executing repeatable, process\-driven tasks using established methodologies, documentation, and configuration standards. The Specialist applies attention to detail and discipline to ensure outputs are reliable, traceable, and aligned with global best practices.


Operating as part of a global delivery capability, the role emphasises efficiency, consistency, and continuous improvement. There is no direct client engagement; instead, the focus is on dependable execution, effective use of tooling (including AI\-assisted capabilities), and contribution to reusable knowledge assets such as the Services Catalogue.

**Clinisys' AI Philosophy**


Building an **AI‑first organisation** is central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI‑enabled, cloud‑based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 30 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function—to work confidently with AI‑enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve. We **must drive an AI\-first sense of purpose and urgency.**

**Job Summary:**


1\. **Essential Functions / Job Responsibilities**

* Execute configuration tasks assigned through structured intake systems (e.g. ServiceNow), ensuring full adherence to the instructions, context, and acceptance criteria provided within each request.
* Interpret and apply detailed work instructions, templates, and supporting documentation to deliver consistent, high\-quality outcomes across repeatable configuration activities.
* Operate within a process\-driven delivery framework, ensuring tasks are completed efficiently, accurately, and in alignment with defined service levels and quality benchmarks.
* Follow established escalation pathways when task inputs, requirements, or instructions are unclear or incomplete, ensuring risks to quality or timelines are proactively managed.
* Maintain a strong focus on consistency and standardisation by adhering strictly to configuration standards, governance frameworks, and catalogue\-defined approaches.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of intake quality by identifying gaps, ambiguities, or inefficiencies in task instructions and providing structured feedback to upstream roles (e.g. Configuration Architects, intake reviewers).
* Develop and maintain configuration artefacts within the Services Catalogue, ensuring outputs are reusable, well\-documented, and aligned to standard patterns.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tools and automation capabilities, where approved, to increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve accuracy across repetitive tasks.
* Ensure all configuration activities are fully documented, version\-controlled, and traceable in line with governance and audit requirements.

None

We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

  



**HPE Operations** is our innovative IT services organization. It provides the expertise to advise, integrate, and accelerate our customers’ outcomes from their digital transformation. Our teams collaborate to transform insight into innovation. In today’s fast paced, hybrid IT world, being at business speed means overcoming IT complexity to match the speed of actions to the speed of opportunities. Deploy the right technology to respond quickly to market possibilities. Join us and redefine what’s next for you.***Management Level Definition:***


We are seeking a highly skilled Data Architect with over a decade of expertise in designing, implementing, and managing enterprise\-scale data architectures. The ideal candidate will have deep experience in database design, data modeling, and data engineering, ensuring that data systems are scalable, secure, and aligned with business objectives. This role requires strong technical leadership, hands\-on design capabilities, and the ability to collaborate across business and IT teams to enable data\-driven decision\-making.

**What you’ll do:**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Data Architecture \& Strategy**
	+ Define and maintain the organization’s enterprise data architecture blueprint.
	+ Develop strategies for data integration, storage, retrieval, and governance.
	+ Ensure data architecture aligns with business goals and analytics needs.
* **Database Design \& Optimization**
	+ Design and optimize relational and non\-relational database schemas for performance, scalability, and maintainability.
	+ Implement indexing, partitioning, and query optimization techniques.
	+ Ensure database designs adhere to normalization, security, and compliance requirements.
* **Data Engineering \& Integration**
	+ Oversee data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data transformation workflows.
	+ Integrate structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data from multiple sources.
	+ Support real\-time and batch processing solutions.
* **Data Governance, Security \& Compliance**
	+ Implement data governance frameworks to ensure data quality, consistency, and accuracy.
	+ Define and enforce data security policies, access controls, and encryption standards.
	+ Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements such as GDPR, HIPAA, and industry standards.
* **Collaboration \& Leadership**
	+ Partner with analytics, BI, application, and infrastructure teams to deliver data solutions.
	+ Mentor data engineers, modelers, and database administrators.

description:

Your role ensures the overall security and integrity of our corporate network by leveraging network security best practices, innovative products, and rigorous security validation.



Reporting to the Network Engineering Manager, this operations\-focused role is distinct from core Network Engineering and Network Security, centering primarily on operational execution—including responding to alerts, maintaining service availability, and ensuring system health across our global enterprise network. Always On." environment. You will own multi\-quarter objectives and establish long\-term strategies for network reliability.

As an L6 Software Development Manager in AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain, you will define the strategic vision for your team, establish a roadmap, and successfully deliver software that powers one of the world's largest and most complex physical infrastructure supply chains. * Real\-time observability platforms — powering the Infrastructure Control Tower that tracks 100K\+ active demands through stage progression, dwell times, blocker reason codes, and checkpoint milestones.

Multi\-agent orchestration systems — coordinating fulfillment across vendors, manufacturing sites, and DC positions in priority order (ML Network* Non\-ML).

large\-scale distributed systems processing millions of events daily Manage software operations effectively — ensuring uptime, reliability, and performance for systems tracking 100K\+ active demands Define and monitor metrics for team development progress, customer experience, and operational excellence (e.g., stage dwell times, on\-track/off\-track KPIs, manufacturing output trends) Drive across the organization Delegate appropriately — assign tasks based on individual strengths and development objectives, stretching engineers into areas like AI/ML forecasting, optimization engines, title: Configuration Specialist
description:
**Purpose (of the role):**


The Configuration Specialist operates within a structured, scalable delivery model focused on executing well\-defined configuration activities through a centralised intake process (e.g. ServiceNow). Work items are assigned with detailed requirements, contextual information, and predefined standards via structured request forms, enabling consistent, high\-quality delivery at scale.


This role is responsible for accurately executing repeatable, process\-driven tasks using established methodologies, documentation, and configuration standards. The Specialist applies attention to detail and discipline to ensure outputs are reliable, traceable, and aligned with global best practices.


Operating as part of a global delivery capability, the role emphasises efficiency, consistency, and continuous improvement. There is no direct client engagement; instead, the focus is on dependable execution, effective use of tooling (including AI\-assisted capabilities), and contribution to reusable knowledge assets such as the Services Catalogue.

**Clinisys' AI Philosophy**


Building an **AI‑first organisation** is central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI‑enabled, cloud‑based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 30 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function—to work confidently with AI‑enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve. We **must drive an AI\-first sense of purpose and urgency.**

**Job Summary:**


1\. **Essential Functions / Job Responsibilities**

* Execute configuration tasks assigned through structured intake systems (e.g. ServiceNow), ensuring full adherence to the instructions, context, and acceptance criteria provided within each request.
* Interpret and apply detailed work instructions, templates, and supporting documentation to deliver consistent, high\-quality outcomes across repeatable configuration activities.
* Operate within a process\-driven delivery framework, ensuring tasks are completed efficiently, accurately, and in alignment with defined service levels and quality benchmarks.
* Follow established escalation pathways when task inputs, requirements, or instructions are unclear or incomplete, ensuring risks to quality or timelines are proactively managed.
* Maintain a strong focus on consistency and standardisation by adhering strictly to configuration standards, governance frameworks, and catalogue\-defined approaches.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of intake quality by identifying gaps, ambiguities, or inefficiencies in task instructions and providing structured feedback to upstream roles (e.g. Configuration Architects, intake reviewers).
* Develop and maintain configuration artefacts within the Services Catalogue, ensuring outputs are reusable, well\-documented, and aligned to standard patterns.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tools and automation capabilities, where approved, to increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve accuracy across repetitive tasks.
* Ensure all configuration activities are fully documented, version\-controlled, and traceable in line with governance and audit requirements.
* Collaborate with global teams in a structured manner to support throughput and workload balancing, without direct client interaction.


2\. **Skills needed to be successful**

* Knowledge of configuration management principles, tools, and implementation practices within enterprise software environments.
* Understanding of AI\-assisted tools for configuration, documentation, and automation, with awareness of secure and compliant usage.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills with the ability to interpret requirements and translate them into effective configurations.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and concisely to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in configuration tools and familiarity with scripting or automation platforms.
* Ability to leverage AI tools to support documentation, configuration standardisation, and knowledge management.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across cross\-functional and global teams.
* High attention to detail with strong documentation and quality assurance capabilities.


3\. **Required Experience \& Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in configuration management, software implementation, or related technical roles.
* Familiarity with enterprise software solutions and configuration\-driven implementations.
* Exposure to automation tools, scripting, or AI\-assisted development environments is desirable.
* Ability to work in a structured, process\-driven environment with strong adherence to standards and governance.


4\. **Preferred Experience \& Education**

* Experience with Clinisys solutions or similar healthcare/LIMS platforms.
* Exposure to AI tools (e.g., Copilot or similar) for documentation, configuration, or automation tasks.
* Experience in building or maintaining reusable catalogues, templates, or configuration repositories.
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and global delivery models.
* Strong focus on continuous improvement, standardization, and operational efficiency.


5\. **Supervisory Responsibilities**


None

**Shift Timings:**

* This is a permanent role comprising a five\-day week with shifts to cover our US and UK hours from Monday to Friday. For India these are UK shifts from 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST.

*We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.*

title: Unified Data Platform Architect
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.


Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.


Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.


About the Role
  

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to provide technical leadership for the design and evolution of large\-scale data platforms and distributed systems.
  

This is a senior individual contributor role with responsibility for solving complex, ambiguous engineering problems and establishing technical direction across multiple systems and teams. You will architect platforms that process and serve data at significant scale, combining large\-scale batch and streaming computation with reliable backend services and cloud\-native infrastructure.
  

The ideal candidate has deep expertise in distributed systems and data infrastructure, with strong hands\-on experience in **Java, Hadoop, Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Apache Airflow, and Kubernetes**. Python experience is also important for data processing, platform automation, and engineering productivity.
  

You will remain technically hands\-on while influencing architecture, engineering standards, and long\-term platform strategy across the organization.
  

Responsibilities
* Define the architecture and long\-term technical direction for large\-scale data platforms and distributed processing systems.
* Lead the design of highly scalable, reliable backend and data infrastructure supporting business\-critical workloads.
* Architect and build high\-performance backend services and platform components primarily in **Java**, with **Python** used where appropriate for data processing, orchestration, automation, and tooling.
* Design and evolve large\-scale **batch and real\-time data processing architectures** using Apache Spark and Apache Flink.
* Establish architectural patterns for data ingestion, transformation, computation, orchestration, storage, and serving across the data lifecycle.
* Design reliable workflow and dependency\-management capabilities using **Apache Airflow** and related orchestration technologies.
* Define architecture and operational patterns for running large\-scale data and backend workloads on **Kubernetes**.
* Solve complex distributed\-systems challenges involving scalability, state management, fault tolerance, consistency, partitioning, backpressure, resource management, and recovery.
* Drive improvements in platform reliability, performance, observability, developer productivity, and infrastructure efficiency.
* Identify systemic bottlenecks and lead architectural initiatives that improve throughput, latency, availability, and cost at scale.

This role is dedicated to architecting and building the high\-performance "connective tissue" between Salesforce, external ERPs, and other platforms to power seamless Field Service and Asset Lifecycle operations.

 **Responsibilities:**

* **API Architecture:** Design and implement robust **REST, SOAP, and Pub/Sub API** integrations to synchronize data between Salesforce, ERPs (like SAP/Oracle), and Asset Management systems.

Our core values \- Make Life Simple, Build for People, Move with Purpose, and Create Lasting Communities are key to who we are and what guides us from how we hire to how we recognize our team members.

title: Custom Software Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Custom Software Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high\-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
  

**Must have skills :** AWS Networking  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Custom Software Engineer, a typical day involves creating tailored software solutions by designing, coding, and improving various components within systems or applications. The role requires working with modern development frameworks and following agile methodologies to ensure the delivery of scalable and efficient software that meets unique business requirements. Collaboration with different teams and continuous refinement of software elements are integral parts of the daily workflow, fostering innovation and responsiveness to evolving project needs.  

We are looking for a Senior Network \& Kubernetes Migration Specialist (6–9 years experience) to lead and execute large\-scale AWS network and container platform migration initiatives. This role requires deep expertise in AWS networking, enterprise hybrid connectivity, and strong hands\-on experience with Amazon EKS from both infrastructure and application perspectives.  

  

1\. AWS Network Architecture \& Migration  

* Lead end\-to\-end migration of on\-premises and hybrid network environments to AWS.
* Design complex AWS networking architectures including multi\-account VPC strategy, subnet segmentation, routing, NAT, IGW, and load balancing.
* Architect and implement AWS Transit Gateway (hub\-and\-spoke, inter\-region, multi\-account connectivity).
* Design hybrid connectivity using AWS Direct Connect, Site\-to\-Site VPN, and BGP routing.
* Perform network segmentation aligned with zero\-trust principles.
* Lead migration risk assessment, rollback planning, and phased cutover strategies.
* Optimize network cost, latency, and high availability post migration.

  

2\. Security \& Governance  

* Define and enforce enterprise\-grade security policies using Security Groups, NACLs, AWS Network Firewall, and third\-party firewalls.
* Implement inspection VPC and centralized egress architectures.
* Collaborate with security teams on compliance and regulatory requirements.
* Implement guardrails using SCPs and IAM boundaries.

  

3\. Amazon EKS – Infrastructure Perspective  

* Design and operate production\-grade Amazon EKS clusters.
* Architect multi\-cluster and multi\-environment EKS strategies.
* Design cluster networking (CNI, IP management, pod density planning).
* Optimize VPC CNI, prefix delegation, and subnet sizing.
* Implement cluster autoscaling using Karpenter and Cluster Autoscaler.
* Manage node lifecycle, taints/tolerations, and capacity planning.
* Implement IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts).
* Upgrade and patch Kubernetes clusters with minimal downtime.

  

4\. Amazon EKS – Application Perspective  

* Support application teams in migrating workloads to Kubernetes.
* Design ingress strategies (ALB / NGINX Ingress).
* Optimize application networking (Services, Network Policies, DNS).
* Troubleshoot pod\-to\-pod and cross\-cluster communication issues.
* Implement scalability and resilience patterns (HPA, PDB, readiness/liveness probes).

  

5\. Platform Engineering \& Automation  

* Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform (modular approach).
* Implement GitOps workflows using Argo CD.
* Build CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
* Define policy\-as\-code using Kyverno.
* Develop automation scripts using Python or Go.

  

Required Skills \& Qualifications  

* 6–9 years of experience in AWS infrastructure, networking, and cloud\-migrations.
* Strong expertise in AWS VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, and VPN.
* Deep understanding of enterprise networking concepts (BGP, routing, firewalls, segmentation).
* Strong production experience with Amazon EKS (cluster design, scaling, networking optimization).
* Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes networking internals.
* Strong Terraform expertise (module design, remote state management).
* Experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Scripting experience with Python or Go.
* Strong troubleshooting and stakeholder communication skills.

  

15 years full time education

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**


AtkinsRéalis is one of the world's leading consultancies operating in the built and natural environment. You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. We are proud to say it is thanks to our people's diversity of thought, expertise, and knowledge. We offer unparalleled opportunities for talented individuals in search of a rewarding career both in India and around the world. Our teams are proud to deliver on some of the most prestigious projects across the world. It's thanks to our talented people and their diverse thinking, expertise and knowledge. Join us and you'll be part of our genuinely collaborative environment, where everyone is supported to make the most of their talents and expertise.


The Lead Software Engineer is responsible for contributing to the design, development, deployment, and operation of secure, scalable, and reliable software solutions.


The role provides technical leadership within an assigned product area or project, contributes to architectural and design decisions, and ensures that solutions comply with organizational engineering, quality, security, and operational standards.


The role is expected to lead complex projects, coordinate technical delivery across participating teams, mentor software engineers, and act as a key technical contact for project stakeholders.

**Your role**

* Lead the technical delivery of complex projects.
* Contribute to technical planning, estimation, scheduling, dependency identification, and delivery tracking.
* Break technical solutions into implementable work packages and engineering tasks.
* Allocate or delegate technical activities within the team when appropriate.
* Monitor technical progress against agreed project objectives, quality expectations, milestones, and timelines.
* Identify technical risks, constraints, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Recommend practical mitigation and contingency measures.
* Coordinate technical activities across development, QA, DevOps, architecture, security, infrastructure, and business teams.
* Ensure that technical deliverables satisfy the agreed acceptance criteria and non\-functional requirements.
* Escalate issues that may affect project scope, cost, quality, schedule, security, or architecture.
* Support release readiness assessments and production deployment decisions.
* Provide clear and timely progress updates to project and product stakeholders.
* Communicate clearly, calmly, and effectively during challenging situations, production incidents, delivery delays, or periods of increased project risk.
* Provide stakeholders with timely and transparent information about delivery risks, technical constraints, potential impacts, mitigation actions, and recovery plans.
* Facilitate constructive discussions with technical and business stakeholders to support timely decision\-making during critical situations.
* Strong presentation and demonstration skills, with the ability to communicate solution capabilities effectively to clients and stakeholders.
* Provide day\-to\-day technical guidance to software engineers.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level team members and support the development of their technical capabilities.
* Lead code reviews, design reviews, technical discussions, and engineering problem\-solving sessions.
* Delegate suitable technical activities and monitor their completion.
* Encourage team members to apply coding, security, testing, documentation, and DevOps standards.
* Promote knowledge sharing, collaborative problem\-solving, and continuous learning.
* Provide constructive feedback and identify development opportunities for team members.
* Facilitate collaboration among team members and other participating technical teams.
* Act as a technical escalation point within the assigned scope.
* Apply quality assurance practices throughout design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Define and enforce appropriate unit, integration, contract, API, security, performance, and regression testing expectations.
* Collaborate with QA engineers to develop test strategies and ensure adequate technical test coverage.
* Review code quality, test results, security findings, and release evidence.
* Ensure that defects are appropriately prioritized, investigated, resolved, and prevented from recurring.
* Conduct technical reviews to verify compliance with coding, architecture, security, and operational standards.
* Promote automation of repetitive testing and quality\-control activities.
* Lead technical design activities for an assigned product, application, service, or project area.
* Contribute to architectural decisions in collaboration with solution architects, enterprise architects, security specialists, and other technical stakeholders.
* Translate functional and non\-functional requirements into appropriate technical designs.
* Design scalable, maintainable, resilient, and secure software solutions.
* Design event\-driven and microservices\-based architectures where appropriate.
* Define service boundaries, integration patterns, data flows, and communication mechanisms.
* Apply API gateway patterns for routing, authentication, authorization, throttling, monitoring, and service abstraction.
* Evaluate technical options and document architectural decisions, assumptions, constraints, and trade\-offs.
* Ensure that technical designs are aligned with organizational standards and the approved architecture.
* Develop and maintain accurate technical documentation like Architecture and integration diagrams, Software development Plan, API specs etc.
* Ensure documentation is maintained throughout the product and project lifecycle.
* Communicate technical information effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Contribute directly to the implementation of complex and business\-critical software components.
* Apply specialist technical knowledge to investigate and resolve complex engineering problems.
* Develop high\-quality, secure, testable, maintainable, and reusable code.
* Establish coding practices and ensure that agreed engineering standards are consistently followed.
* Lead code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback to team members.
* Identify and address technical debt within the agreed product or project scope.
* Promote the use of suitable design patterns, reusable components, and engineering practices.
* Conduct proof\-of\-concept implementations when required to validate technical approaches.
* Support the integration of software components with internal systems, third\-party services, and cloud platforms.
* Define and implement the CI/CD approach for the assigned product or project area.
* Establish appropriate build, test, security scanning, approval, release, and deployment stages.
* Implement gated release processes and configure appropriate deployment approvals.
* Define and maintain development, testing, staging, pre\-production, and production deployment workflows.
* Implement automated quality checks within CI/CD pipelines.
* Define rollback, recovery, and release validation procedures.
* Monitor pipeline reliability and recommend improvements to release efficiency and deployment quality.
* Work with operations, platform, security, and infrastructure teams to resolve deployment\-related issues.
* Cloud Infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code:
* Design and provision Azure resources using Infrastructure as Code.
* Develop and maintain reusable Bicep or Terraform templates and modules.
* Apply source control, peer review, testing, and versioning practices to infrastructure code.
* Ensure consistency across environments through automated infrastructure provisioning.
* Apply appropriate Azure identity, networking, security, monitoring, and resource management practices.
* Support configuration management and secure handling of application secrets.
* Ensure that cloud resources follow organizational naming, tagging, access control, governance, and cost\-management standards.
* Security, Privacy, and Compliance:
* Incorporate security requirements throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Apply privacy\-by\-design and security\-by\-design principles to technical solutions.
* Ensure appropriate application of authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, logging, and audit controls.
* Integrate static analysis, dependency scanning, container scanning, and other security checks into engineering workflows.
* Ensure adherence to organizational security policies, development standards, and applicable industry or regulatory requirements.
* Track security findings and coordinate their timely remediation.
* Performance, Reliability, and Operational Support:
* Define and implement performance, scalability, availability, and reliability requirements.
* Analyse application behaviour, service dependencies, latency, throughput, resource utilization, and potential bottlenecks.
* Assess system performance and capacity and recommend appropriate improvements.
* Implement suitable caching, asynchronous processing, database optimization, connection management, and scaling strategies.
* Define appropriate monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and health\-check requirements.
* Contribute to the establishment of service\-level indicators and operational thresholds.
* Lead the technical investigation of complex incidents and recurring problems within the assigned product or project.
* Continuous Improvement and Technology Evaluation:
* Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt, improve performance, and streamline delivery; contribute to backlog grooming.
* Experience using approved AI\-assisted development tools for coding, code analysis, documentation, testing, troubleshooting, and engineering productivity.
* Understanding of the security, privacy, compliance, confidentiality, and intellectual property considerations associated with AI\-assisted engineering.
* Ability to identify appropriate AI use cases without compromising engineering quality or accountability.

**About you**

* 8\-10 or more years of software engineering experience, including experience delivering production\-grade applications.
* Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership within a software development team.
* Experience leading the technical delivery of small to medium\-sized projects or well\-defined workstreams within larger programs.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, containers, APIs, and distributed\-system design.
* Experience supporting production applications and resolving complex technical incidents.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading code or design reviews.
* Relevant Azure, DevOps, security, or architecture certifications would be desirable but not mandatory.
* Solid experience building full\-stack solutions with C\#, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC/Web API, SQL Server, and at least one modern front\-end framework (React/Angular/Blazor).
* Hands\-on experience using Entity Framework or Entity Framework Core for object\-relational mapping and application data access. Experience with entity modelling, relationships, migrations, change tracking, query optimization,
* Hands\-on experience using Dapper for lightweight and performance\-sensitive data\-access requirements.
* Ability to select appropriately between Entity Framework, Dapper, stored procedures, and other data\-access approaches based on solution requirements.
* Strong knowledge of SQL, relational\-data modelling, query optimization, transactions, concurrency, and database\-performance considerations.
* Experience implementing repository, unit\-of\-work, specification, or other suitable data\-access patterns where appropriate.
* Ability to diagnose and resolve application and database performance issues, including inefficient queries and excessive data\-access operations.
* Understanding of secure data\-access practices, including parameterized queries, least\-privilege access, secure connection management, and protection against injection attacks.
* Solid experience in Authentication/Authorization (preferably Azure AD), Secure coding practices (input validation, secrets management) and Logging (Serilog, ILogger).
* Solid Experience working in Agile environments, using Azure DevOps (Boards, Repos, Pipelines) or equivalent tools for work tracking, source control, DevOps Pipelines and CI/CD.
* Solid experience working with Microsoft Azure Cloud (App Service, Functions, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Entra ID, etc) in real projects, including operational troubleshooting.
* Hands\-on Experience integrating APIs (REST) and handling security concerns (OAuth2/OIDC, tokens, scopes, roles).
* Good experience with Infrastructure as Code; ability to read and make incremental changes to Bicep/ARM/Terraform with guidance (optional but valuable).
* Languages: C\#, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, PowerShell (basic), Python (basic). SQL Server basics: CRUD, indexes, stored procedures.
* Frameworks/Services: .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, REST; experience in WCF/SOAP beneficial.
* Front\-End: React or Angular (components, state management, routing), Blazor (beneficial).
* Cloud \& DevOps: Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Azure Key Vault; Azure DevOps (Repos, Pipelines), Git.
* Security \& Identity: Azure AD (Entra ID), OAuth2, OIDC; understanding of roles/claims, secure secret handling.
* Architecture Patterns: MVC, layered architecture, microservices (conceptual understanding), SOLID, dependency injection.
* Testing \& Quality (Good to Have): Unit testing (xUnit/NUnit/MSTest), mocking frameworks (good to have); awareness of SAST/DAST, OWASP Top 10; basic performance profiling; Awareness of integra.

**Reward \& benefits**


Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

* Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
* Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**  

Role summary


The Staff Software Engineer (IC4\) on HR Service Delivery designs, builds, ships, and operates capabilities whose core behavior is model\-driven rather than explicitly authored: agentic and conversational experiences that interpret an employee's, manager's, or HR agent's intent, reason over employee profile, case, catalog, policy, and knowledge context, invoke tools, and act on the user's behalf across the employee lifecycle.


This is not a machine learning or AI research role; the engineer does not train foundation models. It is also distinct from traditional full\-stack engineering, where systems follow deterministic logic rather than selecting execution paths at runtime. Two consequences shape the work. First, the most important logic often lives in natural language: instructions, prompts, tool descriptions, guardrails, escalation rules, all of which must be engineered, versioned, and reviewed with the same discipline as code. Second, because behavior is probabilistic, correctness is established by measuring behavior at scale rather than by asserting fixed outputs, making automated evaluation a first\-class engineering activity rather than a quality\-assurance afterthought.


HR sharpens both points along two independent axes.

**Accuracy.** An agent answering on payroll, benefits, leave, or a lifecycle event touches statutory entitlement, jurisdiction\-specific policy, and an employee's pay. A confidently wrong output is not a bad answer; it is a missed enrollment window or an incorrect leave balance acted on in good faith.

**Audience.** HR data is among the most sensitive on the platform, and correctness of content is not sufficient. An answer grounded in a record or knowledge article the requestor is not entitled to read is a data exposure even when every fact in it is true, and manager\-scope and employee\-scope views of the same question have different correct answers. Access boundaries have to be enforced in the retrieval and tool layer rather than requested of the model.


At IC4 the engineer owns AI design decisions across the domain, not within a single feature, and owns the correctness of what ships whether a person or an agent produced it.


What you do Build AI\-native capability across the employee lifecycle


Design and ship features built around agentic behavior — intent interpretation, multi\-step reasoning, tool invocation, and action on the user's behalf — together with the data models, integrations, and channels that make them usable in production. In HRSD this spans guided service selection and intake, natural\-language case creation and enrichment, conversational case status and in\-flight change, tiered resolution of payroll and benefits inquiries, case triage, routing, and deflection, eligibility and entitlement inquiry, and agent\-driven execution of onboarding, transfer, and offboarding lifecycle events.


Design AI\-driven autonomous workflows


Decompose HR processes into the steps and decision points an agent can execute: determining where autonomy is appropriate, where a checkpoint with a person is required, and how exceptions, retries, and hand\-back are handled. Anything that changes pay, employment status, or a restricted record, and anything touching employee relations or investigation, needs a human decision point by construction. The design must make that distinction structural rather than advisory.


Author and maintain agentic instructions as engineering artifacts


Write, structure, and version the system instructions, role definitions, tool descriptions, guardrails, and escalation paths that govern agent behavior in the domain, under code review, source control, and regression coverage. Own the shared instruction and tool\-description surface that adjacent teams build against. Because HRSD ships as product, customers configure, extend, and override that surface on their own instances: treat it as public API, with upgrade\-safe extension points and versioning discipline to match.


Build automated evaluation and test non\-deterministic behavior


Design and operate the evaluation that makes change safe: golden datasets, multi\-turn conversation suites, model\-as\-judge scoring calibrated to human review, CI gates, and drift detection, plus adversarial, jailbreak, grounding, and tool\-selection testing. Extend that coverage to the HR\-specific failure classes — access\-boundary violations in retrieval and citation, PII leakage across scopes, and jurisdictional and policy\-variant correctness — and keep evaluation meaningful across customer configurations rather than against a single reference dataset. Own the resolution, containment, and quality metrics the domain is measured on, including whether they are instrumented correctly in the first place.


Design conversational experiences across channels


Build experiences that hold context across turns, hand off cleanly between automated and live HR agents, and behave consistently across employee\-facing portals, chat shells, workplace messaging clients, agent workspace, and voice — accounting for what voice imposes: latency budgets, barge\-in, speech recognition error on names and plan terminology, disambiguation, and explicit confirmation before consequential actions.


Specify precisely and direct AI coding agents


Convert requirements into testable specifications with explicit scope, constraints, non\-goals, and acceptance criteria; decompose work into agent\-sized tasks; supervise several workstreams in parallel; and review agent output for correctness, spec adherence, security, and maintainability. You own the result regardless of what produced it.


Own quality, safety, and reliability in production


Monitor conversation quality, containment, hallucination rate, tool\-selection error, and unsafe or unauthorized action. Defend against prompt injection and data leakage across integration surfaces, including the paths where user\-supplied content — case notes, inbound email, attachments, authored knowledge — enters agent context. Maintain reasoning\-trace observability and model rollback mechanisms, and feed production failures back into specifications and evaluation sets. Because HR conversation content is itself restricted, design that observability to be diagnosable without exposing what was said. Lead root\-cause analysis when agentic behavior deviates from intent, and hold the line between a genuine model failure and a platform or configuration failure presenting as one.


Ground it in solid full\-stack delivery


Build the application, APIs, data models, and integrations around these capabilities: front\-end experiences for employees, managers, and HR agents, server\-side logic, and the connections to HCM, payroll, benefits, identity, knowledge, and the adjacent service domains HR cases cross into — with the CI/CD, observability, and upgrade\-safe extensibility expected of production software.


Collaborate across product, design, and engineering


Partner with product managers, designers, conversation designers, HR domain and compliance partners, and engineers to define success criteria and communicate capability and risk clearly. Mentor IC1 to IC3 engineers, and raise the team's practices around instruction authoring, evaluation, and accountable agent use.

 **Qualifications** **Required experience and skills**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 9\+ years software engineering experience (backend, frontend, or full stack)


 Strong JavaScript/Node.js, React and API integration skills


 Automated testing (unit \+ integration) and CI/CD pipeline experience


 Solid understanding of data modelling and query optimization

* Agentic delivery experience:


 Hands\-on experience with AI/GenAI or ML\-driven features (LLM prompting, NLU,  

 classification models, or similar)


 Hands\-on experience with LLM\-integrated features: prompt design, context injection, output tuning, guardrails.


 Experience with NLU/intent classification or conversational AI systems


 Familiarity with ML\-driven automation (classification, clustering, recommendation  

 systems)

* Production AI integration. Experience integrating large language model APIs and retrieval\-grounded features, including agent orchestration, tool and function calling, and structured output enforcement.
* Applied machine learning literacy. A working command of the concepts that govern how these systems behave — evaluation, embeddings, and the probabilistic output and failure modes of modern models — sufficient to reason about, debug, and verify model\-driven behaviour in production.
* Accountable use of AI coding agents. Current, effective use of AI coding assistants and agents with evidence of accountable delivery: precise specification, critical review of generated output, and verification harnesses.
* Operational experience. Hands\-on CI/CD, containerized workloads, and observability experience, plus direct on\-call and incident\-command experience with customer\-facing systems.
* Mentorship. Demonstrated mentorship of less\-experienced engineers and a record of raising quality through code review.
* Education. Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees are a plus but not a substitute for a record of shipping reliable AI\-native applications.

**Preferred experience**

* HR domain depth. HR case management, the employee lifecycle, or payroll, benefits, leave, and absence, at a depth sufficient to challenge a requirement rather than only implement it — including why the same policy question resolves differently by jurisdiction, employment type, or plan year.
* HCM and downstream integration. Integration with core HR, payroll, and benefits systems of record, including the reconciliation and eventual\-consistency problems that come with treating an external system as the authority on employment data.
* Extensible product engineering. Building capability that customers configure, extend, and override on their own instances, where instruction and tool surfaces are versioned contracts rather than internal implementation.
* Evaluation and observability tooling. Evaluation frameworks, prompt and instruction management tooling, tracing for model\-driven applications, and analysis of production transcripts at scale, particularly where transcript content is itself access\-restricted.
* Conversational channel breadth. Employee self\-service portals, virtual agent or chat shells, workplace messaging clients, and voice, including handoff between automated and live agents.
* Conversation design partnership. Working alongside conversation or content designers on dialogue flow, tone, and error\-recovery design — with attention to how an HR answer is worded when the subject is the employee's own pay, health coverage, or employment status.
* Forward deployed delivery. Building against a customer's data, integrations, and channels, and tuning instructions and evaluation sets in their environment.
* Now Platform depth. Scoped applications, ACLs and platform security rules, Flow Designer, UI Builder, Automated Test Framework, and upgrade\-safe extension patterns.

 **Additional Information** **Work Personas**


We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.

In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.
