**About the Team**

At Workday, we bring technical rigor, customer empathy, and a spirit of fun to enterprise software. Our support team underpins operational excellence across Workday's digital experience, AI/ML platform, and Agent Factory initiative. Workday’s Agent Factory is our internal engine that builds, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute complex HR and Finance workflows, including expense processing, hiring, and workforce scheduling. We partner with core engineering to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability for our global customer base.
**About the Role**

We are seeking a customer\-focused Support Engineer to drive incident resolution, root\-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimisation across Workday’s enterprise platform and autonomous AI agent workflows. In this high\-visibility role, you will analyze system metrics, debug cloud\-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, and manage critical customer escalations within strict SLAs. You will also partner directly with engineering and data science teams through feature iteration and optimisation. A key part of this role involves hands\-on AI evaluation: analysing LLM outputs, reviewing conversation logs, and digging into system traces to spot failure modes and translate those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.


Key Responsibilities


* Enterprise SaaS \& Functional Domain Expertise: Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
* Hands\-On AI Evaluation: Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
* Technical Troubleshooting \& RCA: Assist in root\-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
* Cloud \& LLM Diagnostics: Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
* Incident \& Queue Management: Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high\-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on\-call rotations.
* Customer Communication: Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high\-stakes escalations.
* Database \& Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
* Documentation \& Team Collaboration: Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.

**About You**

**Basic Qualifications (Required)**
-----------------------------------

Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.


Technical \& Diagnostic Skills:


* Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
* Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command\-line tools.

Cloud \& Monitoring Systems:


* Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.

AI \& LLM Exposure:


* Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.

Triage \& Operations:


* Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.

Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
* Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
* History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post\-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer\-facing teams.
* Strong active problem\-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi\-tiered enterprise systems.

title: Senior Engineer, QE
description:
**About AlphaSense:**
---------------------



The world's most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision\-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients' own research content.



The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI\-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S\&P 500\. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

### **About the Role:**



As a Senior Engineer, QE, you own test strategy and coverage for your team's features and act as a strategic quality partner to the engineers who build them. You design test plans, build and evolve automation frameworks, and embed quality\-by\-design.You partner closely with developers, product managers, and platform teams to define test requirements, guide teams toward sustainable quality practices, and help us ship with confidence at velocity.


### **You will:**


**Define and execute test strategies across UI, API, and service layers to ensure comprehensive coverage.****Develop and maintain reliable automation frameworks and performance testing suites.****Utilize AI\-assisted tools and agentic workflows to accelerate testing and debugging cycles.****Lead risk assessments, release validations, and root\-cause analyses for critical issues.****Implement shift\-left practices and enforce quality gates within development teams.**

* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in software quality engineering roles
* Deep proficiency in testing TypeScript/JavaScript and modern frontend ecosystems (React, Webpack, or similar).
* Expert\-level experience with Playwright or comparable browser automation frameworks (Cypress, Selenium WebDriver) for end\-to\-end testing.
* Strong experience with unit and component testing frameworks such as Vitest, Jest, or React Testing Library.
* Proven track record of designing and building test automation frameworks from scratch or significantly evolving existing ones at scale.

* Experience in SaaS, fintech, or market intelligence domains.
* Familiarity with performance and load testing tools (k6, Lighthouse, Artillery).
* Familiarity with visual regression testing (Percy, Chromatic, Playwright visual comparisons).
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).

description:
**Job Summary:**

Manages sourcing, quality, plant liaison, and business continuity planning within a business unit, commodity group, or international region to ensure continuity of supply. Manages the procurement within a business unit, commodity group, or international region for all materials, supplies, and equipment in support of corporate procurement operations and goals. Ensures procurement activities reflect diverse requirements and overall business goals, as well as complies with all regulatory standards.


**Key Responsibilities:**

Manages end\-to\-end procurement strategies and processes that capitalize on savings and risk mitigation opportunities for the business. Builds strong supplier relationships. and encourages a high level of supplier collaboration and delivery. Solves complex matters of supplier performance. Contributes to and implements overall procurement strategy that provides foundation for supplier negotiations. Mitigates risk and promotes compliance by establishing and maintaining valued relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Communicates regularly with procurement team and business partners. Identifies, plans, and implements continuous improvement opportunities within procurement processes. Actively supports and drives acceptance of standardized business system solutions across the supply chain. Advises and consults with internal business partners on sourcing processes and procedures. Actively supports the annual planning (AOP) at the business unit, commodity group, or international region level. Presents sourcing and procurement issues and proposed solutions to procurement leadership. Actively promotes and uses Cummins’ fundamental operating mechanisms such as the Cummins Operating System (COS) and Six Sigma. Develops, leads, and motivates staff; sets goals in training and development, performance, and career planning.


**Competencies:**

Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.


Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.


Category Strategy Development \- Establishes category strategy using Total Value Performance (TVP) approach to define the Supply Base, Tooling and Technology Strategy to meet all current and future Cummins' needs; Manages risk and inclusion of diverse suppliers.


Diversity Procurement \- Evaluates, develops, establishes and integrates global diversity requirements and compliance; creates an inclusive environment that fosters the need for diverse suppliers to ensure a global sustainable and inclusive supply base to meet Cummins and customer's requirements.


Intellectual Property Management \- Assures protection of Cummins Intellectual Property to optimize the use of intellectual property for Cummins future competitive advantage by engaging the Legal and Procurement function; assures Cummins’ intellectual property ownership rights are clearly defined in executed agreements.


Negotiations Excellence \- Utilizes tools and methods in negotiations to achieve Cummins stakeholder objectives and achieve a mutually agreed upon all contract terms between all parties.


Procurement Ethics \- Avoids supplier engagement that may compromise supplier sourcing, selection, and management processes and seeks counsel to ensure compliance.


Source to Pay Principles \- Leverages key principles of the Source to Pay process to smoothly execute sourcing decisions, order placement, material/service acquisition and on\-time payment of Suppliers.


Sourcing \- Utilizes the purchasing functional system to support the Request For Quote process and establish a Total Cost of Ownership comparison of suppliers based on the category strategy and define the supplier that is most likely to meet Cummins and customer's needs.


Supplier Contract Development \- Develops contracts based on the templates available that cover commercial and legal relationship between Cummins and supplier; incorporates commercial requirements and legal requirements in the region(s) that are covered by the contracts; drives engagement between stakeholders following the Supplier Agreement Contracting Process (SACP) and negotiations excellence skills.


Supplier Relationship Management \- Defines category’s key/strategic suppliers. Manages the relationship of those suppliers using agreed Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) process with established work plan, senior sponsor meetings, and scorecards. Defines and evaluates a collaborative relationship with a category’s key/strategic suppliers to deliver value to Cummins and the supplier.


Supplier Tooling Management \- Manages supplier tooling strategy by noting the impact on Total Value Performance throughout the product life cycle to accurate piece price, leverages Cummins\-owned tooling procedure and ensures continuance of supply from that supplier or another by use of that specific tooling, by using proper Letters of Intent and bailment agreements; tracks and maintains inventory of which tooling Cummins has paid for and owns.


Supply Base Risk Management \- Minimize supplier risk to Cummins by proactively mitigating risks through use of risk analysis tools and risk mitigation playbook to manage three key risk: 1\) Continuity of Supply, 2\) Reputational Risk, and 3\) Risk to our Margins of parts. By minimize disruption and services throughout supply chain. Manage and leverage supplier selection and dual sourcing opportunities as a first line of defense against supplier risk.


**Education, Licenses, Certifications:**

College, university or equivalent degree in a related business field such as supply chain management required.


This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.


**Experience:**

Significant level of relevant work experience required.


Senior sourcing and procurement manager is required to manage data center business with global strategic accounts\- AWS, Microsoft, Google \& Equinix working in India for new DC facility building.


Business revenue forecast for year 2026 is M$80 \& for year 2027 is M$240\. To manage execution of data center business scaled up for year 2027, we need to reinforce team to deliver projects on time, within budget and 100% compliance to Cummins \& Customer project requirements.

* New supplier addition processing as per Cummins process as per project need.

* Process audit of suppliers along with SQI team and work on closure of audit observations.
* Supply chain management and weekly reviews with supplier \& Cummins site execution team to monitor work progress and manage escalations as applicable.

Services is critical for the sustained, long\-term growth of Mastercard.  

  

Within the Services organization, this role sits within the Business \& Markets Insights (BMI) organization. The Business \& Market Insights vertical is focused on creating products and solutions that create value for customers through Analytics, Insights, Business Experimentation, and Payment Consulting \& Innovation.  

  

Under BMI, Payment Performance Intelligence Program's Global Product Management team is seeking an accomplished technology\-focused Product Leader to support the evolution of its products to include AI intelligence. This person will be leading a team of product managers that oversee key activities including execution of the AI product strategy, management of the roadmap, shaping the product platform architecture and the creation of technical requirements.  

  

This individual will partner closely with other members of the Global Product Management team including data scientists to support development of Gen AI chatbot use cases \& agentic services and ensuring product priorities are well\-aligned with strategic objectives. This individual will also be the key collaborator with the Platform team to shape the long term vision for the product and ensure efficient development execution.  

Role  

* Define and own the AI product strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for Payment Performance Intelligence.
* Identify high\-value use cases for GenAI, chatbots, agentic services, predictive insights, and self\-service analytics.
* Translate customer needs, market trends, and business objectives into scalable product capabilities and clear technical requirements.
* Partner with Data Science, Engineering, Platform, Commercial, Risk, Legal, Security, and Compliance teams to deliver AI products from discovery through launch.
* Drive prioritization decisions based on customer value, strategic fit, commercial impact, technical feasibility, and responsible AI considerations.
* Establish measurable success metrics and ensure product outcomes are repeatable, scalable, and aligned to business goals.
* Influence senior stakeholders, communicate roadmap progress, and build alignment on risks, opportunities, and investment decisions.
* Coach product teams and help build organizational capability in AI product management, experimentation, and continuous learning.

  

All About You  

* Extensive experience in agile product management for analytics, data insights, AI\-enabled, or financial services products.
* Strong understanding of AI product strategy, GenAI use cases, data monetization, predictive insights, and self\-service analytics.
* Proven ability to convert customer problems and market opportunities into product vision, business cases, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Risk, Legal, Security, and Compliance.
* Strong communication and executive stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and articulate customer and business impact.
* People leadership experience, including coaching, mentoring, and building high\-performing teams across diverse geographies.
* Highly organized, analytical, and comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or equivalent experience required; technical background, payments experience, or advanced product certification preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**About dunnhumby**



dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca\-Cola, Meijer, Procter \& Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.


**Product**



Our Product team owns the vision, strategy and roadmap for the dunnhumby platform — the data, science and software that powers retailers and brands around the world. We work at the intersection of customer data, AI, and commercial impact, building products that turn insight into measurable growth.


**The Role**



The Senior Product Analyst plays a key role in helping us build better products through data\-driven decision making. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers, you'll transform complex product data into actionable insights that shape product strategy, improve user experiences and drive measurable business outcomes.



You'll champion product analytics across our product teams, enabling experimentation, establishing best practices and ensuring decisions are backed by meaningful data.


**What You'll Be Doing**



You'll combine analytical expertise, product knowledge and stakeholder collaboration to deliver insights that influence product direction and maximise customer value.


* Own product analytics across a portfolio of products, defining key metrics and ensuring they are measured, reported and understood effectively
* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers and Product Designers to support product strategy, objectives and key results (OKRs)
* Identify opportunities to improve product performance through data analysis, experimentation and evidence\-based recommendations
* Work closely with Data Engineers and product squads to ensure the right data is captured, modelled and available for meaningful analysis
* Deliver end\-to\-end analytics, from defining requirements and success metrics through to presenting insights and recommendations to stakeholders
* Build, maintain and continuously improve product performance dashboards that provide clear, actionable visibility into product health
* Support product discovery, roadmap planning and experimentation by providing data\-driven insights and commercial context
* Leverage multiple data sources to identify trends, answer business questions and uncover new opportunities for product improvement
* Continuously improve analytics practices, reporting tools, data visualisation and automation to enable faster, more effective decision making
* Communicate insights clearly through compelling data visualisation and storytelling tailored to technical and non\-technical audiences


**What We're Looking For**



You'll bring strong analytical capability, curiosity and a passion for using data to solve product challenges while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.


* Experience in product analytics, product management, product ownership or a similar analytics\-focused role within a software or technology environment
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting complex data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations
* Experience working with cross\-functional product teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers
* Knowledge of product metrics, experimentation, performance measurement and product analytics best practices
* Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through effective data visualisation and storytelling
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision making through data
* Understanding of statistical analysis, product performance measurement and commercial drivers
* Experience on Heap,Fullstory or Amplitude
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification


**What You Can Expect From Us**



We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.



And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process — please let your recruiter know what adjustments would help.


**India Benefits**


* Healthcare \& Family Cover: Group Medical Insurance of INR 500,000 for employees and dependents, plus dental and vision cover up to INR 5,000\.
* Protection: Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover with benefit levels linked to employee grade, including disability benefits.
* Retirement \& Wellbeing: Provident Fund, Gratuity, National Pension Scheme access, Indian Health Organisation membership, and confidential employee assistance support.
* Lifestyle \& Flexibility: Office commute support, internet allowance of INR 2,000 per month for blended working, work\-from\-home kit support, subsidised food, and wellbeing resources.
* Recognition \& Extras: Long service awards, Talent Scout referral programme, and family milestone support.
* Time Off \& Family Leave: 25 days holiday plus 10 public holidays, paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and a day off for your birthday.


**Our approach to Flexible Working**



At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.



We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

description:

The Flight Operations Analytics \& Safety Insights team is responsible for delivering timely, actionable insights that support operational excellence across Flight Operations. * Partner with cross\-functional teams to gather business requirements and develop reporting and analytics solutions
* Leverage tools such as Power BI, SQL, Excel, and other analytics platforms to extract, transform, analyze, and visualize data
* Support strategic initiatives through data analysis, forecasting, scenario modeling, and business impact assessments
* Identify opportunities to streamline and automate manual reporting and operational processes

* Support adoption of advanced analytics, AI\-enabled solutions, and data\-driven decision\-making practices across Flight Operations

Education

* Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Aviation Management, or a related field

* Experience creating reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools
* Experience working with large and complex datasets

  

Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Proficiency in SQL and advanced Microsoft Excel
* Ability to interpret data and communicate insights to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced operational environment
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and accuracy
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams
* Ability to use AI, machine learning, and Generative AI solutions
* Experience using cloud\-based analytics platforms and modern business intelligence tools

title: Global People Analytics Senior Analyst
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As a Senior Analyst, you’ll support evidenced\-based decision making. You’ll provide analytical input to support the Global People team and work with stakeholders across BCG. You’ll add a quantitative perspective to discussions on new and existing HR processes and procedures

  

You will apply an analytics mindset and empower internal clients with dashboards, data, and reports to help improve processes, and solve people related challenges, to provide thought leadership on the complete cycle of talent analytics, from sourcing the candidates to managing attrition

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, design, and manage advanced Tableau and Power BI dashboards that integrate data from diverse sources
* Use SQL to query databases and retrieve relevant data for analysis and reporting
  

Perform data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) to create efficient and scalable data models
* Thought partner with internal stakeholders on various people related challenges, by developing domain expertise
* Ensure data accuracy and consistency through rigorous testing and quality checks
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements and understand data sources

  

What You'll Bring

* Undergraduate degree, preferably in an engineering or other technology\-related fields, with high academic achievement required; advanced degree preferred
* MUST HAVES: 5\-7 years of full time Tableau and Power BI dashboard development, data modeling, and SQL language expertise
* Advanced Tableau experience, including Tableau server management, level of detail calculations, built custom charts, hyper data source, Javascript APIs
* Advanced Power BI skills, with a focus on dashboard development including DAX calculations, custom visualizations, and Power Query
* Strong understanding of UX/UI principles for creating intuitive and visually impactful Tableau dashboards
* Knowledge in SQL for querying databases, optimizing data retrieval, and supporting data\-driven decision\-making
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, with skills in data manipulation, including sorting, filtering, and using formulas to analyze and organize complex data sets
* Background in HR data analysis and HR domain knowledge is preferred, however not mandatory
* Deep interest and aptitude in data, metrics, and analysis

  

Who You'll Work With

  

* As part of the Global People analytics team, you will modernize HR platforms, capabilities \& engagement, automate/digitize core HR processes and operations and enable greater efficiency. You will collaborate with the global people teams and colleagues across BCG to manage the life cycle of all BCG employees.
* The People Management Team (PMT) is comprised of several centers of expertise including HR Operations, People Analytics, Career Development, Learning \& Development, Talent Acquisition \& Branding, Compensation, and Mobility. Our centers of expertise work together to build out new teams and capabilities by sourcing, acquiring and retaining the best, diverse talent for BCG.
* We develop talent and capabilities, while enhancing managers’ effectiveness, and building affiliation and engagement in our global offices. The PMT also harmonizes process efficiencies, automation, and global standardization. Through analytics and digitalization, we are always looking to expand our PMT capabilities and coverage.

  

Additional info

**You are good at**

* Providing analytical support in metrics, reporting, and dashboard development
* Leading technical aspects of a large project with minimal supervision
* Generating insights from large and complex datasets, and understanding the nuances and inconsistencies in data
* Ability to multi\-task and operate effectively in a fast\-paced and customer\-oriented environment; ability to manage multiple stakeholders in a matrix organization
* Communicating and presenting technical details to non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong interpersonal skills, who showcases credibility and excels in a collaborative setting


At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

  

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

  

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Research Analyst IND
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


The Lead Research Analyst will support the Alternative Investments and Manager Research teams by performing investment data analysis, due diligence support, reporting, and operational research activities across both private and liquid alternative investment offerings. The role will partner closely with investment analysts and portfolio research professionals to support ongoing manager monitoring, research projects, investment onboarding activities, and various reporting initiatives.  

This position provides broad exposure to alternative investments, manager research processes, and investment due diligence activities across multiple asset classes. The analyst will have the opportunity to develop investment knowledge while supporting a wide range of research, reporting, and analytical functions for both private and liquid alternative investment strategies.**Key Responsibilities**

* Support quarterly and ongoing monitoring of alternative investment offerings by gathering, validating, and analyzing performance, asset, distribution, redemption, and portfolio\-level data.
* Prepare recurring research reports, dashboards, and analytical materials utilizing internal systems, FactSet, Morningstar, Preqin, Bloomberg, and other third\-party data sources.
* Assist with due diligence activities by reviewing offering documents, RFIs, marketing materials, and manager communications and extracting key information for analyst review.
* Coordinate and maintain investment research databases, due diligence records, SharePoint sites, and document repositories.
* Support manager onboarding, product review, and completion memo processes through data collection, drafting, and documentation.
* Assist with ad hoc analytical projects, including portfolio construction, holdings analyses, risk metrics, and other investment\-related research requests.
* Support recurring private alternatives reporting initiatives, including industry data gathering, performance benchmarking, and market intelligence reporting.
* Participate in manager meetings and introductory calls, documenting key discussion points and maintaining organized records of manager interactions.
* Coordinate the distribution, collection, and tracking of due diligence questionnaires, RFI responses, and related materials.
* Partner with investment research professionals across multiple manager research disciplines to support team initiatives and cross\-functional projects.

 **Required Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of relevant experience in investment research, due diligence, or alternative investments
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience), preferably in Finance, Economics, Investments, or related field
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving capabilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage work independently and prioritize effectively
* Active Series 7 license or ability to obtain within 120 days

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated knowledge of alternative investment strategies and structures

title: Senior Computer Scientist - C++
description:
The Opportunity
  
Adobe builds products that power millions of customer experiences worldwide. Behind these products are sophisticated software systems operating at scale, where performance, reliability, security, and engineering excellence are fundamental requirements.
  
We are looking for a Senior Computer Scientist with deep C\+\+ expertise who enjoys solving complex technical problems and taking ownership of significant areas of the product. You will shape architecture, build high\-performance software, make critical technical decisions, and influence solutions that span components and teams.
  
We value engineers who are self\-driven, proactive, and outcome\-oriented — engineers who challenge assumptions, solve problems at their root, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and take responsibility for making the systems they own better, more reliable, and easier to evolve.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas end\-to\-end — from understanding ambiguous problems and defining the right solution through architecture, implementation, production validation, and long\-term evolution.
  
Design and build high\-performance C\+\+ systems , making thoughtful decisions around architecture, concurrency, memory management, resource utilization, and scalability.
  
Drive technical direction for complex problems — evaluate alternatives, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and influence architecture decisions across components and teams.
  
Solve problems at the root — identify systemic causes rather than treating symptoms, and drive durable solutions that reduce recurring issues and technical debt.
  
Own outcomes, not just tasks — proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities and drive them to closure with minimal direction.
  
Solve complex problems across boundaries , collaborating with engineers, architects, product managers, and other teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
  
Raise the engineering bar through architecture and code reviews, performance optimization, testing, and engineering best practices.
  
Build for operational excellence with strong focus on performance, reliability, security, observability, maintainability, and efficient resource utilization.
  
Be a force multiplier — mentor engineers, share technical expertise, and establish patterns and practices that improve the broader engineering organization.
  
Leverage AI\-assisted engineering to accelerate development and problem solving, improve engineering workflows, and increase team productivity.
  
  

What You Need to Succeed
  
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
10\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience , with a strong track record of owning and delivering complex technical solutions.
  
Deep expertise in C\+\+ , including modern C\+\+, memory management, concurrency, multithreading, STL, and performance optimization.
  
Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, operating systems, and computer science fundamentals .
  
Strong understanding of systems design, distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and performance engineering .
  
Experience designing and building large\-scale, high\-performance software systems .
  
Experience building or operating Distributed systems at scale , with an understanding of multi\-tenancy, scaling, reliability, backward compatibility, security, observability, and capacity planning.
  
Strong experience with performance analysis and optimization , including profiling CPU, memory, I/O, latency, and resource utilization.
  
Experience with cloud platforms, distributed infrastructure, and modern software development practices.
  
Strong proficiency in AI\-assisted engineering , leveraging tools such as Claude, Codex, or Copilot to accelerate development, improve problem solving, and enhance engineering productivity.
  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving ability , with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence technical decisions across teams.
  
  

What Success Looks Like
  
Success in this role is not measured only by the features you deliver. You will be successful when you:
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas with minimal direction and strong technical judgment.
  
Turn ambiguous, complex problems into clear technical direction and executable solutions .
  
Make architecture decisions that balance performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long\-term evolution .
  
Solve systemic problems at their root and eliminate recurring sources of complexity, performance issues, and operational risk.
  
Influence technical direction across teams and organizational boundaries through technical depth and credibility.
  
Deliver solutions that materially improve performance, scalability, reliability, quality, or developer productivity .
  
Raise the technical bar through mentorship, design leadership, and engineering practices that benefit the broader organization.

title: R&D Engineering, Sr Engineer
description:
### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You are someone who looks at a test failure and does not just log it, you dig until you understand why it happened and what it means for the next release. Scripting is not a chore for you, it is how you make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human brain. You have spent enough time in labs or codebases to know that quality is not something you test in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.


Data tells you stories. When you see a trend in regression results, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you pull the thread, ask the right questions, and surface what matters. You are comfortable working across teams, translating between what verification found, what design needs to know, and what a release checklist actually requires.


You do not need years of experience to have a point of view. You know when a process is not working and you are not afraid to suggest a better way. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the rigor you bring to testing and automation will directly affect whether those products ship on time and work as promised.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Run kickoff and release meetings across design, verification, and release teams, making sure compliance checkpoints are hit and nothing falls through the cracks
* Execute regression testing on Embedded Memory IP, catch issues before they reach customers, and track results across release cycles
* Analyze test data to spot trends, recurring failures, and process gaps that affect product quality or schedule
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that eliminate manual testing steps and speed up validation workflows
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on quality gates, release criteria, and issue resolution timelines
* Document test results, failure analysis, and process improvements in a way that helps the next engineer understand what happened and why

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Ensure Embedded Memory IP on advanced process nodes ships with zero critical defects, directly affecting customer success and market readiness
* Reduce validation cycle time by automating repetitive test and data collection tasks, freeing engineers to focus on complex debug work
* Surface quality and process issues early in the development cycle, preventing costly delays and rework downstream
* Improve the reliability of regression infrastructure so teams can trust test results and make faster release decisions
* Strengthen compliance and traceability across the release process, reducing risk and audit friction
* Enable smarter decision\-making by turning raw test data into actionable insights for design and verification teams

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role
* Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation
* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Familiarity with regression testing, release processes, or quality management systems is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to work across teams without losing track of details

### **Who You Are**

* You can look at a spreadsheet of test results and spot the one anomaly that matters, not just the loudest failure
* You write scripts that other people can actually read and modify six months later
* You are comfortable running a meeting with senior engineers and keeping it focused without being intimidated
* When a process does not make sense, you ask why before you follow it blindly
* You can explain a technical issue to a release manager in two sentences without losing the nuance
* You stay organized when managing multiple release tracks, test cycles, and compliance checkpoints at once

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Lead AI Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Lead AI Engineer
Overview  

  

AI Solutions, part of Mastercard’s AI \& Data organization, scales AI across the enterprise, moving use cases beyond pilots into trusted, production\-grade capabilities embedded in Mastercard’s platforms and products. Centralizing this capability drives speed to scale, operational resilience, consistent delivery standards, and responsible AI by design, in close partnership with the AI Center of Excellence.  

This position sits on the Horizontal Enablement team, reporting to the Manager, AI Engineering, and is a senior hands\-on contributor to the team’s MLOps initiatives. Horizontal Enablement bridges platform teams and data science by setting engineering and data science operating standards for production models and maintaining domain\-specific feature and model monitoring. As a Lead AI Engineer, you will build and operate the model deployment pipeline, the domain model monitoring platform, and the Databricks and infrastructure automation that allow AI and machine learning systems to run reliably at scale, while mentoring engineers across the team.  

  

Role  

  

As a Lead AI Engineer, you will:  

* Design, develop, and maintain MLOps capabilities and advanced AI and machine learning systems that address specific business challenges.
* Implement models into production, building scalable training pipelines and deployment frameworks that handle large data volumes and high request rates.
* Administer and maintain Databricks workspaces, including provisioning and configuration, cluster and compute policies, job orchestration, runtime and library upgrades, catalog and access management, secrets, monitoring, and cost optimization.
* Deploy and maintain AI and machine learning infrastructure through infrastructure as code and automated release pipelines, keeping environments repeatable, secure, auditable, and consistent.
* Build and optimize data ingestion, preprocessing, and feature engineering workflows that support model training and inference.
* Automate model training, testing, deployment, and update workflows following CI/CD best practices.
* Build and maintain domain\-specific feature and model monitoring, tracking performance metrics and drift and updating models to sustain high\-quality outputs.
* Implement onboarding and operating standards for platform users, including naming and packaging conventions, validation rules, and exception handling.
* Ensure the operational stability and scalability of AI systems, adhering to ethical guidelines and contributing to the organization’s AI infrastructure.
* Influence stakeholders and partner with data science, platform, and product teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Guide and mentor junior engineers through on\-the\-job experiences and code and design reviews, fostering continuous improvement across the discipline.


Required Qualifications

title: Security Managed Services Engineer (L2)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  

As a Security Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, your role will be to ensure that our clients' security infrastructures and systems remain operational. With a proactive approach, you'll monitor, identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, restoring service efficiently. Your primary objective will be to handle client requests or tickets with technical expertise, ensuring they are resolved within the agreed service level agreement (SLA).  

  

You'll actively manage work queues, perform operational tasks, and update tickets with resolution actions. By identifying issues and errors early on, you'll log incidents promptly and provide second\-level support, communicating effectively with other teams and clients to extend support when needed. Your role includes executing changes responsibly, flagging risks and mitigation plans, and ensuring all changes have proper approvals.  

Collaborative efforts are at the heart of this role. You'll work closely with automation teams to optimize efforts and automate routine tasks, ensuring seamless handovers during shift changes. Your analytical skills will be key in auditing incident and request tickets for quality, recommending improvements, and contributing to trend analysis reports to identify automation opportunities.  

  

As a go\-to for initial client escalations, you'll assist L1 Security Engineers with triage and troubleshooting, and support project work when required. Your contributions to the change management process will ensure thorough documentation, effective planning and execution of maintenance activities, and compliance with standard procedures.  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:*** Experience with managed services handling security infrastructure and working knowledge of ticketing tools, preferably ServiceNow.
* Proficiency in active listening, with techniques like paraphrasing and probing for further information.
* Excellent planning skills, able to anticipate and adjust to changing circumstances.
* Strong ability to communicate and engage across different cultures and social groups.
* Adaptability to changing conditions and flexibility in approach.
* Client\-focused mindset, always putting their needs and positive experience first.
* A positive outlook and the ability to work well under pressure.
* Willingness to put in longer hours when necessary.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing, or relevant work experience.

unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and


application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move


confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more


than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as

title: Senior Engineer - RPA
description:
### **Role Summary**


We are looking for a highly skilled **Senior RPA \& AI Developer** to design, develop, and support intelligent automation solutions using RPA, Generative AI, and related technologies. The role requires strong hands\-on development expertise, solution design capabilities, and the ability to work closely with business stakeholders to deliver scalable automation solutions.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy RPA and AI\-enabled automation solutions.
* Build automations using UiPath, Power Automate, or similar platforms.
* Integrate AI/GenAI capabilities such as LLMs, OCR, NLP, and IDP into automation workflows.
* Analyze business processes and identify automation opportunities.
* Develop reusable components, frameworks, and best practices.
* Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards.
* Integrate bots with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and cloud services.
* Support production deployments, incident resolution, and enhancement activities.
* Collaborate with business analysts, architects, and support teams during project delivery.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, design specifications, and operational runbooks.

### **Required Skills**

### **RPA \& Automation**

* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in **UiPath** and/or **Microsoft Power Automate**.
* Experience developing attended and unattended automation solutions.
* Strong understanding of Orchestrator, queues, assets, exception handling, and framework\-based development.

### **AI \& Emerging Technologies**

* Experience with **Generative AI**, **Azure OpenAI**, **Copilot Studio**, or similar AI platforms.
* Understanding of AI Agents, Agentic AI, prompt engineering, and retrieval\-based solutions.
* Experience with OCR, NLP, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), and document understanding.

### **Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in **Python**, **C\#/.NET**, SQL, and REST APIs.
* Experience integrating with SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Oracle, or web applications.
* Good understanding of Azure services and cloud\-based automation architectures.
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development methodologies.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* UiPath Advanced RPA Developer Certification.
* Microsoft Power Platform or Azure AI Certifications.
* Experience working on enterprise\-scale automation programs.
* Exposure to Process Mining, Task Mining, and Analytics platforms.

### **Key Competencies**

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Excellent stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
* Ownership mindset with focus on quality and delivery.
* Mentoring junior developers and supporting knowledge\-sharing initiatives

title: QE Manager
description:
About This Role
**6 years of experience**  

**Skills: Selenium, Playwright, Java / Python, REST API Testing, BDD / Cucumber, JUnit / Mockito, CI/CD, Postman / RestAssured, Performance Testing, Git, SQL, Agile, Shift\-Left Testing, Defect Management, JIRA**

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for an experienced Quality Engineer with 6\+ years of experience to design, build, and execute automated test solutions across enterprise applications. You will bring strong test automation skills combined with solid domain knowledge — embedding quality as a first\-class concern across Agile delivery teams. This is a hands\-on technical QE role requiring strong coding ability, deep automation framework expertise, and a shift\-left quality mindset.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks covering UI, API, integration, and E2E testing layers.
* Develop automation scripts using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright supporting functional, regression, and cross\-browser testing.
* Build and maintain REST API test automation suites using RestAssured, Karate, or Postman covering API contracts and business logic validation.
* Write unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito collaborating with developers to improve code testability and test coverage.
* Build and maintain BDD test frameworks using Cucumber and Gherkin working with product owners and BAs to define business\-readable acceptance criteria.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines implementing quality gates that prevent defective code from reaching production.
* Champion shift\-left testing practices engaging with developers and architects early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Design and execute performance and load tests using JMeter or Gatling validating application scalability under realistic load conditions.
* Manage defect triage and reporting logging, prioritising, and tracking defects in Jira with clear business impact assessment.
* Mentor and coach junior QE team members sharing automation expertise across the team.

**What We're Looking For**


* 6\+ years of quality engineering experience with strong hands\-on technical automation expertise.
* Strong automation skills using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright building scalable, maintainable frameworks from scratch.
* Solid Java or Python skills writing production\-quality test automation code.
* Proven REST API testing expertise using RestAssured, Karate, or Postman.
* Experience with BDD frameworks including Cucumber and Gherkin for business\-readable test scenario automation.
* Strong CI/CD integration experience embedding quality gates into Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions pipelines.
* Good SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation testing.
* Strong shift\-left testing mindset engaging early in the delivery lifecycle to define testability and quality requirements.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills working effectively across developers, product owners, and DevOps teams.

**Nice to Have**


* Performance and load testing experience using JMeter, Gatling, or k6\.
* Contract testing experience using Pact or Spring Cloud Contract.
* Accessibility testing knowledge including WCAG standards and Axe tools.
* AI assisted testing tools including Mabl, Testim, or Applitools.
* ISTQB Foundation or Advanced certification.
* Experience in Financial Services, Banking, or regulated industry environments.

As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


**Role summary**

  

We are looking for a Infrastructure \& Enterprise Engineer III to join the Reliability Operations. This role is built for a hands\-on engineer with strong coding depth who can improve reliability through automation, AI enablement, and modern platform engineering practices.
  

This team is moving from reactive operations to autonomous resilience, with a clear focus on AI\-enabled detection, response, communication, and prevention, plus automation that reduces manual effort and improves recovery speed. The role should help advance operational excellence through better workflows, stronger observability, and scalable engineering foundations across production systems.


**What you will do**

  

* Design and build workflow automation that removes toil, improves operational consistency, and accelerates incident response
* Develop AI\-enabled operational capabilities that improve detection, diagnosis, communication, and recovery workflows
* Build and maintain services, tools, and automations using Python as a primary engineering language
* Use platforms like n8n and adjacent automation tooling to orchestrate operational workflows across systems
* Strengthen observability across metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and service health signals
* Partner with SRE, platform, infrastructure, and service owners to improve

resilience, MTTR, and engineering standards
  

* Identify repeatable failure patterns and turn them into durable automation,

guardrails, and self\-healing opportunities
  

* Contribute to DevOps practices including CI/CD, release reliability, infrastructure automation, and production readiness
* Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code quality, operational rigor, and mentoring of other engineers.
* Eliminate manual steps in recurring operations processes AI enablement
* Apply AI to operational workflows such as summarization, triage assistance,

intelligent routing, runbook guidance, anomaly context, and post\-incident analysis  

  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

  

* Software design and hands\-on implementation experience
* 8\+ years of experience in reliability engineering and automation
* Strong Python development skills, including building automation frameworks,

services, APIs, and production\-grade tooling
  

* Strong experience with workflow automation, including event\-driven and API\-led integrations
* Deep understanding of observability, including logs, metrics, traces, alerting

strategy, and operational telemetry
  

* Strong DevOps background, including CI/CD, infrastructure automation, production support, and release reliability
* Experience working in high\-availability or mission\-critical environments
* Strong debugging, systems thinking, and incident management instincts
* Ability to work cross\-functionally and influence technical direction.
**Preferred qualifications**

  

* Experience with AIOps, operational intelligence, or AI/LLM\-enabled engineering workflows
* Familiarity with incident management, problem management, and post\-incident review practices
* Experience integrating across tools used in enterprise operations ecosystems
* Knowledge of SRE practices such as SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and reliability

engineering tradeoffs
  

* Experience mentoring engineers and leading medium\-to\-large technical initiatives
* Exposure to cloud\-native infrastructure, platform engineering, and resilience

automation patterns

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.  



  

**Introduction to team**

The Lodging connectivity Organization at Expedia Group is seeking an experienced backend developer and a seasoned technologist with a passion for building robust, scalable, and high\-performance applications that help millions of people plan their travels and create lifelong memories. Join us as we revolutionize the travel industry!  

  



The organization owns a core lever of Expedia Group's growth: expanding global lodging supply and making it a source of competitive advantage. We build and operate the platform that sources, normalizes, and serves third\-party lodging inventory — powering the shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys that travelers rely on every day. Through resilient API integrations and AI agentic workflows, we bring diverse partner content onto a single platform and make it competitive, accurate, and bookable at scale.


We are part of the partner connectivity platform that serves as the backbone of Expedia's business, powering an efficient two\-way marketplace that bridges supply and demand. Our platform sources properties and handles more than 3M transactions per minute. Built with modern technologies like Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Kafka, DynamoDB, ML, Elasticsearch, and Redis on AWS, our ecosystem supports millions of travelers in finding the best travel products tailored to their needs.  

  



If you're passionate about creating transformative solutions, tackling large\-scale engineering challenges, and shaping the future of lodging supply, we'd love to have you on our team. Join us, and let's redefine the way the world travels together!  

  



**In this role, you will:**

* Design, build, and evolve scalable, reliable services and software components, including system design, low\-level design, API design, and data modeling to support customer\-facing and platform experiences.
* Lead the technical design across domains and delivery of complex, multi\-quarter initiatives across the 3PI supply system that support shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys.
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of complex features or services, from technical design through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement in production.
* Break down large, ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions that can be reused across multiple domains and services, driving streamlined execution by the team.
* Write, review, and maintain high\-quality, well\-tested code while driving best practices in code quality, security, observability, resilience, and performance.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by reducing incidents, enhancing observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve traveler and business outcomes, applying AI\-driven systems, tools, and workflows to production\-grade software.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and architecture, and raising the overall engineering bar for the team.
* Partner with product, analytics, design, and engineering teams to apply data\-driven decision making, define success metrics, and improve system health and user outcomes over time.
* Contribute to architectural direction by participating in design reviews, proposing improvements, leading communities of practice, and helping shape long\-term technical strategy.
Technologies we use: Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Docker, Kafka, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Redis, Datadog, Splunk, and AWS cloud.  
* 

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 10\+ years of professional, post\-college backend software development experience in an object\-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end\-to\-end delivery for services or components — design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support — within a multi\-service or multi\-domain environment.
* Deep understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures, with a strong command of core engineering practices including object\-oriented design, testing, and version control.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**About dunnhumby**



dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca\-Cola, Meijer, Procter \& Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.


**Product**



Our Product team owns the vision, strategy and roadmap for the dunnhumby platform — the data, science and software that powers retailers and brands around the world. We work at the intersection of customer data, AI, and commercial impact, building products that turn insight into measurable growth.


**The Role**



The Senior Product Analyst plays a key role in helping us build better products through data\-driven decision making. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers, you'll transform complex product data into actionable insights that shape product strategy, improve user experiences and drive measurable business outcomes.



You'll champion product analytics across our product teams, enabling experimentation, establishing best practices and ensuring decisions are backed by meaningful data.


**What You'll Be Doing**



You'll combine analytical expertise, product knowledge and stakeholder collaboration to deliver insights that influence product direction and maximise customer value.


* Own product analytics across a portfolio of products, defining key metrics and ensuring they are measured, reported and understood effectively
* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers and Product Designers to support product strategy, objectives and key results (OKRs)
* Identify opportunities to improve product performance through data analysis, experimentation and evidence\-based recommendations
* Work closely with Data Engineers and product squads to ensure the right data is captured, modelled and available for meaningful analysis
* Deliver end\-to\-end analytics, from defining requirements and success metrics through to presenting insights and recommendations to stakeholders
* Build, maintain and continuously improve product performance dashboards that provide clear, actionable visibility into product health
* Support product discovery, roadmap planning and experimentation by providing data\-driven insights and commercial context
* Leverage multiple data sources to identify trends, answer business questions and uncover new opportunities for product improvement
* Continuously improve analytics practices, reporting tools, data visualisation and automation to enable faster, more effective decision making
* Communicate insights clearly through compelling data visualisation and storytelling tailored to technical and non\-technical audiences


**What We're Looking For**



You'll bring strong analytical capability, curiosity and a passion for using data to solve product challenges while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.


* Experience in product analytics, product management, product ownership or a similar analytics\-focused role within a software or technology environment
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting complex data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations
* Experience working with cross\-functional product teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers
* Knowledge of product metrics, experimentation, performance measurement and product analytics best practices
* Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through effective data visualisation and storytelling
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision making through data
* Understanding of statistical analysis, product performance measurement and commercial drivers
* Experience on Heap,Fullstory or Amplitude
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification


**What You Can Expect From Us**



We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.



And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process — please let your recruiter know what adjustments would help.


**India Benefits**


* Healthcare \& Family Cover: Group Medical Insurance of INR 500,000 for employees and dependents, plus dental and vision cover up to INR 5,000\.
* Protection: Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover with benefit levels linked to employee grade, including disability benefits.
* Retirement \& Wellbeing: Provident Fund, Gratuity, National Pension Scheme access, Indian Health Organisation membership, and confidential employee assistance support.
* Lifestyle \& Flexibility: Office commute support, internet allowance of INR 2,000 per month for blended working, work\-from\-home kit support, subsidised food, and wellbeing resources.
* Recognition \& Extras: Long service awards, Talent Scout referral programme, and family milestone support.
* Time Off \& Family Leave: 25 days holiday plus 10 public holidays, paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and a day off for your birthday.


**Our approach to Flexible Working**



At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.



We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

title: Solution Engineering - AIBS
description:

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Sales, Service and Marketing management/automation technologies, paired with extensive experience in CRM presales.

  

As an AI Business Solution Engineer – Sales \& Service, you will provide technology expertise to help win deals by guiding Microsoft customers to successfully evaluate our CRM solutions. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, develop deep business acumen, hone your selling skills, and become adept at deal structuring. In this role you will advance pipeline by assisting the Solution Specialist in qualifying the deal, developing the strategy, and inspiring the CxO/Business Decision Maker/Technical Decision Maker. The demo will focus on solving the technical proof requirements while highlighting our business value and competitive differentiators and should result in securing the customer’s solution design endorsement. You will develop relationships with the decision makers with our customers and position yourself as a trusted advisor in your domain. As a recognized product expert, you are responsible for sharing your technical, industry knowledge and best practices with your peers.


Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

* Proactively deliver compelling customer centric solution demonstrations based on technical workload expertise while building Business Decision Maker/CxO/Technical Decision Maker connections.

* Assist in formalizing the customer proposal.

Searches for customer references to use in engagements.

**Leverage Partner Ecosystem**

* Supports partner technical capacity by identifying skill and resource gaps and providing feedback to internal teams (e.g., Global Partner Solutions).

**Build Strategy**

Where applicable, build consumption plans with Partner and Industry Solutions Delivery teams after customer sign\-off.

**Qualifications** **Required/Minimum Qualifications (RQs/MQs):**

title: Lead AI or ML Engineer
description:

Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience
* 8\+ years of experience building and operating production systems with real\-world constraints
* Hands\-on experience with Azure cloud services, infrastructure management, and cloud\-native deployment
* Experience designing and operating production APIs and model\-serving endpoints under defined SLAs and failure modes
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) and managing model versioning and registries
* Experience implementing observability for production systems: logging, metrics, alerting, and drift detection
* Solid software engineering fundamentals in Python, with solid software design, automation, and debugging skills
* Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, and workflow orchestration for containerized workloads

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Infrastructure as Code experience (Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent)
