title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.  



  

**Introduction to team**

The Lodging connectivity Organization at Expedia Group is seeking an experienced backend developer and a seasoned technologist with a passion for building robust, scalable, and high\-performance applications that help millions of people plan their travels and create lifelong memories. Join us as we revolutionize the travel industry!  

  



The organization owns a core lever of Expedia Group's growth: expanding global lodging supply and making it a source of competitive advantage. We build and operate the platform that sources, normalizes, and serves third\-party lodging inventory — powering the shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys that travelers rely on every day. Through resilient API integrations and AI agentic workflows, we bring diverse partner content onto a single platform and make it competitive, accurate, and bookable at scale.


We are part of the partner connectivity platform that serves as the backbone of Expedia's business, powering an efficient two\-way marketplace that bridges supply and demand. Our platform sources properties and handles more than 3M transactions per minute. Built with modern technologies like Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Kafka, DynamoDB, ML, Elasticsearch, and Redis on AWS, our ecosystem supports millions of travelers in finding the best travel products tailored to their needs.  

  



If you're passionate about creating transformative solutions, tackling large\-scale engineering challenges, and shaping the future of lodging supply, we'd love to have you on our team. Join us, and let's redefine the way the world travels together!  

  



**In this role, you will:**

* Design, build, and evolve scalable, reliable services and software components, including system design, low\-level design, API design, and data modeling to support customer\-facing and platform experiences.
* Lead the technical design across domains and delivery of complex, multi\-quarter initiatives across the 3PI supply system that support shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys.
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of complex features or services, from technical design through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement in production.
* Break down large, ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions that can be reused across multiple domains and services, driving streamlined execution by the team.
* Write, review, and maintain high\-quality, well\-tested code while driving best practices in code quality, security, observability, resilience, and performance.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by reducing incidents, enhancing observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve traveler and business outcomes, applying AI\-driven systems, tools, and workflows to production\-grade software.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and architecture, and raising the overall engineering bar for the team.
* Partner with product, analytics, design, and engineering teams to apply data\-driven decision making, define success metrics, and improve system health and user outcomes over time.
* Contribute to architectural direction by participating in design reviews, proposing improvements, leading communities of practice, and helping shape long\-term technical strategy.
Technologies we use: Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Docker, Kafka, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Redis, Datadog, Splunk, and AWS cloud.  
* 

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 10\+ years of professional, post\-college backend software development experience in an object\-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end\-to\-end delivery for services or components — design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support — within a multi\-service or multi\-domain environment.
* Deep understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures, with a strong command of core engineering practices including object\-oriented design, testing, and version control.
* Hands\-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable, maintainable systems.
* Hands\-on expertise with AI/ML frameworks and tools, and experience applying AI/ML concepts to real\-world products.
* Experience building on cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) with sound architectural patterns and scalable, cost\-efficient, production\-quality systems.
Strong communication skills and a highly effective collaborator — able to articulate ideas to teammates, peers, and leaders, support them with data, and incorporate others' feedback to find common ground.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high\-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low\-level designs.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data\-informed tradeoffs across scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Experience with partner or third\-party integrations, supply/inventory systems, or high\-volume marketplace platforms.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Experience leading cross\-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI\-assisted development and testing tools.
* A self\-starter who embraces change and is always open to replacing what you built yesterday with something better today.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.  



  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .  



  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**About dunnhumby**



dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca\-Cola, Meijer, Procter \& Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.


**Product**



Our Product team owns the vision, strategy and roadmap for the dunnhumby platform — the data, science and software that powers retailers and brands around the world. We work at the intersection of customer data, AI, and commercial impact, building products that turn insight into measurable growth.


**The Role**



The Senior Product Analyst plays a key role in helping us build better products through data\-driven decision making. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers, you'll transform complex product data into actionable insights that shape product strategy, improve user experiences and drive measurable business outcomes.



You'll champion product analytics across our product teams, enabling experimentation, establishing best practices and ensuring decisions are backed by meaningful data.


**What You'll Be Doing**



You'll combine analytical expertise, product knowledge and stakeholder collaboration to deliver insights that influence product direction and maximise customer value.


* Own product analytics across a portfolio of products, defining key metrics and ensuring they are measured, reported and understood effectively
* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers and Product Designers to support product strategy, objectives and key results (OKRs)
* Identify opportunities to improve product performance through data analysis, experimentation and evidence\-based recommendations
* Work closely with Data Engineers and product squads to ensure the right data is captured, modelled and available for meaningful analysis
* Deliver end\-to\-end analytics, from defining requirements and success metrics through to presenting insights and recommendations to stakeholders
* Build, maintain and continuously improve product performance dashboards that provide clear, actionable visibility into product health
* Support product discovery, roadmap planning and experimentation by providing data\-driven insights and commercial context
* Leverage multiple data sources to identify trends, answer business questions and uncover new opportunities for product improvement
* Continuously improve analytics practices, reporting tools, data visualisation and automation to enable faster, more effective decision making
* Communicate insights clearly through compelling data visualisation and storytelling tailored to technical and non\-technical audiences


**What We're Looking For**



You'll bring strong analytical capability, curiosity and a passion for using data to solve product challenges while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.


* Experience in product analytics, product management, product ownership or a similar analytics\-focused role within a software or technology environment
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting complex data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations
* Experience working with cross\-functional product teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers
* Knowledge of product metrics, experimentation, performance measurement and product analytics best practices
* Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through effective data visualisation and storytelling
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision making through data
* Understanding of statistical analysis, product performance measurement and commercial drivers
* Experience on Heap,Fullstory or Amplitude
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification


**What You Can Expect From Us**



We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.



And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process — please let your recruiter know what adjustments would help.


**India Benefits**


* Healthcare \& Family Cover: Group Medical Insurance of INR 500,000 for employees and dependents, plus dental and vision cover up to INR 5,000\.
* Protection: Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover with benefit levels linked to employee grade, including disability benefits.
* Retirement \& Wellbeing: Provident Fund, Gratuity, National Pension Scheme access, Indian Health Organisation membership, and confidential employee assistance support.
* Lifestyle \& Flexibility: Office commute support, internet allowance of INR 2,000 per month for blended working, work\-from\-home kit support, subsidised food, and wellbeing resources.
* Recognition \& Extras: Long service awards, Talent Scout referral programme, and family milestone support.
* Time Off \& Family Leave: 25 days holiday plus 10 public holidays, paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and a day off for your birthday.


**Our approach to Flexible Working**



At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.



We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.



For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found(here)

description:

We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

title: Project LEad
description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------



To be a driven business analyst who can work on complex Analytical problems and help the customer in better business decision making especially in the area of pharma/life sciences (domain).


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Role Overview**



The Snowflake Developer is responsible for building and optimizing data pipelines and analytical datasets within a Snowflake\-based data lakehouse. This role also includes leveraging **Snowflake Cortex** to enable AI\-driven data transformations, natural language processing, and intelligent data applications directly within the data platform.



**Key Responsibilities**


**1\. Data Ingestion \& Integration**


* Develop and maintain scalable data ingestion pipelines (batch and near real\-time).
* Load data from databases, APIs, files, and streaming systems into Snowflake.
* Handle structured and semi\-structured data (JSON, Parquet, Avro, CSV).
* Integrate Snowflake with cloud storage platforms (S3, Azure Data Lake, GCS).


**2\. Data Transformation (ELT)**


* Build ELT pipelines using Snowflake SQL and native features (Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables).
* Implement transformations across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers.
* Use tools like dbt for modular, reusable, and testable transformations.


**3\. Snowflake Cortex \& AI Enablement**


* Leverage **Snowflake Cortex** functions within SQL for AI\-powered transformations.
* Implement use cases such as:
* + Text summarization of large datasets (logs, documents)
	+ Sentiment analysis and classification
	+ Natural language enrichment of datasets
* Work with vector embeddings and similarity search for semantic use cases.
* Assist in building AI\-ready datasets for downstream analytics and ML.
* Collaborate with data scientists to integrate AI/ML logic into Snowflake pipelines.
* Support simple **prompt engineering** within Cortex functions for optimized outputs.


**4\. Data Modeling**


* Design and implement analytical data models (star schema, snowflake schema).
* Build fact and dimension tables optimized for BI and AI use cases.
* Ensure datasets are structured for both analytics and AI consumption.


**5\. Performance \& Cost Optimization**


* Optimize SQL queries and Snowflake workloads.
* Use clustering, caching, and efficient compute strategies.
* Monitor warehouse usage and control costs, including Cortex consumption.


**6\. Data Quality \& Validation**


* Implement data validation checks and quality frameworks.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data.
* Debug and resolve pipeline and data issues.


**7\. Security \& Governance**


* Apply RBAC, masking policies, and row\-level security.
* Ensure compliance with data governance and privacy standards.
* Maintain proper documentation and lineage for datasets.


**8\. Collaboration \& Agile Delivery**


* Work with architects, analysts, and AI/ML teams.
* Translate business and AI use cases into technical implementations.
* Participate in Agile development processes.

BE/B.Tech
Master of Computer Application**Work Experience**

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**


**Core Snowflake Skills**

* Advanced SQL skills with performance tuning.
* Experience with Snowflake features:
* + Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables

title: Senior Computer Scientist - C++
description:
The Opportunity
  
Adobe builds products that power millions of customer experiences worldwide. Behind these products are sophisticated software systems operating at scale, where performance, reliability, security, and engineering excellence are fundamental requirements.
  
We are looking for a Senior Computer Scientist with deep C\+\+ expertise who enjoys solving complex technical problems and taking ownership of significant areas of the product. You will shape architecture, build high\-performance software, make critical technical decisions, and influence solutions that span components and teams.
  
We value engineers who are self\-driven, proactive, and outcome\-oriented — engineers who challenge assumptions, solve problems at their root, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and take responsibility for making the systems they own better, more reliable, and easier to evolve.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas end\-to\-end — from understanding ambiguous problems and defining the right solution through architecture, implementation, production validation, and long\-term evolution.
  
Design and build high\-performance C\+\+ systems , making thoughtful decisions around architecture, concurrency, memory management, resource utilization, and scalability.
  
Drive technical direction for complex problems — evaluate alternatives, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and influence architecture decisions across components and teams.
  
Solve problems at the root — identify systemic causes rather than treating symptoms, and drive durable solutions that reduce recurring issues and technical debt.
  
Own outcomes, not just tasks — proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities and drive them to closure with minimal direction.
  
Solve complex problems across boundaries , collaborating with engineers, architects, product managers, and other teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
  
Raise the engineering bar through architecture and code reviews, performance optimization, testing, and engineering best practices.
  
Build for operational excellence with strong focus on performance, reliability, security, observability, maintainability, and efficient resource utilization.
  
Be a force multiplier — mentor engineers, share technical expertise, and establish patterns and practices that improve the broader engineering organization.
  
Leverage AI\-assisted engineering to accelerate development and problem solving, improve engineering workflows, and increase team productivity.
  
  

What You Need to Succeed
  
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
10\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience , with a strong track record of owning and delivering complex technical solutions.
  
Deep expertise in C\+\+ , including modern C\+\+, memory management, concurrency, multithreading, STL, and performance optimization.
  
Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, operating systems, and computer science fundamentals .
  
Strong understanding of systems design, distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and performance engineering .
  
Experience designing and building large\-scale, high\-performance software systems .
  
Experience building or operating Distributed systems at scale , with an understanding of multi\-tenancy, scaling, reliability, backward compatibility, security, observability, and capacity planning.
  
Strong experience with performance analysis and optimization , including profiling CPU, memory, I/O, latency, and resource utilization.
  
Experience with cloud platforms, distributed infrastructure, and modern software development practices.
  
Strong proficiency in AI\-assisted engineering , leveraging tools such as Claude, Codex, or Copilot to accelerate development, improve problem solving, and enhance engineering productivity.
  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving ability , with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence technical decisions across teams.
  
  

What Success Looks Like
  
Success in this role is not measured only by the features you deliver. You will be successful when you:
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas with minimal direction and strong technical judgment.
  
Turn ambiguous, complex problems into clear technical direction and executable solutions .
  
Make architecture decisions that balance performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long\-term evolution .
  
Solve systemic problems at their root and eliminate recurring sources of complexity, performance issues, and operational risk.
  
Influence technical direction across teams and organizational boundaries through technical depth and credibility.
  
Deliver solutions that materially improve performance, scalability, reliability, quality, or developer productivity .
  
Raise the technical bar through mentorship, design leadership, and engineering practices that benefit the broader organization.
  
About Adobe
  
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  

Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
  
  

Let’s Adobe together
  
At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture , focus on people, purpose and community , Adobe for All , comprehensive benefits programs , the stories we tell , the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
  
  

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com .
  
  

**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**

If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

title: Video Editor – Creative & Conceptual Content
description:
Job Summary



SAI is looking for a creative and technically skilled **Video Editor** who can transform raw footage, product demonstrations, ideas, and concepts into engaging and professional video content.



The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling both **standard video editing** and **creative/concept\-driven video production**. The role requires someone who can understand the purpose of a video, develop a visual storytelling approach, and create content that is clear, modern, engaging, and aligned with the SAI brand.



Key Responsibilities


* Edit raw video footage into polished, professional final videos.
* Perform standard editing tasks including cutting, trimming, sequencing, transitions, audio synchronization, subtitles, and basic color correction.
* Create creative and visually engaging videos for product launches, presentations, marketing campaigns, social media, events, and internal communication.
* Develop videos from a concept, script, storyboard, or rough idea.
* Convert technical or product\-related information into simple and engaging visual stories.
* Create strong opening sequences, title cards, end screens, callouts, highlights, and visual emphasis.
* Add motion graphics, text animations, icons, overlays, screen recordings, and graphical elements where required.
* Work with software/product demonstration recordings and make them easy for viewers to understand.
* Synchronize voiceovers, background music, sound effects, animations, and on\-screen activity accurately.
* Create concept videos that communicate the vision of a product, technology, feature, or future experience.
* Improve raw or ordinary footage through creative pacing, transitions, visual effects, sound design, and storytelling.
* Produce short\-form and long\-form content depending on the platform and project requirement.
* Create content suitable for presentations, exhibitions, customer demonstrations, social media, websites, and corporate communication.
* Maintain visual consistency across SAI videos, including typography, branding, transitions, colors, logos, and overall presentation style.
* Review completed videos carefully for visual, audio, spelling, timing, and synchronization issues.
* Manage multiple video projects while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
* Organize project files, raw footage, exported videos, graphics, audio, and reusable video assets properly.
* Work closely with product, design, marketing, and management teams to understand project requirements and incorporate feedback.


Types of Video Work



The candidate should be comfortable working across different video styles, including:


**Normal / Standard Video Editing**


* Product demonstrations
* Screen recordings
* Training videos
* Tutorial videos
* Corporate videos
* Internal communication videos
* Event videos
* Presentation videos


**Creative Video Editing**


* Promotional videos
* Product launch videos
* Social media content
* Brand videos
* Highlight videos
* Exhibition and event content
* Cinematic product presentations
* Visually engaging feature demonstrations


**Concept Video Editing**


* Product concept videos
* Future technology demonstrations
* Vision videos
* Story\-driven product presentations
* Feature visualization
* UI/UX concept presentations
* Before\-and\-after scenarios
* Problem\-to\-solution storytelling
* Technology and AI concept videos


Required Skills


* Strong understanding of video editing principles and visual storytelling.
* Good sense of pacing, timing, composition, typography, and visual hierarchy.
* Ability to convert an idea or rough brief into a complete video.
* Ability to understand the objective and audience before starting an edit.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good understanding of audio editing and synchronization.
* Knowledge of color correction and basic color grading.
* Experience with motion graphics and animated text.
* Ability to work with screen recordings and software demonstrations.
* Ability to select suitable music, sound effects, transitions, and visual styles.
* Ability to manage feedback and revise videos efficiently.


Preferred Software Knowledge



Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:


* Adobe Premiere Pro
* Adobe After Effects
* DaVinci Resolve
* Final Cut Pro
* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* CapCut or similar editing tools
* AI\-assisted video, image, voice, or animation tools


Knowledge of motion graphics, compositing, 2D/3D animation, or basic Blender/Cinema 4D workflows would be an advantage.



Creative Expectations



We are looking for someone who does more than simply cut footage.



The editor should be able to look at raw content and think:


* What is the main message?
* How should the video begin?
* What should the viewer notice first?
* Where should the video slow down or speed up?
* What visual treatment will make the content easier to understand?
* How can an ordinary product demonstration become more engaging?
* What graphics, animation, sound, or storytelling will strengthen the message?
* How can a complex technology concept be explained visually?


The ability to **think creatively before editing** is an important part of this role.



Qualifications


* Degree/Diploma in Video Editing, Film, Media, Animation, Graphic Design, Multimedia, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.
* Relevant professional or freelance video\-editing experience.
* A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating previous work.
* Candidates with strong practical skills and an excellent portfolio will be considered regardless of formal qualification.


Portfolio Requirement



Candidates should provide examples demonstrating at least some of the following:


* Standard video editing
* Creative editing
* Product or corporate videos
* Motion graphics
* Concept videos
* Promotional content
* Screen\-recording/product demonstration videos
* Social media content

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Join JPMorganChase's India GIFT City buildout and lead a front\-line operations team at the center of trade lifecycle delivery. You will manage complex post\-trade processes across multiple markets products, strengthen controls, and drive automation and process improvements. This is a high\-visibility role for an experienced operations leader who can deliver results under pressure, develop talent, and partner effectively across trading, technology, risk, and compliance.  

  

As a Vice President Market Operations based in the GIFT City branch (Ahmedabad), you will lead a highly visible operations function responsible for end\-to\-end post‑trade delivery. You will own service delivery, controls, and regulatory compliance across products including foreign exchange, rates derivatives, options, fixed income, and money markets. Reporting to the India Branch Head of Operations, you will lead a team, drive measurable improvements in efficiency and straight\-through processing, and partner closely with the front office and key control functions to deliver stable, well\-controlled operations.

 **Job responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end post\-trade delivery, including trade capture and validation, confirmations, settlements, reconciliations, break management, investigations, and issue resolution.
* Own service performance outcomes, improving accuracy, timeliness, straight\-through processing, and client experience.
* Strengthen the risk and control environment through disciplined control execution, issue management, remediation, and audit readiness.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies, maintaining strong governance, documentation, and operating discipline.
* Lead, coach, and develop the team, ensuring clear accountability, effective coverage, and operational resiliency.
* Partner with sales and trading, technology, risk, compliance, and finance teams to resolve exceptions and deliver change effectively.
* Drive automation and process improvements, including workflow redesign, data quality enhancements, and operational dashboards.
* Provide clear reporting on key performance indicators, incidents, control issues, and change delivery progress.

 **Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Bachelor's degree
* Minimum 15 years of experience in markets operations, post\-trade, middle office, or trade support, with end\-to\-end lifecycle ownership across at least one of: foreign exchange, rates derivatives, options, fixed income, or money markets.
* Proven people leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, and building a strong controls culture.
* Strong knowledge of post\-trade processes, including confirmations, settlements, reconciliations, and investigations.
* Track record of delivering measurable improvements, such as reduced breaks, faster turnaround times, higher straight\-through processing, or automation benefits.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and seniority levels.

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to use data and key performance indicators to manage performance and prioritize risk.  
* 

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience working in a regulated markets environment, with familiarity with India and emerging markets operating considerations.
* Experience leading change or transformation initiatives in operations in partnership with technology teams.
* Experience leading teams through the adoption of AI\-enabled analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to improve operational efficiency and accuracy, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, well\-controlled execution through coaching, change adoption, and continuous improvement

The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: NDT Technician
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled **NDT Technician** with experience in **shipbuilding, ship repair, marine, fabrication, or heavy engineering** to carry out non\-destructive testing and inspection of welds, structures, piping, and other components. The candidate should be familiar with NDT procedures, inspection standards, safety requirements, and preparation of accurate inspection reports.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform NDT inspections as per approved procedures, inspection plans, drawings, and applicable standards.
* Carry out **UT, DPT, MPT and/or RT** depending on qualification and project requirements.
* Inspect welds, plates, pipes, structural members, pressure components, and repaired areas.
* Identify and evaluate weld discontinuities, defects, cracks, porosity, lack of fusion, undercut, etc.
* Verify inspection areas and test locations as per approved drawings and inspection requirements.
* Calibrate and perform routine checks of NDT equipment before use.
* Record inspection results accurately and prepare NDT reports.
* Maintain proper documentation, inspection records, test reports, and traceability.
* Coordinate with **QA/QC, Welding, Production, and Project teams** for inspection activities.
* Conduct re\-inspection of repaired/reworked areas and verify compliance.
* Ensure NDT activities are carried out in accordance with applicable **class, client, statutory, and project requirements**.
* Maintain NDT equipment, accessories, consumables, and calibration records.
* Follow all applicable **HSE and radiation\-safety requirements**, particularly during RT activities.
* Support client/class surveyors during inspection and testing.
* Report inspection findings and non\-conformities to the concerned QA/QC Engineer or NDT Level II/III personnel.

Required Qualifications

* Diploma / ITI / Technical qualification in Mechanical, Welding, NDT, or a related field.
* Valid certification in relevant NDT methods such as:
* **UT – Ultrasonic Testing**
* **MT/MPI – Magnetic Particle Testing**
* **PT/DPT – Dye Penetrant Testing**
* **RT – Radiographic Testing**, if applicable
* Certification as per relevant **ASNT / ISO 9712 / PCN** or equivalent requirements will be preferred.
* Practical experience in **shipyard, ship repair, marine, fabrication, or heavy engineering** is preferred.

Technical Skills

* Good knowledge of weld inspection and NDT techniques.
* Ability to interpret **engineering drawings, weld symbols, inspection procedures, and specifications**.
* Knowledge of relevant **ASME, ASTM, AWS, ISO and classification society requirements**.
* Familiarity with acceptance criteria for weld and material defects.
* Ability to prepare clear and accurate NDT reports.
* Basic computer knowledge for documentation and reporting.

Desired Competencies

* Strong attention to detail.
* Good observation and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a QA/QC team.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Willingness to work in **shipyard, dock, vessel, and outdoor environments**.
* Commitment to safety and quality standards.

Key Performance Areas

* Accuracy and reliability of NDT inspection.
* Timely completion of inspection activities.
* Proper identification and reporting of defects.
* Compliance with approved NDT procedures and applicable standards.
* Proper maintenance of inspection records and equipment.

description:
Executive Level 1
  
  

$122,620 \- $139,850 \+ 15\.4% Superannuation
  
  

All Commission Locations
  
  

About the Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission
  
  

About the Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission
  
  

The Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission is the national regulator of Australian Government\-funded aged care services.
  
  

We protect and enhance the safety, health, wellbeing, and quality of life of people receiving aged care. This includes managing complaints and feedback about the care older people receive.
  
  

We help build confidence and trust in aged care, by promoting best practice and a culture of safety and quality in the sector. We register providers and hold them to account if they don’t meet expected standards of care.
  
  

We work with providers, workers, older people, their families, and supporters to make sure they understand and uphold older people’s rights.
  
  

Meet some of our people and learn more about the Commission and our Regulatory Strategy on our website www.agedcarequality.gov.au
  
  

About the Team
  
  

Cyber Section
  
  

Safeguarding the Commission’s digital assets, information, and infrastructure from cyber threats and security breaches, the Cyber team focuses on implementing robust security measures, policies, and practices to protect against unauthorised access, data breaches, and cyber\-attacks.
  
  

About the Role
  
  

The Assistant Director, Information Governance leads the team responsible for strengthening how the Commission creates, manages, protects, uses, retains and disposes of information. The role ensures information is treated as a strategic asset: trusted, discoverable, secure, accessible when needed and managed in line with legislative, policy and National Archives of Australia expectations.
  
  

As an EL1 leader in the Digital Group, the position connects information governance practice with the Commission’s regulatory purpose, digital and data priorities, risk appetite and service outcomes. The role provides practical leadership across information management, recordkeeping, assurance, cyber security, privacy and responsible technology use, helping the Commission make confident, evidence\-based decisions and maintain public trust.
  
  

Position Duties
  
  

**Lead information governance:** Develop and improve information governance frameworks, policies, standards, procedures and guidance that align to business outcomes, regulatory responsibilities and the Commission’s digital and data priorities.
  
**Deliver recordkeeping and information management outcomes:** Support the proper creation, capture, management, preservation, access, retention and disposal of Commission information in line with the Archives Act, records authorities, National Archives of Australia guidance and Commission requirements.
  
**Strengthen information stewardship:** Improve ownership, classification, metadata, access, sensitivity, handling and lifecycle controls so information assets are discoverable, usable, trusted and appropriately protected.
  
**Manage information risk and assurance:** Identify, assess, manage and report information governance, recordkeeping, privacy, information handling and emerging technology risks, and coordinate assurance activities, remediation and reporting.
  
**Align with cyber security, privacy and the ISMS:** Work with cyber security, privacy, legal, technology and business stakeholders to embed information governance requirements into secure\-by\-design services, access controls, classification, incident response and business continuity practices.
  
**Support responsible technology use:** Provide practical governance for AI, automation, analytics and other emerging technologies, ensuring information inputs, outputs and records are managed according to value, sensitivity, ownership, retention, privacy, security and accountability requirements.
  
**Build capability and culture:** Develop clear guidance, education, communications and stakeholder engagement that help staff understand and meet their information management responsibilities.
  
**Provide strategic advice:** Give clear, evidence\-based advice to executives, managers and service owners on information governance, records management, information risk, privacy and lifecycle management.
  
**Lead the team and deliver results:** Set direction, clarify priorities, allocate work, build capability, manage performance, support wellbeing and deliver agreed outcomes while managing risks, dependencies and changing priorities.
  
**Drive continuous improvement:** Use evidence, feedback, reporting and lessons learned to improve information governance services, tools, registers, controls and assurance processes.
  
**Other duties:** Perform other duties as required, consistent with the classification, work level standards and direction of the Director.
  
  

**Position Eligibility Requirements (Selection Criteria):**  

To be successful in this role you will need to demonstrate the following:
  
  

**Strategic thinking:** Connects information governance work to the Commission’s purpose, regulatory responsibilities and digital and data priorities, using evidence and judgement to solve complex problems.
  
**Delivery and accountability:** Plans and delivers quality outcomes, manages priorities, risks and dependencies, and follows through on commitments with clear evidence and documentation.
  
**People and change leadership:** Provides direction, supports staff and stakeholders through change, builds capability and creates a positive, accountable and service\-oriented team culture.
  
**Stakeholder engagement:** Builds productive relationships across Digital, Data, Privacy, Legal, Governance, business areas, providers and government partners to achieve practical information governance outcomes.
  
**Communication and influence:** Explains complex information governance, recordkeeping, privacy, risk and assurance matters clearly and provides advice that supports informed decisions.
  
**Professional judgement and integrity:** Models ethical information handling, sound judgement, professionalism, resilience and a strong commitment to public accountability.
  
**Information governance expertise:** Applies strong knowledge of Australian Government information management, recordkeeping, lifecycle management, metadata, retention, disposal, discovery, preservation and relevant obligations, including the Archives Act, Privacy Act, PSPF and Commission policies.
  
**Risk, assurance and responsible digital practice:** Designs proportionate controls and assurance approaches for information, privacy, security and emerging technology risks, supporting trusted, secure and responsible digital and data outcomes.
  
**Security clearance:** Baseline Security Clearance, or ability to obtain and maintain.
  
  

**Position Notes:**  

Salary offered will be between $122,620 \- $139,850 per annum depending on skills and experience. In addition, 15\.4% superannuation will be paid.
  
Only candidates who hold Australian citizenship can apply. Appointment is conditional on successfully completing a national police check. For more information, please visit www.apsc.gov.au/citizenship\-aps
  
Non\-ongoing opportunity will be offered for an irregular/intermittent term. Opportunities will be offered for varying periods up to 12 months with the option to extend to a total of 24 months.
  
Merit Pool established through this selection process may be used to fill this or future ongoing or non\-ongoing vacancies.
  
In your application, please provide a statement of claims against the position eligibility requirements (selection criteria) in no more than 600\-words , including what strengths you would bring to the role, and a copy of your CV.
  
  

Please complete the application and submit by 1 October 2026 at 11:30PM
  
Follow our guidelines for candidate use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) throughout the recruitment process.
  
Please contact our recruitment team on (02\) 9633 3262 or email recruitment@agedcarequality.gov.au for assistance with accessing our website or with lodging your application.
  
  

Specific questions about the roles can be directed to Toby Harvey by emailing Toby.Harvey@agedcarequality.gov.au with Position title in the subject line.

The Commission is committed to fostering a workplace with flexible work arrangements to support a diverse, respectful and inclusive culture for all staff.

 When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
   

  

 Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
   

  

  

**Job Description**
  

 Turnitin's Revenue Operations team is modernizing its analytics foundation — moving to governed dbt models on Redshift and building a trusted, consolidated view of the business for Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Finance.
   

  

 You own the models, pipelines, and tests that everything downstream depends on. You're not a ticket\-taker: we expect you to understand why a metric matters before you model it, and to say so when the requirement as stated will produce a number that's technically correct and practically wrong.
   

  

 This is an early\-stage function, so you'll have unusual influence over how it's built.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Lead the migration of legacy Alteryx workflows into documented, tested dbt models on Redshift.
* Design models with deliberate grain and clear lineage, building toward a certified set of marts that reporting reads from.
* Own orchestration, monitoring, and alerting in Dagster (or Airflow), and the ingestion layer feeding it.
* Keep Redshift fast and cost\-effective.
* Trace issues to the right root cause — reporting, data model, or upstream business process — and route each to the right fix.
* Build the data foundations behind RevOps initiatives such as account\-based marketing, customer health scoring, and predictive work like churn and lead scoring.

**About the Team**

At Workday, we bring technical rigor, customer empathy, and a spirit of fun to enterprise software. Our support team underpins operational excellence across Workday's digital experience, AI/ML platform, and Agent Factory initiative. Workday’s Agent Factory is our internal engine that builds, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute complex HR and Finance workflows, including expense processing, hiring, and workforce scheduling. We partner with core engineering to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability for our global customer base.
**About the Role**

We are seeking a customer\-focused Support Engineer to drive incident resolution, root\-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimisation across Workday’s enterprise platform and autonomous AI agent workflows. In this high\-visibility role, you will analyze system metrics, debug cloud\-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, and manage critical customer escalations within strict SLAs. You will also partner directly with engineering and data science teams through feature iteration and optimisation. A key part of this role involves hands\-on AI evaluation: analysing LLM outputs, reviewing conversation logs, and digging into system traces to spot failure modes and translate those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.


Key Responsibilities


* Enterprise SaaS \& Functional Domain Expertise: Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
* Hands\-On AI Evaluation: Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
* Technical Troubleshooting \& RCA: Assist in root\-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
* Cloud \& LLM Diagnostics: Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
* Incident \& Queue Management: Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high\-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on\-call rotations.
* Customer Communication: Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high\-stakes escalations.
* Database \& Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
* Documentation \& Team Collaboration: Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.

**About You**

**Basic Qualifications (Required)**
-----------------------------------

Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.


Technical \& Diagnostic Skills:


* Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
* Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command\-line tools.

Cloud \& Monitoring Systems:


* Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.

AI \& LLM Exposure:


* Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.

Triage \& Operations:


* Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.

Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
* Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
* History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post\-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer\-facing teams.
* Strong active problem\-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi\-tiered enterprise systems.

* Experience working with large\-scale business, sales, and product datasets, including CRM, telemetry, subscription, and customer data.

* Experience building models that support GTM, Product, or Customer Success decision\-making.

description:
**Your role**
-------------

**About us**
------------

Atlas Copco is a Swedish multinational industrial company that was founded in 1873 headquartered in Nacka, Sweden. We are world leaders in Compressors; we also manufacture industrial tools and equipment.


We are an IT Service Provider company within Atlas Copco Group called Global IT Hub (India). We are also focusing on Digital transformation Technologies for Data Driven Decisions, Web and Applications developments, Automations, IT Infrastructure etc.


Data Analytics Competence is the competence within the Global IT Hub (India).


**Job Description**
-------------------

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Solution Architect to join our growing Data \& Aanlytics team from Digital Technology vertical. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing innovative data solutions that support our data analytics initiatives. You will bridge the gap between business needs and technical feasibility, ensuring our data infrastructure is scalable, secure, and optimized for advanced analytics.


### **The Role**

* **Bridges the gap:** Translates business needs into technical solutions for data analytics projects.
* **Designs the roadmap:** Define and implement scalable, secure data architectures for analytics platforms and BI solutions.
* **Technology expertise:** Possesses deep knowledge of various data technologies (cloud platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, analytics tools) to recommend the best fit for optimal performance.
* **Integration champion:** Designs solutions that integrate seamlessly with existing IT infrastructure.
* **Scalability focus:** Keeps scalability and future growth in mind when designing the architecture.
* **Collaboration king:** Works closely with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and stakeholders to ensure everyone's on the same page.
* **Risk assessment:** Identifies potential risks and proposes solutions to mitigate them.
* **Communication is key:** Clearly communicates complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* **Innovation:** Stays at part with emerging trends in data and analytics to future\-proof solutions.

**Key responsibilities and accountabilities**
---------------------------------------------

### **Skills and Experience**

* **Data Modelling \& Design:** Expertise in data modelling techniques, including relational (SQL) and non\-relational (NoSQL) databases.
* **Data Warehousing \& ETL:** Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, and big data technologies.
* **Programming Languages:** Proficiency in SQL and potentially scripting languages like Python, Spark, etc. for data manipulation and automation.
* **Cloud Platforms:** Knowledge of cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, Data Bricks, Fabric) for deploying and managing data solutions.
* **Data Management \& Security:** Understanding of data governance, security best practices, and data access controls.
* Certifications: good to have relavent certifications which shows academic regor e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Databricks Certified Solution Architect

**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

### **Competences**

* **Communication \& Collaboration:** Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Problem\-Solving \& Critical Thinking:** Ability to analyze complex data problems and design effective solutions.
* **Project Management:** Experience managing data\-related projects and ensuring successful execution.
* **Teamwork:** Ability to guide \& collaborate effectively with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and business teams.
* **Strategic thinking** and E **nterprise\-level solution design**

### **Stakeholder management**

* You can discuss with stakeholders about their requirements and clearly communicate back your understanding of the requirements.
* You can work with the stakeholders to understand the big picture and work towards it.
* Work with team members and other users from the organization at different levels for performance improvement and suggestions.

### **Must have**

* Communication skills, Facilitation: Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between technical and non\-technical stakeholders (business users, data engineers, analysts, data scientists).
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a team environment, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing across the data team.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to analyse complex business needs and translate them into technical solutions for data analytics projects.
* Technical Architecture Design: Skilled at designing and implementing scalable data pipelines, platforms, and tools to support data analytics at an enterprise level.
* Technology Selection: Deep knowledge of various data technologies (cloud platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, analytics tools) to recommend the best fit for specific needs.

### **Nice to have**

* Emerging Technologies: Curiosity and interest in keeping up with emerging data technologies.
* Experience in hybrid environments: cloud \+ on\-prem
* Business Acumen: Understanding of core business processes and how data analytics can drive strategic decision\-making.
* Project Management Tools: Experience with project management methodologies and tools like Agile or Scrum.
* Mentorship: Ability to mentor and guide junior team members within the data team.

### **Education**

* Any Graduate (B.E./B.Tech/MCA/MTech/BSc/MSc/MCS) in Engineering with 8\+ years of experience in software development/data analytics domain and at least 5 years of experience as a solution architect on IT Projects.

### **Knowledge**

* Good analytical skills: You feel comfortable working with numbers/data, e.g. collecting and analysing trend graphs, combining the info with insights from ERP and previous site visits to come to a sound conclusion.
* You are fluent in English: both written and spoken.

### **Personality requirements**

* You like open communication and enjoy working with different cultures.
* You are decisive (not afraid of making errors and willing to learn by doing)
* Open minded; expect the unexpected (\= stay sceptical when viewing at the data and info)
* Not afraid to approach other stakeholders (customer centre specialists, local engineering, or technical support specialists)
* You work with a structured approach when collecting info and data, but also when closing the feedback loop to further increase your learning.

**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

**What we offer**
-----------------

* This is a leadership role focused on defining roadmap of Data Engineering competence and achieving it.
* Global exposure and opportunities
* This role is ideal for you, if you wish to challenge yourself on Technological front and creating competence centre for Data Engineering and Visualization
* This role gives you enough opportunities to build your professional network among technical fraternity within the group.
* This role also expects you to build a very strong network of local ecosystem and bring the benefits for Atlas Copco
* Flexible working hours

* To be part of the data competence team which is constantly growing.

BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry\-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
We are seeking a highly skilled Data Scientist with deep experience in B2B SaaS to lead the development of advanced analytics, predictive models, and AI\-driven insights that improve business performance and customer outcomes. This role will partner closely with teams across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Data teams to solve high\-impact business problems using data science.
The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, and business analytics, combined with a practical understanding of key SaaS metrics such as ARR, NRR, churn, retention, expansion, pipeline conversion, customer health, and product adoption. This person must be able to move fluently between technical depth and business context, translating complex data into actionable recommendations that influence strategy and execution.
Here is how, through this exciting role, YOU will contribute to BMC's and your own success:
* Develop and deploy predictive and prescriptive models to solve critical business problems across the B2B SaaS lifecycle.


* Build data science solutions for use cases such as customer churn prediction, upsell propensity, lead scoring, pipeline forecasting, product adoption, customer segmentation, pricing optimization, and customer health scoring.


* Partner with Sales, Operations, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to identify opportunities where data science can improve growth, retention, and operational efficiency.


* Design and analyze experiments, A/B tests, and quasi\-experimental studies to measure the impact of product, marketing, and sales initiatives.


* Apply statistical methods and machine learning techniques to large, complex datasets from CRM, product telemetry, marketing, support, finance, and customer systems.


* Translate business questions into structured analytical approaches and communicate findings clearly to executive and cross\-functional stakeholders.


* Collaborate with data engineers, analytics engineers, BI teams, and architects to ensure scalable data pipelines and production\-ready modeling workflows.


* Monitor model performance, validate assumptions, and continuously improve model accuracy, explainability, and business relevance.


* Support the development of self\-service insights, reusable data science assets, and scalable frameworks for decision\-making.


* Document methodologies, assumptions, and business impact in a clear and reproducible manner.


To ensure you’re set up for success, you will bring the following skillset \& experience:
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.


* 8\+ years of experience in data science \& machine learning, with significant experience in B2B SaaS environments.


* Strong expertise in machine learning, statistical modeling, forecasting, experimentation, and causal analysis.


* Strong proficiency in Python and advanced SQL skills.


* Experience working with large\-scale business, sales, and product datasets, including CRM, telemetry, subscription, and customer data.


* Deep understanding of B2B SaaS business models and core metrics such as ARR, MRR, churn, retention, expansion, NRR, CAC, LTV, conversion, and product usage/adoption.


* Hands\-on experience with large language models (LLMs) and modern AI frameworks such as OpenAI APIs, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar tools.


* Familiarity with RAG, prompt engineering, model evaluation, guardrails, and responsible AI practices for enterprise\-ready AI solutions.


* Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery


* Experience in subscription analytics, revenue analytics, product\-led growth, or customer lifecycle modeling.


* Experience building models that support GTM, Product, or Customer Success decision\-making.


* Strong ability to communicate technical findings to non\-technical audiences and influence business decisions.


* Experience working cross\-functionally in fast\-paced, matrixed environments.


* Familiarity with GenAI or AI\-enabled analytical workflows is a plus.


* Familiarity with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker

  

  

Core Skills:
* Machine Learning


* Statistical Modeling


* Forecasting


* Experimentation and A/B Testing


* Customer Churn and Retention Analytics


* Product Adoption Analytics


* Revenue and Growth Analytics


* Segmentation and Propensity Modeling


* Python


* SQL


* Applied AI / Generative AI


* Large Language Models (LLMs) / Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)


* Data Storytelling


* Cross\-Functional Business Partnership

  

  

What Success Looks Like:
Success in this role means delivering data science solutions that create measurable business impact. This includes improving customer retention, accelerating growth, increasing forecast accuracy, identifying high\-value opportunities, and enabling smarter decisions across the B2B SaaS customer lifecycle. The successful candidate will combine strong technical rigor with business judgment and will help embed data science into everyday decision\-making across the organization.
**Our commitment to you!**

  

BMC’s culture is built around its people. We have 6000\+ brilliant minds working together across the globe. You won’t be known just by your employee number, but for your true authentic self. BMC lets you be YOU!

  

  

If after reading the above, You’re unsure if you meet the qualifications of this role but are deeply excited about BMC and this team, we still encourage you to apply! We want to attract talents from diverse backgrounds and experience to ensure we face the world together with the best ideas!

title: Senior Vice President - Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (CIP)
description:
Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (CIP), Pune


Senior Vice President


Pune, India


**About Infrastructure Technology**

The Global Infrastructure organization builds and maintains the critical technology backbone that enables Jefferies to operate at scale, delivering secure, resilient, and high\-performing IT services that power the business. We drive innovation through solutions such as cloud and hybrid adoption, network resiliency, platform modernization, and automation. The organization is structured into several specialized sub\-domains: Core Infrastructure Platform, Public Cloud, Digital Workspace, Networking, Telecom \& Multimedia, and International Infrastructure. Our teams collaborate globally to ensure Jefferies’ technology platforms are highly available, secure, scalable, and cost\-effective.


**Core Infrastructure Platforms**

The Core Infrastructure Platforms function lays the foundation for Jefferies’ IT, designing, operating, and optimizing the essential compute, storage, operating systems, and database platforms that support all business\-critical applications. Our mission is to deliver secure, resilient, and high\-performance datacenter and cloud solutions for global operations.


Organized into four teams, Global Systems Engineering, Unix Engineering, Windows Engineering, and Database Engineering, this group drives operational excellence, security, high availability, compliance, and continuous improvement across our technology estate.


By championing automation, standardization, and proactive monitoring, and by working closely with application, security, and business teams, we ensure our environments are robust, stable, and scalable. Through this collaborative approach and a relentless focus on modernization, Jefferies’ infrastructure remains agile and adaptable, ready to meet the evolving needs of our global business.


**Job Summary**

Jefferies is seeking a dynamic, hands\-on, and strategic Senior Vice President (SVP), Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (Pune). This executive technical leader will lead automation, operations, and modernization of Jefferies’ platform stack, with a focus on critical platform domains: databases, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, and Unix/Windows server infrastructure. Based in Pune, India, the SVP will lead the Pune CIP team and be accountable for technical excellence, operational resilience, and end\-to\-end Pune led delivery supporting the US, EMEA and APAC estate. This role reports to the Head of GCC, Pune (primary) and the Global Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms, Jersey City (secondary).


This is not a pure management or “middle\-layer” role. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on domain expert who remains technically current, acts as a trusted escalation point and decision\-maker, and independently resolves complex infrastructure and operational challenges rather than simply escalating them.


Success in this role comes from earning the trust of engineers and global business stakeholders through demonstrated technical mastery, incident command, and the delivery of solutions that enable strategic business outcomes. The position requires deep technical expertise paired with proven people leadership to build, mentor, and scale high\-performing teams supporting 24/7 capital markets operations.  



**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global Platform Leadership:** partner with global leads on the vision, engineering standards, and operational governance for Jefferies’ core infrastructure stack: database, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, Unix/Linux, and Windows server platforms, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* **Local Management of the Infrastructure Team:** direct managerial responsibilities for Infrastructure Technology team members located in the Jefferies Pune office (Networks, Telecom, Digital Workplace, Cloud, CIP, Service Delivery).
* **Modernization \& Cloud/Hybrid Adoption:** Drive modernization, cloud/hybrid adoption, automation\-first delivery, and standardization across all domains, balancing operational excellence with innovation and optimization. Lead strategic integration and optimal workload placement between on\-premises and cloud resources, as business and regulatory requirements permit.
* **Hands\-on Technical Escalation:** Serve as the final point of escalation and technical incident lead during major outages, performance, or security incidents. Analyze real\-time symptoms, ask the right diagnostic questions, and guide teams towards root\-cause resolution.
* **Solution Delivery:** Architect and deliver practical, high\-impact solutions for business and application teams, actively collaborating with CIO leadership, BU leads, and local metro SVPs/VPs worldwide.
* **Operational Resilience** : Own and continuously improve resilience, high\-availability, recovery, and compliance strategies across the global platform estate.
* **Global Team Development:** Partner with global leads in NYC, London, and HK to cultivate a high\-performing, distributed team of engineers and architects, primarily based in India. You will mentor leaders and engineers, promote end\-to\-end ownership, and develop problem\-solving capability.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Partner with business units, application teams, and senior platform leaders to align technical priorities, communicate platform direction, and enable local\-global business outcomes.
* **Technical Standards \& Documentation:** Author, maintain, and enforce robust operational standards, SLAs, playbooks, and knowledge base for platform operations and incident response.
* **Post\-Incident Review \& Learning:** Lead technical post\-mortems and deep\-dives, drive remediation, and foster a culture of continuous technical learning.
* **Regulatory \& Risk Alignment:** Execute robust security, compliance, vulnerability management, and audit readiness for mission\-critical infrastructure in a highly regulated financial services environment.

**Mandatory Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Experience:**
	+ 15\+ years in IT infrastructure/platform engineering and operations, with at least 5 years in global technical leadership (financial services or complex enterprise IT preferred).
	+ Proven recent, hands\-on experience with at least three of: database platforms (SQL/Oracle/etc), virtualization (VMware/Hyper\-V/KVM, Nutanix), storage (SAN/NAS), backup/DR, Unix/Linux, and Windows server engineering and operations.
	+ Track record as a solution owner, not just a conduit, able to independently architect and deliver technical outcomes in critical environments.
* **Core Competencies:**
	+ Deep technical expertise, able to lead troubleshooting, ask the right questions, synthesize technical indicators, and command resolution during platform issues and outages.
	+ Domain credibility, regarded by engineers and senior IT partners as the go\-to technical escalation contact.
	+ Record of driving platform modernization, cloud/hybrid/cloud adoption, automation, and cost/risk optimization.
	+ Strong foundation in regulatory, compliance, and operational risk management for infrastructure.
	+ Executive presence, able to command trust in both technical and business forums, and partner with C\-levels, application owners, and metro engineering leaders.
	+ Outstanding stakeholder management, communication, prioritization, and conflict resolution skills, on both local (India) and global scales.
	+ Experience designing and enforcing technical standards, SLAs, and incident management frameworks.
* **Certifications (optional, but valued):**Recognized certifications (RHCE, MCSE, VMware, Nutanix, NetApp, AWS/Azure/GCP, ITIL, etc.)  

	+

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent required; Master’s degree preferred.  

* 

**What Success Looks Like**

The SVP delivers a world\-class platform that serves as a resilient, secure, continuously modernizing backbone for all Jefferies business applications, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You lead actively, commanding incidents, delivering solutions, and growing your team’s technical and operational capability. You are trusted by engineers as a technical authority, by CIO/BU leaders as a business partner, and by the enterprise as the leader who enables robust, scalable solutions tightly aligned with the business's needs.  



**Equal Opportunity Employer:** Jefferies values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Computer Scientist - C++

The Opportunity
  
Adobe builds products that power millions of customer experiences worldwide. Behind these products are sophisticated software systems operating at scale, where performance, reliability, security, and engineering excellence are fundamental requirements.
  
We are looking for a Senior Computer Scientist with deep C\+\+ expertise who enjoys solving complex technical problems and taking ownership of significant areas of the product. You will shape architecture, build high\-performance software, make critical technical decisions, and influence solutions that span components and teams.
  
We value engineers who are self\-driven, proactive, and outcome\-oriented — engineers who challenge assumptions, solve problems at their root, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and take responsibility for making the systems they own better, more reliable, and easier to evolve.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas end\-to\-end — from understanding ambiguous problems and defining the right solution through architecture, implementation, production validation, and long\-term evolution.
  
Design and build high\-performance C\+\+ systems , making thoughtful decisions around architecture, concurrency, memory management, resource utilization, and scalability.
  
Drive technical direction for complex problems — evaluate alternatives, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and influence architecture decisions across components and teams.
  
Solve problems at the root — identify systemic causes rather than treating symptoms, and drive durable solutions that reduce recurring issues and technical debt.
  
Own outcomes, not just tasks — proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities and drive them to closure with minimal direction.
  
Solve complex problems across boundaries , collaborating with engineers, architects, product managers, and other teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
  
Raise the engineering bar through architecture and code reviews, performance optimization, testing, and engineering best practices.
  
Build for operational excellence with strong focus on performance, reliability, security, observability, maintainability, and efficient resource utilization.
  
Be a force multiplier — mentor engineers, share technical expertise, and establish patterns and practices that improve the broader engineering organization.
  
Leverage AI\-assisted engineering to accelerate development and problem solving, improve engineering workflows, and increase team productivity.
  
  

What You Need to Succeed
  
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
10\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience , with a strong track record of owning and delivering complex technical solutions.
  
Deep expertise in C\+\+ , including modern C\+\+, memory management, concurrency, multithreading, STL, and performance optimization.
  
Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, operating systems, and computer science fundamentals .

Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving ability , with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence technical decisions across teams.
