title: Senior Vice President - Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (CIP)
description:
Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (CIP), Pune


Senior Vice President


Pune, India


**About Infrastructure Technology**

The Global Infrastructure organization builds and maintains the critical technology backbone that enables Jefferies to operate at scale, delivering secure, resilient, and high\-performing IT services that power the business. We drive innovation through solutions such as cloud and hybrid adoption, network resiliency, platform modernization, and automation. The organization is structured into several specialized sub\-domains: Core Infrastructure Platform, Public Cloud, Digital Workspace, Networking, Telecom \& Multimedia, and International Infrastructure. Our teams collaborate globally to ensure Jefferies’ technology platforms are highly available, secure, scalable, and cost\-effective.


**Core Infrastructure Platforms**

The Core Infrastructure Platforms function lays the foundation for Jefferies’ IT, designing, operating, and optimizing the essential compute, storage, operating systems, and database platforms that support all business\-critical applications. Our mission is to deliver secure, resilient, and high\-performance datacenter and cloud solutions for global operations.


Organized into four teams, Global Systems Engineering, Unix Engineering, Windows Engineering, and Database Engineering, this group drives operational excellence, security, high availability, compliance, and continuous improvement across our technology estate.


By championing automation, standardization, and proactive monitoring, and by working closely with application, security, and business teams, we ensure our environments are robust, stable, and scalable. Through this collaborative approach and a relentless focus on modernization, Jefferies’ infrastructure remains agile and adaptable, ready to meet the evolving needs of our global business.


**Job Summary**

Jefferies is seeking a dynamic, hands\-on, and strategic Senior Vice President (SVP), Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (Pune). This executive technical leader will lead automation, operations, and modernization of Jefferies’ platform stack, with a focus on critical platform domains: databases, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, and Unix/Windows server infrastructure. Based in Pune, India, the SVP will lead the Pune CIP team and be accountable for technical excellence, operational resilience, and end\-to\-end Pune led delivery supporting the US, EMEA and APAC estate. This role reports to the Head of GCC, Pune (primary) and the Global Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms, Jersey City (secondary).


This is not a pure management or “middle\-layer” role. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on domain expert who remains technically current, acts as a trusted escalation point and decision\-maker, and independently resolves complex infrastructure and operational challenges rather than simply escalating them.


Success in this role comes from earning the trust of engineers and global business stakeholders through demonstrated technical mastery, incident command, and the delivery of solutions that enable strategic business outcomes. The position requires deep technical expertise paired with proven people leadership to build, mentor, and scale high\-performing teams supporting 24/7 capital markets operations.  



**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global Platform Leadership:** partner with global leads on the vision, engineering standards, and operational governance for Jefferies’ core infrastructure stack: database, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, Unix/Linux, and Windows server platforms, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* **Local Management of the Infrastructure Team:** direct managerial responsibilities for Infrastructure Technology team members located in the Jefferies Pune office (Networks, Telecom, Digital Workplace, Cloud, CIP, Service Delivery).
* **Modernization \& Cloud/Hybrid Adoption:** Drive modernization, cloud/hybrid adoption, automation\-first delivery, and standardization across all domains, balancing operational excellence with innovation and optimization. Lead strategic integration and optimal workload placement between on\-premises and cloud resources, as business and regulatory requirements permit.
* **Hands\-on Technical Escalation:** Serve as the final point of escalation and technical incident lead during major outages, performance, or security incidents. Analyze real\-time symptoms, ask the right diagnostic questions, and guide teams towards root\-cause resolution.
* **Solution Delivery:** Architect and deliver practical, high\-impact solutions for business and application teams, actively collaborating with CIO leadership, BU leads, and local metro SVPs/VPs worldwide.
* **Operational Resilience** : Own and continuously improve resilience, high\-availability, recovery, and compliance strategies across the global platform estate.
* **Global Team Development:** Partner with global leads in NYC, London, and HK to cultivate a high\-performing, distributed team of engineers and architects, primarily based in India. You will mentor leaders and engineers, promote end\-to\-end ownership, and develop problem\-solving capability.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Partner with business units, application teams, and senior platform leaders to align technical priorities, communicate platform direction, and enable local\-global business outcomes.
* **Technical Standards \& Documentation:** Author, maintain, and enforce robust operational standards, SLAs, playbooks, and knowledge base for platform operations and incident response.
* **Post\-Incident Review \& Learning:** Lead technical post\-mortems and deep\-dives, drive remediation, and foster a culture of continuous technical learning.
* **Regulatory \& Risk Alignment:** Execute robust security, compliance, vulnerability management, and audit readiness for mission\-critical infrastructure in a highly regulated financial services environment.

**Mandatory Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Experience:**
	+ 15\+ years in IT infrastructure/platform engineering and operations, with at least 5 years in global technical leadership (financial services or complex enterprise IT preferred).
	+ Proven recent, hands\-on experience with at least three of: database platforms (SQL/Oracle/etc), virtualization (VMware/Hyper\-V/KVM, Nutanix), storage (SAN/NAS), backup/DR, Unix/Linux, and Windows server engineering and operations.
	+ Track record as a solution owner, not just a conduit, able to independently architect and deliver technical outcomes in critical environments.
* **Core Competencies:**
	+ Deep technical expertise, able to lead troubleshooting, ask the right questions, synthesize technical indicators, and command resolution during platform issues and outages.
	+ Domain credibility, regarded by engineers and senior IT partners as the go\-to technical escalation contact.
	+ Record of driving platform modernization, cloud/hybrid/cloud adoption, automation, and cost/risk optimization.
	+ Strong foundation in regulatory, compliance, and operational risk management for infrastructure.
	+ Executive presence, able to command trust in both technical and business forums, and partner with C\-levels, application owners, and metro engineering leaders.
	+ Outstanding stakeholder management, communication, prioritization, and conflict resolution skills, on both local (India) and global scales.
	+ Experience designing and enforcing technical standards, SLAs, and incident management frameworks.
* **Certifications (optional, but valued):**Recognized certifications (RHCE, MCSE, VMware, Nutanix, NetApp, AWS/Azure/GCP, ITIL, etc.)  

	+

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent required; Master’s degree preferred.  

* 

**What Success Looks Like**

The SVP delivers a world\-class platform that serves as a resilient, secure, continuously modernizing backbone for all Jefferies business applications, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You lead actively, commanding incidents, delivering solutions, and growing your team’s technical and operational capability. You are trusted by engineers as a technical authority, by CIO/BU leaders as a business partner, and by the enterprise as the leader who enables robust, scalable solutions tightly aligned with the business's needs.  



**Equal Opportunity Employer:** Jefferies values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Global IT Platform Engineer Senior Specialist
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


The **Global Digital Marketing Automation Senior Specialist** is a deep, day\-to\-day expert in Marketo (or an equivalent platform such as Eloqua, Pardot, or HubSpot) who owns and optimizes our marketing automation engine. You’ll manage everything from advanced campaign builds and third\-party integrations to lead lifecycle strategy, event operations, and data governance — acting as the platform’s subject matter expert across the organization.


This is an ideal role for someone who has moved beyond basic email sends and wants to own the architecture, personalization, and performance of a marketing automation instance end\-to\-end.

 **Platform Management \& Campaign Execution**

* Manage, build, and optimize advanced Marketo core assets daily, including Smart Campaigns, Programs, Smart Lists, and flow logic
* Build and maintain universal, advanced Marketo Forms with progressive profiling, UTM parameter capture, hidden fields, and custom JavaScript for use across multiple workspaces
* Design and deploy standard landing page templates integrated with social sharing/network components
* Create reusable snippets for standardized footers and modular content blocks across landing pages and emails

 **Integrations \& Tech Stack**

* Integrate and manage third\-party platforms within Marketo, including webinar/virtual event tools (Zoom, ON24\), event registration platforms (Aventri, Certain), and mobile push notification channels
* Work with CRM platforms such as Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics, ensuring seamless lead/contact flow, field mapping, and sync configuration between Marketo and the CRM
* Troubleshoot CRM–Marketo sync issues (e.g., sync errors, field mismatches, duplicate records, blocked syncs) and implement fixes to maintain reliable, real\-time data flow \- Apply data enrichment practices — using enrichment tools, form\-based progressive profiling, and third\-party data append — to keep lead and contact records complete and up to date
* Demonstrate strong API familiarity, including configuring and managing API user roles/permissions, working with REST APIs for platform integrations, and troubleshooting API\- based data exchanges
* Test new services, integrations, and platform updates prior to launch

**Lead Lifecycle: Nurturing, Scoring \& Personalization**

* Build and maintain lead nurturing and lead scoring programs at both the global/instance level and individual campaign level
* Design and execute web personalization campaigns using dynamic content, web campaigns, and audience segments
* Develop lifecycle models and continuously refine scoring frameworks to improve lead quality and MQL conversion

**Data Management \& Segmentatio****n**

* Define and maintain audience segmentation strategies at both the client/account level and individual project level
* Own database hygiene, list imports, and data quality processes to maintain a clean, actionable database
* Support governance and documentation standards for data usage across programs

**Events \& Content Programs**

* Manage end\-to\-end program setup for trade shows, including personalized agendas and dynamic imagery per attendee/segment
* Build and manage webinar, online event, and gated content programs, including registration, reminder, and follow\-up flows
* Own program status tracking and post\-event hygiene (e.g., processing attendee/lead downloads, deduplication, list cleanup)

**Enablement, Governance \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as subject\-matter expert (SME) for the marketing automation platform, supporting troubleshooting, consultations, and new project readiness
* Provide training and documentation to internal teams, marketing ops representatives, and business stakeholders
* Partner with stakeholders to define requirements, governance standards, and rollout plans for new pilots or workspaces
* Support onboarding of new projects/workspaces onto the platform, including QA and functionality testing

  

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 4–7 years of hands\-on experience managing a marketing automation platform (Marketo strongly preferred; Eloqua, Pardot, or HubSpot experience also considered)
* Marketo Certified Expert certification preferred (or willingness to obtain)
* Proven experience building advanced Smart Campaigns, Programs, and multi\-step nurture/lead scoring logic
* Experience integrating Marketo with third\-party tools (webinar platforms, event management tools, CRM, mobile/push notification systems)
* Working knowledge of CRM platforms (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics), including lead/contact sync configuration and troubleshooting CRM–Marketo data flow issues
* Familiarity with data enrichment tools and practices to maintain accurate and complete records
* Strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and responsive/media\-query email template design
* Experience with progressive profiling, dynamic/personalized content, and web segmentation
* Solid understanding of database segmentation, list hygiene, and data governance best practices
* Experience managing event marketing programs (webinars, trade shows, gated content) end\-to\-end
* Familiarity with Git or a similar version control tool (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) for tracking changes to custom scripts, JavaScript used in forms/landing pages, and code\-based assets
* Nice to have:
* Experience with Zoom, ON24, Aventri, or Certain integrations
* Experience supporting global, multi\-region marketing operations
* Exposure to lifecycle model design and cross\-functional campaign governance
* A/B testing and campaign performance reporting experience
* Exposure to CI/CD deployment practices for managing and releasing code\-based assets (custom scripts, templates,
* integrations) in a structured, version\-controlled way

  

Who You'll Work With


You will work within a Global Digital Marketing Automation and Email platform team across multiple geographies, collaborating with business stakeholders, architects, and platform teams. This role offers the opportunity to directly shape internal tools used globally across BCG.

  

Additional info

**YOU'RE GOOD AT** :

* Working with APIs — understanding of REST API concepts, managing API user roles/permissions, and supporting API\-driven integrations
* Strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and responsive/media\-query email template design
* Strong communication skills with experience training stakeholders and documenting processes
* Detail\-oriented, process\-driven, and comfortable owning platform QA/testing before launches

 *"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*

*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*

*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."*

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

We are looking for a senior Microsoft Infrastructure Technical Architect with strong hands\-on expertise across enterprise Windows infrastructure, Active Directory, IIS, Microsoft SQL Server, Exchange Server, SCCM, Hyper\-V, VMware and associated datacenter technologies.

The role requires deep technical experience in designing, implementing, migrating, upgrading and troubleshooting mission\-critical on\-premise Microsoft infrastructure environments. title: Quality Executives
description:

**Company:** 
  Vashini Agro Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Location:** 
  Pollachi
 



**Employment:** 
  Full\-time, factory\-based
 



**Vacancies:** 
  2 positions
 



**About the role** 




 Quality in food manufacturing depends on people who notice the details, ask the right questions and follow through. At Vashini Agro, we are looking for Quality Executives who want to apply their knowledge and contribute to safe, consistent food production.
 



 You will join our Quality Assurance team and work closely with production and other departments, checking quality from incoming raw materials through to finished products. This role suits someone who enjoys practical work, values accurate records and is willing to speak up when something needs attention.
 



**Key responsibilities** 



* Inspect raw materials, in\-process materials and finished products against quality requirements.
* Conduct or support microbiological, physical and chemical testing, as applicable.
* Monitor hygiene, cleaning, sanitation and housekeeping practices on the factory floor.
* Check adherence to standard operating procedures, GMP, GHP, HACCP and food safety requirements.
* Maintain accurate inspection records, test reports and quality documentation.
* Identify and report quality or food safety concerns, and work with relevant teams to resolve them.
* Support investigations into customer complaints and non\-conformities, including corrective and preventive actions.
* Assist with internal and external audits, regulatory inspections and traceability activities.
* Coordinate with external laboratories when required.
* Contribute to practical improvements in quality and food safety.



**Qualifications** 




 A relevant qualification in Food Technology, Food Science or Microbiology, such as:
 


* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Microbiology or Food Science \& Technology.
* B.Tech. / M.Tech. in Food Technology.
* Other relevant food science or microbiology qualifications.



**Experience** 




 1–2 years of relevant experience in food processing, quality assurance, quality control, food testing or microbiology laboratories. Experience with fresh produce or food products is preferred.
 



**Freshers with strong relevant practical knowledge may also be considered.** 




**Required knowledge and skills** 



* Understanding of food safety, HACCP, GMP and GHP.
* Basic knowledge of microbiological testing and food quality parameters.
* Careful documentation and record maintenance.
* Basic working knowledge of MS Excel and MS Word.
* Clear communication and the ability to work with production and operations teams.
* Attention to detail, responsibility and a willingness to learn.
* Readiness to work in a factory environment and follow hygiene and safety procedures consistently.



**Why this work matters** 




 Your checks, records and observations help the team make informed decisions about food quality and safety. The role brings you close to the manufacturing process and provides opportunities to apply your technical knowledge to real production situations.
 



 We welcome candidates who take pride in doing work carefully, approach problems constructively and want to deepen their understanding of food manufacturing.

title: Data Intelligence Manager
description:
**Who we're looking for**



Fieldwire is looking for a Data Intelligence Manager to join our Data \& Operations team based in Pune, India. You will be the operational owner of reporting and analytics for a core business function (G\&A, R\&D, or GTM), turning raw data into accurate, timely, and trusted intelligence that drive decisions at the executive and departmental level. You will work closely with our Data Engineers, DIM Team Lead, and business partners to build dashboards, define KPIs, and maintain rigorous data quality. This role is critical to the integrity and scalability of our reporting landscape.


**What you'll be doing**


**The primary responsibilities for this role include:**


* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of non\-native dashboards for your assigned business function (G\&A, R\&D, or GTM), combining data across multiple source systems into a single, accurate view
* Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards and BI products (Power BI or equivalent), ensuring they are always live, accurate, and clearly documented
* Define and govern KPIs and performance metrics for your business area, ensuring consistent definitions across teams and regions
* Act as the primary business partner for stakeholders in your assigned function — translating business questions into analytical requirements and delivering clear, decision\-ready intelligence
* Conduct extensive QA on all data outputs: validate inputs, test transformations, reconcile outputs against source systems, and prevent conflicting or duplicate reporting
* Maintain a single source of truth for your reporting area, ensuring consistency across all dashboards and outputs
* Manage a release and change control process for dashboard updates — including testing, versioning, and stakeholder communication before any changes go live
* Monitor data quality continuously; detect and escalate anomalies, breaks, or integrity issues early
* Document all metrics, logic, and definitions clearly so that any stakeholder can understand what the data means and how it is calculated
* Contribute to cross\-training within the DIM team to ensure coverage and reduce single points of failure
* Support the DIM Team Lead and Director of Operations in roadmap planning and continuous improvement of the reporting landscape


**At Fieldwire, we're looking for our next Data Intelligence Manager to have the following skills and experiences:**


* 3\-5 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or data intelligence role
* Strong proficiency in SQL and hands\-on experience building dashboards in Power BI
* Experience working with large datasets across multiple systems and understanding how to combine them into coherent reporting
* Demonstrated ability to conduct rigorous QA on data outputs and maintain high standards of accuracy
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills — able to identify inconsistencies and root\-cause data issues independently
* Experience defining and governing KPIs and metrics frameworks

title: Lead Product Manager - Technical
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Lead Product Manager \- Technical
Who is Mastercard?
  

  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  

  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  

  

Overview
  

  

The Mastercard Dispute Lifecycle team in Pune have an exciting opportunity for a Lead Product Management \- Technical to help further enhance and modernize our Dispute management platform.  

  

The ideal candidate will quickly develop a deep technical understanding of the applications and systems they support, demonstrating a willingness to dive in, challenge assumptions, and ask thoughtful, probing questions to ensure plans are executed effectively and efficiently.  

  

They will bring a strong interest in Payments domain, along with proven technical leadership, and the ability to think creatively applying innovative, out\-of\-the\-box approaches to solve complex problems  

  

Role
  

  

* Customer obsession: Champion a deep understanding of customer needs, the broader ecosystem, and key market dynamics, and embed these insights into product decisions
* Systems analysis \& design: Develop an in\-depth understanding of the product platform and its surrounding ecosystem; produce high\-quality functional artifacts for Engineering, including data flows, sequence diagrams, APIs, and interface specifications
* Backlog management: Define and maintain a clear roadmap aligned to business objectives; translate system designs into well\-structured features and user stories that are ready for Engineering execution
* Story elaboration: Lead refinement sessions and create detailed, comprehensive acceptance criteria to ensure clarity and delivery readiness
* Technical analysis: Provide rigorous analysis of application software to validate that business and functional requirements can be effectively delivered
* Strategic alignment: Partner with stakeholders to ensure backlogs are prioritized and refined based on business value, impact, and measurable outcomes
* Agile mindset: Advocate for and model agile best practices across the product lifecycle—from defining epics to writing actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
* Continuous improvement: Measure outcomes, evaluate existing practices and metrics, and drive ongoing optimization across processes, roles, and delivery execution

  

All About You
  

  

* Proven product experience: Several years of product management or new product development experience delivering high\-quality products, with the ability to clearly articulate business context and customer use cases
* Technical product expertise: Experience managing highly technical platforms or API\-driven services, with strong software architecture and systems design knowledge
* ISO8583 knowledge (preferred): Familiarity with key payments and dispute management concepts is a plus
* Lean \& Agile delivery: Hands\-on experience with Lean product management and agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), along with CI/CD and modern DevOps practices
* End\-to\-end ownership: Demonstrated success delivering features from design through development, deployment, and customer integration
* Backlog management: Expertise in grooming epics, features, and user stories; defining clear acceptance and exit criteria; and effectively prioritizing platform backlogs
* Data\-driven decision making: Ability to define and leverage SMART metrics (leading and lagging) to guide product strategy and measure success
* Collaboration \& stakeholder management: Proven ability to work across global, cross\-functional teams, align diverse perspectives, and manage dependencies and co\-development opportunities
* Thrives in ambiguity: Comfortable navigating uncertainty; proactively identifies solutions, engages the right stakeholders, and drives clarity
* Continuous improvement \& communication: Committed to optimizing team processes for speed, quality, and innovation, with excellent written and verbal communication skills

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: AI Enterprise Product Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an **AI Enterprise Product Manager** to drive the next phase of evolution of our existing enterprise AI platform. The core platform and several major capabilities are already developed. The mandate for this role is to **enhance the product, improve user adoption, strengthen the subscription experience, identify product gaps and continuously evolve the platform based on customer usage and market requirements**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and continuously evolve the **product roadmap** for an existing AI enterprise platform.
* Deeply understand the current platform, its capabilities, user journeys and architecture, and identify opportunities for **enhancement, simplification and better adoption**.
* Translate customer feedback, usage patterns, sales inputs and market developments into clearly prioritized product improvements.
* Improve the overall **user journey from signup and onboarding to activation, regular usage, subscription and expansion**.
* Enhance the platform's **subscription model**, including plans, feature entitlements, trials, upgrades, usage controls and monetization opportunities.
* Identify friction in the product and improve **self\-service adoption and time\-to\-value**.
* Work closely with engineering and AI teams to enhance existing capabilities and introduce new features without unnecessarily increasing product complexity.
* Evaluate whether customer requirements should become **reusable platform capabilities** rather than customer\-specific implementations.
* Define detailed **PRDs, user stories, workflows, acceptance criteria and release priorities**.
* Own prioritization across **product enhancements, customer requirements, technical improvements and strategic platform capabilities**.
* Define and track key product metrics including **activation, feature adoption, trial conversion, paid conversion, retention, usage and expansion**.
* Use product analytics and customer behavior to identify underused capabilities, adoption bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct regular customer and user discovery to validate product decisions and identify emerging requirements.
* Work closely with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to ensure alignment between **product capabilities, packaging, positioning and customer expectations**.
* Continuously track developments across **Enterprise AI, AI agents, agentic platforms and enterprise SaaS** and translate relevant developments into product decisions.

**Required Skills** 

* Strong experience in **B2B SaaS or enterprise product management**.
* Strong understanding of **subscription\-based SaaS products**, including onboarding, trials, plans, entitlements, upgrades and usage\-based/product\-tier monetization.
* Good understanding of **enterprise software, workflows and business processes**.
* Practical understanding of **Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents and agentic workflows**.
* Strong ability to evaluate an existing product and identify **UX, capability, adoption and monetization gaps**.
* Ability to distinguish between a **customer\-specific requirement and a scalable platform capability**.
* Strong experience with **product discovery, roadmap prioritization, PRDs, user stories and release management**.
* Understanding of SaaS/product metrics including **activation, conversion, retention, churn, engagement and expansion**.
* Ability to work closely with engineering teams and understand **APIs, integrations, data flows and platform concepts**.
* Strong analytical, customer\-discovery and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to operate with significant ownership in a **fast\-moving product environment**.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business or a related discipline**.
* **2–4 years of overall product management experience**, preferably in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
* Demonstrable experience managing and **evolving an existing software product or platform**, rather than only launching greenfield products.
* Experience working with a **subscription\-based SaaS product** with multiple plans or tiers.
* Experience improving **product adoption, onboarding, engagement and conversion**.
* Prior exposure to **AI/Generative AI, enterprise automation, workflow platforms or developer platforms** is strongly preferred.
* Experience taking a product from **early\-stage development to customer adoption and commercial scale** would be a significant advantage.
* Prior experience working with an **enterprise SaaS startup or product company** is preferred.

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**About dunnhumby**



dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca\-Cola, Meijer, Procter \& Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.


**Product**



Our Product team owns the vision, strategy and roadmap for the dunnhumby platform — the data, science and software that powers retailers and brands around the world. We work at the intersection of customer data, AI, and commercial impact, building products that turn insight into measurable growth.


**The Role**



The Senior Product Analyst plays a key role in helping us build better products through data\-driven decision making. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers, you'll transform complex product data into actionable insights that shape product strategy, improve user experiences and drive measurable business outcomes.



You'll champion product analytics across our product teams, enabling experimentation, establishing best practices and ensuring decisions are backed by meaningful data.


**What You'll Be Doing**



You'll combine analytical expertise, product knowledge and stakeholder collaboration to deliver insights that influence product direction and maximise customer value.


* Own product analytics across a portfolio of products, defining key metrics and ensuring they are measured, reported and understood effectively
* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers and Product Designers to support product strategy, objectives and key results (OKRs)
* Identify opportunities to improve product performance through data analysis, experimentation and evidence\-based recommendations
* Work closely with Data Engineers and product squads to ensure the right data is captured, modelled and available for meaningful analysis
* Deliver end\-to\-end analytics, from defining requirements and success metrics through to presenting insights and recommendations to stakeholders
* Build, maintain and continuously improve product performance dashboards that provide clear, actionable visibility into product health
* Support product discovery, roadmap planning and experimentation by providing data\-driven insights and commercial context
* Leverage multiple data sources to identify trends, answer business questions and uncover new opportunities for product improvement
* Continuously improve analytics practices, reporting tools, data visualisation and automation to enable faster, more effective decision making
* Communicate insights clearly through compelling data visualisation and storytelling tailored to technical and non\-technical audiences


**What We're Looking For**



You'll bring strong analytical capability, curiosity and a passion for using data to solve product challenges while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.


* Experience in product analytics, product management, product ownership or a similar analytics\-focused role within a software or technology environment
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting complex data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations
* Experience working with cross\-functional product teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers
* Knowledge of product metrics, experimentation, performance measurement and product analytics best practices
* Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through effective data visualisation and storytelling
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision making through data
* Understanding of statistical analysis, product performance measurement and commercial drivers
* Experience on Heap,Fullstory or Amplitude
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification


**What You Can Expect From Us**



We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.



And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process — please let your recruiter know what adjustments would help.


**India Benefits**


* Healthcare \& Family Cover: Group Medical Insurance of INR 500,000 for employees and dependents, plus dental and vision cover up to INR 5,000\.
* Protection: Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover with benefit levels linked to employee grade, including disability benefits.
* Retirement \& Wellbeing: Provident Fund, Gratuity, National Pension Scheme access, Indian Health Organisation membership, and confidential employee assistance support.
* Lifestyle \& Flexibility: Office commute support, internet allowance of INR 2,000 per month for blended working, work\-from\-home kit support, subsidised food, and wellbeing resources.
* Recognition \& Extras: Long service awards, Talent Scout referral programme, and family milestone support.
* Time Off \& Family Leave: 25 days holiday plus 10 public holidays, paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and a day off for your birthday.


**Our approach to Flexible Working**



At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.



We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.



For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found(here)

:
**Job Summary**
---------------

As a Relationship Manager, you'll be responsible for managing and developing relationships with clients of International Banking to drive business growth and meet the bank's strategic objectives. You’ll help clients set wealth goals, manage investments, and create portfolios for long\-term growth and stability. You’ll be supported by specialists in the areas of investment, insurance, products and treasury to provide clients with comprehensive solutions.
  

This is an opportunity for you to demonstrate your relationship management, sales, customer service and communications skills. Our Relationship Managers can advance their careers across client segments or explore roles across Wealth and Retail Banking.


**About Wealth and Retail Banking**  

We service more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment which encompasses Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.


We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East, and our deep local presence and international network enables us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross\-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product propositions span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.


We’re investing USD $1\.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within Standard Chartered Group.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

• Support our clients to meet their financial needs, as they progress through their career and life\-stages.
  

• Build relationships for the long\-term and understand clients’ financial needs and aspirations to grow, manage and protect their wealth, with appropriate investment solutions.
  

• Stay ahead of the market and get regular market updates and investment insights from our Chief Investment Office (CIO) to share with clients.
  

• Leverage myWealth digital and help clients to create custom portfolios, check performance and asset allocation based on CIO’s advice.
  

• Provide outstanding client experiences.


**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

• A minimum of 2 years of experience in client acquisition, relationship management and retail banking.
  

• Technical knowledge and expertise in consumer banking products (i.e. Treasury, Equities, Funds, Insurance, etc.).
  

• Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship building skills.
  

• Ability to learn new products and services quickly.
  

• Ability to work in a flexible and agile way.
  

• Self\-starters and team players who enjoy working in an international environment.
  

• Excellent local language skills, client networks and experience.
  

• Maintains a high standard of personal conduct and lives our valued behaviours.


**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.


Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.


Together we:


* **Do the right thing** and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* **Never settle,** continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* **Are better together,** we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
**What we offer**
-----------------

**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.


* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance,** with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* **Time\-off** including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* **Flexible working** options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* **Proactive wellbeing support** through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* **A continuous learning culture** to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation,** one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Senior Associate, Treasures Relationship Manager, Consumer Banking Group
description:
**Business Function**

As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions across 600 branches across the country. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits (incl. structured solutions for NRI), investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage.


**Job Purpose**

* To deliver exceptional volume and revenue performance by acquiring and engaging with DBS
* Treasures clients having an AUM \=\> INR 20 Million through “need\-based approach\” and ensure client coverage and product penetration through cross\-sell and up\-sell of DBS products and services.
* To manage \& maintain the highest customer satisfaction and service levels through pro\-active client engagement \& relationship management, coordinating internally with DBS Service and Distribution and Product team

**Key Accountabilities**

* Acquire and upgrade quality Treasures clients in the branch location areas
* Engage with existing customers to deepen the wallet share through retention and growth of AUM.
* Accountable for achieving monthly \& annual volume and revenue objective, as agreed.
* Ensure activation of e\-Channels (I\-Banking / M\-Banking/ Online MF/Debit Card) and Savings Book growth
* Ensure proper implementation \& execution of product strategies through effective relationship management.
* Develop the client trust and loyalty for entrenched relationship with DBS through lifestyle and beyond banking propositions
* Ensure optimum product mix and new\- to\- product clients aimed at customer level profitability and enhancing client coverage.
* Drive and deliver exemplary customer service in the local market and uphold DBS service standards.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance through strict adherence to DBS sales process, timely risk reviews and exercising due diligence while on\-boarding.
* Ensure exemplary service delivery of these clients by building appropriate workflows and processes incl. doorstep banking etc.

**Job Duties \& responsibilities**

* Establish, manage and grow the AUM of the elite Treasures Client segment by acquiring and nurturing the client having AUM \=\> INR 10 M
* Ensure timely portfolio review by jointly engaging with Wealth / Investment / Insurance specialist with clients.
* Ensure complete knowledge of all products \& services through continuous skill and knowledge improvement.
* Resolve customer queries and complaints within the agreed TAT as per the DBS customer service policy.
* Provide feedback on market, competition and products, suggest innovations \& ideas for continuous product and service improvements.
* Keep attuned to the current economic and financial markets to be current and proficient to ensure effective engagement with the elite segment of Treasures customers.
* Coordinate and work closely with CBG Relationship Manager peer groups and colleagues, Service teams, Product specialist at branches to ensure that team objectives are met through an environment that nurtures harmony and collaboration through team work
* Work closely with the Line Manager and City / Cluster Head to ensure achievement of common team and Branch objectives.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance and address operational risks if any, e.g. Health \& Safety standards, security of premises, AML / KYC and ongoing risk reviews.
* To exercise appropriate due diligence while on\-boarding and engaging with clients.
* Establish DBS as a primary banker for clients and as a prominent wealth management provider in India.
* Organize exclusive lifestyle, sports , music and such other elite engagement events and activities for prospect generation , entrench existing relationship and reinforce the DBS brand in the Private Wealth management space

**Requirements:**

* Sound understanding of financial planning and wealth management products in India
* In\-depth knowledge of local market and competition.
* AMFI / IRDAI / FEDAI certified candidates with BCSBI certification would be an added advantage

**Education / Preferred Qualifications**

* Graduate / Post Graduate with MBA in relevant field

**Core Competencies**

* Effective probing and listening skills.
* Strong Relationship Management and influencing skills
* Self\-driven and ambitious.
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Results\-orientated \& the ability to deliver results under pressure
* Understanding of competitive positioning
* Strong service orientation, customer\-centric behavior.
* Focused on developing image and good will of the brand
* Creative, inquisitive mind with problem solving abilities.
* Ability to deliver results within tight timelines.
* Attention to details, analyzing abilities.

**Technical Competencies**

* Understanding of HNI Sales/ wealth management product suite, platforms and operational procedures
* Understanding of banking and para\-banking guidelines issued by RBI (local regulations in India) and local laws and regulations that impact businesses in general.
* Understanding of KYC requirements \& Anti\-money Laundering Policies.
* Knowledge of financial markets and products to assist in meaningful engagement with clients.

**Work Relationship**

* Management of clients and prospects for acquisition and deepening of wallet share.
* Close interaction with Treasures Elite Team Leader, City / Cluster Head, Branch Service and Operations team to ensure consistent delivery of volume and revenue targets.
* Close and regular interaction with Branch Product specialists for effective skill / knowledge development of self and explore potential in existing book through joint engagement with clients.

**Mandatory Training**

* GCAP (Group Customer Acceptance Policy)
* BCAP (Business Customer Acceptance Policy)
* AML (Anti Money Laundering) and KYC Guidelines
* PIP (Personal Investment Policy)
* ORM (Operational Risk Management)
* Information Security Policy

**DBS India \- Culture \& Behaviors**

* Performance through Value Based Propositions
* Ensure customer focus by delighting customers \& reduce complaints
* Build pride and passion to protect, maintain and enhance DBS’ image and reputation
* Enhance knowledge base, build skill sets \& develop competencies
* Execute at speed while maintaining error free operations
* Maintain the highest standards of honesty and integrity.

Kolkata\-DBIL
**Job:**

Relationship Management
**Schedule:**

Regular

Full time

description:
**Job Requirements**  

Site Engineer must ensure safe, correct, and timely **installation of DG sets, panels, fuel system, exhaust system, earthing, and cabling** as per approved drawings, standards, and safety norms. **Data Centre experience is preferred**.

  

* Pre\-Site Preparation \& Resource Readiness – Verify approved drawings, layouts, P\&IDs, piping/cable schedules, and ensure site readiness, manpower safety induction, tools, lifting equipment, testing kits, and PPE availability before mobilization.
* Material Handling \& Equipment Installation – Inspect and verify receipt/storage of DG sets, heat exchangers, pumps, cooling towers, piping, valves, and accessories; carry out proper installation, alignment, levelling, grouting, and mounting of DG sets and associated equipment as per approved drawings.
* Mechanical System Installation – Execute installation of exhaust, fuel, water cooling, and piping systems including silencers, insulation, flexible joints, valves, strainers, NRVs, vents, drains, supports, expansion loops, and hydro/pressure testing of pipelines.
* Cooling Water \& Cooling Tower Integration – Install and commission heat exchangers, cooling water/raw water pumps, cooling tower structures, piping connections, gauges, VFD/starter panels, and ensure proper alignment, rotation checks, water quality, and chemical dosing systems.
* Electrical, Cabling \& Earthing Works – Install AMF/synchronizing panels, lay and terminate LT/HT cables, verify control wiring/interlocks for DG–HE–Pump–CT systems, conduct IR tests, and ensure proper earthing/bonding with resistance monitoring and logs.
* Pre\-Commissioning \& Testing Activities – Perform leak tests, hydrotests, insulation tests, alignment and rotation checks, verify oil/coolant/fuel/battery conditions, confirm relay settings, alarms, interlocks, and sensor feedback systems before commissioning.
* Safety, Compliance \& Project Documentation – Ensure adherence to PPE, PTW, rigging, welding, fire safety, MSDS, and site safety practices while maintaining daily logs, installation/test reports, inspection clearances, as\-built drawings, and final handover**.**

  

**Work Experience**  

Site Execution, Erection Management, Testing \& Commissioning, Contractor Management, Project Planning

--------------------



To be a driven business analyst who can work on complex Analytical problems and help the customer in better business decision making especially in the area of pharma/life sciences (domain).


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Role Overview**



The Snowflake Developer is responsible for building and optimizing data pipelines and analytical datasets within a Snowflake\-based data lakehouse. This role also includes leveraging **Snowflake Cortex** to enable AI\-driven data transformations, natural language processing, and intelligent data applications directly within the data platform.



**Key Responsibilities**


**1\. Data Ingestion \& Integration**


* Develop and maintain scalable data ingestion pipelines (batch and near real\-time).
* Load data from databases, APIs, files, and streaming systems into Snowflake.
* Handle structured and semi\-structured data (JSON, Parquet, Avro, CSV).
* Integrate Snowflake with cloud storage platforms (S3, Azure Data Lake, GCS).


**2\. Data Transformation (ELT)**


* Build ELT pipelines using Snowflake SQL and native features (Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables).
* Implement transformations across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers.
* Use tools like dbt for modular, reusable, and testable transformations.


**3\. Snowflake Cortex \& AI Enablement**


* Leverage **Snowflake Cortex** functions within SQL for AI\-powered transformations.
* Implement use cases such as:
* + Text summarization of large datasets (logs, documents)
	+ Sentiment analysis and classification
	+ Natural language enrichment of datasets
* Work with vector embeddings and similarity search for semantic use cases.
* Assist in building AI\-ready datasets for downstream analytics and ML.
* Collaborate with data scientists to integrate AI/ML logic into Snowflake pipelines.
* Support simple **prompt engineering** within Cortex functions for optimized outputs.


**4\. Data Modeling**


* Design and implement analytical data models (star schema, snowflake schema).
* Build fact and dimension tables optimized for BI and AI use cases.
* Ensure datasets are structured for both analytics and AI consumption.


**5\. Performance \& Cost Optimization**

title: Construction project coordinator
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

uniqside is an architectural, interior and construction company based in Kochi. We deliver residential and commercial fit\-out and civil projects end to end \- design, estimation, procurement and execution.

We are looking for a Project Manager who can own a project from handover of drawings to final client sign\-off. You will be the single point of accountability for programme, cost, quality and site discipline across two or more live projects at a time. This is a hands\-on site role, not a desk role.

We are not fixed on a number of years. Show us the projects you have delivered and we will judge on that.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Planning and programme

\- Prepare and maintain project schedules in MS Project or Primavera; set milestones, track the critical path and issue look\-ahead plans

\- Run weekly site review meetings and circulate daily and weekly progress reports (DPR/WPR)

\- Flag slippage early with a recovery plan, not after the deadline has passed

Cost, BOQ and billing

\- Review and validate BOQs, quantity take\-offs and rate analyses before work is released

\- Control project cost against the approved budget; track variations and get them approved in writing

\- Certify contractor and vendor bills, check measurements at site, and coordinate client billing

Procurement and vendors

\- Plan material requirements against the programme so nothing stops site

\- Float enquiries, compare quotations, negotiate and place orders with vendors and subcontractors

\- Manage subcontractor scope, deployment and performance \- carpentry, joinery, modular, painting, flooring, MEP

Site execution and quality

\- Read and interpret working drawings, GFC drawings and shop drawings; resolve drawing queries with the design team

\- Supervise execution to drawing, specification and finish standard; carry out snagging and de\-snagging

\- Enforce housekeeping and site safety; maintain measurement books, registers and photo records

Client and stakeholder management

\- Be the client's main contact through execution \- updates, approvals, material and finish selections

\- Coordinate with architects, consultants, structural and MEP teams

\- Manage handover: as\-built documentation, warranties, completion certificate and closing the final account

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Essential qualification

\- M.Tech / M.E. in Civil Engineering \- Structural Engineering, Construction Engineering and Management, or a related civil specialisation

\- B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering at undergraduate level

Applications without an M.Tech in a civil discipline will not be considered for this role.

Also essential

\- Experience managing construction or interior fit\-out projects, with a period of independent site responsibility

\- A record of delivering projects to programme and budget \- be ready to talk us through two of yours

\- Working knowledge of AutoCAD, MS Project or Primavera, and MS Excel

\- Confident reading working and shop drawings and taking site measurements

\- Fluent Malayalam and English

\- Two\-wheeler or car with a valid licence, for site visits

Preferred

\- Turnkey interior fit\-out, modular furniture or joinery\-heavy projects

\- Exposure to MEP coordination

\- Experience handling client billing and final accounts

\- Published research or a dissertation in construction management, structures or project delivery

Who fits here

Someone who chases a delay the same day they see it, who is comfortable telling a client an uncomfortable truth early, and who keeps paperwork clean without being asked. We are a growing company \- you will have real ownership and the freedom to fix a process that is not working.

WHAT WE OFFER

\- Salary negotiable, based on experience and the projects you have delivered

\- Direct exposure to the leadership team and a real say in how projects are run

\- Growing project pipeline across residential and commercial interiors

TO APPLY

Apply through Indeed with your CV. Please state your M.Tech specialisation and institution, and include the project value, duration and your specific role for two projects you have delivered.

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Are you passionate about leading complex embedded software programs at the intersection of hardware and software? We are looking for an experienced **Embedded Software Project Manager** with deep expertise in **Device Driver development** and a proven ability to navigate low\-level hardware constraints while driving end\-to\-end project execution.  

Your role  

Key responsibilities in your new role

  

* An Embedded Software Project Manager specializing in Device Drivers must possess a unique hybrid skillset, bridging the gap between low\-level hardware constraints and high\-level project execution.
* They are responsible for managing timelines, cross\-functional teams, and the architectural risks inherent to low\-level hardware abstraction.

  

Your profile  

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  

* A Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science
* 8\+ years of total experience in embedded systems, including at least 3\+ years in a technical leadership or project management role.
* A proven track record of designing, developing, and debugging device drivers
* Standard PM credentials like PMP (Project Management Professional) or Certified Scrum Master (CSM) are highly preferred.
* Ability to manage project dependencies where code cannot be completed or tested until silicon, prototypes, or Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) simulators are ready
* Proficiency in mixing Agile methodologies (for iterative driver features) with Waterfall milestones (aligned with rigid physical hardware tape\-outs and manufacturing deadlines)
* Defining alternative timelines if custom chips or silicon samples arrive late or display physical defects.
* Managing specialized engineers (e.g., separating the application layer team from the hardware abstraction layer team).

title: Release Train Engineer
description:
About This Role
**5 years of experience**  

**Skills: SAFe 5, RTE, PI Planning, ART Sync, Stakeholder Engagement, Agile, Banking, Capital Markets, DevOps, Jira/confluence**

**About the Role** We are looking for an experienced Release Train Engineer (RTE) with 5\+ years of experience to lead and facilitate Agile Release Train (ART) delivery You will serve as a servant leader and coach for the ART — facilitating PI Planning, managing cross\-team dependencies, removing impediments, and driving continuous improvement across the delivery organisation. Banking and capital markets domain experience is essential for this role — enabling you to engage credibly with business stakeholders, understand regulatory delivery constraints, and navigate the governance frameworks of a complex financial services environment.


**Key Responsibilities**


ART Facilitation \& Delivery


* Facilitate and coordinate all ART\-level ceremonies — PI Planning, ART Sync, System Demos, and Inspect \& Adapt workshops — ensuring effective cross\-team alignment and programme increment delivery.
* Manage and coordinate delivery across two squads of 7 — ensuring teams are aligned to PI objectives, dependencies are managed, and risks are identified and mitigated proactively.
* Track and manage ART\-level programme board — maintaining visibility of features, dependencies, risks, and milestones across both squads throughout each programme increment.
* Facilitate cross\-team dependency resolution — identifying blockers, coordinating between squads, and escalating impediments that cannot be resolved at team level.
* Support squad\-level Scrum Masters — providing coaching, guidance, and facilitation support to ensure effective Agile ceremonies and team delivery rhythms.
* Monitor and report ART\-level delivery metrics — velocity, predictability, feature completion, and PI objective achievement — providing clear, evidence\-based progress updates to programme leadership.
* Coordinate System Demo preparation and execution — ensuring both squads deliver integrated, demonstrable working software at the end of each programme increment.

Continuous Improvement \& Coaching


* Lead Inspect \& Adapt workshops — facilitating structured retrospectives at ART level, identifying systemic improvement opportunities, and driving measurable delivery improvement.
* Coach squads, Product Owners, and stakeholders on SAFe principles, Agile practices, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Champion DevOps and continuous delivery practices — supporting squads in improving build, test, and deployment automation to accelerate feature delivery.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and psychological safety across both squads — enabling high\-performing, self\-organising teams.

Stakeholder Management \& Governance


* Act as the primary ART\-level communication interface — providing regular, clear delivery status updates to programme managers, product leadership, and senior stakeholders.
* Manage relationships with Business Owners, Product Management, and key stakeholders — facilitating business engagement in PI Planning, System Demos, and governance forums.
* Contribute to portfolio\-level planning — providing ART capacity, dependency, and risk inputs to support programme and portfolio prioritisation decisions.
* Support risk and compliance governance — ensuring ART delivery activities align to organisational delivery standards, change management processes, and regulatory requirements within a banking and capital markets environment.
* Maintain ART\-level documentation — PI plans, programme boards, risk registers, and retrospective action logs.

**What We're Looking For**


* 5\+ years of experience in Agile delivery roles — Scrum Master, RTE, or Agile Coach — with at least 2–3 years as a Release Train Engineer in a SAFe environment.


* Deep SAFe expertise — PI Planning facilitation, ART coordination, programme board management, and Inspect \& Adapt — with proven ability to lead ARTs of 10–15\+ people.


* **Banking and capital markets domain experience — essential** — understanding of financial services delivery constraints, regulatory governance, and capital markets technology programmes.


* Experience managing cross\-team dependencies and delivery coordination across multiple squads in fast\-paced programme delivery environments.


* Strong servant leadership and coaching skills — supporting Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and squad members in Agile best practices.


* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — engaging senior business and technology stakeholders with clear, concise ART\-level delivery reporting.


* Proficiency with Agile tooling — Jira, Confluence, Miro — for PI planning, programme board management, and delivery reporting.


* Strong facilitation skills — leading large\-group PI Planning events, System Demos, and Inspect \& Adapt workshops with energy, structure, and impact.


* Good understanding of DevOps and continuous delivery practices — supporting squads in improving automation and deployment frequency.


* Strong analytical mindset — interpreting ART delivery metrics and driving data\-informed continuous improvement.


**Nice to Have**


* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE) certification — SAFe 5 or SAFe 6\.
* SAFe Programme Consultant (SPC) certification.
* Experience in capital markets technology programmes — trade reporting, regulatory platforms, market data, or trading systems delivery.
* Familiarity with LPM (Lean Portfolio Management) and portfolio\-level Agile governance.
* Experience with scaled Agile tooling — Jira Align, Rally, or equivalent ART\-level planning tools.
* Agile coaching certification — ICP\-ACC or equivalent.
* Exposure to regulatory delivery programmes — MiFID II, EMIR, APRA, or equivalent financial services regulatory change.

title: Advance Power-Point & UI/UX Designer
description:

title: Website Manager
description:
**Organisation Name:** 
 One World One Family Mission
 



**Job Title:** 
 Website Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Muddenahalli, Karnataka
 



  





**About Us:** 




 One World One Family Mission provides free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare to those in need across 100 countries. Under the visionary leadership of the globally acclaimed humanitarian, Sadguru Sri Madhusudan Sai, the Organisation is dedicated to uplifting the most marginalised communities. The mission is grounded in the ethos of selfless service, guided by the belief that all are a part of ‘One World, One Family’.
 



  





**About the Mission’s websites** 



1. Mission Website \- The Mission has its own website which provides an overview of the mission and the member organisations worldwide. This is managed by the Mission Website Team.



  




1. Parent Trusts and Foundations \- In addition to this, there are parent trusts and foundations in India that primarily focus on specific verticals (Health, Education, Nutrition). Many of these organisations have their own websites, which are managed by dedicated website teams, while others are managed by the Mission Website Team.



  




1. Institutional Websites \- The Mission also manages multiple institutions such as Hospitals, Schools, Colleges and Universities. The Mission Website Team provides advice, guidance and instructions on the content, branding, function and usability of these sites.



  




1. Country Websites \- For countries in which our organisation has a presence, some of them have their own websites. Many of these countries do not have a website. However, for those that do, their websites are managed by local teams. The Mission Website Team provides advice, guidance and instructions on the content, branding, function and usability of these sites.



  





 The Mission is currently undergoing a rebranding phase wherein we are consolidating and enhancing the existing websites to ensure that it is clear to website visitors that all these websites fall under one Mission.
 



  





**Position Description** 




 The Website Manager will be responsible for the management, maintenance and enhancement of the key websites under the
 **One World One Family Mission** 
 . The role will ensure that all websites remain accurate, up\-to\-date, secure, user\-friendly, and aligned with the mission's vision, values, and objectives.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Website Management \& Operations** 



* Manage and oversee all websites under the One World One Family Mission.
* Ensure websites are regularly updated with relevant and accurate content.
* Monitor website functionality, performance, and availability.
* Maintain consistency in design, branding, content, and user experience across all mission websites.
* Implement website enhancement initiatives and support new website launches when required.
* For mission websites that are managed by other individuals and parties, the Website Manager is responsible for providing support, guidance and instructions to ensure that these websites maintain a standard of care, quality and professionalism and are in line with the Mission’s branding guidelines.
* Initiate and manage a dashboard or ticketing system for managing website updates.



**2\. Content Management** 



* Coordinate with departments, project teams, and content owners to collect and publish website content.
* Establish a systematic review process to ensure information remains current and relevant.
* Update news, events, announcements, programs, reports, and other digital content regularly.
* Ensure content follows organisational guidelines and quality standards.
* In areas where there are no existing processes or guidelines, the Website Manager is responsible for defining and developing new processes/guidelines.



**3\. Stakeholder Coordination** 



* Act as the central point of contact for all website\-related requirements.
* Collaborate with mission leaders, departments, partners, and external vendors for website updates and improvements.
* Gather stakeholder requirements and translate them into actionable website enhancements.
* Facilitate periodic review meetings to address website needs and priorities.



**4\. Website Governance \& Quality Assurance** 



* Conduct regular audits of website content, links, forms, and functionality.
* Ensure compliance with organisational standards, accessibility requirements, and digital best practices.
* Maintain documentation related to website structures, processes, and update logs.
* Ensure information accuracy and consistency across all websites.



**5\. Technical Coordination** 



* Liaise with developers, hosting providers, and IT teams for website maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Monitor website security, backups, software updates, and performance optimization.
* Coordinate implementation of new features, integrations, and technical improvements.
* Ensure timely resolution of technical issues affecting website operations.



**6\. Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Monitor website traffic, engagement, and performance metrics.
* Generate periodic reports on website usage and effectiveness.
* Provide recommendations to improve user experience, engagement, and website performance.
* Track the impact of digital initiatives and content updates.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Digital Media, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
* 8\-10 years of experience in website management, digital communications, or related roles, including at least 2 years in a role leading or supervising a team.
* Extensive experience working with Content Management Systems (CMS) such as WordPress or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with website analytics and digital marketing tools.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Strong organisational and project management skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Strong working knowledge of website technologies, hosting, and security practices, sufficient to liaise confidently with developers and IT teams and troubleshoot issues independently where possible. Solid understanding of SEO, accessibility standards, and digital best practices.
* Able to work on tight deadlines to ensure websites are updated on a timely basis, and establish/adhere to agreed SLA timelines.
* Demonstrated experience managing and developing a small team, including delegating responsibilities, setting priorities, and building team capability over time.
* Able to confidently communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
* Able to collaborate with other teams, including the content team, institutional leadership, design team, branding team and social media team.
* Able to manage multiple websites and priorities simultaneously.



  





**Location/Work Environment:** 
 This is a full\-time on\-site job role.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




  





 Joining the OWOF mission offers a chance to impact marginalized communities globally. With a focus on free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare across 100 countries, your efforts directly contribute to positive change. Being part of our mission means experiencing the joy of helping others and knowing your contributions bring happiness to those in need.
